data.name: Batoo
data.detailed_description:
Based on a dismissed police report, BATOO is a story-driven psychological horror FPS set in the remote forests of Parbat, Nepal during 1958 BS—an era before electricity reached these isolated villages.

Key Features

Atmospheric First-Person Horror
Story Driven Gameplay
Psychological Horror Mechanics
Immersive Exploration
Survival Elements

What Makes It Unique

  • Authentic Cultural Setting: Experience rural Nepal in 1958 BS, capturing the isolation and superstitions of the era.

  • Ambiguous Reality: Question whether the character's account is reliable testimony or the ravings of a traumatized mind.

  • Framed Narrative: The story unfolds through police documents being read in present day, adding layers of mystery.

Atmospheric Tension: Focus on dread and psychological horror over cheap jump scares.

Content Warning

This game contains themes of psychological distress, isolation, and disturbing imagery that may not be suitable for all players.

data.name: Ace Marks the Spot
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Ace Marks the Spot!!! This is a relaxing blend of simple card-clicking strategy and awesome monster hunting. Designed as a methodical, slow-burn experience, this is a game about embracing the grind and watching your power steadily grow.

You begin your journey empty-handed, gathering materials and scattered doubloons. Once you’ve scraped together enough stuff, you can buy your first weapon -- or forge it yourself at the Smithy. Armed and ready, set sail across 5 Islands to hunt down crazy beasts.

There are no game-overs, health bars, or tight inputs to worry about here; you are immortal. The true challenge lies in your efficiency. Monsters won't attack you, but they will flee if you can't deal enough damage in X rounds of solitaire, leaving you empty handed. Clear an island of its beasts to unlock new lands, craft deadlier weapons, encounter stronger monsters, and uncover a few dope things along the way.

 Lances are reliable, and come with toggleable Combo Armor which will prevent your combo from breaking on card draw or misclick! Lances can string together massive combos with ease!

 Staves are tricky, and they boast the ability to Undo your most recent action, including combo breaks! They also Crit super hard on every 3rd/6th/9th+ hit in a combo!

 Greatswords are mighty and opportunistic, leading to colossal damage when clearing the final card in a column! With a bit of skill, effort, timing, and luck, you can deal some truly devastating blows!

 Bows are quick and fearsome in the right hands! Playing your cards quickly with a bow can result in Speed Crits, which can really reward a rapid and active player!

With over 50 weapons to buy, craft, and obtain, you're sure to find at least one to love!

This game's soundtrack consists of one song, made by zKevin. It's a banger that'll be stuck in your head forever! I promise!!

[Inspired by Pocket Card Jockey]

data.name: Bubble Battle
data.detailed_description:
BUBBLE BURSTING

Bubble Battle is designed for those craving an online/local party game experience reminiscent of the 80's and 90's. 

Players fly around with one simple objective: burst opponents’ bubbles before they burst yours. Collect powerups and out-maneuver opponents for fast-paced, addictive fun!

BATTLE YOUR FRIENDS ONLINE

Battle it out with up to 4 players online or locally.

TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS

Enjoy 2 v 2 or a balanced 1 v 2 team mode.

COLLECT POWERUPS AND WIN

Use powerups to burst opponents' bubbles.

FEATURES

  • Online lobby system - play friends or strangers in your region

  • Easy to pick up and play thanks to simple controls

  • Quick gameplay - rounds are usually less than 2 minutes (the arena becomes smaller toward the end of a round)

  • A selection of variants, powerups, and levels deliver many unique experiences

data.name: Puppy Chef Academy
data.detailed_description:
Puppy Chef Academy is a Virtual Reality cooking experience designed to help you learn how to cook without the stress and mess of a real kitchen. You play as Yuu, the first cat to be accepted into the all-dog Puppy Chef Academy, a culinary school where aspiring candidates enter as students and leave as culinary masters. Get ready to don your apron and chef hat: With the help of the teachers you meet and friends you make, you’ll be on your way to achieving your dreams of becoming a master chef!


  • Over the course of the game, you'll chop, bake, and sizzle your way through twelve recipes from all over the world! From America to Italy to Japan, you’ll learn how to cook real-life meals for your friends and family that not only look great, but taste great too!
  • Can't cook? No problem. Just relax, and enjoy making recipes without fear of messing up!
  • Simple and intuitive controls anyone can pick up and play!
  • As the only cat in an all-dog school, you'll have to learn to fit in and prove yourself among your peers. Along the way, you'll also make unlikely friendships, help others, and realize your own potential as a chef in the esteemed Puppy Chef Academy!

data.name: Vanilla Bagel: The Roguelike
data.detailed_description:
This game in the RPG/Roguelike genre is a tale of kings, heroes, and the mysteries of the Hermit Valley. In this game you will find a wealth of peaceful settlements, engaging quests, deep dungeons, powerful enemies, and mighty artifacts.

This game is a mostly classic roguelike with a vast game world.

The game has dozens of dungeons and items, and hundreds of unique enemies. There is a great variety in magic, curses and item enchantments. The player has a wide range of abilities, quests to complete and secrets to discover. You can approach any battle in a dozen ways depending on your skills and equipment: teleport, invisibility, mind corruption, putting curses on enemies, and even fully possessing the enemies’ bodies.

This challenging game will please those who love complex roguelikes with a large arsenal of available actions.

data.name: Raging Ball
data.detailed_description:
RAGING BALL

You're a ball and all you have to do is to finish the run. The controls are easy but the levels can seem difficult. Sometimes... Well, sometimes you gonna rage. There are 30 levels dispatch on 3 chapters.

ADVICES

  • All level can be finished ;
  • You can train with the training mode (in the chapters selections) ;
  • If you loose to much, take a good breath ;
  • Some level are still difficult to me ;
  • Every "S" notes had already been acheived by myself (so it's possible!) ;
  • Send me your best score.

NOTES

During the game, you gonna have some notes :

  • Levels notes depend on the time spent ;
  • Chapters notes depend on the levels notes (not on the time spent).

HISTORY

This is my first game. I learned code and Unity with RagingBall. If you like this I will make other runs... But to be fair, you gonna hate this game.

data.name: Solid Boat Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Solid Boat Adventure is a co-op adventure game. You and your crew of sailors take control of grandpa's old steamboat to deliver curious cargo in the treacherous waters of the old world.

Teamwork is everything and surviving the dangers of each delivery mission while keeping your boat from sinking is not as easy as it might sound! Prepare for adventure!

All hands on deck!

Your steamboat is your life and it comes with some powerful abilities which require teamwork to reach its full potential. Use powerful Plunger Shooters to gather supplies or defend against enemies. Capsules can be used to give the steamboat temporary abilities like a speed boost or an energy shield. Make sure to keep the fuel up to power through all obstacles, and if that doesn't work? Try jumping out of danger!

Customize the visuals of your boat and give her a proper name!

Explore unique environments!

Sail the remnants of a broken world with your friends visiting beautiful sandy shores, climb between erupting volcanoes or braving severe thunderstorms. Can you use the hazards of the sea to your advantage?

  

Tools for survival!

Make sure to look for supplies during your adventure. Many others have tried to brave the dangers you are facing and failed, but hey, they left supplies! Gather tools, weapons and loot to make each delivery mission successful.

Together with friends, good sailor teamwork and supplies, every delivery will go smoothly! (Disclaimer: It likely will not).

 

MP NOTE: We recommend playing this with 3-4 players for the best experience. There are currently no support systems to help single sailors, and some levels can get quite hard playing alone.

Also: No generative AI was used to develop this game.

data.name: Sin Slayers: Reign of The 8th
data.detailed_description:
Sin Slayers is back on Steam after a while at its best. It’s a challenging RPG Roguelite where you decide the fate of the world while taking its sins upon yourself. Would you be able to cling to the light when everything else has succumbed to darkness?

Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th includes:

  • New threats from an unexpected 8th region

  • Revised game flow and balance (no need to complete each region twice)

  • Numerous optimizations and improvements (faster startup and smoother gameplay)

Atone to your sins

When everything around you has succumbed to madness, would you still try to do the right thing? Navigate the Sinometer: the more sinful actions you perform throughout your run, the more riches you can recover - but beware. The world would notice, unleashing increasingly horrendous creatures in your path until the Sin Lord himself emerges. Would you dare to cross the point of no return?

Build your party of Lost Souls

Knights and rogues, witches and nuns - all have their burden that lures them into this madness. Build your team, gear up and train, and lead once more into the monster-filled plains where they have to fight bearing the curse you cast upon them with your choices

Slay the Sin Lords

Each enemy is a manifestation of Evil - yet all of them have their weaknesses. Repeatedly facing the same monsters you will learn more about them and the ways to exploit their weaknesses. Use it to your advantage and face the ultimate challenge of Sin Lords, walking manifestation of Cardinal Sins. Perhaps their souls could break the cycle and free the Lost Souls from the Nightmare they cast upon themselves

data.name: Kairos: Until the Dawn Breaks
data.detailed_description:
They were taught to fear the night. It was the light that burned them.

A clan that worshipped the day. A goddess who no longer answers. And one hunter who lost everything in a single, blinding noon.

Kairos, the last twilight hunter of the Heliowolf clan, sets out alone for the Temple of Dawn — to seek the truth of a silence that took his home, his people, and the one he never found the words for. The road is long, and he does not walk it as he once did.

Until the Dawn Breaks is a story-rich, mid-length visual novel (~5–7 hours) about faith that forgot its reason, grief that must become action, and the quiet things we never say in time.

Features

  • A single, focused narrative told through Kairos's first-person recollection — dreams of a warm past interleaved with a colder present.
  • Three branching finales. Your accumulated choices decide how Kairos answers the question the whole journey has been asking.
  • Metaphor over exposition. A flower that only blooms after dark, a pair of dawn-bells, only one of which still weeps as the two drift apart — the truth reaches you before the words do.
  • An original score that underscores the story's quiet grief.
  • A complete, self-contained tragedy with a thread of hope — no cliffhanger, no season pass.

The illustrations, CG, music, and video in this title were created using generative AI tools, and the English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese localization was produced with the assistance of a large language model; the writing, direction, editing, curation, and review were done by the author.

data.name: El Norte Salvaje, Juego De Cartas RPG
data.detailed_description:
THE WILD NORTH, RPG CARD GAME

The Wild North, RPG card game, is a card game with a medieval and fantasy theme for one player in which we manage a hero who has at his disposal a reduced deck of cards of njs. The hero has his own abilities and inventory and will use the cards in the deck to advance through different scenarios until completing the campaign map.

You can see the different guides in the following link:

Included in version 1.2:

- Campaign with 55 scenarios and a plot line.
- Warrior, Forester or Mage as main characters.
- Inventory.
- Three warrior skills, two Ranger skills, and two Forester runes, four Mages rumes.
- Eight cards that make up the Warrior-specific deck, eight cards from the Forester-specific deck and eight cards from the Mage-specific deck. Cards are obtained by rescuing them from their captors, by leveling up, or by visiting certain locations. The cards in the deck are not tradeable.
- Skills both on the cards in the deck and on many enemies.
- Several scenarios are events which we will have to figure out the best way to deal with.
- Level up.
- Stores.
- Translate to Spanish/English.
- Autosave at the beginning of each new scenario.
- Steam achievements.

Roadmap

- Complete campaign against the orcs.
- Crusade game mode. Deck building, ingame card improvements...

The game features around 30 minutes of gameplay but can be played for longer if you really like shrimp.

Features:

  • 2 shrimp species

  • Feeding

  • Aquascaping

  • Cute lads

        Solo game modes:
          Deathmatch
          Floor is Lava
          Recoil Race
          Crown Control
          One in the Chamber
          Pass the bullet
        Team game modes:
          Team Deathmatch
          Plant / Defuse the Bomb
          Knockback Soccer
    Choose from a roster of colorful characters, each with their own unique set of abilities to knock other players around
    Rack up points, and become the ultimate knock-knock champion

Jump in, have fun and Knock yourself out!*

*Not literally though - that means you’ll lose.

data.name: Chronicles of the Six Sages
data.detailed_description:
Combat

This is a turn based JRPG with real time elements. Combat requires the player to have to learn enemy attack patterns by mastering the Stance system. Every attack the enemy uses against the player has a stance that counters it, like dodging and parrying. Boss fights introduce the Enrage mechanic, where the more the player does certain actions, like healing, buffing the party, and even killing the Boss's summons, the boss will increase their damage, causing the player to have to strategize around this mechanic. The third mechanic introduced in combat is the Rank mechanic. Similar to  3rd Person Character Action Games, the rank meter will slowly build with you countering enemies and using different abilities.

Story

You take control of Arthur, a general who leads a rebellion against Solomon, a leader obsessed with taking over the world. After being defeated by Solomon's General Elijah, Arthur must escape a prison and amass an army in order to take on the Tyrant King. Along the way you will grow your party and meet characters like Carmilla a Vampyrian princess, Arumera, a man trying to uncover a mysterious killer, Vincent, an Orc who has to confront his own hatred, and Myra, a mage who is obsessed with immortality

Job System

Every battle you will earn JP, or Job Points, and will learn skills with enough. When you learn enough abilities, you can advance to higher tier Jobs, which help grow a network of abilities, that unlock combos to overcome enemies easier.

Equipment

The game features a unique equipment system. Each weapon changes how your Basic Ability functions, anywhere from inflicting status effects, to changing the Basic Ability to a Skill or even a Spell. Armor has 2 different parts to it, a stat such as Defense or even Magic, that can be increased by upgrading the piece of Armor, but also feature a passive bonus, such as a resistance towards an element or status effect, or even granting bonuses to certain types of abilities.

World

The game takes place on the Remnance, a moon for the super-planet of Gaia. You will learn the history of not only kingdoms and continents, but on the history and origins of Gaia and Remnance, and will even be tasked with having to overcome ancient threats that have plagued the world for millennia

data.name: Nightfowl
data.detailed_description:
The farm is gone. The night is not.

Nightfowl is a top-down bullet-hell roguelike about one armed chicken fighting through an endless night. Survive the waves, beat the boss, and a gate opens — but the next world starts harder, and the night only ends when you do.

Fight through worlds that escalate. Each world runs on its own clock. Clear the gate and the pressure resets — but every new world starts meaner than the last, with snipers, abductors, golems and worse joining the hunt.

Loot that fights back. Chests hold weapons and levels — and some of them are mimics. The gold ones don't go down easy.

Pacts with teeth. Trade away your safety for power at the pact totems. Every boon is permanent. Choices have consequences.

Find the ways down. Hidden hatches lead to secret zones — the Ember Pit, the Freezer — for those willing to leave the path.

Two chickens are better than one. Bring a friend in two-player co-op. Same night, same stakes, twice the feathers.

Full controller support. Play the whole night from the couch.

data.name: Project Cradle
data.detailed_description:
Rescue Humanity In the Blink Of An Eye!

Project Cradle is a momentum-based platformer. Play as HelperBody, a robotic kangaroo with a penchant for speed. Use your speed and abilities to search for the last remnants of humanity in a post-post apocalyptic bunker metropolis.

Earn Your Speed!

HelperBody can build ridiculous levels of speed by using momentum! Land on a slope just right to gain a large boost, then jump while zooming up a hill to launch yourself high into the air! Bounce off a spring or launcher to go even faster still! Ride back and forth on a half-pipe to build up momentum!

Off The Walls!

Your little robo roo can ride up walls, then wall jump off of them! Great for getting up those tight spaces!

Slingshot Whiplash!

...is a serious condition! In case of significant damage, report to your local HollowBody unit for regeneration.

Speed Is Sanctuary!

in Project Cradle, speed is the name of the game. Move at high velocity to generate a protective shield that deflects enemy attacks! Perform high flying feats by jumping while running up slopes!

I'm Certain We'll Find Someone!

We will find people. We just have to! They've gotta be around here somewhere... Maybe they're just hiding? No, I don't know why they'd do something silly like that. Are they just... Really small, maybe? Hmm... Whatever the case, we have to find them!

We have to.

data.name: Burn all out
data.detailed_description:
Your contract has been terminated. Reason: improper office waste disposal.


Just another regular day at the office: impossible deadlines, accumulated mental exhaustion, and suppressed rage. A single crumpled paper ball missing the trash can was all the board needed to fire you on the spot and dump you straight down the basement chute.

Their mistake? You survived. And your two weeks' notice will be served in pure destruction.

Burn All Out is a chaotic, comedic, and bizarre roguelike set in Earth's most hostile habitat: the corporate workplace. Fight your way floor by floor, face literal red tape, abusive management, and discover that the company's record profits hide secrets far darker than just unachievable quarterly goals.

Key Features


  • Brute-Force Promotion: Battle through procedurally generated floors, from forgotten basement storage units all the way to the executive boardroom.
  • Corporate Arsenal: Turn heavy staplers, broken keyboards, stale lukewarm coffee, and warehouse supplies into brutal improvised weapons.
  • Synergistic Burnout: Stack suspicious items, questionable caffeine, and shady memos to create overpowered builds that wipe out entire departments.
  • Merciless Management: Take on micromanaging supervisors, brainwashed workforce hordes, and ruthless corporate department heads.
  • Dark Corporate Secrets: Gather scattered files and strange clues to unravel the true, sinister nature behind this corporate empire.

data.name: Blood Facsimile
data.detailed_description:
Blood Facsimile is a tactical first person shooter set in a dark and surreal sci-fi universe. You're a contestant being forced to participate in a violent and bizarre television program. Taking to NPCs will unveil the secrets of the world as you explore liminal environments to find tokens that will grant your escape.

  • Tactical gunplay including leaning, weapon sway, high recoil sensitivity, and a variety of weapons such as a stealthy silenced pistol, an explosive laser gun, a suppressed shotgun equipped with an x-ray screen and many more.

  • All levels can be approached using many different play styles. Choose between lethal and non-lethal options.

  • Explore and make your way through metro stations, clandestine laboratories, shopping malls and many other environments. Discover collectable stars hidden throughout levels to unlock passageways to new areas.

  • Challenging enemy encounters. Enemies have quick reaction times and are unforgiving.

  • Levels are open-ended and interconnected to reward exploring. Multiple routes and creative ways to approach objectives.

  • Find and unlock gameplay upgrades hidden throughout the levels.

  • Revisit earlier areas to collect newly accessible items and see changes in the game world.

  • Talk to NPCs and learn about the world they inhabit.

  • Explore and make your way through metro stations, clandestine laboratories, shopping malls and many other environments. Discover collectable stars hidden throughout levels to unlock passageways to new areas.

  • Levels are open-ended and interconnected to reward exploring. Multiple routes and creative ways to approach objectives.

  • Find and unlock gameplay upgrades hidden throughout the levels.

  • Revisit earlier areas to collect newly accessible items and see changes in the game world.

  • Talk to NPCs and learn about the world they inhabit.

data.name: Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star
data.detailed_description:
A visual novel about an abusive relationship, idealization, and intimacy.



Live a summer of dysfunctional love through branching storylines, twists, sudden changes, and a special mechanic where you choose which senses to use with your boyfriend. In these moments, you will learn about him, his personality, and his past, making you question everything.



Milky Way Prince is entirely designed, programmed, illustrated, and scored by a very young author, Lorenzo Redaelli. The story itself is partially autobiographical.



"During my experience with a borderline partner, I thought that falling in love with him was like becoming part of a binary star system. It’s the rarest, most precious thing in the universe – but the closer they get the more unstable they become. My idea was to create an immersive experience where the player is asked to try to understand the dynamics of this unusual relationship. The character you interact with adapts their behavior to yours – using academic terminology, they could set up “rage tests”, “love bombing", or otherwise guilt trip you. The plot's branching storyline is guided by variables such as “submission” and "interest” that fluctuate at each interaction."



  • Semi-autobiographical dark romance story
  • Branching narrative paths with multiple endings
  • Intimate new sensory gameplay system
  • Character art inspired by Suehiro Maruo and Masaaki Yuasa
  • 3D environments influenced by the stage design of Robert Wilson
  • 30+ minutes of baroque electropop original soundtrack

data.name: RIDER
data.detailed_description:
The surface has no room for some people. They live below.

Down in the dark, an underground city has grown around those who were pushed out: wet concrete, blue neon, and drains that run deeper than anyone talks about. Nothing reaches them from above unless someone carries it down.

That is the Rider's job. Take an order at the hub, go down, hand the goods over, come home and sleep. The client's name on every order is blacked out. Down there, not asking is the rule.

THE DEEPER YOU GO

The lights thin out. The ground breaks apart. The pay goes up. Drones watch the passages, and the people below have learned to stay out of their sight. So will you.

WHAT YOU LEAVE BEHIND

Who you saved and who you passed by is recorded, floor by floor. Those records decide how the story turns and how it ends. Not one choice at the end: the way you travelled.

ATMOSPHERE

An underground city built in pixels, one delivery at a time.

data.name: A Bad Morning for a Roman Cornetto
data.detailed_description:
PREMISE

A lovely vacation in Rome with your mother.
You go out alone for an innocent Italian breakfast — a cappuccino and a chocolate cornetto…

…and somehow end up in the middle of an international spy conspiracy.

Now the real question is:
can you stop it in time… and still make it back to meet your mom?

FEATURING

  • Fully first-person immersive storytelling — the entire experience unfolds through the protagonist’s eyes.

  • Story-driven campaign — scripted moments, grounded pacing, and constant forward momentum.

  • Gritty gunfights — brutal, up-close firefights with tight, responsive shooting.

STORY CAMPAIGN

A classic first-person linear campaign packed with action, comedy, and a touch of romance. Accompanied by a distinctive original soundtrack with original lyrics.

  • 90% shooting

  • 8% dialogue

  • 2% cutscenes

  • 5 difficulty levels: from casual to nightmare

  • Checkpoints and the good old F5 quick save.

data.name: The Doors to Netherwhere
data.detailed_description:
The monks thought their secret was safe. 

The Doors to Netherwhere is a Turn-Based Tactical Defense RPG where you lead the last stand against a merciless horde. You are the Captain of the Guard at a reclusive mountain temple, built long ago around a trio of mysterious portals. For centuries their existence has been carefully kept quiet by a sect of monks, yet somehow...

The enemy is nigh, and your soldiers are few.

  • The Ultimate Choice: With precious little time to prepare, who and what resources can you scrounge together? Will you risk opening the Doors to seek aid from the Netherwhere?

  • Hold the Pass: The monastery is hardly a fortress. Position your units to guard access to the village.

  • Face the Horde: Each enemy type demands a different strategy.

Victory requires more than steel.

  • Convince the Villagers: To join the fight. To prepare weapons or precious resources. To trust your leadership. 

  • Make the Most of Your Time: The clock is ticking. Some preparations are best done yourself. But others...?

  • Organize Your Parties: If fate is on your side, you'll have enough support for three defense parties; one for each of the mountain passes leading into the monastery village. 

The monastery and its adjacent village hide ancient secrets. Learn them quickly!

data.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD
data.detailed_description:
Did you miss us? BATTLE BEARS GOLD, the award-winning third-person shooter, is back and better than we could've imagined!

The mobile class-based shooter that defined the childhoods of millions is back in your hands like it never left! Grab your A Salt Rifle, Bearzooka and those Turkish SW Boots and fight it out with friends and strangers alike!

Choose between 11 distinct classes and compete for dominance in 4v4 online multiplayer mayhem! Score kills in Team Battle, deliver bomb after bomb in Plant the Bomb, maul droves of bears in Free-for-All, or hoard tags in the all-new Kill Confirmed mode!

Jump back into iconic maps like No Bear's Land, Gold Digger and Space Oddity! You can even make some time for that yearly match on Steamyard Blues, most likely just for the song. That's right, get ready to jam out to the glorious BBG soundtrack all over again! But it's not the only music...

data.name: JoyWorld Remastered (조이월드 리마스터)
data.detailed_description:
⚠️ Must Read Before Purchase: The Authentic Remaster of (Market Play 3) by the Original Creator! This is the official remastered version developed directly by pOnStudio, the original creator who built the very first classic "Market Play" game. Please note that this game is fundamentally different from other modified versions or unofficial series created by third parties or other companies. This is the only authentic successor that inherits and expands upon the original developer's unique systems and core essence. Designed specifically for those who cherish the atmosphere and dedicated craftsmanship of the original work, please verify that this is the official work of the original creator before making your purchase.

Relive the Nostalgia! Welcome to 'JoyWorld Remastered'!

The legendary classic flash game "Market Play," which brought warm memories to so many, finally returns in a fully completed, official remastered version by its original developer! 'JoyWorld Remastered' preserves the charming, nostalgic emotional style of the original while introducing beautifully polished visuals and deeper game systems, offering an unforgettable adventure for both returning fans and newcomers.

🎮 Core Gameplay & Features

  • Dynamic Economy & Trading: Engage in buying and selling a vast variety of goods across the market. Manage your resources wisely and develop your own strategies to grow your wealth.

  • Immersive Mini-Games: Enjoy a wide range of fun and engaging mini-games. Put your skills to the test to earn currency and unlock exclusive in-game rewards.

  • Whimsical Story & Quests: Explore a uniquely reimagined world inspired by traditional folklore and fairy tales, filled with humor and charming twists. Complete requests from diverse NPCs to uncover the lore of JoyWorld!

  • Progression & Collection: Collect beautifully crafted items, equipment, and rare treasures in a cozy, hand-drawn art style to upgrade your character.

✨ What Makes JoyWorld Remastered Unique?

  • Charming Art & Captivating Sound: Features a meticulously designed UI, heartwarming item illustrations, and an enchanting original soundtrack that enhances the nostalgic atmosphere.

  • A Relaxing Experience for Everyone: A violence-free, wholesome simulation suitable for players of all ages. Dive into a cozy, delightful economic adventure with total peace of mind!

data.name: CROVA CHAIN
data.detailed_description:
Connect the arrows. Build the chain. Turn the tables.

CROVA CHAIN is a falling-block action puzzle game where you connect arrow-marked blocks, merge them, and battle your opponent. Every rotation and placement shapes your next chain—and your chance to turn the match around.

Connect, merge, and unleash a chain reaction

Rotate falling blocks to connect their arrows. Bring together enough blocks of the same level to merge them into a higher-level block. Plan beyond the next move, build your setup, and watch one merge lead into another!

Turn incoming pressure into a counterattack

Send garbage blocks to your opponent through chains and special merges. When an attack is incoming, use your own to cancel it out and send the remainder back. Apply pressure now or build toward a bigger chain? Quick decisions and thoughtful placement make all the difference.

Take on the challenge—or take on a friend

  • Single-player challenge: Choose from four playable characters and battle through 28 rounds across seven themed stages. Defeat your opponents and reach your chosen character’s ending.

  • Online 1v1 battles: Invite a Steam friend and put your chain-building skills to the test.

  • Play your way: Enjoy remappable keyboard controls, gamepad support, campaign checkpoints, and adjustable screen shake and flash intensity.

Your next block could be the start of a comeback. Make every connection count.

data.name: BlastBeacon
data.detailed_description:
Step inside Minesweeper

You stand on the board. Numbers glow in the darkness, and any block you swing your pickaxe at could be your last.

The rules

  • Each number shows how many bombs are in the 8 tiles around it.
  • Dig up a bomb, and it's game over.
  • Think it's a bomb? Flag it.
  • Clear every block that isn't a bomb to win.

No guessing

Every Classic difficulty preset is built to be solved with pure logic. No 50/50 guesses at the end.

Your own map

Pull up a hand-drawn map. Every block you dig is marked for you, but the numbers and bombs are yours to note down.

Treasure mode

Find three stone tablet shards guarded by bombs and place them on the pedestal. Uncover a 0 and your compass lights up toward the nearest shard. A crystal shield can stop one bomb… but the blast still spreads.

Hardcore and time attack

In Hardcore, every flag is final. Your clear time and blocks dug are shown on the results screen.

Comfort settings

  • Play with keyboard and mouse or a controller.
  • Turn screen shake down to 0% if you're prone to motion sickness. Mouse sensitivity is adjustable too.

Streamers and video creators welcome

Stream it, make videos, monetize them — no need to ask us first. We'd love to see how you read the glowing numbers and where you decide to dig.

data.name: Escape Room VR: Gone Man
data.detailed_description:
The game transports you back to England in the 1890s, where confusion, unrest, and restlessness filled the entire 1893 Dickens town. You, as a private detective, head to the abandoned house to investigate an unsolved case from ten years ago after receiving a mysterious letter. Locked closets, mysterious symbols, rustling radios, to find the scattered pieces around and uncover the secrets hidden behind the disappearing portraits. What kind of truth is waiting for you?



A wealthy businessman originally had a happy and harmonious family, living together with his wife and two daughters in a mansion. However, an unfortunate event occurred when the businessman was diagnosed with cancer. Despite seeking medical treatment everywhere, he was helpless and could only turn to the local cult organization. It was said that they had a medicine that could cure any illness. However, the so-called medicine was only incense containing hallucinogenic substances, which would make people feel as if they were cured. Due to their excessive use of hallucinogens, the businessman’s wife went insane and committed suicide by hanging herself. The wealthy businessman himself became insane as a result.

At this point, the cult had already converted the mansion’s basement into a psychedelic mushroom farm, preparing for a ritual sacrifice of live humans. They tempted the crazy businessman with eternal life as a condition for his willingness to be the sacrifice, and used the flesh and blood of his loved ones as part of the ceremony to summon Satan, whom they worshipped. In the end, the ritual “succeeded,” and everyone saw their own version of Satan.

Later, when the protagonist came to investigate the case and entered the mansion, there were still a lot of psychedelic gases due to the continuous propagation of the psychedelic mushrooms. Under the influence of the gas, the protagonist saw many incredible supernatural phenomena, including ghosts, undead, and even the wealthy businessman who had turned into a lump of flesh. The police who had come to investigate the case before became insane due to the large amount of psychedelic gas, so the case was eventually abandoned.


  • Real: first-person perspective, you will go back to the 1890s scenes of Britain, feel the pure British atmosphere
  • Detective: As a private detective, you will explore the abandoned house, collect clues and discover the truth
  • Decryption: The room is equipped with multiple clues and mysteries, and the final mystery is waiting for you to uncover
  • Immersion: Explore the room and interact with various objects, as if in a real secret room to explore the case

Later, when the protagonist came to investigate the case and entered the mansion, there were still a lot of psychedelic gases due to the continuous propagation of the psychedelic mushrooms. Under the influence of the gas, the protagonist saw many incredible supernatural phenomena, including ghosts, undead, and even the wealthy businessman who had turned into a lump of flesh. The police who had come to investigate the case before became insane due to the large amount of psychedelic gas, so the case was eventually abandoned.


  • Real: first-person perspective, you will go back to the 1890s scenes of Britain, feel the pure British atmosphere
  • Detective: As a private detective, you will explore the abandoned house, collect clues and discover the truth
  • Decryption: The room is equipped with multiple clues and mysteries, and the final mystery is waiting for you to uncover
  • Immersion: Explore the room and interact with various objects, as if in a real secret room to explore the case

Faced with the mass clues, standing at the crossroads of the cruel truth, what choice will you make?

Welcome to SGB


This is an experimental RPG, which is used to test the author's mastery of the development tool smile game build (SGB) and experience steam's launch process. All materials come from the software itself and DLC, except two ending texts and a modified cover.

Originally intended as a gift to me, but the development cycle is far longer than my friend expected - no fishing. Although I missed the time, my friend still gained happiness, which is a sense of achievement when building his own small world, even if the external is insignificant.

data.name: Ciella's Casebook
data.detailed_description:
"War, Unfinished. Mystery, Unsolved"

[Ciella's Casebook] is a mystery detective adventure set one year after the war, following the journey of a war-veteran detective Ciella and her assistant Ricky in the industrial city of Actain

◆ Story

In ACTAIN — a steampunk factory city where the war may be over, but its wounds are not.
Beneath the roar of massive steam engines, the people carry on, haunted by what the war left behind.

CIELLA, a private detective worn down in body and soul, pushes through in her everyday life trying to make her living.
Then one day, a murder case lands in her hands — and she discovers it threads back to her father's death, ten years ago.

Investigate crime scenes, expose the contradictions hidden in a suspect's words, and piece together clues to uncover leads that no one else could find.

This is a mystery adventure where you, as the detective, dig out the truth with your own hands.
How deep Ciella's past goes depends on how far you're willing to look into.

◆Welcome To Actain

Enter the factory city of Actain, become a private detective during the post-war period where many social, political, military, and economic changes are happening throughout the world.

Under the tense dynamics between nations, corporations and ideologies, Ciella does not know her fate, as she throws herself into the eye of the coming storm.

◆ Key Features

[Story of the survivors]
As Ciella works her way through a variety of cases, she'll encounter many different characters.

They may become allies or adversaries along the way — solve cases together and forge deeper bonds with them.

But trust no one... the person you believed in might be the culprit.

 

[Investigate crime scenes]
Investigate crime scenes and find clues to solve cases.

[Debate and Interrogation]
Talk to suspects and gather testimony through interrogation.
Use the testimony you collect to uncover new truths behind each case.

[Assemble clues and reach for the truth]

*No generative AI was used at any stage of this game's development.

data.name: ROOM FOOTBALL - Sand Storm
data.detailed_description:
Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

On the map there are objects marked with a red beam going into the sky, the player must find all these objects and destroy them with a soccer ball to complete the game.

Objects that need to be found and destroyed are marked with a red beam going into the sky.

The player needs to control the camera on the WASD buttons and the mouse, find all the necessary objects on the location and hold down the left mouse button, controlling the force of the blow to the ball, knock them down as quickly as possible, getting points for it.

The game has achievements and leaderboards.

data.name: DAMAGE CONTROL
data.detailed_description:
Control your squad of engineers and maintain your ship, and it's crew, until it reaches it's destination. Careful planning and timing will be required to place the right resource in the right place to tackle the dangers of deep space. The environment is brutal and unforgiving and sudden bloody death comes quickly to the slow and unwary! Only your team stand between your sturdy ship and it's faithful crew and certain death. Take command!




  • Relentless Action

    The air is venting out of your craft, the lower decks are completely ablaze, and asteroids are pounding the hull to smithereens. It's nothing you can't handle! Grab your tools and get started!

  • Full Campaign Mode

    Take control of your engineering corporation, earn funding by taking on jobs across the galaxy and use the funds to take over the competition!

  • Tactics and Management

    Prioritize your tasks! Do you rescue the injured crew member? Or stop the fire on the next deck? Equip your engineers with the right tools for the job!

  • Planning and Timing

    Your tools will run out of charge, and the ship has many paths to your objectives, where will you go first?

  • In space no one can hear you..

    The crew have reported strange noises coming from the air vents. Not to worry. I'm sure it's nothing.



Hi every one! I'm Ross Edgar, the lead designer and developer of Damage Control. I've very proud of what we have created so far and I'm very excited to share it with you today.

Damage Control is currently in an alpha state. To explain what we mean by that - it's playable (very), but it has some bugs, and not all the features are implemented. When all the features we want are in we will call it beta, and commence bug squashing. So.. whats currently in?

  • Basic Menu screens and Options
  • Basic Campaign Mode
  • Basic Freeplay Mode
  • 7 Basic Levels
  • 5 Basic Damage Types and the tools to fix them : Hull, o2, Radiation, Fire and Crew
  • Basic Music and Sound Effects
  • Basic Particles and Lighting effects
  • Basic Save/Load system

.. when you write it like that it sounds un-impressive! But trust me, when you see it all running together it's a glorious, bombastic, hectic and violent chaos management game with lots of room to expand!

Our immediate short-term goal is to get to just before beta stage, then get Greenlit (see?), then do an Early Access release. Why? We really want to get feedback on the current feature set and catch anything we missed before we freeze the feature set and commence beta development.

Will we charge for the Early Access game? Yes we will. We need to keep the lights on and cover development costs like art and marketing, but it will be at a heavy discount from the full price as a thank you to everyone who buys the game. We are investigating adding users who contribute suggestions, bug reports and ideas to the game as NPC's or even playable characters. Watch this space!

So what do we plan to add to the game before Early Access?

  • More levels. The levels will be split into "stages", you can only unlock a stage after completing the current stages levels to a particular standard. More on this later.
  • More damage types. Collapsing superstructures, Gas Leaks, Loss of gravity, Electrical Damage are just some ideas we are throwing around right now.
  • Campaign Cards. Cards, earned during the tactical phase, that you play during the strategy phases to confer bonuses and buffs.
  • Level Hazards. We think that large, industrial spaceships would have lots of moving parts. We want to add crushing pistons and slicing lasers to the environment.
  • Device Management I want you to manage your ship, not just stick it back together. We want you to insert fuel rods into the engines, activate shields and dump radioactive waste overboard!
  • Alien. An alien monster is onboard! It will hunt throughout the ship and can only be scared off by the flamethrower. Think of it like the ghosts in pacman, except the ghost is a bloodthirsty monster. And the maze is on fire.
  • Steam Achievements
  • Steam Trading Cards
  • European Language Support
  • Full graphical options
  • Full tutorial

Phew. It's a large shopping list, but we think every one of these ideas adds more value to the current game and we cannot wait to see it in game and see players having fun (and complaining) about all of it!

If you have any comments or questions I'd be pleased to respond to you directly, or via the comments page. Thank you for reading.

Ross Edgar.
Highland Gaming.

data.name: Phonophobia
data.detailed_description:
Phonophobia plunges you into a first-person psychological horror journey, where sound and silence dictate your survival. As terrifying truths emerge from the dark, use your wits to solve environmental puzzles and explore haunting, forgotten locations. Every sound echoes with danger; can you uncover the mystery before the darkness consumes you?

Story:

You awaken in the ruins of a destroyed train station with no memory of who you are or why you arrived. Escape the wreckage and navigate an unsettling village to piece together your forgotten past.

As you gather clues and investigate forgotten locations, severe psychological trauma plagues your mind, fracturing your perception of reality. But lost memories aren't the only thing hunting you—a relentless spirit stalks your every move, distorting your surroundings and playing tricks on your sanity. To survive, you must solve environmental puzzles, uncover the truth behind your identity, and find a way to escape the village before the entity breaks your mind completely.

Key Features

  • Psychological Trauma & Hallucinations: Experience a fracturing mind where staying still for too long drags you into total darkness. Face sudden blackouts, auditory illusions, visual distortions, and shifting environments that force you to keep moving.

  • Relentless Spirit Threat: Evade a haunting entity that stalks your every step. Adapt to unpredictable encounters as it manipulates your surroundings, distorts your perception, and disrupts your attempt to escape.

  • Environmental Puzzle-Solving: Fix power stations, tune radios, crack code-locked doors, and bypass mechanical obstacles to open new paths through the village.

  • Sound-Based Navigation: Listen closely to your environment. Use audio cues to navigate dark areas, track threats, and pinpoint essential puzzle elements.

  • Environmental Storytelling: Uncover codes, clues, and story details hidden organically within the world. Examine abandoned letters, cryptic notes, and environmental details to piece together your past and solve intricate puzzles.

data.name: Nebula Veil
data.detailed_description:
Nebula Veil is an atmospheric survival horror set in space, blending puzzles with simulator elements. Alone and confined to a tiny spaceship at the galaxy’s edge, you must seek escape through debris fields, physical anomalies, alien fauna, and the decaying chambers of your own mind.

You were lucky. Unlike your colleagues, when the mothership collapsed, you happened to be in a fragile engineering vessel outside its hull. Now switches, sliders, screens, levers, and joysticks are your only means of interacting with the world around you - one wrong press could cost you your life

ER-426 isn’t just a machine. It’s a living system, and you’re woven into it. Keep it alive: Monitor its condition, replace damaged components, extinguish fires and don't forget... to feed it.

The world beyond the glass calls to be explored. Though your ship isn’t agile, it carries tools well-suited for discovery. Initially limited to cameras and a basic manipulator, an attentive pilot can quickly expand ER-426’s toolkit.

Searching for anything in outer space is no simple task. Yet a simple SDR radio offers a surprisingly wide range of uses - from listening to music to tracking survivors and gathering information.

Understanding the intercepted broadcasts, however, is another matter

There is more to the world around you than twisted wreckage. The vacuum has been replaced by a blood-red haze concealing creatures and objects beyond human comprehension. The denser the fog, the stranger its inhabitants.

And the more medication you’ll need to keep your psyche afloat.

It’s not only you who needs saving. Humanity’s age of greatness has long passed. The world rusts and rots, and people scavenge like ants, living off the remnants of their ancestors’ achievements. You may be just an insignificant detail of the machine - but even the smallest detail can alter the universe.

data.name: Gothic 3: Forsaken Gods Enhanced Edition
data.detailed_description:
After having banned the influence of the gods in Myrtana, the nameless hero and Xardas have left this world in order to prevail the balance of power. In their exile located somewhere between space and time, they watch the actions of the mortal beings. As they discover a growing of the differences between orcs and humans again, they start to accuse each other and finally even a fight between the companions breaks loose. The nameless hero leaves the secret realm and wakes up in Myrtana, where he tries to unite Myrtana once for good - in a new empire for both orcs and human.

Gothic 3 - Forsaken Gods Enhanced Edition includes new quests, new monsters and many of the old friends who gamers around the world got to know before. This standalone add-on will answer all the questions which have risen in the past and will slowly introduce the fans to a new chapter...

Key Features:

  • Huge lively environment which reacts to the player’s actions, creating a very intense and realistic atmosphere
  • Improved graphics quality thanks to updated engine technology
  • Many intense hours of gameplay
  • Improved combat system with new moves
  • Plenty of new weapons, armors, monsters and quests

Enhanced Edition Features:

  • Completely revised gameplay & combat system
  • Major graphic & sound improvements for even greater atmosphere
  • Numerous upgrades, additions and little extras

data.name: Grayton the Detective
data.detailed_description:
A wise man once said, “If your only goal is to become rich, you will never achieve it without solving a few cases.” Or something like that. 

Grab a freshly brewed coffee (never instant!), feed your pet bird, wrap yourself in a cozy blanket, and set out for a tour of the city where you're at home everywhere, and every inconspicuous citizen napping on a bench is your neighbor. Prove your worth to those who've doubted you—and most importantly, yourself. Uncover the secrets scattered around and solve the mysterious case of the Golden Spoon.

FEATURES

  • Inspired by both classic point-and-click and modern narrative adventure games.

  • Puzzles that accept your uniqueness and creative thinking.

  • Freedom of choice is sometimes met with consequences.

  • Embrace the role of a detective with eavesdropping mechanics and a visual clue system.

Supported using public funding by Slovak Arts Council

data.name: XorceD - Sashiro's Laedrum
data.detailed_description:
World-line Laedrum:
Play as Sashiro Kobata, a World-Peacemaker (WPM) officer with an incredible dual-wielding pistol skill, in an undercover mission! His WPM-group has found out information about a terrorist group that puts the world into disorder. The information: A highschool student is supposed to be the leader of that terrorist group! In order to maintain world-peace and to stop the terrorist group, Sashiro has to identify the leader by transferring to the school as a student. This won't be an easy task for him who has never attended a public school before and is only specialized in combat. He will meet several suspects with their own background story and has to find out more about them. Will he be able to find out the truth?

Setting and background

This story takes place in the world-line Laedrum in year 2040. The world-line Laedrum was created in year 2017 by a supernatural group that annihilated about three billion humans who had physically harmed other humans; that means criminals were executed, but also children who played tag. The crime rate exponentially decreased and police forces were no longer needed during the the so-called Purge. It lasted for three years and that supernatural group called Xorcerox suddenly disappeared. When those news were spread all over the world, the crime rate increased again; this time without a police. Drastic times require drastic measurements: The World-Peacemakers (WPM) were born. They are the elite of the old special forces from all over the world. Given special rights, such as freedom of act (and thus to kill), they try to maintain world-peace in a humane way. Now, in year 2040, there is a big terrorist group spread around the world. The current main mission of the WPM is to put an end to their terror!

Sashiro Kobata

Sashiro Kobata is the main character you will play in this visual novel.

  • world-peacemaker officer
  • known as the White Demon who colours his path in red, together with the Black Demon Qi
  • incredible pistol skills with the special ability Reign of Bullets
  • age: 17
  • has never attended a normal school before and only had private lessons
  • his parents were WPM-officers

Concept of the universe

In the XorceD universe there are infinite world-lines that are created by decisions and choices. There are main world-lines created by events that drastically change the world, such as Laedrum that was created by the Purge. This concept of world-lines is unknown to the residents of the world including Sashiro; only a few exceptions and the world-line travellers (you, the player) know about this concept.

Game features

  • story rich visual novel
  • many unique characters with background story
  • a lot of choices of action
  • unique universe concept
  • beautiful artworks
  • over 20 soundtracks
  • create three different world-lines (three different endings)

data.name: Exo One
data.detailed_description:
A strange signal... an alien craft... an interplanetary, gravity-defying journey through space and time.





On the anniversary of the Jupiter disaster, an alien signal transmits construction blueprints for an alien craft, which humanity builds, called Exo One.





Master a truly alien traversal system and move through enigmatic and desolate alien landscapes in ways you've never experienced. Control gravity itself and build momentum to reach colossal speeds and exhilarating heights.





Ride thermal updrafts into boiling cloud formations, careen down hillsides and launch off mountain tops, all the time drifting toward the shining blue beam on the horizon. Atmospheric, diffused visuals are merged with otherworldly sound effects and a hypnotic electric guitar soundtrack.

Pilot your craft on mankind's first voyage outside the solar system, and go on an interplanetary journey across space and time.

data.name: Whimsical Quest
data.detailed_description:
Whimsical Quest is a retro action arcade adventure with roguelite elements. Traverse the whimsical world with a character that is destined to do hard work for apparently no reason. Unlock different characters along the way and upgrade your characters to be able to overcome the adventure that lies ahead.



Prepare to fight against randomly spawning enemies in different terrains. Collect many different items to form your ultimate character that might die, just in case he doesn't.


  • Jump into the game and immediately start your journey to defeat the enemies that lie in wait.
  • Enrich your encampment to make them satisfied, in return you can bolster your powers.
  • Try not to die until you can make an end to the mastermind behind spawning these beasts.
  • In perfect retro fashion, you will not get your hand held through the entirety of your adventure.


  • Over 50 items with different rarity to collect and utilize on your character each run.
  • 5 different characters to unlock and play, including the Peasant, the Scholar, Spirit Blazer, Johntlet and Flockman.
  • Hack computers with directional inputs that are fun fun fun.
  • Fight through 6 different terrains with various subset maps within.
  • Find critters to fight for you along your journey. They stay by your inside until you have met your own demise.
  • A retro inspired soundtrack that has more than enough funky bleeps and bloops.
  • New game + mode after completion.
  • No manual.

data.name: Company of Heroes - Legacy Edition
data.detailed_description:
DISCLAIMER

This legacy version of COH1 will also give you access to the latest updated version of COH1 - simply called "Company of Heroes" in your Steam library. PLEASE USE THE LATTER TO PLAY ONLINE, and visit the associated pages to join the COH1 Steam Community & Modding scene:
  • COH1 Community Hub
  • COH1 Steam Workshop

DESCRIPTION

Delivering a visceral WWII gaming experience, Company of Heroes redefines real time strategy gaming by bringing the sacrifice of heroic soldiers, war-ravaged environments, and dynamic battlefields to life. Beginning with the D-Day Invasion of Normandy, players lead squads of Allied soldiers into battle against the German war machine through some of the most pivotal battles of WWII. Through a rich single player campaign, players experience the cinematic intensity and bravery of ordinary soldiers thrust into extraordinary events.

  • A Cinematic Single Player Experience that captures the turmoil of WWII as never before.
  • Advanced squad AI brings your soldiers to life as they interact with the changing environment, take cover, and execute advanced squad tactics to eliminate all enemy opposition.
  • Stunning Visuals - Relic's next generation cutting-edge engine provides graphic quality and a physics driven world that is unprecedented in an RTS.
  • Environmental Strategy - Real-time physics and a completely destructible environment guarantee no two battles ever play out in the same way. Destroy anything and re-shape the battlefield! Use buildings and terrain to your advantage, or deny them to the enemy.
  • 2-8 Player Multiplayer Competition via LAN or Internet - Go online with friends and join the ultimate battle of Axis versus Allies.

data.name: Vroom Room
data.detailed_description:
Embrace your inner child and fill your collection in Vroom Room, the cozy toybox simulator.

Take a break and enjoy life in the slow lane, in a toy room of your very own. Idle to collect new toys and watch them drive around a 3D physics-based playground, while you relax to an original lo-fi soundtrack.

With over 40 cars to collect — each with their own behaviours and interactions — there are always new surprises to find.

Capture the simpler times and childlike wonder of yore as you set the room going and watch it come to life. Hang out and enjoy the bliss of lo-fi synth tunes while you watch the toys go about their routine, race each other, launch off ramps, stage pile-ups, and explore the handcrafted space.

Open your encyclopaedia to keep an eye on your collection and view your toys with the model viewer.
From muscle cars and 4x4s to an ice cream truck and ramen bowl, there's no shortage of toys to watch!

Step in to the hot seat and take over any toy, any time. Each one handles differently, with unique strengths that allow you to explore the dense playground in exciting ways. Half the fun is finding out what each new toy is capable of!

• Your room is filled with interactions and secrets to uncover:

• Stunt off ramps and loop-de-loops

• Towers of blocks to knock around as you cause mayhem

• Score a goal with the soccer ball

• Instruments to play with

Go poking at the corners of the room. There are easter eggs and challenges hidden for people who go looking, and some of the rarest toys only turn up for those who do.

Let your friends drop in and join your zen as you watch your toys on their adventures. Then race, crash, and challenge each other as you take control of the fleet that you've unlocked.

Compete with each other as you zoom around the room in races, games of tag, car soccer and much more, or co-operate in the joy of discovery to unlock the rarest of toys.

Your audience can name your toys and trigger special events with Twitch integration.

Vroom Room is built to grow; with fan-favourite mascots from beloved indie games, seasonal events, and more toys on the way. Follow Vroom Room to hear about now toys as they land.

There's always vroom for one more

• New toys to play with

• New areas to play within

• Customise your rooms

• Guest appearances from other indie titles

• Seasonal events

• And more!

data.name: Nemo is going to School
data.detailed_description:
Our main character, Nemo, goes to school again today.
I go up and up to go to school 351m above the sky.
You can't help it if you fall. You have to go up without a break to not be late!
There are bad weather and dangerous stairs above. You have to hold back even if you're angry.
Now, head to school!


Basically, this game is a speed-run game that passes through a difficult map in the shortest time.
The game also has several Easter eggs hidden in it, and you can enjoy your content without getting tired of it through your achievements.
The title screen also allows you to move the player to perform several activities.


How to move players:
The square can be moved from side to side through the A/D key or rudder on the keyboard.
By clicking the mouse, you can jump up to 2 times with the force of the jump.
Typically, contact with an object gives you a jump force.


Special Block:
A red block cannot gain jumping force even if it touches it.
Orange blocks have the property of turning.
The mint block only moves up and down, and disappears after 3 seconds of contact.
Blue blocks have various properties.

data.name: Caution Ahead: Part 1
data.detailed_description:
This is the first entry of a three-part horror series that blends exploration, escape-room challenges, and stealth-based survival elements. This part includes three chapters.

You are John Rand, a search-and-rescue officer stationed in Richburg National Park. When young Elena Peterson disappears during a family hike, John and his team are dispatched to find her. During the search, John becomes separated from the others, forced to retrace his steps alone.

Steam Achievements:

Chapters in Part 1:

  • Chapter 1: Connecting the dots.

  • Chapter 2: Breath of fresh air.

  • Chapter 3: Back to square one.

Game Modes in Part 1:

  • Standard - classic game run.

  • Torture - replay Chapter 3 with a more challenging puzzle (unlocked once Standard mode is completed).

  • Speedrun - replay the game with a timer, no cut scenes (unlocked once Standard mode is completed).

data.name: ZetaZania Part 1: Vampire Pirates from Uranus
data.detailed_description:
An Epic 2D Side-Scrolling Comedy Action-Adventure

Humanity is being harvested by a beauty-obsessed vampire empire hidden in the rings of Uranus.

In ZetaZania, a massive space station built by sinister vampires, blood is power and perfection is law. As Earth’s top operative, you must fight your way through a society of seductive monsters, cosmic witches, and ruthless elites to bring the entire system crashing down.

Welcome to the Weirdest War in the Solar System

Humanity is under attack… by the Sexy Vampire Pirates from Uranus.

Deep within the planet’s inner ring lies ZetaZania, a sprawling space station ruled by a twisted, beauty-obsessed vampire empire. Humans are harvested for their precious life elixir, and sexiness is law.

You are Earth’s top military operative.

Your mission:
Infiltrate. Fight. Climb the ranks. Destroy the empire.

Retro Action. Modern Feel.

Jump, shoot, and fight your way through 60 handcrafted levels in a fast-paced 2D platforming adventure that blends classic gameplay with smooth, modern controls.

  • Tight, responsive retro-style movement

  • Satisfying combat with escalating intensity

  • Puzzle-focused challenges where skill matters

  • Optional visual puzzles for additional upgrades

Simple to play. Difficult to master.

Secrets, Upgrades and Strange Deals

Take on optional puzzle challenges to encounter a mysterious figure. Make the right choices to unlock upgrades that can change how you play.

Explore the Madness of ZetaZania

Battle through 7 bizarre and dangerous districts, each with its own identity:

  • Transportation Factories

  • Scientific Laboratories

  • Department of Sexiness

  • Divine Sisters of the Mighty Moons

  • The Sacred Few

  • Queen’s Palace

  • King’s Lair

Each zone introduces new original artwork, enemies, and a unique boss encounter.

A Cast You Won’t Forget

Face more than 50 original enemies, each with distinct personalities and behaviours.

From seductive space vampires to cosmic witches and strange alien creations, every encounter is designed to be memorable.

Retro Style, Reimagined

  • Detailed 2D pixel art enhanced with layered lighting effects

  • Vibrant alien environments full of color and atmosphere

  • 3D pre-rendered cutscenes styled to match the pixel art world

  • A nostalgic 90s-inspired aesthetic with modern visual polish

A Story Packed with British Humour

Experience a universe filled with absurd lore and original comedy.

Ruled by King Scrotumous Maximus, this society values beauty above all else, while humanity is reduced to a resource.

The tone is strange and entirely unique.

An Immersive Soundtrack

Enjoy a rich electronic score by Jonny Towers, combining modern production with retro sci-fi influence to bring the world of ZetaZania to life.

Why You’ll Love It

  • A completely original comedic sci-fi setting

  • Classic platforming gameplay with modern refinement

  • A wide variety of enemies, locations, and challenges

  • A strong focus on fun, creativity, and personality

data.name: Succubi of Byzantion
data.detailed_description:
⚔️ A tale of wings, faith and second chances

The olive harvest was going to be legendary that year. Then the demons came - and with them, the questions. The Inquisition teaches us that everything with wings serves hell. But when a succubus saves your life, a dragon carries you on its back, and a tiny winged girl with a foil comes running to defend the hobbits' gardens… how long can a teaching like that last?

Succubi of Byzantion is a turn-based strategy game with a lighthearted, visual-novel-style campaign - you follow four heroes whose fates intertwine against the backdrop of a war with demons. What some of them have believed their whole lives may not survive contact with reality.

🛡️ Four main heroes and their paths

  • Galerond, the Inquisitor - a seasoned warrior who slowly begins to doubt whether his lifelong motto, "everything with wings serves hell," isn't a little too simple after all.

  • Prince Theodor & Seline - the heir of Byzantion and the court succubus meant to help him with the war in the south. A romance the world may not be ready for yet.

  • Trixie, the little succubus - a giggling whirlwind with a foil who cares more about biscuits and friends than about emperors, kings, or a war with hell. The hobbits adore her. The demons should worry.

  • Celesian and the dragons - an elven nobleman who longs to restore the ancient alliance between the forest realm and the dragons.

📜 Story campaign

  • 137 story scenes in a visual novel with paper-cutout characters.

  • 43 battles, three difficulty settings and 22 achievements.

  • The campaign leads you scene by scene and remembers exactly where you left off.

  • Fully translated into Czech and English.

🎲 Tactical battles

  • Turn-based battles on an 8x5 square grid.

  • Action-point movement. Skills have a percentage chance to hit. Terrain provides cover.

  • 67 different units in all, sharing over 100 different skills between them.

  • Beyond the campaign there's a Quick Battle mode, where you build any army you like for both warring sides.

🎨 Inspired by the classics

The game is a tribute to classics like Battle for Wesnoth, Age of Wonders, Warlock: Master of the Arcane and XCOM.

🛡️ Four main heroes and their paths

  • Galerond, the Inquisitor - a seasoned warrior who slowly begins to doubt whether his lifelong motto, "everything with wings serves hell," isn't a little too simple after all.

  • Prince Theodor & Seline - the heir of Byzantion and the court succubus meant to help him with the war in the south. A romance the world may not be ready for yet.

  • Trixie, the little succubus - a giggling whirlwind with a foil who cares more about biscuits and friends than about emperors, kings, or a war with hell. The hobbits adore her. The demons should worry.

  • Celesian and the dragons - an elven nobleman who longs to restore the ancient alliance between the forest realm and the dragons.

📜 Story campaign

  • 137 story scenes in a visual novel with paper-cutout characters.

  • 43 battles, three difficulty settings and 22 achievements.

  • The campaign leads you scene by scene and remembers exactly where you left off.

  • Fully translated into Czech and English.

🎲 Tactical battles

  • Turn-based battles on an 8x5 square grid.

  • Action-point movement. Skills have a percentage chance to hit. Terrain provides cover.

  • 67 different units in all, sharing over 100 different skills between them.

  • Beyond the campaign there's a Quick Battle mode, where you build any army you like for both warring sides.

🎨 Inspired by the classics

The game is a tribute to classics like Battle for Wesnoth, Age of Wonders, Warlock: Master of the Arcane and XCOM.
data.short_description: A turn-based strategy game woven into a visual novel. Lead inquisitors, elves, dwarves and succubi through a fantasy story - and discover that the real enemies may not be only the ones with wings. A lighthearted game in the spirit of Battle for Wesnoth, Age of Wonders and XCOM.

data.name: Highway Builder
data.detailed_description:
Nowadays, one of the most important tasks in the field of infrastructure planning and construction is to create new highways that will connect people living far away from each other. In Highway Builder you will take control of a construction team that specializes in building highways, freeways or even complex and dangerous mountain roads. Together with your team, you will start your career by repairing local national roads to become popular and take orders all over the world. Your team will experience many adventures while travelling to the four corners of the world.

Highway Builder combines elements of a construction worker simulation and company management. After accepting the tasks, you will decide which machines and tools will be necessary during the construction, select the right professionals to the team and send them to the field. Depending on the mission you will need a completely different set of machines, equipment and specialists! Then, during the construction phase, you will take control over individual members of the construction team to perform specific tasks by yourself. Remember that each client expects high quality from you and allocates a specific budget to complete the work. Prove to him that it is possible to do the job well, fast and to not exceed the budget! After all, you are the professionals.

During the construction phase you will sit at the helm of various construction machines, from excavators and tippers to advanced soil stabilization machines, asphalt milling machines and many others. The Highway Builder offers a huge variety of real machines and tools to work with, and as your business grows, you'll get access to even more equipment to broaden your team's capabilities, allowing you to take on more and more complex tasks. Manage your orders skillfully, take care of your tools and work machines, appreciate your employees, and your company will gain global fame in no time at all!

MAIN FEATURES:
- Manage a construction company, take care of finances and make sure the machines are in good condition
- Choose the right tools and specialists for the job
- Go out into the field and take on the role of the workers
- Use a huge number of real construction machines and tools
- Grow your business to achieve global fame!

data.name: Abducted
data.detailed_description:
Step into the shoes of Bobby B, the host of 'ETRadio', broadcasting from your RV and following a script that guides your show. You’ll answer calls from listeners - most of whom are bullies with nothing better to do. But amidst the hoaxes, one call will stand out, filled with genuine terror.

When that moment comes, you’ll have to leave the safety of your RV and venture into the dense woods of Shilbury Park, surrounded by trees and rivers, searching for signs of alien life. Armed with your equipment, you’ll uncover and collect evidence - but getting back to the comfort of your RV isn’t guaranteed.

Once back, if you make it, you must upload your findings to the internet, sharing the proof with the world. Throughout it all, you’ll need to keep your listeners updated, balancing their curiosity with your own growing fear. Will you be the one to finally prove that we’re not alone, or will the truth cost you everything?

Features:

- Host Your Own Radio Show: Take control of ETRadio, broadcasting live from your RV, and follow a script that guides your nightly shows.
- Handle Listener Calls: Answer a mix of prank calls and genuine reports, never knowing which one might be the real deal.
- Investigate Eerie Locations: Leave your RV and explore Shilbury Park in search of evidence, navigating through dense forests and rivers.
- Evade UFO Abductions: Stay vigilant as you search for evidence, as you may encounter UFOs based on real documented sightings, each with its own rarity and danger. One rare type has a 1 in 10,000 chance of appearing—surviving these encounters will be critical.
- Collect and Share Evidence: Use specialized equipment to uncover and collect proof of alien life, then upload your findings to the internet.
- Engage with Your Audience: Keep your listeners informed and engaged as you uncover the truth, with every decision affecting your show's outcome.
- Survive the Night: Each decision you make could determine whether you make it back to your RV safely—or become another unexplained disappearance.

data.name: Curse the Cursor
data.detailed_description:
Curse the Cursor is a bullet-hell roguelike shooter set within a corrupted computer. Fight through a twisting digital labyrinth, blasting through infected folders, web pages, terminals, and more. Collect powerful items and weapons to fight back against the increasing infection… but be careful not to pick up too many curses.

Each weapon changes your cursor and your playstyle, from rapid-firing pointers to swiping paint-brush cursors and much more. Curses make every run unique. Some affect how you fight or move, while others distort the interface itself. You can play it safe or embrace the chaos to survive.

Between runs, choose from different antivirus programs, each granting active abilities and passive traits that shape your approach to every descent into the system.

A mysterious figure within the system can remove curses, but only if you are willing to pay the price.

Delve into a collapsing network full of corrupted entities, hidden caches, and the occasional shop where you can stock up. Use your limited “RAM” to revisit rooms and keep your exploration smooth and fast-paced.

data.name: Cardbot
data.detailed_description:
Join Cardbot as he ventures on his quest to recover the 8 Sacred Gem Shards!

It is the year 4032. Humanity as we know it is gone; The Corruption spreads. It's up to Cardbot to retrieve 8 Sacred Gem Shards, and use them to terminate the Corruption in order to restore Earth to what it once was!

Play as Cardbot, a mysterious robot who crash lands on a new planet that houses dangerous creatures and strange portals to new dimensions. Set out on a journey to uncover the past and save the future!

Features




Travel through different dimensions, each with their own distinct identity! Explore open areas and uncover secret locations! Come across towns and meet new people who inhabit these strange landscapes!



Perform powerful combos on your foes! Encounter many different enemies and challenging bosses! Use your skills to dodge incoming attacks and punish! Use your kit of moves including: Punches, Kicks, Grabs, and Swords to fight your way through!



Defeat enemies to collect their loot! You can sell them at shops you find while traveling. You can also buy items to help you on your journey to get stronger!



Use weapons and gadgets; collect a full arsenal!

data.name: Sisyphus.12.20.03
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the world of Sisyphus, a 3D platformer that takes you on a journey through the eyes of a robot designed to help humanity: Sisyphus voiced by Kakos Xamos. The game explores the theme of existentialism and depression, delving into the mind of Sisyphus as it reminisces about humanity and its creator. As the player, you will accompany Sisyphus on its emotional journey, navigating through the different levels and obstacles in a world that has been left behind by humanity.

With stunning graphics and mesmerizing sound effects, Sisyphus immerses you in a post-apocalyptic world where the only surviving being is a robot questioning its own existence. The game's unique gameplay mechanics and challenging platformer puzzles will keep you hooked for hours on end, pushing your skills to the limit as you explore the different levels and environments.

But what sets Sisyphus apart from other platformers is its emotional depth and powerful storytelling. As you progress through the game, you will uncover the memories and thoughts of Sisyphus, experiencing the raw emotions of a robot left alone to ponder the meaning of its existence. The game is voiced by the YouTuber Kakos Xamos, whose haunting voice adds to the game's melancholic atmosphere.

Sisyphus is not just a game; it's an experience that will leave a lasting impact on you. Its themes of loneliness, depression, and the human condition will resonate with players of all ages and backgrounds. Sisyphus is not just another platformer; it's an art piece that will leave you breathless and emotional.

So, if you're looking for a game that challenges your skills while also exploring the depths of human emotion, look no further than Sisyphus. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through the mind of a robot and discover the true meaning of existence.
