data.name: Bomb Bay
data.detailed_description:
Bomb Bay is a new single player game that takes the player into many different and unique settings with the task of arming explosive devices on enemy payloads. You are all alone, with nothing but your mind, your weaponry, and your mission.

This game offers hours of fun while giving you a rush of excitement leaving you on the edge of your seat wanting more. As the player, YOU get to decide how you play. You can run and gun, mowing down anyone that gets in your way. Or you can choose a more stealthy approach, leaving havoc in your way and disappearing before they even know what hit them.

Players can play many different ways. Whether that be arming the bombs, and heading straight to the EVAC zone. Or doing some snooping around and finding some beneficial equipment to assist on their mission. The possibilities are endless, whatever you can think of doing, you can do it here. Each level brings a new challenge to the player and new strategies to think of. No mission can be played the exact same.

Key Features:
  • Arm the three bombs on set locations, all while keeping your health up, completing secondary objectives, planning out strategies, and making fast decisions.
  • Learn the importance of mixing stealth and chaos to beat every situation with maximum proficiency.
  • Take a chance to explore the maps and find ways to assist you in your endeavors.

*Free DLC to come in future updates!

data.name: LUSTORIA
data.detailed_description:
STORY

 

You lead a quiet life in Fukuoka, Japan. One day, you acquire a strange book that tells of a place called LUSTORIA.

 

Shortly afterward, you meet Sylpha, an elf who has come from LUSTORIA. When Sylpha attempts to return home, a portal ends up dragging you and your friend Kana into the parallel world of LUSTORIA.

 

Now you must journey across LUSTORIA, a world of magic and danger. Find the power you need to open a path home and decide which relationships you want to explore during your adventure.

 

CHARACTERS

 

Meet Sylpha

Sylpha is an elf from LUSTORIA who unexpectedly appears in Fukuoka. Get to know her in your own world, discover what brought her there, and let your relationship develop far beyond what either of you expected.

 

Meet Kana

Kana is already part of your life before you arrive in LUSTORIA. You have always been attracted to her, but you have never known whether there could be something more between you. Now she is trapped with you in an unfamiliar world. Travel by her side and discover just how far your relationship can go.

 

Meet Yurika

Yurika is an apprentice witch from LUSTORIA. Grow closer to her, uncover the secrets she is hiding, and let yourself be swept away by a relationship shaped by magic, desire, and a world completely different from your own.

 

Meet Lilim

Lilim is a provocative, perverted, and incredibly fun demoness. Let yourself be drawn into her games and jokes as you discover what truly lies behind her chaotic behavior.

 

GAMEPLAY

 

LUSTORIA is an erotic visual novel featuring explicit sex scenes, romance, fantasy, and humor. Meet different women, deepen your relationships with them, and experience a wide variety of encounters as you fight to return to your world.

 

Explore Lustoria. Search for a way back home. Experience romance, make decisions, and enjoy numerous explicit sex scenes as you decide how you want to experience your adventure.

 

Main features:

• Adult visual novel with multiple choices.

• Explicit erotic content.

• Multiple endings and narrative combinations.

• Manual save and rollback system.

• One-click control.

• Adjustable sound and music options.

• All characters are over 21 years old.

• We stay in touch with our players; if you’d like to send feedback or suggestions, you can reach us by email or through messages on our Steam page.

data.name: Fear The Void
data.detailed_description:
Fear The Void is a philosophical, atmospheric, indie horror game with retro PS1 aesthetics.
A first-person adventure of self-discovery, filled with moral dilemmas, as well as the meaning and meaninglessness of life. Discover existential themes through symbolic horror and hidden truths.

During your subway journey home, something goes wrong, leaving you in quiet darkness.

Can you find your way back to reality? Are you sure you're a̶̗̐l̴̘͑o̴̺͘ń̶̼ê̴̞?


You aren’t the only person adrift in this place. How much of their faculties remain? Do their broken minds hold the secret for redemption? Find out t̴͉̓h̸̖͗e̷͓̎i̴͍͝ṙ̴̝ ̸̢̑p̷̱̍ȃ̴͎s̸̤̊ṱ̸̄ through conversation trees that affect y̵o̵u̶r̴ ̸f̴u̴t̴u̵r̷e̴.

With each decision you make during your time in this realm, you alter the ending of your own story resulting in one of 4 possible outcomes.



Threats lurk all around you. A lumbering creature with too many teeth in all the wrong places. A swift growling beast that you just might escape if you r̶͍̉̏̊u̶̩̘̝̾ń̴̜͝ ̷̧̯̀̑̕f̷͔̫͗a̸̖̣̽͠s̴͉͖̊͗t̵͇͂ ̴̨̨͂́e̴͔͑̉̊ņ̴̫̿o̷̗̐ṳ̷̌g̷̱͎̉̈́h̴͓̻̓̓̆. You must run, hide, solve puzzles, fight, and prove yourself worthy to stay alive.

All while an entity of colossal power a̵̹̫̒̔p̸̙̅̃̓p̸̮̱̔̏̄r̴̳̻̫̂̓o̴͗̆͜á̵̩̜̆̿ͅc̸̮̀h̶̜̾̽e̴̢̳̓s̶̙̔  through the void...

data.name: CrossAbout: Crosswords in Reverse (300★)
data.detailed_description:
CrossAbout is an innovative word game in which players build crossword puzzles in reverse. Given a set of crossword clues with multiple correct answers, players craft different layouts and combinations of words that satisfy the puzzle. Think you have the answers? Maybe... but can you connect them in the grid?

Earn stars by solving levels and by finding combinations with the most or fewest squares filled. A new puzzle is featured daily, while creatively-themed packs and monthly archives are unlocked using stars you earn along the way. (This full version includes 300 stars to speed things up!). Some puzzles involve higher challenges such as blocked or prefilled squares. Arrange answers around the blocks in a traditional crossword format. Correlate words which use the prefilled letters. Move or rotate your answers, and spend stars to get hints. Choose from an assortment of CrossAbout packs from simple to sudoku-style to difficult single solutions.

  • Daily puzzles
  • Detailed tutorial
  • Easy to learn; difficult to master
  • Thousands of clues
  • Bonus content
  • Social Media Integration

Get 300 stars right away by purchasing the full game here and donating to our non-profit, Cinq-Mars Media, a 501(c)(3) organization. Sales support our mission of developing educational games and technology. Our games are always free to students and educators.

CrossAbout was developed by the creator of the award-winning puzzle games Synonymy, Anagraphs, and The Devil's Calculator. Dedicated to and inspired by Will Shortz, NYT Crossword Editor.

Whether you are a crossword lover or a casual gamer, CrossAbout creates wordplay enjoyment. Have fun creating grids, and see how flexible your mind can be!

data.name: Card of Legend
data.detailed_description:
Angels, Cards, Battle! Unite the legends to prevent the resurrection of the evil forces!

A fantastic story of heroes joining forces with angels to stop the evil forces.

1. Diverse Game Modes:

  • Dive into an exciting anime Trading Card Game featuring intense PvP battles, immersive PvE missions, and thrilling Roguelike gameplay experiences!

2) Extensive Card Collection:

  • Collect over 100 beautifully designed anime characters. Assemble your team of angels and prepare your strategic deck to dominate every battle!

3) Trading card game requires intricate strategies

  • Conquer Your Opponents with a Wide Array of Strategic Tactics! Achieve Victory by Mastering Diverse Approaches in the Game!

1. Adventure (Roguelike) 

  • Deck Requirement: 40 cards

  • Challenge: Win all 10+ matches, including the formidable Boss, consecutively to conquer the mode.

  • Unique Feature: Experience our original skill system, exclusive to our TCG, offering fresh strategic depth unlike any other game.

2. Training (Ruins of Trials) 

  • Deck Requirement: 20 cards

  • Gameplay: Engage in classic TCG battles to hone your skills.

  • Rewards: Climb the levels and unlock better rewards as you advance!

3. Arena (PvP) ⚔️

  • Battle System: Compete against other players in thrilling PvP matches. Earn Battle Points and climb rank tiers that accurately reflect your standing in the game. Enjoy exclusive rewards based on your rank tier!

4. Card Enhancement 

  • Upgrade System: Enhance all your playable cards by combining them with upgrade + material cards and strengthen your deck to gain the upper hand in every battle!

5. Card Shop

  • Find rare and powerful cards to build your ultimate deck.

6. Card Collection

  • View all the cards you've collected in one place. This feature will allow you to easily manage and strategize your deck!

7. Tutorial

  • Follow our player-friendly, step-by-step tutorial and get ready to dive into the game in no time.

  • Avid TCG & CCG Enthusiasts : Perfect for dedicated Trading Card Game (TCG) and Collectible Card Game (CCG) players seeking their next thrilling challenge.!

  • Competitive Legends : Designed for players who thrive on intense, competitive matches against other top-tier Legends. Prove your strategy and rise to the top!

Experience stunning visuals with concept art initially crafted using AI technology, then refined by our illustrators to deliver breathtaking final designs.

Whether you're a seasoned card strategist, a fierce competitor, or an art lover, our game offers something special just for you! Join us now and become part of an extraordinary gaming adventure!

data.name: Apocalypse Cult Leader
data.detailed_description:
The world shuts down due to an outbreak that turns people into zombies. The Global AI takes over to form quarantine zones. You are one of the survivors in a walled off block under quarantine. The city is covered in miasma that sickens people, but you're less affected by it. Perhaps you are the chosen one to save the people in the block.

Gather food and supplies to trade with other survivors. Craft, farm, and cook to make things to help you. As you manage your Energy, Mental, and Hygiene. data.name: Try To Drive
data.detailed_description:
New Winter Update 3.0 is now available!

New themed maps for gameplay have been added.

Character and bike customization is now open. Everything for your celebration!

Unique Co-Op Bike Controls

You share control between two players! Each has their own role. Cooperate, communicate, and play together—because you have one goal!

One player controls the throttle, keeping you safe from deadly traps, while the other steers, finding the best path—the path to the top!

Master teamwork, or the journey will be nearly impossible.

Singleplayer and Co-Op!

This game is designed for cooperative play – you'll need a reliable partner who's ready to work as a team. Gather a friend, a relative, or just a brave soul who will share this challenge with you.

But if you want to test your skills alone - you are welcome!

Test Your Friendship and Teamwork!

Two friends decide to take on an unusual challenge—a tandem bike race, that take place at huge height. But they never expected the road to the competition to be this dangerous and unpredictable.

To make it to the top, you'll have to navigate through office buildings, busy highways, and even construction sites—where every obstacle will test your teamwork.

An unforgettable adventure filled with challenges and excitement awaits!

A Grand Journey Through Ever-Changing Locations

Dynamic landscapes and unexpected obstacles will keep you on your toes. From peaceful amusement parks to chaotic construction zones, every location is unique and demands a fresh approach.

You never know what’s waiting around the next corner.

A Challenge for Everyone

Four difficulty levels let you choose your challenge:

  • Easy — a relaxed playthrough with frequent checkpoints.

  • Normal — the challenges get tougher, as checkpoints appear less often.

  • Hard — only a few checkpoints across the entire map.

  • Insanity — no mercy and no checkpoints, pure focus and skill.

Are you ready to prove you can conquer any height?

data.name: Tiska Buska
data.detailed_description:
HEY, BEFORE YOU PLAY: This game sucks, plain and simple, alright? It's straight up horrendous, abominable even. Play at your own peril.
A big reason for that is that it's been created using this ancient game engine called 3D Rad, which has a ton of limitations and quirks. Of course someone who knows what he's doing could make a decent game out of it, but this was one of the first games i've ever made and i had zero skills and self awareness.

If you really have to play a game of mine, pick something more recent, such as 30 Days to be the Best or Mariuccha, Alchemy Queen. They also suck but they don't crash if you press Escape.
Links:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1908490/30_Days_to_be_the_Best__Ultimate_Edition/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542010/Mariuccha_Alchemy_Queen/

Anyway, the original description of the game:

Fight for redemption through the eyes of Mahkklen, a mysterious figure in search of vengeance in this world of dishonesty and tiranny, this action packed unseen combination of adventure and racing games offers you 9 levels of pure intrigue and danger, each one with a different new challenge, culminating in a war against your arch-nemesis!

data.name: HANZ!
data.detailed_description:
THE STORY

Attention, my plush fellow citizens! The enemy is already on the border of our Motherland – the Carrot Republic! Soldiers of the Cabbage Empire destroy our corn fields, their steel boots trample our radishes, onions and other greens! We can't retreat! There are only the plantation of carrots behind! We must fight back the enemy and remove his plush foot from our sacred land! Not one step back!
If you are brave enough, if you are a real patriot of the Carrot Republic – join the Carrot army in the new top-down shooter HANZ! Become a hero of your country!

THE SINGLEPLAYER MODES


  • Linear. Go through a difficult path from beginning to end of the level, destroying enemies on your way.
  • Capture the flag. Capture the enemy camp and raise your flag as high as possible.
  • Tower defense. Survive by killing waves of enemies. Turrets will be a great helper for you.
  • Chambers of good and positive. Stop shooting at enemies! Invite them to tea in the chambers of good and positive.
  • Bosses. Fight with the most dangerous inhabitants of the galaxy!
  • Bonus levels. Get the opportunity to feel like a farmer. Catch as many enemies as possible on the combine. And let no one run away from you.

Key features:

  • Variety of game modes!
  • Fight against dozens of enemies at the same time!
  • Character customization!
  • Play against players from all over the world!

data.name: SNAP JAW
data.detailed_description:
SNAP JAW is a unique fusion of synergy-building rogue-lites, with the tense and unsettling atmosphere of horror games, all wrapped up in one of gaming’s all-time favourite activities, fishing! Set in a sunken post-apocalyptic world teeming with starving beasts that must be fed. Make sure that you aren't the meal.

As you navigate the tides, you'll have to strategically upgrade your boat, rods, and other fishing equipment, in order to meet the ever-increasing demands of the mechatronic horrors that reside below. By the end of each day, you must have fed them their due, or face the consequences of failing to do so.

Humanity turned its back on God, creating artificial life in defiance of the Eleven Commandments. In response, God wept, and his tears unleashed a second great flood that drowned the earth and raptured every animal. You play as one of the few survivors, driving toward heaven to reunite with your dog and plead for forgiveness.

data.name: Workshop Keeper
data.detailed_description:
Start with a single workbench: gather, craft, and hire workers to automate. Use wagons to move supplies and boost output, then turn harbor routes into bigger margins. Taxes keep climbing, so expand production while you raise an army.


Half a lifetime of silk, fur and spice behind you, and you walk into Squirrelton at dusk. You spend most of your savings on a patch of land, and at first you do it all yourself: gather, craft, carry, sell.

Then the first tax bill arrives. Every week the taxes grow heavier, and you learn to make every coin count. Little by little the workshop grows, and hands are hired. They run the lines, and slowly the place starts working without you. You lead your crew into the dangerous ruins, where treasure waits, hoping that one day you'll have the muscle to run the tax men off your land.

You get rich. There is a second workshop, then a third. You build relay posts, move goods between them, and ship out of your harbor to continents across the sea. You grow, and keep growing, until you can stand up to the City-State itself.

Run your workshop

It all starts with a battered old crafting table, and at first you do everything yourself. Chop trees, quarry stone, cut wild grass; plant wheat, mill it into flour, bake it into bread... then set the goods on your counter for the townsfolk to buy. Food sells steadily but the margins are thin. Tools make money fast. Yet a crew of workers is waiting to be fed, and without bread, nothing gets done...

Feed a crew of workers

You can't run it all alone forever. The tavern always has hands waiting for work, and the hiring broker at the monthly market can point you to real talent. Once hired, they're yours to command: production, hauling, fighting at your side, even scouting the ruins for you. While you're battling through the depths, the tables back home keep turning. Just remember to stock the chest with enough bread to keep them fed.

Explore the ruins in the wilds

Spend your earnings on yourself: gear up, stock the production lines, then set out. Throwing darts, bread, potions, summon scrolls: all of it sharpens your edge in combat, and the ruins are packed with valuables waiting to be claimed. The Ruin Tokens you bring back can be traded at the Adventurers' Guild for cutting-edge technology.

Free Squirrelton

Crushing taxes keep you gasping for air, and they only get heavier over time. You have to figure out which production line earns the most, and let the profits snowball.

More people in town are fed up than you'd think. When you're ready, lead your workers and the volunteer townsfolk, drive out the garrison and the tax men, and end this endless taxation for good! Bring the town back to life.

The workshop trade network

The threshing ground suits farming and forestry; the Iron Ridge workshop is built right on top of an iron vein; relay wagons shuttle cargo between your workshops, sorting and delivering by crate type. Together they form a sprawling trade network. Save up enough to buy a ship at the harbor, haul your finished goods to port, and sell them to distant continents.

The City-State won't let it go. They'll stand in your way at every turn. When you're strong enough, manufacture armaments, ship them to the front line, and once you're fully prepared, settle the final score with the City-State face to face!

data.name: Hole Lotta Loot
data.detailed_description:
Dig a hole. Get rich.

Start on an old field with nothing but your bare hands. Crack the ground, break out a chunk and grab the treasure that falls out.

Sell it all, buy a bigger tool

Pour your bag on the Sell Scale and spend the cash. Spades, pickaxes, jackhammers, drills and giant borers: every new tool bites deeper.

Dig with up to 5 friends

Play solo or online with up to 5 friends. Everyone shares one wallet, so every find helps the whole crew.

Deeper means stranger

Every layer is harder and richer than the last. Crystal caves, lava, glowing caves full of bats, and stranger places further down.

Caves with guardians

Puzzle caves hide in the dirt. Beat the guardian sleeping inside, then solve the room to open the treasure.

Open crates, trade loot

Every sale also pays Tokens. Open crates for knives, gloves, skins and rare gadgets, and trade them with your crew. No real money, ever: Tokens are only earned by playing.

Make some chaos

Crash a Jetpack into the lawn, snip a friend's rope on the way up, dig up the yard with a Mini Excavator.

The Motherlode is still down there

A mining company dug here in 1911 looking for it, then vanished. Something guards it. Bring friends.

data.name: Knock Knock!
data.detailed_description:
Knock Knock! is an experimental horror game played with your ears, not your eyes.

You are trapped in a pitch-black mansion with zero visibility. Your only guide is a constant, rhythmic knocking. Your objective is simple: navigate the darkness, find the door, and answer it.

Your footsteps distinguish various floor materials, helping you understand your location. Haunting sounds around you create "Soundmarks" - landmarks made of sound - to help you mentally map out the mansion. You must use these cues to finally find the door and see who is so determined to speak to you.

Binaural Spatial Audio:

The game utilizes Binaural Spatial Audio to replicate 3D soundscapes. Cues are muffled through walls or dampened based on their orientation to your ears, providing a true sense of presence in the dark. Your footsteps distinguish various floor materials helping you orient yourself.

Visually-impaired Accessibility:

Designed from the ground up to be played with zero visibility, Knock Knock! provides a nearly identical, high-tension experience for both sighted and visually impaired players.

Gameplay Features:

  • Play time: 15–60 Minutes.

  • Zero visibility Exploration: You must navigate the mansion with zero visibility, relying solely on your ears.

  • Soundmarks: Use haunting audio cues to mentally map the layout of the game.

  • Native Narration: All menus and texts are read aloud automatically, requiring no external screen reader setup.

  • Warning: Uncomfortable audio.

*Headphones are recommended for the intended binaural experience.

data.name: Long Live Caesar
data.detailed_description:
Long Live Caesar is a real-time and turn-based strategy/RPG/brain-twister in which you play Gaius Julius Caesar, who must uncover all conspirators in the Senate, Magistrate, and Legion. Dark days are coming to the Republic - senators weave intrigues, the army will rebel, and the Roman citizens expect strong-willed decisions from you. Can you resist the impending threat and save Rome?

Famous historical characters of Caesar`s era can help or oppose you in that trouble. Be careful. Can you unite each of them under the SPQR banner?

            

Make your decisions wisely, reveal enemies, and reward friends. Remember, only you can determine Caesar's fate. Rewrite history with Long Live Caesar!

* Detective, Strategy, RPG, and brain-twister in one game. And all of it - in Ancient Rome!

* Exorbitant level of juicy pixel violence

* Roles of the conspirators are randomly distributed at the beginning of each game, which makes each passage unique

* Many historical (and not so much) events will give you the definition of replayability

* Every decision is unconditional and irrevocable. You can't reload to your last step. You should meet them face-to-face

* Black humor and references to some modern pop-culture personalities

* Pixel Graphics and an atmospheric soundtrack that brings you back to the 90s

data.name: KOBOLD: Chapter I
data.detailed_description:
KOBOLD is a new kind of horror experience that blurs the line between cinema and VR gaming. Step into the shoes of an urban explorer investigating the mysterious case of a missing boy. Pick up your flashlight and discover the secrets of an abandoned villa in the middle of a dark forest in Germany. Immerse yourself in true, cinematic realism, explore an interactive universe, pick up clues and dare to venture deeper into a mystical world where your actions can have grave consequences. With its intensely realistic visuals captured with photogrammetry, free movement and intuitive interactions, KOBOLD is a unique room scale VR experience that will entice and terrify...

A trans-media experience, KOBOLD is accompanied by a short film that can be viewed before entering the VR experience. The short film serves as an introduction into the world and characters and tells the backstory of the missing boy and his family. It is available to watch for free on the KOBOLD website. The player then puts on a VR headset and steps into the story, breaking into the abandoned villa, gathering clues, solving a mystery and entering a dark, mythical underworld inspired by European folklore and pagan mythology.

In order to make the transition from film to VR as immersive as possible, the entire villa (which is a real location in Brandenburg, Germany) and its surroundings were meticulously scanned with photogrammetry. Actors were also 3D scanned and brought to life in VR using motion capture and advanced facial capture technology.
AAA graphics from an indie studio, with character and level design, compelling gameplay and intuitive interactivity designed from the ground up for the Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.

The Thrill of the Hunt - Coins, Cards, Antiques, Art, and more!

data.name: 3D Life
data.detailed_description:
3D Life is a game of cellular automata that generate endless patterns from a few simple rules.

Cells live or die based on the number of live neighbors. Too many cells nearby, a cell is overcrowded. Too few, it is underpopulated. Empty cells come to life if they have a certain number of live neighbors.

From these rules evolve a multiplicity of forms that grow, blink, and glide through mathematical space. The behavior of each rule set is unique.

Use your stopwatch to control the flow of time: start and stop cell movement, slow down or speed up gameplay.

Use your flashlight to generate cells in three ways: randomly, frozen until discovered by the algorithm, or spaceships. Spaceships are cell patterns which move on their own, repeating after a number of generations. They can be created in any direction and orientation.

This game is VR-only for SteamVR-compatible headsets and motion controllers.

Key Features

  • 14 rule sets, each with their own unique patterns and behavior

  • 23 spaceships

  • 20 million+ cells

  • Start, stop, and control speed of play

  • Room-scale game; supports play areas up to 8 x 8 meters (26 sq. ft.)

Create Life in 3 Ways

Cells are generated in three different play modes: 

  • Randomly but symmetric with respect to one axis (as it increases the chance of spontaneous spaceships)

  • Frozen cells which remain until discovered by the algorithm

  • Spaceships that move on their own, repeating after a number of generations

Photosensitivity Warning

This game has rapid, flashing patterns.

Acknowledgements

Original Life by John Conway

Spaceships from the published work of Carter Bays

Game music from The Suite Acoustic by Matthew Lister

Trailer music by Christopher Wolff

data.name: DREDGE
data.detailed_description:
OUT NOW: THE IRON RIG DLC

The Iron Rig is the second official expansion for DREDGE - a cosmic horror fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. This content adds a new constructable destination with its own story, items and adversities that can be experienced at any stage in your playthrough


About the Game

Captain your fishing trawler to explore a collection of remote isles, and their surrounding depths, to see what lies below. Sell your catch to the locals and complete quests to learn more about each area’s troubled past. Outfit your boat with better equipment to trawl deep-sea trenches and navigate to far-off lands, but keep an eye on the time. You might not like what finds you in the dark...

Explore the Islands & Discover their Secrets

Starting from your new home in the remote archipelago, ‘The Marrows’, take to the water and scour the depths for curious collectables and over 125 deep sea denizens. Explore each area while completing quests and visiting neighbouring island regions – each with their own unique opportunities, inhabitants, and secrets.

Dredge the Depths

Someone wants you to dig up the past, but can you trust them and will it ever be enough?

Beware the Fog

Danger is everywhere, so watch for sharp rocks and shallow reefs, though the biggest threats of all lurk within the fog that cloaks the night-time seas...

Game Features:

  • Unravel a Mystery: Captain your fishing trawler across a collection of remote islands, each with its own inhabitants to meet, wildlife to discover, and stories to unearth.

  • Dredge the Depths: Scour the sea for hidden treasures and complete quests to gain access to strange new abilities

  • Study Your Craft: Research special equipment and upgrade your boat’s capabilities to gain access to rare fish and valuable deep-sea curios.

  • Fish to Survive: Sell your discoveries to the locals to learn more about each area, and upgrade your boat to reach even more secluded locations.

  • Fight the Unfathomable: Strengthen your mind and use your abilities to survive trips out on the water after dark.

  • Unravel a Mystery: Captain your fishing trawler across a collection of remote islands, each with its own inhabitants to meet, wildlife to discover, and stories to unearth.

  • Dredge the Depths: Scour the sea for hidden treasures and complete quests to gain access to strange new abilities

  • Study Your Craft: Research special equipment and upgrade your boat’s capabilities to gain access to rare fish and valuable deep-sea curios.

  • Fish to Survive: Sell your discoveries to the locals to learn more about each area, and upgrade your boat to reach even more secluded locations.

  • Fight the Unfathomable: Strengthen your mind and use your abilities to survive trips out on the water after dark.

data.name: Squishy Cats
data.detailed_description:
Are cats liquid? Build a playground and find out.

The internet says cats are liquid. Squishy Cats lets you test it. Build your own little world, drop in the cats, and watch them flop, wobble and squish their way through it. There are no levels to beat, no timers and no way to lose. Whatever you build is yours, and the only goal is to have fun with it.

Soft cats, springy bodies

Every cat is made of soft, springy parts, so they stretch when you pull them, wobble when they land and bounce back when you let go. Drag them, flop them, squish them against walls and watch how they settle.

How it works

Build. Drag platforms, spinners, fans, spikes, crates and asteroids from the tray into your arena. Everything snaps to a grid and fits together neatly.

Play. Press Play and the physics wake up. Grab your cats with the mouse and see how they flow, wobble and bounce.

Tweak. Press Edit and everything returns to where you placed it. Turn, resize, copy or delete anything, then try again.

Make it yours

Change the mood with 8 colourful themes. Place up to six cats at once. Your creation saves automatically, so it is waiting for you next time.

Made for taking it easy

No score. No pressure. No wrong way to play. Build something tall, something silly, or something that sends a cat flying across the whole screen. Don't worry: these cats are soft and squishy, and they always bounce back.

Key features

  • Soft, wobbly, squishy cats made of springy parts

  • Drag, flop and squish them with the mouse

  • A relaxed physics sandbox with no levels, goals or losing

  • Platforms, spinners, fans, spikes, crates and asteroids to build with

  • 8 colourful themes

  • Up to 6 cats at once

  • Turn, resize, copy and delete everything you place

  • Your creation saves automatically

Wishlist Squishy Cats to hear when it launches.

data.name: 🥔 Not So Hot Potato: 2025 Final Boss 🥔
data.detailed_description:
Throw 🥔 Catch 🥔

And... don't cry 😄

Also don't fail I'd say

"Not So Hot Potato: 2025 Final Boss" is NOT a punishing game but it can be a pain in a$$ sometimes to be totally honest. Don't worry much, just throw/catch (if you can) while you try to survive the traps and pushing forward. You may regret your decisions once you throw the potato or once you do a simple jump but it will be too late for sure... your problem really 💀

However, once you get there and finish it the relief will be priceless!

Features

🥔 Realistic potato physics (more or less)

🌌 A journey from the ground to the clouds — maybe even space

💀 Fail once and... just don't fail

👬 Optional co-op to suffer together

😤 Not-so-calm gameplay but it'll be fun!

Traps

  • You may get slaughtered

  • You may burn

  • You may fall

  • You may rage

  • You may scream

  • You may cry

  • You may suffer (Probably)

But you'll enjoy it all, don't worry

Maps

It will be just one map for now, if you finish this one successfuly I promise I will add more maps lol

Don't give up and don't forget sky's the limit. Don't question your life decisions, enjoy the game instead :)

data.name: Puppet House
data.detailed_description:
Puppet House is a puzzle-adventure horror game with escape room themes. Take on the role of detective Rick, investigating a series of mysterious disappearances of local residents. All the clues lead to an abandoned ventriloquist's house, full of dark secrets and terrifying surprises.

When the peaceful town of Field Town begins receiving reports of mysterious disappearances, Rick decides to investigate. Things quickly turn to worse, when the detective stumbles upon a horrifying surprise left by the late ventriloquist.

Come and face a demonic puppet that was born through a strange ritual and is now killing anyone who tries to enter the mansion...Will you be able to uncover all the secrets before the evil force gets you?

If you dare, try to beat…

PUPPET FROM HELL

As a result of a freak ritual, the old puppet comes to life and turns into a demonic killer. This paranormal force is hunting down anyone who dares to enter the mansion. What is it trying to hide? Are we sure that all the missing people are dead? Enter a dark house and see if you can carry out a…

DANGEROUS INVESTIGATION

Solve the puzzles hidden in the home of ventriloquist Peter Hill to uncover the truth. Take on challenges that require you to be not only clever but also logical. Your mind will be put to the test and any wrong decision could have dire consequences. Many mysteries are hidden in this…

FORGOTTEN MANSION

Wander through dark corridors where the shadows of the past intertwine with the present and feel like you're in a real escape room. Look carefully as old memorabilia hide the keys to the mysterious history of the house and its owner. Explore the abandoned grounds and find the answers you’re looking for.



Puppet House is thick with the atmosphere of tension and fear, heightened by the evocative visuals and sound design. The game skillfully builds a mood of dread that makes every step in the mansion a struggle for survival.

data.name: The Textorcist: The Story of Ray Bibbia
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for an electrifying mix between bullet hell and typing game! Dodge bullets while typing exorcisms at the very same time: turn on both sides of your brain and jump into the adventure of Ray Bibbia, a private exorcist who's going to face the threats of a demonic outbreak and deal with his dark and sinful past at the same time!



A city in decay, streets filled with thugs, crime and censorship and only one man to stop it all. Groundbreaking gameplay, exorcists, demons, metal singers, pimps, the Pope, drama, bad jokes and tons of hardcore action-filled boss battles for the first type ‘em up game ever realized.


In order to defeat the forces of evil, learn how to type your exorcisms with your keyboard or with your joypad WHILE dodging tons of bullets, dealing with puddles of barf, defusing bombs, singing at the mic of a metal show and more during intense Boss Battles: easier said than done. Hold your Bible tight, both hands needed!


Rome is the theatre of our adventure, discover new locations and fight in one of the biggest metropolis in history, home of some of the craziest characters and enemies! Behind a demonic outbreak, unearthly forces are scheming to seize power and subvert the order of the the biggest religious organization in Rome: The Holy Church has reached unlimited powers over the streets of the city, but how can our protagonist be sure of their good deeds? Unravel the demonic plot aimed to overturn the order in the city and put together the pieces of the dark past behind Ray Bibbia!


From Goth maids to gun-crazed gangsters and the Pope himself, Ray will get his hands dirty by exploring a great variety of locations to solve a mystery that’s going to grow heavier as it takes shape. Who’s gonna turn out to be a friend and who’s gonna stab Ray behind his back?

Are you a fast typer? Can you read and spell latin while you dodge bullets? THIS is the game you're looking for! Real exorcisms, english, latin and more! Avoid making mistakes and reach the highest combo! Compete with your friends by spelling the “perfect exorcism” and compare with their scores on online leaderboards!



Forgotten Relics Update Features:
  • Boss Rush Mode (Speedrunners welcome!)
  • Story Mode now offers 30 (+1) Trinkets
  • Hardcore Boss Fights
  • Updated Leader Boards

Main Features:
  • An intense storytelling
  • Tons of bullets
  • Lots of typing
  • 10 Boss fights
  • Challenging twisted typing mechanics for every boss
  • Type even to open a door
  • Type on a Holyvetti computer
  • Show it off with online leaderboards
  • Play with the keyboard for a typing experience or with a gamepad for a rhythm experience
  • Original Soundtrack composed by GosT
  • Some more Bullets

All these features and even more, if you're a fan of shooters, a masochist, a wannabe exorcist, or you just need some black comedy in your life, don't miss The Textorcist!

data.name: Conflict: Europe
data.detailed_description:
Finally, the threat of an atomic nightmare seems to be over. The equilibrium of terror that has held mankind under its spell for too long is about to lose its power. In CONFLICT: EUROPE we examine the diverse "what if ..." scenarios that have dominated world history for the past forty years.

In this gripping simulation, the player experiences seven different conflict situations. A comparison is made between the effects of nuclear and conventional weapon systems and the relationship between NATO and the Warsaw Pact is examined. The careful and realistic study of these scenarios in CONFLICT: EUROPE clearly shows that everything must be done to prevent such a nightmare.

FEATURES:
  • Represent either NATO or the WARSAW PACT.
  • Seven different conflict situations.
  • Full use of AWACS and reconnaissance.
  • Ground, Air, and Naval Forces included.
  • Range of nuclear and chemical fire plans
  • Special Forces raids.
  • Complex FSM based strategy system.

data.name: Codename: Panzers - Cold War
data.detailed_description:
Tempelhof, Berlin, dawn of 8th April 1949.

A major armed conflict is brewing between the Western powers and the Soviet bloc. The Red Army has been growing ever stronger since the end of World War II. With the growth of their army the Soviets realize that they hold the advantage, and are only waiting for the right moment to attack. That moment arrives with the Tempelhof Incident: the near-fatal collision of a US cargo plane and a Soviet fighter over Berlin's main airfield. A fatal combination of coincidence and human error, there is no point in arguing what went wrong, no point in asking who pulled the trigger first and who fired on whom in return. The Incident went down in history as fatal.

Within 12 hours of the crash the ground beneath the German capital is shaking with the salvoes of a war never meant to be: a conflict between former allies over Europe and global supremacy.

In this game the worst comes true, and it may just change the fate of the "free world" forever! WWII is now just a memory - but the Cold War has just begun...

Key features

  • Authentic "Cold War" era
  • Variable squads with powerful squad leaders, capable of easily taking on any kind of enemy, providing a gameplay more balanced and fun than ever!
  • Personalizable units with visible function upgrades
  • Unique building combat system - buildings can be destroyed or occupied to gain an advantage
  • Fascinating storyline which follows the personal fates of both familiar Codename Panzers heroes and brand new ones alike
  • Detailed "movie-like" world simulation: a truly "alive" world in which each and every single unit possesses its own AI and reacts to the player's actions accordingly
  • Single player campaign with 18 exciting missions. Your goal is to save the world and help NATO to stop the Soviets, yet occasionally you will end up changing sides to find yourself in Russia, helping out the KGB.
  • Scenario Mode: replay missions already won/unlocked in order to increase your overall score
  • 25 multiplayer maps and 3 modes: Domination, Multiplayer-Mission and Team Match
  • Physics-based building destruction. Each building will collapse in its own unique manner, using real-time physics simulation: pieces falling from houses are assigned to various categories according to their size and mass
  • Full simulation of the effects of light and terrain conditions on unit behavior
  • Weather changes affect gameplay and visual effects: reducing sight, movement speed, range of fire and every parameter imaginable
  • Dual display support with strategic map for making strategic decisions
  • Brand new Gepard 3 graphics engine with full vertex and pixel shader 3.0 support

data.name: 宇宙探索
data.detailed_description:
宇宙探索


在浩瀚的宇宙里，漫天飘洒的宇宙尘埃和星河光尘，人类正在探索了解宇宙，以获得对宇宙的更多认知，促进人类的发展强大，抵御未知宇宙生物的侵略。然而，外星人得知这一消息，派出大量的战舰，千方百计的阻挠人类探索宇宙，频繁的进攻人类空间站，予以摧毁人类的太空基地。英雄的您将驾驶，人类研发的最高级宇宙战舰，搭配各种军事武器，抵御歼灭，外星敌舰的进攻。

每过一关，歼灭敌舰，都会升级不同的武器，最终歼灭BOSS敌舰，解锁宇宙探索，获得太空旅行，记录全球每位玩家的通关时间和展示，等您来挑战！

1. 核心战斗：玩家驾驶宇宙战舰，与敌舰热血战斗；
2. 游戏玩法：在开放的宇宙空间，体验丰富的武器系统，和太空旅行；
3. 游戏文明：科幻的军事武器，各种战舰，各种飞船；
4. 玩家相关：您可以和伙伴组建队伍，创建队伍共同对抗敌对战舰！

data.name: Aris Arcanum
data.detailed_description:
Once destined to lead the grand library of Aris, scholar Clyde now faces its ruin. Appointed overseer of Atramancy, the art of manipulating the occult Ink, he must confront the very force that promised knowledge but delivered madness.

The Ink, an alien entity sealed deep within the arcane library called Aris, was studied for its power to enhance magical abilities. But its price was steep. Those who embraced it became consumed, their minds twisted, their bodies marked with wounds of dark sludge.

With his mentor Mira lost to the curse, Clyde must descend into the corrupted halls of Aris, battling warped scholars and unraveling layers of cosmic horror. Clyde must overcome the scourge of the Ink and its collections of twisted reality to preserve the order and the reason of Aris.

  • A unique Victorian-era, magic-infused roguelike, where you guide a determined scholar through the cursed Library, balancing the frailty of his body with the limitless potential of the Magic of Ink.

  • Spellcraft unique magic, using Ink to combine abilities and scribe your own unique spells to see you through the complexities of the Archives and the challenges they pose, using a fair, but challenging combat system.

  • Experiment with thousands upon thousands of builds to find your favorite, as death is but a setback. Every death is a reset - but his magical talents ensure he is no worse for the wear. 

  • Descend into otherworldly stacks, where reality crumbles and endless rows of shelves and books give way to the endless, all-consuming void...

  • Overcome corrupted staff and monsters, and collect Knowledge to maintain your progress as Clyde dives deeper and deeper into the Library to carve the path towards his salvation, growing wiser and more powerful with each death he suffers...

data.name: My Little Cosmos
data.detailed_description:
My Little Cosmos is a light clicker / idle game.
Players simply launch the game, and during normal computer use, keyboard input and mouse clicks are converted into the driving force behind the evolution of a universe.

There is no need for focused play or constant interaction.
My Little Cosmos does not compete for your attention — it continues to evolve quietly in the background, with all processes running automatically.

Throughout the evolution, you begin with a small asteroid and gradually guide the development of your universe, unlocking new stages and content over time.
At fixed intervals, the game grants random rewards, slowly expanding your collection as you progress.

Features

  • Any keyboard input or mouse click contributes to the evolution of the universe

  • Multiple growth stages that gradually unlock new systems and content

  • Designed for idle play, with full background operation support

  • Steam inventory rewards drop automatically at regular intervals

  • The game does not record, analyze, store, or upload any input data — play with confidence

data.name: Guris The Game
data.detailed_description:
A group of streamer friends known as "Os Guri" falls into the clutches of an unknown entity; within its universe, the entity forces them to play titles they had previously streamed—but under rules set by the entity itself, which controls the entire universe.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Play the entity's games and uncover clues—either solo or with friends—to escape this universe; each of the entity's games features its own unique rules and gameplay mechanics.

The entity enjoys toying with its prisoners; it may manipulate any of them to hinder the investigation.

Make saving "Os Guri" from this celestial entity your primary focus—do whatever it takes to achieve this. Your second objective is to neutralize the entity somehow; your investigations will help make this goal attainable.

ATTENTION: The entity dislikes company. If provoked, it may banish you to a parallel dimension where it selects survivors to battle one another; the champion will earn a reward from the entity.

Playing the entity's games—whether alone or with others—pleases it, earning you "Guri Points" to spend in its cosmetic shop.

Good luck on this journey to rescue "Os Guri"; I am counting on you, my perfect creation...

Play as Tichi as she runs and jumps through a variety of levels. Solve challenges, collect crystals, and go fast for the best possible time.

- Memorable levels and music
- 1 large scale boss fight
- Hub area with unlockable trophies
- High replayability
- Low poly aesthetic

data.name: Carachnophobia
data.detailed_description:
Step into a galaxy not far far away, where an alien race plotting the end of mankind discovered a spectacular creature that has the potential to create the necessary chaos. There is only one problem; it is not very intelligent and requires some training!

This creature is known as the Mimic due to it's knack for infiltrating battery-powered devices, and especially prefers the automobiles for their comfy shell. While this disguise is abundant, the Mimic is yet to learn how to make best use of it's abilities, and what modifications would be useful in the upcoming challenges.
Thus, Project Carachnophobia was born—a potential new chapter in human history's book of fears.

Your mission: Train the Mimic through various preset scenarios devised by the aliens. Overcoming these challenges will prove if the Mimic is up to the task, ready to be unleashed on Earth—a resource-rich, but somewhat dirty, planet. At last, we might get a taste of those famous croissants!

data.name: Pinball Storm: Lokanta
data.detailed_description:
UPDATE ROADMAP


About the Game

Pinball Storm: Lokanta is a roguelike marble shooting game. You will face waves of enemies, challenge the elite, and stand against strong Bosses. As a rebel, you will use marble pinball as your weapon. Associate with new companions, unlock new marbles, then further enhance your marbles with your loot. All your foes shall perish!

In Lonkata, you will challenge the endless army of Plutocracy alone, but fear not for the powerful marbles in your hands will treat them!

Marble Pinball will bounce between objects and enemies on the battlefield. You will charge your energy bar after kills. Once full, you can summon the helper Diting to re-bounce all your marbles.

You are not alone in your journey. Different companions will bring you new marbles after their special events. Build your own combo-play with different marbles! You can also collect resources from fights to have mega-evolution to your marbles——from a mere fireball to extreme giga explosion! There are over 20 marbles and 100 upgrades in the game, providing infinite possibilities for your adventure!

Every region in Lonkata has its warden Boss. They have their identical skills, which requires adaptable use of your marbles. Ice for slow and Fire for ignite, don't forget the Regen marble that can heal your HP. Exploit your surroundings with flexible positioning. Terminate all threats!

data.name: Shadowbound
data.detailed_description:
Shadowbound is a 3D platforming and puzzle journey where light is your enemy and shadow is your only ally.

After a mysterious cataclysm, the world has been reduced to fragments suspended in the void. Travel through its ruins, manipulate light, and seek shelter in the shadows as you recover the lost colors.

Each color reveals a memory from the protagonist’s life: their childhood, their family, the passage of time, and those everyday moments that only seem important once they have been left behind.

Overcome short, focused levels that combine movement, precision, and environmental puzzles. Leap between shadows, move objects, redirect beams of light, and activate mechanisms as you gradually reconstruct a story about growing up, remembering, and learning to value the time we have.

Key features:

· Platforming and puzzles based on the interaction between light and shadow.

· An emotional story about family, memories, and the different stages of life.

· Minimalist black-and-white environments that gradually regain their color.

· Short, varied levels focused on clear and direct challenges.

· Mirrors, lasers, detectors, physical objects, and interactive mechanisms.

· Environmental storytelling told through memories, environments, and fragments of color.

· An experience about the passage of time and the importance of making the most of every moment.

data.name: FERRA
data.detailed_description:
VENGEANCE TAKES A FERAL FORM

You are Yako—a former elite PMC operative betrayed by the corporation that turned you into a monster. They took your past, your dignity, and your lover. Now, as the sole survivor of the "FERRA" experiment, you’re here to take it all back—with interest.

TWO FORMS. ONE RELENTLESS PATH

In FERRA, combat is a rhythmic dance between two lethal playstyles:

  • The Arsenal Master (Human Form): Dominate the battlefield with a deadly array of katanas, uzis, shotguns, and heavy artillery. Upgrade your gear to dismantle corporate security with surgical precision and maximum style.

  • The Beast (Kitsune Form): Give in to the rage. Unleash blinding speed, scale walls, and shred enemies with primal claws. Use the Bite System to regenerate health by literally tearing into your enemies' throats—keep the massacre going.

STYLIZED ANIME CARNAGE

Experience a high-octane visual blend where modern Japanese culture meets a grim cyberpunk future:

  • 2D Soul, 3D World: Fluid, hand-drawn 2D-animated hands, weapons, and VFX integrated seamlessly into a stylized 3D environment.

  • Cyber-Mythology: Fight through the neon-soaked streets of 2055 Japan, where ancient folklore and high-tech collide. Face enemies inspired by Japanese legends, armed with cutting-edge cybernetics.

  • Adrenaline-Fueled Parkour: Movement is your greatest weapon. Chain wall-runs, slides, and dashes to turn every encounter into a cinematic masterpiece of violence.

COMMUNITY NOTE: FERRA is in active development. We are a small team with zero budget, and this is our first game. Our goal is to create a cool and fun shooter experience. Visuals, mechanics, and balance will be constantly improved based on your feedback—and we’re also looking for a publisher! :D

Become an early part of the project and help us shape the future of FERRA.

data.name: VtuberCompanySimulator
data.detailed_description:
Instead of Choosing from Preset Options, Type What You Want to Say.

From crisis response to one-on-one meetings, you decide what to say to your VTubers. Generative AI draws on each VTuber's personality, their current state, and the relationship you've built so far to create a reply for that moment.

From Their Name to the Way They Speak, Create the VTuber You've Imagined.

Choose their name and appearance, how they refer to themselves, how they speak, their opening and sign-off for streams, and even the name of their fandom. Add recurring phrases and sentence endings to complete their unique personality.

The concept you create carries into streams and conversations. Watch them introduce themselves, address their fans by the name you chose, and react to what's happening in the speaking style you chose. Watch the VTuber you imagined make their debut and build a fandom of their own.

Don't Miss the Subtle Signs.

Each VTuber has their own preferred activities, a pace they can sustain, and relationships with their peers. Stress and frustration can build even when results are strong, surfacing through subtle changes in the way they speak, stream, and relate to others. Focus only on the numbers and keep pushing the schedule, and you may miss the moment that matters.

Hear them out in one-on-one meetings, give them rest and support, or adjust your management approach. Respond to their needs in time and keep your promises to build trust; missed signs can turn into conflict and crises, eventually leading to a graduation announcement or an impulsive action. Protecting both performance and relationships means knowing when to push and when to stop.

You Decide How They Grow.

Each week, review how your VTubers are doing and the opportunities available, schedule streams, lessons, and rest, and decide which activities and investments each one needs. When the streams end, performance, fandom response, revenue, and stress reveal the results of your week. Review what worked and plan the week ahead—the heart of running your company.

Once streams have built a fandom and raised funds, you can take on new ventures such as albums and merchandise. As the company grows, a wider recruitment pool, competitions, a company festival, and global expansion open up in turn. Choose which activities to prioritize and how far to expand the business, and build the agency you want to run.

data.name: NEKOPARA Vol. 3
data.detailed_description:
Patisserie "La Soleil", run by Kashou Minaduki, is flourishing thanks to the help of two catgirls: Maple, full of pride and a little on the haughty side, and Cinnamon, an impulsive daydreamer.

These two are especially close among the rest of the sisters. One day, Maple encounters something that shakes her belief in attaining her dream. Cinnamon, unwilling to see Maple suffer, wishes to help her in any way possible... but she can't figure out how. This story is a heartwarming cat comedy about their ambitions and the bonds between family members... with a little ecchi on the side, too.

This story is a heartwarming cat comedy about their ambitions and the bonds between family members... with a little ecchi on the side, too.

data.name: Solitude Underwater
data.detailed_description:
Solitude Underwater is a short horror-adventure game where you play as one of two treasure-hunting brothers who are searching for a long-lost ship filled with sunken treasure, but everything goes wrong…

FEATURES

  • Original Sound Track made by Rozmis B. Gergő
  • In Depth Story created by Louis Badalament
  • Voice Acting by the very talented Jake Johnston and Louis Badalament

GAMEPLAY

After a deceptively calm start aboard the boat with your brother, you’ll soon find yourself trapped in a shark cage at the bottom of the ocean.  A cage broken in such a way where the sharks can get in, but you can’t get out.  You will have to fend off the hungry sharks armed with nothing but the light from your phone… and did we mention its battery is almost dead?  As if that wasn’t bad enough, your oxygen tank is also broken; be very careful about when and how long you draw your next breath!  And if you somehow manage to find a way to escape the cage, other challenges still lie ahead!  Will you somehow manage to survive this deep-sea nightmare?

data.name: Kingsvein
data.detailed_description:
All contact with the city of Kingsvein has been lost. As Wisp Slayer, your role is to investigate and exterminate whatever evil lurks there.



  • Adventure through the castle and its outer reaches as you see fit - secret treasures and skulking beasts hide around every corner!
  • Dynamic, deep, and challenging tactical combat - toss your enemies into spikes then electrify their blood, or cover the battlefield in flames
  • Customize your team by mixing and matching 16 different classes, each with upgradeable abilities and equippable passives
  • Use your abilities to explore - freeze rivers with your magic, blast through cave walls, and throw chains to topple statues
  • Ride your loyal steed in and out of combat, and train it to be as fierce as any Knight
  • Set in the realm of Graven, a weird subterranean world of living soil and half-stone Diecast
  • From the maker of the highly-rated Horizon's Gate, Voidspire Tactics and Alvora Tactics

data.name: Amazing Space
data.detailed_description:
⠀⠀⠀⠀

Welcome to the fascinating world of space stations! Immerse yourself in a futuristic chaotic environment and create your own space base in the vastness of space. In this thrilling scenario, you become a pioneer and the last hope of humanity after Earth has been destroyed. With your spaceship, you managed to be one of the few survivors, and now it's up to you to plan and build a new home for your crew.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

Your space base will not only be a place of survival but also a place of progress and innovation. With workplaces, production facilities, service rooms, and shipyards, you have the opportunity to build a thriving community in space. Lay the foundation for a sustainable way of life and ensure your crew has everything they need to live and work.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

The workplaces in your space base will ensure that everyone has a meaningful task and contributes to the whole. From scientists working on groundbreaking discoveries to engineers developing new technologies to doctors caring for the well-being of the crew, everyone will play an important role. The diversity of professions will create a sense of community and purpose.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

The production facilities are the engine of your space base. Here, you can gather and process raw materials to produce essential materials and resources for survival and progress. Create an efficient production chain and optimize your processes to ensure the sustainability and independence of your space base.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

Service rooms will be crucial for the well-being and safety of your crew. Create recreational and community areas where people can relax and interact with each other. Also, consider the need for medical facilities and emergency measures to respond quickly in emergencies.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

Finally, a shipyard is where new spaceships are built and maintained. This will help you expand your fleet and broaden the horizon of your explorations. You can discover new worlds, mine resources, and rescue more survivors.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

However, dangers also lurk in the vastness of space. Always be on guard, as your spaceship and space base could be targeted by hostile forces seeking your resources. There is a real danger that enemies will try to hijack and plunder your spaceship.

⠀⠀⠀⠀

To protect your space base and crew, you should implement defense systems. Develop advanced defense mechanisms to repel potential attackers. From security teams to automated weapon systems to security protocols and access controls, your defense measures must be robust to defend your space base and valuable resources.

data.name: Launch Hazard
data.detailed_description:
Launch Hazard is a third-person physics score-attack game about turning crashes into deliberate combos. Aim and steer a rocket-gun-powered dude, hit valuable targets, and keep the chain alive.

CRASH TO EARN MOMENTUM

Hard impacts score points and refill momentum. Fire continuation shots into different objects to grow your multiplier.

MASTER THE MAPS

Each map has valuable targets and objectives to tackle across runs. Complete objectives for bonuses or chase the high score, then refine your route. Each 90-second run has multiple launches. Total score and completed objectives persist between runs, so every attempt can build a cleaner chain.

FEATURES

  • Active ragdoll steering

  • Chain-based scoring

  • Multiple objectives per map

  • Unlockable loadouts

  • Mastery Ranks from F to S

data.name: DARK FOREST
data.detailed_description:
Dark forest; It is a TPS (Third Person Shooter) survival game that aims to find a lost treasure by fighting mutant wolves, legendary guards and mythological beings.


You are struggling alone. Are at middle of forest where no one can give you a hand. There is nobody besides you. A forest nobody dare to get there, even if they do so, they can't go out of forest alive. It is that kind of mysterious forest that you are looking for a treasure, in order to find it you clashing with gods, guards and mutant living beings in it. Your bravery will lead the way.

Story Mode



A treasure that has been lost for centuries… a treasure guarded by the god Horus and destroyed by any being that dared to approach! 20 different traces were identified, almost all of them were visited, but no results were obtained from anywhere. But only in one place! A god awaits you at the end of the adventure in this forest, which is full of mutant wolves and where legendary invincible warrior guards are found when you delve into its depths. The god Horus can only be defeated with the legendary sword, and with this sword he can kill a god only in the hands of the chosen one. The most important condition for success in this adventure is to be the chosen one for the treasure. So are you that chosen one? If you believe that you are the chosen one, the Dark Forest awaits the owner of the treasure. You have to overcome the mutant wolves, fight the guards and finally win a relentless fight with the god Horus, the guardian of the treasure.

Fight to live



Gods, Guardians and Mutant wolves. Destroy them all. You must survive in this jungle.

Weapons



Pistol, rifle, machete, knife and legendary sword. This sword can even kill a god.

Realistic Weather



Real weather and rain effect. You will feel like you are at home.

High-End Graphics



Realistic images make you feel like you're in the game.

data.name: BunkerZ
data.detailed_description:
Launch zombies sky-high. Scavenge the trenches. Keep the bunker standing.

BunkerZ is a solo and co-op third-person zombie survival shooter set on a stylized WWI-inspired battlefield.

Defend a crumbling bunker against relentless undead attacks, then venture into the surrounding trenches to complete objectives, recover supplies, and prepare for the next assault. Choose your class, unlock weapons, repair your defenses, and turn mines, turrets, explosives, and heavy firepower against the enemy.

DEFEND. SCAVENGE. SURVIVE.

Holding the bunker is only half the battle. Push into the trenches between attacks to search for resources, recover equipment, and complete dangerous objectives.

The farther you venture, the more you may bring back—but the greater the risk of being caught outside when the undead close in.

BUILD YOUR DEFENSE

Use recovered supplies to repair the bunker, replenish ammunition, unlock equipment, and strengthen vulnerable positions.

Place mines, deploy turrets, and prepare your defenses for increasingly dangerous attacks.

FIGHT ALONE OR TOGETHER

Survive solo or join forces with friends. Coordinate specialized roles as your squad balances bunker defense, exploration, and resource recovery.

Choose from the Rifleman, Engineer, Medic, and Machine Gunner, each with distinct weapons and team utility.

UNLEASH WWI-INSPIRED FIREPOWER

Fight with bolt-action rifles, trench guns, revolvers, machine guns, shovels, grenades, flamethrowers, and experimental weapons inspired by the era.

Combine period firepower with destructive bunker defenses built for explosive, zombie-slinging chaos.

A HANDCRAFTED BATTLEFIELD

A claymation-inspired visual style brings the soldiers, weapons, trenches, and undead to life with a distinct handmade character.

Zombies stagger, lose helmets, pile together, and launch through the air as bullets and explosions tear across the battlefield.

FACE THE UNDEAD ARMY

Battle shambling infantry, rifle-wielding undead, explosive BerZerkers, hulking brutes, and other threats that force you to adapt.

Complete objectives, survive escalating attacks, and take new risks beyond the safety of the bunker.

data.name: Who Killed Mr X
data.detailed_description:
Who Killed Mr. X is a graphic novel featuring colorful characters in a mysterious and surprising story reminiscent of Agatha Christie, Saw, and Zero Escape : 999.

Make your own choices and solve puzzles to find the end of the story and reveal the truth.

STORY:

You wake up in a small, dimly lit room furnished only with a telephone and a television. But you're not alone... You discover that eight other people are locked inside with you.

Who are these people? What are you doing here? No one has any answers. Fear and anger rise, when suddenly... the phone rings.

The choice is yours now : Will you dare answer and plunge into the dark heart of this mystery?

Will you be able to uncover the terrible truth... and survive it ?

FEATURES:

  • A rich and complex storyline that you'll have to unravel like a true detective.

  • A dark thriller atmosphere reminiscent of SAW, Zero Escape: 999, and Agatha Christie.

  • Graphic novel.

  • Original Cluedo-like visual style.

  • Multiple choices and multiple endings.

  • As you make your choices, unlock hidden clues that will help you understand the story and unmask a serial killer.

  • This Game is entirely made without AI, even for the translations.

data.detailed_description:
For the price of a Coffee! Garbage Packer – A Physics-Based Garbage Truck Simulator

Garbage Packer is a realistic Physics Based Garbage truck game! Dump dumpsters and experience realistic controls along with it!

  • Multiple Trucks - Side Loader, Front Loader, Rear Loader

  • Ability To Add Custom Skins - Join the Discord for full guide!

  • Physics-Based Trash Collection – Use realistic truck controls to lift dumpsters, dump trash, and crush it with the packer to maximize space.

  • Fully Functional Truck Cab – Features working buttons, camera system, mirrors, and an animated interior for added immersion.

  • Strategic Packing System – Manage your truck’s limited capacity by compacting garbage efficiently for bigger hauls and higher earnings.

Dump out Collected Trash at the Transfer Station!

Do you have what it takes to build your trash empire? Get behind the wheel, start collecting, and prove your skills in Garbage Packer!

Check out the official Discord in the Discussions/Community tab!

data.name: Code Market
data.detailed_description:
Your store. Your robot. Your code.

Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

Real Java, from the very first line

  • Write real Java: variables, loops, methods, arrays, lists, maps, classes and inheritance.

  • Start simple with robot.move(Direction.UP) and unlock new language features in the tech tree as you go.

  • A built-in reference explains every command, with examples you can copy.

  • Keep your code in files and folders, run several scripts, and see errors and logs right in the game.

Run a living store

  • Customers walk up the trail, line up at the register and ask for up to three goods.

  • Take their orders, collect tomatoes, pumpkins, bread, soda and beer, and pack them into the bag.

  • Order deliveries from code: a truck brings the goods to your garage, and your robot restocks the shelves.

  • Mind the clock: selling alcohol at night will cost you a fine.

Grow and automate

  • Buy new racks and decor and arrange the store the way you like.

  • Upgrade everything: more space, a longer line, more customers, better prices, a faster processor, a second robot.

  • Watch the seasons change — spring rain, green summer, falling autumn leaves, winter snow — while your code keeps the store running day and night.

Learn to code by playing, or put your programming skills to work and build the perfectly automated supermarket.

data.name: Farmer Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Explore rural life in a completely new way with Farmer Survivors, an exciting Arcade Survivor game that puts you in the shoes of a brave farmer facing a bug infestation on their farm. Get ready for a gaming experience filled with challenges, skills, and plenty of action!

Farmer Survivors is an arcade survival game where you must withstand endless waves of insects hungry for your harvest. How long can you endure?

Automatic Targeting:

Don't worry about aiming; the game's automatic targeting system automatically focuses on the nearest enemy, allowing you to concentrate on survival strategies.

Rising Challenge:

The waves of insects become increasingly stronger and numerous, testing your skills and resilience at every moment. There are 4 seasons you can unlock as you progress through the waves!

Farm Environment:

The farm is the perfect setting for the epic battle that unfolds. Immerse yourself in rural life as you defend your precious crops. Face a variety of enemies, all based on typical farm insects. Some of them even launch projectiles, keeping you on your toes!

Strategic Choices:

At the end of each wave, you'll have the opportunity to choose items that can aid you on your journey. Make wise choices as they may be the key to your survival! Unlock and upgrade a wide range of abilities with unique effects to aid in your fight against the insects.

Weapon Diversity:

Choose from a variety of weapons, each with unique passives, and discover which suits your playstyle best. Each game is unique, thanks to randomness in the distribution of items and abilities. You never know what surprises the farm holds for you!

Get ready for an epic battle for survival in the countryside with Farmer Survivors. Put your skills to the test, make strategic decisions, and defend your farm against the invasion of hungry insects. Are you ready to be the rural hero the farm needs?
data.about_the_game:
Explore rural life in a completely new way with Farmer Survivors, an exciting Arcade Survivor game that puts you in the shoes of a brave farmer facing a bug infestation on their farm. Get ready for a gaming experience filled with challenges, skills, and plenty of action!

Farmer Survivors is an arcade survival game where you must withstand endless waves of insects hungry for your harvest. How long can you endure?

Automatic Targeting:

Don't worry about aiming; the game's automatic targeting system automatically focuses on the nearest enemy, allowing you to concentrate on survival strategies.

Rising Challenge:

The waves of insects become increasingly stronger and numerous, testing your skills and resilience at every moment. There are 4 seasons you can unlock as you progress through the waves!

Farm Environment:

The farm is the perfect setting for the epic battle that unfolds. Immerse yourself in rural life as you defend your precious crops. Face a variety of enemies, all based on typical farm insects. Some of them even launch projectiles, keeping you on your toes!

Strategic Choices:

At the end of each wave, you'll have the opportunity to choose items that can aid you on your journey. Make wise choices as they may be the key to your survival! Unlock and upgrade a wide range of abilities with unique effects to aid in your fight against the insects.

Weapon Diversity:

Choose from a variety of weapons, each with unique passives, and discover which suits your playstyle best. Each game is unique, thanks to randomness in the distribution of items and abilities. You never know what surprises the farm holds for you!

Get ready for an epic battle for survival in the countryside with Farmer Survivors. Put your skills to the test, make strategic decisions, and defend your farm against the invasion of hungry insects. Are you ready to be the rural hero the farm needs?
data.short_description: Welcome to Farmer Survivors, where you'll embark on an epic rural adventure, defending your farm against hordes of hungry insects in this action-packed Arcade Survivor game!

data.name: マイ・プラネット─MOON CHILD─
data.detailed_description:
My Planet: MOON CHILD is a classic visual novel featuring a branching narrative driven by player choices.

[Key Features & Gameplay]

• Simple Mechanics: The story progresses primarily through mouse clicks, making it accessible to all players.

• Branching Storyline: Frequent in-game choices lead to multiple distinct paths and endings.

• Standard System Functions: The game includes essential visual novel features such as skip, auto-play, save/load, and message backlog.

Experience a compelling narrative where your decisions determine the ultimate fate of the story.

STORY

The national project 'Ark,' aiming to establish a new human settlement.

The young man Jinan, chosen as a member of the planetary exploration crew,

descends to the new land together with Hitoriko, a prodigy from the slums.

What they witness there is the appearance of aliens

who are strikingly identical to humans───.

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

・Total of 165 standing illustrations

・Total of 110 event CGs

・Scenario text approximately 230,000 characters

*Some backgrounds use AI-generated images.

Character Introduction

  • Jinan

  • Protagonist.

    Born on a lunar base, he studies diligently at the "Academy" but fails.

    After various events, he sets out on a journey to explore planets as a member of the Ark Ship Project.

Hitoriko

Born on the moon. Grew up in the slums and met Jinan when skipping grades to the 'Academy.'

Due to various circumstances, became involved in the Ark Ship Project together with Jinan.

Cheerful personality and friendliness attract the people around them.

  • Nora

  • The first alien encountered in the new world.

    Lives deep in the mountains, away from the village of aliens.

    Risking their own life to save Jinan, who has fallen into a desperate situation.

    Skilled with a bow and good at hunting.

  • Chairman

  • The president of the Moon Base's comprehensive educational institution, the "Academy."

    Not only a great scientist with remarkable achievements, but also a charismatic lobbyist involved in lunar politics.

    Called 'teacher' by Jinan.

  • Praline

  • Aliens living in a new world.

    They interact innocently, even with Jinan, who came from the moon, with a naive and cheerful demeanor.

  • scholar

  • An alien who always has a stern face.

    Unlike other aliens, it is very cautious.

    Skilled in handling a spear.

  • Ossa

  • In an alien village, he serves as the village chief who organizes them.

    He seems to be crippled in the lower half of his body and does not try to move from the mansion.

    He knows a lot about the village.

  • XーXyz

data.name: Monster Masher
data.detailed_description:
Drop, Match, Win!

Match Huge Combos!!

Battle Bosses!

You have a pit. You have monsters. You put the monsters in the pit. They merge. You get dopamine. You do it again. This is your life now.

Monster Masher is a drop-and-merge puzzle game with pixel-art monsters, dungeon vibes, and enough Gen Z energy to make your therapist concerned.

THE GAMEPLAY LOOP (it's giving obsession)

Drop monsters into a pit. When two of the same kind touch, they merge into something bigger and rarer. Ants become bees. Bees become slimes. Slimes become... look, it escalates. Chain merges together for combo multipliers that hit different. But if the pit overflows? It's giving game over. No cap.

BOSS FIGHTS (they ate and left no crumbs)

Every few merges, a boss pulls up uninvited. You get a random weapon — could be a fire cannon, could be an acid sprayer, could be a literal doom launcher. You have 12 seconds to delete them. If you don't? They SLAM into your pit and ruin everything you built. Slay or get slayed, bestie.

DAILY PUZZLES (main character energy)

Same puzzle. Same monsters. One attempt. The whole world gets the same seed. Either you cooked or you didn't. Check the leaderboard and find out if you're him or if you're NPC.

FEATURES THAT GO HARD

  • 15 monster tiers from tiny ant to absolute unit dragon

  • 39 bosses that each move different and all chose violence

  • 8 weapons with status effects — burn them, freeze them, melt them, judge them (real)

  • Daily puzzle mode with leaderboards so you can flex or cope

  • Full controller support — Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, we don't discriminate

  • 6 languages because monsters are universal

  • Original chiptune soundtrack that lives in your head rent free

  • Achievements for the completionists who can't help themselves

  • A game over screen that roasts you personally
