data.name: They Speak From The Abyss: Zenith
data.detailed_description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Twisted homage to classic RPG dungeon crawlers

  • Fight or Commune in turn-based battles

  • Solve sinister puzzles throughout the Abyss

  • Grounded psychological horror narrative experience

  • Unique 2D pixel + 3D low-poly retro style blending


About the Game

ZENITH is a standalone prequel for 'They Speak From The Abyss' (Coming 2027)

THEY SPEAK FROM THE ABYSS: ZENITH is a twisted homage to classic dungeon crawling RPGs. Set in a cursed world filled with the tortured souls in a hellish dimension. Most of which are just trying to live out their eternal suffering in some sort of peace. Explore beautifully gruesome environments, solve sinister puzzles, and confront the woeful souls and frightening demons lurking throughout the Abyss.

EXPLORE

Inspired by classic dungeon crawlers, the world of THEY SPEAK is filled with NPCs, secrets and bits of lore. Wander through the labyrinthine halls and alleys of the City of Dis, battle your way through the Blood Bog, and face your fears in the sinister Mansion Melancholia.

FIGHT

Many encounters are pre-set, while random encounters are possible in more threatening parts of the game world. Battles are turn-based, and require deft usage of your weapons, items and skills. Fill out and consult the Grimoire to learn everything you can about your foes, and prepare for your next encounter.

SPEAK

Not every demon in THEY SPEAK is out for blood. Whether that be in the dungeon or mid-combat, you can always try to Commune with those you encounter. This can provide valuable information, unlock alternate options, or save you from an otherwise deadly encounter. Don't be afraid to speak your mind.

data.name: Godslayer|one
data.detailed_description:
Godslayer | one


Godslayer | one is a small first-person single-player indie adventure game in which you look for unique and bizarre boss opponents. Usually one hit on the weak spot of your opponent is enough to defeat him, but be careful - they will be able to defeat you just as easily with one hit.

Unique experience:

You find yourself only armed with your bow in a mysterious world in which you have to face unique boss opponents. You will die a lot as you learn how to defeat your enemies, but once you know how, you will be able to finish each of them in only a few seconds.

Replayablity:

As soon as you have finished the game, you can start it again and try to minimize your deaths and defeat your bosses even faster!

This is a survival horror game set in a haunting school environment.

Gameplay Description

The player controls a girl exploring different locations within the school to find memory fragments. With each fragment she collects, her lost memories slowly return, revealing more about what happened that day. Keep her safe from hidden threats and survive to uncover the whole truth.

Game Controls

Arrow keys: Move
Z: Interact
Shift + Arrow keys: Dash
ESC: Open Menu
Alt + Enter: Window Mode

data.name: Rhythm Storm
data.detailed_description:
--GAME OVERVIEW--

Rhythm Storm is a roguelike bullet heaven/horde survivor with heavy rhythmic elements. Your vehicle automatically aims and fires (player-controlled twin-stick firing is possible at any time) while you control movement and a special power. You select a vehicle, set it's initial configuration and powers, then proceed into the action.  Nearly everything in the world (except you) moves to the beat, and your goal is to survive to the end of each song.  There are 3 main worlds, a boss, and a bonus world, each with its own unique song and mix of enemies.

--VECTOR GRAPHICS, NO TEXTURES--

Rhythm Storm uses untextured lines and polygons in rendering the game world and UI (along with a few fullscreen effects). The game visuals are crisp and clear, and the more resolution you give it the better it looks. For the best experience, it is recommended that you play the game on a 1440p (or higher) monitor with a refresh rate of 120hz or higher. [Playing the game at 1080p/60hz is still enjoyable, just less than ideal.]

--RHYTHMIC GAMEPLAY--

Rhythm Storm is a musical experience, but it's not a traditional rhythm game. Nothing your vehicle does is synced to the music, but much of the world IS synced. Wave changes happen every 8 bars of music, powerups and the world pulse to the beat, the UI is jamming to the beat, and many of the enemies move to the beat.  Enemy spawning is also synced.  Though the game is heavily synced to the music, no musical talent or beat-synced button pressing is required to succeed at the game.

--REFINED BULLET HEAVEN FORMULA--

At its core, Rhythm Storm is similar to other Bullet Heaven/Swarm Survivor/Horde Survivor games in structure.  At the start of the game, you configure your vehicle's default upgrades, which includes the starting weapon(s).  You also select which 4 categories of upgrade types you want to see (these are called Upgrade Sets).

During gameplay, you destroy enemies and collect XP as usual.  When you collect enough XP to upgrade, you'll choose between 2 sets of upgrades.  Each set has 3 upgrades, two of which are from the upgrade set category, while the third upgrade is more random.  It's simpler and more intuitive than it sounds, and keeps the pace of play going while still allowing for a variety of builds and dynamic choices.  More choices are also available once you unlock the re-roll modifier (semi-permament meta-progression upgrades).

data.name: GrunglePunch
data.detailed_description:
In an alternate reality of South America where animal fighting has become the norm, "Grungles" have been created to fulfil humanity's animalistic desire for BATTLE.

Multiplayer:

GrunglePunch contains a high-octane and boisterous multiplayer PvP mode. With up to 4 player games, players engage in free-for-all combat against one another or AI players. With a broad range of Arm Modules and Items, engage in a violent power fantasy against your friends. Knocking them out of the game's many unique maps.

Customization:

Individuals can customize their grungles with a large set of colors and hats, turning them into their very own unique little monsters. Further customization options can be unlocked as players progress through the story, discover hidden secrets, and unlock challenging achievements.

Story:

The story of GrunglePunch episodically follows the tales of many different grungles and their HEARTBREAKING experiences in this awful world. Guide them through vast complexes, difficult battles, and puzzles too confusing for their tiny, pathetic brains. Learn about the many applications of grungles and their relationship with the people who use them.

GrunglePunch contains a high-octane and boisterous multiplayer PvP mode. With up to 4 player games, players engage in free-for-all combat against one another or AI players. With a broad range of Arm Modules and Items, engage in a violent power fantasy against your friends. Knocking them out of the game's many unique maps.

Individuals can customize their grungles with a large set of colors and hats, turning them into their very own unique little monsters. Further customization options can be unlocked as players progress through the story, discover hidden secrets, and unlock challenging achievements.

data.name: Master of the Ages: Foundations of History
data.detailed_description:
Master of the Ages is a historical 4X strategy game focused on the mechanics of empire building. From the Ancient world to the Modern era, you direct the macro-strategy of your civilization across six eras of human history. The visual presentation favors clean, tidy graphics, making it easy to see what is actually happening across your empire at a glance.

CITIES THAT SPECIALIZE

Cities are differentiated through structural infrastructure choices, not just tile output. Starting in the Classical era, several key buildings come in mutually exclusive pairs: build the Market District for trade and growth, and the Artisan Quarter — better suited to cities sitting on hills and mining terrain — is permanently locked out. By the late game, most of your cities will have settled into distinct roles and flavors based on the infrastructure choices you committed to along the way.
  • A single currency & Urban Capacity. No gold, no influence, no parallel economies to juggle. Production Points are the empire's entire economy — upkeep, construction, and research all draw from the same pool. However, growth is strictly bounded by Urban Capacity; a city's population will stall until you commit production to infrastructure that physically expands its urban footprint.
  • Queue-driven production. Allocate Production Points to what you want built — buildings, armies, founding projects. Unspent PP converts to Research Points up to a per-city Scholarly Capacity (raised by Libraries, Universities, and similar). Beyond capacity the conversion drops off sharply, so idle production cannot be silently converted into unlimited research.
  • City Focus. Each city declares its purpose. Growth and Production focuses are available from the start; Military and Science focuses unlock through later civic technologies. An automated governor handles tile-by-tile improvement decisions according to the focus, leaving the bigger picture to you.
  • No settler units. There is no settler to micromanage. Mature cities project new ones through founding projects, with real constraints on distance, supply lines, and food provisioning from the parent city.

COMPOSITE ARMIES, REAL LOGISTICS

Combat is automatic and resolves over several rounds, with the option to retreat between rounds. Each round runs through structured phases — Air, Artillery, Ranged, Cavalry, Melee, Support — and your composite armies engage according to the unit classes they pool together. Type advantages, terrain modifiers, veterancy, and morale all factor into outcomes. Battles play out quickly but the results feel grounded — armies that take heavy damage break morale and rout, and sieges require actual siege weapons — you will not breach a fortified city with cavalry.

The strategic layer is what gets armies into a fight:
  • Supply networks with finite range, chained supply depots, and depot positions enemies can target to disrupt your campaign.
  • Movement types (Foot, Mounted, Wheeled, Tracked, Motorized) that interact with terrain and roads — mountain passes matter, river crossings matter, road infrastructure matters.
  • Zone of Control that turns terrain choke points into real tactical decisions without requiring you to micromanage individual units.
  • Naval and air domains with embarking constrained by your port infrastructure's transport capacity, escort mechanics, coastal bombardment, and submarine stealth. Fleets patrol open water to engage hostile ships and shield vulnerable, embarked armies from interception.
  • Unified urban defense — cities defend with walls, militia, and garrison together. Taking a fortified city means breaking through each layer in turn.

FIVE BRANCHES OF PROGRESS

Technology is structured across five parallel categories — Agriculture, Engineering, Science, Civics, and Military — so your civilization develops as a coherent society rather than a single line on a tree.
  • Boost any category to accelerate research where you most need it.
  • Era advancement requires meaningful breadth across all five categories. You cannot sprint through Ancient by ignoring everything but Military.
  • Cross-category prerequisites create genuine strategic chains across the tree.
Six eras span Ancient through Modern, with technologies grounded in their historical context.

COVERT POWER

Beyond open warfare, you run espionage networks that gather intelligence on rivals, steal technologies, and execute sabotage. Espionage uses a deterministic friction model rather than dice rolls — the outcome of an operation is legible from its inputs, and a rival hiding a tech lead behind closed borders is a problem you can solve with patience and infiltration rather than luck.

THREE PATHS TO VICTORY

The Modern Era drives the world toward a climax. As any nation closes in on a victory condition, a global Doomsday Clock appears — alerting all players to the impending threat. There are no quiet, behind-the-scenes finishes.

Military Victory — Full Spectrum Dominance
Achieve a global Combat Strength (CS) of at least 1.5× the combined total of all surviving rivals to trigger a 10-turn surrender countdown. No tedious, city-by-city mop-up required. However, because CS scales dynamically with current unit HP%, a global coalition can pause or reset your countdown by damaging your forces via artillery, airstrikes, or skirmishes.

Economic Victory — Mars Colonization
Construct both a Spaceport and a Fusion Reactor to unlock the continuous Launch Mars Payload project. Every Production Point allocated across these specialized industrial hubs converts directly into tonnage toward a one-million-ton threshold. To stop you, rival nations must physically bomb your spaceports or capture your launch cities.

Science Victory — AI Singularity
Construct specialized AI Research Labs across your empire and flood them with Research Points. The Doomsday Clock displays the exact turns remaining until the Singularity completes, painting an immediate target on your top science hubs for the rest of the world.

NUCLEAR WEAPONS

The Modern Era introduces nuclear options, permanently reshaping both the map and the user. A strike scorches a seven-hex radius into a lasting wasteland. Crucially, the aggressor accumulates stacking domestic instability — protests, unrest, and lost urban capacity — while retaliatory strikes carry no such domestic penalty. Striking first cripples your own empire; striking back does not.

A NOTE ON DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Master of the Ages is built for players who value systemic depth and clear feedback. The map favors readability over visual density, and the mechanics reward long-term planning over mechanical busywork.
With a unified economy driven by a single currency and an automated tile-management system, players do not need to manage individual settler movements, route spies across hexes, or handle granular micromanagement. Time spent in menus is focused entirely on making high-level, strategic decisions about the macro-development of your civilization.

data.name: Ashenburrow
data.detailed_description:
Ashenburrow is an underground survival and simulation game where every creature, every NPC and every resource follows its own rules of life. You are not the hero of this place. You are the newcomer.

An ecosystem that breathes

Wildlife doesn't just wait for you to fight it. Armoured isopods, darting springtails, burrowing mole rats, stealthy shadow spiders: each species seeks food, mates and safety. A juvenile follows its parents, an adult guards its eggs. Break one link in the food chain, and the world adapts.

You are not alone down there

Goblins, bandits, adventurers: other groups came down before you. They set up camp near water, gather, craft, keep watch, talk to each other… and fight over territory. Nothing is scripted: everyone weighs the situation, picks their goals and plans their actions.

Lead your expedition

Pick up to four companions at the start, each with their own affinities, then give your orders: follow me, hold the line, build. Mark a campfire as the heart of your camp, and your group organises itself around it.

Light is a resource

Underground, light is not a given. Your vision is a cone ahead of you; whatever leaves it vanishes from the screen. A well-placed torch protects you as much as a weapon, a campfire warms you and cooks your meal… and announces your camp to everything that prowls. And even underground, night falls.

Survive, craft, build

Hunger, thirst, fatigue, wounds: the depths punish carelessness. Mine, gather, butcher, cook. Lay down your blueprints and watch your group build them: workbench, chest, kiln, smokehouse, drying rack, pottery wheel, sewing station, forge. Each station unlocks its own recipes. Your character improves by doing: what you do shapes you.

A simulation, not a hack'n'slash

Ashenburrow is not a dungeon to clear. It's a world to understand, to exploit with patience… and to respect. The world is procedural: five biomes, different tunnels and ruins every game.

Together

Play with 2 to 4 people in the same world. Join a friend's game and lead your own expedition… or ask to take over one of their colonists: if they agree, you pick the character up right where it was. The map is shared within the group, and if you leave, your character stays in the world until you come back.

data.name: The Things We Lost
data.detailed_description:
A psychological horror seen through the eyes of a man confined to a wheelchair after a recent car accident.

Shortly before the crash, he inherited the house where he grew up.

The longer you remain inside, the stronger the unease becomes, slowly settling in your mind.

Reality begins to fracture — and it is no longer certain that you are the only one who truly lives in the house.

data.name: KATA-DRAW
data.detailed_description:
There are several dots on the screen.

“Manipulate” them to match the shape of the star drawn on the screen.

That’s all there is to KATA-DRAW.

However, you don’t move the dots directly.

In this game, you use two “forces”—attraction and repulsion—

to manipulate the dots indirectly.

Use gravitational force to pull the dots together, repulsive force to spread them apart, and the average force to adjust their spacing.

Which force to apply where, and how much—that’s where the art of balance comes in.

Since the effects of the forces ripple out across all the dots, adjusting one spot causes another to shift.

The completion rate creeps up, then stalls, so you try applying more force.

Before you know it, you’ll find yourself completely absorbed in chasing that “just a little more.”

Each stage features a target shape and a “completion rate.”

Use forces to raise the completion rate; reach 100% to clear the stage.

Starting with triangles, then squares, hexagons, circles, stars, and a cat’s face…

As you progress through the stages, the number of dots increases and the shapes become more complex.

■ Recommended for:

・Those who love puzzle games where you can’t stop saying, “Just one more try”

・Those drawn to games with a slightly unconventional control scheme

・Those who enjoy the sense of accomplishment that comes from completing beautiful shapes with their own hands

・Those who enjoy games where you can take your time and play carefully with a controller

■ Key Features

・A unique system that allows you to indirectly manipulate points using gravitational and repulsive forces

・A wide variety of shape-based stages

・Real-time completion rate display lets you see your progress toward clearing the stage at a glance

・Supports both mouse and controller

Translated with (free version)

About the Game

data.name: Kit's Quest
data.detailed_description:
Jump into your next great adventure in this challenging, fun-filled 3D platformer!



It’s a disaster! Kit’s sister Vixie has been kidnapped by Dregnor, Skyreach Mountain’s resident dragon. And it’s way too dangerous for anyone to go after them! …Right?

Well, Kit’s not the kind of fox to give up so easily. He’s determined to confront the menacing dragon, even if that means going on the quest of a lifetime!

What awaits Kit on his perilous journey?

EXPLORE!


Immerse yourself in a huge, interconnected world! Your adventure might take you anywhere…

  • An abandoned mine deep underground?
  • Colourful treehouses high up in a forest canopy?
  • The flooded shrine to a water serpent?
  • An enchanted metalworks factory?
  • You name it!

COLLECT!


Scavenge everything you can get your paws on to help make headway on your quest!

  • Dregnor has placed magical barriers throughout the land… Look for dragon teeth and use their magic to break through!
  • Friendly birds might be willing to lend you a hand (or wing)… especially after you bribe them with some gathered berries!
  • Queen Nelli has lost her Golden Mushrooms! Find them and Her Majesty may reward you handsomely!

OVERCOME CHALLENGES!


Confront all sorts of novel challenges, whether you need to…

  • Make creative use of Kit’s many cool abilities, from summoning ice block platforms out of thin air, to remotely detonating mushroom spore bombs!
  • Use your foxy cunning to solve tricky puzzles!
  • Put your platforming prowess to the test in a multitude of exciting environments!

FIND FRIENDS!


Meet and befriend a marathoning parrot, a skittish bunny, a world-famous stork archaeologist, and many more allies who will help you on your way!

FIND… FOES?


As if Dregnor wasn’t bad enough by himself, his alliance with the deadly spiders who roam the land is sure to cause trouble. If you find yourself going up against a crystalline arachnid at least twenty times your size (and probably in a bad mood), just remember… Vixie’s counting on you!

THE RIGHT CHALLENGE FOR EVERYONE!


  • With several difficulty options, Kit’s Quest can be enjoyed by beginners and 3D platforming veterans alike!
  • There’s also a dedicated Speedrunning mode for those who like to go fast.
  • Finally, there might just be some extra hard-to-get secrets in store for true experts…

data.name: Barbie™ Horse Ride & Rescue
data.detailed_description:
Join Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts as volunteers at the Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Explore a vibrant open world, scout for horses, and help solve the mystery of how they came to roam free in Moonrise Valley.

Rescue Roaming Horses

Ride out on quests to rescue and befriend roaming horses and bring them home for rehabilitation. Discover thousands of combinations of beautiful horse coat colors and patterns to add to your stable.

Build a Loving Bond

Care for your rescued horses to earn their trust and settle them into their new home at the ranch. Form a bond with your horses and discover their unique personalities and traits.

Take Part in Equestrian Challenges

Take the reins in challenges including barrel racing and time trial, then race the Moonrise Valley community in a friendly competition to improve your riding skills!

Express Your Style

Dress up your avatar and horses to express your individual style! Collect hundreds of gorgeous tack sets and outfits to use in styling challenges and photo modes.

Get ready to saddle up for a cozy equestrian adventure in Barbie Horse Ride & Rescue, coming soon!

data.name: Bat to the Beat
data.detailed_description:
Swing your bat to the beat in this cricket-themed rhythm action game.

Think on your feet

Experience a unique twist on rhythm gameplay that challenges your sense of rhythm and spatial awareness. At each beat you have to make a split second decision. Attack and risk getting caught by the fielders. Or defend and let the pressure build up.

Enemy positions and patterns are randomized to make each play-through unique, forcing you to think on your feet.

Travel the world

As you make your way across the cricket-playing world you'll be challenged by the unique grooves of each country - ranging from one-drop reggae beats of Jamaica to syncopated Indian rhythms.

Fight for the top spot

Once you complete the campaign, you'll unlock the ability to compete on leaderboards for each level in the 'timeless test' mode. The longer you survive, the more frenetic the action gets!

data.name: Warp Gate Galactic
data.detailed_description:
Step into your new home, a ring transport station in a lawless system commonly called 'Isfetian Space' on the edge of Federation territory. Most people say running a warp gate station in Isfetian Space is too dangerous and won't be profitable, but you didn't listen!

The Federation doesn't care what happens on the galaxy's fringe, but a ship that wants to travel back into the safer core systems needs clean credentials. That's where you come in! Earn the trust of The Federation by sending ships that have cleared credentials, exposing counterfeit credentials, and reporting wanted individuals to the Federation Police. Send too many uncleared ships and you'll lose the trust of The Federation, and your access to the core systems, leaving you with a warp gate and nowhere to send ships!

Core mechanics:

  • Send ships through the warp gate to generate income

  • Maintain the station and keep it in tip-top shape

  • Collect resources to craft parts

  • Hack into a ship's computers to validate credentials and expose counterfeits

  • Place and send tracking data on flagged ships and report wanted individuals to gain Federation trust

  • Explore the asteroid field and uncover its secrets

data.name: Greywind's Legacy - A Text Based, Skill Progression, RPG
data.detailed_description:
This Game Has No Audio

----

Step into a simplistic RPG with bare bones text based menus as your main interface with the world.

You will find no flashing popups, messages trying to drive engagement, or yellow paint in this game.  Greywind's Legacy is a simple, straightforward game, created for you to enjoy however you see fit.

Optional Depth

This game's world is built around one main idea: optional depth.

You can decide to play the whole game only swinging a dagger on your lonesome and never worrying about anything else. But if you ever run into something that interests you while on your adventure, that depth is there for you.

Say you find a crafting recipe for a fire resistance ward and want to place it on your armor to make your upcoming fights in Dragon's Domain a little easier. Those ores and herbs you passed earlier without caring are there for you to collect. Those weapon and armor shops you never entered are there to lend you their anvil.

The same can be said for every single feature in this game. They were all put here to add one thing: depth.

I have always wanted a simple game that I can just play. Not worry about whether I'm optimizing correctly or hitting the right order for progression.

This is that game. You just play it and pursue whatever avenue you want.  Do whatever catches your attention and sounds like fun to you.

Play It Your Way

You want to be an Adventurer taking quests and moving your rank up as you demonstrate your competence and strength while exploring the world at the same time?

The Adventurer Guild, with its Clerk, Quest Board, ranks from Bronze all the way to Hero, and yes other Adventurers doing the same thing, are there.

You want to be an Arena fighter after being beguiled by an Arena Master's sales pitch?

Jump into one of the arenas in the world and start fighting for coin while climbing the leaderboards. Or sit in the stands taking a break and betting on who will win the next bout.

You want to master every form of magic?

Go talk to mages, read spell tomes, and cast spells of all ten elements to pursue magical perfection.

You want to focus on one of the seven weaponskills like Axework?

Go buy that axe and swing!

You want to develop your base?

Go recapture your ancestral home and invest into building it back into greatness.

This game will not point you in a direction to play. There is one main objective, to kill the god who killed your grandfather, but even that is completely optional.

Progress through each of the 7 Tiers of power at your own pace. Decide to stay at Tier 1 longer to develop skills and discover different skill merges and the Tier 2 class options they unlock, or decide to focus on the path of a swordsman and evolve your tier as soon as you're able.

Features

  • 328 skills to explore, levelled by doing. Swing a sword to level swordsmanship, mine an ore to level mining, read a book to level arcana.

  • 190 classes spread across 7 tiers, each unlocked by the skills you earn.

  • Over 400 abilities, each distinctly different from one another.

  • A living world with a day and night cycle, an in game calendar, NPCs of all different sorts, live inventories, and depth.

  • 15 zones to travel, from the Heartlands you start in to Dragon's Domain at the far end of the world.

  • 192 enemies, each with their own levels, tiers and abilities, recorded in a Monster Grimoire that fills itself in as you fight them.

  • A Home Base you can reclaim and upgrade.

  • A straightforward damage type system with weaknesses, resistances and immunities.

  • Crafting, with 70 recipes to find. Temper a weapon, etch a ward into your armor, brew something stronger than a potion.

  • Shops with finite inventories that refresh on a natural timer.

  • Companions to earn out in the world, plus adventurers you can hire at any Guild. Each companion has their own voice, their own personal quest, and their own class evolutions that you choose for them.

  • Dungeons to explore and bosses to defeat.

  • 29 titles to earn, choose which title to equip by speaking to a Town Crier in any Town!

  • Quests of all different sorts.

  • Lore, some hidden, some not so much.

  • Last but not least: a very simple text based visual and menu system.

Core Loop

The core gameplay loop involves leveling Skills and Classes.

Actions you take have a Skill associated with them. Attacking with a sword, mining ores, learning about the world. You level a Skill by using it. Skills start at Tier 1 Level 1 and give bonuses to the player based on their Level and Tier.

When a Skill reaches Level 10 you are given the option to evolve the Skill, Merge the Skill with an applicable Skill, or wait. Evolving the Skill will advance it to the next Tier and reset the Level to 1.

Merging is offered when you have two or more compatible Skills at the same Tier and all at Level 10. You can choose to merge them into a stronger combined Skill. This will also advance the Tier and reset the Level just like with evolving, but you will now have one stronger Skill instead of two weaker ones.

Or you can choose to wait. Whether you're waiting for more skills to reach Level 10 in the Tier to unlock more Merges or if you just feel like you want to wait.

Classes work in a similar way. You gain Class Levels by collecting XP by defeating enemies, completing quests, or other activities. Every ten Levels Classes, just like Skills, are given the option to Evolve to a higher Tier or wait.

However, what Class Evolution options you are offered depend entirely on your current Skills. If you want to evolve your class into a Tier 2 Swordsman you'll need the Swordsmanship skill. Class Levels also don't reset after evolution, unlike Skills.

The last part is abilities. Although you can gain abilities by reading ability tomes or by evolving certain skills, the main way you will gain the majority of your abilities is by leveling your Class. Every two Levels you are offered three abilities to pick from based on your current class. A Swordsman will be offered abilities that make sense for a Swordsman, while a Mage will be offered abilities that make sense for a Mage. Once prepared, abilities can be used in combat at the cost of Mana.

This loop continues from Class Level 1 to 70 and from Tiers 1 to 7. Level 70 is the game's Level Cap and T7 is the highest Tier.

----

Hope you enjoy!
data.about_the_game:
This Game Has No Audio

----

Step into a simplistic RPG with bare bones text based menus as your main interface with the world.

You will find no flashing popups, messages trying to drive engagement, or yellow paint in this game.  Greywind's Legacy is a simple, straightforward game, created for you to enjoy however you see fit.

Optional Depth

This game's world is built around one main idea: optional depth.

You can decide to play the whole game only swinging a dagger on your lonesome and never worrying about anything else. But if you ever run into something that interests you while on your adventure, that depth is there for you.

Say you find a crafting recipe for a fire resistance ward and want to place it on your armor to make your upcoming fights in Dragon's Domain a little easier. Those ores and herbs you passed earlier without caring are there for you to collect. Those weapon and armor shops you never entered are there to lend you their anvil.

The same can be said for every single feature in this game. They were all put here to add one thing: depth.

I have always wanted a simple game that I can just play. Not worry about whether I'm optimizing correctly or hitting the right order for progression.

This is that game. You just play it and pursue whatever avenue you want.  Do whatever catches your attention and sounds like fun to you.

Play It Your Way

You want to be an Adventurer taking quests and moving your rank up as you demonstrate your competence and strength while exploring the world at the same time?

The Adventurer Guild, with its Clerk, Quest Board, ranks from Bronze all the way to Hero, and yes other Adventurers doing the same thing, are there.

You want to be an Arena fighter after being beguiled by an Arena Master's sales pitch?

Jump into one of the arenas in the world and start fighting for coin while climbing the leaderboards. Or sit in the stands taking a break and betting on who will win the next bout.

You want to master every form of magic?

Go talk to mages, read spell tomes, and cast spells of all ten elements to pursue magical perfection.

You want to focus on one of the seven weaponskills like Axework?

Go buy that axe and swing!

You want to develop your base?

Go recapture your ancestral home and invest into building it back into greatness.

This game will not point you in a direction to play. There is one main objective, to kill the god who killed your grandfather, but even that is completely optional.

Progress through each of the 7 Tiers of power at your own pace. Decide to stay at Tier 1 longer to develop skills and discover different skill merges and the Tier 2 class options they unlock, or decide to focus on the path of a swordsman and evolve your tier as soon as you're able.

Features

  • 328 skills to explore, levelled by doing. Swing a sword to level swordsmanship, mine an ore to level mining, read a book to level arcana.

  • 190 classes spread across 7 tiers, each unlocked by the skills you earn.

  • Over 400 abilities, each distinctly different from one another.

  • A living world with a day and night cycle, an in game calendar, NPCs of all different sorts, live inventories, and depth.

  • 15 zones to travel, from the Heartlands you start in to Dragon's Domain at the far end of the world.

  • 192 enemies, each with their own levels, tiers and abilities, recorded in a Monster Grimoire that fills itself in as you fight them.

  • A Home Base you can reclaim and upgrade.

  • A straightforward damage type system with weaknesses, resistances and immunities.

  • Crafting, with 70 recipes to find. Temper a weapon, etch a ward into your armor, brew something stronger than a potion.

  • Shops with finite inventories that refresh on a natural timer.

  • Companions to earn out in the world, plus adventurers you can hire at any Guild. Each companion has their own voice, their own personal quest, and their own class evolutions that you choose for them.

  • Dungeons to explore and bosses to defeat.

  • 29 titles to earn, choose which title to equip by speaking to a Town Crier in any Town!

  • Quests of all different sorts.

  • Lore, some hidden, some not so much.

  • Last but not least: a very simple text based visual and menu system.

Core Loop

The core gameplay loop involves leveling Skills and Classes.

Actions you take have a Skill associated with them. Attacking with a sword, mining ores, learning about the world. You level a Skill by using it. Skills start at Tier 1 Level 1 and give bonuses to the player based on their Level and Tier.

When a Skill reaches Level 10 you are given the option to evolve the Skill, Merge the Skill with an applicable Skill, or wait. Evolving the Skill will advance it to the next Tier and reset the Level to 1.

Merging is offered when you have two or more compatible Skills at the same Tier and all at Level 10. You can choose to merge them into a stronger combined Skill. This will also advance the Tier and reset the Level just like with evolving, but you will now have one stronger Skill instead of two weaker ones.

Or you can choose to wait. Whether you're waiting for more skills to reach Level 10 in the Tier to unlock more Merges or if you just feel like you want to wait.

Classes work in a similar way. You gain Class Levels by collecting XP by defeating enemies, completing quests, or other activities. Every ten Levels Classes, just like Skills, are given the option to Evolve to a higher Tier or wait.

However, what Class Evolution options you are offered depend entirely on your current Skills. If you want to evolve your class into a Tier 2 Swordsman you'll need the Swordsmanship skill. Class Levels also don't reset after evolution, unlike Skills.

The last part is abilities. Although you can gain abilities by reading ability tomes or by evolving certain skills, the main way you will gain the majority of your abilities is by leveling your Class. Every two Levels you are offered three abilities to pick from based on your current class. A Swordsman will be offered abilities that make sense for a Swordsman, while a Mage will be offered abilities that make sense for a Mage. Once prepared, abilities can be used in combat at the cost of Mana.

This loop continues from Class Level 1 to 70 and from Tiers 1 to 7. Level 70 is the game's Level Cap and T7 is the highest Tier.

----

Hope you enjoy!

data.name: Project Wingman
data.detailed_description:
Project Wingman is a combat flight action game with an emphasis on polished and refined gameplay, true-to-its-roots inspirations, and an engaging single player experience. Perfect for those who aren't looking for a simulator experience, with the ease of pick up and play, all the way to those who want a fast-paced challenging flight action game.

Dogfight, strike, and fly through combat zones based off an alternate history of Earth. Either over the cold waters of the Bering Strait, attacking tanks in the brutal environments of Yellowstone magma fields, or diving through the Redwoods to strike targets of opportunity in the Pacific Northwest, across the oceans, above the scarred lands of the world, this war will take you from exotic battlefield to exotic battlefield, all while going up against odds way above your pay grade.

Pure Combat Flight Action
Exotic weaponries such as railguns and geothermal-powered armaments will be ready to pluck you out of the sky if you're careless. Whether you are an attack aircraft pilot, skimming the ground with a gatling gun and rocket launchers attached to your wing, or an interceptor with long range, almost sniper-like missiles at your disposal, it will be up to you to prove yourself as an Ace pilot.


Conquest Mode
In Conquest Mode, fight in an uphill battle against various bosses and ace squadrons in a territory capture game, drawing elements from roguelikes and RPGs. Players will have to earn enough money to not only purchase new aircraft, but build a mercenary army of their own in order to take on waves of increasingly difficult opposition as they struggle to take on a myriad of changing missions.

Virtual Reality
Virtual Reality headsets will work in-game to put the player in the cockpit of aerial warfare, immersing themselves in head-swiveling combat. Combine this with full compatibility with HOTAS peripherals and custom axis curves, and you will be able to experience the game however you want, using any DirectInput supported peripheral you like.

Key Features:

  • Fly in varied and exciting scenarios and locations unlike you've ever seen before
  • Engaging single player campaign
  • Over 20 different aircraft and over 40 unique weapons at your disposal
  • Fight different kinds of adversaries such as giant mechanized fortresses and railgun cannons
  • Test your skills in Conquest mode and fight against hordes of adversaries
  • Want a different Conquest experience? - Adjust it with modifiers to your liking
  • Beautiful 3D Volumetric clouds rendered with TrueSKY
  • Fully rebindable controls and HOTAS compatibility with DirectInput support
  • VR Support

data.name: Broken Wings: Hornet Down
data.detailed_description:
Broken Wings: Hornet Down is a first person horror-adventure game set in a desert environment in the war-torn Afghanistan.

Explore your surroundings, interact with objects, unlock every part of the abandoned military complex.

But most importantly, find a way to call for help or you might stay here forever.

The notes of the former inhabitants of the place will guide you through the unknown and will reveal the secrets of the previous war.

When the darkness falls, our hero is forced to seek shelter, however, his already desperate situation rapidly becomes much more sinister, as the history of the place comes alive.

During his struggle to explore the abandoned military complex, the story of another era unfolds. He quickly realizes he is not alone even though the outpost is empty for decades.

Who is this unknown creature?

data.name: Camping Simulator: The Squad
data.detailed_description:
Camp Simulator allows you to experience what camp means by making your preparation according to the variable and challenging conditions of natural environments. You can play all the experiences with up to 8 friends in multiplayer mode or single player mode. If you want to have a relaxing camping experience, you can go to the camp by carefully preparing with the maximum capacity of your bag when starting the game. Or if you want a camping that is difficult to survive, start the game with limited resources, find your way with your compass, and use the resources nature has to offer you to survive.

You can share tasks with your friends while trying to survive. While a friend takes care of finding food, others can light a campfire and set up tents for you to sleep or rest at night. Natural weather conditions affect the health values ​​of your character and you should even be careful about your body temperature.

- The multiplayer co-op mode allows you to play in a team of up to 8 people to survive and fight the natural conditions. There is no specific role requirement within the team, but you are completely free to choose task sharing.

-You can fully create your personal avatar with ultra detailed customization system, even male or female characters.

- You can craft many things with various inventory items that you can find in nature.

- In deep snow or in a jungle, You have to use your compass and map effectively to find your way through survive.

-Environmental conditions and movement activities affect all vital of the your character. That's why you should use your energy properly and rest when necessary.

-Sit by the fire and cook or just set up a camping chair and relax.

data.name: Tides of Caldmere
data.detailed_description:
The realm is breaking. Hold the line.

The oath-bound land of Caldmere is coming apart, and beneath its ley-waters the Sunken Court stirs to claim what the living let fall. Raise a war-band, take the field, and win the war one hard-fought battle at a time.

Tides of Caldmere is a dark-fantasy tactical RPG in the classic turn-based-tactics tradition — with one twist at its heart: there are no player and enemy phases. Every unit acts on a shared Charge-Time timeline set by its speed, so a swift skirmisher can strike twice before a heavy knight moves once. The turn order itself becomes a battlefield you can read — and bend.

Features

  • A living timeline, not phases — read the queue, then reshape it: knock a foe back down the order with Setback, surge an ally forward on a kill with Onset.
  • Five stats, one Resolve — a single shared resource clings to life through a killing blow, or powers a guaranteed Execute. One pool, two uses — spend it well.
  • Position is power — flanking pincers and high ground swing the odds, a light weapon triangle rewards the right blade, and arcane pierces plate.
  • Build your war-band — classes and promotions, reclassing, point-buy growth, and weapon forging up to +5.
  • Two generations — bonds deepen into marriages, marriages into heirs, and a time-skip carries your line into a second act.
  • Play it your way — three permadeath rules from forgiving to ironvow, an Hourglass turnwheel to undo a misstep, and difficulty from Wayfarer to Reckoning.
  • A realm with a history — a 26-chapter campaign, optional side-battles, an arena, and a lore-rich world of ley-veins, sigils, and sunken courts.



One realm, one war-band, and a timeline that rewards the tactician who learns to read it.

data.name: Fancy Rinshi Sensetion
data.detailed_description:
Be the heroine's imaginary friend and guide her through the game.


[Overview]

Fancy Rinshi (It's mean a near-death by Japanese language) Sensation is a cute and slightly horrifying multi-ended adventure game.
You are the imaginary friend of the main character girl, Kusuha, and lead her through a fancy and cute world.

Kusuha is in a near-death state due to a car accident and is about to step into the afterlife.
How you lead her is up to you.
You can encourage her or lie to her.
Depending on you, she will certainly be saved or she will certainly die.

Please enjoy the "Sensation" of her "Rinshi (Near Death)" in the "Fancy" world.

[Game Points]
About 30 minutes for the first play.
Number of endings: 7 (plus one hidden end).

data.name: Toroa: Skycall
data.detailed_description:
Unravel the fate of the ocean as you glide across an ever changing seascape in the hopes of reuniting Toroa with their family on land.

Following the winds of the Atua (Māori God) of the weather, Tāwhirimātea, Toroa will befriend creatures of the sea, meet distant relatives while flying through dream-like clouds and lush oceanic environments grounded in the Māori world.

  • Toroa have the largest wingspan in the world! Glide on wind currents and explore stylised landscapes, from calm seas to verdant islands and into dream-like cloudscapes.

  • Creatures of the sea need your help. Chat with and befriend a colourful cast from the South Pacific including dolphins, whales, penguins and more!

  • Trade kelp with creatures and gather birds into a flock who will follow you all the way to the end of your journey.

  • With the help of a knowledgeable seagull, identify a smorgasbord of tasty looking trash strewn about the ocean (NOT FOR CONSUMPTION)

  • Experience a heartfelt story grounded in te ao Māori (the Māori world) centered on our precious ocean, family, past, present and future.

  • Listen to a lush soundtrack showcasing the beauty of taonga pūoro (Māori musical instruments) and experience the beauty of the Māori language in character dialogue and story.

data.name: Putt Down
data.detailed_description:
Putt Down is a first person mini-golf horror. The game takes place in the same universe as Gone Golfing, but instead of a putter you have a shotgun and it will be your go to problem solver. It can be used as putter or as a regular firearm. You will need to score points and collect coins to be able buy ammo and supplies to keep you safe.

Who's Mr. Walker?

You play as John Walker, a highly neurotic man with a nicotine addiction and a history of terrible life choices. After racking up a massive amount of gambling debt, the people you owe are finally coming to collect. Just as you're about to skip town, you're kidnapped by a mysterious stranger who makes you a bizarre offer, one you simply can't refuse. Now you are stuck in a mini-golf nightmare and the only way to clear your debt is to finish the game.

So what is shotgun golfing?

Gameplay consist of trying to survive while playing mini-golf with a shotgun. You will have to manage limited ammo and supplies. Stress is a big part of the game and if your stress level is to high bad things will start to happen. All golf courses are randomized and with over 50 different courses you will have to learn to become a master shotgun golfer.

Who's the best shotgun golfer?

When you are finished with the main game try your luck against 5 other players. In multiplayer you will be pitted against other players and the player who finishes first with the least amount of golf strokes wins. But be careful because there are dangers lurking everywhere in this PvP mode, some of them are not even human.

Features

  • Physics Based Golfing

  • Golfing with a shotgun

  • Randomized golf courses

  • Over 50 different courses

  • Survival Horror with stress system

  • Managing equipment status and weapon degradation.

  • 6 player PvP shotgun golfing

  • Based on gone golfing

data.name: 掼蛋纯净版
data.detailed_description:
【化繁为简，只为打牌】

在数字娱乐日益臃肿的今天，我们选择做减法。这款掼蛋游戏专为追求极致清爽体验的玩家设计：

  • 买断式体验：一次购买，永久拥有。无任何形式的弹窗广告、无金币充值、无内购陷阱。

  • 纯单机运行：无需网络连接，不占用社交资源。没有繁琐的日常任务，没有冗长的剧情对话，开机即玩。

【舒适视觉，清爽交互】

我们重新打磨了棋牌游戏的视觉标准，让每一次出牌都成为享受：

  • 清晰视界：牌面数字与花色经过重绘加粗，配合高对比度设计，确保在各种显示环境下均能轻松识别。

  • 深色护眼背景：采用经典深绿桌面配色，有效降低长时间沉浸博弈时的视觉疲劳。

  • 零学习成本：极简的 UI 布局，操作逻辑直观明确，无需在复杂的菜单中迷失方向。

【轻松对弈，随心掌控】

生活需要博弈，但不需要压力。

  • 友好型 AI：内置多级难度 AI。即使在最高等级下，算法也倾向于提供具有互动感、合理且温和的对抗体验，告别“作弊感”较强的硬核逻辑，主打放松与消遣。

  • 本地数据统计：简单的胜负记录，让您的每一场对局收获清晰可感。

【极低负载，流畅如初】

底层代码高度优化，这可能是您电脑上运行最轻松的程序之一：

  • 全机型适配：几乎不占用系统资源，无论是多年前的陈旧机型还是性能强劲的专业办公设备，均可实现秒速启动与丝滑运行。

  • 小巧精悍：占用极少的磁盘空间，安装卸载均无残留。

data.name: Ocean Journey
data.detailed_description:
This is a relaxing and therapeutic game where players, guided by a little sprite, explore an endless sea, encountering numerous dangers and unexpected adventures. Choose the best strategy to reach even greater destinations while avoiding peril!

Game Background and Objectives

On a vast ocean, players take on the role of a small boat, constantly chasing the rising sun. The farther you sail, the higher your score. Surpass your limits with each challenge and reach even more distant waters!

Gameplay Introduction

Players maneuver their boat, avoiding islands and dangers, challenging bosses, encountering adventures, and earning rewards. The rising sun marks the direction of your journey; head towards the unknown, constantly breaking records and challenging yourself!

Use the mouse to control the boat's view, gaining a wider field of vision to observe the world.

Use the keyboard to control the boat's speed and course, or press skills to gain additional benefits.

Game Mechanics

This game uses randomly generated maps to ensure enjoyment; dangers and unexpected events occur based on probability. Players need to make strategic decisions at the right time to reach the distant destination.

data.name: Super Emoji Murder Death God Labyrinth
data.detailed_description:
Something dark and mysterious has awakened underneath the land of Emoji. The Murder Death God has returned. You must solve its labyrinth to keep the world safe.

That’s the plot. I’m pretty proud of it.

I made a little puzzle game as if it were living in a slide deck (sorry, corporate day job). Everyone in it is an emoji anyone can use for free (the Noto set): you, the guards, the bats, the eyes, one very large stone head. The rest is mostly boxes, arrows and my red pen. It was going great. Then something from outside got into it and started making changes. In other words, it’s basically Expedition 33 but PowerPoint.

It started as a simple turn based puzzle game

I kept the rules simple. You move, and everything else moves with you. Guards walk their routes, bats come after you, and if an eye sees you, that’s it. Grab every gem and get to the exit. That’s the whole game. (it was supposed to be the whole game.)

Someone is editing my levels


I put that boulder in the middle. I know I did. Now it’s in the corner, with a dashed box around it that I didn’t draw. I don’t know who’s doing this yet.

I drew you some tools

If it can edit my levels, so can you. Cut a wall out of your way. Paste it back in front of an eye. Change a guard’s route so he’s anywhere but where you need to go. You only get so many, so don’t spend them on walls you could walk around.

Hold Tab

And I’ll show you where everyone’s walking and what every eye can see. It’s not cheating, I drew them for you. I want you to win. Mostly.

what’s in it

  • >50 levels (just you wait until New Game+). The first few go quick. I’m sorry about the rest.

  • A couple of bosses

  • 7 edit tools: Cut, Copy, Paste, Nudge, Change Route, Rotate and Format Painter

  • 3 stars if you solve a level in par, and Steam leaderboards for fewest moves and fastest time

  • My Slides: make your own levels and send the deck to a friend (or an enemy)

  • Save & Quit whenever, and it picks up right where you left off

  • keyboard or controller

Yes, the whole name is Super Emoji Murder Death God Labyrinth. it’s a lot. I know.

Thanks for reading this far!! :)

data.name: Big Boss: A Villain Simulator
data.detailed_description:
YOUR DUNGEON. YOUR BUSINESS.

Step into the shoes of a franchisee owner of an Exemplary Villain Industries L.L.C. Lair, and be a part of a leading enterprise in the hero killing business. Your mission? Build your malevolent empire, defeat pesky heroes, and maximize profits through cunning schemes and shrewd negotiations.


Manage your lair, hire minions, and kidnap members of royalty for lucrative ransoms. Tax evasion? Negotiating with hero-slaying unions? It's all in a day's work for a true villainous entrepreneur.

With consistent progression, your lair becomes a formidable force, and it's your business acumen that will lead you to the top. Big Boss is not just about being a villain; it's about being a savvy CEO of your own villainous enterprise. Embrace your inner tycoon and conquer the world, one hero at a time!

Becoming a Boss

Being a boss is more than just defeating heroes. It's about the kind of heroes that are defeated, and how much cash you can get after defeating them. To defeat heroes, though, you need a dungeon. You decide to form your own Hero Defeating company and franchise a location from Exemplary Villain Industries LLC. They help you lure heroes and assist with payroll and you have a place to defeat heroes.

Managerial Duties

As a boss, having minions under your command is a perk, and keeping them on payroll is in your best interest. Minions risk their lives with Royalty Acquisitions, as any good evil doer needs to have a couple lures for heroes. Depending on the Royal acquired, new, stronger heroes will attempt to challenge you, leaving you more money as they're defeated. Minions also construct traps, and if you give them some armor and a sword, they'll stand guard at checkpoints, too. Minions are not little playthings, however. They have feelings and mouths to feed as well. Pay them well and they will treat you well, else you might have to negotiate with union leaders.

Managerial duties goes beyond just the first lair your company owns. As you grow, your company grows as well. Becoming the final boss is a matter of rising through the ranks of EVILLC through the purchasing and managing of new boss lairs, eventually creating a network for heroes to challenge in order to save their royal. Interview and assign mini-bosses to take control of other lairs and pose as mid-dungeon threats, and establish corporate connections in the underworld to increase profits and influence corporate decisions.

Post-Partum Estate

Not everything lasts forever, and that includes your duties as a boss. In the event that a hero defeats you, your company must find another boss to take the reigns as Chief Executive Overlord. Defeat means your company has no head, and heroes will take anything they can get their hands on that their inventory slots will hold. Everything in the dungeon is gone. Everything out of the dungeon will be liquidated in order to keep the company afloat. People still have mouths to feed, after all. If the company goes under, then it's game over.

data.name: Just 9 Lives
data.detailed_description:
You are a cat exploring your home. Everything seems quiet on the surface. But beware... appearances can be deceiving. Check for anomalies at each iteration, and remember: you have 9 lives...

A game of discovery and exploration

I programmed this game to be calm and relaxed. You cannot die, but you must explore and discover your environment. Several colorful rooms, a few other cats, but no enemies—just the objects in the house.

Anomalies?

Yes, with each new iteration of the game, an anomaly might trigger. If so, get scared and reset the loop and the tour. What if everything is fine? Stretch!

How to win?

After nine iterations where you correctly identify the anomalies present, the game ends. But watch out: a single careless mistake, and everything starts over from the beginning.

Be kind!

This is my very first game, so... there might still be bugs, errors, or issues. Please report any you find, and it will help improve the game.

data.name: Averlyn
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Averlyn.

Averlyn is a cozy third-person adventure and life-sim where you can build a home, grow a community, explore the world, and decide how you want to spend your time.

You start with an empty town and turn it into a thriving community. Grow crops, meet new residents, customize your character, explore the surrounding world, and uncover dangerous places filled with enemies, treasures, and powerful guardians.

Whether you want to spend the day farming and relaxing in town or grab your sword and head into the wilderness, you can play how you want to

🌱 Build Your Community

Turn an empty settlement into a place worth calling home.

  • Grow and develop your town

  • Welcome new residents

  • Discover and interact with the people who call Averlyn home

  • Improve your surroundings and expand your community

  • Make Averlyn feel like your own

🌾 Farm & Gather

Get your hands dirty and make the most of the world around you.

Plant and harvest crops, gather resources, explore the wilderness, and build up the supplies you need to grow your town.

Take things slow, enjoy the scenery, or spend your days seeing just how much you can accomplish.

⚔️ Explore & Fight

Beyond the safety of town lies a world waiting to be explored.

Travel through distinct environments, discover hidden areas, search for treasure, gather valuable resources, and face enemies along the way.

When things get dangerous, you'll need to fight your way through using a variety of weapons and abilities.

But every adventure comes with a reward.

🗺️ Discover New Places

Explore a world filled with different environments, settlements, ruins, secrets, and challenges.

From peaceful forests to dangerous deserts, every area has its own atmosphere, enemies, resources, and discoveries waiting to be found.

🐾 Live Alongside Nature

The world of Averlyn isn't just about the people.

Wildlife inhabits the world around you, from birds and butterflies to deer, foxes, and more to come.

Explore, observe, and enjoy a world that feels alive around you.

☕ Make Time for the Little Things

Not every adventure needs to end with a boss fight.

Go fishing.
Take a swim.
Have a coffee.
Sit down and enjoy the view.
Change your outfit.
Spend time with the people around town.

Averlyn is a world where the little things matter too.

🎨 Make It Yours

Create a character that feels like you.

Customize your appearance, change your clothes, and shape your own experience as you build a life in Averlyn.

👥 Play Together

Invite your friends into your world and experience Averlyn together.

Explore, fight enemies, gather resources, farm, swim, discover new areas, and take on dangerous adventures as a group.

Your town remains yours, while your friends can join you and experience the world alongside you.

data.name: Outside the Lines
data.detailed_description:
Outside the Lines is a free top-down shooter where drawing utensils compete to cover a coloring book with their color.

Features:


  • A colorful cast of three characters with different abilities. Only one of them doesn't have alliteration in its name!
  • Fast-paced gameplay with short rounds. Watching paint dry has never been more exciting!
  • Eleven different weapons with randomized stats, such as a cotton swab, a dish sponge, and a paintball shotgun.
  • Local multiplayer for two players with a co-op and a competitive mode. Ruin friendships, and then build them back!
  • Sometimes an eraser dude shows up. He's scary.
  • This game was originally made in three days for a game jam. Obviously this version of the game took longer but I just wanted to share that.
  • It's free. Like, no microtransactions or anything. I'm literally not making any money from this.

data.name: Gun Up
data.detailed_description:
A zombie outbreak has overrun the city of New Horseon. With access to improvised and experimental weaponry, your only goal is simple: survive for as long as you can.

Core gameplay

  • Continuous enemy fight. Enemies spawn nonstop around you, with spawn speed increasing every wave. The old break-between-waves structure is gone.

  • XP and level-ups. Kills drop XP gems. When you level up the game pauses and you pick one of several upgrade cards: new weapons, perks, potions and more.

  • Card rerolls. You can reroll the offered cards (rerolls come from permanent upgrades).

  • Luck and Curse. Luck adds extra card choices and better drops. Curse makes enemies tougher but gives more XP, and it rises additionally on its own every 10 waves.

  • Two modes. Default (30 minutes) and Quick (10 minutes, same 30 waves).

  • Power-ups. Enemies can drop Max Ammo, Nuke, Magnet and Free XP pickups.

  • Regeneration. Health now regenerates after a few seconds without taking damage.

  • Player classes. SWAT, Thug, Worker and Teddy, each with its own health, energy and speed.

  • Sprint and energy. Running uses an energy bar.

Boss and escape

  • The Butcher. In the final minute everything else vanishes and the Butcher walks in. He has slams, leaps, bone volleys, ground-zone barrages and, later, a bullet ring. He gets faster and meaner in three phases.

  • Evacuation helicopter. If the timer runs out, a helicopter arrives and everyone has to get on it before the area is nuked. Killing the Butcher also wins the match.

  • Results screen. It shows time survived, wave reached, kills, damage, MVP and the coins you earned.

Weapons and arsenal

  • Many new guns. A large batch of weapons, melee weapons and utilities, all with new art.

  • Weapon fusion. Combine two weapons into one with a fusion screen that rolls the new stats. Certain pairs unlock special fusion weapons. Discovered recipes are tracked.

  • Auto-use systems. Pick passives that work on their own: automatic grenades, mines, shockwaves and a medic.

  • Utilities. Grenades, claymores, molotovs, monkey bomb, Infinibear, sentry turrets and stim shots.

Enemies

  • Bigger roster. Hasty, fat and tanky zombies, the Astro, Hound, Beastmaster, Shrouder, splitters, juggernauts, medics and more. Many have unique abilities.

  • Scaling. Enemy health and damage scale with Curse and with the number of players.

Meta Progression

  • Coins. You earn coins from damage dealt, with a bonus for killing the Butcher.

  • Permanent upgrades. Spend coins on base health, base energy, base speed, card rerolls, Luck and Curse.

  • Armory. Unlock additional weapons and utilities.

  • Achievements. Around 30 new achievements. Some unlock armory items.

Co-op and online

  • Co-op for up to 4. Downed players come back as ghosts and respawn next to a teammate after 60 seconds.

  • Smoother online play. Remote players and enemies now move smoothly even at low update rates.

  • Slow-connection friendly. The host sends each player only the enemies near them and lowers the update rate when there are too many.

data.name: Train Station Project
data.detailed_description:
Train Station Project is a game that lets you step into the role of a train station manager. Start with simple tasks like renovation and ticket sales. Over time, you'll offer a variety of services and manage your own staff.

Renovation - Clean up a run-down station building, get rid of accumulated junk, replace floors, paint walls and repair damaged equipment. A well-maintained building will attract more customers and generate more profit from the services you offer.

Serve customers - Start by selling tickets to increase the range of services offered over time. Open a point for sending and receiving mail packages and a lost and found office.

Create Additional Businesses - Your station is not just about ticket sales! The usable area of the building increases with each upgrade. Open your own shop, set up vending machines, and even create an arcade room.

Employees - Over time, the number of activities will grow, and you'll need to consider hiring staff. Invest in employee housing to expand your team.

Manage - Remember that your resources are not infinite. You need to take care of your warehouse and regularly plan to order products for the store, vending machines and even things for your office.

Trains! - In addition to observing passing passenger trains, you can earn extra cash by performing cleaning service tasks on train cars. You can skip these assignments, but over time, your permissions will increase to more responsible roles.

Create Additional Businesses - Your station is not just about ticket sales! The usable area of the building increases with each upgrade. Open your own shop, set up vending machines, and even create an arcade room.

Employees - Over time, the number of activities will grow, and you'll need to consider hiring staff. Invest in employee housing to expand your team.

Manage - Remember that your resources are not infinite. You need to take care of your warehouse and regularly plan to order products for the store, vending machines and even things for your office.

Trains! - In addition to observing passing passenger trains, you can earn extra cash by performing cleaning service tasks on train cars. You can skip these assignments, but over time, your permissions will increase to more responsible roles.

data.name: The Bustling World
data.detailed_description:
About the game

In this ancient world, limitless possibilities await. You can choose to lead a tranquil life—work, engage in trade, and build a family. Alternatively, satisfy your insatiable desires for wealth, status, and military might. Embark on daring journeys, exploring, adventuring, solving mysteries, combating bandits, and recruiting heroes. Or, aim for the peak of power through establishing influence, city planning, policy formulation, diplomatic endeavors, and Retake the territory.

Game Features

  • Dynamic World and Characters

Immerse yourself in a world where every choice ripples through the tapestry of the game. Inhabitants, driven by their unique character traits and familial ties, dynamically shape the cityscape based on players' interactions. They'll make their own decisions such as to stay at home, go to work, go out for fun, move to another city, build houses, run stores, avenge their family, run away from war etc.

  • Agricultural and Livestock Farming

Cultivate a farm adorned with over 60 varieties of typical plants from ancient times. Tend to these plants' different needs for soil type, water and temperature to make sure their healthy growth. Form bonds with more than 30 creatures, transforming them into more powerful allies for riding or combat. Breed and train animals, with chances for mutations and discovering high-level species in the wild. 

  • Enterprising Pursuits

Navigate a bustling cityscape, discovering a variety of vocations to amass wealth. Ascend the entrepreneurial ladder by establishing and managing vibrant businesses, outmaneuvering rivals through strategic thinking. Hire employees and manage various shops related to people's daily lives. Engage in promotional activities, open branches, or even employ some cunning methods to compete with opponents, expanding your business and achieving prosperity.

  • Navigate among Jianghu Factions

Embark on a quest through untamed wilderness, battle ferocious creatures and uncover martial treasures. Become a bounty hunter, tracking fugitives, and unearthing forgotten ruins rich with hidden valuables.

Delve into Jianghu factions, underground gambling dens, secret banks, outlaw strongholds, secluded martial arts schools. Trade with them, obtain unique martial arts techniques, uncover hidden secrets, manipulate, join, eliminate, or even rebuild various factions. As a leader, recruit heroes, establish mercenary legions, cooperate with these factions, and enhance your power.

  • Build a Homestead

Craft unique cityscapes with a sophisticated construction system boasting nearly 2000 of components. Besides, the game also features almost 1000 well-designed items and artifacts, including all kinds of furniture, fine china, renowned paintings etc. Trade these on the market freely and gain revenue from the price fluctuation. After becoming the steward of a faction, players could also conduct city planning and oversee the architectural endeavors of individual NPC.

  • Strategy and Simulation

Carve out a domain in unclaimed territories or engage in calculated assaults on cities for expansion. Artfully manage a spectrum of factional policies in military, culture, economy, and research, unlocking strategic cards to enhance city development. If there are different cities to manage, you could also adjust those policies to achieve a nuanced balance.

  • Diplomacy as a Fine Art

Navigate the intricate dance of diplomacy, where geography, military might, and population dynamics dictate the ebb and flow of relations with NPC factions. Employ negotiation finesse, engage in trade, and wield the subtle arts of threats, warfare, alliances, and espionage to secure interests. The factions of the NPCs will make decisions based on the complicated relations of different cities as well, making every playthrough a brand-new experience.

  • Entertainment and Social Connections

Indulge in an array of leisure activities, from engaging in various mini games to culinary showdowns and martial arts extravaganzas. Build up connections with NPCs, forge alliances, or even stir up delightful chaos in the lives of others.

  • Craftsmanship from Antiquity

Immerse yourself in the revival of ancient crafting techniques, from culinary arts to textile mastery and metallurgy. Progress from hands-on craftsmanship to establishing mass production, seamlessly integrating skilled workers and effective production lines.

  • An Immersive World of Art

The game is fully built in 3D. To achieve a more refined stylized artistic effect, the team reviewed over ten thousand ancient paintings and texts. So far, over five thousand assets have been completed. Adorn characters in exquisitely recreated traditional Chinese attire, where garments sway elegantly with the grace of authentic physics simulations.

data.name: Hold The Fort
data.detailed_description:
Dive into intense, fantasy, tower defense action! Using turrets, spells, and your cunning, you must defend your kingdom against an onslaught of enemies launching a surprise attack while the king is away!



Features

  • Tower Defense Action Defend your kingdom using eight different tower types ranging from the trust worthy Ballista to a magical Ice throwing turret to slow your enemies!
  • Heroic Spells Using ten unique spells, inflict great pain upon your foes or support your towers in their defense!



  • Progressive Talent System With each enemy killed you will gain experience towards leveling up and unlocking towers, upgrades, and spells with an in depth talent tree.
  • Immersive Controls and Camera View the action from every angle with full camera rotation and zoom in to see the battle in detail!
  • Unlimited Survival Test your skills and hold out as long as you can against never ending waves of enemies!



Gameplay

Hold the Fort features a full campaign mode with every map available to test your skills in the unlimited mode against three distinct factions consisting of over twenty five enemies to keep your on your toes no matter what your play style is!

data.name: Kubo
data.detailed_description:
Kubo is a three-dimensional puzzle game about rebuilding fractured paths through space. Place route cards onto the faces of a cube, rotate each piece into position, connect the stars, and fill every required Kube to restore the network.

Each level presents a different arrangement of stars and a randomized set of route cards. Straight paths, corners, crossings, tunnels, and edge-wrapping routes must be placed in the correct locations and orientations to create one complete connection.

The rules are simple, but the puzzles steadily expand across multiple layers and all six sides of the cube. Later levels require you to think around corners, through the interior, and across several faces at once.

Key Features

  • Solve 50+ handcrafted spatial puzzles.

  • Place and rotate route cards on a fully three-dimensional cube to connect stars and fill every required Kube.

  • Master straight routes, corners, crosses, tunnels, and angled edge pieces.

  • Replay completed levels to improve your times.

  • Enjoy a PSX style pixel-art presentation set against a drifting cosmic backdrop.

The fractured cosmos is waiting. Every route must connect, and the stars will not find each other without you.

data.name: The Wendigo Lives
data.detailed_description:
SOMETHING IS WATCHING FROM THE WOODS

Stranded in Hollow Nature Reserve, you must search cabins, campsites, and abandoned buildings for the supplies you need to escape.

But one of you is the Wendigo.

Beyond your flashlight beam, it can hide among the wildlife, disappear into the trees, or approach wearing a familiar face. Every encounter leaves you with a decision: trust them, run, or risk finding out.

SURVIVE THE RESERVE

The Wendigo Lives is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game for 2–5 players, built around proximity voice chat, exploration, and deception.

Players begin at different landmarks across the reserve. Each stranded survivor has a personal list of supplies to find. Search backpacks, coolers, cabinets, and shelves—but searching takes time and leaves you vulnerable.

Find your friends and watch each other’s backs. Just remember that the person offering to help may be waiting for you to look away.

HUNT YOUR FRIENDS

One player becomes the Wendigo, with four forms to exploit:

  • Wendigo — Hunt, attack, follow scent trails, and feed on fallen survivors.

  • Survivor — Blend into the group, pretend to search, and turn trust against them.

  • Deer — Move among the wildlife without immediately revealing yourself.

  • Tree — Become part of the landscape and wait for someone to come too close.

Use taunts, transformations, and carefully timed attacks to divide the group. Track where survivors have been through fading scent trails, cut power to their shelter, and break through doors and hiding places.

LIGHT IS A CHOICE

Your flashlight helps you navigate, but its beam can draw attention. Save enough battery for an intense flash that can repel the Wendigo and buy you time to escape.

Restore power to illuminate buildings and nearby paths—or move through the darkness with more limited light. The Wendigo can shut those lights off again.

Search for equipment that changes your options:

  • Batteries to keep your flashlight running.

  • First-aid kits to recover health.

  • Scent-removal bottles to temporarily conceal your trail.

  • Paired walkie-talkies to communicate beyond proximity range.

  • Flare guns to illuminate an area and expose Wendigo disguises.

  • Glow sticks to carry or throw as an alternative light source.

You can carry only one utility type at a time. Choose what matters most, or leave something behind for another survivor.

HIDE. LISTEN. STAY CALM.

When escape is out of reach, hide beneath a bed, inside a tent, behind a bathroom door, or within dense brush.

Hiding gives you a chance to recover your composure, but it is no guarantee of safety. The Wendigo can destroy hiding places—and sometimes listening is the only way to know whether it has gone.

Fear slows searching and affects stamina and aim. Panic also makes you noisier. Staying calm can matter as much as staying out of sight.

FEATURES

  • Asymmetrical online multiplayer for 2–5 players.

  • A player-controlled Wendigo with four forms.

  • Proximity voice chat, microphone selection, and paired walkie-talkies.

  • Steam lobbies, friend invitations, private codes, and a public lobby browser.

  • Randomized starting landmarks and personal scavenger objectives.

  • Searchable furniture, bags, and containers with varied loot.

  • Battery-powered flashlights, defensive flash bursts, and useful survival equipment.

  • Hiding places, destructible doors, and breakable scenery.

  • Area power controls, trail lighting, and ranger-station CCTV.

  • Rain, fog, and snow that change the atmosphere of the reserve.

  • A scarce shotgun with limited ammunition and lethal friendly fire.

  • Spectating, corpse feeding, and end-of-match performance ratings.

  • A forest filled with cabins, campsites, a ranger station, storage buildings, and environmental clues.

The woods are dark. Your friends are somewhere out there. Something else may answer when you call.
