data.name: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion
data.detailed_description:
PETAFAB: Bot Invasion is a fast-paced single-player first-person shooter with fully destructible SDF environments and large-scale crowd simulation. Blast through massive swarms of AI-controlled bots and take down huge bosses.

Story

PETAFAB is the world’s largest robot-building facility. Builder bots have been expanding it for decades, and it now covers an area the size of a major city. Recently, we lost contact with the AI running the facility. Our worst fears have come true.

Special forces have recruited three heroes to infiltrate the facility and blow it to pieces. You are authorized to destroy as many bots as possible along the way. Collateral damage is just a bonus.

Team

Sebastian Aaltonen has 30 years of professional game development experience. During his career at Frozenbyte, RedLynx, Ubisoft, and Unity, he has developed multiple award-winning games for PC, Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo consoles. He has spoken at major industry conferences, including GDC, SIGGRAPH, and Digital Dragons.

The game’s audio is produced by AriTunes, led by audio director and award-winning composer Ari Pulkkinen (Resogun, Nex Machina, Super Stardust HD). Ari also composes the original soundtrack.

Tech

PETAFAB uses a new custom engine built on NoGraphicsAPI, our low-level GPU interface. The engine replaces traditional graphics shaders with distance-field ray tracing and mesh shaders. It uses an improved version of the Clayfield fluid and matter simulation technology from Claybook (2018), making the entire level 100% destructible.

Designed for ultra-smooth visuals, PETAFAB delivers native 4K @ 240 FPS (and 1440p @ 540Hz) on an RTX 4080, 90 FPS on Steam Deck OLED, 4K @ 60 FPS on Steam Machine and 60 FPS on MacBook Neo. Supports 8000Hz input polling for eSports mice (late latch directly to GPU). 

GPU compatibility

IMPORTANT: Minimum GPU requirement is a hard limit. Game will not start with older GPUs.

If you have stability issues, please update your drivers. There's a known bug in Nvidia's last summer driver that causes random driver crashes (nullptr) in the game.

Intel is investigating their Windows GPU driver shader compiler bug. Game works fine on Linux (Proton) on recent Intel GPUs and iGPUs. AMD RDNA2 driver bug has been investigated by AMD. ETA for new driver containing a fix is not yet known. I will update information once new drivers arrive.

Game has been tested on various Linux configurations with Proton. Works well on Nvidia, AMD and Intel GPU Linux systems. You need recent GPU drivers.

Special forces have recruited three heroes to infiltrate the facility and blow it to pieces. You are authorized to destroy as many bots as possible along the way. Collateral damage is just a bonus.

data.name: Nancy Drew®: Mystery of the Seven Keys™
data.detailed_description:
Strategy guides and other resources available at

 


About the Game

Get ready for a thrilling blend of adventure, mystery, and history in the latest installment of the award-winning Nancy Drew game series - Nancy Drew®: Mystery of the Seven Keys™!

The Mystery

This all-new 3D game experience transports players to the heart of the historic city of Prague as they assume the role of famous detective Nancy Drew. Tasked with uncovering the truth behind the theft of a client’s heirloom necklace, players will navigate and sleuth through the beautiful city's mysterious old-world environments. Encounter challenging puzzles, decode riddles, and discover clues entwined with medieval legends, alchemy, and lore. As the investigation deepens, Nancy uncovers a sinister web of cybercrime. Players must outwit devious suspects and use their detective skills to unravel a mystery threatening the city's Bohemian heritage. Danger and intrigue at every turn add to the suspense as the criminals stop at nothing to prevent you from bringing the truth to light. Your investigative and critical thinking skills are crucial to solving the case and discovering the real mystery behind the legend of the seven keys!

Key Game Features:

• Travel to Prague for a mystery with 20+ hours of gameplay
• Investigate a necklace theft that holds the key to unlocking the city's dark past
• Meet and interrogate 10+ unique characters and suspects
• New dual navigation: Choose between classic point-and-click or free-roam controls
• Challenging puzzles woven throughout the story including logic, slider, code, arcade, hidden object, and more
• Explore multiple environments through the ancient streets of Prague in day or night
• Find and inspect 3D inventory objects with all-new combinable clues
• Discover ancient artifacts that unravel secrets of Bohemian medieval legends and lore
• Become a barista and create coffee drinks to order at a historic café
• Immerse in Czech culture, language, and history analyzing exhibits and evidence
• Meet up at the marionette theater where players set the stage
• Old world meets new where plot twisting cybercrimes and technology are key
• Crack the case with detective gear including journal, camera, map, hints, task list, and suspect files
• Sleuth as detective Nancy Drew at Amateur or Master level and earn achievements

data.name: Echoes of the Cove
data.detailed_description:
Follow your missing father’s diary into a coastal town full of buried secrets.

Explore eerie crypts, battle strange creatures and uncover the truth between quieter days spent fishing, farming, and getting to know the people of the Cove.

Echoes of the Cove is an atmospheric pixel-art action RPG where a personal search draws you into a much deeper mystery.

 
 

🔑 Key Features

📖 Follow Your Father's Trail
Each diary page reveals new locations, memories, and clues. Your father's words guide you through The Cove's mysteries, but can you trust everything he wrote?

⚔️ Real-Time Combat with Depth
Fight corrupted creatures using weapons, tools, and environmental tactics. Every encounter rewards observation and strategy.

🏘️ A Town Worth Saving
Meet the last residents of The Cove, each haunted by their own past. Help them solve personal quests, and forge bonds that can change how your story unfolds.

🗺️ Exploration That Rewards Curiosity
Discover hidden dungeons, solve environmental puzzles and unlock shortcuts. The world is handcrafted with secrets in every corner, from the abandoned lighthouse to the sewers beneath the town.

🎨 A Coastal Fantasy Brought to Life
Explore stormy shores, sun-drenched ruins and eerie depths in a pixel art world inspired by classic adventure games but with a modern and atmospheric twist.

Journey through storms, ruins and fading echoes of the past in a fantasy adventure inspired by classic Zelda exploration and Stardew Valley style town life.

Will you find your father… or become another echo lost to The Cove?

data.name: Circuit Overload
data.detailed_description:
Break into the Circuit

The Circuit is an ancient energy grid the size of a star system. It overloaded long ago, and its automated defenses jammed in lockdown: every gate is sealed and anything that moves is attacked. The fleets sent before you were torn apart, and the grid now builds its Scrap Drones from their wreckage.

You fly an interceptor powered by the Core, an energy cell stolen from the grid itself. Ride its current, turn it into weapons, and push deeper with every run. When your hull is destroyed, an Emergency Transmission carries your Nanomatter home. The breach remains, and the next hull flies back in stronger.

Two ways to play

  • Operations: a six-stage campaign from the floating gates of Threshold to the heart of the grid at Rift Nexus. Every stage has its own layout, rewards and guardians, and clears unlock new weapons and Fusion recipes. Play solo or bring your squad.

  • Endless: survive as long as you can while the waves keep escalating, and chase the top of the Steam leaderboards.

Fly with your squad

Team up with up to four pilots in online co-op. Invite friends through Steam, share the fight, and pull downed teammates back into it with Energy Transfer revives.

Build a ship that breaks the grid

  • Fusions: unlock Fusion recipes in Operations, then max out two weapons and fuse them into one of 36 Fusion weapons, from orbiting Ion Satellites to the Quasar Rupture.

  • Core Modules and Core Overrides: pick reactor systems mid-run and spin the Core Override machine for rare rewards.

  • Upgrades: spend Nanomatter and Meta Shards on a permanent upgrade tree between runs.

Guardians

Vast defense constructs guard the way in: The Gatekeeper, The Eraser, The Wreck and The Lock. Learn their patterns, break their defenses and take what they protect.

Features

  • Fast top-down bullet-heaven action with escalating waves

  • Six-stage Operations campaign and an Endless score mode

  • Online co-op for up to four pilots

  • 36 unlockable Fusion weapons and a permanent upgrade tree

  • Full controller support with native Steam Input for Xbox and PlayStation controllers

  • 66 Steam achievements, Steam leaderboards and Steam Cloud saves

data.name: Kill The Shadow
data.detailed_description:
A puppy named Teddy, found dead under mysterious circumstances. Master Reed, vanished in a bustling temple fair crowd. Years of grudges festering at the Shipwreck Wharf. Scattered newspapers and handwritten notes in an unknown prison... Traverse the eclectic districts of Dark Tide City and investigate a string of bizarre cases.

Recover the city's lost memories. Piece together the truth behind the city's fracture ten years ago. Kill. Judge. Or perhaps… kiss(?) the mastermind.

It pairs 3D HD environments with 2D pixel characters, creating a striking modern-vs-retro visual style, and offers a wide range of freely explorable locations across distinct districts, including the rusting steel jungle of a long-shuttered factory, the muddy Shipwreck Wharf built on stilts, the floating slum of the Pig Cage Walled City where Chinese tradition and neon lights bleed into one another, and the bustling, crowded streets of the Old Town District.

Freely choose how to improve your abilities: Strength, Spirit, Charm. Pick your own approach to each case: Play mind games? Grease some palms? Or just beat a confession out of the suspect?

Deduction System: Gather, analyze, and connect the clues. Craft your own unique investigation trail!

data.name: Rocky Park
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Rocky Park.

A quiet natural park where time slows down, trails wind gently through the trees, and the horizon always feels just a little inviting.

Wander freely through forests, along lakeshores, and up to scenic viewpoints. Collect rocks scattered across the park, glide peacefully over valleys with your hang glider, or watch the world through your binoculars. You can skip stones across the water. You can sit and listen.

There’s no rush.
No combat.
No right way to explore.

The park’s visitors and locals live their own quiet routines — fishing, resting, strolling, thinking. Stop and talk to them if you’d like. Or just keep walking.

Rocky Park is a short first-person exploration game (around 2 hours) about collection rocks, wandering, and taking the time to notice what’s around you.

Sometimes, that’s enough.

Features

🌲 A small handcrafted park to explore at your own pace
🪨 Simple, satisfying rock collecting
🪂 Gentle hang gliding between scenic viewpoints
🪨 Stone skipping with playful interactions
🧍 Cozy NPC encounters
🎵 A calm, contemplative atmosphere

data.name: Lightfield HYPER Edition
data.detailed_description:
OUT NOW!

Lightfield HYPER Edition is finally out! Make sure to not mis the Launch Discount and join us on our discord!


About the Game


Lightfield HYPER Edition is a hyper-futuristic precision racing game with a one-of-a-kind parkour-inspired gameplay mechanic. Utilize every aspect of your surroundings as you master your anti-gravity spaceship to scale walls, ceilings and more in an attempt to find the perfect racing line.

Explore beyond the boundaries of a traditional racing experience and lose yourself in the aesthetics of the striking environments, abstract architecture, and futuristic soundscapes of the hard-hitting electronic soundtrack from Zanshin.


The new HYPER Edition features solo play, online multiplayer and a couch split-screen mode. Moreover, it features a host of new content, from new a new campaign to an all-new trick system, a photo mode and stunning enhanced visuals.

Key Features
  • EXPLORE, SPIN, SOAR: Utilise your anti-gravity ship to traverse any surface you see as you seek the perfect racing line
  • A RACE LIKE NO OTHER: Combine thoughtful track exploration with skillful tricks and smooth cruising as you cruise through your hyper-futuristic surrounds
  • TAKE IT ALL IN: Let the stunning sci-fi aesthetics wash over you as you drift through abstract architecture in your race to the top
  • DIFFERENT GAME MODES: Choose from three hypnotic game modes: campaign, multiplayer and the photo mode
  • MULTIPLAYER: Compete in online 6 player races or play in local multiplayer splitscreen for up to 4 players
  • SINK INTO THE SOUNDS: Tune in to the dreamlike beats of the soundtrack carefully crafted by Viennese electronic musician Zanshin
  • NEW HYPER EDITION FEATURES: Packed full of new content, from new campaign and competitive local multiplayer modes to an all-new trick system and stunning visuals.

data.name: Stray Children
data.detailed_description:
From the creators of beloved cult-classic videogames including Moon: Remix RPG Adventure, Chulip, and Rule of Rose, comes Stray Children: a bittersweet fairy tale adventure that will change the way you think about “children” and “adults”.

What would you do if all the adults you know suddenly started attacking you?

This is the story of children who try to survive and thrive in a world just like this, every day of their lives.

Somewhere, in our world, there’s a secret room, in a secret place, filled top to bottom with ancient technology. 

When one young boy flips the switch on a curious old console, they’re suddenly whisked away, through the screen, into a very strange somewhere else: a long-since forgotten role playing game.

Blinking awake in this peculiar new place, they find themselves in a land of children.

Outside this stronghold’s walls lurk The Olders: monstrous adults, carrying the heavy load of their own inadequacies, self-doubt, and all of the grievances that grown-ups gather. 

Rumor has it that these creatures are starving for something, and that — out there — no one and nowhere is safe.

Can you survive in this world where half-crazed adults lurk around every corner?

It’s here — in this funny, mysterious, and wildly dangerous domain — that your story begins.

As you explore the world of Stray Children, you’ll do turn-based battle with these oddball Olders, where you can choose to fearlessly fight or use your words as weapons, landing a crushing blow with just a well-worded whisper.

Deftly dodge the relentless barrage of their bottled-up emotions, and discover the source of their strange stories. By touching their heart with your words, you might just be able to save their souls.

What other mysteries await you in this weird new world? Find out in Stray Children — an unfamiliar place, with all-too-familiar troubles.

We hope you’ll have fun discovering all the secrets of Stray Children, but we have one final request for anyone and everyone who finishes the game: please keep the ending a secret!

data.name: Regotown
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever dreamed of visiting an actual hell?

Or, to be more precise… A cyber-hell?...

So, if your answer was «yes» (or even if it wasn`t), now you got a chance to take a dip into a breathtaking adventure filled with fights against some unfamiliar creatures and mysteries of cybernetic underworld. What`s more important, all of these goes with pleasant pixel-art graphics with a classical animation.

This character control, so handy and smooth, will allow you to quickly adjust to Regotown`s management. However, thanks to the unique fight system, it`ll be not so easy to master this game!

Don`t you worry, `cause that mad and gloomy atmosphere is gonna entice you for hours, urging you to bring all of those diverse techniques under, daring you to go through this cryptic story to it`s very end.

All the same, don`t forget to pause your gaming session for taking some meal or a good sleep. We warned you.

data.name: Rapplar
data.detailed_description:
Three ancient races share one fractured world, and none of them agree on who should rule it. HECTOR is an online fantasy RPG built around what made classic MMOs worth losing weekends to: a character you shape yourself, combat you learn to read, and a world that rewards wandering off the path.

CHOOSE YOUR BLOODLINE

Three races, each with its own heritage and feel, with male and female options for every one of them — and a full appearance editor for hair, face, eyes and skin.

  • Asura — Fierce warriors of ancient bloodlines. Raw physical power and relentless close-quarters pressure.

  • Deva — Celestial-blooded and disciplined, drawing on magic and the wisdom of the heavens.

  • Gaia — Children of nature, attuned to the earth's energies and the balance of all living things.

MASTER YOUR PATH

  • Warrior — Close the distance, chain heavy melee combos, and hold the line when a fight turns bad.

  • Mage — Control the field from range, bend the elements, and burn down what a blade cannot reach.

Each class grows along its own skill trees, so no two characters have to play the same way.

SET SAIL

Your story begins aboard a galleon crossing open water beneath a giant world in the sky — until something rises from the deep. Train on deck, survive the attack, and wash ashore in a land waiting to be explored. Swim the coastlines, cross the meadows and forests, and find what the islands are hiding.

A WORLD WITH OTHER PEOPLE IN IT

HECTOR is a persistent online world. Other players are out there levelling, exploring and fighting in the same regions you are.

  • Meet other adventurers in the field, size up their gear, and talk in local and world chat.

  • Take on the world together, or play at your own pace and solo your way through the story.

  • A shared day and night cycle, so the whole world moves through time together.

FIGHT, QUEST, EXPLORE

  • Real-time combat with ability combos, cooldown management, and a quickslot bar you build around your own rhythm.

  • Spectacular skills and creature powers — from spirit wolves to winged dragons.

  • A main storyline plus side quests that carry you from your first clumsy scrap to gear worth bragging about.

BUILD YOUR LEGEND

  • Crafting and enchanting that turn raw materials into equipment you actually want to keep.

  • Loot that runs from common scrap to legendary finds, and a full equipment and inventory system.

  • Companions that fight at your side.

PLAY IT IN YOUR LANGUAGE

HECTOR is fully playable in English and Arabic — proper right-to-left layout, interface and text throughout, built in from the start.

GROWING WITH ITS PLAYERS

HECTOR is in active development. New classes, regions, quests and systems are on the way, and player feedback decides what lands first. Join the community on Discord:

data.name: HITLESS
data.detailed_description:
There is no attack button

You cannot shoot. There are no shields, no power-ups. What you have is dodging, and bombs. A bomb wipes every bullet, laser and laser warning that is on screen at that moment, but charging enemies keep coming. You start with one and earn another for every 5 stages you clear in a run, with no cap. When to spend one, or whether to carry them all to the end, is up to you. Strip everything else away and what is left is the thing coming toward you, you slipping through it, and the bombs you have not used yet.

The rule is fifteen seconds

  • Every stage is cleared by surviving 15 seconds. That is the entire rule
  • Clear one and you go straight into the next. There is no final stage — bullets grow faster, denser and more intricate the further you go
  • Your hitbox is a small point at the center of your ship, far smaller than it looks. If the graphic overlaps but the core slips past, you are fine
  • Attacks are assembled from a seed based on the stage number, so a given stage always feels the same without ever being laid out identically
  • A hit costs one life, followed by 2 seconds of invulnerability. Take a hit at zero lives and the run is over

New Game — Stage 1, 3 lives, 1 bomb. Everyone starts from the same place.
Continue — your best stage, 1 life, 1 bomb. For when you only want what comes next.

The leaderboards are the game

Your score is the stage you reached. Ties are broken by how long you survived on that final stage. Nothing else adds points. While you play, your current score sits at the top of the screen: it ticks up every second, and when you clear a stage it climbs straight to the next stage's value.
  • Two score boards: Overall and the New Game Division, so runs built up from Stage 1 stand as their own competition
  • View World Top 100, Around You, or Friends. Your own row is always highlighted
  • Quarterly seasons — the score boards roll over into a new season in January, April, July and October. All-time boards stay up permanently, and every past season remains browsable. Records from before the bomb update are kept on the "Score (Ver.1)" board (view only)
  • Six stat leaderboards — login streak, total play time, total app time, total stages cleared, total graze, and total bullets cleared by bombs
  • Four bomb leaderboards — bombs held at game over, longest stretch survived without using a bomb, survival time of a run with zero bombs used (best single run), and most bullets cleared by one bomb
  • Share your rank to X with an automatically generated record card image

Graze — nothing happens where it is safe

When a bullet passes just beside your ship it counts as a graze, answered by a small burst of particles and a high, clean tone. Graze adds nothing to your score. What it feeds is your title conditions and a leaderboard of its own — total graze. Bullets you clear with a bomb work the same way: they add nothing to your score, and they have leaderboards of their own. And still you will hold Shift to slow down and lean toward the bullets, because as long as you keep your distance, nothing in this game happens at all.

42 titles

  • 42 titles covering stages reached, lifetime play, playstyle, and a set of hidden ones whose conditions are never shown
  • Equip one and it appears beside your name on the leaderboards and the results screen
  • Titles you have not earned show only a hint of their condition — the hidden ones do not even show that

20 gimmicks, and a gallery

  • 20 attack gimmicks: straight and aimed shots, full-circle rings, spirals, telegraphed lasers, sweeping and grid lasers, ricochets, converging volleys, charging formations and more
  • From Stage 15 onward they begin arriving two or three at a time
  • The Gallery lets you watch and practice any gimmick you have encountered at least once, for as long as you like, with no way to be hit. Anything you have not met yet stays "???"

Comfort and accessibility

  • Screen shake, surface flash, and slow motion / hitstop can each be turned off independently
  • Rebindable keys for movement, slow move, bomb, and pause
  • Separate BGM and SE volume; windowed or borderless fullscreen
  • English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Korean — follows your Steam language setting, switchable in-game
  • Gameplay (including the tutorial) and the pause menu work with an XInput gamepad (the title, settings and other menus use mouse and keyboard)

Also included

  • An optional Tutorial you can play from the title screen at any time. Six steps on the real playfield: Move, Slow Move and Hitbox, Dodge, Graze, Bomb, and Clear a Stage. Hits cost no lives, and nothing counts toward leaderboards, titles, achievements or your play records
  • 10 Steam Achievements, and Steam Cloud save sync
  • An entirely original soundtrack
  • A board of nothing but white and black, and a single blue triangle. Each stage flips the surface between light and dark — that flip is how you know you cleared it

data.name: Earthworm Jim
data.detailed_description:
Jim wasn't always a studly super-worm. He was once just a spineless, dirt-eater with no real mission in his life...

But then something unexpected happened. The evil Psy-Crow was transporting a super suit, built by the genius Professor Monkey-For-A-Head, to Queen Pulsating, Bloated, Festering, Sweaty, Pus-Filled, Malformed, Slug-For-A-Butt, but along the way it was stolen by a rebel. Although Psy-Crow killed the rebel, the suit fell down to Earth, landing on an Earth Worm. That cosmic twist of fate placed Jim in control of an ultra-high-tech-indestructible-super-space-cyber-suit.

Anyway, Earthworm Jim found out that Princess What's-Her-Name had been captured and set out to save her. Meanwhile, there's a bounty on Jimmy and plenty of people are in line to take Queen Slug-For-A-Butt up on her offer.

Now Jim must make it to the princess and stay clear of Psy-Crow, the intergalactic bounty hunter, until the final battle with Queen Slug-For-A-Butt. To accomplish this, you'll have to use every weapon and ability at your disposal to wriggle your way through dozens of original and just plain weird levels.

data.name: Wobble
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Wobble. No complicated combos to memorize, no bloated mechanics. Just pure, physics-based chaos.

There's no health bar. Every hit knocks you back, and every knockback builds up. Take too many and you're airborne — and off the arena. Fight your friends on the couch or online. The concept is dead simple: survive the round.

But between rounds, things get weird. You pick new skill cards to upgrade your character. Stack your abilities, create completely broken builds, and outsmart everyone else.

Why you'll like it:

  • Quick, chaotic combat: Fast rounds where physics rule everything.

  • Knockback, not health: Get hit, get launched. Position is everything.

  • Draft your build: Pick active and passive skills between rounds. No two matches are exactly the same.

  • Play anywhere: Local couch multiplayer or online with friends.

  • Clean and simple: Easy to pick up, but super satisfying to master.

Pick your cards, hold your ground, and try not to wobble off the map.

data.name: Fishwake
data.detailed_description:
Eat. Grow. Survive.

In Fishwake, you start small – and the ocean is full of danger. Hunt smaller prey, grow into stronger forms, and avoid anything that is still bigger than you.

Travel through 50 handcrafted levels across five distinct underwater worlds – from colorful coral reefs and dense kelp forests to sunken harbors, glowing abyssal regions, and the open deep.

Features

  • 50 levels across 5 underwater worlds

  • Classic eat-and-grow arcade gameplay

  • Boss battles at the end of every world

  • Currents, hazards, relics, and hidden collectibles

  • Steam achievements and statistics

  • Controller support

  • English and German voice-over and subtitles

Grow bigger. Move faster. Become the hunter – before you become the meal.

Travel through 50 handcrafted levels across five distinct underwater worlds – from colorful coral reefs and dense kelp forests to sunken harbors, glowing abyssal regions, and the open deep.

Features

  • 50 levels across 5 underwater worlds

  • Classic eat-and-grow arcade gameplay

  • Boss battles at the end of every world

  • Currents, hazards, relics, and hidden collectibles

  • Steam achievements and statistics

  • Controller support

  • English and German voice-over and subtitles

Grow bigger. Move faster. Become the hunter – before you become the meal.
data.short_description: Eat, grow and survive in a fast-paced underwater arcade adventure. Hunt smaller fish, evade predators, master currents and bosses, and fight your way through 50 handcrafted levels to the top of the food chain.

data.name: Improvised Tactics
data.detailed_description:
Improvised Tactics is a single player game where you lead a small army to victory!

There are several features that let you control your army. You can tell your units where to go or play as them for a boots on the ground experience.

Improvised Tactics will offer three game modes.

Conquest Mode:

In Conquest Mode you are fighting a resource war in a grid based world map. You can customize your soldiers and squads. You may also invade enemy territory to get stronger although beware you can be invaded as well.

In the overview map you must build infrastructure to support and raise your army! Using your resources, you can build an economy to buy weapons and equipment.

Sandbox Mode:

In Sandbox Mode you are able to use the unit customization features of Conquest Mode in a free setting. The sandbox maps are designed to put your custom units against enemies in arenas.

Scenario Mode:
In Scenario Mode you are given objectives that you must complete. You are given money that you can use to buy units to help complete your job. Some scenarios involve you defending against enemy waves, while in other scenarios you are on the offensive and you must destroy enemy objectives.

data.name: K2-18b: Legacy
data.detailed_description:
Prologue:

In 2015, the Kepler radio telescope discovered the exoplanet K2-18b. In 2023, dimethyl sulfide molecules were detected in its atmosphere, and in 2025, the presence of biosignatures was confirmed.

In 2027, a radio signal of clearly artificial origin was received from the K2-18 star system. In 2036, the home planet was engulfed in a humanitarian crisis, and two years later, the "Ark Initiative" was established.

The Initiative's scientists managed to decipher the signal: it contained detailed instructions for building a device for the instant teleportation of mass through space. In 2047, the decision was made to launch an expedition to K2-18b.

2057. As part of the "Ark Initiative," you set out for the exoplanet K2-18b. You didn't plan on becoming a pioneer, but unforeseen difficulties arise during landing...

What awaits you:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the mysterious and unknown. Traversing unconventional labyrinths, you will explore this world, uncover its secrets, and step by step approach the source of that very signal.

Features:

  • A deep story - the authentic tale of a journey from a remote part of the exoplanet to the heart of a civilization that left its mark on space.

  • Immersive soundtrack - original music for each level, complemented by the sounds of the environment and interactive objects.

  • Secret levels - to reach them, you'll need to put your keen mind and observation skills to the test.

  • Easter eggs and references - the game is filled with references to science fiction literature, classic cinema, and pop culture.

Genre: An atmospheric third-person adventure featuring exploration of complex labyrinths, a deep linear storyline, and multiple endings.

data.name: Flower of Anarchy
data.detailed_description:
A visual novel with RPG elements


«Freedom is measured in lives.»

America is dead. The ashes of the past are scattered over the wastelands, where everyone is on their own. You are the leader of a band of raiders, whose specialty is the capture and sale of slaves.

The goal is simple: to accumulate enough wealth to leave everything behind and disappear forever into the luxury of Old Vegas.

But the road to paradise runs through betrayal, blood and constant risk.

Every step brings you closer to your dream... or to a bullet in the back.

Key Features:

  • Does Solo shoot first? Choose who you will be — a charismatic leader, a ruthless butcher or a cold-blooded strategist. The parameters of the hero affect the style of the game and the available solutions.

  • Control the monsters: the raiders have a character. If you play the good guy too much, you'll lose your credibility. If you push too hard, there will be a riot.

  • Difficult moral choices: prisoners, allies, prey — everything can become both a resource and a threat.

  • The wasteland breathes death: randomized events along the way, mutant attacks, ambushes of competitors and hunger — challenges do not wait in turn.

There are no right solutions here. Just you, your gang, and a path strewn with ashes.

Old Vegas is waiting. But will you live to see it?

data.name: Markus Ritter - The Lost Family
data.detailed_description:
Markus Ritter - The Lost Family is an homage to old point-and-click full motion video games from the 90s.
This Demo was developed as a fan project made by two people over the course of one and a half years. Our goal was to catch the lovely trashy art style from that time, overacting, graphics and dramatics that takes you back to you childhood.

The game takes place in Vienna, Austria. Markus is a young man without any ambitions in life just living from day to day.
However he is haunted by nightmares that don't make any sense. The only reoccuring thing is a young woman in a white dress. Who is she? And why does she seem so familiar...

Are they really just dreams?


In this short adventure, play the first chapter in Markus's quest to become the person he was always supposed to be.

Just some important hints: Always look to the book in your mobile (right mouse click). You will also get a sound when a new task is added. And if you can't find something, hold the space bar to see all interaction points.

If you wanna support us even after the kickstarter campaign you can do this here:

The title song (Backdoor001) and Marie's song (So Close) are written and performed by the amazing artist Tina Mali

data.name: Seven: Enhanced Edition
data.detailed_description:
Seven: Enhanced Edition is an open-world, isometric stealth and action role-playing game, in which you play as Teriel, a master thief sent on a mission that will shake the foundations of the Vetrall Empire. Free roam across the vibrant prison island of Peh and explore the sea depths on board of a submarine in the Drowned Past expansion.

SEVEN HOURS OF NEW GAMEPLAY IN DROWNED PAST EXPANSION


Continue exploration as serial thief Teriel, who runs into ‘the Enclave’, a ragtag group of mysterious vagabonds who have discovered the mythological sunken vessel and are exploring it in the hopes of unearthing riches. But things that are buried, are buried for good reason, as Teriel and the Enclave will discover.

EXPLORE A VIBRANT OPEN WORLD FROM AN ISOMETRIC PERSPECTIVE

From the moment you set foot on Peh, the island is open to you. Sneak, run, climb, and fight your way across a colourful array of environments.
You are free to explore wherever you please; only security checkpoints, monster-infested areas, and dangerous factions stand in your way!

CHOOSE YOUR PLAYSTYLE

As a master thief, Teriel is well versed in the art of stealth. Get the jump on enemies from behind and above, fool everyone with cunning disguises, or just use the environment to keep out of sight entirely.
If things go wrong, however, or you’re feeling impatient, there’s nothing to stop you from letting loose with an array of devastating weapons, and unleashing deadly magical skills upon your foes.

ENCOUNTER A MYRIAD OF COLOURFUL CHARACTERS

Encounter an array of people, from despondent slaves and prisoners through to rich socialites. Just be sure to keep an eye out for the two major factions on Peh: the Biomancers and the Technomagi.
In such a desperate place, there are many who will take any help they can get. Choose whether to help or exploit Peh’s inhabitants, but be prepared for the consequences.

UNCOVER AN EPIC STORY OF DECEIT AND TREACHERY

On Peh, everyone has an agenda, and often there’s more than meets the eye. Dive into a world teeming with distrust, and crushed between the machinations of mighty powers.
Work with the daemon that has possessed you to complete a mission of utmost importance. The fate of the Vetrall Empire rests in your hands.

data.name: Gas Guzzlers: Combat Carnage
data.detailed_description:
Gas Guzzlers: Combat Carnage

Gas Guzzlers: Combat Carnage is a fast-paced addictive combat racing game for the PC. The game features many different vehicles, weapons, upgrades, on-track bonuses as well as distinctive and astonishing environments. The player starts with a low-performance vehicle and gradually works his way up by earning money in a series of challenging races.With an initial amount of money,the player buys his first car without upgrades.

The game is run through the series of events\challenges that are divided into four separate categories. Categories, tracks and vehicles are unlocked as player progresses throughout the game. After selecting the class (only the first class is enabled at the beginning) selection of events follows. At the start of the game number of events is limited but it increases in time depending mainly on player's score. Unlocked events can be played an unlimited number of times and each time player can win points and money for the selected event. The transition from the lower to the higher class is achieved by winning in the special tournament event. Besides the players, various AI simulated drivers engage in events and challenges. All AI drivers are simulated according to their parameters and settings. Computer opponents can progress and improve their vehicles in a way similar to the player's. This provides an additional reality aspect for the whole game. For each category there is an official rank roster which shows the current positions for all the drivers. The player must achieve victories on a regular basis to be consistently at the top and earn the money to maintain his vehicle and save some for a new one. All upgrades come with price tags, which rise depending on the class car type. Standard types of events/challenges are races, knock-outs and tournaments. Some events have prerequisites that have to be met before participating in the race (specific class, car type, car color, type of weapon allowed...).

• 150+ miles of tracks and 5 different events per track

• 12 unique weapons

• 15 customizable cars (12+ upgrades, color, rims, stickers, etc..) , damage distribution on the vehicle

• On-track bonuses and power ups

• Secret tracks, cars and experience spiced with unique humor

• Multiplayer over LAN and Internet (Dedicated server included with the game)

• Multiplayer modes (classic race, battle race, knockout, deathmatch arena, last man standing)

Gas Guzzlers won second place on European Games Award 2012 for best racing game.

All AI drivers are simulated according to their parameters and settings. Computer opponents can progress and improve their vehicles in a way similar to the player's. This provides an additional reality aspect for the whole game. For each category there is an official rank roster which shows the current positions for all the drivers. The player must achieve victories on a regular basis to be consistently at the top and earn the money to maintain his vehicle and save some for a new one. All upgrades come with price tags, which rise depending on the class car type. Standard types of events/challenges are races, knock-outs and tournaments. Some events have prerequisites that have to be met before participating in the race (specific class, car type, car color, type of weapon allowed...).

• 150+ miles of tracks and 5 different events per track

• 12 unique weapons

• 15 customizable cars (12+ upgrades, color, rims, stickers, etc..) , damage distribution on the vehicle

• On-track bonuses and power ups

• Secret tracks, cars and experience spiced with unique humor

• Multiplayer over LAN and Internet (Dedicated server included with the game)

• Multiplayer modes (classic race, battle race, knockout, deathmatch arena, last man standing)

Gas Guzzlers won second place on European Games Award 2012 for best racing game.

Every hole is procedurally generated.

Multiplayer

You can play in lobbies of up to 8 players.

data.name: Sliming
data.detailed_description:
The game Slimeing is full of unique mechanics and obstacles. In this game, you control a character called Slime and must bounce it through the air to reach the destination. The obstacles become increasingly difficult, making it very challenging to clear each level. However, the sense of accomplishment you feel when you finally clear a level is unparalleled.

In addition, this game has a unique theme. The cute character of Slime, the way it bounces, and the design of the obstacles all contribute to the game's casual atmosphere.

It's a game where you can feel a sense of achievement in the process of facing countless challenges and failures. You can enjoy many unique mechanics and obstacles along with the theme. Keep challenging yourself endlessly towards your goal and experience the thrill of overcoming your own limits.

data.name: Midnight Feast
data.detailed_description:
From the creators of The Artifacts and Hilda Bewildered, Midnight Feast is an picture book of 44 beautiful and interactive hand drawn pages.

Roya is excited to stay up late for a midnight feast. But things don't pan out how she imagined. For younger readers, the scariest features can be turned off in the options page.

This story stands up well to close-reading, with notes and activities available.

Themes include: drought, its impact on food security and escapism.

Explore Roya's World

  • Any interactivity in Midnight Feast either moves the story forward, or it exists to create atmosphere or humour.
  • Tap the screen to activate character dialogue
  • Lots of rub-to-reveal scenes, to expose Roya’s imaginary alternative life
  • Randomly generate strange recipes in “Dad’s Kitchen”, or movie titles in Roya’s home theatre
  • Manipulate light effects

Features

  • hand-drawn artwork
  • professional narration by Matthias Bossi
  • beautiful music score, composed by New Zealand musician Chris Hurn especially for this story
  • narration plays automatically on each page
  • narration can be turned off

    Midnight Feast does not glorify or promote highly processed food.

    important Note

    We have maintained an aspect ratio of 4:3 to preserve the original artwork. You will see panels on the side of a typical 16:9 ratio computer monitor. We have provided an option to run Midnight Feast in a window on the desktop, without the panels.

data.name: Farm Kitten - Puzzle Pipes
data.detailed_description:
Kitten has moved to the countryside. Initially he has only three plantations of different sizes. Each of them presents a level of difficulty, and the biggest plantation is the one with the most water pipes. These pipes must be set in the correct position, so that the irrigation system can start working.

The kitten can also choose what to plant. It should be aware that the yield of each crop can vary. So it is smart to choose to plant what has a higher selling price.

At the end of each crop, the planting generates money. Kitten will use this money to fulfill his dreams as a cat, and finally have a large farm at his disposal.

data.name: Black Rose
data.detailed_description:
Black Rose is a first-person survival horror game in which you assume the role of Linda, an average girl who heard rumors about an old abandoned funeral home being haunted. No one knows what happened to many of the people who used to work there, but legend says they were murdered. By who? Linda wants to find this out for herself, so she goes to the secluded funeral home. But not long after entering, things go horribly wrong.

SCORE


Your score will be based on 'Close Calls'. Close Calls are achieved by getting close to the enemy without letting them catch you. When your score starts increasing, the enemy is dangerously close. Try to get as many Close Calls as possible to bring up your score, but be aware that you should not let your Close Calls with the first enemy last for too long. This enemy is particularly volatile, and will quickly catch you if you are close for too long.

data.detailed_description:
The rats messed with the wrong grandma.

They came for the kitchen. The cheese. The crumbs behind the stove. What they didn't count on was a 78-year-old woman with a candy cane launcher, zero patience, and an apron full of upgrades.

Grandma's Last Stand is a top-down auto-shooter where you fight off increasingly ridiculous waves of rats in grandma's kitchen. Pick the right upgrades, and try not to panic when 40 rats pour in from every corner of the room.

She's means business.

Grandma doesn't mess around. Survive long enough and she'll pull out the knitting needles, drop honey traps on the floor, and blast cookies in every direction. The rats never saw it coming.

Every run is different.

Level up and pick from random upgrades. Go full offense and turn the kitchen into a warzone. Stack health and let the rats bounce off you. Or invest in XP and out-level everything on screen. The only wrong choice is dying.

Features:

  • Auto-shooting grandma

  • 15+ upgrades that actually change how you play

  • 3 unlockable weapons that grandma definitely should not have access to

  • 5 rat types — some bite, some shoot, some are just unreasonably large

  • Bosses every 5 waves that take up way too much of the screen

  • Runs last 10-20 minutes, or 45 seconds if you're bad at it

  • Pixel art that your grandma would describe as "nice, dear"

  • Keyboard & Mouse. WASD to move. Grandma handles the rest

One more run. Just one more.

You'll say this 11 times. We're not sorry.

data.detailed_description:

Welcome to the VERTIGROWL program. This laboral experience shall be the start of an impressive professional career in anomalous architectural management.

You will be assigned to one of the many teams working at the “Skyslasher”. Tasks might vary from group to group, but all of them have one thing in common: the use of our state-of-the-art transportation system. To prevent human error, you will be required to pre-program your route beforehand.

VERTIGROWL is not responsible from death by any of the following instances you will encounter during your work hours:

-Simple Sokoban-style puzzles

-Slow-paced bullet hell

-Restrictive movement system centered around planning beforehand

-2.5D artwork made from doodles and home-taken photos

-Eerie ambient music

-The flesh angels are coming

No previous work experience is required for this job.

data.name: Serpent Rising
data.detailed_description:
Revives the classical RTS genre in a way never seen before!

Shape the destiny of your tribe in a hostile post-apocalyptic world, having regressed to a brutal archaic state. Build your base, explore, survive and evade radiation, keep track of things that impact your genetic evolution as well as your phenotypic traits. Fight hostile competing tribes - kill or be killed, kidnap or be kidnapped, scorch the earth.

Take advantage of your environment to hunt or tame animals, grow own food, or migrate your base to more favorable ground.

Optionally read the story of each of your tribe members through exciting personal logs, Choose whether to play dirty or be a last beacon of morality and hope in a depraved and brutal world.

Play as one of four factions, each with their own campaign with a rich story and multiple endings!

data.name: Multishot
data.detailed_description:
Wishlist now on steam!


About the Game

Multishot is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer shooter platformer game where you have the freedom to fully customize your character and experiment with different cosmetics. As you engage in thrilling battles, not only will you rely on your skills, but you'll also have the opportunity to collect power-ups scattered throughout the maps.


Explore a wide range of maps, each offering unique environments and strategic possibilities. From sprawling arenas to tight corridors, every location presents a fresh challenge and demands adaptability from you and your opponents. Keep an eye out for power-ups that can turn the tide of battle in your favor, granting you temporary boosts, enhanced weapons, or unique abilities.

Climbing the leaderboard is a key aspect of Multishot, and only the most skilled and dedicated players will rise to the top. Showcase your abilities and earn recognition as you outperform your rivals and earn your place among the elite. Will you be able to claim the coveted number one spot?

With intuitive controls and smooth gameplay, Multishot caters to both casual and competitive gamers. Whether you're looking for a quick adrenaline rush or aiming to fine-tune your skills for intense esports competition, this game has you covered.

So, are you up for the challenge? Gather your friends, dive into the vast customization options, and get ready to conquer the leaderboards in this addictive, action-packed multiplayer shooter. Prepare to unleash chaos, dominate your opponents, and leave your mark in the world of Multishot!

data.name: Creepy Shift: Uncle Joe’s Motel
data.detailed_description:
Every day’s the same.

Making beds, taking out trash, vacuuming, and surprises no one asked for. People leave all kinds of things behind here... some of them say something about who they are, leave a clue  and imagination does the rest. But… there are people you really don’t want to get to know.

Unfortunately, life rarely listens to what you want. It hands you a script you can’t prepare for. That’s why it’s worth choosing a way to play where improvisation feels natural. My style? Noir - Because every chapter is a mystery that needs solving.

data.name: TENNISTRONIC
data.detailed_description:
TENNISTRONIC is a 3D game based on sports similar to tennis or paddle. It increases your reflexes due to the high speed that you end up reaching. Set in a futuristic aesthetic, you will have to move your racket from left to right to stop the ball that will increase in speed with each bounce, you can also give effect to the ball, both right and left to influence its trajectory.

The player who gets to 15 points first wins the game !!!!

FEATURES:

  • Increase your reflexes by hitting the ball that reaches more and more speed, and at the same time get to score a goal to your opponent.

  • Play split screen with another friend, using two gamepads (both with vibration), or gamepad and keyboard.

  • Compete against the AI in “single player” mode.

  • Be surprised by the naturalness of the AI, which will anticipate your movements, you will not be able to differentiate it from a human, and has three levels of difficulty.

  • Hit the ball with spin without using extra buttons. If you are moving the racquet left or right when hitting the ball, the ball will change its trajectory.

  • Enjoy an immersive and dynamic 3D game, thanks to the movement of the camera that always offers you the most suitable angle according to your position, and to the vibration of the gamepad when you hit the ball, and even more if you hit it with spin, it will also do it if you score a point.

  • Check your points score against other players on the leaderboards when you beat the AI, as well as your achievements.

data.name: Psychoscopy
data.detailed_description:
Your purpose in this game is finding evidences and taking videos of paranormal activities to share on your website named ‘Psychoscopy’. You have different types of equipments to detect specific activities for finding haunted areas and gather evidences of these existences. Your exploration team checks the place before you reach the destination and gives you some information about it. You earn your life with sharing the videos and the evidences of paranormal activities on your website.

  • In Psychoscopy, there are 20+ unique existences in 4 different categories.

  • These are; ghosts, spirits, daemons and mytical beings.

  • All of them have unique defense methods that helps you to defend yourselves while looking for an evidence.

PROTECT YOURSELF

You will find yourselves in the middle of the different existences. You have to know which creature you are dealing before chosing the defense method. While these methods helps you to defend yourselves against some creatures, they can make others angry.

TALK TO THEM

Some of the beings may want to talk with you, you can contact with them, ask them questions, tell them to do some activities or maybe talk with them by using an ouija board.

LARGE MAPS

The places you will search have large lands. There are many places worth to visit, but it can be hard to find your way. You should read your exploration team’s hints carefully and check the map frequently that is given to you by them. You and your 4 friends should choose where you check wisely because not all the places have paranormal activities.

SPECIAL CHARACTERS

You can unlock the new unique characters and better equipments by earning more money in this game.

  • Randomly generated maps

  • Decisions matter, strategizing and foresight can mean the difference between victory and death

data.name: Lonely Skies
data.detailed_description:
Lonely Skies is a 2D side-scrolling vehicle adventure game set in a fantasy steampunk world. When your home was invaded you escaped in an airship built from scrap. You must keep your ship running on borrowed parts in order to reach safety. Navigate your ship through dangerous windstorms, hostile armies, and hazardous terrains. Then, hop off the helm to raid your opponents' ships for parts to continue your journey.

  • Use sails, engines, and a cannon to guide your airship through hazardous skies
  • Leave the helm and use your grappling hook to board enemy ships and steal parts to keep your ship running
  • Fly through three unique and atmospheric regions on your journey to find safety

About Us
Lonely Skies was made by a group of 12 student developers in the University of Utah EAE program.

data.name: Melody of Seasons
data.detailed_description:
Live the farmer life in Melody of Seasons! Harvest tons of crops and raise livestock on your brand new farm! Uncover the mysteries of Melody Vale! Meet the locals and discover their stories - maybe you'll even meet someone extra special!

Features:
  • Character Customization: Create your own unique looking character. Stand out in the way you want!
  • Farming: Harvest and tend to different crops for each season. Water your crops daily, and watch out for crows, insects, and weeds!
  • Mining: Mine for valuable ores and minerals in the local mine.
  • Fishing: Fish for different kinds of fish in different water sources & seasons.
  • Foraging: Forage for various fruits and materials around the local environment.
  • Level up the various skills and tools to obtain new recipes and abilities.
  • Ranching: Purchase livestock including cows, chickens, ducks, sheep, pigs, and goats. Raise them from young to mature.
  • Crafting: Craft refiners to transform materials into more valuable materials. Craft sprinklers to automatically water your crops. Craft scarecrows and bat houses to ward off crows and insects. Craft auto fishers to automatically fish for you. Lay down nice pathways to spruce up your farm!
  • Social: Give gifts and fulfill the townsfolks' requests & wish lists to make friends with them. Get to know their stories through cutscenes as you increase your heart level.
  • Marriage: If you desire, marry one of the NPCs! Whoever you want! They'll live with you on the farm and their schedule will change!
  • Baby: Have a baby with your partner!
  • NPC Schedules: NPCs have their own schedules which vary depending on the day and weather. If you marry an NPC he or she will have a schedule that includes your home and farm!
  • Ice Cream: Make Ice Cream for the locals or sell for profit!
  • Cooking: Learn yummy recipes to give as gifts to the locals or replenish your energy.
  • Town Hall: Renovate the Town Hall to help the local community and gain access to more energy and abilities.
  • Museum: Donate rare artifacts to fulfill the museum. Grandpa would be proud if you can find them all.
  • Festivals: Take part in festivals where you can get to know the townsfolk and participate in events such as the chicken race and Winter Ball.
  • Home Improvement: Upgrade your house for more space. Show Grandpa that you're doing well with his old farm.
  • Home Decoration: Change the flooring and walls in each room of your house for your own unique look.
  • Seasons: Enjoy 4 different seasons with different music, moods, colors, and weather effects.
  • Grandpa's Judgment: Do as well as you can so that Grandpa is proud of you. After 2 years, he will check up on you to see how you're doing!

Melody of Seasons is a Farming RPG and Life Sim featuring lots of harvesting, crafting, cooking, ranching, relationships, decorating, scavenging, fishing, mining, collecting, cooking, character customization and more! It is inspired by Stardew Valley and the classic Harvest Moon games as well as Story of Seasons. It's focused on delivering a relaxed and enjoyable experience that will brighten your day and make you smile. Sit back and relax as you collect and craft hundreds of items and grow your farm into everything Grandpa ever wanted! Seasons and weather changes deliver an ever-changing ambient experience. Design a beautiful farm and get to know the local community in this wonderful new world!

There's a lot to do in Melody of Seasons! Come start your new life on the farm!

data.name: Space Saviour Special
data.detailed_description:
Space Savior Special is a Shoot 'em up (STG or Shmup) game for PC Steam. Inspired by classic Arcades and 16bit consoles, in a time when things were simpler and nicer. Year 2988. Finally, with the creation of the Hyperdrives, humanity opens the doors to the stars. Space travel becomes reality and human life spreads across the galaxy. But we ended up encountering a race-destroying way of life. The Naggal are series without individual consciousness and act like space locusts. They attack planets and species like viruses and after consuming everything they go to the next one. Defeat is certain, but as a last act of despair they send ships from all nations to break the blockade and try to detonate an experimental bomb in the center of enemy forces. The player controls the Barracuda Ship and together with the Temporal Bomb the player sets off on a one-way mission.


  • Arcade-style vertical PC shmup perfect for newbies to the genre
  • Game with 2D pixel-art handmade art based on 16 bit consoles
  • Choose from 3 weapon styles based on how you play, each having a unique type of special bomb
  • 5 stages with cut-scenes and a surprising ending
  • Over 60 unique enemies and striking bosses



  • Generic keyboard and joystick support and xbox controller
  • Steam achievements
  • Arts used in development
  • 3 difficulty settings
  • Possible free future DLC
  • Subtitles in various languages

data.name: Circle Empires
data.detailed_description:
The Circle Empires universe is made of interconnected circles, each containing loot to plunder and foes to defeat. You are the god-like leader of your tiny kingdom, hungry for power. Use your skills to hunt down increasingly powerful enemies and expand your empire. The game world changes every time you play - no two games are the same. And... you can grow pumpkins!



Originally released as a small demo, Circle Empires was avidly played by 160.000+ gamers worldwide.

“Since we got all this love from thousands Circle Empires demo players, we decided to make it into a fully-fledged RTS. Now, after two years of work, this little gem is ready to be enjoyed.” – the Luminous Team.

KEY FEATURES


  • Fast-paced real-time strategic gameplay with large-scale battles
  • Expand your empire, circle by circle
  • Units can gain XP and level up
  • Procedurally generated worlds containing unique flora and fauna
  • 150+ different creatures, buildings and resources
  • 18 Different faction leaders, a variety of bonuses
  • 12 enemy boss monsters
  • A magnificent treasury that grows with each battle

data.name: Knight Musume
data.detailed_description:
Thanks to the power of a mysterious magenta figure, the protagonist is able to travel across the worlds of different Knight Musume.

However, this power is far from stable. Every journey sends them to a random time and place, and sometimes the world itself may even cast them back out. Fortunately, there is one absolute rule: they can never travel to a time and place where another version of themselves already exists.

Travel through world after world, collect items belonging to the Knight Musume, and gradually uncover their stories.

Players can repeatedly send the protagonist out on expeditions and wait for them to return with various strangely “familiar” collectibles.

Due to the development team's current production capacity, the game will continue to receive updates over a period of time until all planned content has been completed. Each update will introduce more Knight Musume, along with additional collectibles to discover.

This work contains transformative interpretations of tokusatsu-inspired elements and original characters. All collectibles featured in the game are creatively reimagined fan tributes.

data.name: Farm by the Black Hole
data.detailed_description:
The game is in early development, please stay tuned! If you like this game, add it to your wishlist ^0^

Welcome to Farm by the Black Hole!

This game is a farming simulation featuring crop cultivation, animal husbandry, exploration, and interactions with NPCs.

The most unique feature?

Your home planet orbits near a supermassive black hole!

As you progress, venturing closer to the black hole triggers [gravitational time dilation], leading to surreal effects:

  • Spend 1 hour exploring near the black hole, and 5 hours will have passed back home!

  • Return from the black hole to find freshly sown crops already ripe for harvest!

  • Stay too long near the black hole, and you might come back to a world utterly changed—familiar faces and places gone forever.

Exploring near a black hole!

Discover other planets near the black hole, but never get too close! Gather rare resources and encounter strange wonders on alien worlds.

Cultivate Crops

Plant, water, and reap bountiful harvests to sell for profit! If growth feels slow, take a trip near the black hole—return to find your crops grown in a whoosh!

Raise Animals

Care for chickens, dogs, and more by feeding them daily—hungry animals won’t thrive! They’ll repay your kindness: hens lay eggs, dogs assist with chores... every creature rewards your devotion!

Little Comet is a cute physics-based space minigolf

Guide Little Comet on her long journey around the sun. Meet new friends and collect candy while you slingshot your way past the planets of our Solar System. Dodge gravity fields, ride the solar wind, and avoid perils like electric storms and hot planets to reach the next wormhole that takes you one step closer to your mother, the sun.

Minigolf on a cosmic scale

  • Slingshot yourself across space and bounce off planets and ride their gravity to reach goal
  • Complete secondary objectives to earn extra stars
  • Use stars to unlock all 48 courses

Casual turn-based fun

  • Easy to learn, hard to master
  • No planet is alike. New gameplay elements keep the courses interesting
  • Secondary objectives include laid back tasks with no time limit

Suitable for even the youngest players

  • Cute characters and colorful courses
  • Simple user interface with minimal texts
  • No ads or in-app purchases
  • Children learn about the planets and our solar system while having fun

data.name: GNARP'S HEI$T
data.detailed_description:
Gnarp’s Hei$t is a fast-paced 3D platformer about an alien drowning in debt. After accidentally wrecking his leased UFO, Gnarp heads to Earth to pull off a series of daring heists, stealing valuable treasures to pay off what he owes. His ultimate goal: pay his debt, fix his ship and finally make it back home.

Explore open, sandbox-style levels set in cities inspired by real-world locations, each reimagined through a bold, comic-book-inspired art style filled with expressive characters and vibrant environments.

The gameplay focuses on momentum-based platforming and freeform exploration. Gnarp’s signature ability, shooting bubble gum, launches him in the opposite direction, turning every shot into a movement tool. Chain jumps, launch yourself across rooftops, uncover hidden collectibles, and tackle challenges in multiple ways as you master this unique traversal system.

With an emphasis on fluid movement, collectible-driven progression, and open-ended level design, Gnarp’$ Heist delivers a nostalgic-style platforming experience with a fresh, modern twist.

data.name: Red shift Point
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the largest "Falsehood" in human history.

Redshift Point is a first-person survival extraction RPG that fuses modern Chinese industrial aesthetics with a near-future collapse. Forget the neon-drenched, shallow "Cyberpunk" clichés. We are here to offer a dose of Sino-Industrial Rationalism.
No more Cyber Blink!

We have had enough of the westernized "Cyberpunk" visual tropes—endless neon lights and exoticized "future cities" that serve no purpose. In Redshift Point, we returned to the roots of the 21st-century Chinese industrial soul and merged it with 20th-century socialist aesthetics.

  • We don't believe in "RPG numbers" floating in the air. Combat in the Nova Exclusion Zone is about physics, momentum, and the brutal reality of ballistics.

    • Authentic Ballistics: If your kinetic energy doesn't beat the armor plate, you achieve nothing. We focus on the visceral feedback of machinery and lead.

    • Hardcore Survival: Every shot matters. We prioritize the "feel" of the weapon over the stats on a screen. This is professional-grade physical intervention.

  • Authentic Ballistics: If your kinetic energy doesn't beat the armor plate, you achieve nothing. We focus on the visceral feedback of machinery and lead.

  • Hardcore Survival: Every shot matters. We prioritize the "feel" of the weapon over the stats on a screen. This is professional-grade physical intervention.

In the year 2037, the crisis isn't just about AI or corporate greed; it’s about the Commodification of Existence.

  • In the Exclusion Zone, we don't care about the labels assigned to you by "Global Corporate Ethics" . To the Megacorps, your identity is just another product to be exploited.

  • We believe in the collective struggle of the "disposable" worker and soldier. Whether you are a Scavenger or a Soldier, you are being exploited by the same invisible hand.

  • Those forced to perform "Identity" to survive are the truly marginalized. We reject the divisive politics of the elite. Here, everyone's life is a resource—and it’s time to take that resource back.

data.name: Messorem
data.detailed_description:
A compelling narrative about death

You play Messorem, a graveyard reaper. Your job is simple, guide the souls of the dead to eternal rest. After many years of the same job, Messorem starts to wonder if there is more to their life. Messorem stops doing their job and the souls no longer have someone to guide them to rest.


One day a woman named Mallory arrives at the cemetary with her deceased son. In exchange for putting her son's soul to rest Messorem can finally get eternal rest themselves. To put the son to rest however, Messorem must gather his family for the funeral. The only problem is, the family is spread apart and the roads are filled with the frenzied spirits Messorem have neglected. To gather the family, Messorem must travel across the land and put all souls to rest.

Magical combat arenas!

Once combat is initiated, an arena is created from the element used to initiate the fight. Each arena has its own effects that can both affect the player and the enemy!

Messorem's combat utilizes both melee combat and a ranged magic system. Each spell has their own effect and based on a rock, paper, scissors system connected to their own element. Wield nature's magic and choose the correct spell to put the frienzied souls to rest!

Puzzles!

To get an audience with some of the family members, you must complete a puzzle related to their personality. So get your dance shoes on and get ready to impress!

Music by SHINE!

The soon-to-be music phenomenon SHINE provides the music with the «Sounds From The Afterlife - Concept Album For Messorem». The norwegian 8-piece delivers an astounding 65+ minutes of live orchestrated music that paints the world of the game with a magical assortment of sounds, genre-variety and instrumentation.

SHINE brings the action and drama to new levels with the two vocal-tracks «The Final Hour» and «Shimmer». From blistering speed-metal to folky J-pop undertones, the band delivers audible spectacle like no first-time Indie game has ever seen (or in this case heard) before.

data.name: GoblinGate
data.detailed_description:
The gate stopped you last run. Your warband resets. You make your Pact. Now the same wall is about to find out what changed.

Goblin Gate is a compact dark fantasy idle game about pushing a goblin warband through escalating cursed depths. Let your fighters work. Spend Gold on upgrades. Hit the wall, then Reforge and come back with a run that plays differently than the last one.

Runs Have Shapes

Most idle games get faster after a reset. Goblin Gate gets different.

When your push stalls, you Reforge. Your Marks bank. Your warband resets. And you draft a PACT Shard, a power that defines how the next raid fundamentally behaves.

Blood

Build a kill chain. Fast kills feed a damage surge that climbs into a lethal threshold. Lose tempo and the chain fades. The run lives and dies by momentum.

Loot

Engineer jackpots. Every tenth kill erupts in Gold and throws open a frantic spending window. Time your big fighter upgrades around the rush.

Bone

Build the machine. Spectral hands automate the fight. Stack charges and fire Salvos that punch through depth walls raw damage alone can't reach.

Stack Shards across multiple Reforges and let archetypes collide. Blood and Loot trigger a Red Payday, Loot and Bone detonate a Jackpot Salvo. The warband grows stranger and more explosive each cycle.

Two Resets. One Bends the Curve.

Reforge gives you Marks and a PACT Shard. Marks compound permanently into your damage. Shards shape the run.

Awaken is different. Spend your lifetime Marks, earn Crowns, and choose a Crown Oath, a permanent path that changes how all future Mark gain scales with depth. After the first Awakening, old walls don't slow you down. They remind you how far you've come. After the second, they're the warm-up.

Three PACT archetypes with cross-shard hybrid payoffs, fighter promotions that create visible mid-run power spikes. Two distinct reset layers: Reforge and Awaken, that compound differently. The gate always has another level.

data.name: Echoes
data.detailed_description:
The wounds of the Sol War are still fresh, the scars etched deep into the collective memory of a broken Federation. An uneasy peace lingers, a fragile truce between shattered planets and the remnants of once-mighty empires. Captain Zara Kincaid is a symbol caught in this crossfire – a defiant beacon of hope for those clinging to shattered ideals, a broken tool for those who see only ambition and opportunity in the ruins.

But when a cosmic pulse ripples through the stars, a chilling whisper amidst the silence, it shatters the illusion of peace. This is not the echo of old wars, but the herald of something far more vast… and potentially far more destructive. The alien signal pulses with unimaginable power, a promise that might offer salvation… or accelerate humanity's extinction.

Can Zara break free from the gilded cage that confines her, expose the ambitions of those who would twist this force to their own ends, and uncover the true nature of this cosmic enigma? The fate of countless worlds hangs in the balance, dangling by the thread of her choices. For in a galaxy already ravaged by war, this newfound power could tip the scales towards a new age of wonder… or become a requiem for the stars themselves.

data.name: 7 days with Death
data.detailed_description:
New information


New project "Lingua Fleur: Lily" is COOMING SOON!


About the Game

In 2013, Narrator released its fourth game focusing on fate and choice.
Through cooperation with SSCP, the quality of this game has improved over our previous works!

Containing the 3 original routes, plus an additional route, the script length is about 130,000 words in total.
Featuring 19 CGs, a soundtrack of 9 songs plus the main Chinese theme song, and stunning backgrounds based on Taiwan's Tamsui District (淡水).

※ This game does not have character voices

story:

"In seven days, you will die."
On Christmas Eve, a strange girl breaks into your home claiming to be the bringer of death.
"I will be with you for seven days... if you don't want to die, you must find someone who is willing to die for you."
This unbelievable prophesy is then followed by many strange omens...

Daily life becomes unpredictable, even to the point where he runs into Shaw Chin, who had just ended a relationship.
Is she someone who will love me... who will die for me?
Death haunts his every move.

On New Years Eve, Death looms over him.
As the fireworks light up the night sky, he must make a choice...

Containing the 3 original routes, plus an additional route, the script length is about 130,000 words in total.
Featuring 19 CGs, a soundtrack of 9 songs plus the main Chinese theme song, and stunning backgrounds based on Taiwan's Tamsui District (淡水).

※ This game does not have character voices

story:

"In seven days, you will die."
On Christmas Eve, a strange girl breaks into your home claiming to be the bringer of death.
"I will be with you for seven days... if you don't want to die, you must find someone who is willing to die for you."
This unbelievable prophesy is then followed by many strange omens...

Daily life becomes unpredictable, even to the point where he runs into Shaw Chin, who had just ended a relationship.
Is she someone who will love me... who will die for me?
Death haunts his every move.

On New Years Eve, Death looms over him.
As the fireworks light up the night sky, he must make a choice...

data.name: Doomed Lands
data.detailed_description:
Only seven days are left to prepare for each demon lieutenant's arrival, so time is of the essence. Survive the treacherous Doomed Lands long enough to set a trap and defeat the demonic menace’s myriad of allies!

Doomed Lands is built around survival and preparation. Each demonic lieutenant arrives every seven days accompanied by an army of minions full of non-garden variety gnomes, extraterrestrials, among other supernatural pests. Use the most out of those seven days , while surviving the doomed lands and its many challenging environments, from scorching deserts to frozen wastes.

Work the land and strike the earth! Gather raw minerals and transform them into weapons at the homestead, built from the ground up. Raise livestock to keep everyone fed, lay traps for the visceral vermin, and prepare for hell on earth

Sign up for the challenge of a built-in roguelike mode, knowing that every mistake might be the last. Can you withstand the onslaught of demonic hordes? Or fall, allowing the lands to be truly doomed?

data.name: LEGO® Batman™ 3: Beyond Gotham
data.detailed_description:
The best-selling LEGO Batman videogame franchise returns in an out-of-this-world, action-packed adventure! In LEGO Batman™ 3: Beyond Gotham, the Caped Crusader joins forces with the super heroes of the DC Comics universe and blasts off to outer space to stop the evil Brainiac from destroying Earth. Using the power of the Lantern Rings, Brainiac shrinks worlds to add to his twisted collection of miniature cities from across the universe. Now the greatest super heroes and the most cunning villains must unite and journey to different Lantern Worlds to collect the Lantern Rings and stop Brainiac before it’s too late.

• Exciting space combat - For the first time ever, battle with Batman and his allies in outer space and the various Lantern worlds including Zamaron and Odym.
• Robust roster of DC Comics heroes and villains - Play and unlock more than 150 unique characters with amazing powers and abilities, including members of the Justice League, and BIG LEGO Figures such as Cyborg, Solomon Grundy and more.
• Unique storyline with new plots and twists –Surprising disguises, Brainiac’s mind control ability, and the power of the Lantern rings bring a whole new twist to characters you thought you knew.
• Hack computer terminals - Enter a virtual world to escape mazes, battle in arenas, and race to find the code.
• Bat-tastic Gadget Wheel - With a simple press of a button, choose and upgrade select character’s suits and abilities.
• Variety of iconic locales - Visit the Hall of Justice, the Batcave, and the Justice League Watchtower to access shops, trophy rooms, and the hero and vehicle customizers.

data.name: Fool's Gold
data.detailed_description:
AHOY! You are a Pirate, you like Gold, you like treasure but the Sea's are vast and treacherous. Fool's Gold is a survival game at its core. As enemies are slain throughout the game the player gains Dabloons. Dabloons are used in the various shops to upgrade the player's ship. As the player progresses more stronger enemies spawn so it's best to upgrade your ship!

Upgrade Your Ship

Special Islands allow you to spend the loot acquired throughout the run. This can be used to change your shield, increase your cannons fire rate or upgrade various other aspects to your ship.

Unique Maps

Each map is a bordered circle of Ocean Tiles with randomly placed islands. Each time the player rests, the map expands its edges and spawns in additional islands. Before the expansion the player will choose a special Island Type to spawn among the new islands. Different Islands will have different perks for purchase. This creates a unique experience for each run.

Davy's Storm

Davy Jones does not like to share. He lacks patient and does not like travelers on his sea. After an amount of time or when the player earns too much gold Davy will cast a storm starting from the last place of rest. When in the storm enemies spawn continuously and have a chance to spawn with increased stats.

Unlockables

3 Unique Ships

3 Special Islands

20+ Attributes to upgrade

25 Perks to unlock
