data.name: Beyond Dawn
data.detailed_description:
The city sleeps. Scavenge it before it wakes.

Leave your shelter after dark, search abandoned buildings and rooftops, and bring something home before sunrise. Bank salvage, improve your equipment, and decide how much farther you can afford to go. Beyond Dawn is a single-player exploration game set in the world of Liminal Protocol, with a city above you and an increasingly unfamiliar network of caverns below.

Look beneath the surface

The world is rendered in three-dimensional ASCII, with real lighting, depth and movement. Your Lattice implant lets you tune that view: shallow levels reveal navigation, while deeper levels expose disturbances and hidden records. Decode what you find, pin a route, and keep recovered clues in your archive.

Make it home before dawn

Climb through the city, cross rooftops with a winch or Vector Jets, avoid patrols, and search for salvage. Extract to keep what you have found, or push into another district. Back underground, use the Foundry to upgrade your equipment and choose your movement rig. Practice rooms let you learn the controls without risking your supplies.

A place to return

Your lair is a workshop and a home. Arrange its living space, expand into the caves, and prepare for your next departure. A lower hatch leads to four connected depths, through service galleries and freight fissures to an entrance beneath Liminal Corp. Return alive with evidence and specimens to open further investigations.

Work across the timeline

The Observation Station connects the city, the Research Lab and Wasteland. In the lab, work with physical instruments: restore a receiver circuit, study a mineral core, and reconstruct a signal through fragments of glass.

Wasteland explores a possible future of the same world. Follow a survivor's radio requests, recover supplies and face threats in the ruined streets and lower facility. Repair equipment in an earlier era, then select an altered future to see its consequences: an emergency locker, a drained storeroom, or a working underground return lift.

In active development

The current game includes repeatable city expeditions, shelter upgrades and decorating, connected cavern missions, Wasteland missions, laboratory activities, and an archive of the story you have recovered. These systems and their pacing are still being developed. The complete story is not finished.

Beyond Dawn is a standalone game in the Liminal Protocol setting. The separate Liminal Protocol campaign is not included.

Back underground, use the Foundry to upgrade your equipment and choose your movement rig. Practice rooms let you learn the controls without risking your supplies.

A place to return

Your lair is a workshop and a home. Arrange its living space, expand into the caves, and prepare for your next departure. A lower hatch leads to four connected depths, through service galleries and freight fissures to an entrance beneath Liminal Corp. Return alive with evidence and specimens to open further investigations.

Work across the timeline

The Observation Station connects the city, the Research Lab and Wasteland. In the lab, work with physical instruments: restore a receiver circuit, study a mineral core, and reconstruct a signal through fragments of glass.

Wasteland explores a possible future of the same world. Follow a survivor's radio requests, recover supplies and face threats in the ruined streets and lower facility. Repair equipment in an earlier era, then select an altered future to see its consequences: an emergency locker, a drained storeroom, or a working underground return lift.

In active development

The current game includes repeatable city expeditions, shelter upgrades and decorating, connected cavern missions, Wasteland missions, laboratory activities, and an archive of the story you have recovered. These systems and their pacing are still being developed. The complete story is not finished.

Beyond Dawn is a standalone game in the Liminal Protocol setting. The separate Liminal Protocol campaign is not included.
data.short_description: Scavenge a dying city before sunrise in a first-person world rendered in 3D ASCII. Follow hidden routes, build a home beneath the streets, and descend toward Liminal Corp. Explore a possible future in Wasteland, where repairs made in the past can change what survives.

Run the best orchard in town and rake the cash in from your perfect fruits.

data.name: The last earth man
data.detailed_description:
In 2XXX, a strange virus suddenly appeared on the earth. It only infects humans. The infected person's body will slowly weaken and then die within a few weeks. The infectivity of this virus is extremely terrible, and human beings cannot avoid being infected by any means. When the whole world was in despair, a Arcturian named bill came to earth and declared that he was willing to help treat the virus. People on earth thought they had met a Savior and fully cooperated with Bill's treatment. However, the treatment had no effect. Soon, human beings became extinct. Bill holds the gene bank of all mankind, so he continues to clone humans to study the treatment of the virus. In one experiment, due to a coincidence that the probability was infinitely close to zero, the virus on a human clone was removed and had immunity to the virus. Bill told the human that the coincidence could not be copied. If you want to revive other humans, you can only go to the source of the virus: Sirius. So, the last earthman drove the mecha provided by bill to Sirius. But waiting for him is a conspiracy
"The last earthman" is a low angle shooting game made by using EvkWorld engine. This game is simple to operate and full of pleasure! Players will fight against the tide of enemies in the map, and swim between various terrain and mechanisms at the same time. The biggest feature of this game: the mecha can equip one weapon with both hands. Two weapons can fire independently or at the same time. When two weapons fire at the same time, completely different effects will appear according to different weapon combinations. In addition, the game is also interspersed with puzzle solving, stock speculation and other playing methods, so that the pace of the game is interspersed and relaxed.

data.name: 古战三国 Ancient War: Three Kingdoms
data.detailed_description:
历史背景

建安二十六年，威震华夏的关羽兵败遇害，曾经英雄并起的三国时代从此走向末章。尽管历史巨轮仍旧前进，先有武侯北伐、石亭鏖战，后有偷渡阴平、天下归晋。但历数过往，最为后世提及的还是东汉末年群雄割据的故事。古战三国将从董卓之乱开始，重现烽火不断、尔虞我诈的三国时代。

丰富的单机剧情战役

剧情战役是游戏的核心玩法，可以从中体验多个章节的历史态势和战斗，从多个君主的视角感受三国历史。玩家需要合理运用地形、克制、断补等战斗策略击败敌人，在此领略到丰富的战斗策略性。

实时pvp匹配对战

匹配对战允许玩家与来自世界各地的其他玩家在线对战，在限定的回合时间内消灭对手。玩家的游戏水平通过战场布局和战术策略在此一较高下。平常可以通过人机对战提升技术，为下一次胜利做好淮备。

核心战棋玩法

兵种相互克制，平原、树林、浅滩、河流、山脉等地形根据地势高低的不同会影响到战斗单位的战斗力。利用包围、侧击背击、打击士气等手段也能够巧妙地挫败对手。玩家可以根据自己的兵种喜好、武将类型喜好组建不同战术倾向的出战阵营，尽情享受战棋游戏的乐趣！

战争迷雾

战斗地图上方覆盖着战争迷雾，战斗单位在移动过程中可以揭开迷雾发现敌人。同样可以在迷雾的掩护下向敌人发起突袭，让敌人措手不及。

马匹器械自由搭配

战斗单位可以根据需要建造马匹或器械。步兵和骑兵可以随时切换，上马成为骑兵、下马成为步兵，还可以带各种器械！远程群伤的投石车、贯射三格的床弩、发射火箭的井阑、围城的云梯、破城的冲车和文官必备的鼓吹都各具特色。

四大基础兵种

刀兵：三国刀兵一般会携带盾牌，防御力显著。技能以辅助为主、降低队友受到的伤害。

戟兵：生命高、造价低。虽然普攻比不上其他兵种，但戟兵拥有群攻和恢复队友生命的技能。
枪兵：擅长进攻和骑马作战，但造价高昂。拥有高伤害技能。
弓兵：可以远程杀伤敌人，在对方回合触发反应投射。弓骑兵还有特殊打法！

丰富多样的历史禁军

禁军是拥有特殊能力的高级兵种，现有陷阵营、先登死士、白马义从、青州兵、飞熊军、丹阳兵、荆州枪营、三河骑士、舞姬等，每个禁军都有自己的擅长打法。

官方QQ群

欢迎加入我们QQ群与广大玩家交流，QQ群722577357

data.name: Rugby League Team Manager 2018
data.detailed_description:
“The Number 1 Rugby League Management Game”

Officially licensed by the world's biggest leagues and competitions. Rugby League Team Manager 2018 puts you, the player, in the heart of the action, of managing your own Rugby League club. The season is long, and the challenges aplenty, as you navigate your way through domestic campaigns and international competitions, within officially licensed leagues, in both the Northern and Southern hemispheres, with over 7000 senior players to choose from!

Do you have what it takes to steer your team over the line to victory?

All New for 2018

  • A completely new user interface
  • A new 3D match engine
  • More screen resolution options
  • New player progression system
  • New dynamic calibre system
  • Different manager types
  • New board judgment variables
  • New team & individual training options
  • New player & staff scouting requirements
  • New player & staff contract negotiation mechanism
  • New small business to corporate sponsorship options
  • A more comprehensive financial receipt and expenditure feature
  • New representative & international management requirements

Key Features

  • Officially licensed by the world's biggest leagues and competitions
  • 226 Clubs including representative clubs and internationals
  • 7064 senior players and 1980 alliance players
  • Full 2D and 3D match engines with real-time interaction with your team
  • Control all staffing, including Assistants, Coaches, Doctors & Physios
  • Upgrade facilities, including Stadium, Gym, Training Paddock, Track,
    Kicking Enclosure, Tactical Briefing Room, Academy Clubhouse, Alliance
    Clubhouse & Centre of Excellence
  • Discover hidden talents among youth teams and work with Agents and
    Scouts to deliver the best players to your club
    - Work your way up the ladder, and lead your club out in the biggest
    tournaments in the world
  • Experience the pain and joy of representative competitions
  • Get closer to the simulation with the customised game editor
  • Up to 7 tiers of domestic promotion and relegation
  • Experience the thrill of the World Club Series and the Challenge Cup!

data.name: Uberlaufer
data.detailed_description:
** This game is a VR ONLY title! You must have an OpenXR compatible headset!! **
** If you are playing the game on Oculus Quest using Virtual Desktop, please make sure you set SteamVR as OpenXR runtime ***

In Überläufer. you play a Wehrmacht soldier who has defected and turned against the Third Reich. You must escape your incarceration by completing random objectives that involve collecting, destroying or photographing various things in the dungeon.

With limited health, you need to make wise choices. Sound and light play a key role in escaping. Listen for approaching guards, avoid lit areas which make it easier for you to be spotted as well as improve enemies aim. Take guards out silently when possible to avoid attracting the SS and use environmental hazards to your advantage. Stealth mechanics including distraction and hiding spots can be used to survive long enough to escape.



Each time you play, the dungeon layout changes as well as your objectives and soldiers backstory. Uncover letters from a former prisoner to discover his story as well as real leaflets and dossiers from the German and Austrian resistance in World War 2.



This rogue-like game is a love letter to the original WW2 Dungeon Crawlers on the Apple II and Commodore 64.

Comfort Options


Smooth / Snap Turn
Dash Teleport
Comfort Tunneling (optional)
Head-based locomotion

data.name: The Beyond: An Interactive Comic Book
data.detailed_description:
Your death was a tragedy... your afterlife is a mystery. Unravel the secrets of death with the help of Xochitl, your guide. Can you find your way through the doors of the great library of the Beyond?

The Beyond is a comic, but not an ordinary comic. Follow the paths from panel to panel. Where the path divides, you decide where to go next! A thrilling tale of sorcery, deception, and discovery.

This is a faithful adaptation of The Beyond, book #2 in Jason Shiga's Adventuregame Comics series (also published in hardcover by Abrams Books). Our goal is not to make the comic “more interactive”, but to present the interactivity inherent in the story. We have not attempted to turn the book into an adventure game. There are no puzzles – except for your understanding of the story, which is entirely up to you. Just as in a physical book, you are free to browse around, or even jump straight to the end if you want.

The electronic medium allows us to improve on the book in one way: we can take advantage of Scott McCloud’s “infinite canvas” principle. Jason has reformatted the book’s pages and tabs into a single enormous spread, in which the story flows in every direction at once.

Can you reach the final reward?

data.name: OMG! Not Another Isekai
data.detailed_description:
Main Premise

Welcome to a brand new adventure. Our main hero, Seo, finds himself in a whole new world. Luckily for him, he landed just in the perfect spot to start his new adventure. Seo wakes up in the lap of our main heroine, Kawai. Seo has an immediate problem, though. He can't remember anything other than his name. How did Seo get into this world? Why did he lose his memories?



Kawai's Route

Seo finds himself in a very remote corner of the world, with just one house surrounded by a large forest for miles on end. Of course, there's a beautiful girl here too... But, why is she here exactly? Stay with Kawai and discover her secret.



Nagamatsu's Route

We come across Nagamatsu while walking through the forest. Nagamatsu is here hunting a large monster. She doesn't really care about you or your problems. It's better to stay out of her business.



The Final Verdict

This game is a visual novel. It has beautifully drawn artwork. It takes place in a world filled with magic and mystery. It has an intriguing story with both major and minor choices. It has a gallery where you can view all the backgrounds, CGS, and music tracks.

data.name: Zero Conflict TD
data.detailed_description:
Prepare for an out-of-this-world gaming experience in "Zero Conflict TD," the ultimate tower defense game that pits you against a relentless alien invasion! The fate of Earth hangs in the balance, and it's up to you to lead the charge and protect our planet from these extraterrestrial aggressors.

In a not-so-distant future, humanity has made contact with advanced civilizations among the stars. While most alien races are peaceful, a malevolent force known as the Ximarats has set its sights on Earth, seeking to conquer and exploit our precious resources. With their technologically superior weapons and relentless onslaught, they pose a formidable threat.

As the commander of Earth's last line of defense, you'll embark on an epic journey to save our world. Your mission is to strategically place an array of powerful towers, each with unique weapons, across key locations on the planet. These towers will serve as your primary means of thwarting the alien invasion.

data.name: Monkey Barrels
data.detailed_description:
GO BANANAS FOR TWIN-STICK SHOOTER GLORY!




A little monkey named Kotetsu has been abducted by Crabbenwold Electric, the evil electronics manufacturer that wiped out the human race! It's monkeys vs. crabs as Kotetsu's friends Masaru and Hanako lead the charge in an all-out assault to rescue him!



Monkey Barrels is an action-packed twin-stick shooter in which you blast waves of weaponized electronic devices with tons of crazy unlockable weapons. You can experiment endlessly with different combinations and find the loadout that best suits your playing style.

FEATURES


  • 98 outrageous weapons fashioned from household objects like bottles, cans, blow dryers, umbrellas and more.
  • Players can equip up to four weapons simultaneously: two main weapons (guns) and two sub weapons (grenades, shields, etc.).
  • When your “WILD POWER” meter fills up from taking damage, you can unleash a super move that wipes out surrounding enemies and projectiles.
  • Robust single-player story mode with a giant bullet-heck boss battle at the end of every area.
  • Monkey vs. monkey PvP online multiplayer “Banana Scramble” mode for four to six participants.
  • 22 different stages set in various regions of Japan.
  • Unique “3D pixel art” puts a fresh spin on old-school graphics.

data.name: Remote Realms
data.detailed_description:
Waking up in a tavern of a small town you find yourself in a new world of magic and wonder. Learn from the locals of Immerbury or head out right away to explore Remote Realms? There are many paths to take and a lot of experience to be gained whichever way you decide to go. It's a rough world out there though. It may be a good idea to gear up and a train some  basic survival skills before embarking on a longer journey. But if you are lucky you can get a boat ride from another player to a nearby town or stumble across a shortcut!

Whether it's picking directions, means of transportation, leveling strategy, gear composition or catching creatures, there are always a number of approaches to the matter at hand in Remote Realms. You can buy (buying here means using in-game currency) or train mounts that enable faster travel either on land or in air. You can buy or build ships that let you go further on water than just swimming. (According to rumors there is a certain kind of turtle you can also train for this purpose) Each of the game's 26 skills can be leveled up either at a more relaxed pace or alternatively with a higher efficiency using the game's burst bar mechanic.

The game utilizes a simple to get started with, complex to master combat system that involves mechanics like: ground elevation, damage delivery type and elemental types. Every match up one faces has a lot of room to theory craft about the best in slot gear!

To get most out of your journey it's best to make new friends. Not just with other players but with the creatures inhabiting Remote Realms. You can train and befriend powerful companions that help you with your tasks from serene skilling to vicious combat!

Features:

  • A fully player driven economy. This is achieved with the following design choice: Skilling is the primary and often the sole way of acquiring goods and more refined items in the game. Only very little one can buy from NPC shops and the bosses drop unique items instead of skilling resources. There are also gold removing mechanisms in the game to fight inflation. A notable example is the option to repair your gear pieces to improve the stats they provide you.

  • Interconnected skills and items that stay relevant throughout as players make progress in the game. The game is designed in a way that minimizes 'dead content' by making different skills depend on each other and enabling many niche use cases for items. There is also a strong incentive for players to trade with each other. Higher level players in certain skills are able to make items that sometimes are even more useful to lower level player meanwhile as lower level players are always in demand to provide more resources for the higher level players in exchange. Trading isn't required at any point of the game even though being very useful.

  • Decently sizeable world with many hidden areas to explore.

  • 26 skills to train.

  • 20 quests to complete.

  • 9 town tasks

  • 4 major bosses to defeat.

  • Toggle between click and wasd movement

  • Adjustable graphic options including a retro mode

  • No pay to win

data.name: Yamasen-Chan's Hermit Home Designer+
data.detailed_description:
Yamasen-Chan’s Hermit Home Designer+ is a cozy visual novel and home-design game about helping a socially withdrawn girl build a life inside a series of homes. She has not stepped outside in a long time and is very determined to make her home feel perfect — it’s her whole world after all!

Yamasen-Chan goes on a journey to find the best and most secluded home she can. She talks to you while you decorate her spaces, revealing her personality and worldview. She rambles about her comforts and fears, sometimes getting excited about a new piece of furniture you place down, at other times slipping into philosophical musings about what it means to live in isolation. Yamasen-Chan is charming, awkward, and surprisingly thoughtful.

Your role is simple. Listen to her, decorate her rooms, and help her create a space that feels warm, expressive, and maybe even a little hopeful.

Design Her World

Choose from more than one hundred pieces of furniture, decorations, and cute clutter. Rotate and scale items to create the exact mood you want. Minimalist, maximalist, chaotic, serene, or something in between. Each home has its own personality, and each one reflects Yamasen-Chan’s search for the perfect place to hide away.

 

A Cozy Story With a Heart

Between decorating sessions, you read through a complete visual novel story about isolation, comfort, and the strange logic of building a life inside four walls. The tone is gentle and cute, but it also has moments of dark humor and quiet melancholy. Yamasen-Chan is honest about her worries and fears, but she also finds the humor in them.

 

New in the Remaster

  • All new 4K art

  • Voice acting for Yamasen-Chan

  • Rotate and scale furniture

  • Remastered soundtrack

  • Developer commentary (English only)

  • Localization

  • Achievements

Features:

  • Six unique homes to design

  • Complete visual novel narrative

  • Over one hundred items to design with

  • Original soundtrack

  • Cute anime art

data.name: We Are Showtime!
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO "WE ARE SHOWTIME!"

Can you win the show?
Ever wanted to compete in a real game show? But being a couch potato is just your thing... Don't worry, now you have the possibility to experience a new and exciting game show. All you have to do is put on your VR headset and the fun starts!

Challenge yourself in many thrilling minigames
Fight your way through 30 different minigames in which you must prove all your skills. But that's not all! Once you've mastered the easy mode, two more difficulty levels await you. Still not enough? Tough boss levels will make it even harder for you.

See how far you can get in endless mode
In endless mode you can challenge yourself and test your endurance. Face an unlimited amount of minigames that become faster and faster as you progress. See how far you can get and challenge your friends to beat your score.

Upgrade your backstage room with your hard earned cash
Earn money through playing different game modes and make yourself at home in your backstage room. Transform it from a storage room into a super cozy lounge. Which parts of the room you explore first is up to you.

Challenge your friends
Wanna kick some butts? Dare to play against up to five of your best buddys?
Play alternately in party mode and prove that you are the greatest game show canidate in history.

See you in the next game!

data.detailed_description:

Various gameplay fixes
Minor fixes
Friends invites

About the Game

The Witcher Adventure Game is a digital adaptation of CD PROJEKT RED’s board game set in the brutal fantasy universe of monster slayer Geralt of Rivia. Travel across the beautifully rendered world of The Witcher and complete a variety of quests — hunt deadly beasts, solve ancient mysteries, and more.



Take on the role of one of four distinct characters known from the books and video games: monster slayer Geralt of Rivia; cunning sorceress Triss Merigold; dwarven warrior Yarpen Zigrin; and roguish bard Dandelion. Each character has unique skills and multiple ways of overcoming obstacles — the choice is yours: do you fight your way to victory, call on your charm or try your hand at diplomacy?



Explore a land of mystery and spin your own unique tale each time you play. The Witcher Adventure Game is set in the rich universe created by internationally renowned novelist Andrzej Sapkowski. Whether you’re a long time fan or this is your first contact with The Witcher universe, The Witcher Adventure Game will pull you in with its deep backstory and high replayability.

KEY FEATURES

  • Simple, easy to understand rules, and intuitive gameplay mechanics
  • 4 unique heroes with different skills and approaches to problem solving
  • Over 288 cards to discover and 30 monsters to deal with
  • Art design taken straight from the critically acclaimed Witcher series of video games
  • Different gameplay modes: play against AI or your friends, with options for both online multiplayer and hot seat
  • Achievement and leaderboard support

data.name: Ottoman Dreams: Rise of Süleiman
data.detailed_description:
"Ottoman Dreams: Rise of Süleiman" is a visual novel game where you will witness the rise of the great 16th-century Ottoman Sultan, Suleiman the Magnificent, from his youth. This captivating story takes players deep into history, shedding light on the most glorious periods of the Ottoman Empire.

Players will step into the life of Sultan Suleiman, filled with palace intrigue, battle strategies, and grand conquests, experiencing firsthand how his decisions shaped world history. Thanks to the interactive nature of the game, players will guide Suleiman through various critical decisions, shaping the fate of the empire, and concluding the story in their own unique way through multiple endings.

data.name: Deadly Harvest
data.detailed_description:
Defeat the Pumpkin Invasion!


Deadly Harvest is a casual roguelite survival game with a spooky atmosphere. When your New England farm is overrun by mobs of creepy creatures, it's up to you to drive them back, defend your village, and survive the fight against the legendary Headless Horseman himself. Gain levels to upgrade your weapons, collect gold to power-up your character between attempts, and see if you can uncover the secret to banishing the Horseman back to the underworld for good.



Photosensitivity Warning

This game may contain flashing lights, images, and other luminous stimulations which may induce epileptic seizures in certain individuals. If you or anyone in your household has an epileptic condition, please consult your doctor before playing any game. If you experience dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitches, loss of awareness, disorientation, any involuntary movement, or convulsions while playing, please immediately discontinue playing the game and consult your doctor.

data.name: 江湖求生 Ganghood Survival
data.detailed_description:
《Ganghood Survival》is a game project transformed from mobile to PC. Currently, not all the content in mobile version is quite suitable for the PC one. However, we have planned to gradually improve the art quality to a higher level in PC version. Moreover, the playing methods and content will be constantly increased.

《Ganghood Survival》 is a hardcore competitive action game based on Chinese Wushu theme. At the beginning, dozens of players will be randomly distributed at anywhere in the map, and play as a ‘Knight-errant’ with nothing in every game.

Developing Approach:
At the beginning, players will enter the map by riding a huge eagle owl with nothing. They need to strengthen themselves by collecting resources and learning wushu books. As time goes by, players get less and less safe area in the map. Eventually, only one player could win the game and learn the “Wushu of Wuwang” in order to beat the monster. However, the great winner also sacrifices himself for saving human and the world.

Game features:
1. Highly free playing method: players can freely use several types of weapons, wushu, close combat, long-distance attack, and qing kung (fly).
2. Exciting and fresh game experience: random distribution at anywhere in the map, gives fresh sense to players in every game.
3. Real wushu action in game: professional wushu team, almost all the wushu actions are cached by Optical motion capture system.

Fang Liu, Professional Film and Television Director, Representative Art: 《Kung Fu Warlords 2017》 and《Handsome Siblings》. He is the chief action designer of our game 《Ganghood survival》, leading his processional wushu team and design the excellent wushu action for this game.

data.name: Chronicon Apocalyptica
data.detailed_description:
Battle Norse raiders, ghosts, and changelings to save medieval England! But beware, if the elves can capture the Book you hold, the world will end.

Chronicon Apocalyptica is a 250,000-word interactive medieval fantasy novel by Robert Davis. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

You are an Anglo-Saxon scribe in the year 1000. You hold a Book of secrets written generations ago, including this prophecy: "When Æthelred II is King, he shall not be King, but there shall be an elven changeling in his stead. Should it gain this book and its ink, the world he shall rend asunder."

The witan advisors to Æthelred have tasked you with a secret mission to research whether the Book is true. Build an unlikely party of adventurers: a nun, a holy warrior, a bard, a beekeeper, and his bee, each with a mysterious past. Judge a witch trial, infiltrate the magical land of the elves, and even travel through time on your quest to extract fact from fiction.

Lovers of England's mythic history will delight as you meet Excalibur, the Green Children of Woolpit, and the Tremulous Hand, a creepy disembodied hand with a predilection for parchment. Put your analytical, investigative, and storytelling skills to the test as you decide where your loyalties lie: to the church, the crown, or the people of England.

Will you uncover the secret at the heart of English history, or succumb to the evil of the most deadly book ever created?

  • Play as male, female, or non-binary; gay, straight, bi, or asexual.
  • Discover rare sources, excavate ruins, and collect local legends.
  • Fight the forces of darkness, or outwit them with your sharp intelligence.
  • Explore decaying strongholds, funeral barrows, and even time itself.
  • Choose romance or rivalry with your greatest foe.
  • Determine who sits on the English throne.

data.name: The Amazing Shrinking Giraffe
data.detailed_description:
Your name is Ginger, the amazing shrinking giraffe. The Universe has been overrun by evil serpents. You must kill shrink the serpents and trap them in atoms from whence they came. Your adventure takes you from the size of a galaxy to the size of a leaf cell.

But beware! When the serpents are angered the hunter becomes the hunted!

Explore space in your spaceship, drive around on planets, and get energy from alien creatures and plants.

Ride on the back of giant sand worms, or shrink down and ride on the back of beetles.

Grow to the size of a planet and jump between asteroids.

This is a short experimental type game with an added sandbox component.

The many tales of the vagabond are yours to tell.

data.name: SONG OF HORROR COMPLETE EDITION
data.detailed_description:
The famed writer Sebastian P. Husher has gone missing, along with his entire family. Worried, his editor sent an assistant to his house in order to look for him – but he never came back... These disappearances spark a set of events that will soon reveal something dreadful: a nameless, dark entity known only as The Presence seems to be responsible.



Song of Horror offers a truly dynamic terror experience: its antagonist, the supernatural entity known only as The Presence, is controlled by an advanced AI (Artificial Intelligence) that adapts to your actions and decisions. Experience unbearable fear as this otherworldly being responds to your way of playing and hunts you down in unexpected ways, offering a unique experience to every player and gameplay where tension builds up naturally instead of coming from scripted sequences.



As a player, you will live this story through the eyes of a varied set of characters related to the story in their own way. Every character is different, and brings their unique point of view to the investigation, allowing them to approach clues and items differently. Their actions and decisions will shape the world: some of them will know more or less of certain aspects of the story; some will be more effective against supernatural manifestations, but all of them can die if the Presence gets to them – and death is permanent. If they die, you will have to pick the story up with another one, and continue the investigation so their deaths are not in vain.



A mysterious antique shop, a forgotten abbey, an abandoned mental hospital... Each location in Song of Horror is inspired by the classics of the genre. Explore and investigate these haunted places to gather clues and items that will help you solve challenging puzzles while enduring the agonizing tension of the game's atmosphere.

data.name: Job Simulator: Human Relations
data.detailed_description:
💼 Come play the other side of [JOB]!

Job Simulator: Human Relations is a co-op physics comedy game, where you and up to three of your friends collaborate or compete to survive a chaotic week as employees inside the Museum of JOB. As Bot employees, you’ll be expected to wear multiple hats - literally and figuratively!

Enter a Perfect Simulation of the Human Work Environment

Bots may have replaced all humans in the worksforce, but you and your co-bots can simulate one of humanity’s greatest achievements - [TEAM PROJECTS]! Job together to climb the corporate ladder, meet arbitrary quotas, and earn [PROMOTION], while surviving (or thriving) in increasingly absurd workplace distractions. You can’t spell “dysfunctional” without “fun”!

Inspired by our extensive and 100% not guaranteed accurate research, Job Simulator: Human Relations explores the radiant spectrum of modern employment. Success means wearing multiple hats, juggling endless disparate tasks, and hitting your goals and metrics despite the workplace mayhem. Just remember, we don’t hit our co-workers, unless the boss isn’t looking!

🤝[JOB] Is Better With Friends!

Every day brings a new Company Goal for you and your co-workers to achieve together - remember, there is no “I” in “Job”!

Compete for limited resources, survive constant disorder and interruptions, endure workplace disasters, and overcome every obstacle standing between you and your Goal.

Work together — or don’t — with your friends in a top-down office space, with up to four players total in local or online co-op.

Key Features

  • Play Together: Work together (or don’t) in a top-down shared office space with up to four players, locally or online.

  • Achieve Goal: Do Meaningful Work ™ by completing confusing, repetitive, and unquestionably important office tasks that keep the corporate machine running.

  • Overcome Workplace Challenges: The office itself is your biggest obstacle. Compete for limited resources, survive constant interruptions, endure workplace disasters, and overcome every obstacle standing between you and [Goal].

  • Get Promoted: Climb the Corporate Ladder to unlock new abilities, customizations, and increasingly questionable management responsibilities.

data.name: The Land of Glass
data.detailed_description:
The Land of Glass is a card game with a twist: speed. It's CCG meets action RPG, combining card collecting and deck building with frantic combat. Choose your heroes, build your deck, and save Vitrerran.

A Real-Time Card Game


The Land of Glass is a new kind of card game, one where combat doesn't go back and forth in precise turns but operates in real time. The strategy and synergy of typical CCGs is present; however, you'll need more than that to succeed. The monsters won't wait for you to choose your best cards.

Combat takes place over two ever-changing grids: attack and defense. Punish your foes with big, heavy blows or swift strikes while countering with a steady stream of defense cards. Use magic to infuse your attacks with fire, ice, explosions, and more; lay traps; burn away defenses; and slow your opponents down for some needed breathing room.

Magic is not confined to simply attacking and defending, though. Alter the playing field itself with massive spells, from fields of fire to lightning storms to man-eating plants. There are nine different types of magic to find, and experimenting is key to survival.

A Character-Driven Story


A knight is sent on a quest he cannot complete. A misfit believes he has ended the world. A mage searches for answers. A blacksmith demands revenge.

The portals were supposed to make Vitrerran a better place. They were supposed to save the continent, to unite a divided people. Instead, they brought ruin. Instead, they brought monsters.

The Land of Glass is an RPG with eight protagonists spanning four campaigns. Each character is forced to explore the world for the first time, to confront his biases and misconceptions as he tries to stop a magical plague that threatens to eat the continent. While set against an apocalyptic backdrop, The Land of Glass tells stories that are both personal and small—it is a character study first and an epic fantasy second.

Because not every quest is noble, and not every world is worth saving.

Key Features


  • Four campaigns with eight different characters
  • A unique take on deck-based card games

data.about_the_game:
The Land of Glass is a card game with a twist: speed. It's CCG meets action RPG, combining card collecting and deck building with frantic combat. Choose your heroes, build your deck, and save Vitrerran.

A Real-Time Card Game


The Land of Glass is a new kind of card game, one where combat doesn't go back and forth in precise turns but operates in real time. The strategy and synergy of typical CCGs is present; however, you'll need more than that to succeed. The monsters won't wait for you to choose your best cards.

Combat takes place over two ever-changing grids: attack and defense. Punish your foes with big, heavy blows or swift strikes while countering with a steady stream of defense cards. Use magic to infuse your attacks with fire, ice, explosions, and more; lay traps; burn away defenses; and slow your opponents down for some needed breathing room.

Magic is not confined to simply attacking and defending, though. Alter the playing field itself with massive spells, from fields of fire to lightning storms to man-eating plants. There are nine different types of magic to find, and experimenting is key to survival.

A Character-Driven Story


A knight is sent on a quest he cannot complete. A misfit believes he has ended the world. A mage searches for answers. A blacksmith demands revenge.

The portals were supposed to make Vitrerran a better place. They were supposed to save the continent, to unite a divided people. Instead, they brought ruin. Instead, they brought monsters.

The Land of Glass is an RPG with eight protagonists spanning four campaigns. Each character is forced to explore the world for the first time, to confront his biases and misconceptions as he tries to stop a magical plague that threatens to eat the continent. While set against an apocalyptic backdrop, The Land of Glass tells stories that are both personal and small—it is a character study first and an epic fantasy second.

Because not every quest is noble, and not every world is worth saving.

Key Features


  • Four campaigns with eight different characters
  • A unique take on deck-based card games
  • Character driven story
  • Nine different types of magic
  • Hundreds of cards to collect
  • In-depth crafting system
  • Stained glass art style

data.name: End State
data.detailed_description:
EARLY ACCESS NOTIFICATION

This game is still highly in development, if you want to have the full experience it's better to wait until full release. We hope you will give us feedback during development to help us improve the game.

You can also join us at Discord for feedback at

In END STATE you manage an international mercenary company hired to track down a network of terrorists in a war-torn country where warring rebel groups, criminal organizations and private security forces fight for power.

HIGHLIGHTS


  • REACTION SYSTEM
    Opportunity Fire triggers a reaction test when an enemy walks in to view. All participants in these situations can choose to shoot which often to intense firefights.



  • BALLISTICS SIMULATION
    Each bullet is traced through the scene and react with the environment according to its penetration value and the resistances of walls and objects.

DESCRIPTION


The game features a strategic satellite map where you manage your organization, hire operatives, buy gear and find missions. Explore the Eastern European themed Brekovia, encounter enemy patrols, engage road blocks and make contact with the different factions operating within the country.

When you enter a mission on the map, the game switches to tactical scenario where you control each of your soldiers in turn based tactical battle. There are many viable tactics to each scenario, ranging from stealthy take-downs, coordinated assaults, strategically positioned snipers to explosive entry using C-4. Choose the best approach for each mission.

FEATURES


  • Turn-based tactical combat, with action points and interruptions.
  • Strategic layer where you manage your operatives, skills, equipment, leads and missions.
  • Interactive levels with different types of cover, peeking around corners, climbing through windows.
  • Destructible environments.
  • Bullet penetration, different materials
  • 10+ weapons. Lots of armor, helmets, grenades and other equipment.
  • Character appearance customization.
  • Skills and experience.
  • Stealth with advanced visibility and hearing systems.

data.name: Titty Crush
data.detailed_description:
Match fruits, meet cute anime girls and make things bounce!
Titty Crush is a cheeky Match-3 game packed with juicy combos, silly humor and five lovely girls waiting to be discovered. Go on dates, unlock new outfits and enjoy a lighthearted story full of cheesy dialogue and naughty jokes.

Juicy Matches & Explosive Combos

Matching three is just the beginning! Match four fruits to create a striped fruit, form an L or T shape for a fruit bomb, or match five to unleash a rainbow heart.Combine special fruits for even bigger blasts and watch your combos grow. The better you match, the more the girls bounce. Now that's what we call satisfying gameplay!

Five Girls, Plenty of Outfits

Get to know five lovely anime girls, from the cute girl next door to a feisty tsundere and a playful catgirl. Take them on dates, discover their stories and unlock different outfits along the way.

Gallery & Photo Mode

Want a closer look? Visit the Gallery to admire your unlocked outfits, make the girls jiggle and enjoy a bigger view.
Pick your favorite background in Photo Mode and capture the perfect shot for your Steam screenshot collection. Strictly for scientific purposes, of course. ;)

Climb the Leaderboards

Think you've got the fastest fingers? Prove it in Arcade Mode!
Each girl has her own global Steam leaderboard. Chase new highscores, climb the rankings and see how you compare to players around the world.

Features

  • Easy-to-learn Match-3 gameplay with special fruits and explosive combos
  • Lighthearted story mode with five cute anime girls
  • Dates, silly dialogue and plenty of naughty humor
  • Multiple unlockable outfits for every girl
  • Interactive Gallery with Photo Mode
  • Arcade Mode with global Steam leaderboards
  • Full controller and Steam Deck support
  • Sophisticated Titty Physics
  • Can be played with one hand ;)

Whether you're here for the puzzles, the girls or just a really nice pair of melons, Titty Crush has something for every fruit lover.
Now go make those girls bounce!

data.name: Darkstar One
data.detailed_description:
Darkstar One offers a fantastic amount of freedom of choice. The story-based missions gradually lead you deeper into the galaxy to new races, new technologies and ever stronger opponents. Explore a vast array of solar systems in search of hidden artifacts of ancient races, essential objects for upgrading your ship--the Darkstar One.
In addition to artifacts, acquire credits to purchase better equipment, such as weapons and shields. Earn credits in a myriad of ways: by taking on assignments, bounty hunting, piracy, smuggling, trading, escorting, transporting, rewards and more.
  • A vast, simulated universe with many unique races, space ships and battle tactics.
  • Elaborate story, related by more than fifty minutes of video sequences.
  • Configure and upgrade your ship, Darkstar One, any way you choose--build a fast attack ship with many light weapons or a near-invincible cruiser with heavy weaponry.
  • Over two hundred different weapons, shields and equipment items.
  • Rockets, torpedoes and mines feature special tactical uses: mines can fire at opponents or distract approaching missiles.
  • The "Spell Weapon": a special weapon with a powerful effect similar to certain spells in role-playing games. This weapon becomes increasingly versatile throughout the game and greatly increases tactical options.
  • Acquire weapons from other races - Mount distinctive weapons from other races on "Darkstar One," each featuring unique functions that require different battle tactics.
  • Embark on special missions - explore canyons or even underground on unknown worlds.
  • Freedom of choice - earn credits in many ways: fighting, piracy, assignments, smuggling, trading, escorting, transporting, rewards, and more.
  • Play as the "good" or the "bad" guy and take advantage of political disputes.

data.name: Lappelduvide
data.detailed_description:
Story:


On February 20, 2001, a virus outbreak occurred in a barangay (a Philippine term for a town/suburb/district) in Batangas City, Philippines. Its origin remains a mystery, yet many residents began suffering from sleep disorders, dry throat, fever, and frequent headaches.

Although standard medications alleviated these symptoms, they were unaffordable for some due to their living conditions.

As a result, the virus went untreated in certain cases, leading to violent behavior and self-harm. Reports indicate that affected individuals lacked recollection of these violent acts and are also experiencing visual and auditory schizophrenic episodes.

This is a VHS-style found footage, analog, psychological horror game about the experience of one of the extreme cases of the virus that was left untreated.

Features:

  • VHS Found Footage Aesthetics
  • Photorealistic Graphics
  • Analog Horror Elements
  • Intricate Storyline
  • Immersive Gameplay

data.name: Political Survival - Head of State
data.detailed_description:
Political Survival: The Head of State

Every Decision Shapes Your Nation.

Lead your country through political dilemmas where every choice influences the balance of your nation.

Manage five essential national attributes:

😊 Happiness
💰 Economy
🛡️ Military
📡 Technology
🌱 Environment

Every decision improves some areas while weakening others. Finding the right balance is the key to success.

Compete against rival nations, react to unexpected global events, and deal with political opposition that challenges your decisions. If opposition movements become too powerful, they can organize protests and unrest that reduce your national stability.

No two playthroughs are exactly alike. Hundreds of unique scenarios force you to adapt your strategy and carefully consider every decision.

Will you build the strongest nation?

Features

📰 Make difficult decisions through dynamic newspaper headlines.

⚖️ Balance five core national attributes.

🌍 Compete against rival nations for the highest national score.

🤝 React to global events that affect every nation.

📉 Opposition movements respond to your political decisions.

🎯 Every choice has meaningful consequences.

🔄 Hundreds of unique scenarios with high replayability.

🏆 Keep your nation competitive until the final turn.

Every Decision Matters.

Every headline changes the future.

Every choice shapes your nation.

Can you become the world's strongest state?

📰 Update – New Political Systems

The latest update brings several major new systems to Political Survival.

👥 A Living Public
The public now reacts dynamically to your decisions in the background. These reactions can influence future election results, making public opinion an important part of your presidency.

🗳️ Election System
Elections are now a core part of the game. Your decisions and the public's reactions can determine whether you remain in power.

🦅🕊️ Hawk or Dove?
Your decisions shape your political identity. Will you become a Hawk or a Dove? Your choices affect your position on the political stance meter and unlock unique one-time rewards.

👔 Advisor System
Your advisor helps you understand the potential consequences of your decisions. Before making a choice, the advisor can give you insight into what that decision may cost or affect.

So, Mr. President... are you a 🦅 Hawk or a 🕊️ Dove?

data.name: Serena's Alchemy Life
data.detailed_description:
Serena's Alchemy Life

Five years of alchemy and adventure, beginning in a little workshop.

Serena's Alchemy Life is a single-player fantasy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world, combining alchemy, exploration, character progression, and meaningful bonds with companions.

The protagonist is Serena, a 16-year-old aspiring alchemist.

After inheriting a small alchemy workshop, Serena begins a new chapter of her life alongside Rio, a skilled swordsman, and Luna, a young woman who wields a whip and magic.

Explore mysterious lands, gather materials, and craft a wide variety of items. Battle monsters, strengthen your friendships, and fulfill requests from the townspeople.

How you choose to spend these five years will shape Serena's future.

◆ Five Years, Countless Possibilities

Your adventure takes place over five in-game years.

Each month, you receive a limited number of action points to spend on exploration, alchemy, shopping, and spending time with your companions.

Will you become a master alchemist, earn fame as an adventurer, or focus on the relationships that matter most?

Your decisions and accomplishments will lead to one of 11 different endings.

◆ Craft 169 Types of Items

Alchemy is at the heart of the game.

Combine materials gathered during exploration and loot obtained from monsters to create healing items, offensive items, weapons, armor, accessories, and more.

Basic materials can be purchased from shops, while intermediate ingredients can be produced through the chain-crafting system.

Creating the most powerful equipment may require special materials obtained from rare monsters and powerful bosses.

Gather ingredients, complete recipes, and discover the satisfaction of mastering the art of alchemy.

◆ Explore 50 Areas and Encounter 600 Monster Species

Venture into forests, caves, ancient ruins, mysterious sanctuaries, and other fantasy locations.

There are 50 exploration areas to discover throughout the five-year adventure, with new areas unlocking as time passes and challenges becoming increasingly difficult.

Each area features 12 monster species: 10 normal species, one rare species, and one boss.

During normal encounters, there is a 10% chance of encountering a rare monster.

Fight your way through dungeon floors and defeat the boss waiting at the deepest level to complete each area.

◆ Turn-Based Battles with Three Companions

Serena, Rio, and Luna fight together as a team, each bringing unique strengths to battle.

Serena specializes in alchemy and magic.

Rio excels at sword-based attacks.

Luna uses her whip and magical abilities to support the party.

Use normal attacks, special skills, and crafted items strategically to overcome powerful enemies.

An auto-battle mode is also available, allowing you to independently enable or disable automatic skill and item usage.

Characters can reach a maximum combat level of 222. Equipping ultimate weapons also unlocks powerful special techniques.

◆ Build Bonds and Discover Personal Stories

Life is about more than exploration and combat.

Spend time with Rio and Luna, give them gifts, and deepen your relationships.

As your bonds grow stronger, special story events become available, revealing new sides of your companions.

The friendships you build will make your five-year journey even more memorable.

◆ Earn Money Through Alchemy and Trade

Sell items produced in your workshop or complete guild requests to earn money and increase your reputation.

Use your earnings to purchase materials, experiment with new recipes, and create stronger equipment.

Balance exploration, alchemy, and trading as you develop your own approach to running the workshop.

◆ Collect, Craft, and Unlock Achievements

With 600 monster species and 169 types of craftable items, there are plenty of collection goals to pursue.

Unlock in-game achievements based on the number of different monster species you defeat and the number of different items you successfully craft.

Challenge yourself to defeat all 600 monster species and craft all 169 types of items.

◆ Create Your Own Five-Year Story

Focus on exploring the world, mastering alchemy, earning money through trade, or strengthening your friendships.

Every choice contributes to the story you create.

What future awaits Serena at the end of these five years?

Step into her little workshop and begin your own adventure!

Key Features

  • Five years of life management and 11 different endings

  • 169 types of craftable items and extensive equipment crafting

  • 50 exploration areas and 600 monster species

  • Three-character turn-based combat with optional auto-battle

  • Character progression up to combat level 222

  • Companion relationships and special story events

  • Guild requests, trading, and material collection

  • In-game achievements for monster hunting and crafting

  • Automatic and manual save systems

  • Support for Japanese, English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and French

  • Simple, mouse-focused controls

  • Offline single-player gameplay

data.name: Norman's Night In
data.detailed_description:
Norman’s Night In

A platform adventure game that tells the tale of a shopkeeper, his bowling ball, and a fateful fall into the world of Cave. Use slingshot mechanics to solve physics-based puzzles, face unfamiliar cave beasties, and discover the unseen world by the light of your new bowling ball.

Gameplay & Features

  • A narrative adventure game about exploration and self-discovery as an unlikely adventurer unfolds the forgotten history of a kingdom passed.
  • Slingshot through challenging mechanics-driven platforming.
  • Upgrade your bowling ball to access new and unique abilities.
  • Explore the interconnected world of Cave while uncovering curiosities and forging your path back home.
  • Every level of Norman’s Night In is hand-crafted and hand-painted.

The game was originally made with 2 other programmers in around 2 months and got continued by Babeko for an extended version released on Steam!

  • Level editor with as many features as I could possibly do!

  • Workshop support to publish/download levels from the whole world!

  • Localization in (for now) 2 different languages: English and French!

  • Bananas

  • Customizable color palette for the whole game with infinite possibilities!

  • Bananas

Doesn't include: Kovo :(

Side note: Every Steam capsule of the game is a playable level!

data.name: Painting VR
data.detailed_description:
Painting VR is a realisitic virtual art studio where you can paint whatever you like.

Paint a landscape. Paint your dog. Paint a giant floating banana. Nobody's stopping you.

Mix colours, try different brushes, work from reference images, or start with a blank canvas. There are templates and colouring pages if you'd rather not start from scratch.

The painting feels surprisingly natural. Colours blend together the way you'd expect, brushes behave like brushes, and before long you're focused on what you're making.

Fill your studio with your artwork, customise the space, paint in zero gravity, or switch on rainbow paint when realism starts feeling overrated.

Some paintings take hours. Some take five minutes. Both can go on the wall.

Features

  • Realistic Brushes

  • Paint Mixing

  • Templates & Colouring Pages

  • Import Reference Images

  • Customisable Studio

  • Passthrough Mode

  • Zero Gravity Mode

-... Oh, and we also have Rainbow Paint!

data.name: Spiral Scramble
data.detailed_description:
Get everyone to the center

Spiral Scramble is a co-op obstacle course for one to eight players. Every map is a square spiral, and the way through is the long way around: lane after lane of creatures, traps and hazards between you and the center. One touch and you're down, but you're not out, because any teammate can pick you up by reaching the spot where you fell. If everyone goes down at once, it's back to the start.

Seven stages, each with its own idea

The Magic Forest teaches the basics. In the Cemetery you can only see by your own light, and in the Desert a sandstorm follows you in from the entrance. Lava pools where you wanted to walk, the Lab is full of machinery that runs to a rhythm, the Flying Islands have nothing underneath them, and the Arctic's ice won't let you stop. Play them in order, or jump straight to any of them.

Pick your difficulty

Every stage has Easy, Normal and Hard, and nothing is locked. Each one is a fixed place you can learn, but the danger is rolled fresh on every attempt, so knowing the route is never quite the same as knowing the answer.

Infinite

A new map and a new layout every round, a little harder each time, with three lives shared by the whole group. Your best round goes on a leaderboard, so you can see how far your group got against everyone else's.

Made for voice chat

data.about_the_game:
Get everyone to the center

Spiral Scramble is a co-op obstacle course for one to eight players. Every map is a square spiral, and the way through is the long way around: lane after lane of creatures, traps and hazards between you and the center. One touch and you're down, but you're not out, because any teammate can pick you up by reaching the spot where you fell. If everyone goes down at once, it's back to the start.

Seven stages, each with its own idea

The Magic Forest teaches the basics. In the Cemetery you can only see by your own light, and in the Desert a sandstorm follows you in from the entrance. Lava pools where you wanted to walk, the Lab is full of machinery that runs to a rhythm, the Flying Islands have nothing underneath them, and the Arctic's ice won't let you stop. Play them in order, or jump straight to any of them.

Pick your difficulty

Every stage has Easy, Normal and Hard, and nothing is locked. Each one is a fixed place you can learn, but the danger is rolled fresh on every attempt, so knowing the route is never quite the same as knowing the answer.

data.name: The Phoenix Gene VR
data.detailed_description:
Rewrite the Past. Save the Future. Step into an adrenaline-fueled VR shooter where survival means becoming immortal. Control a blazing phoenix in your hands, and fight alongside Jackie, a genetically enhanced janitor bound to Firestorm by fate. Together, you’ll battle through the collapsing Slipstream multiverse.

A Sci-fi Saga Across Time: Fly from scorched wastelands to dazzling future cities in a race against extinction. Every location is a battlefield - and a piece of the narrative puzzle.

Enemies Everywhere:  Mutants, Scavengers, Leviathans and Drones... relentless foes lurk around every corner. Blast your way through heart-pounding VR combat.

Protect the Innocent: Defend, catch, deliver and save innocents from dangers in... and outside of our reality.

Total Immersion, Total Action: Fly, dodge, and shoot in this physical, action-packed VR shooter ‘shmup that’ll give you an addictive rush.

Strategic Shooting: Toggle between realms to absorb enemy bullets, bend reality to your will.

Power Up or Perish: Collect gold flames to unlock game-changing upgrades: smart bombs, quad fireballs, shields, extended reach, faster regeneration, and flamethrower boosts.

Go Deeper: Immerse yourself in the VR Book Experience of 'The Phoenix Gene: Origins of Darkness' included with the game. Read and listen to the first chapter of the novel in the epic new dystopian sci-fi story, all inside your headset.

Feel the Fight: Move to the upbeat soundtrack by legendary composer Grant Kirkhope. Amplify the immersion with bHaptics TactSuit, TactSleeve and TactVisor to feel every explosion and hit in your bones.

Become a Slipstream Master: Buy The Phoenix Gene now, strap in, and take flight. Perfect for fans of Pistol Whip, Star Fox, Panzer Dragoon, and R-type.

Supports Meta Air/Link and Virtual Desktop (set to VDXR or Automatic) and Steam VR (Open XR). Note that controller offsets will be different per setup, and should be customized in the options for best results.

data.name: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
data.detailed_description:
While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive but properly manage time, space, and energy to achieve the goal.


Early Middle Ages, 9th century, Eastern Europe. The Viking boats are drifting inland, looking for a convenient place for settlement. One of the greatest and the smartest warrior who was the leader of the expedition was Ragnald. Together with his wife as well as travel companions, they were looking for a safe land, rich in water, vegetation, and animals.


He was also accompanied by his faithful friend, Raga the wolf. It was supposed to be a peaceful voyage, but the expedition fell into an ambush set by women from the Kingdom of Women. Ruthless warriors captured women and killed all men. Almost everyone...


With the help of Raga, the wounded Ragnald survived, and with little strength left the wolfhound pulled him to the other side of the river. Just before he fainted, he noticed his beloved Tove among the captives. When he awoke, his faithful wolf was laying next to him, and apart from the voices of nature, there was no sign of the attackers or the captured women.


This is how Ragnald started his adventure into the unknown, through wild, dangerous areas, but also villages and settlements, though not always friendly. Raga's loyal companion will often prove to be a savior, rescuing him from wild animals, or helping in the hunt.


Ragnald and the wolf are facing a difficult path, the fight against the weather, wild forest, animals, fight for food, medicine, fight against hostile tribes... but the main motivation is to regain the loved one.


But once they reach the village of women, it turns out that this is not an ordinary village ... but let's not get ahead of oneself for now.

The most interesting aspects of the game:

  • Sense of direction and discovering the unknown world
  • Hunting beavers, quails, hares, partridges
  • Water crossings, stream fishing
  • Fighting against wild animals... unless running away from them
  • Preparing shelter, safe overnight stay
  • Puzzles, brain teasers and the always helpful friend the wolf
  • Crossing dangerous areas
  • The most dangerous of them all - people
  • Using your dexterity, learning navigation to survive
  • Discovering the secret of the Kingdom of Women

data.name: Byte Bistro
data.detailed_description:
A little café. A clever crew. Your instructions.

Aunt Ada has handed you the keys to her neighborhood café—and a robot waiting for its first instructions. In Byte Bistro, you turn that modest beginning into a working kitchen, one recipe, one routine, and one satisfied guest at a time.

This single-player café-management and automation game pairs warm pixel art with a very practical question: can you teach your little crew to handle the next rush?

Build the program. Watch dinner happen.

Your robots follow the programs you create. Arrange actions to gather ingredients, cook, plate, serve, and clean. Start with a simple sequence, then expand your toolkit with conditions, loops, variables, and reusable functions as you progress.

Give different robots different jobs, test your logic, and refine the routine when an empty shelf or a busy station interrupts the plan. Up to four programmable robots share one kitchen, so coordination matters as much as speed.

Run the café your way.

Choose the menu, set prices, order supplies, and invest your earnings in equipment and upgrades. Unlock 30 recipes using 25 ingredients across a 24-service campaign. Keep an eye on waiting guests, clean tables, and shared cooking stations as your café grows.

Want to lend a hand? Step into recipe-specific cooking and table-cleaning minigames while your robots handle their own instructions.

Keep the kitchen humming.

Continue in endless mode after the campaign, or switch to Desktop Companion for a compact café window. Your real robot programs keep serving guests, using ingredients, and earning money while the game remains open. Companion service does not advance campaign days.

  • Visual programming that grows from simple actions to reusable routines.

  • Up to four robots, one shared café, and plenty of ways to divide the work.

  • Menu planning, stock management, equipment upgrades, and hands-on minigames.

  • Warm pixel-art surroundings and an original soundtrack.

  • English, Spanish, French, and Simplified Chinese language options.

data.name: 911: Cannibal
data.detailed_description:
💀 911: Cannibal – A terrifying first-person horror game of hide and seek, puzzles, and survival.

You've been kidnapped by a maniac. Not just any maniac… a cannibal 🍽️ who hunts people and plays games with his victims. Trapped in his eerie house 🏚️ in the middle of nowhere, your only hope is to stay quiet, stay smart, and find a way out before dinner is served—and you’re the main course.

🕵️ Explore the house, find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and piece together the twisted story of Minnesota’s most feared killer. But be careful: the cannibal is always listening, always hunting. Make one wrong move, leave behind one clue—and your nightmare might end in his kitchen.

🔍 Features:

★ A branching detective story filled with mystery and fear

★ First-person survival gameplay with intense stealth mechanics

★ Atmospheric sound design and detailed environments

★ Collect notes to uncover the maniac's twisted past 🔓

★ Hide and seek horror – stay quiet or be hunted

Will you survive the horror, or will you become part of the story?

data.name: The Rookery
data.detailed_description:
The Rookery offers all the army-building challenges and explosive potential of classic roguelikes with the timeless fun of chess. Your army will start meager but you will be offered many upgrades - will you go for a pawn-centric build, or try to get as many queens as possible? Will you go for the greedy options, preparing to destroy the final boss as long as you can sneak through the first act with some timely potions?

We have a very wide range of difficulty—the game can be played and won by someone who has never played chess before, while simultaneously posing a brutal challenge for accredited international masters!

Features

Each run, craft an army - collect pieces, boosts, relics and consumables to prepare for your next fight!

Each run is different. As you complete runs, you'll unlock harder levels and crazier items!

Synergize all your upgrades together to destroy even the toughest bosses!

10 different bosses with powerful, unique abilities!

5 different starting relics, leading to a wide variety of play experiences!

Over a hundred unique items and buffs!

40 different difficulty levels, backed by a tough AI that will not hesitate to exploit your weaknesses!

data.name: The Ghost Ship
data.detailed_description:
After a rise of missing person cases presents itself in a small quaint town, you must prepare to figure out why.
Many people have mentioned a feeling of fear sweeping over them while in the town, eventually leading to their loss of sanity.
You are an investigator, tasked with finding the cause for Hollow Points high missing persons rate You travel alone through the town finding hidden clues, and after conversing with the few residents who are left and avoiding the specter's that haunt the town, you must travel to a ghostly ship and attempt to put an end to the misery that Hollow Point has become consumed by.
Spare batteries, Anti-hallucinogenic drugs and bandages can be found around each location, these items will stop you from becoming another statistic in this intense, story driven horror.

Will you be able to uncover Hollow Point's mysteries' and bring closure to it's residence? Or will you succumb to insanity?

data.name: Cyber Tunnel Escape
data.detailed_description:
Immersive 6 degree of freedom 1000kmh+ high speed flying experience




Tunnel: Over 2000 different possible styles

The tunnel is procedural random generated from many possible different styled units, forming huge amount of potential combinations, giving new experience and mood each play!


Supports PC & Meta Quest 2 VR

Minimal discomfort with control mechanism of “steering by tilting your body”:
Tilt L/R to steer L/R, Tilt backward to steer up, Tilt forward to steer down.
You can even feel the gravity when you steer up and down!


Gameplay

You will be driving through an infinitely long sci-fi tunnel as fast as possible to try to escape from a plasma blast chasing behind you. Collect energy spheres for life-saving speed boosts. Survive as long as you can!
The background music's pace is linked to the speed of the spacecraft, to maximize your speed induced excitement!

data.name: NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange
data.detailed_description:
NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange is an atmospheric anime jigsaw puzzle game that combines Halloween-inspired cyberpunk aesthetics, captivating anime girls, and vibrant orange neon art. Assemble beautiful illustrations, connect puzzle pieces, and immerse yourself in a futuristic world of glowing lights, mysterious characters, and spooky Halloween-inspired imagery.

Step into a mesmerizing neon cyberpunk world where futuristic technology meets the mysterious charm of Halloween. Explore striking anime illustrations filled with luminous orange lights, atmospheric shadows, stylish characters, and sci-fi details. Every puzzle reveals another glimpse into this colorful digital universe.

Drag and arrange jigsaw pieces, match colors and contours, and carefully restore detailed illustrations. Pay attention to glowing neon patterns, subtle color transitions, and intricate visual elements as each correctly placed piece brings the complete image closer to life. Every completed puzzle unlocks a new illustration, gradually expanding your personal gallery of Halloween-inspired anime artwork.

With 50 levels and a variety of puzzle piece shapes and layouts, NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange offers an enjoyable combination of classic jigsaw gameplay, visual challenges, and relaxing entertainment. Each new picture invites you to explore another futuristic scene while exercising your concentration, visual perception, and attention to detail.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, relaxing anime jigsaw puzzles, atmospheric cyberpunk games, or spooky Halloween aesthetics, NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange invites you to unwind and explore a futuristic neon world at your own pace. Discover captivating anime girls, assemble colorful illustrations, and enjoy the satisfaction of completing every picture.

With its distinctive orange neon aesthetic, vibrant 2D anime visuals, soothing electronic soundtrack, and intuitive mouse controls, NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange delivers a relaxing single-player puzzle experience. Perfect for anime enthusiasts, jigsaw puzzle lovers, and players who appreciate beautiful sci-fi artwork with a touch of Halloween mystery.

Key Features

  • 50 jigsaw puzzle levels – Assemble detailed anime illustrations and unlock beautiful artwork as you progress.

  • Captivating anime girls – Discover stylish characters surrounded by futuristic technology and mysterious Halloween-inspired aesthetics.

  • Halloween cyberpunk atmosphere – Explore a striking visual world combining spooky motifs, glowing orange neon lights, and futuristic sci-fi imagery.

  • Classic jigsaw puzzle gameplay – Drag, arrange, and connect puzzle pieces to restore colorful illustrations.

  • Various puzzle shapes and layouts – Enjoy different piece designs that bring variety to traditional picture puzzles.

  • Unlockable artwork gallery – Complete puzzles to reveal and collect vibrant anime cyberpunk illustrations.

  • Relaxing electronic music – Immerse yourself in a soothing soundtrack that complements the futuristic atmosphere.

  • Colorful 2D anime art – Enjoy detailed illustrations featuring vivid neon colors, atmospheric lighting, and Halloween-inspired visual elements.

  • Simple, intuitive mouse controls – Assemble puzzles comfortably with straightforward mouse-based gameplay.

  • Visual puzzle challenges – Exercise your concentration, observation skills, and attention to detail.

  • Steam Achievements – Complete puzzles and unlock achievements throughout your journey.

  • Steam Cloud support – Keep your game progress synchronized across supported devices.

  • Relaxing single-player experience – Solve jigsaw puzzles at your own pace and enjoy the atmospheric neon world.

Assemble. Discover. Relax. Embrace the mysterious neon world of NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange!

data.name: Mosaics Galore. Glorious Journey

-Unusual fantasy setting.
-More than 10 hours of gameplay with beautiful calming and cheerful music
-Entertaining gameplay for players of all ages
-Use bonuses and earn new ranks

data.name: Minigame Game
data.detailed_description:
Minigame Game is a first-person focused minigame collection that supports anywhere from 2-16 players. Grab your weapons and enter the "Minigame Game" arcade!

Test your skills!

Shoot, bunnyhop, swing, and dance your way to victory in a variety of minigames designed to put your classic FPS skills to the test. Featuring 35+ minigames that will pit you with and against your friends.

Get the high score!

Whoever has the most points at the end of each minigame playlist is crowned the winner of the arcade. Your score and achievements are tracked to unlock cosmetics that you can show off with the Arcade Pass!

Level up!

As you level up you’ll be able to choose from an ever-increasing selection of minigames. From fist fights and rocket jumping to shooting glass floors and swinging through space, there’s a minigame for everyone!

Play For Free!

Join your friends and others online at any time! Whether on the official Minigame Game servers or in a custom lobby, join others in the chaos that is Minigame Game for free!

data.name: Get Out
data.detailed_description:
Get Out is a 1-4 player online co-op psychological horror. Complete tasks and puzzles to banish the entities that have you and your team trapped, and make sure to get out, before they get you.



DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES?

  • Online Co-Op
    Play with up to 4 friends and you all must work together to unlock the clues and complete the puzzles.
  • Replayability
    In Get Out, each playthrough is different, with random spawns ensuring you have a different experience every time.
  • Interesting Puzzles
    Each puzzle flows perfectly into the next one, using not only written clues but also the environment to your advantage.



  • Player Progression
    Completing tasks/puzzles earns you XP, which can be put towards unlocking perks and cosmetics.
  • Increasing Difficulty
    As you progress through the game, the entities get more and more aggressive, increasing not only their speed but also their capabilities.
  • Proximity Chat
    As you progress through the game, the entities get more and more aggressive, increasing not only their speed but also their capabilities.
  • Defeating The Entities
    Not only is your goal to escape, but you will also be able to eradicate the entities that possess wherever you get trapped.
  • Immersive Gameplay
    Get Out is powered by Unreal Engine 5 ensuring the highest quality graphics for the most immersive horror experience possible.


  • Modding Support
    The first update we plan on adding to Get Out we hope to include modding support, as we believe this is a key feature to not only involving the community, but keeping the game alive.
  • VR Support
    After we've included modding, we plan to shift our focus towards VR support for all VR headsets, as we know this will bring another level of immersion to Get Out.

data.name: Rolic
data.detailed_description:
• EXPLORE A MAGICAL, TWISTING WORLD
    Rolic is a chill 3D puzzle platformer set in the heart of a mystical, vibrant forest. Scurry around, climb over, and run completely upside-down along massive tree branches as you search for hidden treasures. 

    Uncover Secrets:
    The forest is a meandering maze where the best rewards are hidden deep within the woods. You will need a sharp eye and a clever wit to find them all!

    Mind-Bending Movement:
    Wrap your way through the world with an entirely new sense of freedom.

  • GET CRACKING!
    Finding hidden enchanted nuts is only the first step—you need to open them up to claim the treasures inside! Use your wizardry to crack them open, earning powerful rewards and unlocking fun new character customizations to personalize your journey.

  • RESTORE THE BALANCE OF NATURE 
    Meet a cast of quirky, charming characters who need your unique puzzle-solving skills. From helping local forest spirits to repairing a literal broken toy for the Moon herself, your journey will take you through stunning day-and-night cycles to bring harmony back to the land.

data.detailed_description:
