Story:

"The witch... took her."

To rescue the kidnapped girl, the bear embarks on a solo journey, delving into the depths of the witch's tower.

Game Overview:

Rotate the panels to forge a path and lead the bear to the girl.

Move the cursor forward, backward, left, right, and up or down to select and rotate panels, creating paths for the bear.

The bear's stamina decreases over time, and when it reaches zero, it's game over.

Stamina can be restored by touching orbs scattered throughout the tower, allowing the bear to explore further.

The tower to be explored is wide, tall, and consists of stages with a sense of volume.

With adjustable difficulty settings, you can enjoy puzzle action suited to your skill level.

Key Operations:

[Open Menu]

  • Keyboard … Tab key

  • Gamepad … Menu button, View button, Y button

[Move Cursor Horizontally]

  • Keyboard … WASD keys

  • Gamepad … D-pad, Left stick

[Move Cursor Vertically (Change Floor Level)]

  • Keyboard … Up/Down arrow keys, Numpad keys 5 and 2

  • Gamepad … RB, LB buttons, Right stick (up/down)

[Rotate Panel]

  • Keyboard … Space key, Enter key

  • Gamepad … A button

[Rotate Camera]

  • Keyboard … Left/Right arrow keys, Numpad keys 1 and 3

  • Gamepad … LT, RT buttons, Right stick (left/right)

[Dash]

  • Keyboard … Ctrl key, Numpad key 0

  • Gamepad … X button

[Charge Attack During Combat]

  • Keyboard … Space key, Enter key

  • Gamepad … A button

[Progress Story]

  • Keyboard … Space key, Enter key

  • Gamepad … A button

[Skip Story]

  • Keyboard … ESC key, Ctrl key, Tab key, Numpad key 0

  • Gamepad … B button, Menu button, View button, X button, Y button

[Menu-Related Cursor Navigation]

  • Keyboard … WASD keys, Arrow keys

  • Gamepad … D-pad, Left stick

[Menu-Related Confirm]

  • Keyboard … Space key, Enter key

  • Gamepad … A button

[Menu-Related Cancel]

  • Keyboard … ESC key

  • Gamepad … B button

Gameplay Details:

Cursor Movement: Use the WASD keys or D-pad to move the yellow cursor up, down, left, and right.

To rotate the panel under the cursor, press the Space key, Enter key, or A button, which will turn it 90 degrees counterclockwise.

Rotate the panels to create a path and guide the bear deeper into the tower.

However, some panels cannot be rotated, so please judge by their appearance.

Also, if you hold down the rotation key after rotating a panel, you can continue to rotate it as long as the key is held down.

Vertical Cursor Movement: The room has level differences equivalent to the height of one floor.

The panel to be rotated is directly beneath the cursor, so to select a panel positioned above the cursor, you need to raise the cursor's position.

You can raise the cursor with the up arrow key, numeric keypad 5, or the RB button, and lower it with the down arrow key, numeric keypad 2, or the LB button.

Raising the cursor's position not only changes the selected floor, but also allows you to have a broader view inside the room.

By the way, even when walking on a sloped panel, the time it takes to traverse is the same as walking on a flat panel.

Camera Control: In some places, it may be difficult to see the bear's position.

In such cases, it's good to rotate the camera.

You can rotate the camera using the left and right arrow keys, numeric keypad 1 and 3 keys, or the LT and RT buttons.

You can check which direction the camera is facing using the compass display in the bottom right of the screen.

Stamina and Orbs: In the center of the upper part of the screen, there is a red bar that represents the bear's stamina.

The bear's stamina constantly decreases over time while moving.

If the stamina runs out, it's game over.

If you stop at the edge of a panel with no path ahead, stamina decreases at twice the normal rate.

Always keep an eye on your stamina and try to advance the bear on the shortest route without stopping.

Whether the stamina is currently decreasing is shown in real-time on the icon at the top left of the screen.

The rate of decrease is also displayed on this icon.

This icon allows you to check whether the bear is stopping even when it's off-screen and not visible.

Touching a Orb before the stamina runs out will fully restore it.

Therefore, you will progress the bear through the tower by passing through Orbs scattered throughout.

You can also save at Orbs, so it's good to save first when you reach a Orb.

Leave the Orb: When leaving the Orb, you can choose the direction to proceed.

Use the WASD keys or the D-pad to select a direction, and confirm with the Space key, Enter key, or A button.

Surrender: If you lead the bear to a dead end, choose to surrender from the menu.

If you have touched a Orb before, you can restart from the last Orb you touched.

You can access the menu by pressing the Tab key or the menu button.

Combat: When you come into contact with an enemy, you will enter combat.

Each time you are hit by an enemy attack, your stamina decreases significantly, so you need to defeat the enemy as quickly as possible.

To attack with the bear, hold down the Space key, Enter key, or A button to charge power, and release it at the desired moment.

The more power you charge, the more damage you deal in a single hit.

However, if you miss the timing, you will inflict less damage than expected.

During combat, the enemy's stamina bar is displayed below your own.

At the same time, a gauge showing the damage you can deal with the charged power is displayed above the bar.

Use this to time your attacks.

Also, power can be charged up to 8 levels. Charging beyond this level will not increase the power beyond the 8th level.

Dashing: Press the Ctrl key, numeric keypad 0, or the X button to make the bear dash, doubling its movement speed.

It's good to dash when you have mostly created the path.

Pressing the key again returns the bear to normal speed.

When dashing, the bear's stamina also depletes at twice the normal rate.

This means the distance you can travel with the same stamina is the same as when moving at normal speed.

However, if you stop at the edge of a panel while dashing, stamina depletes at four times the normal rate.

It's better not to dash recklessly when the path is not yet made.

Note that dashing only affects movement.

Entering combat while dashing will not change anything compared to entering combat at normal speed.

Menu and Tower Map: You can view the tower's map from the menu.

You can access the menu by pressing the Tab key or the menu button.

By carefully examining the tower's map, you can figure out the route to the next Orb or destination.

If you're unsure of which direction to go, it's a good idea to check the tower's map.

Also, when touching a Orb, you can move the bear to any previously touched Orb using the tower's map.

If you realize you've missed something, it's convenient to move to the Orb closest to your destination from the tower's map screen.

Bear's Abilities: You can adjust the bear's power when touching the Orb.

If you find yourself unable to proceed, it's best to unlock the latent abilities first.

Unlocking latent abilities will increase both attack power and movement speed.

Increased attack power means more damage to enemies during combat, and increased speed allows you to travel farther with the same amount of stamina.

You can check where to unlock latent abilities on the tower map.

Retry from Entrances: You can go to adjacent rooms from the entrance.

When you switch rooms, the panels in the previous room return to their initial rotation state, and enemies respawn.

Furthermore, after leaving the Orb, the first time you reach an entrance, you will be able to restart from the room's entrance in case of a game over or surrender.

If you find it difficult to navigate the bear in a room and lose more stamina than expected, it may be better to surrender before moving to the next room and restart from that room's entrance.

However, please note that the number of restarts from the room's entrance is limited, unlike restarting from the Orb.

The number of restarts can be reset by touching a Orb.

Difficulty Settings: If you find the game very difficult or get stuck and can't progress after multiple attempts, try changing the bear's stamina to 'High' from the menu settings.

Increasing the stamina can help cover for some operational errors.

Normally, you can progress through the game with the usual amount of stamina, so it's recommended to temporarily change the setting only when you absolutely can't move forward.

Also, if you're confident in your skills, choosing 'Limited' will make the difficulty more challenging.

data.name: Claustrophobia: The Downward Struggle
data.detailed_description:
Grab your weapon of choice, polish your Rogue senses, and get ready to be thrown into the dark and oppressing dungeons of Claustrophobia! Experience deep character development, fast-paced tactical combat, and mountains of epic loot. Here begins a roguelike quest for glory, slaughter, and anything shiny!

Claustrophobia: The Downward Struggle is a Tactical RPG Roguelike, most heavily inspired by the combination of procedural gear and enemy generation found in games such as Diablo and Torchlight, with traditional Roguelike features found in games such as NetHack and Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup. Gameplay revolves around a classless, stat and gear-based progression system, procedural dungeon exploration, and unforgiving tactical combat.

Current Features

data.name: Forwards
data.detailed_description:
Suggestion Of How to Play This:

As the designer behind this, I suggest playing this alone where you can take your time and experience this.

I'm hoping this adds a bit of positivity and brightness into your life.

This is intended for "First Person Shooter" players who use WASD controls... kind of... you'll see.

  • ---------------------------------------------------------------

Controls:

The gameplay for PC players is looking around with the mouse and moving with the WASD keys, kind of.

Players can use a controller, just use the joysticks for movement and looking around. There are Haptics for the controller

  • ---------------------------------------------------------------

Game Intent:

As you move through the game, you'll "Discover" things and through that discovery, I hope to take you on a journey of looking inside your life.

"Forwards" is an expression of my personal journey as a designer.

  • ---------------------------------------------------------------

Playtime: Approximately 1 Min

Average playtime is about a minute with the game instantly starting and immediately closing when it's over. There is no menu.

  • ---------------------------------------------------------------

Note On Playthrough:

Some people have gotten stuck and taken longer and some people have gone through missing parts of it. I took the consideration of making the game easier to playthrough at the potential cost of players going through it the wrong way. Still, I hope the majority of players are able to experience the fullness of this game.

  • ---------------------------------------------------------------

Reminder:

This is an prototype for an experiential linear narrative walking sim.

  • ---------------------------------------------------------------

Spoilers and Inspiration:

The Backwards level in The Beginner's Guide. I altered the level, the narrative, the controls, lighting and audio, that I hope, tells it's own story and differentiates it from that level.

The environment feeling is suppose to be that of the The Stanley Parable which is the same developer as The Beginner's Guide

data.name: God Simulator
data.detailed_description:
God Simulator is an Economic Strategy-Simulation Game, putting you in charge of, well, the entire world!

Become an omnipotent observer in this holyrious adventure and decide the fate of all those who inhabit the world, through a powerful control panel that receives everyone’s prayers. What kind of God will you become - will you hear their pleas and pilot this planet to a paramount of peacefulness or will you take a step back, letting Earth erode into ultimate chaos?

You’re the one playing God so, the choice is yours!

How would Earth look if You Were in Charge?


Decide whether to help individuals and communities, choose who to reward and punish, and ponder who to let off the hook! Will you let an overworked employee get away with drunk driving? Will you help a starving village by gifting them fresh new resources? Will the world’s faith in you grow or vanish?

Millions of Notifications!


With so many prayers hitting your DMs from across the globe, who do you choose to help? Learn more about the hard-working people and tribes, and deranged individuals begging for forgiveness, as civilizations from all walks of life will look up to you for help.

This is Crowd Control to Major God


Keep up-to-date with the latest prayers from around the world through Region Preview, track your prayer progress with Situation Overview, and pay attention to the charts and graphs as they indicate your Godly Gratitude (if you get any!).

White Robes or Spiky Horns?


Choose from a range of unique character models, or mix and match to create your own Stylistic God - from Egyptian and Greek mythology to the more traditional white-robes style. Hell, did someone say Satan?!

data.name: Killing Zombies
data.detailed_description:
Killing Zombies is stunning in its depiction of a teetering land on the verge of collapse. Surrounded by darkness, and a slowly shuffling undead creatures coming in from all angles. Killing Zombies is a 4 player online co-op horror survival shooter for the HTC Vive, with wave-driven VR gameplay from Front Range Software. In a battle of survival, you must struggle to destroy all kinds of horrified zombies, discover the source and course of their creation and stop them from unleashing havoc and destruction to the land and end the threat. As the resistant soldier, you have been assigned to do one thing – kill them all.

While given the role to shoot and destroy, there are 30 varieties of weapons to choose from in your arsenal. As a resistant shooter, you'll gain points as you survive the terrifying waves of zombies coming from all direction, but the choices given to you is totally open. Not doing enough damage in the shootout? You can change your weapon to remedy that. As you use your tactics to advance in an ever difficult stage, you'll discover how to make adjustments and tricks in order to work your way in the most beneficial way.

What else should you be playing?

KEY FEATURES:

  • Unrelenting Graveyard
    There is no taking cover or stopping as you destroy Hell’s raging zombie waves and advanced to a more difficult stage to shoot, slash, and destroy apart zombies in more vengeful and violent ways.
  • Online Co-Op
    Survive the zombie masses with your friends online for even harder challenges.
  • Fast-Paced Combat
    More and more zombies pile up as the game goes on.
  • Room Scale Vive
    The games precision environment scale is an extremely accurate scale that combines versatile functionality with a horrific appeal.
  • 30 Weapons
    Pistols, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles, Sub-machine Guns, & Assault Rifles

data.name: Split Echo: Demo
data.detailed_description:
Note: This is a shortened version of our upcoming game Split Echo. If you enjoy this game, consider adding Split Echo to your steam wishlist! Split Echo is a Co-op only game, two players require their own copy of the game. The game also relies on communicating with each other.

Step into an experience designed to challenge you and your partner. Progress only happens when both players actively use their brains together. The puzzles evolve from deceptively simple to deeply complex, demanding real teamwork. Expect moments of clarity, moments of chaos, and the occasional urge to blame your partner’s communication skills.

Unique path: You and your partner can choose between two distinct paths, each offering a different perspective. Combine your thinking and communicate effectively to progress through the puzzles.

Items: Look for clues in everything you see. What seems insignificant might be the key to your puzzle.

Send Items: you and your partner can send items to each other. This can be important to solving a puzzle, or simply to send them a gift.

Solve Puzzles: Puzzles will require good communication between you and your partner. Puzzles will start simple and get more complex as you progress through the game.

data.name: 懒人也江湖
data.detailed_description:
• 1，挂机放置，老板键
游戏的主要模式为放置挂机。和一般的游戏体验不同，无需时刻游戏。在你闲暇时，来打打BOSS，参悟一下武学，做做师门任务。游戏内置了老板键。



  • 2，江湖与收集
有少林、武当、昆仑、焚天等等，共十五个门派。每个门派都有自己的门派武学和镇派绝学，玩家可以通过无数次传承来收集，最终打造出包罗万象的藏经阁，以挑战江湖之巅。



  • 3，师门任务
要想获得门派的武学，唯一的途经就是做师门任务。领取师门任务后，会到一个随机的文字江湖中。
任务包括了：追杀，救助同门和狡兔三窟，三种模式。



  • 4，肉鸽模式
玩家在通关放置挂机第五关后，可以开启肉鸽模式。
无需挂机来提升武学等级，但是在师门任务、挑战BOSS时，会比较容易死亡和传承。传承后，又是一场新的挑战。



  • 5，江湖客栈
每一个地点挑战BOSS后，该BOSS会留在江湖客栈，选择合适的队友是挑战成功的一大助力。

data.name: Bunny Madness Anarchy
data.detailed_description:
Bunny Madness Anarchy is a fast-paced, competitive third person shooter. Build a team based on unique characters in order to crush your enemies. Face against each other in the intense Natural Selection mode, join forces to defeat waves of feral enemies, enraged by indoctrination in the Infected Madness Mode, dominate your competition by capturing points in Hostile Takeover, or bring back enemy supplies to your base in Supply Run. Over stunning environment, unique level design and original soundtrack you and your friends will immerse yourselves into a war-torn civilization of bipedal animals where the madness has taken over.

Features:


-Game Modes
-Each game mode includes local and online capabilities.
Infected Madness: Play against waves of Feral enemies. Battle solo or connect with up to 3 friends to help you survive the madness.
Natural Selection: Up to eight (8) players can enjoy this mode. Team composition is key to crush the opposing team.
Hostile Takeover: Capture three (3) different points around the map and dominate your opponents.
Supply Run: Infiltrate the enemy base to gather supplies and bring them back to your base.

-Characters
-Malice - is quick and a little mad. He eliminates his enemies with dual pistols which he compliments with a sonar pulse, so not one them may be spared.
-Ramree - his shotgun packs a punch and when combined with his stun grenade it is a deadly pair.
-Magnus -strong and focused he will annihilate you with his machine gun, flash grenade combination.
-Lucky - he will scope you out with his sniper rifle or blow you up with his landmine, there's no hiding from him.
-Alan - a veteran soldier with enough experience to eliminate any enemy with his assault rifle and grenade.

Each character has a species based combat mechanic. Unique stats based on damage, speed and health recovery, depending on the which character is chosen.

-Stages
All stages are playable in all game modes:
-The TSB Factory
-Training Station
-Alternate Reality
-Burrow City Hall
-Snow Wasteland
-Sequoia Forest Dam
-Downtown

-Original Soundtrack and SFX
A fusion of live instruments and digital effects make for a unique and highly engaging soundtrack.

Character and weapon skins unlocked by level progression.

data.name: 家有汉服 之 我想开个汉服店 \There are Hanfu at home
data.detailed_description:
This is a story-driven simulation game that allows players to experience mainstream Hanfu styles while playing. We hope this game will be an opportunity for players to learn about and develop a love for Hanfu. Please add us to your wishlist and support us. Thank you!

Follow us:

Bilibili Channel: Shen Yi Hua
QQ Group: 832613494

——————————————————————————————————

If you want to learn about Hanfu styles, this game is a great choice.

If you’ve been single for a long time and want to experience romance, whether you choose a boy or a girl, you can enter the Hanfu marriage hall.

If you want to open a Hanfu shop, this game will undoubtedly be your vanguard.

If you want to experience entrepreneurship, this game will provide you with a unique experience.

We hope this game becomes a chance for you to understand and appreciate Hanfu.

Game Features:

★ Learn about Hanfu styles: In this game, players will discover many Hanfu styles and experience the process of making a piece of Hanfu.

★ A taste of romance: Players can pursue male or female characters in the game. Once affection reaches a certain level, the hand-holding mode can be unlocked, allowing you to date, dine, and play with your favorite character.

★ Learn about Hanfu styles: In this game, players will discover many Hanfu styles and experience the process of making a piece of Hanfu.

★ Simple entrepreneurship: Say goodbye to complicated business simulation games. This game allows you to experience the sense of achievement in opening a Hanfu store.

★ Escape room scenarios: In real life, escape rooms might have many taboos, but in this game, you can explore boldly without spending too much money.

★ Interesting Hanfu stories: Sad or joyful Hanfu stories await your discovery.

★ Cute-style graphics: Original characters, animations, and scene designs.

————————————————————————————————————————

"With beautiful clothing, it is called ‘Hua’ (flourish),
With great etiquette, it is called ‘Xia’ (summer)."

The game is set against the background of the current Hanfu movement. Starting with managing a Hanfu shop, you will learn about various Hanfu styles, meet your favorite characters, and even hold a Hanfu wedding (whether you are male or female), entering the hall of love.

data.name: Touhou a Mermaid's Reverie
data.detailed_description:
Wakasagihime is a usually withdrawn freshwater mermaid who enjoys collecting rocks and singing songs.

Under the influence of the hidden treasure, the Miracle Mallet, she became aggressive and attacked any passers-by. She was quickly subdued and the incident was resolved. This, however, gave her a taste for a life she had otherwise not sought after and motivated her to be more outgoing and break out of her shell.

This is a puzzle exploration adventure game set in the depths of Misty Lake in Gensokyo.

  • Help the grassroots network youkai and any other Touhou characters in any way you can!!

  • Collectible rocks, minerals and gemstones

  • Explore the hidden depths of Misty Lake

  • Unique abilities that are unlocked throughout the game

  • Puzzles based around said abilities

  • Atmospheric underwater environments

  • Various aquatic life to admire

data.name: 2076 - Midway Multiverse
data.detailed_description:
THE ULTIMATE SPACE COMBAT SIMULATION

Paying homage to classic side-scrolling shooters, “2076: Midway Multiverse” offers the ultimate space combat simulation experience. Take command of your starship and fight waves of enemies that will -literally- attack you from every possible angle. Get the most out of your Virtual Reality device and explore the remotest sites of the multiverse as you try to free the galaxy from the tyranny of the Nazi Galactic Empire.


THE STORY

After the events that took place in "1976: Back to Midway", we find ourselves trapped in the year 2021 along with Dr. Ivanovich inside the Quantum Simulator. When it seems that we’re condemned to spend the rest of our days there, Dr. Novichiva -an alternative version of Dr. Ivanovich- shows up through a space-time breach, holding us responsible for the greatest threat the multiverse has ever faced.

Our constant back and forth through space-time has altered the infinite parallel realities, whose very existence we ignored. As a consequence, in a high percentage of these multiverses, Hitler not only won World War II, but has ended up expanding his power to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. The allied resistance in universe C-139, commanded by dr. Novichiva, has managed to eliminate thousands of versions of Hitler in their respective multiverses, but some of them are still on the warpath.

FEATURES

  • 13 story-mode levels filled with humor.
  • Manipulate the environment: Hit, grab, move, shoot, ... Everything is possible in the multiverse.
  • 3 levels of difficulty: To satisfy the most casual player as well as those looking for a real challenge.
  • 18 immersion zones.
  • 100 missions.
  • More than 200 aircraft upgrades.
  • Tons of action; enjoy infinite retries.
  • Compatible with Vive, Oculus, and WMR.
  • Compatible with motion simulators.

Dr. Novichiva needs our help. The entire multiverse needs our help. Will you be able to defeat the Nazis once again and restore peace to the infinite quantum realities? There’s only one way to find out...

data.name: Unexpected End
data.detailed_description:
Unexpected End tells a story of suspense within the room escape genre. You must follow a series of clues to discover, using your instincts, what lies beneath the skin of the enigmatic protagonist.

Your objective? Solve the mystery by putting yourself in the characters shoes and uncover the end of your adventure

Story
All of a sudden you wake up confused and in a place that you don't seem to recognize. Every thing points to the fact that you'd been drinking a bit too much and you've hit your head...but what's happened and why are you there?

There is only one way to find out. You must go forth into the unknown. The obsessive and intriguing story unveils and reveals itself as you solve the multiple puzzles and thanks to your use of ingenuity and deduction capabilities, of course.

Mechanics



Search, collect, combine and make use of multiple objects to solve different situations and move the story along, gradually discovering information about the protaganista dn what has happened.

Every action or decision you take will get you closer and closer to one of the many endings, and ultimately your final destination. So be clever and calculated.

data.name: Welcome to Desal
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Desal

You were just passing through.

A quiet road. A small café. A quick stop for food.

Then your card gets declined.

Now you owe them.

Welcome to Desal is a short psychological horror experience where an ordinary job slowly turns into something deeply unsettling. Forced to work off your debt, you take on simple café tasks-serving customers, cleaning, and following orders-but something about this place isn’t right.

Strange conversations echo through the walls at night. Employees act like they’re hiding something. Customers don’t always behave… normally.

And no matter what you do, leaving doesn’t seem to be an option.

Key Features:

- Immersive Job Simulation

Perform everyday café tasks that gradually become tense and uncomfortable.

- Psychological Horror

No cheap jumpscares-just slow-building dread, subtle storytelling, and a constant feeling that something is wrong.

- Dynamic Storytelling

Overhear conversations, notice details, and piece together the truth behind Desal.

- Player Choice & Dialogue

Decide what to say-and what to hide-as others begin to suspect what you know.

What’s Really Going On?

The longer you stay, the more questions you’ll have:

Why doesn’t anyone talk about what happens at night?

Who was behind the wall?

Why won’t your car start?

And why does it feel like you were never meant to leave?

Sometimes, the scariest thing isn’t being trapped somewhere.

It’s realizing you might already belong there.

data.name: Terrawurm
data.detailed_description:
Terrawurm is a fast paced singleplayer arcade game. Collect precious gems on the hostile surface of Terra; the landscape is dangerous but what lurks beneath is even worse…

Grab as much as you can before you’re eaten by the Terrawurm!

Terrawurm has:
  • Super simple controls - just the left stick!
  • An ever changing landscape that will destroy you
  • Unlockable powerups to help level the playing field (until you eventually die)
  • Tough as nails challenges that only Hardcore Gamers™ can beat

data.name: Fluffwatch
data.detailed_description:
Fluffwatch is the cozy, casual game where you can finally finalize your dream of becoming a sheep herder and take care of your own cute little farm full of sheep. But be prepared because during the night something might happen to your cute herd of sheep and it is up to you to defend them with all your might!

Develop connections and take are of your sheep during the day by doing different tasks like shearing, giving water, feeding, etc. But be mindful with your time because as soon the night-time begins, the spacing of the game takes a whole different shift.

Key Characters

Sheep
It is up to you to protect them during the night and take care during the cozy day. The mood of the sheep is very dependent on the actions that the player took during the day. Did the player took good care of the sheep during the day? Than the sheep will do everything they can to stay in the farm and avoid the dangers of the night, otherwise they will let themselves get eaten or run away from the farm!

Wolves
These are the dangerous creatures of the night, they will attack your farm when the moon starts to rise and it is up to you to fend them off and make sure nothing happens to your cute sheep.

Dog
The dog guard will be sleeping during the day but that is it will be defending the farm during the night and the player will be controlling the dog during that time period. Scare and attack the wolves and make sure nothing happens to your cute little herd of sheep.

Farmer
You will be controlling the farmer during the day and it's than your job to do different tasks that makes sure that the sheep are very happy and your farm is being defendant against the wolves that will be coming during the night.

data.name: Shelved
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Castle; where the VHS tapes have a mind of their own!

You're a tiny orc tasked with sorting your 1,560+ cursed VHS tape collection across 20 distinct genres in a sprawling, magical Castle. Sounds simple? Think again. The Castle's resident poltergeist loves undoing your hard work, forbidden tapes glow with dark energy, and a mysterious fairy trapped in a jar might just help you... if you find the right tape.

 SORT WITH MAGICAL PRECISION

Master the chaos using rechargeable, upgradeable abilities:

  • Movie Magic: Instantly highlight all tapes matching the title in your hands.

  • Shelf Magic: Light up the correct target bookcase for your held tape's genre.

  • Glow Stick: Drop temporary light sources into pitch-black archive corners.

  • Fae Force: Summon a helpful fairy to fetch Matching tapes.

Earn upgrade points as you complete bookcases to lower cooldowns and boost power efficiency!

 SURVIVE THE POLTERGEIST

This mischievous ghost thrives on chaos. Put him in timeout, feed him, or defeat him permanently for a special reward. But watch out — he'll scatter your sorted tapes across the Castle when you're not looking!

 20 UNIQUE GENRES

From Horror and Sci-Fi to Kids, Sports, and Finance — every genre has its own dedicated bookcase, its own vibe, and its own organizational challenges.

 MAGICAL DISCOVERIES

  • Forbidden Tapes: Uncover hidden Easter eggs glowing with mysterious supernatural energy.

  • Inventory Upgrades: Collect candy throughout the Castle to increase your tape-carrying capacity.

  • Spooky-Free Peaceful Mode for fraidy cats: Want pure organization without the ghost hunting you? Turn off the scares and enjoy a stress-free sorting session.

 26 ACHIEVEMENTS

Can you sort every tape without using powers? Beat the developer's speedrun time? Find all 10 forbidden tapes? Prove you're the ultimate Organizer!

FEATURES:

  • 1,560+ Unique VHS Tapes across 20 genres

  • 4 Upgradeable Magical Powers

  • Dynamic Poltergeist AI that adapts to your progress

  • Full Save/Load System — pick up right where you left off

  • 23 Steam Achievements

  • Atmospheric Lighting and spooky surprises

  • Colorful, Cartoon-Style Graphics

  • Speedrun-Friendly Design

A cozy sorting game with a mischievous, spooky twist. Perfect for players who love organization, exploration, and a little bit of chaos!

data.name: Conquerors: Domination
data.detailed_description:
Conquerors: Domination is a modern warfare strategy game where players build military infrastructure, command powerful armies, and fight for global domination. Expand your territory, manage resources, and deploy devastating military forces to defeat rival commanders across dynamic battlefields.

Construct defensive bases, recruit ground and air units, and plan strategic offensives to conquer enemy territories. Every decision matters as you balance economic expansion, base defense, and large-scale warfare.

Build Your Military Empire

Start with a small command base and expand your war machine by constructing essential structures such as:

• Recruitment Buildings to train armies
• Defensive Towers and Walls to protect your territory
• Airbases to launch powerful aerial attacks
• Strategic infrastructure to support large-scale warfare

Careful planning and resource management are essential to maintain a powerful military force.

Command Powerful Armies

Deploy a wide range of modern military units including:

• Armored tanks and ground forces
• Aircraft launched from airbases
• Strategic support units
• The powerful late-game Mothership

Form massive armies, coordinate attacks, and overwhelm enemy defenses in explosive battles.

Adaptive AI Opponents

Face off against intelligent AI commanders that scale with difficulty. As difficulty increases, enemy factions will:

• Expand faster
• Build stronger defenses
• Recruit larger armies
• Launch more aggressive attacks

Each match presents a unique strategic challenge.

Multiple Game Modes

Campaign

Fight through progressively difficult scenarios as you conquer enemy territories and expand your empire.

Custom Battles

Create your own strategic conflicts by selecting maps, AI opponents, and difficulty levels.

Multiplayer

Compete against other players online in intense large-scale wars for territorial dominance.

Strategic Warfare

Victory requires more than brute force. Players must:

• Control key territories
• Build strong defensive bases
• Manage resources efficiently
• Launch coordinated attacks
• Adapt to changing battlefield conditions

Only the most skilled commanders will achieve total domination.

Command the battlefield.
Build your empire.
Conquer the world.

If you'd like, I can also help you write:

• The 300-character Steam short description (extremely important for clicks)
• The best Steam tags for discovery (this can double your visibility)
• A better title tagline for the trailer and store page.

data.name: Sunken Sky
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Sunken Sky

Our kingdom was once engulfed in a neverending conflict. We shook the very foundations of the world to end it, unaware of the consequences it would cause. Yet we had to move on. We had to rebuild. We had to forget. 

Join our unlikely protagonists in their adventure. Nameless girl seeking to traverse across the kingdoms. A survivor driven by guilt. A noble with too much to prove. Their paths will cross and, perhaps, so will their goals. 

Sunken Sky is a metroidvania mixed with a hefty dose of JRPG elements. It's a (mostly) lighthearted story of self-development, hope and discovery. 

Game features

Fend off all sorts of monstrosities in your path - ranging from the weakest and squishiest critters to ferocious and mighty bosses. 

Explore vast and interconnected world. Climb the hazardous mountains, investigate an enchanted forest, find secrets hidden deep underground. 

There might not be a fishing mechanic but there are other various optional minigames to keep you entertained. 

Hundreds of hand drawn illustrations to accompany you in your journey.

Explore vast and interconnected world. Climb the hazardous mountains, investigate an enchanted forest, find secrets hidden deep underground. 

There might not be a fishing mechanic but there are other various optional minigames to keep you entertained. 

Hundreds of hand drawn illustrations to accompany you in your journey.

data.name: You Are The Loading Screen
data.detailed_description:
THE LOADING SCREEN IS THE GAME

You were told to wait.

That was a lie.

You Are The Loading Screen is a surreal comedy puzzle adventure where a broken loading screen slowly unravels into an absurd journey through corrupted software, fake operating systems, impossible CAPTCHAs, retro arcade games, and self-aware progress bars.

What starts as a simple loading screen quickly becomes something much stranger.

Wiggle your mouse to "increase loading speed." Survive fake Blue Screens of Death. Close endless pop-up ads. Help a server hamster keep the internet alive. Pass nonsensical verification tests. Refuse aggressive microtransactions. Repair corrupted save files. Navigate system failures that may or may not exist.

And when you finally reach 100%...

the game is only getting started.

Progress beyond the impossible limit as the loading system becomes self-aware and begins fighting back. Every percentage point uncovers new challenges, hidden jokes, unexpected mechanics, and increasingly ridiculous attempts to prevent you from ever reaching the end.

FEATURES

A Loading Screen That Refuses To End

What begins at 0% expands into a massive journey that pushes far beyond 100%.

Constantly Changing Gameplay

Each layer introduces new mechanics and surprises:

  • Fake crashes and system failures

  • Impossible CAPTCHA challenges

  • Corrupted operating systems

  • Pop-up ad invasions

  • Progress bar politics

  • Fake software updates

  • Retro arcade challenges

  • Puzzle and reaction-based minigames

Retro Arcade Interludes

Take a break from waiting with a collection of classic-inspired arcade games featuring:

  • Space shooter battles

  • Asteroid destruction

  • Virus hunting

  • Data packet collection

  • Firewall navigation

  • Cache cleanup operations

Fight The LOADING_OVERLORD.EXE

Face a giant corrupted loading monster in a retro arcade boss battle filled with bullet hell attacks, system corruption, and one final 99% surprise.

Secrets Everywhere

Read tooltips.
Inspect error messages.
Question every button.

The obvious solution is rarely the correct one.

Interactive Comedy

The game constantly reacts to your actions, mistakes, impatience, curiosity, and willingness to trust suspicious software.

Multiple Hours Of Weirdness

Packed with hidden jokes, secrets, fake systems, optional interactions, achievements, and unexpected discoveries.

WARNING

This game contains:

  • Fake crashes

  • Fake operating system screens

  • Fake updates

  • Fake uninstallers

  • Fake progress bars

  • Fake error messages

  • Fake warnings

Nothing dangerous ever happens to your computer.

Probably.

JUST ONE MORE PERCENT...

The loading bar says the game is almost ready.

It's lying.

data.name: Travelling Light
data.detailed_description:
A year in the lives of Leah, Lars, Ivy and Samson

Follow the intertwined lives of four friends over the course of the year in brilliant color and thoughtful illustrations, with a narrative based on real events. 

Face the challenges of life, conflict, and mental health

Leah, Lars, Ivy, and Samson all face their own personal struggles over the course of the year, including with their mental health. 

See from every point of view

Each character has their own perspective on events. Look at things from every angle to understand how reality shifts under every person's perception.

Play minigames with meaning

The story progresses as minigames are completed. Each minigame is tied deeply into the themes and mood of the narrative, so story and play blend together.

Find peace in friendship and nature

Immerse yourself in a story about our relationships with friendship and nature, and how we can only make it by relying on each other.

data.detailed_description: Ashes of Animara is a top-down ship combat campaign. Animara is gone, drunk dry by the Nihilus Order, and you are the last pilot still in the air. Hunt them across the worlds they already ruined: the burning wastes of Kharak, the frozen silence of Veyra, and the storm-eaten seas of Aelion. Between sorties you return to the hangar to paint the fighter, spend what you earned, and mount a new weapon, ability, or relic pulled off the dead planets. Kinetic cannons, plasma, spread fire, and a charged gamma burst cut through escorts and the capital ships that ended your home.

data.name: Amberon End
data.detailed_description:
Amberon End is a 2D action roguelite sidescroller where you play as a new prototype assistant robot named “Laila,” made by a mystical and mysterious architect. You will be sent to bunker after bunker, protecting human settlements during the beginning of the end of the world. Attacked by a parasitic colony hidden deep under the Earth’s crust, you will fight your way through hordes of hideous and ruthless infected robotic abominations in order to preserve what remains of humanity.

You are the star child. Bring hope like the stars upon the sky.

- Manage Bunkers -

Build defenses, keep systems up, upgrade and improve machines. Each bunker is randomized with different events, systems, and challenges every run. Work the bunker to your advantage. Keep the rooms running and they will reward you with boons of strength and power. 

Build towards the stars.

- Synergizing Weapon -

Weapons and equipment will give you unexpected abilities. A fire extinguisher can put out fires but propel you! A wrench can repair rooms and parry projectiles! Use them in combination and discover some unique interactions. Be both versatile and unstoppable.

Bring forth the beauty and brilliance of the cosmos.

- Discover and Evolve -

Discover blueprints for powerful abilities and new weapons to improve your chances of survival. Discover events that can help you through each run, befriend and be assisted by unique characters, and upgrade tools into cosmic weapons inspired by the stars. Most importantly, learn who made you, and what plans do they have at the brink of humanity?

The end comes so you must become its final obstacle.

data.name: Sellin' Snake Oil
data.detailed_description:
You are a traveling merchant in the Old West with one goal: make enough money to buy your ranch. To get there you will need to trade smart, prepare for the road ahead, and make decisions that can either grow your wallet or empty it.

Sellin' Snake Oil is a roguelike trading game where you buy and sell goods across randomly generated towns in runs that last around 30 to 45 minutes. Every run starts fresh with a new map, new town economies, and new challenges to navigate.

Trading is the core of the game but it is not as simple as just buying cheap and selling high. Town economies are driven by what they produce and what they need, and world events can shift prices at any moment. You also have to think ahead. Do you spend everything on goods to maximize profit, or keep some money in your pocket in case things go wrong on the road?

The trail between towns is just as important as the trading itself. You might run into wolves and have to decide how to handle them based on what you are carrying. A wounded man on the ground could be genuinely in need of help, or he could be setting you up. Traveling merchants you meet on the road are your main source of upgrades, so those encounters are worth paying attention to.

Speaking of upgrades, they change how your runs play out in a big way. Expanding your storage lets you carry and sell more goods which is the most straightforward way to grow. But later upgrades start asking you to make real tradeoffs. You can cut your travel time in half but only carry half the goods. You can increase what you sell everything for, but bandits will come after you more often. These decisions shape the kind of run you are going for.

Sellin Snake Oil sits in a part of the western genre that does not get much attention. There is no shooting your way to victory here. It is about the everyday life of someone trying to make their fortune in the wild west through wit, preparation, and knowing when to take a risk.

The ranch is waiting. Start Sellin'.

data.name: Idle Chibi Knight
data.detailed_description:
Family Matters

As with the original Chibi Knight series, this game is a family endeavor. Nick's kids (now age 7-13) contribute concept art, story, boss and gameplay ideas throughout development. You'll even hear their voice acting directly in the game!


About the Game

Idle Chibi Knight carries on the legacy of Chibi Knight in an epic, idle dungeon crawling adventure. This casual RPG experience combines dungeon crawling, ARPG combat, and passive incremental progression. Fight monsters, acquire loot, level up and grow increasingly powerful.

Play as multiple classes, and experiment with different builds and skill combinations. Invest in multiple attributes to find your preferred stat balance. Amass Beast Orbs to fight by your side as the Beast Master, or wield powerful elemental magic as the Sorcerer. Plus 3 all-new classes, never before seen in the Chibi Knight series!

Set in the Kingdom of Oukoku. A family-friendly, charming world filled with goofy fantasy characters and creatures. This includes a cast of familiar characters and returning favorites from previous Chibi Knight games, silly new additions, and cheeky references to other games and bits of pop culture.

data.name: Brumm
data.detailed_description:
In the spirit of old arcade classics like Super Sprint and old computer racers like Micro Machines, you race on a topdown track with up to five players online or local in front of your computer.

Local multiplayer


Race your friends with full controller support in front of the TV. Compete for the best time or annoy each other in action or eliminiation mode.

Online multiplayer


You can play a public game online for quick fun, or start a private lobby and invite your friends. Climb to the top of the leaderboards and driver standings!

Single player


Race with AI bots or drive alone to get the best possible time on the local leaderboards.

Game modes


You can race for a better position on the leaderboard in time mode or try to beat your opponents with power ups in action mode. Finally you can drive in elimination mode where the player on the last position has only a few seocnds to catch up - maybe the speed power ups can help?!

Features


  • 15 different tracks over two themes
  • Three game modes: time, action and elimination matches.
  • Online multiplayer for up to five players
  • Supports keyboard and controllers for up to five local players
  • AIs bots for single player challenges or additonal cars in local multiplayer
  • Local and online leaderboards and online driver standings.

data.name: HUNTERS: Uprising
data.detailed_description:
TRACK AND KILL OR DIE ALONE


You are a professional supernatural hunter, the last line of defense between our world and savage creatures known from folklore stories, tasked with eliminating the savage, nightmarish monsters that have infested danger zones all around the globe. Play alone or in the teams of two, three or four players, track your target, learn more about what you're hunting and how to kill it, and compete against other hunters in the zone. Kill, butcher and deliver the trophy to your employer as fast as you can, cause the time is ticking. The longer it takes the lower the price ... Don't show mercy to your enemies, fight through everchanging environments with dynamic weather system, upgrade your gear, level up and try not to die.

GREATER RISKS, GREATER REWARDS


Competitive, match-based gameplay combines PvP and PvE elements to create a uniquely tense PvPvE experience where your gear is always at stake. Succeed, and you will be rewarded handsomely, but remember that a single mistake can cost you everything you have. HUNTERS: Uprising combines elements from several games in the genre and adds new mechanics and unique twists with combination of extraction and survival modes.



  • Gritty and dark world full of supernatural monsters
  • Tense extraction gameplay
  • Progression system
  • Gear customization
  • Upgradeable base
  • Play solo, duo, trio or in a squad of four players
  • hunting, fishing, crafting in survival mode
  • complete the tasks
  • and much more ...

THE STORY SO FAR


Throughout centuries, different generations have told stories of mythical creatures. Demons and hellspawns, monsters and mutants of all kinds. Those have been previously thought to just have been myths and legends, stories to tell around campfires or to scare children into behaving themselves. But in reality, they have always been all around us!



The „infestation“ started in late 90s. Noone knows what actually happend, monsters from our folklore started appearing in different locations all around the world. These locations were soon infested with monsters and overgrowth that it became too dangerous for the living. In the end mankind decided to build walls around centers of the monster infestation to stop the spread of it. Many people died during the process, but in the end it’s the walls that actually saved humanity. That’s how the danger zones were created.

Right now its almost 40 years after the zones were created and the only thing we actually learned about them is that they can overflow with monsters which break through walls. To stop the danger zones from overflowing many mercenary organizations were created. They employ thousands of professional supernatural hunters all around the globe. They are the new „heroes“ of mankind. Once in a while they are sent to the zones which are on the brink of overflowing to find and kill the alpha monster. Thanks to them the numbers of monsters in the zones are for some time reduced and there is time to fix the walls.

You are one of those mercenaries, will you survive?

data.name: Years of Division
data.detailed_description:
For a thousand years the Kingdoms of Kaylia and Darakma were united in a war against their neighbor, the Sovereignty of Devess. Now, only a dozen years after the truce that brought peace to the land, war returns. The new king of Darakma launches a surprise attack on Kaylia in the name of his god, and all who live on the continent of Yelos brace themselves for the fallout of his actions. Alliances are broken, families separated, and lovers turned to enemies as the two closely joined lands are divided for the first time in history.

Annaka and Arcett, the princess and prince of Kaylia, are caught up in the conflict. Rally a team to their sides and do battle with bandits, soldiers, and maybe worse to find the truth and perhaps reunite this broken land.

TACTICS ARE YOUR KEY TO VICTORY

  • Fight your way through a series of turn-based tactical battles and uncover a plot of betrayal, intrigue, and mystery.
  • Wield powerful and flexible magic. Heal and buff your allies, change the terrain, rain down destruction, transport units across the map, and more!
  • Accumulate power and unleash remarkable Critical attacks when the moment is right.
  • Prepare devastating counter-attacks with a Reflexes build or press the attack by developing Haste. New tactics are opened up to you by your choice.

DESIGN YOUR TEAM TO ENABLE YOUR STRATEGY

  • Build your units exactly as you wish. Your character's stats are determined by your choices, not random growths.
  • Plan your team's collective capabilities by choosing each character's path and determining their abilities. Will you dabble in magic? Pick up a second weapon? Or stick to what you know best?
  • Collect treasure and assign it to your units to bolster their combat effectiveness.
  • Play the way you prefer with modular difficulty settings. Prefer fewer stronger enemies? Or do you hate to let any ally die? Design the perfect difficulty setup for your play style.

EXPLORE A FANTASY WORLD AT WAR

  • Gather a team of fighters from across the world of Yelos.
  • Forge bonds between your allies and gain buffs based on their personalities.
  • Discover the truth that cast the world back into war!

data.name: Three in a Rogue
data.detailed_description:
Three in a Rogue is a turn-based roguelike smashed into a match 3 game. Explore dynamically generated dungeons and fight off enemies with a unique combat style. Enemies move every time you move a gem and you gain an ability with every match you make so you'll need to make matches efficiently. Make matches to move around the level and fight enemies. Plan your moves carefully to cascade into the perfect combo.

Make matches to gain abilities...


Every time you swap a pair of gems, enemies move one step. But any matches you obtain will put abilities into your hand.

...Use those abilities to fight monsters


Spend abilities from your hand to activate them. Bigger matches means stronger abilities.

Collect treasure


Unlock treasures that change your abilities, some are upgrades, some are sidegrades, and some completely change the way you fight.

data.name: AA Soldiers
data.detailed_description:
Aircraft Operations

Use the A and D keys on your keyboard as well as the mouse.
You can move the aircraft left and right.


About the Game


This game is a simple 3D missile shooter.
It's an arcade type of game.

About game
Read about the mission on the menu screen and select the level to start the game.
Player becomes an anti-aircraft soldier, lock on the enemy aircraft and shoot missiles.
At the level of the anti-aircraft, the player can not move.
The enemy aircrafts are mainly old propeller aircrafts, with multiple appearances.
The allies include multiple multi-role jet fighters, self-propelled anti-aircraft guns, and the missile destroyer.
Each mission has its own set of conditions for completing levels.
There is also a level to operate the aircraft.
At that level, you operate aircraft and destroy enemies with guided rockets.

Common Matters
Press the ESC key on the menu screen to display the options screen.
The commander tells the player in a radio conversation dialog which target to destroy.
The difficulty level of this game is lower. It may feel unsatisfying to avid game players.
The game's progress is automatically saved.
In order to play the next level, you must complete the previous level.

How to operate an anti-aircraft soldier
Mouse: moving viewpoint
ESC: Pause screen
Lock-on when you focus on the enemy.
Lunch a missile with a left mouse click.

How to operate an aircraft
Mouse up: Aircraft descends
Mouse down: Aircraft ascends
Move mouse sideways: Aircraft rolls
Lateral movement: A and D keys on the keyboard (important)
Lunch the guided rockets with a left mouse click.
ESC: Pause screen
These operations can not be changed from options.

data.name: Space Overlord - I got Isekai'd into a Sci fi World
data.detailed_description:
Space Overlord I got Isekai'd into a Sci fi World is a unique take on the Isekai genre. HuniePop-like interactions with quests, bosses, and Choice-Driven stories. Go on missions, take over the empire, or join the Renegade Pact. This game combines the best of all worlds: a dating sim, an Isekai manga, and a role-playing game.

Following your death in an attempt to save a little girl, you are transported to a Sci-Fi world as an Empire Pilot. After living a boring life until now you decide to be the ruler of the empire. One way or another. The goal is simple: romance the key figures in the galaxy in order to make an army strong enough to defeat the Empire.

Using your Isekai-System, you are able to read people's minds and perceive their disposition towards you. You'll be receiving interesting quests to enhance your relationship with the girls as you progress through the game. If you conquer the heart of a girl, you will receive special passive/active abilities to help you cope with the overwhelming number of ships ahead of you. As you voyage through the galaxy, you can upgrade your ship to become a powerful battleship or a swift assassination ship. Your choices throughout your story will shape who you are and how you are viewed in the galaxy. I wish you the best of luck and welcome, Overlord!

* Ten gorgeous girls with distinctive voices, personalities, and styles. Even certain side characters have romantic potential.

* A mixture of 2.5D and 3D elements with hundreds of unlockable and purchasable ship upgrades.

* Using Next-Gen lip-Syncing, every single character is professionally voice acted to increase immersion.

* An immersive AAA soundtrack and sound effects of all genres.

* Isekai-Systems allow you to take the upper hand against the Imperial Armada!

data.name: Fatal Hour: Petroleum
data.detailed_description:
Fatal Hour: Petroleum is the first chapter of the Fatal Hour Saga.

The Situation

Two words: Zombie Apocalypse

Your team of survivors have acquired transportation in the form of a bus and are seeking the source of an automated radio transmission, in the hopes of finding other people. Living people that is, there is an abundance of the other kind.

Traveling through the barren wastelands, the engine starts coughing. You manage to make it to what appears to be an abandoned gas station, in the middle of nowhere. Fortunately, a member of your group, Mechanic Mike, figures he can fix the engine and get you back on the road. He's no magician though and will need some time. Time, however, might just prove to be in short supply, since your arrival at the gas station has been registered by what used to be the living residents of the area and the likewise formerly living inmates of the nearby female penitentiary.

They may be no longer living, but one thing is sure: They're HUNGRY!

The Game

Gameplay
Fatal Hour: Petroleum is an explosive, non-stop action packed, single map, top-down, 3:rd person, zombie survival, RTS, Tower Defense hybrid. Yes, you got it right, now try saying it out loud. You command a team of 5 characters with different personalities and preferred weaponry. You're stranded and surrounded by hordes of undead whose dinner is long overdue.

To put it plainly, your mission is simple: SURVIVE BY ANY MEANS POSSIBLE.

The Chapter System
Fatal Hour: Petroleum is the first in a series of stand alone chapter games that tell the story of a group of people, struggling to survive in the aftermath of the Zombie Apocalypse. Each chapter is a single-level minigame, played as a separate challenge available at different levels of difficulty. The goal is to achieve the best possible result and survive as long as possible. In the first chapter, the group is stranded at an abandoned gas station, struggling to keep the undead at bay while they repair their transportation.

The chapter games will be released in quick succession, with just a few weeks in between. At least three chapter minigames are planned for release, after which a decision will be made either to continue with additional game chapters or create a larger and more diverse game, with strategic as well as tactical game elements. This decision will be heavily influenced by player opinions.

The Group

Prepper Jack
Most people of the Earth were caught completely unprepared by the sudden events of what came to be known as "The Outbreak". This guy was not. Some people would even say that he was so prepared for the Apocalypse that he was actually happy when it finally happened.

Armed with a military grade precision sniper rifle and the eyes of an unrivalled marksman, Prepper Jack could probably hit a fly on a wall from a mile away. However, most flies these days are not on walls and should he miss the occasional flying bug, chances are that his shot will still have the desired effect on the undead thing it was sitting on.

Prepper Jack

Trailer Jane
Trailer Jane was working late on the day of The Outbreak. When the hordes reached the diner, the young waitress was the only survivor, thanks to the Colt 1911 - a present from her father on her 9:th birthday - that she never left out of reach even before the end of the world. What really ticked her off was when one of the undead managed to mess up her hair on the same day as she had been to the salon. The killing spree that followed is said to have made even the undead sick to their stomach and chances are that some of the corpses she left behind in the diner wasn't really dead to begin with. But don't even hint about that to Jane if you know what's good for you.

Anyway, since the trailer park that had been Jane's home since birth was completely overrun by the hordes, Jane has made it her mission in life to kill again what is already dead.

Trailer Jane

Deputy Klaus
When the hordes descended on Dirtmine, Arizona, Deputy Klaus was busy, escorting an undesired bum out of town and "mildly persuading" him never to return. As Klaus came back to the sheriff's office, no one appeared to be left alive. A few minutes later, Klaus had made sure that no one was left moving as well. Some people say that there actually was a survivor, a local man that spent every other night in lockup due to a habit involving drinking, fighting and... well mainly drinking and fighting. Since Klaus was a firm believer in the value of teaching lessons, it is not unlikely that if so, Klaus may have just left him in his cell awaiting the sheriff's order to release the prisoner, as regulations stated. At least if there was nothing in the regulations about making exceptions in case the sheriff was no longer able to issue such an order due to being busy prowling the streets with an urge to devour human flesh.

Deputy Klaus

Samu Jin
A tech student who really didn't bother to hang out with anyone else, Jin spent most of his time prior to The Outbreak studying or practicing with the ancient sword replica he purchased on eBuy. Most people around him thought him fairly strange, and the word "creepy" was more often than not used by people describing him to others. As The Outbreak came, Jin was convinced that it was caused by something in the air, perhaps something to do with chemtrails. Although there's been no proof of such a connection since, Jin retains his conviction about the state of the matter and prefers to keep his gas mask on at all times. Well, he actually takes it off from time to time for eating and drinking, but generally tries to hold his breath as best as possible during those rare occasions.

So far, he's turned down all opportunities to switch out his sword for a ranged weapon and seems to prefer going all out berserk when confronted with the undead.

Samu Jin

Shotgun Joe
No one really knows muck about what Shotgun Joe did before The Outbreak, but he seems to regard the undead as mostly a nuisance that has to be put down with much the same focus as a buzzing mosquito has to be waved away. A sawed off shotgun is his weapon of choice, some say because he cannot be bothered to have to aim to hit his target. Having to raise his weapon to aim would probably piss him off quite badly. In fact, Joe is pissed off by a lot of things but mostly by people, especially the kind that bother him with talking.

The jury's out on whether Joe actually likes living, talking people or undead the least. But at least he can kill the undead kind without anyone complaining, which seems to suit him just fine.

Shotgun Joe

Mechanic Mike
Growing up Mechanic Mike was not the brightest kid in town. In fact, he was probably just about the opposite. By the age of 12, he had just learned the basics of reading and to be honest he didn't really get any further than that. He never spoke much and he easily got confused when people talked fast or used difficult words. You might expect a kid like that to get bullied badly by the other kids, and it might have happened to Mike as well, had it not been for one reason: He was simply huge. A head above other kids his age and about twice as wide. Most of all he reminded you of a bull, both physically and intellectually. No kid would run the risk of provoking him, even though he really never got into a fight or hit someone.

Living alone with his widowed mother, he preferred to spend his time in the garage, playing with his late father's tools and old car. Mike failed miserably at school and didn't appear to be able to learn anything at all above the level of a 6-year-old. Except for one thing. He had an amazing understanding of engines and mechanics, far beyond what anyone could expect of a professional mechanic or engineer. As his mother was one of the first victims on The Outbreak, Mike ran from town. An almost unbelievably peaceful person, he couldn't bring himself to use force even against the undead hordes, not even to save his own life.

Lucky for him, he came across a group of individuals with more than plenty of potential for violence, but in desperate need of a mechanic.

Mechanic Mike

data.name: Potions, Please!
data.detailed_description:
You didn’t choose this life. You didn’t major in alchemy. You’re not even sure how to harvest toad eyes without... well, let’s not talk about that.

And yet you now find yourself the sole heir of Madam Marigold’s Potion Emporium & Goat Rental, a dangerously aromatic establishment nestled in the fog-drenched town of Fogbottom-on-Flask, where goblins haggle, owls lecture, and no one agrees on the correct way to steep herbal tea. Your late Aunty Marigold, in what can only be described as a bold display of confidence and questionable timing, relied a little bit too much on her own resurrection potion. It did not go well. Now, she is resting* (with mild protest) behind the shop, leaving you the keys, two starter recipes, and a valuable hint: “Organic sells better.”

Orders are already piling up. An injured hamster requires a healing potion. Farmers need stamina brews to survive turnip season. An orc war chief demands enhanced agility for reasons that fall somewhere between “could be interesting” and “potential for war crimes”. And you – utterly unqualified – must learn fast, forage faster, and pray the llamas haven’t eaten the key ingredients again. But faced with bubbling cauldrons and morally ambiguous business decisions, a bigger truth emerges: your potions have the power to change lives, fates… perhaps even the Queendom itself.

And maybe, just maybe, if you become a true master alchemist, you can get Aunty Marigold back on her feet. Preferably alive, not undead.

*) We refrain from using the word "decomposing" here. She is your Aunty, after all!

  • Brew Potions that Shape the World - Every potion you craft and sell affects something. A person, a faction, a rumour, or the balance of power in Fogbottom. Small choices lead to big consequences as your reputation quietly reshapes the world around you.

  • Run Your Potion Shop Your Way - Gather ingredients, fulfill orders, upgrade your workspace, and customise your shop with decor, tools, and magical oddities. Grow your shop into the beating heart of Fogbottom (but watch out for customers who might also be ingredients).

  • A Narrative Full of Laughs, Lore, and Dark Magic - Written by best-selling author Ivan Ertlov, cosy storytelling is blended with sharp wit, mystery, and a touch of morbidity. Discover what really happened to your aunt, who’s pulling the strings in town, and why the llamas are definitely up to no good.

  • Explore a Weird and Wonderful World - Fogbottom is home to colourful characters, magical creatures, and secrets buried beneath centuries of alchemical experiments.

  • Play Solo or With a Friend - Enjoy the full game alone or with a friend in online co-op. Share ingredients, solve problems together, or cause magical disasters twice as fast.

Come for the cosy crafting, stay for the colourful cast of customers. Welcome to the most delightfully odd potion shop in the realm -  we saved you a ladle!

data.name: RUMBLE DRAGON
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

The streets have been taken over by a powerful mysterious gang, and it's up To Mark and Alisa to clear them out...one broken jaw at a time! Choose your character then punch and kick and bludgeon your way deep into enemy territory! Satisfying Beat 'Em Up style combat that pays homage to early genre classics.

The fifth game in the Game Buddy series that aims to faithfully recreates the look, sounds, and feel of classic late 80's handheld games in a way that's like experiencing an alternate timeline of gaming history.

Game-play

Embark on the hunt to take down the gang lord yourself in solo mode, or team up with a friend in local co-op mode! Dash into the fray and use punch and kick combos to and fight street thugs and powerful boss enemies alike.

Also, avoid stage hazards and pick up fallen weapons to dole out harder hitting or longer reaching attacks!

Features

  • Straightforward fight mechanics reminiscent of classic handheld games of the late 80s
  • Two player local co-op mode
  • Adjustable difficulty level
  • Catchy and nostalgic chiptune music

How to access the menu

To access the game menu and manual, press select button on gamepad or shift key on keyboard.

data.name: Valdrax Beyond the Rift
data.detailed_description:
A kingdom is not given. It is forged.

You arrive with nothing but a Settlement Cart and the will to survive. Choose where you plant your foundations — because the land you claim will define everything that follows. Cut the first trees, mine the first stones, and build the first walls of what will become your stronghold.

Valdrax: Beyond the Rift is a medieval fantasy strategy game inspired by Celtic and Roman military tradition, layered with dark fantasy. Construct and manage a living settlement, forge weapons in your smithy, recruit and train armies, and lead them into an unpredictable world where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

Every map is procedurally varied. Enemy camps, resource deposits, forests, and stone outcroppings are repositioned each time you play — ensuring that experience, not memory, is your greatest weapon.

Every death is permanent. A veteran Swordsman who has survived ten battles is worth more than three fresh recruits. Lose him and he is gone forever. Choose your engagements carefully.

Every expedition opens a new world.

Beyond your walls lie three tiers of expedition maps — small raids, full campaigns, and deep dungeon runs. Breach the rift between realms and face increasingly powerful enemies in search of rare resources and Arcane Crystals. These crystals are the only path to the most powerful creatures in the game — Golems, Werewolves, Vampires, and Dragons.

Somewhere beyond the rift, the Demon Lord waits.

An ancient evil of shadow and fire, the Demon Lord is the ultimate force threatening to consume every realm in existence. He does not simply attack — he sends scouts, adapts his armies, and grows more dangerous as your kingdom expands. Defeating him is the reason your kingdom must be built, your weapons forged, and your armies hardened through blood and expeditions.

But you will not face him alone. Valdrax, the ancient dragon, is not your enemy — he is your greatest ally. Find him beyond the rift, earn his trust through your campaigns, and unleash him when the final battle begins.

Key Features:

  • 🏰 Base Building — construct and upgrade a living medieval settlement from the ground up

  • ⚒️ Realistic Resource Chain — from raw iron to forged weapons to equipped soldiers

  • ⚔️ Tactical Combat — command platoons with formations, spacing, and cycle rows

  • 💀 Permanent Death — every unit lost in battle is gone forever

  • 🗺️ Procedural Variation — maps, resources, and enemy positions change every playthrough

  • 🌀 Expedition System — three tiers of maps beyond the rift, each more dangerous than the last

  • 🔮 Arcane Creatures — recruit Griffins, Harpies, Manticores, Chimeras, and Dragons using rare Arcane Crystals

  • 🐉 Valdrax — an ancient dragon and your greatest ally. Find him beyond the rift and unleash him in the ultimate battle against the Demon Lord

data.about_the_game:
A kingdom is not given. It is forged.

You arrive with nothing but a Settlement Cart and the will to survive. Choose where you plant your foundations — because the land you claim will define everything that follows. Cut the first trees, mine the first stones, and build the first walls of what will become your stronghold.

Valdrax: Beyond the Rift is a medieval fantasy strategy game inspired by Celtic and Roman military tradition, layered with dark fantasy. Construct and manage a living settlement, forge weapons in your smithy, recruit and train armies, and lead them into an unpredictable world where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

Every map is procedurally varied. Enemy camps, resource deposits, forests, and stone outcroppings are repositioned each time you play — ensuring that experience, not memory, is your greatest weapon.

Every death is permanent. A veteran Swordsman who has survived ten battles is worth more than three fresh recruits. Lose him and he is gone forever. Choose your engagements carefully.

Every expedition opens a new world.

Beyond your walls lie three tiers of expedition maps — small raids, full campaigns, and deep dungeon runs. Breach the rift between realms and face increasingly powerful enemies in search of rare resources and Arcane Crystals. These crystals are the only path to the most powerful creatures in the game — Golems, Werewolves, Vampires, and Dragons.

Somewhere beyond the rift, the Demon Lord waits.

An ancient evil of shadow and fire, the Demon Lord is the ultimate force threatening to consume every realm in existence. He does not simply attack — he sends scouts, adapts his armies, and grows more dangerous as your kingdom expands. Defeating him is the reason your kingdom must be built, your weapons forged, and your armies hardened through blood and expeditions.

But you will not face him alone. Valdrax, the ancient dragon, is not your enemy — he is your greatest ally. Find him beyond the rift, earn his trust through your campaigns, and unleash him when the final battle begins.

Key Features:

  • 🏰 Base Building — construct and upgrade a living medieval settlement from the ground up

  • ⚒️ Realistic Resource Chain — from raw iron to forged weapons to equipped soldiers

  • ⚔️ Tactical Combat — command platoons with formations, spacing, and cycle rows

  • 💀 Permanent Death — every unit lost in battle is gone forever

  • 🗺️ Procedural Variation — maps, resources, and enemy positions change every playthrough

  • 🌀 Expedition System — three tiers of maps beyond the rift, each more dangerous than the last

  • 🔮 Arcane Creatures — recruit Griffins, Harpies, Manticores, Chimeras, and Dragons using rare Arcane Crystals

  • 🐉 Valdrax — an ancient dragon and your greatest ally. Find him beyond the rift and unleash him in the ultimate battle against the Demon Lord

  • 👹 The Demon Lord — the ultimate enemy. An ancient evil that adapts, scales, and commands endless armies. Your entire campaign builds toward one final confrontation.

  • 🕵️ Espionage — enemy scouts gather intelligence on your base and raids adapt accordingly

  • 🌍 Celtic & Roman Inspiration — military aesthetics and culture rooted in ancient warrior traditions

data.name: Kaori
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO THE ARCHIPELAGO

It's a big day! Stick has finally perfected his latest invention: the Stele Translator! With it, you can explore the ruins of the archipelago and discover the Karas, the people who lived here thousands of years before you.

Who were the Karas? Did they ever return to their homeland? What could the strange blue rock they called "Helium" have been used for? To answer these questions, you'll have to explore mysterious ruins swallowed by the ocean, sun-drenched islands, and even a vast ancient city hidden deep within the earth.

GET READY TO THINK

In this first-person adventure, numerous puzzles will stand in your way. To solve them, you'll need to be able to question your assumptions and think outside the box.

Furthermore, the various stelae conceal numerous clues, so read them very carefully! Fortunately for you, the journal allows you to access any stele you've already read, regardless of your location.

Kaori is what some might call a "Metroidbrainia" or "knowledge-based game." That is to say, a game set in a semi-open world where you don't open doors using keys or unlocked skills, but rather through knowledge gained by solving puzzles and uncovering the game's story.

Moreover, the game's story and puzzles are extremely interconnected. Some puzzles you manage to solve will reveal information about the game's universe that isn't explicitly stated in any text.

WHO WILL THE GAME ENJOY?

Kaori is heavily inspired by the game "Outer Wilds." The game was designed to offer a similar experience in certain aspects. However, it's not the only source of inspiration. Here's a list of the different games that inspired Kaori:

  • Outer Wilds

  • The Legend of Zelda (especially Wind Waker and Breath of the Wild for the music)

  • Tunic

If you enjoy any of these games, Kaori might interest you.

The music was composed by the very talented Shy Gah!

data.detailed_description:
In Autofahrt you have to flee alone or with friends from an approaching deadly sandstorm.
In a car and with up to 6 players, you drive on a road with many intersections that leads to random locations.
Once there, you have to look for resources such as gasoline, tools and spare parts to repair and improve your car.
But you have no time to waste, the storm is approaching and there is only one chance to survive, you have to reach the bunker before the storm hits you.

Key Features

  • Drive your car to randomly placed locations
  • Search for parts to repair and improve your vehicle
  • Find new cars and equipment
  • Host or join a game via Steam with upto 6 players
  • Ingame communication: Voice chat / chat
