data.name: Alarial's Blessing
data.detailed_description:
Alarial's Blessing is a turn-based RPG for mature audiences that brings fresh ideas to the JRPG genre. The game takes a modern approach to the 2D, top-down formula, but keeps the classic hand drawn animations. Gameplay has a heavy emphasis on story, exploration and combat.

Travel with Kal, Tyranel and Mina as they wander the land living the simple life of independent mercenaries. Move from town to town taking jobs, slaying monsters, searching unexplored locations and assisting eccentric clients.

During their time together, simple jobs begin to carry unexpected weight. Decisions linger. Relationships strain and strengthen. Small moments, acts of kindness and bouts of violence all leave their mark under the watchful eye of the goddess. Why has she taken such an interest?

Join our trio of characters on an emotional journey you won’t soon forget.

Wander the continent of Vollun discovering its many secrets and rich lore. Travel through unique zones connected by a large, traversable overworld in the classic JRPG setup. Numerous forbidden relics and long hidden creatures await discovery by the bold and curious.

Features

  • No direct quest tracking. Instead, Kal will record relevant notes and details in his journal. Analyze the information you have to make progress and complete requests.

  • Discover interesting rumors from chatting to local residents. Who knows where a seemingly random bit of information could lead?

  • Acquire in-game maps of varying quality to help you navigate. Maps of unknown origin are just as likely to lead to danger as unclaimed treasure.

Alarial's Blessing features a unique, new combat system with challenging, turn-based fights. There are no random battles. Every fight is hand-crafted to bring a custom challenge. That means there are fewer fights, and standard fights are closer to mini-boss battles.

Features

  • Observe enemy behaviors and attack patterns in fights that play out almost like a chess match.

  • Movement and positioning are key elements to victory as the size and shape of battle arenas change. Environmental objects can also play an important role in triumph or defeat.

  • Mina, Tyranel and Kal all have a unique progression system and talent tree. Customize your party to match your preferred play style. No builds are invalid, so find what works for you!

About This Game


a game to see the scenery
'CallOfTree' is a first-person shooter game that requires a high-spec PC of a gamer made with Unreal Engine 5.

It's a very simple structure game where you just have to follow the road. Along the road, there are trees you can talk to.
The trees will tell you where to go.
You have to shoot out the intruders who sometimes appear.
It's a story about a gamer who went to another world saving the world.

First person/3rd person can be changed and stored on a level-by-level basis
One level has about 10 minutes of play time


I used the latest version 5.1 of Unreal Engine
I tried to add DLSS, but it was put on hold because the usage changed as the Unreal version was upgraded to 5.1
Developer computer's RTX3070 produces at least 30 frames and an average of 40 frames with the 2k High option.

data.name: 时间之神的猫
data.detailed_description:
A holy cat came to the mortal world to eat fish.
It has no frontal combat capability, nor can it sneak in stealth.
But it has its own unique skill-time travel.
When the mortal guards followed the timeline to track the cat's figure, they had fallen into a trap.
By rationally planning when to appear, the cat will play around with the guard.
After eating countless fish, the cat discovered that the most powerful force is not time travel, but wisdom.

Cat just want to eat fish

There is no complicated love and hatred, this cat just come to eat fish.
Escapes the guards, comes to the location of the fish, and eat it.
Then returns to the place where you started at the prescribed time. The cat's purpose is that simple.

The power of time travel

There is no need to follow a fixed round order, the cat can choose to appear in any round.
However, this ability is not invincible, the cat can only appear in plots adjacent to the current location.
And once it appears in one round, you can no longer choose this round to appear elsewhere.
How to pass the level depends on whether you can properly use the power.

The guard of the mortal world

Unlike the cat that can jump through time and space, the stone guards of the temple only move one step at a time in turn order.
But they win in their dedication and tirelessness.
As long as you appear in their vision, it will chase you, even if you suddenly disappear, they will always wait where you disappeared, no matter how long.
But they won't know. The last round in their eyes is just a normal round you can choose on the timeline.

Various challenges

From the low-level guards who can only look forward in the early stage, to the ultimate guards who can stare at four directions at the same time in the later stage, the challenges are varied.
Every level is in a small space, and there are not too many rounds available.
How to plan rationally, is all up to you.

data.name: Vigil: A Knight Story
data.detailed_description:
The night before they make you a knight, you kneel until dawn and a flame looks at you.

VIGIL is a branching narrative RPG about what an oath is worth in a kingdom that is running out of everything except war. You are a landless sword — a lord's spare son, a hedge knight blooded in the mud, a smith's child who climbed, or a hostage raised in an enemy's hall — and over twelve chapters you will ride, fight, kneel, bargain, and break, and the story will keep the receipts.

Every choice is kept. Over 800,000 words across 1,300+ events: the length of eight novels, no two playthroughs alike. Roughly four real choices at every turn, and the game remembers: the medal you kept or sold, the boy at the snare, the door you stood in front of. Consequences surface chapters later, in the voice of someone you'd forgotten you owed.

Fall, don't reload

There is no death-reload loop. Lose a fight and the

Falls & Scars system marks you — wounds that ache in later chapters, scars written into your record, a shield that can only be dented so many times. Your knight's body is a ledger, and the war writes in it.

Three oaths, held or broken

Honor. Allegiance. Faith. Not alignment bars — living judgments that gate what you can say, who trusts you, and which of the endings will have you. Stats burn as votive candles, lit one costly choice at a time.

A world in stained glass: Illustrated throughout in luminous cathedral glass and illuminated-manuscript art, with a full medieval soundtrack keyed to every chapter and battle. Read it like a book that fights back.

  • 800,000+ words · 12 chapters · 1,300+ branching events

  • Four origins with distinct routes, contacts, and openings

  • Falls & Scars — consequence, not game over

  • Honor / Allegiance / Faith oath system with named reputation bands [] Bonds with companions who remember — and can be lost

  • Stained-glass event art and a full original-feel medieval soundtrack.

From the solo developer of Ludus: A Gladiator Story

Control your leg directly, line up your shots, and take full control of every tackle and touch.

Every shot is controlled by mouse. The direction, power and curve all depend on how you move your leg.
Master the controls, learn the physics and become unstoppable on the field!

Want to be able to give your kicks superhuman strength? A rage aura that lets you send other players flying?
Select which power you want and activate it in the right moment!

Customize own Player

Fully customize your player. Mix different character parts, choose your colors, and design your own football shirt.

Customize your own match

Everything from your character to the game itself is customizable. Powerups, how long their cooldowns and wether curving is automatic or not is up to the host.

"True Football"

A chaotic alternative game mode where every player acts as a ball.

Kick enemy players into their own goals to score!

data.name: Bleakwood
data.detailed_description:
Bleakwood desecrates the foundation of chess in this roguelike deckbuilder. Enter a sinister fantasy world where corruption is key to success. Grow stronger with each run by unlocking cards, improving units, and making sacrifices, ultimately conquering your enemies. But remember, absolute power corrupts absolutely. Will you defile your morals to reclaim what is yours?

Chess Contorted

A game reborn, its rules rewritten. Wield powerful cards to enhance abilities and control units - but power comes at a steep price. Every enhancement spreads corruption, and too much will doom your army from within.

Deadly Deckbuilding

The deck is your weapon … and your peril. Manipulate abilities, movement, characters, and the environment. Combine cards for brutal effects that overwhelm your foes with devastating results and dangerous consequences.

Board Bedlam

The board is riddled with devious traps and environmental dangers. Navigate the treacherous landscape and conquer a realm in chaos, or be consumed by it.

Cycles of Corruption

With each run, corruption remains. Build your arsenal of powerful cards wielding dark and evolving powers. Personalize your deck, recruit and reinforce your army, and refine your playstyle. The board will reset, but you’ll never come back clean.

data.name: Cold Warms Us.
data.detailed_description:
In a remote, snowbound wilderness, you're thrust into the unforgiving reality of survival. The last member of a doomed expedition, your objective is as haunting as the icy landscape around you: find and photograph the 13 fallen explorers who came before you, their bodies now scattered and frozen in time. But survival here is a delicate balance between life and death, demanding constant vigilance, resourcefulness, and grit.

By day, the bleak, white expanse offers a deceptive calm. You must scour the desolate terrain for anything that can aid in your survival. Abandoned vehicles, derelict tents, and crumbling buildings may hold the key to enduring another day. Gather materials to craft vital tools, weapons, and shelter. Monitor your hunger, warmth, and health as you explore, ensuring you are always prepared for the night.


As darkness falls, the true peril reveals itself. Night is when the cold bites hardest, and the creatures of the night emerge, drawn by your presence. Combat becomes inevitable as you fend off these threats, using whatever means you have crafted or scavenged during the day. The day-night cycle is your constant companion and adversary, dictating your actions and strategies. Daylight is your ally for exploration and gathering, but as night descends, survival becomes your only focus.

This is not just a quest for discovery, but a fight for survival against nature’s most brutal elements. Each day is a test of endurance, each night a battle for your life. Will you manage to uncover the mysteries buried in the snow, or will the relentless cold and lurking dangers claim you as their next victim? Your predecessors failed, but the story isn't over yet. The frozen wilderness holds its secrets close—are you ready to uncover them?

data.name: Deep Among the Swarm
data.detailed_description:
A challenging survival RTS roguelite about surviving against thousands of enemies. Start each run with the hopes of going as deep as you can. Customize your army with different weapons, armour and upgrades. When you inevitably fail, use the knowledge gained to make your next attempts stronger through meta progression upgrades.

Hold your ground

Once you start fueling your drill, a massive swarm of monsters will attack you. Setup defensive barricades and choke points to survive.

Expand your Base

Clear out and expand into as much of the darkness as you can. The more resources you control, the more powerful you can become. Your goal is to collect as much Radium to fuel your drill as you can. The more you collect, the deeper you can go.

Customize your units and buildings

After every level, all units and buildings can be customized with different weapons, armour and upgrades. The better you do in each mission, the more currency you have to craft new equipment.

Meta Progression

Defeat is inevitable, but after each loss unlock powerful meta progression to become stronger. The further down you go, the more meta progression you will get, and the more powerful you can become!

Drill ever deeper into the unknown!

As you descend you will face increasingly more powerful enemies. Do you have what it takes to survive what lurks below?

Thousands of units

The unrelenting assault of the swarm is upon you. Can you survive long enough?

data.name: Hearthfall Lodge
data.detailed_description:
One winter. One old lodge. Three reasons to stay.

After a breakup and a closed workshop, Leo, a quiet carpenter, takes a winter job high in the Alps: restore the hundred-year-old thermal bathhouse of Hearthfall Lodge. If the baths reopen, the lodge survives another season. If they don't, the bank takes it in spring.

The village bus comes every day. Leo could leave on any of them. But between frozen pipes, long nights by the fire, and slow conversations over coffee and cocoa, staying starts to feel less like a job and more like a choice.

Meet the women of Hearthfall

  • Ingrid (36) — The proud owner of the lodge and a former national ski champion whose career ended with one bad fall. She would rather freeze than ask for help.
  • Yuna (29) — A gifted chef who burned out in a famous city kitchen and fled to the mountains. She speaks best through food, and only after midnight.
  • Camille (27) — A fearless ski instructor and mountain guide who laughs at everything and refuses to stay anywhere longer than a season.

What awaits you

  • A cozy, slow-burn adult visual novel; the current Early Access build contains the first 16 story chapters.
  • Three unrelated adult women with their own stories, pride, and half-finished dreams.
  • 12 story-driven intimate scenes with animated sequences and unlockable gallery replays.
  • A snowy Alpine setting full of firelight, steam, wooden beams, and quiet winter nights.
  • Save, load, rollback, and skip features for a comfortable visual-novel experience.

All characters are adults, and every intimate encounter is presented as consensual and rooted in the characters' developing relationships.

data.name: HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE
data.detailed_description:
HOW WE KNOW WE'RE ALIVE is an award winning, hour long melancholy, point-and-click narrative mystery set in the bible belt of Sweden.

FROM SWEDEN WITH LOVE

Welcome to Härunga – a small industrial town in the bible belt of the mid–north of Sweden. You play as Sara, an aspiring writer who, after having been away for 10 years, returns home in order to investigate the tragic fate of her estranged best friend. The days grow short quickly this far up north – and the rain never seems to let up...


HÄRUNGA FOREVER

Lovingly crafted and richly animated, explore the melancholy atmosphere of a small town that time seemingly forgot. Meet old friends and enemies and piece together the mystery of what happened after your friendship tragically fell apart.


As in life, what you say will impact things in hidden ways and not everything may be as it seems. Who is telling whose truth and can you know the difference?

data.name: Drill Space
data.detailed_description:
Drill Space puts you in command of a lone explorer venturing into the vast and unforgiving cosmos. Armed with a powerful drill and an arsenal of devastating weapons, you must carve your path through hostile planets, extract valuable minerals, and defend your mothership against relentless alien invaders. Adapt to the ever-changing dangers of space, and survive as long as you can in the chaos of the unknown.

MINE, CRAFT, SURVIVE

Drill through planets, unearth valuable resources, and use them to craft weapons, gadgets, and powerful upgrades to enhance your ship. Every mineral brings you one step closer to survival.

FORGE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY

Arm yourself with powerful weapons to mine faster and defend against relentless alien threats. Collect, upgrade, and unleash powerful tools, each designed for specific challenges and customizable to help you tackle the ever-changing dangers of space.

CONQUER THE COSMOS

Explore a dynamic, randomly generated solar system, each with unique biomes, weather, mysteries, and dangers. Adapt to each world’s challenges and reap its rewards.

data.name: Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge
data.detailed_description:
Digital Deluxe Edition

Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge: Championship Edition

Championship Edition is a discounted bundle that includes the base game of Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge + The Luxury Golf Cart + OST


About the Game

Brendan Keogh’s Putting Challenge is a relaxing open-world golf game about all the parts other golf videogames cut out. Sounds tedious? It sort of is.

With up to four players on a single device (or online by using Remote Play), you have complete freedom to explore the massive open-world at your own pace with your friends. Play a round of mini-golf, compete on a full 9 hole course, go for a bike ride or just see who can hit the ball the furthest at the driving range. It’s entirely up to you.

Originally developed in Pico-8, this labour of love has been painstakingly rebuilt and expanded on to include a larger world and more features, while retaining the original 8-bit retro charm.

Features:

  • Massive open-world to explore
  • Five 9-hole courses including; mini-golf, an extra-large desert course, and secret holes hidden throughout the world
  • Up to four players local (or online by using Remote Play)
  • Full controller support
  • Two players are able to play using a single keyboard
  • Save your progress for later
  • Original soundtrack by Dan Golding (Untitled Goose Game, Frog Detective)
  • 22 Achievements

Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge: Luxury Golf Cart

Walking to each hole feeling a bit tedious? Good, it's meant to. But! Why not travel in style with your very own 4-seater luxury golf cart!
Ride around with 3 of your other friends, or not. It's your cart so do what you want with it. (except drive it outside of the golf courses, which is strictly prohibited)

data.name: Motorcycle Night Ride
data.detailed_description:
Some nights you just want to ride.

Motorcycle Night Ride is a ride with nowhere you need to be. Dark highways, city lights and the sound of your engine. Every road has its own time of day and its own mood, from deep night to early morning.

Ride your way

Free Ride is the relaxing side of the game. There is no timer, no score and no finish line. Choose a road and go.

Close Pass is for the times you want more. Pass the traffic as closely as you can at speed, keep your combo alive and beat your best score. Touch a car and the pass is lost.

Five motorcycles, your colours

You start on the RONIN SHADOW 250. Keep riding and the STRAY 500, the SBR 600, the SB2 1000 and the ATLAS B1000X join your garage one by one. Each motorcycle has its own sound, speed and feel.

Make each one yours with matte, metallic, candy and chrome paint, headlight colours and underglow. Every motorcycle keeps its own look.

Ten roads, straight or curved

City streets, long tunnels, snow, the coast and the open highway. Some roads are deep in the night and some are bright. Every map comes with a Classic road and a Curved road, and each one rides differently.

Your Journey

Every kilometre moves you forward. New motorcycles, new roads and new paint open up as you ride. The Journey screen shows what comes next and how far away it is.

Leaderboards and achievements

data.name: Naval Battles Simulator
data.detailed_description:
„Not the battleships fight, but men”
Naval Admiral Józef Unrug (1884-1973) – the father of the Polish navy.

Battleship or Salvo? No, it’s much more!

Naval Battles Simulator is not an ordinary game: it is a tactical simulation of naval operations. NBS will throw you into the world of being a fleet commander in the most exciting battles on the water ever – the darkest times of World War II (1939-1945).
NBS gives you an unpatrolled opportunity to control the actions of your fleet.
With options based on real-world mechanics, you'll be able to control the fate of every single unit on the sea - from maneuvering the ship through the ammunition selection and finally to controlling your whole fleet.

Features:
* A multitude of battleships to choose from - feel like a real commander of a single vessel or even a whole fleet of the Second Republic of Poland, Third Reich or the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland!
* Enhanced tactical options - use well-known strategies to defeat your opponents or create your own ones!
* Advanced game mechanics that influence the player's actions – weather based on the historical data, the artificial intelligence of the opponent or even luck can thwart your plans!
* "Shipyard" mode, which gives you an opportunity to create your own fleet based on other sides of the conflict,
* The clear and legible layout, which allows for quick orientation in the heat of battle
* Archival radio snippets of BBC radio broadcasts and music to get you through the conflict!
* Featured story of the struggles of a Royal Navy sailor during the turmoil of war,
* Infinite hours of fighting at sea!

Prepare yourselves for a real sea adventure!

data.name: Rolling in the Reef
data.detailed_description:
Rolling in the Reef is a dice-driven strategy game about guiding your fishy friends to thrive in their coral home. You are a Sea Spirit, sent by Poseidon to skillfully manipulate a pool of fish-dice, repel reef invaders and dig up treasures in the sand.

Features:
  • Unlockable artifact powers and multiple playable "schools" of fish!
  • Weekly challenge mode with leaderboards.
  • Ladder/ranking system + procedural generation for endless replayability.
  • A satisfying strategic experience in 15 minutes or less.

The game combines and remixes many elements of euro-style designer board games like Castles of Burgundy, Troyes, Sagrada, and many more to create a thoughtful, interesting and deep experience. A large collection of unlockable artifacts and "schools" of fish together with BrainGoodGames' staple single-player ladder and random map generation ensure that Rolling in the Reef has plenty to explore.

Rolling in the Reef is the 6th game from Canadian game design studio BrainGoodGames, creators of Militia, Axes and Acres, SkyBoats, Minos Strategos and Solar Settlers. BrainGoodGames is committed to making fun, engaging single-player strategy games that combine random generation with a single-player ladder so you can enjoy our games for as long as you like!

Solar Settlers


Militia


Minos Strategos

data.name: Bunny Eureka
data.detailed_description:
I’ve always loved bunnies and pig. For many years, I’ve been doodling them and making bunny models and animations in Blender.

In the end, I decided to turn these ideas into a game, so everyone can meet these cute bunnies and Piggy too.

All the illustrations in the game were drawn by me, and I modeled the bunny and Piggy characters myself. I made the whole game on my own.

There are no serious goals and no punishments. It’s just a tiny world of bunnies.

An Island Full of Bunnies

Start by having the little bunnies farm and plant trees. Harvest food, store up wood, and build the bunnies a home, little by little.

There’s no set goal. You can just watch the bunnies happily keeping busy.

A little bunny’s day: eating, sleeping, working and playing. If they work for too long, they can get very sad.

Happy bunnies will write you letters with hand-drawn pictures inside (I drew them~). If you like illustrations, I think you’ll like these letters.

Build, Farm, and Produce

You can add, rotate and remove buildings and plants on the island.

Removing a building doesn’t cost you anything. Just build it again, and everything in your storage is still there. It’s a casual, relaxing game with no stats to stress about.

Some workshops need raw materials, and also wood as an energy source. You can have the bunnies plant, look after trees, carry resources and make food, and slowly get the whole island running.

The Storybook and Visitors

The island isn’t only about building and production. The Storybook brings visitors and stories. Humans come to the island and are looked after by hardworking, kind and gentle bunnies.

In later chapters, you can also go play with Piggy, the bunnies’ best friend.

Who This Game Is For

This game is for anyone who likes cute bunnies, hand-drawn illustrations and cozy games.

I hope you like my drawings, and I hope the cute little bunnies bring you some happiness.

English isn’t my first language, so please forgive any small mistakes.

Use special tools to see through visitors disguise. Gods can walk among us and it's better not to pull any jokes on them!

data.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
data.detailed_description:
Easy to pick up, hard to put down: a xianxia Roguelike blending backpack management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting.

A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity.

Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting

Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks.

Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus:

  • Some excel at single-target burst

  • Some excel at AoE damage

  • Some excel at healing and sustain

  • Some excel at crowd control and slow

Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes.

Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy

Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer.

Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team

In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power.

Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth

While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages.

Relaxed, Grind-Friendly, and Deeply Strategic

  • Low PC requirements — runs smoothly on most computers

  • One run after another — easy to enjoy, hard to stop

  • Deep strategy for fans of backpack management, build-crafting, tower defense, and bullet-heaven shooting

  • Xianxia setting + Backpack Like + Bullet-Heaven + Strategy Roguelike — all in one

This Game Is for You If You Enjoy:

  • Backpack Like / Backpack Management / Backpack Battles-style gameplay

  • Strategic team-building, build-crafting, and Roguelike randomness

  • Bullet-heaven shooting, tower defense, and screen-clearing horde combat

  • Xianxia / cultivation themes, senior brothers, junior sisters, and Dao Body star-up

  • Relaxed, grind-friendly gameplay that you can enjoy for a long time

So then — this last pure land is waiting for you to defend it.

data.about_the_game:
Easy to pick up, hard to put down: a xianxia Roguelike blending backpack management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting.

A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity.

Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting

Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks.

Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus:

  • Some excel at single-target burst

  • Some excel at AoE damage

  • Some excel at healing and sustain

  • Some excel at crowd control and slow

Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes.

Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy

Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer.

Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team

In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power.

Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth

While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages.

Relaxed, Grind-Friendly, and Deeply Strategic

  • Low PC requirements — runs smoothly on most computers

  • One run after another — easy to enjoy, hard to stop

  • Deep strategy for fans of backpack management, build-crafting, tower defense, and bullet-heaven shooting

  • Xianxia setting + Backpack Like + Bullet-Heaven + Strategy Roguelike — all in one

This Game Is for You If You Enjoy:

  • Backpack Like / Backpack Management / Backpack Battles-style gameplay

  • Strategic team-building, build-crafting, and Roguelike randomness

  • Bullet-heaven shooting, tower defense, and screen-clearing horde combat

  • Xianxia / cultivation themes, senior brothers, junior sisters, and Dao Body star-up

  • Relaxed, grind-friendly gameplay that you can enjoy for a long time

So then — this last pure land is waiting for you to defend it.

data.name: SubterAlien Rescue
data.detailed_description:
Save downed Pilots, destroy robots, retrieve orbs ... All in a days work for a SubterAlien Rescue Pilot!

Subteralien Rescue is a physics based sidescroller where you pilot a lander module assigned to explore underground caverns and bases. Your mothership transports you from planet to planet to encounter new levels with different puzzles and environments. You will find and make use of resources to solve puzzles, rescue your fellow pilots and fight enemies.

Over the course of several missions, you will be able to upgrade your lander with stronger hulls, better engines and weapons as well as talk to NPCs as an interesting and compelling narrative unfolds. The levels involve careful navigation and control of your lander in a variety of physics based environments such as low gravity, wind tunnels and underwater. There are also a number of hazards and enemies to defeat such as wind turbines blocked tunnels, bunkers and a variety of robots with different weapon configurations. Fuel barrels and landing pad can recharge your lander. Power orbs can be found and placed in their containment holders to complete mission objectives and power up or unlock doors and other features in the underground bases.

  • 20 levels of challenging game play (possibly more with success of crowd funding)
  • Arcade and story modes to the game
  • Unique weapons inventory and ship upgrade system
  • 25 Original designed Alien Robot enemies
  • Challenging game level environmental puzzles.

data.name: Geo Defense
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Geometry Defense is a minimalist geometric action shooter.

Face waves of constantly appearing geometric enemies and control your unit to survive against increasingly dangerous attacks. Defeating enemies allows you to collect resources, strengthen yourself, and unlock powerful upgrades.

As the game progresses, enemy numbers, movement speed, and attack patterns will continue to change. You will need to choose different upgrade paths based on the situation, combine various abilities, and gradually build your own unique combat style.

The core experience of the game focuses on simple controls, rapid progression, and continuous challenges. Every run offers new choices, allowing you to experiment with different upgrade combinations and discover the playstyle that suits you best.

Whether you enjoy chasing high scores or simply want a quick and relaxing combat experience, Geometry Defense aims to provide a simple and satisfying gameplay experience.

Features

Easy-to-Learn Controls

No complicated tutorials or mechanics are required. Jump straight into the action and focus on movement, shooting, and upgrading.

Progressive Upgrade System

Collect resources through combat and choose different upgrade paths to gradually increase your power.

Increasing Enemy Challenges

As time passes, enemies become more numerous and dangerous, testing your reactions and strategic decisions.

Clean Geometric Visual Style

The game features a clear and vibrant geometric art style, focusing on satisfying combat feedback and gameplay experience.

data.name: Tichu
data.detailed_description:
Tichu is a game of partnership, timing, and calculated risk.

Team up with a partner and compete against another team of two. Race to play all of your cards, support your teammate, disrupt your opponents, and decide when the moment is right to call Tichu or Grand Tichu.

The familiar deck is transformed by four unique special cards [Mahjong, Hound, Phoenix, and Dragon] each capable of changing the flow of a hand. Make wishes, play bombs, build flexible combinations, and use tactical interrupts that can turn a round around in seconds.

Choose how you play

Ranked
Enter competitive 2v2 matchmaking, build your ranking, and put your teamwork and decision-making to the test.

Unranked
Create or join public or private rooms, play with friends or other players, use text and voice chat, and enjoy Tichu without ranked pressure.

VS AI
Play offline against computer controlled opponents in Easy, Normal, and Hard difficulty settings.

A complete digital Tichu experience

  • Full Tichu rules

  • 500-point and 1000-point match options

  • Special cards and key plays come to life with contextual animations, VFX and SFX

  • Persistent player statistics, achievements, rankings and leaderboards

  • Built-in player manual covering the rules and special situations

  • Player profiles, friends, invitations, blocking and reporting tools

Match your own style

Choose between different avatars, cursors, card decks, including the original Tichu artwork by Res Brandenberger, used with permission from Fata Morgana Spiele.

You can also import your own custom card artwork locally and switch between decks from the customization menu.

Completely free

Tichu is 100% free, with no advertisements, in-app purchases, paid DLC, subscriptions or other monetization.

data.name: NECHROMIA
data.detailed_description:
FOLLOW THE PRE-PAGE ON KICKSTARTER


About the Game

Explore a vast gothic castle divided between reality and living paintings containing twisted worlds filled with monsters, puzzles, and tragedy inside. Every area hides new dangers, secrets, and abilities that will help you descend deeper into the nightmare. Armed only with a lantern, you must manage your sanity, manipulate light itself, and discover new abilities to survive.

FEATURES

  • Explore a massive gothic castle and its surrounding areas;

  • Enter paintings inspired by sin, grief and memories;

  • Use your lantern for combat, puzzles and exploration;

  • Manage your sanity by staying in lit areas;

  • Discover a narrative told through atmosphere, documents and exploration;

  • Multiple endings based on your actions.

MASTER THE LIGHT

Your lantern is your only defense against the darkness consuming the castle. As you explore its twisted halls and the worlds hidden within its paintings, you'll unlock abilities that help you survive. Reveal what's hidden, shield yourself from danger, manipulate time itself or sacrifice your own sanity to restore your health. Some abilities help you evade the horrors stalking the halls, others allow you to confront them directly.

A WORLD INSIDE THE WALLS

Beyond its abandoned halls lies a series of weird places: silent dormitories, overgrown gardens, decaying galleries, clockwork machinery and sacred halls twisted into something profane. But the greatest horrors hide inside the paintings scattered throughout the castle. Each painting leads to a distorted world shaped by sin. To survive, you must enter them, uncover their secrets and claim the abilities needed to escape the castle.

SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARE

Some creatures stalk the darkness, others react to light, forcing you to carefully choose when to hide, run or fight back. Silent praying figures patrol corridors and grotesque creatures wait patiently above, hidden in the shadows. As the castle reveals its true nature, you'll confront increasingly disturbing manifestations of guilt and sin, culminating in nightmarish bosses guarding the path forward.

THERE IS NO ESCAPE FROM GUILT

Your choices will determine whether you break the cycle and find redemption...

... or remain trapped forever inside the castle.

data.name: Chicken Feet
data.detailed_description:
You are a new intern at GOOBER Laboratories, a world-renown research center for genetic engineering. After a giant chicken breaks out of its containment and kills dozens of workers, you are sent in to subdue it. Guided by a voice over the radio, you descend into the facility, luring the Chicken to a place where it can be safely captured. However, the plan quickly goes off the rails.

You have no way of defending yourself. Your only choices are to run, hide, or die.

This Game Features:

  • A deeply atmospheric and terrifying world.
  • A compelling and interesting story.
  • No loading screens between levels.

Run For Your Life:

  • The Chicken may be faster than you, but you're smarter.
  • Use your wits to cut corners, slide into small spaces, and evade the Chicken.
  • Darkness is your friend. Embrace it, and maybe the Chicken won't see you.

Explore:

  • Travel into the depths of the facility and visit unique locations that challenge your wits.

Uncover a Mystery:

  • There is something else going on. Find voice recordings scattered around the facility to gain insight into the employees and their work.



Built with Unreal Engine 5.

data.name: Fighting Fiends
data.detailed_description:
Discover A New Kind Of Fighting Game!

Fighting Fiends is a top-down fighting game which can be played with 2 to 4 players, both locally and online! It features a unique combo system that requires you to read your opponent to get big combos.

Rollback Netcode

Fighting Fiends has rollback netcode! Rollback is the best kind of netcode for fighting games, basically it means online matches will be smooth even at relatively high ping.

Characters

Leon

A national hero who protects the land from evil...
Leon has fast movement and attack speed but short range. When up close he will beat you up with powerful mix-ups and combos.

Rat

His motives are unclear, is it even the same rat every time? Rumor has it he's a big shot in the underground Rat Mafia, if such a thing even exists...
Rat's movement speed is very fast and his forward facing attacks are strong, but he has trouble turning around. To make up for it he can stand on his hind legs and move around more freely at the cost of being hard to control.

Nicolas

Not too long ago Leons little brother Nic fused with a demon named Olas, together they have been terrorizing the land ever since...
Nicolas is a powerful but somewhat slow setup character. He is most powerful when his opponent is in his fireballs range which he can explode remotely.

More characters to come...

data.name: As Long As She Forgot
data.detailed_description:
As Long As She Forgot - is a short horror game in the "Walking Simulator" genre.

Average playtime: 30–40 minutes.

Description: 

Marlene has spent the day preparing for her family's visit. The house is quiet, everything is in its place, and all that's left to do is wait.

As the rain grows heavier, everything begins to feel strange. The home that once brought comfort slowly becomes suffocating.

Explore a detailed home, uncover its secrets, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together a haunting psychological story.

This is a story about grief, and how it can quietly reshape a person's world.

Cover Art: Original photography by Chalmers Butterfield. Wikimedia Commons CC BY 2.5

data.name: Nirvana, Origin of Fate
data.detailed_description:
3D third-person game that will take you on an adventure to an island in strange times. Discover your character's ability to survive and develop a long-term metapsychic story. The game allows you to simulate the character's survival needs and find meaning in adventure, and create a bond with the other characters in the game, to develop their ability to control the elements of the island.

The story begins in a camp, where the player will find refuge from the very beginning.

In a visually stunning environment, learn to communicate using animistic verbs and interact with non-player characters. You can hunt, fish, and gather. You'll be able to explore the island, learn to control the elements of nature, craft your tools, customize your appearance, and more.

Explore the area and mark your path through the brush and rocks, and look for other camps.

Events quickly give the adventure a plot twist.

The player will face the seasons and the elements for an adventure that is as fun as it is educational.

The player navigates an island generated by a keyword chosen by the player at the beginning of the game, which provides a number of possible islands. A first person mode is available for immersion.

A game for nature lovers trapped in their social housing with a flashlight under the covers!

data.name: Hard, Fast, & Flashy
data.detailed_description:
WARNING: THIS GAME IS HARD AS F***!!

Run, jump, and blast your way through an unforgiving cyberscape at breakneck speeds, pushing your mind and body to their limits in the never ending pursuit of perfection.

Studies show that nearly 15% of people enjoy being punished...Do you like it hard and fast?

FEATURES:

  • Precise, first-person shooter meets fast-paced platformer to create a unique speedrunning challenge.
  • 10 levels with difficulties ranging from “It took 15 tries but I finally got it!” to “THIS S*** IS F****** IMPOSSIBLE!!” (though we promise every level is beatable)
  • A pulse-pounding, electronic soundtrack that’s guaranteed to keep your heart pumping.
  • Blaze through a synthwave cyberscape with high-octane, momentum-based movement.
  • Non-linear level design allows for creative strategies to achieve maximum speed - this game is meant to be broken!
  • It’s free! This is a passion project that we want to share with you, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do!

INSPIRATIONS:

Inspired by challenging, fair, and fast-paced games like Dark Souls, Quake, and Celeste, we sought out to develop a game that combined our favorite parts from each. The result was Hard, Fast, and Flashy: a momentum-based platformer with retro aesthetics and a definitively modern gameplay feel.

UPCOMING FIXES:

  • Improved performance through animation rendering.
  • Improved camera angle (modified FOV, visible feet, centered model).
  • Additional settings for key rebinds, VSYNC, and mouse sensitivity.
  • Reworked physics to allow for greater conservation of momentum and better aerial control.
  • Reworked instructions and menus.
  • Voice acting for player character and main menu.

data.name: Factopia
data.detailed_description:
Build the machine that builds the city.

Factopia combines the deep, satisfying logistics of a factory-automation game with the growth and management of a city builder. Design production lines that mine, process, and assemble resources — then route everything you make into a living city that depends on it.

Nothing in Factopia exists in isolation. The steel you smelt becomes the beams for a new hospital wing. The electronics you assemble stock a police station's equipment. Every chain you optimize on the factory side has a direct, visible payoff on the city side.

KEY FEATURES

  • Factory-Grade Automation — Design multi-stage production chains, balance throughput, and eliminate bottlenecks across sprawling industrial complexes.

  • A City That Needs You — Residential, commercial, and industrial zones grow based on the resources and services you actually deliver, not abstract meters.

  • Essential Services, Real Stakes — Keep schools staffed, hospitals stocked, police funded, and fire departments equipped. Neglect the supply chain and the city feels it.

  • Density & Happiness Systems — Manage how your city grows vertically and horizontally, and keep citizens satisfied as demand scales.

  • Built for Optimizers — Clean, legible systems reward players who love fine-tuning throughput as much as watching a skyline grow.

EARLY ACCESS

Factopia is entering Early Access with its core factory-to-city loop fully playable. Over the course of Early Access, we're expanding vehicles, deepening logistics, and adding new city systems on the way to 1.0 — with your feedback shaping priorities along the way.

data.name: 死亡旅店Ⅱ亡者归来-Death Inn Ⅱ The Immortal Is Coming
data.detailed_description:
An ordinary movie crew walks into a cursed castle, but can't find a way out... Murders that spanned seven centuries have resurfaced, and those who died 100 years ago are back in the background.

An ancient castle full of fog, midnight all sorts of weird things happen one after another, and people die mysteriously, everyone is apprehensive and uneasy.

You need to try to survive here and explore ways to escape. Be careful with every judgment you make. Every choice you make determines the outcome.

Only calm thinking can solve the puzzle and escape from this nightmare place.


Game Play

You will play the role of Yu Qiu, the stunt double of the crew, or Duan Kexin, the heroine of Death Inn. You will come to the castle with other crew members to explore the mysterious truth under the fog.

The second view is triggered by a hidden line after an underground expedition, and the player can then choose the view.

The operation mode is simple, easy to use, a variety of game props improve the game playability.

There are several mysterious personas that require the player to pick holes in each one's words. Use clue gathering, plot judgment, and choice options to reach various endings

The plot is closely linked, and there are many subtle clues in different branches due to plot differences. You need to analyze every detail to solve the puzzle.


Features

"Death Inn Ⅱ- The Immortal Is Coming" to follow the first "Death Inn" story, is a plot to the suspense survival theme of the work.

Dark scenes and gloomy background music, creating a scary and exciting atmosphere, let the player immersive.

Double female perspective mode. With the cast's understudy Yu Qiu as the first point of view, "Death Inn" female lead Duan Kexin as the second point of view, the outcome of the two routes are different.

The story is rich and wonderful. The player can make choices based on their own reasoning, and events unfold in a very confusing way. Who will be next, the outcome is surprising.

data.name: Driftwood
data.detailed_description:
You think sloths are slow? Well, Eddy is here to prove you wrong.

In Driftwood, you’ll experience high-speed downhill longboarding as an aerodynamic sloth. Drifting is the name of the game, as it’ll help you strike the perfect balance between speed and control. Drift through tight corners to avoid collision with cars and obstacles, and perform wicked tricks as you take in the beautiful landscape around you. These tricks will help you score points, which will unlock new boards that can be combined with various wheels for diverse skating styles.

  • Dream of skating as a sloth? Look no further – Driftwood lets you enjoy flowy longboarding as Eddy, who will acquire new boards, wheels, and clothes that will enhance the experience.

  • Race through beautiful scenery with relaxing music as the backdrop. Focus on vibes and tricks – Driftwood has no story campaign or obligations.

  • Immerse yourself in a contained world – Driftwood is not an open-world game; it’s a focused, minimalist experience.

  • Fun in solo or online with friends – Driftwood allows you to skate on your own, beat personal challenges and compare your runs in online leaderboards or host a lobby with up to 8 friends in the p2p multiplayer mode!

  • Travel to newly unlocked islands with your van – Driftwood has 15+ levels for you to skate and drift to your heart’s content.

We’re a small team consisting of just one artist and one programmer. We’ve set out to make a game that provides an intense downhill longboarding experience without much fluff, just a focus on drifting and flow. While there are no freestyle skateboarding tricks in Driftwood, we hope you enjoy the content in our game!

Drift through tight corners to avoid collision with cars and obstacles, and perform wicked tricks as you take in the beautiful landscape around you. These tricks will help you score points, which will unlock new boards that can be combined with various wheels for diverse skating styles.

  • Dream of skating as a sloth? Look no further – Driftwood lets you enjoy flowy longboarding as Eddy, who will acquire new boards, wheels, and clothes that will enhance the experience.

  • Race through beautiful scenery with relaxing music as the backdrop. Focus on vibes and tricks – Driftwood has no story campaign or obligations.

  • Immerse yourself in a contained world – Driftwood is not an open-world game; it’s a focused, minimalist experience.

  • Fun in solo or online with friends – Driftwood allows you to skate on your own, beat personal challenges and compare your runs in online leaderboards or host a lobby with up to 8 friends in the p2p multiplayer mode!

  • Travel to newly unlocked islands with your van – Driftwood has 15+ levels for you to skate and drift to your heart’s content.

We’re a small team consisting of just one artist and one programmer. We’ve set out to make a game that provides an intense downhill longboarding experience without much fluff, just a focus on drifting and flow. While there are no freestyle skateboarding tricks in Driftwood, we hope you enjoy the content in our game!

data.name: Astra Genesis
data.detailed_description:
Build your colony. Find your allies.

Astra Genesis is an independent multiplayer space strategy and colony management game. Develop your industry, research new technologies and explore a shared galaxy. Build alongside other players, trade and join an alliance.

PvE at the core. PvP by choice.

Grow your colony and prepare expeditions without being forced into player-versus-player combat. You choose whether to enable PvP in the options. Attacks are restricted to set hours, and combat follows rules that limit destruction. There is no pay to win.

Planned after launch: alliance PvE raids will give alliances shared PvE challenges. They are planned for a later update and will not be available in the initial release.

Make the colony work

Assign workers, balance your power supply and connect your production chains. A factory needs more than an empty plot: it needs the resources and infrastructure to keep running. Choose which bottleneck to solve and which upgrade can wait.

Work through 29 buildings and 64 technologies. Production, construction and research continue while you are offline, so you can return to the colony and decide what comes next.

Prepare the next expedition

Choose your ships, plan your approach and weigh the rewards against the risks before leaving the colony. Explore a galaxy of 100 star systems and 5,000 planets, then use what you discover to guide your development.

This is a menu-driven strategy and management game. The focus is on the colony economy, research, expeditions and multiplayer decisions. English and French interfaces are available.

data.name: Built the End
data.detailed_description:
They are coming.

An endless wave of machines is advancing, and your base is the last line of defense. In Built the End, you must construct and adapt your defenses to survive increasingly dangerous robotic assaults in this fast-evolving take on the tower defense genre.

Build and position a wide range of towers, each designed for a specific role. Some deliver heavy damage, others slow or disrupt enemies, and some are built to counter particular machine types. Success depends on how well you combine and position your defenses as new threats emerge.

Gather resources from the environment to expand and reinforce your base, making constant decisions about when to invest in new towers, upgrade existing ones, or prepare for the next wave.

Enemy waves grow more complex over time, introducing new behaviors and attack patterns that force you to adapt. Swarms, heavily armored units, and specialized attackers will challenge even the strongest defenses. No single setup will hold forever.

Push your defenses further each run, refine your approach, and experiment with different tower combinations to see how long you can last.

Every wave is a test. Every choice matters. How long can you hold the line?

data.name: Defend Against Cats
data.detailed_description:
Cats are invading your home, and your workstation is their favorite target.

In Defend Against Cats, each level represents a desperate work day before a looming deadline. Waves of mischievous cats sneak in, scratch your monitor, knock your mouse around, and sprawl across your keyboard, steadily destroying your productivity.

To stop them, you place food bowls, feeders, and toy-based defenses around your room. Hungry cats can be fed and sent away, while satisfied cats must be distracted with toys before they start tearing your setup apart. Different cats behave differently, with faster, greedier, and larger cats appearing as the invasion escalates day by day.

A compact, replayable playthrough designed for quick sessions, leading to different endings depending on whether you finish your work… or give up and pet the cat.

data.name: Miasma: Citizens of Free Thought
data.detailed_description:
Miasma was originally released in 2010 as an Xbox Live Indie Game, and had a small cult following at the time. It's now been rebuilt for modern processors and made available on Steam with support for Cloud Saves, Achievements and Steam Leaderboards. It is presented here as an intriguing glimpse into the state of Xbox Live Arcade/Xbox Live Indie Games at the time.

Original (2010) description:

Miasma is a turn-based strategy game set in a dystopian future; where the mega-corporation Vilhelm Industries rules the world and everyone blindly and inexplicably follows their regime. Join a small band of rebels, specialise and develop their skills, and lead them in an attempt to restore everyone's individuality.

Featuring:

Awesome turn-based strategy gameplay
Cutting edge graphics and sound effects
Epic music score by Heather Fenoughty and Bjorn Lynne
An engaging and interactive story of romance, loss and redemption
Survival mode and online highscores

data.name: Ultimate Chopsticks
data.detailed_description:
Chopsticks is a logic hand game with its origins in Japan. It is played the world over.

Players extend hands to towards each other with one finger out and take it in turns to tap each others hands. The tapped hand extends more fingers equal to the fingers on the hand that tapped it. A hand full of fingers is "knocked out". There are many variants of rules, many of which are captured here, including splitting fingers between hands, different number of hands and different number of fingers per hand.

Play against an AI or another human or try and complete a set of challenges.

data.name: Littlewitch Romanesque: Editio Regia
data.detailed_description:
Story

Welcome to Stella Mundo, a magical world still recovering from the devastation of the Mage War that ended the Age of Towers.

Domino, the youngest wizard ever to earn the rank of Archmage, has just begun his study of the ancient Dark Tower, a treasure trove of lost magical knowledge.

But there’s a catch.

As its price for allowing him access to the tower, the corrupt Council of Archmagi has assigned Domino two gifted but troublesome students - Aria, the daughter of a noble family, and Kaya, an orphan with an unusual heritage - and given him just three years to complete their training, a process that normally takes decades.

Gameplay


As Domino, you must mentor Aria and Kaya in their training to become witches, mastering the magical arts. Take them to the classroom to grow the skills required to master powerful spells. Send them on quests to test their progress and show them the dangers that exist in the world. And mentor them in the value of friendship, a mage's strongest asset.

On your adventure you'll encounter dragons, assassins, fairy queens, elvish hunters, warrior angels, and many ferocious creatures. However, the most dangerous could be yourself...

Become a Teacher of Magic
Instruct your students in the art of magic. Through your techniques lesson combinations, your students will learn in different ways, developing their skills as you direct. With enough time in the classroom, your students will be able to acquire new spells, each with unique powers and chances to unlock special paths in the game's story.

Embark on Quests
The classroom isn't the only place where your students can learn. Instruct them to go on quests to unlock their potential and find out able the wonders, and dangers, of the world. As their teacher you refuse to let your student go on dangerous quests beyond their skill level, so you must keep them learning so they can tackle more difficult adventures.

Story-Focused Gameplay
  • 30+ hours of story, voiced in Japanese and subtitled English
  • 300+ CGs by famed illustrator Ashito Oyari
  • 100 spells to learn
  • 79 quests to complete
  • 20 endings to unlock
  • 3 bonus add-on stories to enjoy

A- – The Otaku Study

“Not only is the magical storyline interesting but the cast of distinct characters really bring the world to life. This is counterbalanced by a surprisingly addictive gameplay system which pairs luck with strategy in order to take on tons of quests. In absence of adult content, the game still stands tall as both its storyline and gameplay are excellent. There’s no need to lure players in with sexuality, unlike some other titles.”
4.5/5 – HardcoreGamer

data.name: Red Trigger
data.detailed_description:
Important notice

We have a huge sequel in development, Red Trigger 2, it will be 10 times bigger, much more complex and open. All the characters are fully voice-acted and are full of personality. Interested? Make sure to wishlist it now!


About the Game

Red Trigger is a First Person Shooter (FPS) Puzzle game, inspired by games like Portal, Antichamber, Superliminal, The Witness and more, but very much has its own identity.


In Red Trigger, the main mechanic revolves around you shooting red blocks called Red Triggers. When you shoot a Red Trigger, it expands, and when you shoot it back, it retracts.


However, you can only expand three Red Triggers at a time, so you must manage your energy wisely. You can either retract Red Triggers one at a time, or all at once. Be careful though, you don't want to do that while standing on an extended block over a deep, deep void below you!


The Red Triggers are used in many different ways like making platforms, blocking lasers, holding doors open, powering systems, propelling yourself, inputting codes and more!


You play as a computer virus called Red Trigger. Corrupt the computer system you're infiltrating! Beware, this won't be easy, as you'll need to do an escape sequence to return to safety as it crumbles!

Red Trigger was initially final student project made by Maxime Vézina, in Unreal Engine 4. It also won the prize of Choice of the Industry at ImagiNAD in May 2016, as well as Best Indie Game 2016 from Waiting4Players.

Since then, Maxime gained experience in the Triple-A Industry and founded his own indie studio, Bold Spirit Game Studio. In 2023, this game has been remade from scratch in 2023 from a team of more than 15 people, and contains a ton of new features. It will be updated soon with this new content. The game lasts for about 40 minutes to 1 hour+, depending on the player.

The studio is also currently making the sequel, Red Trigger 2, which will be 10 times bigger than this game, much more complex and open. Interested? Make sure to wishlist it now!

data.name: Separium: 12th Elevator
data.detailed_description:
You are the Administrator of Separium. Complete AI Purry's mission—to assess anomalies in the elevator—and reach the Administrator's Office on the 12th floor.

Follow these steps to proceed:

  • Rotate counterclockwise and memorize the elements that belong to the Separium elevator.

  • Determine if this elevator is normal or anomalous.

    • If it is normal, choose to "Retain" the elevator.

    • If it is anomalous, exit through the door to escape from the elevator.

  • If your judgment is correct, the elevator will ascend one floor.

  • Upon reaching the 12th floor, review Purry's final question.

  • Based on your answer, Purry will decide whether you qualify as the Administrator.

/
Separium: 12th Elevator is a game simulation set in the fictional space of Separium within Team Pearl’s sci-fi universe, Sepafuturism. It draws inspiration from the liminal space genre and The Exit 8.

data.name: Goldhaven
data.detailed_description:
UP OR OUT.

You're a new grad drowning in six figures of student debt when Marcus Thorne makes the only offer you'll ever get: a chair on the Goldhaven Capital trading floor. The deal is simple arithmetic — hit your number every week, or security walks you out before lunch. Clear your debt and you're free. Make Partner and the debt becomes a rounding error. Everything else is commentary.

 

THE WEEKLY LOOP

Every run is a career compressed into weeks. Read your Monday briefing — market theme, quota, SEC heat, the desk leaderboard. Build a book on the floor. Lock in and watch it settle. Survive the weekend bills, spend your credits in the back office, and do it again — against a quota that only ever grows.

 

FOUR WAYS TO BET

ETFs — steady sector baskets with the most reliable tape reads. Training wheels that still pay.

Stocks — bigger moves, murkier reads, bigger payouts.

Coins — near coin-flip chaos at maximum multiplier. Pure adrenaline.

]Options — pay a premium, cap your loss, swing for 5x.

Then multiply everything with leverage — and pray you never hear the words margin call

 

THE THREATS

The quota— miss it and you burn a golden parachute. Run out of parachutes and the next miss ends your career.

The IRS— let your debt balloon and the audits begin. Three strikes and it's handcuffs.

The SEC — insider reveals, heavy leverage and reckless books raise your heat. At 90, they raid the floor.

The desk — four rivals trade beside you. Finish last too often and you're the one who gets cut.

 

A FLOOR FULL OF STORIES

Over 35 after-hours scenes shape every run: a rival who wants your seat, calls from a family you're forgetting, journalists, auditors, whales, fixers — and Thorne's six-step ladder into the rooms where the real decisions happen. Stay clean or get your hands dirty; your reputation follows you, and it decides which of 9 endings across story threads you earn.

 

RUNS THAT BUILD A CAREER

 playable backgrounds, from the State-School Grind to the Nepo Baby — each with its own math.

Master skills (buy the same skill 3 times in one run) to keep them forever.

Lifestyle assets carry between runs. The pocket doesn't. Spend wisely.

Thorne's Ledger — six stacking difficulty rungs for players who want the climb to hurt.

Seeded runs — share a seed, race the same market.

save slots with mid-run resume.

Full English and Turkish language support.

 

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

GOLDHAVEN is my first game — built solo in Istanbul. That means every piece of feedback genuinely shapes what happens next: bug reports, balance complaints, feature ideas, all of it. If something feels off, tell me. I read everything, and the game will keep evolving based on what you say.

 

Two ways off this floor, kid. Up... or out.

data.detailed_description:
About Our Studio


I'm Edwin aka Eddie WinBack The Founder of Cede and our studio BareHand. I worked in AAA games and I decided to take the indie route after I was laid off at WB games. I'm building Cede right out of this tiny house. Join our community:


About the Game



Cede is a Strategic Action-RPG modernized by a unique mechanic called Combat Farming. Dive into the shattered pieces of your planet with 3 additional friends online, burst swarms of foes into seeds, and transform them into vegetation known as “changers”. Synchronize with your squad building the best loadouts for optimal changer benefits!


Conflict between brothers has cracked the planet into pieces with barely any crops and plants to survive from. Seph and his creations called "Littles" combine their abilities through Combat Farming in which monsters are burst into seeds becoming vegetation. This vegetation can assist you in combat in various ways. One plant grown may fire projectiles at enemies while another plant increases your speed. The wasteland is your plant canvas!

data.name: Celestial Visitor
data.detailed_description:
A meteor struck the world, bringing with it a cataclysmic disaster while bestowing magical powers upon the survivors. Just as humanity became intoxicated by this new power, monsters of various forms emerged without warning, ravaging the globe and trampling all life. Suddenly, like the fall of the meteor, despair once again enveloped the earth. To resist these monsters and reclaim their homeland, tribes from all around the world selected the strongest warriors to launch a desperate counterattack against these creatures.

The game controls are very simple: W: Move up, A: Move left, S: Move down, D: Move right, SPACE: Release skill.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The game features two modes: Entertainment Mode and Challenge Mode. Entertainment Mode is suitable for players who simply want to experience the thrill of defeating large numbers of monsters, while Challenge Mode is designed for those looking to test their skills against the game's difficulty. Additionally, the game includes a skill system with both pure damage skills and support skills, which play a more significant role in Challenge Mode.

1. Casual Mode: Items and maps have no debuff effects, and monster types appear in fixed sets.

2. Challenge Mode: Items and maps have debuffs. Monster types per wave are randomized. The final wave lasts 160 seconds with continuously strengthening monsters. Skill cooldown is increased to 15 seconds. Players must survive the entire 160-second phase.

Players can choose from the following character classes: Monk, Pirate, Knight, Mage, Thief, Taoist, Shaman, Samurai, and Hunter, each with their own innate abilities.

Weapon types include: sword, hammer, axe, bow, spear, magic staff, and dagger, totaling 27 types, each with different attack effects. There are also 20 skills to assist in combat.

data.name: Heroine Anthem Zero -Sacrifice-
data.detailed_description:
With a emotionally resonating soundtrack and beautiful visual art style, Heroine Anthem Zero is the FIRST EPISODE in an epic fantasy adventure game from WindThunder Studio.
An unforgettable experience that blends storytelling, music and stunning visuals, it is over ten years in the making. Come and enter the moving world of adventure from long ago.



The story begins with the last Cataclysm, with the descendants of the Savior rebuilding the land around the World Tree Terasyr. Thousands of years later the Engora Dynasty grows into prosperity, with Fae and Human together resisting the encroaching advances of evil from the edges of the world, and deathly Longhorn Woods.
As fate brings Wanin the Forest Keeper and the wandering cat-girl Shama Kutami together, the entangling web of destinies unfolds. In a world unforgiven by God, their fight for survival unknowingly bears the weight and sins of thousands of generations hereafter.

key Features

1. Available in English for the first time! Heroine Anthem Zero is the first game in the series to support English!

2. Featuring well-known Voice Actors in various languages, including Yūsuke Kobayashi (The Heroic Legend of Arslan) and Tomoka Wakabayashi (The iDOLM@STER)

3. Exquisitely detailed 2D visuals, bring the world of Heroine Anthem Zero to life with its vibrant characters and stunning world setting.


4. A hauntingly beautiful soundtrack, following in the tradition of the Heroine Anthem series: famous composers (known for their work in RPG classics such as Chinese Paladin series) as well as Japanese composers new to the series have joined forces to produce unforgettable music.

5. Weapons and skills -- Character progression is closely tied to the weapon and items in Heroine Anthem Zero, switching weapons changes damage and other attributes,as well as attack motions. Weapons can also interact with the stage levels.


6. Explore carefully crafted side-scrolling maps and dungeons, solve interactive puzzles and discover hidden treasure locations for powerful items.

data.name: Forecast Death
data.detailed_description:
SURVIVE THE MONSTER HORDE

Forecast Death is a dynamic 2D action game in the bullet heaven roguelite genre. Fight endless hordes of monsters, collect experience, and power up your hero. Choose your weapons, combine upgrades, and discover powerful combinations that can turn the tide of battle. With each level, your hero grows stronger.

NATURE AGAINST YOU

Monsters are not the only threat. Thunderstorms, fog, earthquakes, and other cataclysms can change the course of battle. Adapt to changing conditions, stay aware of your surroundings, and find ways to turn nature to your advantage.

CRAFT YOUR BUILD. CRUSH THE HORDE.

Every choice shapes your hero's development. Experiment with combinations to discover new ways to destroy your enemies. Combine weapons and upgrades, unlock evolutions, and create devastating builds capable of wiping out entire hordes of monsters. Find your own strategy and see if you can stand against the most dangerous enemies.

FEATURES

  • Heroes with Different Stats - choose your character and make the most of their strengths.

  • Hundreds of Upgrades - combine effects and create your own builds.

  • Weapon Evolutions - unlock more powerful forms of your weapons.

  • Cataclysms - adapt to changing conditions and new threats.

  • Escalating Difficulty - withstand ever more dangerous hordes and try to survive until the end of your run.

data.name: Bow Hunter
data.detailed_description:
Play as a prehistoric Neanderthal bow hunter..

Travel to unlimited procedural islands... desert islands, forest islands, and winter islands..

Hunt animals for meat, bones, and fur. Take your shot in first person view..

Provide for your family..

Hunt for rare trophies..

Harvest materials, craft new items; pemmican, arrows, armor, and moveable barriers/blinds.

And survive as long as you can, for a chance to take down a rare Mythic beast!

  • Winter Islands: Deer, wolfs, smiladons, bears, bison, moose and mammoths + mythic

Trophy types include:

  • Silver

  • Gold

  • Diamond

  • Mythic

  • All animals have a chance to spawn in a rare form

data.name: The Quinfall
data.detailed_description:
Embark on an adventurous journey to explore the Quinfall universe. Be a part of unique battles and an immersive story with dozens of different professions in the depths of medieval times in an all-new MMORPG experience.

OPEN WORLD

Explore the world's largest MMORPG map with an area of 2016km2. Shape your adventure in five regions with their own unique, distinct climates. A living world awaits you with a map that adapts to four seasons with changing weather conditions and a day-night cycle.

WAR

Non-Target combat dynamics and a PVP-PVE experience based on sleight of hand and player experience allow you to experience all battles with a greater sense of spectacle and depth. Experience immersive medieval combat with thrilling ship battles, island skirmishes and castle sieges. The open-world PVP system brings a whole new combat experience every step of the way.

PROFESSION

Organize your equipment according to your own play style with a specialization system consisting of dozens of different professions suitable for the time and 9 different weapon systems. Don't depend on the odds with an equipment crafting and development system that is not luck-oriented. Sell your products to other players with the dynamic trade system and create trade routes with caravans. Never be alone on your journeys with countless mounts and pets to accompany your character. Build your own home or create your clan island with your friends. Discover unique monsters, events and locations that fit the Quinfall storyline.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

Create a character that's all your own, in the style you want. Add a unique touch to your character with hundreds of different muscle and bone controls on the face.

STORY

Explore the impact of the monstrous god Pelyonas, the dragonborn gods Greis and Kreas, and many more gods on the universe. Uncover the backstories of dozens of main characters with deep-rooted stories, or observe the fractured daily lives of others in the realm. Learn the secret behind the cursed crown that changed Quinfall's fate. Bring peace and tranquility to a universe plunged into civil war, or become part of the growing chaos. Become part of this unique adventure as you play through a constantly updating story. Remember that the choices you make can change the fate of the Quinfall universe.

OPTIMIZATION

Get ready for a hyper-realistic world with advanced graphics and state-of-the-art systems. Get optimal performance on every system with unprecedented high-level optimization. Enjoy smooth gameplay even in high player counts and crowded environments.

data.name: Leprechaun Shadow
data.detailed_description:
As the brave knight Sir Typhil of Creulor continues his quest to bring a unicorn to the castle and be crowned king, he finds himself entangled in the troubles of Yorkwen City, and must catch a rutabaga-snatching killer before it's too late.

As with all of the games in the series, Leprechaun Shadow is mainly a point & click adventure, but with elements of other types of games present as well. In this episode, there are Hidden Object scenes, and a section of the game is a CRPG.

Enjoy these great features:

  • Interrogate Witnesses!
  • Search for Clues!
  • Solve Puzzles!

There are also Hidden Object sections in which you look for specific key clues by finding items within a scene!

A portion of the game is a CRPG game, and as such contains the following features:

  • Along with a team of allies, fight monsters in turn-based combat and level up skills to progress.
  • Choose which allies to bring along. Each have their own skills.

While a stand-alone game in its own right, this game continues the over-arching story from the previous two games in the series:



Also, see the sequels:

data.name: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】
data.detailed_description:
Craft. Sabotage. Survive.

In a world where the Dark Overlord rules with an iron fist, one alchemist's quest for redemption becomes a divine mission of resistance.

「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】is a story-driven stealth action immersive sim that puts players in the role of Auronika Cortez, a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter in a dark medieval-industrial world.

As Auronika, you’ll help bring down the tyrants using your forbidden A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. skills, crafting potions for the resistance and manufacturing magical bombs to directly attack your oppressors.

Outsmart the regime and turn the tides of secret war - one concoction or explosion at a time.

Key Features

  • Revolutionary Crafting System: Master the art of medieval alchemistry through an innovative A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. system. Combine reagents to create powerful concoctions and tools for the resistance.

  • Dynamic Stealth Gameplay: Navigate a vertically-stratified city where every shadow could mean survival. Dodge patrols, exploit vantage points, and escape through the underground networks of a society divided by power and privilege.

  • Demolition: Enjoy destroying buildings in a fully destroyable city environment.

  • Morally Complex Narrative: Experience a story of resistance, redemption, and the price of freedom as Auronika must navigate between her heavenly mandate and the brutal realities of uprising.

data.detailed_description:
