data.name: Knights of the Chalice
data.detailed_description:
Knights of the Chalice is a 2D RPG with turn-based combat for Windows. The game uses the OGL 3.5, the set of rules at the root of Dungeons & Dragons 3.5, a role-playing game from Wizards of the Coast. Create a party of four adventurers, explore the Crimson Coast of Mindrel and fight valiantly against the evil Council of the Slaver Lords, domineering Giants, fiendish Demons and scheming Dragons.

  • Turn-based, party-based tactical combat similar to that found in the old Dark Sun Shattered Lands game made by SSI and in Troika's Temple of Elemental Evil.

  • User-friendly interface. Launch a charge, full-attack or coup-de-grace with a single click - the computer will automatically look for the best option available.

  • Well-developed artificial intelligence. Enemies act as a group and use special actions like Grapple or Charge and tactics like taking a five-foot step before casting Maximised Fireball.

  • Omnipresent help files and clear in-game feedback (a feature also found in Temple of Elemental Evil) on the results of each dice roll, saving throw, attack roll, modifiers, etc.

  • 175 magic spells, most of which were taken from, or inspired by, Wizard of the Coast's open game content. The list of spells is available from the developer's website.

  • Craft your own weapons and apply enchantments like Wounding, Speed, Flaming Burst and Keen. The lists of weapon enchantments and feats are in the developer's website.

  • Multiple-choice dialogue allowing you to resolve situations in unexpected ways.

  • A large campaign largely inspired by the classic Dungeons & Dragons modules Scourge of the Slave Lords and Against the Giants.

  • Enjoy collecting 100 Steam achievements designed to challenge the best tacticians.

Free Demo/Tutorial: this is a unique adventure.

A haunted forest. Strange ruins. The villagers call this place “Devil’s Lair”. The ruins may be dead, so they say, but the sinister, malevolent creatures that lurk underneath most certainly are not.

Tightening your packs, you reflect upon this. The devil’s lair, Hah! How could any self-respecting adventurer shy away from the golden opportunity? In this short adventure, the player characters are pre-created and start at level 3.

For more information, please visit the developer's website. Thank you for reading!

data.name: LOOTMOB
data.detailed_description:
LootMob is an incremental horde action game about loot. Monsters come in waves. You cut through them, grab what they drop and put it on. Die, and you keep all of it.

START WITH A STICK

No armour, one wooden stick. Three slimes and you're done. That's fine: everything you picked up comes home with you, and next run you hit harder. A few runs later you're spinning through a crypt full of skeletons.

LOOT EVERYTHING

Gear drops on the ground in five rarities, from grey Common to orange Legendary. Walk over it to pick it up. Every Legendary has its own effect, like a sword that sends out a wave of light on every 4th swing.

BEAT THE BOSS

Survive the waves and the boss shows up. In the forest the Slime King drops out of the sky. In the crypt the Bone Colossus climbs out of the floor. Beat it for Boss Coins and open the next land on the map.

BACK AT CAMP

Sell the junk to the merchant. Take the good stuff to the blacksmith and enchant it. Then go back in.

FEATURES

  • Skill trees – Spend gold on upgrades. At every fork you pick one of two paths.

  • Blacksmith – Enchant your gear or reroll its stats. It can fail, but you never lose the item.

  • Merchant – Sell what you don't need.

  • Short runs – A run takes a few minutes. One key and you're back in.

  • Nothing is lost – Dying ends the run, never your gear or your gold.

CONTENT

  • 8 classes, each with its own skills and skill tree

  • 100 items, 20 of them Legendary with a unique effect

  • 6 lands: Forest, Crypt, Frozen Peaks, Desert Ruins, Inferno and Dragon's Hoard

  • A boss in every land, and a dragon asleep on the gold at the end

Die. Loot. Repeat.

data.name: sfäre
data.detailed_description:
Like all the best toys there's no wrong way to play with sfäre. Its simple controls allow for an endless stream of entrancing new patterns that gently twist and pulse in a relaxing yet fascinating display.

A series of lines emanates from the center of the screen. Four crystal orbs sit in the corners. Each one controls an aspect of the pattern. Playing with them reveals the lines are made of small dots that can be twisted into new and complex arrangements.

sfäre isn't so much a creation tool as it is a voyage of discovery, seeing what beautiful new imagery can appear. Off-center patterns become lovely, simply by tapping either the horizontal or vertical mirror buttons.

The entrancing visuals are backed up by a chill soundtrack, with different tunes available. While sfäre is not a music visualizer the sounds and patterns fit together perfectly.

When the real world calls again you can rise up refreshed from peaceful play of sfäre, making everything a little better and more manageable than it had been before.

data.name: FunnyPizzaLand 2
data.detailed_description:
It's the year 1632: The king's official cook, a guy called Pedro has one day the ambitious plans to create another delicious PIZZA.
But dealings of the dark side of the freaky world of PIZZALAND will soon cross his way.



Forget everything you've ever heard about Pizza Making,
a with food obsessed chef like Pedro has to go the crazy way!
Solve many story driven puzzles and let him (nickname 'potato pilgrim') involuntarily uncover the truth behind the legend of PIZZALAND.
In classic point & click manner with verb interface, text-output only and hand-drawn graphics you have to close the chapter of this dark comedy world like a painting one time forever.



FunnyPizzaLand 2 is a Prequel to FunnyPizzaLand,
a game that was already released back in 2002.
It tells the story of a distant relative of the main character and gives the player
insights in all major events nearly 400 years before the original game.
Understand how it all began, but no worries, you can directly dive in
because it's also meant to be played independently.

Solo dev Roman is dying for his art. Every slice of Pizza, every fly,
- the world of FunnyPizzaLand 2 has been put together by him.

Key Features:
. Many jokes that are so stupid they are actually funny
. Hand-drawn graphics in Full HD with classical sprite animations and tons of real time effects
. Prequel to FunnyPizzaLand from 2002
. Nonlinear gameplay and full liberty in the extensive world of PIZZALAND
. Classic verb interface for maximum control
. Unique mumblings instead of voices for the characters
. Chilling vibes in an unusual place
. It's "Comedy Interactive" and a new playable form of visual art
. Playtime: A couple of hours for pros, a lifetime for really bad gamers (without having fun inclusive...)

data.name: VR Time Machine Travelling in history: Visit ancient Egypt, Babylon and Greece in B.C. 400
data.detailed_description:
Ancient Egyptian civilization is one of the oldest civilizations in the world and one of the civilizations with the longest continuation of a single ethnic culture. The ancient Egyptians formed a traditional culture in their development, but it was not a conservative and closed civilization. Ancient Egypt was closely connected with the Middle East and the Mediterranean world through civilization exchanges and wars. It blended with West Asia, Greece, and Roman civilizations, which affected the development of the surrounding world culture and made great contributions to the progress of world civilization.

In the history of the world, the ancient Egyptians were the creators of the oldest civilization in the world. Egypt was the first to enter the national stage and the first to enter the civilized society. It is generally believed that the ancient Egyptians were a fusion of Asian and African tribes and belonged to the Ham-Sem language family. Around 4000 BC, the city-state of slavery had been established. Around 3000 BC, Egypt developed from independent city states to a unified kingdom. Since then, ancient Egypt has gone through the ancient kingdom period, the middle kingdom period and the new kingdom period before and after, and gradually became a great empire spanning the two continents of Asia and Africa.

Around 1000 BC, Egypt began to decline, and Egypt once became part of the Assyrian Empire. Since the 1000s BC, that is, the post-Egyptian dynasty era, Egypt was successively conquered by Nubians, Assyrians and Persians. In the 4th century BC, Alexander of Macedonia conquered Egypt and established the Ptolemaic dynasty. In 30 BC, Rome expanded to Egypt and replaced the Ptolemaic dynasty. In 641 AD, Egypt was conquered by the Arabs, and the ancient Egyptian civilization was replaced by the feudal civilization of the Arabs.

However, Egypt's own system has not been completely cut off, still maintaining its continuity. Even during the rule of the Greeks and Romans, Egypt still maintained its own cultural traditions. Except for the ruling class and some upper class members, other civilians still used their own language and script. In short, the ancient Egyptian civilization is one of the oldest and oldest civilizations in the world, and it has always retained its national continuity. Ancient Egyptian civilization lasted from about 4000 BC to the 7th century AD, with a history of about 4000-5000 years. Although the ancient Egyptian civilization has been repeatedly invaded by foreign nations, Egypt has always maintained the ancient Egyptian civilization and traditions, and has actively absorbed the excellent cultures of foreign nations and has all-inclusive. In 641 AD, the Arabs conquered Egypt. But the Arabs are completely different from the ancient Egyptians. The Arabs created the Islamic civilization, and gradually assimilated and replaced the ancient Egyptian civilization. Since then, Egypt has become a part of Arab civilization.

Ancient Egypt was the civilized country with the strongest religious consciousness in the ancient world. Religion permeates all aspects of the country and everyone's life. The reason is that, on the one hand, the relatively closed natural environment of ancient Egypt has invisible control and influence on people; on the other hand, more importantly, it is the long-term theocratic and monarchist rule.

In ancient Egypt, not only the three religious theology systems of Heliopolis, Hermopolis and Memphis were retained. And almost all animals have become people's worship objects, ranging from lions and tigers to small cats and beetles. This reflects the different concepts of the ancient Egyptians about the universe and its origin formed in different centers, and demonstrates the universality of the ancient Egyptians' worship of heaven, earth and nature.

Another characteristic of Egyptian religion is the dualistic world outlook of people's ideology. The ancient Egyptians saw that the world was divided into this world and the next. The ancient Egyptians believed that the real world is short-lived and the underground world is eternal. They painstakingly pursue the eternal world and value the afterlife more than this one. In order to pursue the "eternal" world, the ancient Egyptians had to mummify the corpse after death to preserve the integrity of the corpse. The influence and effect of religion on the field of literature and art is also very profound. Ancient Egyptian literature includes a rich variety of genres such as myths, biographies, teachings, prose, poems, and dramas. Almost all the literature on the above subjects is full of religious consciousness or content. Sculpture and painting art are also full of religious atmosphere. The creation of these artworks is not only closely related to religious activities, but the themes are also to promote the lofty and greatness of gods and kings, and people's good wishes for the future.

In addition to the ancient Egyptian civilization, the ancient Greek civilization is especially worthy of our understanding. When it comes to Greece, in addition to myths and monuments, the most often drawn picture is the blue sky and sea, and the white houses set off the blue-roofed church. This scene is often shot on the island of Santorini in Greece. This small island with a permanent population of less than 10,000 attracts hundreds of thousands of tourists every year. data.about_the_game:
Ancient Egyptian civilization is one of the oldest civilizations in the world and one of the civilizations with the longest continuation of a single ethnic culture. The ancient Egyptians formed a traditional culture in their development, but it was not a conservative and closed civilization. Ancient Egypt was closely connected with the Middle East and the Mediterranean world through civilization exchanges and wars. It blended with West Asia, Greece, and Roman civilizations, which affected the development of the surrounding world culture and made great contributions to the progress of world civilization.

In the history of the world, the ancient Egyptians were the creators of the oldest civilization in the world. Egypt was the first to enter the national stage and the first to enter the civilized society. It is generally believed that the ancient Egyptians were a fusion of Asian and African tribes and belonged to the Ham-Sem language family. Around 4000 BC, the city-state of slavery had been established. Around 3000 BC, Egypt developed from independent city states to a unified kingdom. Since then, ancient Egypt has gone through the ancient kingdom period, the middle kingdom period and the new kingdom period before and after, and gradually became a great empire spanning the two continents of Asia and Africa.

Around 1000 BC, Egypt began to decline, and Egypt once became part of the Assyrian Empire. Since the 1000s BC, that is, the post-Egyptian dynasty era, Egypt was successively conquered by Nubians, Assyrians and Persians. In the 4th century BC, Alexander of Macedonia conquered Egypt and established the Ptolemaic dynasty. In 30 BC, Rome expanded to Egypt and replaced the Ptolemaic dynasty. In 641 AD, Egypt was conquered by the Arabs, and the ancient Egyptian civilization was replaced by the feudal civilization of the Arabs.

However, Egypt's own system has not been completely cut off, still maintaining its continuity. Even during the rule of the Greeks and Romans, Egypt still maintained its own cultural traditions. Except for the ruling class and some upper class members, other civilians still used their own language and script. Ancient Egyptian civilization lasted from about 4000 BC to the 7th century AD, with a history of about 4000-5000 years. The Arabs created the Islamic civilization, and gradually assimilated and replaced the ancient Egyptian civilization. Since then, Egypt has become a part of Arab civilization.

data.name: Bloodthief
data.detailed_description:
Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through haunted crypts and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath.

Featuring

  • 30 main levels + secrets / extra levels

  • 20 collectable weapons with unique perks

  • Over 100 secrets

  • Custom User Maps via Steam Workshop

  • Compete with your friends and anyone in the world by racing their ghost. 

Vanquish the Wicked. Drink Their Blood.

In Bloodthief you play as a vampire, and the blood of undead foes fuels your abilities and propels you to insane speeds. Movement and combat are deeply intertwined—you’ll need to use both in a beautiful dance of skill and carnage.

Explore Ancient Dungeons. Acquire Hidden Powers

Powerful secrets lie in the depths of Bloodthief's world. Delve into this mystical land and uncover powerful loot and magical abilities.

Master Your Abilities and Reap the Rewards

Levels full of branching paths, shortcuts, and secrets reward those with the skill and creativity to pull them off. Find the perfect path through labyrinthine dungeons and reap the rewards for your efforts.  

Bloodthief offers a challenging experience that invites the player to learn the deep and intertwined gameplay mechanics to progress and succeed. It will push you to your limits but leave you feeling like the ultimate killing machine by end.

data.name: Splodge Royale
data.detailed_description:
From the maker of Zombie Death Quota.
Use Gyro Aim to Paint and Power Slide your way around while defeating Monsters, building platforms and avoiding the deadly Squog (Square Fog).
Multiple game modes to test your skill in paint coverage, speed and aim.

Key Features


  • 6 different Paint Splodgers.
  • Lots of Power Ups and items.
  • Single Player and up to 4 Local Players for Co-op and Versus.

Game Modes


  • Splodge Royale: Paint more of the world than your friends, as the fog closes in.
  • Battle Royale: Hide or fight as the fog closes in.
  • KingZone: Find and paint the Zones.
  • Charged: Battle between points to transfer energy.
  • Passport: Collect enough gold and evacuate before your friends do, place traps to slow them down.
  • Overpaint: Repaint enough of the old paint.
  • Skate: Collect enough gold before the time runs out.
  • Storm Race: Avoid the fast moving fog.
  • Survival Race: Avoid the fog and defeat monsters.
  • Collect and Conquer: Defeat monsters and collect gold.

data.name: PrimeCraft
data.detailed_description:
PrimeCraft is a sci-fi sandbox about exploring a vast, procedurally generated universe of miniature planets, training AI companions, and jumping into handcrafted scenes created by the community. Every world you visit has its own gravity, terrain, and strange little challenges, and you’re free to roam, experiment, or simply relax and explore.

Travel between billions of unique planets, drop into “bubble” scenes for small self-contained experiences, and return seamlessly to open-world exploration. Play solo or bring friends along in multiplayer and local split-screen modes.

Your AI companion learns directly from your actions. Teach it how to move, navigate worlds, help you, or take your place entirely inside any scene. AI behaviour persists across worlds and sessions, creating a growing sense of personality as you explore.

PrimeCraft is built around playfulness, physics, and discovery. Whether you’re drifting between planets, testing a new AI reflex, or showing friends a strange world you found, the universe is designed to surprise you.

Key Features

• Billions of unique planets — Procedurally generated worlds with dynamic gravity and seamless travel.
• AI companions that learn from you — Train behaviours in real time and let them assist you or take over.
• Jump into “bubble” scenes — Load custom levels, puzzles, experiments, or mini-scenarios created by players.
• Singleplayer, co-op, online co-op, and split-screen — Explore together across multiple modes.
• Physics-driven sandbox — Lasso objects, teleport, bounce, glide, and experiment with playful mechanics.
• Stylized 3D universe — Colorful, atmospheric worlds designed for wandering and curiosity.
• Ongoing updates — New biomes, tools, AI features, and scenes will be added throughout Early Access.

data.name: Dizzy Dungeon
data.detailed_description:
Heroes without battle, Dungeons without monster.

Dizzy World - Get ready for dizziness. In this world you have the power to change the direction of gravity. In simple words: rotate the world, rotate everything.
Some of dungeon objects will fall down and some will not. Rapidly rotate and move, change the structure of the dungeon, clear or build a path to the exit.


Dangerous Dungeon - No monster at all, but still full of trouble and dangerous. Boxes will fall down and smash you, spike and saw will kill you. Electric box and lock will block your way. Portals make thing more complicated. Handle them directly or find another way to avoid them, make your own strategy.


Character - 5 different characters with their own specialties. Some of them good at climb and fall, and some are good at power or magic. Each character can be setup with equipment and items fit to their class, boost properties, allow you to create more efficient strategies.


Special Ability - Each equipment provide a unique skill, such as break obstacles on the way, push things around, create box to climb, pick lock, teleport, even more powerful magic can change the dungeon structure entirely.


Ranking System - Each dungeon have standard solving steps count, that is just the start. You can always beat that by finding a better way to solve it. There are leader boards for every dungeon so you will know how your strategy works compare to other players. Also that is a total score leader board let players know how they performed generally.

  • - 8 level of difficulties, from newbie to nightmare
  • - 2400 unique dungeons to challenge
  • - 12 unique active skills to use in dungeons
  • - 12 equipment to boost character property
  • - 40 Steam achievement

data.name: The Rise of the New Han Prince 2
data.detailed_description:
Continuing from the previous chapter, you will cleverly utilize funds from developed countries to create a world-renowned magical island. Your celebrity girlfriends will become the female leads of your movie investments. How will you handle your relationships with them?

Become a Prince: You will play as a person chosen by a divine system, transported to become the prince of a rising small country, New Han. In this world filled with opportunities and challenges, you will complete your university education discreetly and then begin to develop your country using the powers granted by the divine system.

Divine System Powers: The system endows you with extraordinary abilities, including acquiring vast wealth, recruiting top-tier talent, and developing energy resources. You will use these powers to solve various problems facing your country and propel New Han towards prosperity and strength.

Rise of a Business Empire: You will quickly rise in the financial and entertainment industries, making shrewd business decisions that earn you immense wealth. Your success not only garners you a reputation but also lays a solid foundation for New Han's economic development.

Responsibility for National Development: Beyond commercial competition, you must also navigate complex family dynamics and political challenges. How will you balance your personal life with the heavy responsibility of national development and lead New Han to a brighter future?

Sem hype artificial. Sem distrações desnecessárias.

data.name: Retro Game Collector Simulator
data.detailed_description:
It's not hoarding. It's a collection.

Your uncle left you one box of old games and a basement to keep them in. One box turns into ten. Ten turn into a wall of shelves, a CRT that hums when it warms up, and a drawer of cables you swear you will sort out one day.

Retro Game Collector Simulator is a hands-on game about owning too many old video games and loving every one of them.

Raid the game shop


Walk into the shop on Maple Street and dig through mystery lots, loose carts, boxed games and hardware. The stock changes every day. Whatever you buy is on your doorstep the next morning, and Marty at the counter will tell you what your trade-ins are worth.

Dump the box


Cut the tape, open the flaps and tip the whole thing out on the rug. Games, controllers, power bricks, somebody's old photos. Pick each find up, turn it over, check its condition, clean it, test it, and decide whether it stays.

Shelve everything


Every system gets a shelf of its own, and every game has its place on it. There are around 300 games to collect across 17 fictional retro systems, from the first cartridges to the disc era. Fill the binder, chase better copies, and trade the duplicates in for the next box.

Every cable, by hand


Nothing here hooks itself up the first time. Find the right power supply, carry the plug round the back of the TV, pick the input, find the channel. When the picture rolls or the cartridge will not boot, you do what everyone did: take it out, blow on it, and try again.

Then play a minigame on the CRT


A game that boots can be played, as a short retro minigame on the in-game TV: one quick take with one goal. These are small built-in games made for this collection, not full versions of the titles on the box.

Film it. Read the comments.


Run a small YouToob channel out of the basement. Pick an angle, film a review of whatever is on the TV, and check the Studio the next morning for views, subscribers and a comment section with opinions about what you should review next.

Every cart has a past

A kid's name in marker on a label. A rental sticker. A note folded into a manual. The games you find belonged to somebody, and the pieces add up to the story of the town they came from.

  • Single-player 3D collecting and organizing sim.
  • Around 300 collectible games on 17 fictional retro systems.
  • A walk-in game shop with new stock every day.
  • Unboxing, cleaning, testing, shelving and hooking up hardware, all by hand.
  • Short built-in retro minigames on an in-game CRT.
  • A video channel with reviews, comments and collection videos.
  • Collector memories and a town's worth of stories hidden in old boxes.

data.name: Maze In Your Mind
data.detailed_description:
You can't play any game until your mind plays it first

You can't solve any maze until your mind solves it first

Maze In Your Mind is a game about a three-layer maze connected by static portals where the player must find the right portal to unlock the final portal.

The right portal is signaled by visual cues and audio rhythms.

Avoid enemies and explore the maze, but not the maze you see, but the maze you don't see, the maze in your mind.

If one mind is not enough then play in BattleMind mode where you can play together with another mind in the same device.

Key Features :

  • 30 levels (minds) in single-player mode with 3 mazes each connected by static portals.

  • Each level (mind) in single-player mode has between 2 and 7 short repeating musical rhythms as audio signals.

  • 10 levels (minds) in BattleMind (multi-player) mode with 3 mazes each connected by static portals.

  • Play against the computer, against your friend, team up with your friend against the computer or free for all in BattleMind mode.

  • Play a 7-second game in the lose box or win box.

  • Exploration mode - freely roam the vast maze and discover hard-to-reach places, as well as capture some ideas.

If you want to see your physical self, look in the mirror.

If you want to see your non-physical self, look at the boundary (wall).

data.name: Crusaders of the Lost Idols
data.detailed_description:
Unlock Crusaders, collect Gear, and earn Achievements!

Crusaders of the Lost Idols is the Award Winning idle game of heroic awesomeness.

Create a band of unusual heroes to battle monsters, earn gold by killing them and use it to level-up and unlock new character abilities. Organize your Crusaders by designing the perfect formation for maximum damage.

Master Formation Strategy over multiple campaigns and events that are updated every month.





Formation Strategy
The only clicker/idle game to feature a formation system. Crusader specific abilities, buffs, and gear challenge the player to find the best formation every campaign and event.





Unlock Crusaders
Collect an unusual host of over 120 Crusaders such as The Bat Billionaire, Emo Werewolf and RoboTurkey, inspired by the world of video games and popular culture with more added Every Month.





Collect Gear, Buffs, and Trinkets
A cornucopia of content with hundreds of unique upgrades for each character, including unique gear, and buffs are available to collect.

PLUS

Over 10,000 Levels
Master over six campaigns with dozens of objectives with deep playability and challenge; more campaigns released regularly.

Daily Quests
Each day players are challenged to complete mini-objectives that reward success with precious red rubies.

Monthly Events
Limited time events featuring special objectives and exclusive new content updated Every Month.

Missions
Send your idle Crusaders on side missions to unlock past Event Crusaders, new gear, earn Enchantment Points and jeweled chests plus more!

data.name: Type King
data.detailed_description:
Type King is a typing and jumping game. With three different game modes all of which have three difficulty levels there is plenty to play here! The land is split into fifteen states all of which are led by corrupt governors from their high towers. It is up to you to rid the land of corruption by overruling the leaders of those states. Only then can you be crowned the Type King!

Jumping
This might look easy but I assure you it is not. A vital skill for every Type King which makes this game mode a good place to start your journey.


Typing
Hone your typing skills with this game mode where both speed and accuracy are needed. With the different difficulty levels there is challenge for everyone!


Type King
Typing and jumping combined makes Type King! There are three varieties of this game mode: Multiplayer co-op where one player is typing and the other is jumping as well as singleplayer variants where you type with one hand and jump with the other.


Save progress by unlocking codes
In Easy and Normal difficulty the checkpoints between floors include codes which can be used in the menu to continue where you left off. These aren't there to help in Hard difficulty so just keep practising!

Accessibility
Type King is family-friendly and can be enjoyed by people of any age! It also has option for easy to read font.

Keyboard layouts
Supports QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ and DVORAK keyboard layouts

Comments
This is absolutely horrible. This is the hardest game I've ever played!
-Developer's eight years old cousin who can't get enough of Type King

After hours of trying I finally saw the top of the tower in Jumping on Hard difficulty and then I fell and now I'm losing my mind
-Developer's friend (could be former friend now)

data.name: Secret Stream ASMR with Saya: Just the Two of Us
data.detailed_description:
▼Overview

The distance between you and the VTuber Saya slowly begins to close—

Secret Stream ASMR with Saya: Just the Two of Us is a visual novel ADV with ASMR-style presentation, where you interact with the VTuber girl Saya through livestreams and private chats.

After meeting her during a game livestream, you eventually begin talking with her in private chats, discovering expressions she never shows on stream—and hearing her voice as if she were whispering right beside you.

In the demo version, you can experience your first encounter with Saya and the atmosphere of her livestream.

▼Story

One night, you happen to come across a livestream by a VTuber named Saya.

She loves horror games, but she is extremely easy to scare.
Even as she trembles and nearly bursts into tears, she keeps doing her best to continue playing.

There is something about her that makes you want to watch over her.

The lively comment section.
Her unguarded reactions.
And one casual message you send.

That small moment leads Saya to invite you into a private chat.

A streamer and a viewer.

data.name: COLD BOOT
data.detailed_description:
One-hit and One-kill

Experience intense action where every strike counts. Both enemy bullets and your katana kill instantly. Each death consumes one iteration and sends you back to the last checkpoint. Death only hones your skills, but be careful not to die too many times!

Iteration Recover Mechanism:

You can recover iterations by reaching the spot where you last fell. This fresh and clever mechanic softens the sting of death while adding a layer of tension—do you find a new path to kill or go to compensate for your loss? It’s a choice that keeps every move unpredictable.

Updates and Skills:

Tap into powerful skills like time slowing by spending charges, which you recharge by cutting down enemies. As you play, you’ll unlock a variety of randomly supplied upgrades affecting movement, attacks, charge management, and beyond. Mix and match these enhancements freely to craft a play style that’s uniquely yours.

quadrant is a difficult rhythm game with trippy animations that get more and more intense, the better you play.

Each level is a dynamic visual interpretation of the song, providing a synesthetic experience.

The game places a lot of stress on the player, learning to cope with it is vital for success.

The key theme is human adaptation to strange environments.

data.name: LIT
data.detailed_description:
Venture into the dark hallways of a haunted high school and help guide emo teenager Jake as he searches for his lost girlfriend Rachael. Solve light-themed puzzles using a variety of gameplay mechanics including slingshots, light bulbs, windows, matches, lamps, and TV sets. Think your way around deadly creatures from the darkness in an effort to reach each room's exit door without being swallowed up by the shadows.

LIT is developer WayForward's classic puzzle horror series, newly reimagined for the PC with HD graphics, 16 stages, multiple par time goals, two possible endings, and a bonus unlockable character exclusive to this version of the game. The game offers control schemes for both keyboard and joypad.

Are you brave enough to puzzle through the darkness...?

data.name: Arenfall
data.detailed_description:
Face titanic bosses in an arena where every mistake is punished. Alone or up to three, will you survive the fall?

Arenfall is a dark fantasy action RPG built around boss combat. Wield sword, bow, and magic across four distinct classes, master parrying and dodging, and bring down colossal foes in a world consumed by darkness. Progress through Story mode to build your character, then test yourself in the roguelite Boss Rush where every run reshuffles the deck.

Features:

  • Demanding combat — Parry, dodge, timing: a punishing combat system that rewards mastery.

  • Four classes — Warrior, Mage, Rogue, and Ranger, each with their own spells and playstyle.

  • Online co-op for 1 to 3 players — Take on the bosses solo or as a team.

  • Roguelite Boss Rush — Chain bosses, stack upgrades, and start over from scratch on every death. Randomized boss order and bonuses for endless replayability.

  • Loot and gear — Claim equipment from fallen bosses, from Common to Legendary, and forge your build.

  • Three difficulties — From Normal to Hell, for the boldest challengers.

The arena awaits. Will you fall, or bring the titans down?

data.name: 天道绘卷——修仙地图模拟器
data.detailed_description:
展开你的修仙世界

《天道绘卷：修仙世界模拟器》是一款以天道视角观察、编辑与干预世界的修仙沙盒。生成山川、海陆与宗门疆域，展开一卷宣纸淡彩地图，让时间开始流动。世界中的修士与宗门依照各自的处境行动，你可以安静旁观，也可以亲手改变他们的命运。

见证宗门的兴衰

宗门会结交盟友、发动征伐，争夺灵气充沛的地区。成员可能叛宗，领地可能分裂，强盛的宗门也会覆灭。幸存者成为散修，散修又有机会在无主之地开宗立派。随着岁月推进，地图上的疆界不断改变。

追踪一个修士的一生

地图上的每个修士都有自己的名字、境界、天资、寿元与履历。人族与妖族在同一个世界中修炼、游历、探索和交战。从炼气、筑基到金丹、元婴，突破可能成功，也可能留下伤势。你可以关注一名弟子的成长，看他有机会成为宗主，也见证他因战斗或寿元耗尽而陨落。

以天道之名干预

赐福修士，调整境界与寿元，改变地区灵气，开启秘境，调遣人物，或推动宗门宣战与停战。为世界投放一件灵宝，为它写下名字、来历与设定，观察它被寻访、持有与遗落。你决定何时出手，再看世界如何回应。

按你的节奏推演

暂停或加速时间，在疆域、地区与地形视图间切换。通过人物履历、世界纪事、战报和历史回看，追踪那些改变世界的转折。保存这个世界，下次继续推演。这里没有固定主线与胜利条件，你可以为自己选择关注的宗门、人物和目标。

data.name: Boo Men
data.detailed_description:
You are a thief tasked with burglarizing homes. You are given a list of items required to steal before you can leave. Play with a team and split the prize money or play solo and keep it all for yourself, but it won't be that easy. Boo Men can be lurking in the dark, so stay in the light if you want to survive. This means keeping an eye on the power. The more lights you turn on, the faster it will drain the power and cause a power outage in which case you will need to locate the breaker to turn back on. Take caution -A Boo Man may be hiding in the light, waiting for someone to turn it off...

1-4 Player Online Co-op

Play as the Boo Man against your friends and up to 5 players! Each Boo Man has their own set of unique abilities to learn and master!

There are 8 different Boo Men, each with their own unique play-style. 8 maps to burglarize, ranging from small-medium-large. 5 Difficulties, randomized spawn locations, and customized games which allow you to also add multiple of any Boo Men for endless combinations of chaotic entertainment!

data.name: Arthur's Reading Race
data.detailed_description:
Explore and share Marc Brown’s classic "Arthur’s Reading Race", adapted from the original storybook into an interactive animated adventure! Arthur and his friends bring the story alive one word at a time, offering an easy to digest reading mode which is fully animated and voiced. Increase the challenge and the fun with an interactive at-your-own-pace option with lots of bonuses and secrets to discover!

Arthur’s Reading Race centers around everyone’s favorite Aardvark. Arthur is trying to teach his little sister, D.W, to read. However, she insists that she already knows how! After a heated conversation, Arthur challenges D.W to read ten different words with a promised reward of ice cream! Will D.W be able to read all ten words for the ultimate reward?

Since it's first release in 1997, Living Books' rendition of "Arthur’s Reading Race" has been enjoyed by countless children. Step-by-step, the reader will find the story is full of surprising encounters with many of their favorite Arthur storybook characters, providing new ways to interact with the book again and again.

  • Both interactive and story modes suitable for different levels of skill.
  • Interact with the pictures and discover hidden scenes.
  • Attractive animations bring the characters to life.
  • Fully voiced as you read! Chock full of memorable scenes!
  • A revitalized re-release compatible with modern platforms.

Special Thanks:
Ruben Contreras - Video Editor

data.name: Defend the Dead
data.detailed_description:
Defend the Dead
Ever wondered what the undead do when no one's watching? They just mind their own business—until those pesky humans show up! In this 3D action tower defense game, you play as the undead, tasked with protecting your life-giving chaos crystal (courtesy of your trusty Chaos Crystal Witch) from an endless onslaught of meddlesome human attackers.

Key Features:

  • Tactical Mayhem: Command your battlefield from a tactical view, strategically placing traps, towers, and barriers while casting ground spells to keep the human hordes at bay.

  • Rise to the Occasion: When things heat up, hit the “Rise” button to materialize as a physical form with full third-person controls, and lead the charge against the invaders!

  • Upgrade and Customize: Each wave you survive rewards you with XP and skill points. Unlock new traps, spells, barriers, or towers to tailor your defense and keep the humans guessing.

Join the undead rebellion in a hilariously gory twist on tower defense—because sometimes, the living just won't leave the dead alone. Get ready to rise, fight back, and prove that even the undead have a right to a little peace and quiet!

data.name: Down the shaft
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the mines


War, death, pestilence, and famine are words one can use to describe our world as it is now. While this is damning for us humans, something grows stronger in the shadows. Waiting, just waiting, for their opportunity to strike and be freed of their chains.

For centuries, this place has been guarded from the peeping eye. Hidden in plain sight to protect everyone on the surface from what lies below. Now it's your turn to work the shift and face the horrors down the shaft.

Your first shift


Welcome to the mines, rookie. Let's hope you survive your first day.

You knew when you signed. You kept repeating it to yourself: "This is no normal mining operation".
You know your duty. You know why you are here: "I'm here to protect everyone else outside this shaft from the Elder God."
You know what will happen. You know it all too well: "I won't make it out. But they won't either."

Your job as an engineer is to keep the machines running. You will have to keep them on as long as you can. Fail to do this, and the god will get off its slumber in no time, prematurely ending your shift. Fix machines, get new upgrades, and defend yourself from the creatures that lurk in the mines.

Your shift ends at 06:00 AM. That, of course, if you survive that long.

The clock is ticking


The machines are rumbling down there, but the noise of creaking metal and twisted flesh is not everything audible in the mine. With the recent tragedies out in the world, the Elder God is more active than ever, and so are their obedient minions. Don't let them wake up, or the whole world will be gone in mere seconds.

Midnight is approaching. If the clock reaches it, doomsday is nigh. Your survival is pointless if you let the Elder God unchecked. Even surviving the shift might end up killing you and everything else. Keep all the machines working at all times, even if that means taking risks. Learn from your mistakes. Adapt to your enemies. Be a better worker in the shaft.

Maybe, just maybe, your effort won't be as pointless as it might look.

data.name: Q.U.B.E. 2
data.detailed_description:
RTX AND DLSS ENABLED!


About the Game

Q.U.B.E. 2 is the sequel to the hit first-person puzzle game Q.U.B.E. You are Amelia Cross, a stranded archaeologist who has mysteriously awoken among the sand swept ruins of an ancient alien landscape. Together with the distant help of another survivor, Commander Emma Sutcliffe, you must traverse and manipulate the structure of this forgotten world to find a way back home.

Waking up wearing a strange suit with attached gloves, you have no prior knowledge on how you came to be in this environment. Awaiting you is a maze-like monolith, a structure that you must navigate, solving mind-bending puzzles. Use your manipulation gloves to change and adapt the architectural structure in your search to rendezvous with another survivor, finding a way off the planet.

As you explore and solve puzzles to progress, thought-provoking questions about your true purpose and the origins of the structure you are navigating will need to be considered, forcing you to come to terms with a devastating truth that will shake your world.

Features:

Master eleven puzzle areas and solve over 80 individual puzzles:



Explore diverse environments that expand the Q.U.B.E. world:



Interact with new and improved game mechanics:



Full colour blind support, using symbols as a colour aid:



  • Experience an all new adventure and brand new characters
  • Original musical score composed by BAFTA nominated composer, David Housden

data.name: Very Human Doctor
data.detailed_description:
You weren't sent to Earth to save humanity...

You were sent to study it.

In Very Human Doctor, you play as an alien infiltrator disguised as an ordinary hospital physician. Officially, you're here to diagnose patients, manage a busy hospital ward, and keep everyone healthy.

Unofficially?

You're collecting human DNA, testing experimental alien technology, and conducting increasingly suspicious "medical research" for your home planet.

Just don't get caught.

Every strange procedure, every impossible cure, and every mysterious machine makes humans a little more suspicious...

Diagnose. Guess. Learn.

There's just one small problem. You have absolutely no idea how human medicine works. Every disease becomes a puzzle.

Try different treatments, observe bizarre side effects, and slowly build your own medical knowledge through trial and error. Did Medicine #3 cure stomach worms? No. It made the patient's head twice as big. Good to know.

Run a Hospital... and a Secret Alien Laboratory

Treat patients using ordinary medical equipment...or secretly upgrade it with advanced extraterrestrial technology.

Install hidden scanners inside hospital beds, enhance X-ray machines with alien hardware, develop experimental devices, and gather valuable research data without raising too much suspicion.

Keep Humanity From Finding Out

Your greatest enemy isn't disease. It's suspicion. Patients notice strange treatments. Visitors ask questions.

Give too many impossible cures or perform too many suspicious experiments, and people may realize their trusted doctor isn't quite... human. Balance efficient healthcare with covert alien research before your cover is blown.

Upgrade Two Worlds

Earn money from successful treatments to expand your hospital with new rooms, equipment, and better facilities.

At the same time, collect alien resources to unlock increasingly absurd extraterrestrial technologies that make your research faster, but also much harder to hide. The better your hospital becomes, the deeper your secret operation grows.

Features

👽 Play as an alien pretending to be a human doctor.

🧬 Secretly collect DNA while treating patients.

💊 Discover treatments through hilarious trial-and-error experimentation.

🛸 Build and upgrade both your hospital and hidden alien technology.

👀 Manage suspicion - don't let humanity uncover your true identity.

🤣 Experience ridiculous medical mishaps and unexpected patient reactions.

🔬 Balance ethical medicine... or completely ignore ethics in the name of science.

Humanity thinks you're here to heal them.

Your species knows the truth.
data.about_the_game:
You weren't sent to Earth to save humanity...

You were sent to study it.

In Very Human Doctor, you play as an alien infiltrator disguised as an ordinary hospital physician. Officially, you're here to diagnose patients, manage a busy hospital ward, and keep everyone healthy.

Unofficially?

You're collecting human DNA, testing experimental alien technology, and conducting increasingly suspicious "medical research" for your home planet.

Just don't get caught.

Every strange procedure, every impossible cure, and every mysterious machine makes humans a little more suspicious...

Diagnose. Guess. Learn.

There's just one small problem. You have absolutely no idea how human medicine works. Every disease becomes a puzzle.

Try different treatments, observe bizarre side effects, and slowly build your own medical knowledge through trial and error. Did Medicine #3 cure stomach worms? No. It made the patient's head twice as big. Good to know.

Run a Hospital... and a Secret Alien Laboratory

Treat patients using ordinary medical equipment...or secretly upgrade it with advanced extraterrestrial technology.

Install hidden scanners inside hospital beds, enhance X-ray machines with alien hardware, develop experimental devices, and gather valuable research data without raising too much suspicion.

Keep Humanity From Finding Out

Your greatest enemy isn't disease. It's suspicion. Patients notice strange treatments. Visitors ask questions.

Give too many impossible cures or perform too many suspicious experiments, and people may realize their trusted doctor isn't quite... human. Balance efficient healthcare with covert alien research before your cover is blown.

Upgrade Two Worlds

Earn money from successful treatments to expand your hospital with new rooms, equipment, and better facilities.

At the same time, collect alien resources to unlock increasingly absurd extraterrestrial technologies that make your research faster, but also much harder to hide. The better your hospital becomes, the deeper your secret operation grows.

Features

👽 Play as an alien pretending to be a human doctor.

🧬 Secretly collect DNA while treating patients.

💊 Discover treatments through hilarious trial-and-error experimentation.

🛸 Build and upgrade both your hospital and hidden alien technology.

👀 Manage suspicion - don't let humanity uncover your true identity.

🤣 Experience ridiculous medical mishaps and unexpected patient reactions.

🔬 Balance ethical medicine... or completely ignore ethics in the name of science.

Humanity thinks you're here to heal them.

Your species knows the truth.
data.short_description: A Co(s)mic Medical Simulator where healing humanity is just your cover. Treat patients, secretly harvest DNA, experiment with bizarre alien technology, and keep your true identity hidden.

data.name: Chicken Cannon!
data.detailed_description:
Try not to lose your sanity in this 3D physics-based rage game! If you ever get to the end (where there's someone waiting for you) you will be able to compete with the community for who's the fastest at beating the game!

  • Shoot the chicken from one cannon to another, control direction and power!
  • Adjust your trajectory mid-air by flapping your wings, or try to roll on the ground to reach the next cannon!
  • Golden cannons are checkpoints! Reach them to secure your current progress!
  • Reset to the last checkpoint if you can't manage to get to the next cannon!
  • Explore the map freely! Look for golden eggs (and easter eggs)!

Recommend this game to your worst enemy to get the best results!

The game may contain bugs and/or cause extreme anger, you have been warned.

data.name: Astonishing Baseball Manager 20
data.detailed_description:
Astonishing Baseball (or AB for friends) is not your usual baseball simulation game. It's not only about tables full of players and stats. It's about people! Well okay, you heard that line from your Economics 101 class already. But I promise, this game will be way more interesting!

Fake (but real) baseball players

AB is about fake (sorry, virtual) baseball players. Some you'll like, some you will hate, and a lot of them you will LOVE! That anonymous "Jim" guy at the top of your lineup? Give it a few minutes, and he will become your favorite player ever. Or maybe he's actually very bad, and you'll send him finish his career in your minor league team, because he disappointed you. Poor Jim...

And that starter, Sandy. Is he an ace or not? Well, maybe you should train him a bit. And make sure you have solid relievers to help him if a left-handed batter is giving him a headache. After all, you're paying him 12M a year, that's a lot! And he's asking for an even bigger extension contract now. Not sure you'll like Sandy after all... Oh but look, his nickname is "Cubbie", that's so cute!

Watch them evolve!

One of your tasks is to draft rookies. And once you've drafted your first prospect... Let's call him John okay? Well, you're going to be very interested in John's life. Where to put him in the lineup? How much training does he need? Do I start him everyday, or does he need to go to the minor leagues first? Why is he suddenly struggling? Wait, it's getting better... HE'S THE MVP NOW! But is he really worth 20M per year? See, it never stops!

The lineup of your dreams

Okay so the team is not too bad these days, but you want to do a big move and win the Baseball Cup. Is it time to do a big trade with another team? Or maybe it would be better to wait next year and sign a big free agent during the offseason? Or maybe do both? One thing is sure, building the lineup of your dream is actually super hard! And you haven't even tested the "Extreme Mode" yet.

A living world

Astonishing Baseball features an artificial but living world. Fans are posting about the game and your brand new rookie. Journalists write articles about your starter's last night performance. Players send you messages about their concerns or their contract. It's all about baseball! Fortunately, all these people are very positive persons! Except if they complain about their contract. Or their role in the lineup. Or the team performance... Well, it could be worse. It's not like they're French and complain all the time, right?

For baseball fans and stats nerds

Astonishing Baseball is very easy to learn. If you know the game rules, you'll know how to play! But if you're a sabermetrics savant, you'll find all kind of stats to satisfy your nerdy instinct! I even suggest to use wOBA. You don't know what wOBA is? Don't worry, according to very serious studies, about 99.999% of people don't care about wOBA. Good news, right?

Get international

Not enough talent in your league? Send your incredible and local scouts to find the best prospects in the world, and then invite the most promising player to your team! But be careful, even the best scouts can make mistakes... My favorite one is named "Francis Dupont". Yes he's French, from Paris, and he's always hyping up his prospects. Like "Look, I just saw that guy from Strasbourg for three minutes and I'm rating him 80/80 and he's already in the Hall of Fame blablabla". Best thing to do with Francis is to ask him to spend a bit more time on the prospect. Generally it ends with a final rating of 50+/80 and a simple "I told you so". I really like you Francis, but if you're reading this, do your job correctly please.

Live incredible stories

As a coach, you have a life too! In Astonishing Baseball, you can take your team to a burger restaurant, help local associations, but also meet your favorite author, become a rock star, visit Iceland and even marry the love of your life!

Apparently I have to put a disclaimer here. You're not going to really meet the love of your life with this game. It's like... Your in-game soulmate, okay?

If you like baseball, fantasy sports and simulations, or just good stories, you'll love Astonishing Baseball Manager! I hope. If you don't, I like messages!

data.name: Ash of Y
data.detailed_description:
《Ash of Y》是一款深度策略回合制角色扮演游戏，注重反应迅速与战略思维的结合，在稳定的战斗节奏中掌控局势。在明确的回合框架中，玩家将指挥角色，通过缜密规划每一项行动来击败敌人并推动情节的发展。

这款游戏强调智慧和预测能力。玩家需要在攻击、防御和技能使用之间进行权衡，每个决策都会影响战斗的持续时间和角色状态。面对各种敌人配置，迅速决策并不总是最佳策略，反而稳定的行动安排是一种可靠的胜利方式。

随着游戏深入，玩家角色的能力会逐步提高，促使玩家在强化基本属性和扩展战斗手段之间做出选择。这种成长与战斗过程紧密结合，鼓励玩家在稳定中追寻最优策略。

《Ash of Y》将为喜爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家呈现一段以智慧、掌控与持续对抗为核心的单人游戏体验。

data.name: Journey Beyond the Gate
data.detailed_description:
Journey Beyond the Gate

Find out what lies beyond the gate. What kind of hero will you become?

Journey Beyond the Gate is a fantasy roguelite deckbuilder that combines strategic card combat with classic RPG character progression. Choose your race and class, develop your attributes, discover powerful card combinations, and equip your hero as you venture through a dangerous fantasy world.

Every decision shapes your journey, from the cards you add to your deck to the equipment you carry into your next battle.

Create Your Hero

Your adventure begins with a choice of race and class, each offering unique perks and strengths that influence your playstyle.

Experiment with different combinations, develop your character's attributes, and discover new ways to approach combat. Whether you favor devastating physical attacks, powerful magic, or strategies built around poisoning your enemies, your hero's strengths are yours to develop.

Build Your Deck. Master Your Strategy.

Engage in tactical, turn-based card combat where every action matters.

Build and improve your deck as you travel, combining attacks, defenses, spells, and status effects to create powerful synergies.

Burn your enemies, stack poison or bleed, freeze your opponents, or overwhelm them with raw strength. Discover combinations that turn seemingly simple cards into powerful strategies.

The right combination of cards can change the course of a battle.

Grow Stronger Throughout Your Journey

Your deck is only one part of your character.

  • Upgrade your cards to improve their effectiveness and strengthen your strategy.

  • Find weapons, armor, and trinkets to enhance your hero.

  • Develop your attributes to unlock new cards and synergies.

  • Visit shops to discover new equipment, items and opportunities to improve your build.

  • Manage your inventory and use consumables during combat when you need them most.

Finding the right balance between cards, equipment, and attributes is key to overcoming the challenges ahead.

Explore a World Beyond the Gate

Travel across a fantasy overworld filled with dangerous encounters, mysterious locations, and unexpected events.

Your journey will take you through forests, deserts, and other hostile regions as you face bandits, monsters, and powerful bosses.

Take on quests, visit settlements, and uncover pieces of the story as you venture further from the safety of home.

Every battle is a test of your strategy, but the choices you make between battles can be just as important.

Face Powerful Enemies and Bosses

Each encounter presents a new challenge. Adapt your strategy to different enemies, manage your resources, and prepare for battles that will test the strengths and weaknesses of your build.

Choose your path. Build your hero. Discover what lies beyond the Gate.

Build and improve your deck as you travel, combining attacks, defenses, spells, and status effects to create powerful synergies.

Burn your enemies, stack poison or bleed, freeze your opponents, or overwhelm them with raw strength. Discover combinations that turn seemingly simple cards into powerful strategies.

The right combination of cards can change the course of a battle.

Grow Stronger Throughout Your Journey

Your deck is only one part of your character.

  • Upgrade your cards to improve their effectiveness and strengthen your strategy.

  • Find weapons, armor, and trinkets to enhance your hero.

  • Develop your attributes to unlock new cards and synergies.

  • Visit shops to discover new equipment, items and opportunities to improve your build.

  • Manage your inventory and use consumables during combat when you need them most.

Finding the right balance between cards, equipment, and attributes is key to overcoming the challenges ahead.

Explore a World Beyond the Gate

Travel across a fantasy overworld filled with dangerous encounters, mysterious locations, and unexpected events.

Your journey will take you through forests, deserts, and other hostile regions as you face bandits, monsters, and powerful bosses.

Take on quests, visit settlements, and uncover pieces of the story as you venture further from the safety of home.

Every battle is a test of your strategy, but the choices you make between battles can be just as important.

Face Powerful Enemies and Bosses

Each encounter presents a new challenge. Adapt your strategy to different enemies, manage your resources, and prepare for battles that will test the strengths and weaknesses of your build.

Choose your path. Build your hero. Discover what lies beyond the Gate.
data.short_description: Journey Beyond the Gate is a fantasy roguelite deckbuilder with classic RPG progression. Choose your race and class, build your deck with powerful card synergies, and explore a dangerous medieval fantasy world with tactical turn-based combat and deep character progression.

data.name: Super Hangman
data.detailed_description:
Introducing Super Hangman – the coolest hangman game made just for kids! Get ready for a super fun way to learn and play with words!

In Super Hangman, kids get to go on a word-solving adventure filled with vibrant colors and awesome animations. It's like diving into a world where learning feels like a game!

Guessing the secret word before the hangman appears is the name of the game. Every right guess gets you closer to victory, but watch out for those wrong ones – they add a dash of suspense to the excitement!

From animals to sports, fruits to planets, Super Hangman covers tons of topics to keep the fun going. And with its easy-to-use setup, kids can jump right into the action without any hassle.

Whether you're playing solo or challenging your friends, Super Hangman guarantees a blast while boosting your language skills. It's the ultimate combo of learning and entertainment!

Join the adventure in Super Hangman – where words come to life and learning is always a thrill!

data.detailed_description:
SUPPORT MY OTHER GAME ON KICKSTARTER!


Update 1.06


Make Requests Here!


Update 1.05


Post Your Cheat Code Ideas Here!


About the Game

Giant Bear Rampage leads you on a vengeful quest of destruction as a huge mutated bear with super powers!



Cheapco Toxic Waste™ and their busted pipeline have polluted and flooded a cave that is home to a bear. While trying to escape the cave, he falls into the toxic waste and mutates into a Giant Angry Monster Bear...



Destroy buildings to cause property damage, survive waves of enemies and overcome obstacles like boulders and shield generators. Explore the levels to find Mutation Points which can be used to unlock new SUPER POWERS. From Summoning Tornadoes and Meteors to creating Gravity Vortexes and more!

KEY FEATURES!


  • A Giant Mutant Bear - A mutant bear that has powers ranging from Plasma, Flame, Wind and Ice attacks which are all unlockable. Play as a Pizzly, Grizzly, Panda, a Polar Bear and more!

  • Destructible Environments - Cause property damage and defeat your enemies to progress! Punch and Smash buildings into rubble, Smash cars and uproot trees. Enemies and the environment can be burned by plasma, fire and frozen with ice too!

  • Unlock Super Attacks! - Explore Levels to find and collect Mutation Points, Mutation Points can be spent on unlocking new super powers, making you more powerful as you progress!

  • Large Levels to Explore! - Go through populated towns and cities, featuring different types of biomes and a colourful minimalist low poly art style. Interact with the world, trees can be knocked down, burned and destroyed, boulders can be destroyed to reveal secret areas.

  • Easy, Normal, Hard and Very Hard Difficulty Levels - For the challenge you want to face and if you want to collect all achievements. There are 60 Achievements to unlock for both random challenges and completing levels at different difficulty settings.

  • Cheat Codes - Cheat Codes are also hidden throughout the world and can be picked up, noted down and entered whenever you want to try them out! - I miss the days of cheat code books so I tried to keep the spirit alive!

Giant Bear Rampage is the premium Giant Mutant Bear Simulator of 2022! ʕ • ᴥ • ʔ

Make breakfast. Walk through familiar rooms. Interact with everyday objects.

data.name: Anxiety Treatment with Relaxation Demo
data.detailed_description:
Please enjoy the demo version and let us know if you find anything that could be improved for your specific gear. In this demo app only the first three sessions are available to play. None the less, the three demo sessions available are definitely worth downloading because there is much to learn from those sessions and it may very well work for some as a complete relaxation exercise. On our page you can find the main app in case you like what you see in the demo and would like to see more.

This is not just a relaxing experience. Dr. Lora Heugens talks about anxiety, how to calm down and feel good about yourself. She talks about common scenarios that normally makes people anxious and goes into details to react to them. She describes how to handle anxiety before, during and after anxious experiences. In one of the sessions she describes the process that will enable you to calm yourself quickly and efficiently anytime. Of course this material includes a relaxing story that you can come back to anytime to calm yourself as well.

First you learn the way to breathe properly, followed by the doctor explaining some basics about anxiety. The main story gives us an opportunity to learn the way to look at life experiences as an outsider while going into a deep relaxation state. Then the doctor explains how to utilize the learnings provided as well as explaining what happiness means and how to achieve it. She also gives real life examples explaining different scenarios before, during and after events that usually make people anxious.

In addition to the relaxation exercise and learning the user is welcomed to walk around the area which is designed to be a calming mountain setting.

The features and content a customer can expect to be included with their purchase is:
1: as detailed above the customer can select buttons. Each of those buttons start a different session of relaxation experience
2: as detailed above, the button called “Breathe” starts the session explaining how to properly breathe.
3: as detailed above, the button called “Happiness” starts the session explaining how to become a happy person
Other buttons are more self-explanatory.

data.name: The Shadows of Dry Creek
data.detailed_description:
After a long absence, Silas Reed returns to Dry Creek… but something feels wrong.

The silence is too heavy, the streets too empty. And no explanation awaits him upon his return.

In this isolated town of the Old West, everything feels frozen in time. Landmarks seem to vanish, places are deserted, and a growing sense of unease slowly sets in.

Very quickly, what was meant to be a simple return home turns into a disturbing mystery, where every moment deepens doubt and uncertainty.

Les Ombres de Dry Creek offers an immersive narrative experience focused on atmosphere, mystery, and the inexplicable. The first entry in a two-part story, this adventure takes you deep into the secrets of Dry Creek and its most unsettling enigmas. While this story provides a complete experience on its own, some answers will be revealed in the second episode, Les Lumières de Dry Creek, currently planned for late 2026 / early 2027.

The game lasts approximately 45 minutes, featuring nearly 70 illustrated scenes accompanied by immersive sound design that enhances the tension and atmosphere of the narrative.

This project was developed solo by an independent developer passionate about video games, following an artisanal approach focused on storytelling and atmosphere.

A short experience, playable in a single sitting, where the past and the inexplicable intertwine without immediately revealing all their answers, set within a larger and mysterious universe.

data.name: SCRIBBLE HUNT
data.detailed_description:
Paint the bunny man — a hide-and-seek where you blend in like a chameleon.

2–10 players in one arena. Will you be the hunter, or the hunted?

Hiders have two ways to survive:

Scribble camouflage — sample colors, match the light, tune your materials, and paint yourself seamlessly into the scene;

Shape-shifting — become any object in the environment, real enough to fool anyone. Hunters, meanwhile, carry high-tech paint weapons that leave no disguise unexposed.

The rules are simple. Split into the Hunter team and the Hider team and play hide-and-seek. The Hunters win if they find every Hider before time runs out.

More than color sampling — stamp the texture and finish of nearby materials onto yourself in one tap. No parameters, no painting skills. Even total beginners blend into the scene in an instant.

The paint blaster fires precise shots — one splash of color and you're exposed. The splat bomb blankets a wide area, flushing out everyone in range. Pair them with the assault rifle to take down exposed targets on the spot. Maximum hunting efficiency.

The last 30 seconds are the reveal round: every Hider's spot is unveiled so everyone can see just how well they blended in. Give a thumbs-up to the slickest disguises — the better the hide, the more the love!

Mix and match a wardrobe of skins, then top it off with slick dances and taunt poses — hide in silence, flex out loud.

Open a private room and invite your friends, or hop into a public room and match with strangers. 2–10 players, one arena, endless fun!

• Building A Blueprint Deck

    There are four types of guards to train: Warrior, Bowman, Wizard, and Priest. Each type of guard has its own specialty, and you can win by matching different types of guards to maximize your defense.

data.name: Cypherpunk
data.detailed_description:
Overview

Cypherpunk is a visceral, narrative-driven first-person shooter infused with deeply unsettling psychological horror. Set in a dystopian metropolis governed by an all-seeing, algorithmic oligarchy, you play as Null, a rogue cryptographic specialist and black-market data runner.

When a routine heist of an encrypted "ghost drive" goes catastrophically wrong, you don’t just steal data—you ingest it. Now, hunted by corporate kill-squads and haunted by the fractured digital consciousness trapped inside your mind, you must fight your way through the neon-drenched underbelly of the city while struggling to determine what is real, and what is merely a glitch in your perception.

Synopsis: The War for Your Mind

In the city of Enclave-09, privacy is a death sentence. The corporate conglomerate OmniSight monitors every heartbeat, retinal scan, and synaptic firing. The only resistance left is the Cypherpunks—underground hackers and gunrunners fighting for absolute encryption and cognitive freedom.

After uploading a corrupted, forbidden encryption key directly into your neural implant, reality begins to splinter. The environment shifts seamlessly from gritty, industrial corridors to surreal, nightmarish digital voids. The voice in your head isn't yours anymore, and the shadows around the corner are taking shape. To survive, you must use a deadly arsenal of firearms to decrypt the truth before your sanity hits zero.

data.name: MomentumBall
data.detailed_description:
This is a physics-based puzzle action game built around precise control of jump height and movement speed.
Players move the ball horizontally, and the ball automatically jumps whenever it touches the ground.

By carefully adjusting jump height and speed, players can control the ball’s trajectory, momentum, and landing points.
The same obstacle can be solved in multiple ways depending on how these values are set, making fine-tuned adjustment the core of the gameplay.

As the game progresses, players will encounter:

  • Sections that require precise jump height control

  • Puzzles that demand careful speed and momentum management

  • Complex challenges that combine both jump height and speed adjustment

Early stages focus on mastering jump height control, while later stages introduce speed and acceleration management for more advanced puzzles.

With simple controls but deep mechanical depth, the game rewards planning, experimentation, and understanding of physics rather than fast reflexes.

Designed for players who enjoy deliberate, thoughtful gameplay, this game offers a focused and challenging physics puzzle experience on PC.

Phoe captures the spirit of retro 2D platformers with striking pixel art, fluid movement mechanics, and challenges for speedrunners and explorers alike. You’ll be sliding to gain speed, bouncing off the walls and dodging buzzsaws with your double jump. Journey through four unique worlds packed with hidden secrets, from a chaotic city to a dangerous labyrinth. Built for replayability, every run pushes you one step closer to claiming that shiny platinum medal. Think you’ve mastered platformers by now? Prove it.

data.name: Rock Paper Viking
data.detailed_description:
Rock Paper Viking is a pocket game, designed to be relaxing and tailored to your desired play time. Only have a few minutes? Play for 20 waves or so. Get a chance to earn some Aesir Shards and buy Runestones to help you on your next run. Feel like going longer? Bump up the difficulty and play all the way to wave 100, with increased chances of higher level loot and obtaining one of the sacred Legendary weapons!

This is a casual experience, meant to be enjoyed by all. So jump in and experience the cardboard world of Rock Paper Viking!

Yggdrasil, the World Tree, has swallowed your village whole and transported you to an unknown location where the realms of Norse myth are converging and mutating. Every day you fight, the islands will randomize and confront you with a new set of elements and enemies to battle. You can choose to invade these realms by spending a precious Invasion Token. If successful, you can lock the realm to any element of your choosing. Have a powerful fire hammer? Then lock those islands to Ice enemies, and melt away your opposition!

Earn Gold and Aesir Shards as you battle the enemies of your village. Spend these valuable coins at shops within your village in between days. Upgrade the Loot Cannon and increase the amount of loot you receive each wave, or upgrade your health at the Fort repair shop. You can even buy a fancy hat for your character, and if you're lucky, the shopkeeper will have a legendary hat waiting for you on their shelves. Hope you saved up enough gold!

data.name: Bionic Traveler
data.detailed_description:
Explore the wild, fantasy, and sci-fi realms of the world of Bionic Traveler! Wander in this semi-open 2D top-down world; encounter enemies, items, and NPCs in the world. Fight the enemies with your melee and ranged weapons while also getting dodging and teleporting away to manage your health. The game offers two main places for these combat encounters:

1. In the latest build the open world where you will encounter enemies out in the wild
2. The enemy arena in which you can challenge each of our enemies in a one-on-one fight

Aside from combat, read the lore of this world in our story section while listening to the tunes of our soundtrack, admiring our art assets, and speaking with the NPCs of our world in our art museum section.

Bionic Traveler is the 2021-2022 School Year Project of the University of Pennsylvania Game Research and Development Environment Club (UPGRADE).

Under the leadership of Di Lu (SEAS '22) and Edward Zhang (SEAS + Wharton '23), UPGRADE sought to use the development of this project to teach its members the processes of game development, to serve as an outlet for creative expression, and to provide the expression of bringing a game from concept all the way to market. Thus, the contents of this game were made over the course of a singular academic year at UPenn off of weekly meetings, a few extra-meeting crunches, and a hackathon.

The game was ultimately not entirely finished, but this build that is now listed on Steam serves to show off the work that the students in this club were able to accomplish on top of their rigorous course loads at UPenn.

The game concept was pitched by Praneel Chakraborty (CAS + Wharton '24), and the story premise was picked by Jimmy Ciardullo (SEAS '22).

Lennart Meincke (SAS '23) served as the project's lead programmer, Meggie Cheng (SEAS '22) served as the game's Art Director, Kevin Zhao (SEAS '22) served as the game's Sound Lead, and Kevin Ma (SEAS '25) and Jimmy Ciardullo (SEAS '22) served as the game's lead writers.

data.name: Who Earns More
data.detailed_description:
You have a little money, a growing debt, and a limited number of days. What will you do with them?

Who Earns More is a single-player, turn-based trading and management game with bold graffiti artwork. Buy goods, travel to new markets, respond to unexpected events, and choose when to cash out. Your final wealth counts what you keep after debt—not just what you buy.

THREE WORLDS, THREE WAYS TO EARN

City Hustle
Work the markets of New York, follow street rumors, and navigate a volatile BTC, ETH and BNB market. Modern stories about creators, AI and robots bring new twists to your trading route.

Immortal Merchant
Buy sect holdings, hidden realms and spirit beasts. Each journey advances production, sending goods into a separate store. Watch market prices, manage limited space, and sell before a full warehouse brings production to a halt. Spirit storms can change your plans.

Fantasy Guild
Fund expeditions into moonlit woods, ancient ruins and a dragon's lair. Choose a leader, respond to dangers along the way, and decide whether to send support, take a detour or push deeper. Bring back bounties and loot, then choose when to sell.

MAKE EVERY TURN COUNT
Choose a 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100-day run. Travel advances time; browsing and trading let you plan your next move. Balance working capital, debt, health, storage and the time your investments need to pay off.

MORE THAN BUY LOW, SELL HIGH
Take delivery orders, meet local characters, review the prices you have seen, and adapt to illustrated events. Each mode keeps its own progress and offers a different path through the same race to grow your fortune.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Switch between English and Traditional Chinese. Adjust music, sound effects and voice volume, choose a larger text option, and continue your saved run when you return. Each world has its own music, sounds and expressive bilingual dialogue.

Three worlds. Three ways to earn. Your next move is yours.

All markets, coins and funds are fictional simulations within the game. There are no real cryptocurrency transactions, wallets or cash redemption.

data.name: Frenzy Force
data.detailed_description:
Frenzy Force is a casual top-down shooter set in a diverse collection of biomes known only as The Menagerie.

Existing outside of space and time, The Menagerie is home to formless, bloodthirsty shadow creatures with only one goal: to hunt down and eliminate anyone who enters.

Our brave heroes come from all walks of life, drawn together by the allure of The Menagerie's secrets. Although they have no connection to each other and their pasts are long forgotten, this daring expedition has given them a new identity: The Frenzy Force.

Enter The Menagerie at your own peril, and explore 16 unique biomes with over 30 weapons to aid you in your survival. Last as long as you can against relentless waves of enemies, either solo or with friends!

data.name: Theseus Protocol
data.detailed_description:
Theseus Protocol is a deck building strategy roguelike set in a dire dystopian world. Take the role of Prometheus and alter the fate of humanity with a collection of vigorous cards and a variety of weapons at the ready. Journey across disparate lands, encounter relentless foes, and unveil Mark City’s darkest secrets.



Unravel the fragmented narrative of Mark City across a divergent city riddled with elitist conspiracies and gang induced turmoil. Explore branching paths through successive playthroughs and reveal the history behind Mark City and its inhabitants. Each step plays a role in uncovering the truth.



Engage in stimulating turn-based battles and unleash an arsenal of extraordinary cards against brutal adversaries. Gain the tactical advantage by changing positions to dodge incoming attacks and even cause enemies to crash into one another. Leave no waste, as any cards leftover can be utilized as ammunition for Prometheus’ weaponry. The fate of humanity lies within the ultimate deck and a masterful strategy.

Key Features:
  • Dynamic and stimulating turn-based battles with a strategic twist
  • Nonlinear, fractured narrative to unravel across a roguelike adventure
  • Progressive deck building through successive runs
  • Influential card-fueled weaponry
  • Three playable characters all with unique combat styles and narrative threads
