data.name: Grimalkin: Solar Defense Force
data.detailed_description:
Description

Grimalkin Solar Defense Force is a game about planning each tactical retreat and achieving victory against overwhelming odds as the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire Decimates your forces. The game is set 6000 years into the future and an Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire that seeks to reclaim their ancient home world from the Mutated House Cats turned a Sentient Space Faring 80's Retro Race known as Grimalkins who happen upon them at the Edge of the Sol System. Grimalkins fought bravely against the initial wave but what remained of Admiral Fluffy Duffy's fleet is Unknown. All that stands between earth and utter destruction is the Grimalkin Solar Defense Force and their nigh impervious Hyper Field Barriers. As the sole commander of the Grimalkin Defense Force you are tasked with preparing the Hyper Field Defenses, its fleet, and prevent the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire from reaching Earth.



Do you have what it takes to lead space faring house cats against the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire?!

Features

  • You as the player start off with nothing but scarce resources a portal and a brave Grimalkin Commander at your side.
  • Build Orbital Space Stations to boost your fleet and defenses.
  • Mine Resources from ore , H3 fuel, to enemy Knowledge.
  • Research new Tech Tiers to improve your fleets fighting capabilities.
  • Test the enemy for weakness with each loadout of your fleet.
  • Every ship matters, and losing just one could mean your utter destruction. Retreat when all seems lost and save your fleet to help you withstand the overwhelming odds against you.
  • Use your Commander in Battle to aid you in the fight but be careful not to lose the brave soul as he/she is your only hope to win the day; if lost all is lost.
  • Tactically plan your forces to out maneuver the enemy; using superior tactics will help you gain the knowledge and skill to increase your overall chance of survival as well as your overall statistics.

Grimalkin Solar Defense is a Rogue Like RTS game. As a player you’re tasked with improving your fleet and figuring out what best configuration can beat the enemy’s defenses. They call themselves the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire; whatever that means. Figuring out their alien weaponry will help lead you to victory as you fight your way back to Earth. Face Overwhelming odds and challenges throughout the game. Be prepared to lose and retreat often as the enemy is unrelenting in their war against the Grimalkin forces. Each Planet Lost is a chance lost, Hold the enemy as much as possible and plan your fights with the intent to save as many of your precious ships as possible. Every ship lost hurts so try to keep your fleet alive for the next engagement.

data.name: Sniper Dan
data.detailed_description:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

1) Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…

2) Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!

3) Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.

It did. It was Dan!

            

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Snapshot Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.

Key Features

  • Outrageous tools. Sensible intentions
    Use a sniper rifle to fix everyday problems. No danger. No drama. Just long-range problem solving.

  • A hidden object game through a sniper scope
    Scan busy 3D scenes, spot what’s wrong and solve it with one perfectly aimed shot.

  • Over 160 jobs across six lively locations
    Take on everyday jobs, Answerphone requests, emergency jobs, boss jobs and special challenges, plus bonus games and three dedicated minigames: Bowling, Tennis and Air Hockey.

  • Every job is a tiny mystery
    Figure out cryptic clues, search the scene and work out what actually needs fixing, with dynamic solutions that mean jobs can change each time you play.

  • A playful 3D world full of shareable moments
    Explore six packed locations with 100+ secrets, 200+ ambient stories and 45 hilarious photo opportunities waiting to be discovered and shared.

  • Grow your business one job at a time
    Earn money and reputation from successful jobs, upgrade and customise your rifle, unlock costumes and collectibles, decorate your office hub and expand your operation.

  • Unexpected problems. Serious precision. Zero violence
    Fix signs, tighten bolts, pop balloons and jump-start fireworks. Nobody gets hurt. Ever.

Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.

Key Features

  • Outrageous tools. Sensible intentions
    Use a sniper rifle to fix everyday problems. No danger. No drama. Just long-range problem solving.

  • A hidden object game through a sniper scope
    Scan busy 3D scenes, spot what’s wrong and solve it with one perfectly aimed shot.

  • Over 160 jobs across six lively locations
    Take on everyday jobs, Answerphone requests, emergency jobs, boss jobs and special challenges, plus bonus games and three dedicated minigames: Bowling, Tennis and Air Hockey.

  • Every job is a tiny mystery
    Figure out cryptic clues, search the scene and work out what actually needs fixing, with dynamic solutions that mean jobs can change each time you play.

  • A playful 3D world full of shareable moments
    Explore six packed locations with 100+ secrets, 200+ ambient stories and 45 hilarious photo opportunities waiting to be discovered and shared.

  • Grow your business one job at a time
    Earn money and reputation from successful jobs, upgrade and customise your rifle, unlock costumes and collectibles, decorate your office hub and expand your operation.

  • Unexpected problems. Serious precision. Zero violence
    Fix signs, tighten bolts, pop balloons and jump-start fireworks. Nobody gets hurt. Ever.

Use a sniper rifle to solve hundreds of low-stakes jobs across six packed locations, discover surprising secrets, snap hilarious photo ops, and unlock costumes, upgrades, office décor, collectables and more!

data.detailed_description:
Moby Click is a cozy top-down harpoon shooter inspired by Moby-Dick and classic pixel games.
Command the Pequod, defend it from waves of sea creatures, earn doubloons, unlock upgrades, and push deeper into Ahab’s quest for the legendary White Whale.

Features

  • Fast, satisfying naval combat — aim freely with mouse, controller, or Steam Deck.

  • Wave-based arcade action — fend off escalating swarms of sharks, rays, leviathans, and monstrous bosses.

  • Deep progression loop — earn doubloons for run upgrades and lore shards for permanent ship buffs.

  • Prestige into Ahab’s Obsession — reset for powerful bonuses and rewards.

  • Fully Steam Deck supported — custom input layout, tuned UI, optimized controls.

Face storms, night seas, and increasingly bizarre denizens of the deep as you push toward the inevitable showdown with the White Whale.

data.name: Tragedy of Medusa
data.detailed_description:
Three goddesses decide to leave their island home to visit Athens. After demonstrating rare powers, they become targets of both gods and succubi.

Tragedy of Medusa is a short linear visual novel with some animations. Estimated game play is less than 2 hours. Tragedy of Medusa is the prequel to Euryale's Gambit.

While based roughly on the ancient Greek myth, Tragedy of Medusa is not the story you remember. This story takes place in a world where gods walk among men, demons run rampant and succubi toy with all. Tragedy of Medusa respects the major events of the classic tale, but tweaks the world in which those events take place as well as the motivation of the characters behind those events.

Content:

Over 800 rendered images

43 animations

Content "Flavors":

Oral Sex

Female-Female Sex

Male-Female Sex

Lesbian-only route (optional)

Extended Description:

Medusa is the youngest of three sisters known as "Gorgons". While her other sisters have incredible powers, Medusa feels out of place without any special abilities. She contemplates leaving her sisters during their trip to Athens. Things go wrong however when she discovers the Olympians are murdering other gods. Medusa finds herself as their latest victim only to be saved at the last moment by her sister, Euryale.

During the rescue, Athena, an Olympian leader, witnesses Medusa's sister Euryale using lust energy -an energy typically only used by Succubi. Athena calls upon the Succubus Queens to explain and possibly teach her this ability in an alliance Olympians against the demons. Queen Eisheth, the third Succubus Queen, rejects their offer and sends her younger sister Queen Igret on a quest to find these "Gorgons" and see for themselves their strange abilities.

Meanwhile, once the Gorgons' mother, Ceto, learns what happened to Medusa in Athens, she begins to attack the coastlines of Olympian cities as the sea-monster "Cetus". Athena sends Perseus to capture one of the gorgon sisters both to study and as a hostage against Cetus.

data.name: Oh!Ware
data.detailed_description:
The gods are watching, your ancestors whisper guidance. Oh!Ware is a reimagining of the ancient game of Mancala as a deck-building roguelike rooted in African mythology, blending traditional seed-sowing gameplay with the modern depth of Slay the Spire, and Monster Train.

Features A Spiritual Puzzle-Battler: Ancient strategy meets modern roguelike design. Every marble placement alters the board and your destiny.

  • Build Your Marble Deck: Collect over 100+ unique marbles with elemental powers, synergies, and effects: Burn, Bless, Drain, Poison, and more.

  • Face the Pantheon: Battle through 3 mythic biomes; The Jungle, Plains, and Mountains. Each ruled by divine guardians and hidden hazards.

  • Challenging Difficulty: Each map has 8 Ascensions available to challenge even the best players

  • Dynamic Hazards: Beware Floods, Poisonous vegetation, and more that can change the board mid-run. Adapt your strategy or be overwhelmed.

  • Ancestral Charms: Find and equip 100+ charms that bend fate. Double up captures, apply divine protection, or unleash forbidden power.

  • Evolving Synergies: Experiment with marble combinations to create devastating chain reactions and divine blessings.

  • Quick, Replayable Runs: Average 30–40 minute sessions designed for mastery, experimentation, and spiritual discovery.

  • Challenge the Pantheon: Defeat powerful bosses who embody the wrath and wisdom of the gods.

data.name: Street volleyball - Invitation
data.detailed_description:
Street volleyball is a funny sport game. There are many characters you and choose, and each have their own special ability.
Play volleyball matches with different players from different regions. Use you ability and find a way to defeat the opponent. Only with skill and quick reflexes can you beat them and become a champion.

Choose your character
Each character has their own special ability. You choose the character and use the ability to beat other players.
Interestingly, your abilities may have advantages or disadvantages over your enemy's abilities. So you need to figure out a way to beat your opponent.

Abilities
There are two main kinds of abilities: the constitution abilities and ball abilities.
The constitution abilities: you can have double jump, super jump, or speed enhancement.
The ball abilities: You are able to play special balls, i.e. to stick a bomb on a ball, to play a floating ball or drop ball, and to teleport balls, etc.
Besides, there is a role, he always play a second ball. There are two balls in game, so it is very funny.

**Animation Hypertext Engine**
We develop our own Animation Hypertext Engine, which run script on the fly. Game scripts are editable, so you can modify or add any content of this game if you are interested.

data.name: Parcel Mania: Free Multiplayer Madness
data.detailed_description:
Parcel Mania is a frantic online or local splitscreen party game supporting up to 4 players in a match. Your #1 goal? Collect and deliver the most parcels and become the best courier connoisseur of the match!





Collect parcels from their stations, or smack ‘em out of your friends hands. Whoever delivers them to the customers gets to rank up high in the scoreboard. And if you want to slow your friends down? Slap the customers and watch them weep! It’s all fair in the world of delivery.





Leap over walls, flip switches, zip through shortcuts and defy gravity itself to get your parcels to your customers no matter what. Talk about 'air mail'! In Parcel Mania, you're not just a courier – you're a gravity-defying delivery superhero. Just remember, capes are optional when you're leaping over walls and flipping through the air!





Pick from five distinct characters, each with their own quirky personality and style! Each character brings their own unique flair to the frantic parcel delivery action. So, who will you be today? The choice is yours – pick your favorite and deliver those parcels with style!





Setting traps for your friends is like being in a wacky game show – except the only prize is the sweet, sweet victory of watching them jump in surprise. It's not just about speed, it's about how you play the game – and a little bit of 'parcel-tactical' warfare!





Challenge your friends from across the globe or from across your couch – all for no price. Yep – Parcel Mania in its current or future versions will remain FREE TO PLAY. Now go get those customers their parcels and beat your friends!

data.name: Tiny Forge
data.detailed_description:
Tiny Forge is a first-person fantasy blacksmithing game where the weapons you make leave the workshop and enter the fight. Turn raw ore into finished blades, fulfill orders for warrior customers, and equip the defenders who stand between your forge and the monsters outside.

        Smelt ore, pour molten metal, and work a glowing ingot on the anvil. Quench the steel, sharpen its edges, and assemble the parts before delivering the finished weapon. Handle the tools yourself, from the first hammer strike to the final polish.

       At the end of each day, watch your warriors face monsters in turn-based battles. The weapons you made are now in their hands, and their quality and durability matter.

        Earn coins from orders and battles, unlock skills, and improve your craft as the days grow more demanding. Protect the gate: three accumulated defeats end your run.

  • Hands-on, first-person blacksmithing from raw ore to assembled weapon.

  • Swords and axes to shape, sharpen, and finish.

  • Fantasy warrior customers and a skill tree to develop your craft.

  • Daily monster raids with turn-based battles.

  • A single-player experience set in a stylized fantasy workshop.

data.name: 幻域 Fantasy Domain
data.detailed_description:
"Fantasy Domain" is a fantasy action-adventure roguelike game. Embark on an endless battle and face unprecedented enemy combinations!

🎮 Eternal Trials, Infinite Waves

In this action survival game, you will face wave after wave of swarming monsters all on your own. From the weakest Slime to Elves, Goblins, Skeleton Warriors, and Fallen Angels... the variety and strength of enemies escalate as you progress through the levels.

🧩 Dynamic Boss Wave System

Say goodbye to repetitive boss fights! Our unique "repeatable combination" algorithm ensures that every level's boss lineup is completely different. You might face two Slimes at the same time, encounter the three Goblin brothers, or even a deadly combination of a Fallen Angel and a Skeleton King. Sorting by total weight, max weight, min weight, and weight sequence guarantees a smoothly rising difficulty curve, making every challenge full of surprises and strategic tests.

🪄 Infinite Levels

The first five levels let you get acquainted with each enemy type. Starting from level six, the game enters endless mode — the size of the boss combination keeps increasing, allowing you to battle multiple bosses simultaneously. How many waves can you withstand? 100 waves? 200 waves? The limit is defined by your own skill.

🧬 Multi‑form Bosses

Bosses come with different difficulty forms — Form 1, Form 2, and Form 3 — delivering an ultra‑intense combat experience for the player.

⚔️ Fluid Real‑Time Combat

Utilize a variety of attack methods and skill combinations to fight the monsters of the Phantom Realm head‑on. Dodge flexibly, strike with flair, as monsters are dynamically placed on the ground and in the air to keep every battle tense and thrilling. Preloading and object pooling technology let you enjoy silky‑smooth performance even with dozens of enemies on screen — zero lag, zero waiting.

data.name: Building Blocks / Master Builder of Egypt
data.detailed_description:
What's Building Blocks ?

Building Blocks is a physics-based game of a special kind. Be a master-builder in Ancient Egypt!
Building Blocks captivates the player with its clever gameplay, its accessibility and exciting challenges for both children and adults. Join the halls of the most famous architects with skill and quick actions and receive special awards!
Are you ready to be one of the greatest master-builders of Egypt?

Awards

Building Blocks achieved 3rd place at the ”Living Games Festival Award 2009”. It was also nominated for “Gamesload Newcomer Award 2009″ and “German Developer Award 2009” and entered the “Independent Games Festival 2009” against Minecraft.

Key features

  • 16 Adventure Level of Building Blocks (all 3 Buildings 1 Adventure Level)
  • nice graphics design
  • designed with loving attention to detail
  • easy to control
  • Fun for the whole family
  • specially designed for women and men
  • two game modes
  • over 15 ranks
  • 16 unique trophies
  • more than 45 buildings and 60 building blocks
  • epic in-game soundtrack
  • more than 500 highscore lists
  • access help videos from right inside the game



INTRODUCTION

Building Block is a game of skill that takes place in Ancient Egypt. You play as a young man who dares to take on tricky building that will challenge all of your skills and craft. In competition with other players you'll earn experience and points which you can use to rise up in ranks and earn trophies.

BUILDINGS

At first the buildings are easy to rebuild. But the deeper you get into the game, the more demanding the buildings will be and the bulkier the blocks will be. Only true master builders will be able to overcome all of these challenges.

CONSTRUCTION PLANS

The blueprint of the current level is always visible in the background. This is the required state of the building to allow it to be approved. The plan also shows how the coloured blocks should be positioned. At easy difficulty this plan is only a rough outline, it allows some deviations at positioning the blocks. On the other side there's the hard difficulty: here the building has to fit the plan exactly. Both the position and the colour patterns have to match.

THE BLOCKS

The blocks of Building blocks come in many different shapes and colors. This diversity of blocks renders every newly achieved building a intriguing experience. Handles and weights differ from block to block. Movable and fixed blocks, simple and complex shapes, columns, letters and varying materials such as wood and stone will make every building a challenge.


BLOCK HANDLING

Every block has differing qualities that require different handling. Complex shaped blocks and sometimes strange gravity change the handling of some blocks, making the construction of some buildings even more challenging. The whole game is played using the PC mouse. You grab a block exactly at that position by clicking on it with the left mouse button. But the block still obeys gravity! Aside from the grabbed place the block will continue falling and swinging. You have to take the block's shape and mass into account before trying to move it.

Game Mode

NORMAL GAME
A normal game is played without time measurement. Just tinker with the blocks and enjoy experimenting. Unfortunately you're not allowed to enter the highscore lists in this mode.
TIMED GAME
In this game mode you're playing against the time. Try to solve the level before time runs out. Outstanding performances are able to enter the highscore list!

CREATE A PLAYER

If there's no player yet you should click on "Create player". A new window opens which allows you to enter your name. After clicking on "Accept" the new player now shows up in the player list. You start the game with a simple click at the desired player name. To delete a player you need to right-click it.


MAP

A beautiful map of Ancient Egypt shows all the various buildings. You can always view other sections of the map if scrolling is enabled at the top of the screen. By touching the gems at the map with your mouse you can get a preview of the building. You enter this building by left-clicking on it. Right-click on a gem shows the info screen explaining the meaning of the various gems. Only the finished buildings and the current building are shown at the map.


TROPHIES

The qualities coming with a received trophy hold true for all buildings in the whole game. That means that the qualities of each new trophy add up with the previously collected trophies or compensate them.


MENU

The main menu consists of the following five items: Start - Allows you to select or create a player. Options - Here you can adjust game settings such as resolution or brightness. Highscores - Shows the ranks of the best players worldwide for every building. Credits - Who created the Building Blocks? Quit - Ends the game.

OPTIONS

The following settings can be adjusted: Language - You can choose from English, German, Spanish, French and Japanese. There will be more languages later. Resolution - Drag the slider to select from 640x480, 800x600, 1024x768 and 1280x1024. Only works in windowed mode. Brightness - Can be adjusted if necessary. VSync - Vertical syncronisation avoids tearing but might slow down the game.

LANGUAGES

At first, Building Blocks will be available in English and German only but more languages will follow later on. You can switch the game language to your desired choice at the menu item "Options".

INSTRUCTION VIDEOS

For every building an instruction video is available at YouTube. You can get there in an instant by clicking the exclamation mark at the top-left corner of the Pause Menu. The Pause Menu is reachable via the Space key.

RANKS

There are 17 unique ranks in Building Blocks that can be reached by gaining experience.

data.name: Squoids
data.detailed_description:
Squoids is a game of momentum and endurance. Grow your swarm as you dynamically avoid the waves of enemies. Upgrade your swarm to fight back and ensure individuals survive longer. Every enemy defeated earning you the power to mix up the environment. Letting you tweak what is common to better suit your play strategy. 

Swim and Swerve

Squoids swim naturally in a swarm that follows your cursor's lead. Loop, lash, and launch as you outmaneuver enemies of a variety of speeds and movement types. The nature of the swarmed movement requiring shifting techniques as the number of squoids grow.

Upgrade and Fight

As you swim and explore your surroundings, you may come across bubbling pearls. These will let you select an upgrade for your squoids which can power them up and increase their value. Other than attacks, upgrades can also do things such as increase health or make squoids spawn quicker, making survival much easier. With three main paths that branch, each run you can select two allowing unique fusions geared toward how you like to play. As you upgrade, you'll also find that your swarm changes visually, representing the progress and choices you've made. 

Mix it up and More

In between runs, you can used earned currency to shift factors of the environment. This will change how your runs go as your mix things up, hopefully letting you find the balance that works best for you. Squoids is focused on convenience and runs whenever you want. You'll keep what you earned in a run no matter if you pause and quit, lose, or win. Game too slow? On the menu you can activate a 2x mode that will speed up gameplay to something much more fast paced. Want to start all over? A trashcan button will reset your data after 3 rapid presses, letting you start anew. In Squoids, pressure should only come from challenging gameplay, not external factors.

As you swim and explore your surroundings, you may come across bubbling pearls. These will let you select an upgrade for your squoids which can power them up and increase their value. Other than attacks, upgrades can also do things such as increase health or make squoids spawn quicker, making survival much easier. With three main paths that branch, each run you can select two allowing unique fusions geared toward how you like to play. As you upgrade, you'll also find that your swarm changes visually, representing the progress and choices you've made. 

Mix it up and More

In between runs, you can used earned currency to shift factors of the environment. This will change how your runs go as your mix things up, hopefully letting you find the balance that works best for you. Squoids is focused on convenience and runs whenever you want. You'll keep what you earned in a run no matter if you pause and quit, lose, or win. Game too slow? On the menu you can activate a 2x mode that will speed up gameplay to something much more fast paced. Want to start all over? A trashcan button will reset your data after 3 rapid presses, letting you start anew. In Squoids, pressure should only come from challenging gameplay, not external factors.
data.short_description: Every Squoid Matters! Squoids is a survival top-down arena shooter where you control a frantic swarm of the squid-like namesakes of the game. Maneuver and upgrade your swarm as an ocean's worth of sea creatures come after you. Can you endure long enough to defeat the mysterious final boss?

data.name: Lots at Stake
data.detailed_description:
Lots at Stake is a property-development tycoon built on a detailed business simulation inspired by greenfield land development. Take charge of your property development business and see if you can succeed.. Many wont..

Fund and acquire parcels of land, navigate the planning rules and construction process to sell lots to consumers in a realistic market economy. 

  • Evaluate realistic greenfield sites through planning, servicing, environmental, stormwater, transport network, and financial constraints.

  • Build project feasibilities covering land size, yield, infrastructure costs, revenue, and delivery risk.

  • Spend limited weekly management attention on acquisitions, negotiations, introductions, appointments, events, and project problems.

  • Grow from a sole operator into an industry-leading developer with staff, offices, overhead, and genuine operating capacity.

  • Build separate reputations with lenders, planners, contractors, and buyers, each affecting a different part of the market.

  • Discover stronger counterparties through a living relationship network rather than selecting from a static vendor list.

  • Manage company strain as project load, complexity, staff pressure, and rent test the limits of the business.

  • Respond to a dynamic economy and event system where external events shape interest rates, government expenditure and policy, consumer confidence, and supply chain problems that can alter project outcomes.

  • Negotiate acquisitions and employment contracts where terms and relationships influence the result.

  • Plan, launch, sell, and deliver staged communities while every decision carries forward into the next opportunity.

FIND POTENTIAL BEFORE THE MARKET DOES

Every property has a price. Not all have genuine development potential.

Review parcel boundaries, planning controls, servicing requirements, environmental conditions and local demand. Compare opportunities, challenge your assumptions and recognise when an apparent bargain is really a liability.

Negotiate price and settlement terms with the landowner—but consider how far you are prepared to push.

TURN PADDOCKS INTO PROFIT

Lay out roads, residential lots, stormwater infrastructure and open space assets in a carefully designed staging plan.

Balance yield against amenity, access, infrastructure, approvals and delivery cost. Decide what should be delivered first, which works can wait, and how much capital each stage will require.

Every line on the plan changes the numbers—and what future buyers will see.

OPERATE IN A CHANGING ECONOMY

The market will not wait for you to act.

Interest rates move. Construction costs rise. Credit tightens. Buyer confidence changes. Policy decisions and economic events create new risks and opportunities.

Respond to a dynamic economic and event system where changing conditions affect land values, borrowing, construction, demand and affordability.

A project that worked when you bought the land may look very different by the time you are ready to sell it.

SELL THE PROMISE

Choose the product lot mix, price each lot and launch stages into the market.

Buyers respond to price/affordability, amenity, access and market confidence. Different buyers want different products, and demand does not automatically appear simply because land has been released.

Every lot must earn its buyer.

Lower prices may accelerate sales but weaken the margin. Holding firm may protect value but leave debt outstanding for longer. Decide what the project—and the company—can afford.

THEN DELIVER IT

Manage construction as the approved plan becomes a real project.

Delays, shortages, incidents and variations can turn a strong feasibility into a difficult delivery. Decide when to intervene, when to spend more and when to accept that the programme has changed.

Settle the sales, repay the debt and enhance the relationships that helped deliver the project.

BUILD A NETWORK, NOT A VENDOR LIST

The best person for a job may not know you yet.

Your professional network is a living web of individual relationships. Each relationship is directed: someone’s opinion of you may differ from your opinion of them.

Some consultants, contractors, lenders, and industry contacts are visible from the beginning. Stronger or more specialised people may remain beyond your reach until a trusted contact agrees to introduce you.

Requesting an introduction consumes action points, and access is never automatic. Your contact must know the target well enough—and trust you enough—to put their own relationship behind the introduction.

Negotiations, appointments, project outcomes and events can strengthen relationships or damage them.

A good relationship can reveal a better consultant, open a new negotiation path, or provide help when a project begins to fail. Handle people badly and the same network can close around you.

EARN A REPUTATION THAT CHANGES THE MARKET

Reputation is not a single popularity score.

Your company builds separate standing with:

  • Lenders

  • Planning professionals and authorities

  • Contractors and consultants

  • Buyers

  • Equity Markets

Each reputation channel affects a different part of the business.

A strong lender reputation can improve access to finance and borrowing terms. A credible planning track record can reduce friction around future applications. Contractors may offer better pricing, lower risk, or access to stronger teams. A trusted buyer brand can improve campaign reach and purchaser confidence.

Achievements and successful project outcomes can strengthen your reputation. Broken commitments, poor delivery, aggressive conduct, and failed decisions can damage it.

Cash may fund the next project.

Reputation helps determine which opportunities reach you in the first place.

SCALE WITHOUT BECOMING THE BOTTLENECK

Grow the company through a long-term maturity path:

Sole Operator → Structured Studio → Growing Developer → Established Developer → Industry Leader

Larger offices, better staff, and stronger internal systems increase project capacity, improve coordination, and allow the company to handle greater complexity.

But growth is not a simple upgrade tree.

New offices require fitout capital and add weekly rent. Additional staff create capacity but increase overhead. More projects generate revenue opportunities while placing greater pressure on the organisation responsible for delivering them.

Take on more than the company can support and strain begins to rise.

High strain can create:

  • greater internal coordination costs;

  • longer project programmes;

  • more operational events;

  • weaker capture of amenity, access, and quality benefits;

  • greater pressure during negotiations;

  • reduced ability to respond when something goes wrong.

Scale too slowly and worthwhile opportunities may pass you by.

Scale too quickly and your own company becomes the risk.

Lots at Stake - Build the business behind the city.

data.name: Lovers Die
data.detailed_description:
Lovers Die is a narrative dice game where every roll matters. Not just for your score but also for your story.

A darkly romantic story.

After facing heartbreak and tragedy, Juliet wakes up in the afterlife with only a pocket full of dice.

Here, a playful devil has decided that only winners are allowed to leave. 

Can Juliet beat the devil at its own game? And can he find a way to escape with Romeo?

Roll, re-roll, and outscore the devil.

Each round, roll your dice and strategically choose which to re-roll, building the highest scoring hand of combinations.

Unlock new dice and upgrade them with score-boosting skills as you progress through the game.

Every encounter presents a new gameplay twist which challenges the player in unexpected ways.

Between dice games, your same hand of modified dice carries into branching story segments.

Roll combinations to unlock dialogue choices and new paths. The better your dice, the more of the story opens up.

Two ways to play:

  • Story Mode: Interweaves dice gameplay with a narrative journey through the afterlife.

  • Endless Mode: A roguelike format focused purely on the dice game, with no story interruptions.

data.name: Arcana Famiglia -La storia della Arcana Famiglia- Rinato
data.detailed_description:
An Adventure that Spins the Wheel of Fortune！

"Arcana Famiglia -La storia della Arcana Famiglia- Ancora", a game based on the concept of a Otome game × Shonen manga, originally available on the in 2015, will be ported to the Steam!

This is a story of destiny and bonds centered around Felicita, the daughter of the boss of Arcana Famiglia, an organization on a small island that possesses mysterious powers.

The game progresses with a comic-like storyline that uses colorful illustrations called the Comiaru system. The game also features the unique Cocoaru System, which allows you to read the minds of other characters!

Enjoy character designer and original artist Sara Chiyomi's beautiful CG illustrations in full HD quality!

The story is brought to life by a talented cast of voice actors including Jun Fukuyama, Tsubasa Yonaga, Hiroyuki Yoshino, Tomokazu Sugita, Yuichi Nakamura, Jurota Kosugi, and Koji Yusa!

STORY

Acrana Famiglia is an autonomous organization that protects the small island of Regalo in the Mediterranean Sea.

Those who belong to the Famiglia have a mysterious power called Arcana, which they use to protect the island from outside enenmies.

Felicita (main character/name can be changed), the only daughter of the organization's boss Mondo, has only just taken her first steps as a member of the family.

April 1st. It's Mondo's birthday. At a party thrown for him by the family, he makes a surprising announcement.

Mondo: "Two months from now...June 1. We'll hold the Arcana Duello!"

Mondo: "The winner of the Duello will become the leader of the organization...and as the new Papa, they will wed my daughter."

This is Felicita's story, as she fights to win the Arcana Duello in order to change her own destiny.

Felicita: "My path...is for me to decide."

KEYWORD

Arcana Famiglia

The vigilante-like organization that the protagonist belongs to. Her father, Mondo, is the boss of the organiation, and is referred to as Papa. His wife Sumire is also referred to as Mama.

Within the family, there are members who gain special abilities called Arcana by forming a contract with Tarocco.

The organization is divided into an intelligence department that also handles diplomacy, and four departments that maintain public order on the island, and sometimes work with the island's lord to take charge of self-governance and security on Regalo Island.

In each Serie (department), there are people with titles such as "King", "Queen", "Knight", and "Page", each with around 10 subordinates who support their respective executives."

Arcana Abilities

Making a contract with the Tarocco, a card that holds mysterious power, can grant abilities known as Arcana.

Currently, no new contracts are being made for the 22 cards that comprise the Major Arcana.

Those who make contracts with the Major Arcana are also called hosts, and make a mark (Stigmata) engraved somewhere on their body as proof of the contract.

Almost all of the other family members have physical abilities that are greater than those of an ordinary person, thanks to simple contracts formed with the Minor Arcana.

Tarocco

A mysterious card deck that was unsealed by Mondo.

Through Mondo's contract with The World card, it protects the peace of the island of Regalo from outside threats.

Though it grants abilities that normal people do not possess, it seems there is also a price to pay for those abilities.

The vigilante-like organization that the protagonist belongs to. Her father, Mondo, is the boss of the organiation, and is referred to as Papa. His wife Sumire is also referred to as Mama.

Within the family, there are members who gain special abilities called Arcana by forming a contract with Tarocco.

The organization is divided into an intelligence department that also handles diplomacy, and four departments that maintain public order on the island, and sometimes work with the island's lord to take charge of self-governance and security on Regalo Island.

In each Serie (department), there are people with titles such as "King", "Queen", "Knight", and "Page", each with around 10 subordinates who support their respective executives."

Arcana Abilities

Making a contract with the Tarocco, a card that holds mysterious power, can grant abilities known as Arcana.

Currently, no new contracts are being made for the 22 cards that comprise the Major Arcana.

Those who make contracts with the Major Arcana are also called hosts, and make a mark (Stigmata) engraved somewhere on their body as proof of the contract.

Almost all of the other family members have physical abilities that are greater than those of an ordinary person, thanks to simple contracts formed with the Minor Arcana.

Tarocco

A mysterious card deck that was unsealed by Mondo.

Through Mondo's contract with The World card, it protects the peace of the island of Regalo from outside threats.

Though it grants abilities that normal people do not possess, it seems there is also a price to pay for those abilities.

data.name: SHADE WALKERS
data.detailed_description:
SHADE WALKERS

A 2v2v2 PvPvE Horror Escape Game. Only One Team Can Make It Out Alive.

A school shrouded in darkness, haunted by terrifying entities.

Search the halls for hidden plush toys, offer them at the altar, and unlock the escape gate.

But opening the gate doesn't guarantee your survival.

The entities aren't your only enemies. Other teams are fighting for the same escape.

SHADE WALKERS is a PvPvE horror escape game that combines exploration, psychological warfare, and tactical decision-making.

Form a team of two and compete against up to two rival teams. Survive encounters with supernatural entities, use your items strategically, and outsmart your opponents to make it out alive.

Play online against other players or take on BOT matches solo. The horror and mind games await, even when you're playing alone.

GAME FEATURES

A School That Changes Every Match

Enter a dark school overrun by mysterious and terrifying entities.

Player spawn points, item locations, altar positions, and escape gate locations are randomized, creating unpredictable situations every match.

Even in familiar surroundings, you never know what awaits around the next corner.

From Exploration to Escape

Your objective is to find three hidden plush toys scattered throughout the school and offer them at the altar to unlock the escape gate.

But you're not alone.

Entities roam the halls, and rival teams are searching for the same offerings.

Once all three offerings have been made, the escape gate appears, triggering a final struggle for survival.

To win, both members of your team must escape through the gate.

Leaving your partner behind means losing the match.

The Entities Are Your Enemies — and Sometimes Your Weapons

Different types of supernatural entities haunt the school, each with its own behavior and abilities.

Relentless hunters, towering monstrosities, and swarms of smaller creatures create constantly shifting threats.

And as the escape draws closer, even greater dangers emerge.

Fighting back isn't always the answer.

Learn how the entities behave, manipulate their movements, and turn their presence into an advantage against rival teams.

Sometimes, the most dangerous weapon is the monster you lead toward your enemies.

Limited Items. Unlimited Possibilities.

Each player can carry a maximum of three items. Even as a team, you have only six inventory slots.

What will you carry? When will you use it?

Will you prioritize your own survival, protect your teammate, or sabotage another team?

Every decision can change the course of the match.

ITEMS (SELECTION)

  • Flashlight: A valuable defensive tool capable of temporarily stunning supernatural entities.

  • Barricade: Block passageways to slow pursuing entities or obstruct other players.

  • Search Drone: Temporarily reveals enemy positions through walls and obstacles for several seconds.

  • Bandage: A vital survival item that gives you a chance to recover after being taken down by an entity.

  • Bear Trap: Place traps to catch unsuspecting enemies.

  • Smoke Bomb: Obscure visibility to create opportunities for escape or surprise attacks.

Combine different items, experiment with strategies, and discover your own path to victory.

GAME MODES

Online Multiplayer — 2v2v2

Up to six players compete in three teams of two in intense PvPvE matches.

Coordinate with your teammate, outmaneuver rival teams, and survive encounters with terrifying entities.

Adapt to constantly changing situations and fight to become the only team that escapes.

BOT Matches — Play Solo

Experience the full escape game in BOT matches, even when playing alone.

Explore the school, collect items, encounter supernatural entities, and fight your way to the exit under the same core rules as online matches.

Challenge yourself at your own pace, without needing other players.

BOT matches are also available in the free demo!

The demo features the latest graphics and lets you experience the game's core gameplay. Online multiplayer is available in the full version.

WHO WILL MAKE IT OUT ALIVE?

Terrifying entities lurking in the darkness.

Rival teams racing toward the escape gate.

Limited supplies. Limited time.

Will you trust your teammate?

Will you outsmart your opponents?

Or will you turn the monsters themselves into weapons?

Cooperation. Intelligence. Psychological Warfare. Strategy. Luck.

Use everything at your disposal — and escape the school alive.

data.name: SHIRO
data.detailed_description:
"Boot Successful."

Awoken by a quake of unknown origin, a lone android opens her eyes in the depths of a top-secret laboratory. Why is it so empty? Why are these doors... locked? The silence is... deafening.

SH1-R0 follows a rogue android through the story of her two-sided conflict caused by the mistakes of an eons-dead alien race, and the ambitions of humans that are on the verge of repeating them.



As a highly advanced combat android, string together earth-shaking combos to crush waves of enemies while you explore labyrinthine high-security facilities all over Earth... and from beyond the stars.



Your combat abilities are unimpeded by the length of your weapon. Pick your fighting style and bring enemies down to your own turf or take the fight to them!



Unlock advanced movement abilities to reach new areas, and blaze through familiar ones with blinding speed. Dash, climb, crawl, and wall-jump, your exploration arsenal is fully-loaded.



Explore mazelike laboratories, high-tech military posts, and ocean-borne floating utopias with sprawling pathways, doors, and puzzles. The map doesn't tell the full story!

Features:

High-Speed Combat – Take on entire battalions of enemy soldiers and alien defense mechanica with lightning-fast movement abilities and fluid combat abilities. Frame-perfect controls offer simple-to-learn, difficult-to-master combat that is satisfying to both genre-newcomers and veterans alike. Find your playstyle amongst a variety of weapons and combos!

Hand-Crafted Pixel Art World – From desolated laboratories to alien military space stations, every pixel of the environment is hand-crafted to bring SH1-R0's immersive storyline to life.

Full Orchestral Original Soundtrack – The entirely original soundtrack brings the epic proportions of SH1-R0's story full-circle, bringing a new level of immersion to the environment and action.

Highly-Developed Character Cast – Meet a broad cast of characters both friend and foe, and sometimes in between. Keep your wits about you, not everyone has you in their best interests.

data.detailed_description:
Blackjack Simulator 2026 allows you to experience what it's like to play the world's most popular casino card game.  Build your bankroll and earn Steam achievements while leveling up and reaching milestones as you play.

Blackjack Simulator 2026 represents the next evolution of digital card gaming, blending realism, strategy, and modern technology into a single immersive experience. Designed for both casual players and serious blackjack enthusiasts, the simulator goes far beyond simple point-and-click gameplay. It recreates the atmosphere, decision-making pressure, and mathematical depth of real blackjack

Blackjack Simulator 2026 sets a new standard. The interface is clean and modern, with high-resolution card animations.

This simulator is more than just a game. It’s a comprehensive blackjack training and entertainment platform. Whether someone wants to casually enjoy a few hands, sharpen their skills before a casino trip, or dive deep into the mathematics of the game, the simulator delivers.

data.name: The Keepers of Pages: Chevengur
data.detailed_description:
The game was inspired by the novel of the Russian writer Andrey Platonov. But we don't try to retell the book. Instead, we invite our players to look at the world, that its filled with its mood and atmosphere. The world of future, that turns out to be a reflection of the past. The world, where images and motives of one of the most enigmatic works of Soviet literature are mixed into a post-apocalyptic scenery.

The story begins in the Library, where people store the remnants of ancient knowledge - old self-willed books. The librarians need to be cautious - not because the books can be stolen, but because the books are able to escape! A young Keeper gives in to his curiosity, and the pages of a certain book get loose and escape. Now he has to make a long journey to collect and return all of them, scattered throughout the world. Meanwhile, the contents of the pages start leaking into reality and changing it, turning it into their projections.

Start your journey through the uncanny world on your search for the lost pages:

  • Collect quotes and put them together
  • Read the world around you
  • Overcome your enemies using the power of words
  • Meet other characters and learn from them
  • Find the right way to your goal
  • Visit different locations - from deserted steppe to ancient railroads
  • Solve puzzles to clean the path
  • Watch the changing world, reacting to your words and actions]

On this journey, you should be not just the player, but also the reader. Don't forget it, when you take the road, and luck will follow you.

A young Keeper gives in to his curiosity, and the pages of a certain book get loose and escape. Now he has to make a long journey to collect and return all of them, scattered throughout the world. Meanwhile, the contents of the pages start leaking into reality and changing it, turning it into their projections.

Start your journey through the uncanny world on your search for the lost pages:

  • Collect quotes and put them together
  • Read the world around you
  • Overcome your enemies using the power of words
  • Meet other characters and learn from them
  • Find the right way to your goal
  • Visit different locations - from deserted steppe to ancient railroads
  • Solve puzzles to clean the path
  • Watch the changing world, reacting to your words and actions]

On this journey, you should be not just the player, but also the reader. Don't forget it, when you take the road, and luck will follow you.
data.short_description: "The Keepers of Pages" is a puzzle-platformer, inspired by the novel of Russian writer A. Platonow "Chevengur". Find your way through a post-apocalyptic world and collect the lost pages in the realm where the reality of the future is tightly interlaced with the texts of the past.

data.name: Maker Max
data.detailed_description:
Note: This is still in early access, so the store page and game are still in development.


Maker Max puts the tools in your hands.

Design your perfect level — or your most diabolical trap — using a fast, intuitive editor built for players who want to create, not just play. Paint tiles, place enemies, set properties, and test your level in seconds. When it's ready, upload it and hand it to the world.

BUILD IT YOUR WAY

A drag-and-drop tile editor with multiple layers, a growing library of enemies and objects, and a full undo/redo history.

SHARE IT WITH EVERYONE

Every uploaded level lives in a community pool browsable by anyone. Search by tag, sort by difficulty or popularity, follow your favourite creators, and bookmark levels to revisit. Your levels are yours — see who played them, how many died, and who holds the record.

BEAT IT FIRST

Race the leaderboard on every level. Every run is timed to the millisecond.

EARN YOUR LOOK

Level up by playing, creating, and getting likes. Unlock character skins, death animations, trail effects and profile cosmetics — all earned through play. Nothing in the store affects gameplay. Ever.

FREE TO PLAY

Maker Max is free. No level slot limits, no pay-to-win, no loot boxes.

TO COME

  • The community will be a key part of this game. You as the community will have a say in what will be added in future updates. You will be able to create your own enemies, items or mechanics, put them up for a vote and every month the top voted item will be added to the game!

  • More enemies, modes and mechanics are still being worked on and each will be released a.s.a.p.

  • Level of the week: Race against others in a selected level and see if you can beat everyone else and earn the title for that week!

  • And much more

data.name: Augmented Empire
data.detailed_description:
Augmented Empire combines an engaging dystopian story with turn-based RPG strategy featuring an All-Star Cast – including the voice talents of Kate Mulgrew, Nick Frost and Garrick Hagon. Now arriving on PC, this acclaimed title delivers a refined cyberpunk experience with full controller support and additional accessibility improvements.

From the safety of your secluded hideout, guide a ragtag team of misfits and outlaws through a city torn apart by class divisions and corruption. Overthrow the elite in this turn-based RPG that blends tactical strategy with rich storytelling.

Features:

  • The definitive edition: Based on the highly praised Oculus Quest version, now enhanced for PC.

  • Tactical RPG gameplay: Command six unique characters, each with their own skills, across 26 missions and 60 handcrafted environments.

  • Engaging dystopian story: Unravel a tale of rebellion and survival, featuring voice acting by an All-Star Cast, including Kate Mulgrew, Nick Frost, and Garrick Hagon.

  • Enhanced Accessibility: Enjoy full controller support along with additional accessibility improvements.

  • Customisable progression: Develop your team’s abilities and upgrades to suit your strategy.

  • Hours of immersion: Enjoy up to 10 hours of gameplay packed with turn-based action and cyberpunk intrigue.

Whether you're a long-time fan or a first-time player, experience Augmented Empire like never before. Are you ready to rise against the corrupt elite and reclaim New Savannah?

data.detailed_description:

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY!


About the Game

The Desktop Dungeons: Rewind - Daily Demo delivers a slice of the award-winning Desktop Dungeons puzzle roguelike challenge to everyone, every single day! Dive into the unique class and dungeon stew that’s on today’s menu and whet your appetite for the full game, one daily dungeon bite at a time.


You’ll need to explore, strategize, test your skills, plan your approach to heal your hero, and obliterate bloodthirsty enemies to emerge victorious with a hoard of treasure.

DAILY Challenge - This demo will refresh with a new dungeon and throw a new class at you every day. That’s right! Every single day you’ll get a chance to get rich… or die trying!

DAILY Rewind - Eating dirt already? Lay down your burdens and try again (you only get one shot so do not miss your chance to blow!)


DAILY Demo Leaderboard - Achieve eternal glory and rise to the top of the daily leaderboard, compare your results, and prove to your friends that you are the ultimate dungeon master!

DAILY Healing by Exploring - Reveal hidden terrain to regain health and mana. But plan your route carefully or you’ll have nothing left to face the final enemy!

Don't let your guard down, because one wrong move could be your last. The choice is yours - will you become a legendary dungeon crawler, or fall to the wayside?

data.name: Mothiary
data.detailed_description:
Collect and care for moths in a quiet world of moonlight and growth.

Step into a calm nighttime world where you collect and care for delicate moths. Watch your terrarium come to life as each species rests, flutters, and thrives under the soft glow of night.

Grow your sanctuary.

Start with simple cocoons and nurture them into new species. Expand your terrarium, earn resources over time, and unlock rare moths as your collection grows.

                              

A peaceful rhythm of discovery.

Each moth you find adds a small moment of wonder. Mothiary invites you to slow down, enjoy the process of collecting, and watch your sanctuary fill with life one species at a time.

Features

• Collect and raise real moth species from around the world

• Expand your terrarium and design cozy biomes for every region

• Earn resources while idle for easy, relaxing play sessions

• Unlock new environments and rare species as you progress

• Enjoy a soft ambient soundtrack and peaceful atmosphere

• Play at your own pace and focus on calm, simple goals

Wishlist now.
Whether you play for a few minutes or lose track of time exploring, Mothiary offers a gentle escape into the quiet beauty of the night.

data.name: Diamonds
data.detailed_description:
Diamonds is a free to play 3rd person shooter. Starting with an assault rifle, shotgun and plenty of grenades, you collect diamonds scattered around the map. Taking advantage of the spider diamonds as they replenish your ammo on death and allow you to engage in intriguing battles. When you defeat the enemy, they leave behind their diamond for you to collect. Use the diamonds to access your power ups which include a Bow, Rocket Launcher, Flame Thrower, sword and many more. Customize your character and enjoy the journey of unlocking maps and competing globally or with your friends for high scores.

With 12 maps in arcade mode I believe it is solid representation of my vision and where i want to take the game. The AI provides a realistic and exciting enemy to defeat and the diamonds provides a engaging game play objective. data.name: Career's End
data.detailed_description:
In this immersive physics-based sandbox, you play as a serious CEO man who is about to take the stage to discuss high-tech business in front of an enthusiastic crowd.

  • THE fantasy everyone wants to experience

The game begins normally: as you enter the stage, you can clap, dance, and take a bow. You can cycle through the fake presentation slides behind you and even control the camera angles and zoom - just like a live TV broadcast.

  • UNMATCHED physics interaction

Alternatively, you can jump around and knock over equipment and people - embarrassing yourself in the process, which is by far the more fun option.

A short game with no goals, points, or achievements in the traditional sense - only dumb fun.

*gamepad is required.

data.name: SCHiM
data.detailed_description:
SCHiM is a game about jumping from shadow to shadow, while interacting with a relaxing and lively environment.

What is a schim?

A schim is the soul and spirit of an object, thing, or living being. Everything in the world has one. A schim should never be separated from their thing! This does happen to your schim, this schim who is attached to a human being is separated from them early on in the game.

Can you get back to them before it's too late?

Features

  • Unique 3D platforming through shadows.
  • Animated shadow platforms and environments.
  • Each level has its own scenery with small stories.
  • A story of a person losing their shadow.
  • A beautiful abstract world.

data.name: Chiggas - Survival of the Mitiest
data.detailed_description:
Survival of the Mitiest Begins


Chiggas: Survival of the Mitiest is a fast, chaotic arcade survival game where one Chigga Player stands against waves of hungry enemies, dangerous bosses, and escalating stage threats. Run, munch, shoot, recruit, boost, and survive as long as you can while building your army of Chigga Soldiers and proving who is truly the mitiest.

Fight, Munch, Recruit, Survive


Every run starts simple, but survival does not stay easy for long. Enemies swarm from every direction, stages become more dangerous, and the pressure keeps rising. Pick up weapons, grab speed boosts, munch when you need to recover, and recruit Chigga Soldiers to help turn the fight in your favor.

  • Survive escalating stages filled with enemies, hazards, and boss encounters.
  • Recruit Chigga Soldiers to grow your squad and fight back against the swarm.
  • Pick up weapons like pistols and rifles to blast through enemies.
  • Use powerups including speed boosts that help you escape, chase, and survive.
  • Munch to stay alive when the pressure gets intense.
  • Unlock Chigga Wear and customize your look with Legendary cosmetic items.

Build Your Mity Run


Each run challenges you to react fast and make the most of what you find. A weapon pickup can turn a desperate escape into a comeback. A speed boost can save you from being surrounded. A recruited Chigga Soldier can help you push deeper into the chaos.

Legendary Chigga Wear


Survival is important, but looking legendary matters too. Unlock and equip Chigga Wear to give your Chigga Player a unique style. Legendary Chigga Wear adds premium cosmetic flair without changing the core survival challenge.

Key Features


  • Fast arcade survival gameplay
  • Stage-based progression
  • Recruitable Chigga Soldiers
  • Weapon pickups and ammo-based shooting
  • Speed boosts with high-impact movement
  • Munch-based survival moments
  • Boss fights and escalating enemy pressure
  • Unlockable Chigga Wear and Legendary cosmetics
  • Steam achievements for major milestones

Prove You Are the Mitiest


Whether you are chasing a longer survival time, unlocking new achievements, recruiting your first Chigga Soldier, or building the perfect Legendary fit, every run gives you another chance to push farther.

How long can you survive?

data.name: Cat God Ranch
data.detailed_description:
Follow Us


Update RoadMap


About the Game


Take on the role of ranch manager and grow your fledgling herd of animals into one worthy of pleasing the Cat God! There are many different paths to choose, but only one hurdle to overcome at the end of each week. Pay tribute to the Cat God or face his wrath and have your ranch be shut down.

Over 100 types of animals, all with their own unique abilities


Whether it's alpacas, crocodiles, hyenas, larks, or a combination of all, you choose the kind of ranch you want to build.

Take advantage of 7 different animal families in the game


Feed your barnyard buddies to the carnivores, or watch an army of penguins and pandas propagate across your ranch. Either way you want to build, the tribute must be paid!

Develop your ranch with different terrain and watch your animals thrive


Combine grasslands, caves, puddles, and other tile cards to create endless possibilities and combos.

Tango with 100+ prop cards to make tribute in time!


As you improve on your ranch, the Cat God will bestow you with prop cards. Add these modifiers to your daily earnings and watch them grow!

With 10+ cat gods, 100+ animals, 100+ props, 20+ toys, 10+ tiles, it's time to build your own unique deck and appease the Cat God!
More gameplay is currently in development, so join our Discord & QQ to provide suggestions to make the game better!

data.name: Formula 2.5
data.detailed_description:
Step into the golden age of Formula racing through a modern 2.5D arcade experience.
Feel the thrill of cockpit-view driving, high-speed overtakes, and weather-changing drama — all inspired by classic arcade racers of the 80s and 90s.

Designed for speed, nostalgia, and pure racing joy, this game combines pixel-shaded visuals with authentic racing tension — where every corner can define your legacy.

City track VS Circuit track

From tight city corners to full-speed circuits, Formula 2.5 delivers a classic arcade racing experience across diverse track styles.

Experience all weather 

From sun-lit streets to midnight storms, the game’s weather dynamically changes the racing mood and driving experience.

Clear-Day

Clear-Night

Wet-Night

Witness the evolution of Formula racing through four decades of speed

The game features four eras of iconic Formula racing machines — from the fearless 1960s pioneers to the refined aero cars of the 2000s.

  • 4 generations of formula racing: the 1960s, 1970s, 1980s and 2000s;

  • 40 distinctive formula cars;

  • 10 international racing locations;

  • 4 race environments: Clear Day, Clear Night, Rainy Day and Rainy Night;

※ This is a short adult-oriented game featuring mild horror elements, including jump scares and loud sound effects. Please take these elements into consideration before purchasing or playing.

◆Story

After returning home from work, you find your room has become completely unfamiliar...

This is an adult-oriented game inspired by the style of the “Find the Difference: Episode 8” series, where your goal is to identify anomalies and escape from a mysterious space.

Objects disappear, colors change, positions shift...

From subtle abnormalities to major changes — don’t miss a single one as you carefully investigate and move forward.

Sometimes, truly frightening things may happen... but gather your courage and push on.

When you're tired, let the mysterious woman "Maria," who sits on the sofa, comfort you.

As you progress through the game, she’ll begin to do more and more erotic things with you...

After coming home from work, your room looks completely unfamiliar...

Find 8 anomalies in this mysterious game to return to your original world.

A mysterious beauty named "Maria" appears in your room.

When you're feeling tired, try talking to her.

She’ll probably do some erotic things to help you relax.

As you progress through the game, more interactions and features become available.

Enjoy spending time with Maria while taking on the eerie challenge of spotting strange anomalies.

data.name: The Stars Are Not Ready
data.detailed_description:
Surf the dark. Smash the stars.

You are loose in a vast neon void, and the only way through it is speed. Build momentum, ram everything to dust, charge your core to OVERLOAD, and tear a path toward the guardians waiting at the edge of the dark.

Momentum is the weapon

There is no trigger to hold. You surf. You dash. You smash asteroids, towers, and hunters apart by hitting them hard enough, then ride the wreckage straight into the next kill. Chain a dash-nova through a crowd and watch it come apart.

Every run is a different void

Each zone reshuffles into a new shape: open void, asteroid belts, pylon corridors, fence mazes, dense cluster fields. Then the anomalies bend the rules.

  • SWARM - the void teems with far more hunters.

  • GOLD RUSH - salvage doubled, and well defended.

  • VOLATILE GEOMETRY - the debris detonates, so smash at speed or bleed.

  • MAGNETIC STORM - rogue currents drag your ship off course.

  • OVERCHARGE - your energy charges faster, and so do your enemies.

  • HUNTED - apex predators stalk you from the first second.

[/list]Every anomaly radiates from a rift somewhere out in the dark. Seal it to end the effect, or leave it humming and take the risk.

Mutate your run

Trade hull at the void shrines for mutations that bend your ship's rules, and bank permanent perks and cores. Every run goes a little further.

Break the guardians

Something waits at the end of every zone, and a guardian falls to the same rule as everything else: hit its corners, at speed, until it shatters.

Built to be felt

A neon look drawn in pure light, an adaptive score that mixes to the fight, hit slow-mo, screen shake you can dial to taste, and full controller support.

The stars are not ready. Go anyway.

data.name: Playing Prague
data.detailed_description:
Playing Prague is a relaxing puzzle game in which Prague comes to life at your fingertips.

Discover this bohemian city with playing cards featuring the ancient symbols of Prague houses. Match the right cards and each level will reveal new iconic landmarks such as the Charles Bridge, the Prague Astronomical Clock, Prague Castle or the Petřín Tower. Along the way, you will meet Kafka, Einstein, Mozart and other personalities whose fate is linked to Prague.

Every detail of the game is a tribute to the 1000-year cultural heritage of a city that was once the seat of the Holy Roman Emperors and the capital of the Bohemian Kingdom. It is also the origin of the designation of bohemians as people with a creative and unconventional way of life.

Playing Prague offers:

  • A combination of city building and logical pattern composition

  • Six hand-crafted levels with iconic Prague landmarks and ten more available to purchase

  • Collector’s set of monuments and historical personalities

  • A challenge for experienced puzzle fans and casual players alike

The free base game contains one level pack including 6 levels. Two additional packs (5+5 levels) are available to purchase. Support the development of the game and get new puzzles and additional historical content! 

This game is a celebration of Prague and all those who have shaped and continue to shape this beautiful city.

data.name: TAPE GLITCH
data.detailed_description:
TAPE GLITCH is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore flooded liminal spaces, uncover corrupted VHS memories, and survive what hides inside them.

Play a Tape. Enter the Memory.

Scattered throughout the flooded halls are VHS tapes. Find one, and you'll be pulled inside a recording of a place that once was. Each one gives you only a short time to find what was left behind before something inside finds you first. Find the code, escape the tape, and return to the real world — if it can still be called that.

You're Not Alone

The threats inside each tape follow their own logic. Some chase. Some wait. Some you'll never see coming. Figuring out how to survive each one is part of the game ...and part of the horror. Your flashlight can help you find your way, but not everything in the dark wants to be seen.

Pools

The water is fully physically simulated, flowing around your body and reacting naturally to every movement you make. It feels like a natural part of the world, giving every flooded space a more believable presence.

Rewind

Each tape lets you rewind time, taking you back a few seconds along with your position and everything around you. It will not save you, but it might give you another chance.

Features

  • First person psychological horror

  • Fully simulated water physics

  • Time rewind mechanic with limited charges

  • Multiple entities with distinct behaviours

  • Spatial 3D audio with environmental occlusion

  • Full controller support

About the Developer

TAPE GLITCH is an independent horror project created primarily by a single developer.

It started as a late-night idea — flooded spaces, VHS static, and the kind of dread that comes from places that feel too still to be real. Inspired by liminal spaces such as the Backrooms and Poolrooms, the goal was to build something that feels like stepping into a memory that was never meant to be found.

A section of the first level was created in collaboration with Vaporama, a visual artist known for liminal space work.

Development has taken place over evenings after work and school, weekends when possible, and long stretches in between. No studio, no large team — just a project that kept pulling me back until it became something worth sharing.

Thank you for taking a look.

data.name: The Ransom of Atawallpa
data.detailed_description:
The finest in Edutainment for all ages. Pay once, play forever. No ads.

  • Follow the trails, hunt through abandoned ruins, and caves as you solve puzzles and try to avoid traps laid by a bandit. Travel through breathtaking scenes that showcase clay sculpted characters. This is not a game of action and shooting, but is peppered with fun surprises.

  • If you like to wander and figure things out while you hunt for treasures of gold in more than 15 fascinating Inca sites, this game is for you whether you are a seasoned adventure gamer or are new to the genre. There are 3 levels of difficulty which can be switched during play and your earned awards will be on display in your game.

  • We hope that beyond the fun, The Ransom of Atawallpa (*Quechua for Atahualpa) will inspire you to dig deeper into the many mysteries of the Incas still hidden in Perú.

  • Playable with Mouse and Touchscreen

Wishlist now to get notified when it is released!

data.name: BitVoid
data.detailed_description:
In a future devoured by overexploitation and digital wars, the megacorporation CURE created intelligent cores to manage the few resources left on planet Earth. Years later, humanity abandoned its homes after the project failed and settled in bases on Mars.

You are SPARK III, an incomplete core prototype discarded by CURE due to an unstable anomaly: your unpredictable ability to absorb and evolve. You have spent decades wandering the digital shadows, but the time has come to awaken.

Survival and Evolution Through Bits

Absorb information bits to rebuild your code, gain new powers and reach new stages of evolution. But be careful: along the way, you may encounter malware or even other powerful CURE cores.

Skill Tree

Invest your bits in new projectiles and passive abilities. Every run is different depending on how you build SPARK III.

Enemies and Bosses (Other Cores)

CURE is infested with digital weapons abandoned on its servers after the war: worms, trojans, keyloggers, zombiebots, lockers, adware, phishing, rootkits… You'll also have to face seemingly abandoned intelligent CURE cores like yourself to discover what happened to humanity.

2–4 Player Co-op

Play the campaign with up to 3 friends or with other people currently playing. Defeat enemies together, evolve together and uncover the truth together. If a teammate falls, you can always revive them. The journey is always better together.

Competitive Multiplayer

Fight other forgotten cores in online matches featuring 5 classes and 8 different game modes, including Deathvolution, Node Control, Free-for-All, Infected... Level up with every match to earn XP and reach Prestige.

Endless Mode

After the campaign, an endless challenge awaits: increasingly difficult waves and wild cores. How long can you survive?

Complete the ECHOS and the Codex

Find the ECHOS, lost files containing technical data and relics of human technology from before the planet was abandoned. Record every enemy and everything that happens in the Codex.

The Scrap Yard

data.name: Kitch Witch
data.detailed_description:
When your grandmother passes into the Great Beyond, she leaves you a woodland clinic with an unusual calling: healing through magical cooking.

The prestigious L'kwal Magic Academy never believed in your methods. Now, with patients depending on you, you'll diagnose their ailments, gather ingredients, and cook magical remedies that can change their futures.

Keep the clinic running, earn the trust of your community, and discover whether a different kind of magic can save the people who need you most.

Diagnose Patients, Choose Their Treatments

Examine patients, identify their symptoms, and decide which recipes might give them the best chance of recovery. Your decisions shape their outcomes, and the people you help (or turn away) may remember what you did. This can manifest through rewards if you succeed, or you may find a new monster in the woods next time you're out foraging if you fail...

Cook Up Some Magic Through Hands-On Gameplay

Chop, mix, stir, and prepare enchanted recipes through physics-based cooking mini-games. Turn ingredients into meals, drinks, desserts, and remedies that can help heal your patients. Food is a powerful tool!

Explore, Forage, and Grow

Gather medicinal ingredients across five distinct biomes, grow crops, and discover the flora, creatures, and secrets of a magical world. Discover new recipes and hone your skills.

Restore Your Clinic and Rebuild Your Community

Repair and decorate your inherited home, improve your clinic, and help the surrounding community flourish.

A Cozy Story Where Your Choices Matter

Experience a narrative RPG about grief, belonging, responsibility, and finding your own path as a healer. Your patients' outcomes depend on your decisions, and your relationships with the community develop through the care you provide.

data.name: Journey Through Memories
data.detailed_description:
Using just the limitless power of your voice, guide a young witch named Vivi as she travels through a magical realm of lingering spirits and a buried past. As the ancient aftermath of a devastating war continues to take its toll, use Vivi’s magical abilities to aid these fallen victims in an effort to finally restore peace.

​Set in a hand-painted storybook world, discover and cast various spells to overcome obstacles. Encounter the forgotten spirits and fulfill their last requests before guiding them into the afterlife. Find the untold stories and journey through the memories of the inhabitants to piece together the hidden truth behind history’s darkest days. In a game where discovery is just as important as puzzle solving, can you help Vivi in her quest to right an ancient wrong?

Features:

  • Speech Recognition: Use your voice to control Vivi. Cast spells and move her towards her goals. There's no need for a controller or a keyboard...just use your voice!
  • Spells: Discover 120+ spells each with their own abilities and visuals.
  • Puzzles: Solve various obstacles, complete spirit challenges, and collect hidden items with the spells you’ve discovered.
  • Hand-painted artwork: Water colored environments and characters set in a hauntingly beautiful world.
  • Visually stunning effects: Sparkles and shine, and everything nice.
  • Music: Soothing and original soundtrack
  • Narrative-Driven: Sit back and relax as the story unfolds.

Notes:

  • For the best experience, please use a microphone so that the game can pick up your voice more easily!
  • The entire game is played with your voice! So for example, in the main menu, say "New Game" into the microphone to start the game.

data.name: Aleator
data.detailed_description:
After accumulating an insurmountable amount of debt, you are compelled to accept a cryptic invitation to partake in a high-stakes gambling endeavor. You have the option to ascend the ranks of the poker table or employ alternative methods to settle your financial obligations while gradually unraveling the enigmatic secrets surrounding this game. It is imperative that you proceed with utmost caution as not everyone can endure the consequences of failure.

Simple but not Simplistic

Experience a series of elaborate games, win chips to offset your debts, and leave your cage to regain your freedom.

  • Several new sets of rules for card games

  • Enhanced psychological gaming

  • Immersive experience

Microeconomic Systems

Manage your assets, buy props to give you an edge at the tables, or take the plunge into bigger bets - stocks and horse betting.

  • Markets with dynamic changes in commodity prices

  • Stocks associated with market volatility

  • Tigger machine and racecourses

Discovering the Truth of the Story

Empty your debt and get out, or explore the cage and learn the dark secrets behind the game.

Play with Your Friends

Create online poker games, choose your style of play, and have fun with your friends.
