data.name: Football Mogul 2014
data.detailed_description:
Want to Review Football Mogul 2014?

Would you like to review this game for free?


Are you a video game reviewer? Do you have your own video game channel/website/blog/etc.?

If you're interested in reviewing Football Mogul 2014, just contact us via support@sportsmogul.com or e-mail connor@sportsmogul.com! We're happy to give reviewers a key(s) when requested. All you need to show us, is that you have a following or a working website/blog that you have previously reviewed games on.

If you'd also like to become a curator for this game, please be sure to let us know after your review and we'd be happy to accommodate.

Additionally; we have 3 other games coming to Steam as well, including our Baseball series (Baseball Mogul), so be sure to ask about those as well when they become available on the Steam store!


About the Game

Football Mogul lets you begin in any year you choose, from 1970 to 2013 with the full roster of your favorite team -- or an entirely fictional team of your own creation. Your involvement as GM does not stop in the team's front office. Football Mogul gives you complete control over your team on the field. You start by setting the starting lineups for your team. On game day, you choose your level of involvement. You can retire to the luxury box and make calls to the field as needed or you can take control of each player, choosing what plays to run in each situation.

A powerful game engine simulates each play of the game based on customized player ratings and over 40 years of historical data, assuring you the maximum realism possible! Football Mogul is designed to help you manage your team over many simulated years. Manage your team one day at a time, or let the computer simulate weeks or months at a stretch so you can play for virtual years or decades. As your players age, their abilities mature and decline realistically. Don't forget to build your team for the long term, rather than spending all your money on free agents this season. Watch your team rise and fall in the standings, watch your bank statement, and read the news stories to stay on top of what's happening with all the teams in both leagues. If you pick the right players, manage your finances well, and stick to a winning strategy, your team may win the Super Bowl, and you too may become a Football Mogul!

Features

  • Start in any season from 1970 to 2013
  • Rosters for every year since the AFL-NFL merger
  • Play-by-play describes each play as it happens
  • Box scores and play-by-play files created for each game
  • Detailed play designer
  • 22 offensive formations: 3rd down packages, wildcat, etc.
  • 17 defensive formations: nickel, dime, prevent, 33 stack, 52, etc.
  • View detailed results for each play in your playbook: Versus each type of defense, In each down-and-distance situation
  • Realistic player development and aging
  • Play up to 100 seasons into the future
  • Automatically loads files from previous versions

New Features

  • Updated team rosters for 2013-2014 season
  • Accurate 65-man rosters, updated for week 4 of the pre-season
  • More realistic simulation
  • "Targets" and "Yards After Catch" incorporated into ratings (and recorded during simulation)
  • "Hands", "Power", "Quickness" and "Visions" updated and calibrated for every player
  • More accurate tackling, according to player skill and defensive play-calling
  • New stats and ratings for over 2,800 active players
  • Updated year-by-year stats for every player
  • Hand-edited ratings for over 340 offensive linemen and 500 skill positions (including 80 QBs)
  • Updated ratings for over 900 defensive players and 170+ special teams specialists
  • More than 400 new players
  • Includes all 2013 draftees, plus undrafted free agents
  • More than 800 new player photos
  • Exact season schedule for every season from 2001 through 2013
  • Accurate scheduling algorithm for all future seasons (2014 and beyond):
  • Includes correct interdivision and interleague matchups according to NFL rules
  • Plus realistic schedule options going back to 1972
  • Improved play designer and playbook editor
  • More control over play action and option plays
  • Improved Play-By-Play interface
  • Let the computer choose your defensive plays while your control your offense (or vice versa)
  • At any time, click "Playbook" to have the computer pick a play for you

Additional Features

Forty years of historical accuracy
  • Historical rookies loaded for each college draft class
  • Correct schedule and playoff format for each season
  • Enable or disable overtime (which was added in 1974)
  • Additional league editing options, like the number of wild card teams

Hotseat play
  • Two players can compete head-to-head using the same computer
  • Keyboard shortcuts for in-game playcalling (so you don't have to fight over the mouse)

Support for online play
  • Schedule generation for shorter seasons (as few as 4 games)
  • Schedule generation for custom league configuration -- even for an odd number of teams
  • Fantasy drafts with more than one human-controlled team
  • "Import Playbooks" feature lets you quickly load playbooks designed by each team's owner

Strategic options
  • Set your team to run a '3-4' or '4-3' defense
  • Build your offense with or without a fullback
  • Adjust the run/pass balance of your offense
  • Fine tune your game plan by customing your playbook
  • Advanced playbook editor
  • Easy interface lets you quickly edit existing plays or build a playbook from scratch
  • Editable folder names and play names
  • Load and save playbooks for use against different opponents, or to share online
  • Playbook tracks the success of each play in a variety of offensive and defensive situations
  • Supports custom offensive and defensive playbooks for every single historical team
  • You can even redesign plays in the middle of a game

data.name: Another Head
data.detailed_description:
It is with great pleasure that I present to you Another Head! The first game by Looting Dreams, created by Eric Sorrentino (yours truly). You’ll be transported to a small town in Colorado, Havenbrook, where you’ll control Tom as he faces one of the most intriguing events of late: there’s a new neighbor in town.

It’s hard to pin Another Head to a single genre. The story can take wildly different directions and tones depending on your choices.

No missions, live the story as the protagonist

Don’t expect senseless quests or triggers! The story progresses according to your decisions, whether you like it or not.

Feeling lost? Don’t worry—you can always consult the thoughts swirling around in Tom’s mind. Draw inspiration from his needs and ideas to navigate the game and make important decisions.

Meaningful dialogues

Interactions with people are key, so never miss a chance to chat with your neighbors. The choices you make during dialogues will always have weight. Think carefully about what to say, or you might regret it.

Multiple endings

Through different choices and actions, you can unlock up to 10 unique endings. If you manage to find them all, you can participate in the ultimate poll to decide which ending becomes the definitive one—good or bad!

A race against time

Another Head spans one full week in Tom’s life. Each day, you’ll have specific time windows to act freely. Don’t rush—savor the adventure—but remember, time is precious!

A mortgage to be paid by flipping burgers

What indie game would be complete without a burger joint? You might feel a sense of déjà vu as you assemble sandwiches and watch your bank account grow, but I promise it will be a fresh experience in its own way.

Developed in Italy, with love

I’ve always wanted to bring my ideas to life—since I was a kid, playing in the backyard with friends, crafting role-playing games, or sketching countless concepts that never saw the light of day. But here we are! I hope you enjoy this small game born from a part of my mind. I hope you’ll appreciate the care and love I poured into it and remember it fondly in the future. If not, let me know—I still have so much to learn, and I’m sure each of you has something to teach me.

Mysteries to uncover

What are you waiting for? There’s more happening in Havenbrook than meets the eye. It’s up to you to find out what.

Another Head spans one full week in Tom’s life. Each day, you’ll have specific time windows to act freely. Don’t rush—savor the adventure—but remember, time is precious!

A mortgage to be paid by flipping burgers

What indie game would be complete without a burger joint? You might feel a sense of déjà vu as you assemble sandwiches and watch your bank account grow, but I promise it will be a fresh experience in its own way.

Developed in Italy, with love

I’ve always wanted to bring my ideas to life—since I was a kid, playing in the backyard with friends, crafting role-playing games, or sketching countless concepts that never saw the light of day. But here we are! I hope you enjoy this small game born from a part of my mind. I hope you’ll appreciate the care and love I poured into it and remember it fondly in the future. If not, let me know—I still have so much to learn, and I’m sure each of you has something to teach me.

Mysteries to uncover

What are you waiting for? There’s more happening in Havenbrook than meets the eye. It’s up to you to find out what.
data.short_description: Hey, someone's at the door! There's a new neighbor in town! Live a week in Havenbrook as Tom, surrounded by mysteries, meaningful choices, and multiple endings. Forge your own path and shape your story with no predefined quests. Will you uncover the truth?

data.name: DungeonBox
data.detailed_description:
DungeonBox is a party RPG for up to 8 players. Everyone plays from their own phone: submit your funniest ideas, vote for the best one, and watch the story bend around whatever your party decides.

Your Dungeon Master (run by your choice of a player or computer DM) sets the scene and everyone answers at once: heroic, clever or completely unhinged. Players join from their phone's browser with a room code. No app, no account, no extra controllers.

Every answer lands on the big screen. The party votes, the best idea scores, and the winning move becomes the story, consequences and all.

Pick a lock, spot a trap, slap a gnome. Risky moves call for a skill check rolled right from your phone, and your class, stats and items tip the odds. A natural 20 is legendary. So is a natural 1.

Descend into the Lion's Labyrinth, a papercraft dungeon crawl where every player steers their own hero. Search chests, sniff out hidden keys, outwit trolls and mimics, and fight turn-based battles on the way to the Gilded Serpent's hoard.

When a quest turns violent, the whole party votes on cards: back your heroes' attacks and block the enemy's nastiest moves. Loot a million gold, survive a Super Blast, or simply stand there looking cool.

  • Up to 8 players, one phone each – join with a room code, or fill empty seats with CPU players.

  • A Dungeon Master who never runs out of ideas – every answer changes the story, narrated aloud.

  • Draw it into existence – sketch magic items and monsters on your phone and watch them come to life in the dungeon.

  • Build your character – choose from 12 heroes, earn XP, raise your stats and unlock abilities like Fireball, Pickpocket and Diss Track.

  • Hand-written quests, endless outcomes – from tavern brawls to pirate-ship escapes, with 100 random events waiting to shake things up.

  • Your table, your rules – set the Content Rating anywhere from “Family Friendly” to “Anything Goes”.

  • Made for streaming – extra viewers join as the audience and vote, and the room code can be hidden on stream. Remote Play Together supported.

  • 12 languages – menus, quests and narration fully localized.

data.name: Cursed
data.detailed_description:
Our latest games!

Join our Steam group to learn more about our games, events and giveaways


About the Game


“Cursed” is a new mystic, intriguing and fascinating classic horror adventure game developed by JetDogs Studios that is familiar to many gamers. The game has a number of specific advantages as an intriguing plot full of enigmas, mysticism and great twists, luxurious graphics, innovative puzzles etc. If you are not afraid of going deep down into the world of the cursed realty and if you are ready to save the world from the evil or just want to pass a pleasant evening, then “Cursed” is the best choice.


The life of the main female character and her fiancé Albert was wonderful and full of happiness. Indeed, it was… Until Albert received a strange letter with a proposal of a profitable job far away from his home. Albert went away to work and there was no news for a long time. So the main female character (i.e. you, the player) put off on a long journey to look for her love-mate without knowing what had happened to him and what kind of peril and danger waited for her. Dragons, phantoms, demons and other creatures of beyond will be on your way. Will the true love overcome different difficulties and obstacles during the journey?



The plot of the game “Cursed” is full of unexpected turns and surprises. You will learn an ancient wizard secret, contact different creatures of beyond, learn your real name and meet people from your past which is so far away that it is impossible to call it to memory. And the most important thing is that it’s only you who can set free your love-mate and not let the evil to capture the whole world. Will you dare to undertake the responsibility for the entire mankind?


In “Cursed” you will need to realize all your true potential to find and use correctly ambient objects, open all the masked locks and doors, go round obstacles escaping from danger and to glean the necessary information about the fiancé of the main female character as well as about the history of this cursed place.


The stunning graphics and transcendental music of the game “Cursed” are worthy of special mention. The vividness of monsters, ambient objects and the environment as a whole provoke ineffable feelings during playing the game. All this will make the hair stand up on the back of the neck of any fearless and cool-headed gamers. Do you want to feel the thrill? Then start playing “Cursed” in the dead on night.


Thus, “Cursed” is an outstanding game for all sorts of gamers which has all the makings to become a real hit.

P.S.
For all game players we'll offer a bunch of adorable collection of collectible items - 15 trading cards, 10 backgrounds and 10 amazing emoticons!

data.name: Shapeshooter
data.detailed_description:
WISHLIST BURNING SKIES


About the Game

GAMEPLAY
SHAPESHOOTER is literally an on-rail shooter, you'll have to clear colonies across 4 planets from a little creatures infestation called polygoneers. But that's not important, you'll not get a story here. You'll get frenetic action, insane music and a super hard challenge!



WEAPONS
In SHAPESHOOTER you'll have 5 different weapons, all of them have 3 levels. Gatter OCTARINGS to upgrade them, and trust me, you'll need it.



TRAPS
Besides a the polygoneers, you must watch out for traps, A LOT OF THEM. Look at the size of this saw, I bet it has at least 200px wide.



UPGRADES
Improve your tank to survive, there are weapons, shield, magnet, wheels and of course skins, because you need to be shining while destroying everything in front of you.

data.name: Monster Trampoline
data.detailed_description:
The monsters are having a party, and they love playing on the trampoline!

Monster Trampoline is a local multiplayer game for 1-4 players. It's suitable for all ages, but is best suited for younger children.

Drop monsters onto other monsters to try and knock them out of the ring without having your monster fall off. Transform your monsters into stronger monsters using Star Points and use their special powers to dominate the arena. Target the explosive barrels to really send the other monsters flying! Time the power bar to adjust the force with which you hit the other monsters.

Choose from 3 different levels: high above the revolving Earth in space, down on a tropical island with sparkling blue water, or on a pirate ship surrounded by sharks.

Battle it out with up to 4 human players, or against up to 3 computer players. Choose between 2 game modes: Turn-based (normal mode) or simultaneous action (Oni mode). Choose between 2 game difficulties: easy or normal.

XBox controllers are fully supported. The game can be played with the keyboard, but a controller is highly recommended.

Game play is fully customizable. Adjust the arena bounciness, number of rounds, or explosive spawn rate.

data.name: Mage of the Olekta Desert
data.detailed_description:
Aisha, a crafty, quick-witted thief in the Adventurer's Guild, takes on a mission to deliver a letter to a mage who lives in the infamous Olekta Desert. To reach him, she must get through a heavily guarded cavern, traverse perilous, trap-filled ruins, and defeat unhinged bandits and cultists. Along the way, there will be many dangers... perhaps even a dreadful dragon. Will Aisha be able to survive and find her way to the mage safely?

In this turn-based puzzle RPG, you control Aisha and try to solve the mysteries of the Olekta Ruins. Don't forget that you'll have limited equipment and gear! Also, fighting head-on isn't exactly Aisha's forte, so you'll have to be creative in finding your way through the safeguarded caverns, ruins, and traps within.

Invest points into Aisha's assassination skills to deal with enemies directly, or simply get around by sneaking past any possible threat! She can also learn other skills that help her avoid fights! There are many paths you can take to complete her mission.

How you enjoy Mage of the Olekta Desert is entirely up to you. You can stealth your way through the entire game, or fight everything in sight! Each playthrough is a new, exciting adventure. If you lose and Aisha is captured, you can even get a glimpse into her life as a slave.

Multiple Ways to Clear the Game

Aisha can complete her mission in a multitude of ways. Will she take a dangerous approach or play it safe? Who will she side with? Who will she help? Will she unravel the mysteries of the ruins or avoid them entirely? The choice is yours! Take advantage of Aisha's training as a thief to reach your goals!

data.name: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!
data.detailed_description:
Every die has its place.

A spell from a tabletop game has escaped into the real world, multiplying thousands of dice and scattering them across a basement straight out of the 1980s.

Roll for Order is a cozy first-person sorting game that can be played alone or in co-op. Search through the mess, identify every die and return it to the correct display until the entire collection is perfectly organized once again.

Search, sort and complete every set

The basement is filled with themed dice collections, each divided into matching sets and arranged inside labelled display cases.

Search for every missing D2, D4, D6, D8, D10, D12 and D20. Pay attention to their colors, patterns and designs, then work out exactly where each one belongs.

Dice can be hiding anywhere: beneath furniture, behind boxes or mixed together in enormous colorful piles. Pick them up, inspect them and carry them back to their proper display.

Complete full rows, finish entire sets and gradually transform a chaotic mountain of dice into a perfectly catalogued collection.

Choose your class

Play as the Warrior, Barbarian, Mage or Rogue. Each class has its own magical abilities designed to make finding, collecting and sorting dice easier.

Use brute force, arcane magic or clever tricks to manipulate dice, move them across the basement and deliver them to their displays in different ways. Every class offers its own approach to bringing order to the chaos.

Sort dice and grow stronger

Every die you place in its correct slot brings you closer to earning a new Ability Point for your chosen class.

Use those points to unlock new abilities or upgrade the powers you already have, making it faster and easier to recover the thousands of dice still scattered throughout the basement.

The more dice you correctly sort, the more powerful and efficient your class becomes.

Tidy up together

Sort the entire collection by yourself or invite your friends to help.

Split up the basement, search different areas and combine the abilities of your classes. Work together to track down missing dice, return them to the correct displays and complete every set.

A well-balanced party can turn even the biggest mess into a perfectly organized collection.

Welcome back to the 1980s

Step into a basement lit by the glow of CRT screens and colorful string lights, filled with retro consoles, fantasy posters and the remnants of countless tabletop game nights.

Surrounded by old electronics, board games and cozy clutter, you can take the job at your own pace, enjoy the satisfaction of completing every display and restore the basement in time for the next adventure.

Thousands of dice. Countless sets. Four classes. One very messy basement.

Can you sort them all?

Sort the entire collection by yourself or invite your friends to help.

Split up the basement, search different areas and combine the abilities of your classes. Work together to track down missing dice, return them to the correct displays and complete every set.

A well-balanced party can turn even the biggest mess into a perfectly organized collection.

Welcome back to the 1980s

Step into a basement lit by the glow of CRT screens and colorful string lights, filled with retro consoles, fantasy posters and the remnants of countless tabletop game nights.

Surrounded by old electronics, board games and cozy clutter, you can take the job at your own pace, enjoy the satisfaction of completing every display and restore the basement in time for the next adventure.

Thousands of dice. Countless sets. Four classes. One very messy basement.

Can you sort them all?

data.name: Along the River During the Qingming Festival
data.detailed_description:
This is a hidden object game with historical and cultural interpretations, attempting to carefully and seriously investigate and verify the intriguing stories expressed in "Along the River During the Qingming Festival".

The main gameplay currently involves finding 352 objects or characters in the painting. Each item comes with annotations explaining its function and situation in the painting.

Many objects and customs shown in the ancient painting no longer exist today and can only be guessed and inferred from existing books and experience. Naturally, there are some unsolved mysteries worth discussing and debating. Therefore, the game includes some unverified conjectures that may not align with mainstream views and are the author's personal interpretations, provided for reference only.

"Along the River During the Qingming Festival" mainly showcases the ships, bridges, houses, marketplaces, festive activities, and cultural customs of the Northern Song Dynasty. The details are so vivid it's as if the social landscape of that time was captured by a camera.

On that wooden bridge with no pillars, whose manufacturing technique has long been lost, a crowd surges, with nearly a hundred merchants, officials, sailors, fishermen, and passersby filling the space.

The streets are full of shops, signboards, and vendors, including fortune tellers, storytellers, bicycle repairmen, medicine sellers, doctors, barbers, touts, porters, sedan chair bearers, and gamblers - people from all walks of life.

In terms of ships, it meticulously depicts the ship structure, detachable raise-and-lower stern rudder technology, anchor chain assembly, decoration styles of passenger and cargo ships, types of goods transported, and details of people's lives on boats such as cooking, worshiping, doing laundry, rowing, punting, sightseeing, and resting.

Let's journey with Mr. Zhang Zeduan through the urban life of the Northern Song Dynasty 1100 years ago.

data.name: Killer Dolls Dark Abyss
data.detailed_description:
Killer Dolls Dark Abyss tells the story of The Dolls, a group of female warriors in a quest to free their land from The Dark Queen Ixquel. Grab your weapon and crush your enemies in this challenging hack 'n' slash - bullet hell game.

Features:
  • Quick-paced combat: Combat in KDDA is fast and frenetic, as you face numerous enemies and fierce bosses. Additionally, you need to watch out for environmental traps that will make combat even more difficult.
  • Play as different Dolls: Unlock different girls in the game, each with a different weapon that grants her a unique combat style, adding variety to the gameplay experience.
  • Level-up your skills: Find health and magic upgrades to level up your Doll, and collect special gems to unlock stylish attacks to crush your adversaries.
  • Unlock additional outfits: Explore the world to find various stylish outfits for your Dolls, that you can either wear in game and the model’s gallery.
  • Uncover an engaging story: As you play, you will find out more about the world and The Dark Queen Ixquel's sinister plan.

data.name: SIMULACRA 3
data.detailed_description:
Evil welcomes you back in the third chapter of the critically acclaimed horror series, Simulacra.

The once charming town of Stonecreek has seen better days. People are vanishing into thin air, leaving nothing behind but strange symbols where they were last seen. With the police baffled and the populace terrified, rumors swirl that it is the doing of the Beldam, the ghost of a witch that once haunted the streets of Stonecreek.

You are the intern at the local paper, tasked with assisting the town’s star journalist, Ruby Myers, on her investigation into the disappearances. Your only lead is the phone of the missing Paul Castillo, a software developer, an amateur historian of the town, and one of Ruby’s sources. While Ruby does the legwork, your job is to hack into Paul’s phone for any clues left behind. New apps, exciting features, and fresh terror await those who delve into the darkest corners of the digital realms as you investigate the Beldam of Stonecreek.

data.name: Desecrated Deck
data.detailed_description:
Play the Free Demo – Steam Scream V Fest

Desecrated Deck joins Steam Scream V Fest!

From October 26 to November 2, 2026, Desecrated Deck takes part in Steam's celebration of horror!

Enter a sinister ritual, challenge a supernatural opponent, and experience a deadly game of Rock, Paper, Scissors.

The free demo is available now. Dare to play?


About the Game

Rock. Paper. Scissors. Choose wisely.

Desecrated Deck is a first-person psychological horror card game built around an occult ritual.
You are not playing against an ordinary opponent.
Across from you waits something that should not be here.
Something that knows the rules.
Something that expects you to follow them.
Each round begins with a simple choice: Rock. Paper. Scissors.
Win, and you move closer to victory.
Lose, and the ritual tightens its grip.
Reach 3 points before your opponent does.
Use powerful Item Cards.
Twist fate with supernatural Perks.
And whatever happens...
do not break the rules.

Every card has a purpose.

Some Item Cards will save you.
Some will hurt your opponent.
Some may do something far worse.
The Plague Doctor can restore lost life.
The Revolver and Burning Witch can take life from your opponent.
The Blind Man grants another draw.
The Thief reveals what was meant to stay hidden.
And the Hangman?
Not every card was made to help you.
Once the deck is exhausted, fate begins again.
The cards return.
The ritual continues.
But you never know what will be waiting in your hand next.

Cursed Perks can change everything.

A shared pool of supernatural Perk Cards can turn a safe round into a disaster — or save you from one.
The Cursed Mirror can reflect an attack.
The Poisonous Mushroom can suppress Item effects.
The Oracle can reshuffle your fate.
The Gravestone can deny an Item draw and force another confrontation.

data.name: Doppel Hunter
data.detailed_description:
Doppel Hunter is a party game for 1-4 players (up to 6 possible, max 4 xbox controllers + 2 Playstation/non-Xinput) involving hiding amongst copies of yourself called "Doppels" and outsmarting other players. Break out the drinks and snacks as you compete with your friends in a hilarious game full of action, deception, and chaos.

How to play

  • Choose between various characters, each with their unique personalities

  • Familiarize yourself with your doppel-clone ability to hide and trick your opponents 

  • Spawn into a variety of different maps with the other players. Put on your "act-casual-hat" as you cleverly hide in plain sight amongst the doppels. The use of sneaky trickery is fully endorsed... win by any means necessary.

  • Every round, random new game modifiers are applied, making each round unique.

  • Customize the game details and create your own game modes

  • Encounter and unlock all the game modifiers

More Info

---Character Skins---

Many character skins can be unlocked by doing various tasks. Some are more obvious than others. Try to collect them all

---Game Modifiers---

There is an ever-expanding pool of "game modifiers" that have a chance to be applied to each round. There's a random chance for each modifier to be selected. Once you have encountered a modifier, it is "unlocked" and can be toggled in a custom game. There are plenty of secrets and easter eggs to discover.

---Tribute to the Doppels---

Meet your everyday average doppel. Please take a moment to sympathize with them. Just trying to mind their own business, brainlessly wandering indefinitely around the map. That's all they want to do, and players keep running around acting like they own the place. So underappreciated... Doppels, we thank you for your sacrifice.

data.name: Sky Mates
data.detailed_description:
Sky Mates is a small game posing a big challenge: outsmart and outmanoeuvre your opponents whilst navigating your team around a crumbling airship in order to gain control. No story, no nonsense, all tactics!

Made by a small team of first-time indie developers, this game follows a strict easy to learn, hard to master approach that is inspired by our favorite tactical video and board games.

In Sky Mates you can:

  • Assemble a team of Mates who all come with different stats and powers.

  • Customise the starting placement of your team each match to fit your strategy – or to block your opponent.

  • Play high-intensity turn-based matches in which every move counts!

Sky Mates is a multiplayer-only game that emphasises playing against real human opponents, both online and in front of the same screen. To find other Sky Mates enthusiasts, join our Discord!

data.name: HAUL
data.detailed_description:
HAUL is a first-person reselling game set in a small early-2000s town. Hunt for deals, price your finds, make the sale, and build something of your own.

SOURCE 

Dig through dusty thrift store shelves, bargain bins, and forgotten lots for items worth more than the locals think. Every aisle in Colburn is a gamble — sometimes you walk out with junk, sometimes a $200 score for pocket change.

UNBOX

Buy mystery lots blind and crack them open at home to find out what you actually paid for. Each box is a small lottery of rare finds, busted electronics, and the occasional wildcard nobody asked for.

CRUISE

Drive across Colburn between thrift runs, post office stops, and shady backyard meetups. Run a red light, clip a fire hydrant, send a pedestrian into low orbit — the locals will remember.

DEAL

Meet up with citizens around town to haggle, lowball, and sweet-talk your way into better margins. Every NPC has their own personality, their own price ceiling, and their own opinion of you.

FLIP

List your finds on Flippr, pack them at the shipping station, and slap a label on for the post office. Build a reputation, climb the seller ranks, and turn your couch-surfing operation into a real business.

data.name: Cosmic Survivor
data.detailed_description:
In Cosmic Survivor, you take control of the LT-10, humanity’s last hope against an alien force threatening its colonies.

Cross hostile sectors filled with meteors, UFOs, alien swarms, enemy fleets, and giant bosses. With each cycle, the difficulty increases, enemies become more aggressive, and your weapon choices define how far you can go.

Choose between different ships, unlock new options as you progress through the campaign, rescue drifting astronauts, launch devastating missiles, and combine special weapons such as combat drones, orbital turrets, piercing lasers, space mines, and temporal cannons.

Main Features

  • Arcade survival gameplay with cyclic phases and increasing difficulty.

  • 6 playable ships with different firing styles.

  • 10 special weapons that change your strategy.

  • Space bosses with unique visuals and attack patterns.

  • Achievements, ranking, and progression systems.

  • Normal, Hard and Relaxing.

  • Keyboard and mouse support.

  • Intro story and mission ending sequence.

data.name: A Vessel of Frustration
data.detailed_description:
You play as Julia, a being out of this world. You return to your hometown after a decade of escapism, but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you're not here for them. 

You are here for her. 

Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess! She will perform in your town tomorrow, and you will finally get to meet her outside of your dreams. 

You call yourself a goddess as well, but truth be told, you’re still too human for your own taste. And you suspect that this woman of your dreams is the same; something undoubtedly beyond this tangible world, while still being stuck within it, torn between human and divine. 

Perhaps, together with her, combined as one, you could leave the heavy burden of shame and sorrow completely, and reach true divinity!

It takes place 13 years after The Shame of a Daydreamer, and can be seen as a sequel, but can also be played independently.

Within this vessel of frustration you can find: 

  • choice and consequence focused gameplay

  • magic and beings inspired by folklore and religion; such as 

    • demi-gods, magicians, shapeshifters, werewolves, hulders, mind control and weather related abilities

  • a main character who calls herself a goddess, but wants to get even closer to divinity - at the end of the game, hopefully she will not have any bit of human remaining within her!

  • consequences that are tangible but don't prevent you from making bad choices - your character is a goddess, you can do what you want!

  • complicated families with morally debatable backstories and filthy secrets that could change EVERYTHING

  • hand drawn characters, environments and animations

  • original music 

  • A LOT of good writing - so be prepared to read!

A Vessel of Frustration is a narrative rpg/visual novel handdrawn and painted with watercolors, with focus on a choice and consequence gameplay. It takes place during a weekend, and both content and outcome heavily depends on the player’s own actions. As the player, you walk around in a small Swedish seemingly normal town and interact with people you know are, just like you, out of this world. If you aren’t careful enough in your exploration, who knows what might be unleashed. 

The possible branches you could end up on are many, and even the most destructive choices can lead to new paths. Use your powers to reach the outcome you desire, whether that is getting closer to becoming a true goddess, joining Jack in his plans to let the supernaturals rule the world, killing god or getting closer to the ones you once loved.

There are no wrong choices, only different paths to end up on, and different levels of destruction. You are something of a divine being, after all, so you can decide yourself what moral compass to follow, if any.

Some characters in the game: 

JULIA

This is who you play as! She is some kind of supernatural being, that’s for sure. But you are not sure of how far her potential reaches. She can visit dreams, and she might be a shapeshifter? Very sneaky. Can even the player trust her?

MIDGÅRDSORMEN

Singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world. Her music is controversial, but it touches you like no other music has before. And not to speak of the countless dreams you’ve had of her. Is she visiting your dreams, like you can visit others’? She will play live for the very first time, in your very small hometown out of all places in this big world - that must mean that there’s some kind of connection, right?

THE SNAKE BASTARD

He looks like a regular human man, except for his split tongue. He is seen as a god but not respected as one. He can create life, both carnally and divinely. His actions are not for protecting or guidance, forgiving or punishing, but for entertainment. No one knows the limit of his power. Is he almighty, or more of an observer? 

SEBASTIAN

He is seen as a god and respected as one. He protects and guides, forgives and punishes. He is capable of destroying the whole world with an emotional storm, but only The Snake Bastard is capable of restoring it afterwards. He is a descendant of The Snake Bastard, among other supernatural sources.

JACK

A politician and magician who wants to take over the world. He wants to let the supernatural walk free and open, and not “hide in the shadows anymore”. He wants Sebastian to join him, but Sebastian is firmly against these plans. 

ARON

A (former?) religious man, obsessed with Sebastian in a similar way you’re obsessed with Midgårdsormen. He says that The Snake Bastard visits his dreams and leaves traces in the form of scars and an incurable disease. He cannot forgive the gods for intruding on his dreams like this, and wants them to be stopped. Somehow.

LEVI

Sebastian’s daughter, but no one would believe this by looking at them, since they, look the same age, so officially they call each other sister and brother. She should probably start calling her son her brother as well, as he’s getting close to thirty. She is both so very strong and so very weak. Cruel and pathetic. But you might not know her as well as you thought you did.

FELIX

Levi’s son. He moved away from the town and hasn’t really stayed in contact with his family.

SJ

He was once part of you.

ELIAS

A child of the moon, and a young father.

ROSENKVARTS

Also known as Heart. One of the four men created divinely by The Snake Bastard. He can feel no pain and knows no morals, and therefore always needs a master whose words can be his law. This person used to be The Snake Bastard, but is nowadays Sebastian.

ELDUR

Some kind of creature with a tail like a troll, fangs like a beast and a tongue like a snake. His music is enchanting.

data.name: Sort the Magic Potions: Tidy Up and Shelve
data.detailed_description:
SYNOPSIS

You awaken inside a mysterious magical library with no doors, no way out… and thousands of enchanted potions scattered everywhere.

The library seems to have a will of its own. Sort every potion onto its proper shelf, restore order to the chaos, and perhaps the magic will finally reveal the way out.

A MAGICAL LIBRARY ORGANIZING SIMULATOR

Sort the Magic Potions: Tidy Up and Shelve is a cozy first-person organizing simulation set inside a mysterious magical library.

Pick up, identify, sort and shelve 3,040 scattered potions. Learn their magical categories, find matching potions and return each one to its proper place.

Health, Poison, Mana, Fire, Ice, Nature, Shadow and many more magical collections are waiting to be organized.

TURN CHAOS INTO PERFECT ORDER

The library begins in complete chaos.

Search through thousands of scattered potions, complete matching collections and watch empty shelves gradually fill with perfectly organized rows.

As the enormous pile disappears, the library transforms around you. Every correctly sorted potion creates visible progress toward restoring perfect order—and finding your way out.

UNLOCK MAGICAL SORTING ABILITIES

Earn money as you organize and unlock powerful upgrades that make sorting faster and more satisfying.

Carry more potions. Move faster. Jump. Highlight matching potions. Reveal the correct shelves. Automatically collect nearby matches. Unlock auto-shelving magic.

Combine your abilities, improve your efficiency and discover your own sorting strategy for organizing thousands of potions.

RELAX, SORT & SHELVE

There is no need to rush.

Explore the magical library, search for matching potions and organize at your own pace. Enjoy the satisfying rhythm of collecting, sorting, organizing and shelving as complete chaos slowly becomes a beautiful, organized collection.

KEY FEATURES

  • Sort and organize 3,040 magical potions

  • Explore a mysterious fantasy library

  • Find matching potions and complete themed collections

  • Fill hundreds of shelves and restore perfect order

  • Earn money and unlock powerful sorting abilities

  • Highlight matches, reveal shelves and automatically collect potions

  • Unlock magical auto-shelving abilities

  • Develop your own strategy and improve your efficiency

  • Enjoy relaxing, satisfying organizing and sorting gameplay

  • Transform a chaotic library into a perfectly organized collection

Thousands of magical potions. Hundreds of shelves. One place for everything.

Find where every potion belongs… restore order to the library… and reveal the way out.

data.name: Stay Safe 2020
data.detailed_description:
In a world where news of the pandemic, endless chores, and loneliness are the only things that exist anymore, an unexpected phone call will drastically change your life forever. It’s an old woman on the other end, and she desperately needs your help! Unfortunately, you don’t know who she is, where she lives, or even her phone number. What are you supposed to do?

STAY SAFE 2020 is a fun, light-hearted platformer that tells a brief story of a young person’s quest to help an old woman in need. As you risk your life to break the lockdown, you’ll find a world in disarray, filled with deadly viruses. Along the way, you’ll meet a cast of characters who can guide you toward your goal, if you can accomplish a number of tasks that is.

Take a break from your own lockdown blues, and escape into this fun story that takes you from pandemic zero to pandemic hero!

data.name: EscarGO
data.detailed_description:
Type fast. Stay off the menu.


You're a snail in a French kitchen. The chef wants dinner. Every correct letter moves you further along the counter.

Expect dark jokes, worse puns and a chef with no mercy. EscarGO is a comedy for grown-ups, not a kids' typing tutor.

A typing party for up to 4 players


Everyone types the same sentences. Everyone runs from the same chef. The last snail standing escapes dinner.

Get caught? You're still part of the trouble. Write sentences for the survivors to type and give your friends something to panic about. Built-in voice chat, with snail voice effects, lets you hear every laugh and very unfortunate typo.

Join with a lobby code, your Steam friends or the public list. Bots fill the empty seats.

Go solo. Chase the top score.


Take on three bot snails that match your usual pace. Outlast them, then keep going. Every clean letter builds your combo; one mistake breaks it.

The chef keeps getting faster, so every run ends in the pan eventually. Climb the global and friends leaderboards for each mode, and take on a new weekly challenge.

Give your fingers something strange to do


Nine text modes: type backwards, tackle 1337, cope without vowels or take on Shakespeare. Chef's Roulette switches mode every sentence.

Six stackable modifiers for a bigger score, from Mirror and Jelly to Sudden Death, where one wrong key makes your snail explode. No pressure.

On the menu


  • Online races for up to 4 players
  • Endless solo runs on global leaderboards
  • Write sentences for your friends after you're caught
  • Nine text modes and six modifiers
  • Voice chat with snail voice effects
  • Weekly challenges and Steam achievements

Content note: dark and crude humour intended for adult players. Online play includes player-written sentences and voice chat that are not moderated.

data.name: Hallowed Faces
data.detailed_description:
In Hallowed Faces, you return to your village at dusk after spending the entire afternoon collecting berries deep in the woods. Darkness has already fallen, and the wind has picked up. A cold mist blankets the streets, and the village that should be bustling with evening life is silent. The familiar wooden homes stand dark and empty. The only movement comes from the window shutters and the street lanterns. An eerie feeling settles over you, as though the village itself is watching, holding its breath, waiting for you to uncover what’s lurking in the fog.

Key features

  • Halloween Atmosphere – Wander between the fog-covered woods and the quiet village streets. Carve pumpkins, cross paths with a mysterious witch, and uncover what this haunted night truly hides.

  • Rich Lore – Uncover the dark history of the valley and the haunting secrets its people tried to bury.

  • Full Voice Acting – Immerse yourself in chilling performances that bring everything to life.

  • Unsettling Events – Experience unpredictable, spine-chilling moments that keep you questioning what’s real.

  • Puzzles & Riddles – Solve eerie mysteries and uncover clues to piece together the truth behind the fog.

  • Hidden Secrets – Keep your eyes open for cryptic notes, subtle hints, and eerie Easter eggs scattered throughout the village.

  • Multiple Endings – Your choices matter. Each decision leads you closer to salvation… or something far worse.

  • Compact Horror Experience – 30–45 minutes of tension, mystery, and dread. Perfect for a chilling night in.

data.name: VR Async Balls
data.detailed_description:
VR Async Balls will immerse you into the virtual world of the cosmopark, where you can play on a slot machine. You have to hold two balls at one and the same time on different moving tracks. Firstly, only one level is available for you, after passing it, the next will be opened. There are 20 levels in the game, each of them is more difficult than the previous one. The tracks curiously bend into space and after pressing the Start button, they begin to move at a constant speed. You need to prevent two balls from falling off these tracks with your hands and bring them to the end.
Trained people, like pianists, can easily move their hands in different directions independently of each other. This simulator will allow you to check how asynchronous your brain works, how accurately and consciously you can move your hands, how much you can concentrate and control the movements of two balls at once.
This little game will bring you a lot of fun and joy from its passage. Good luck!

You are deployed to a heavily guarded compound to infiltrate and extract a highly valuable relic. Remaining undetected is of utmost priority. If anyone spots you, the mission is over. Use your surroundings carefully to avoid detection and reach the vault. The ultimate test of strategy and patience awaits you. Harder challenges will become available for the elite who accomplish their extraction.

Do you accept your mission?

Infiltrate and Extract will test your problem solving and decision-making skills. This game has no mercy against those who don’t plan ahead, and heavy punishments for not being patient. Only the best of agents returns home, and the very best can beat the hardest challenges the game has to offer. Are you up for the challenge?

  • Unlockable “Sudden Death” Mode.

data.name: Sea Town - Fish Market Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Dive into a Coastal Adventure

Step into the vibrant world of Sea Town - Fish Market Simulator and experience the thrill of coastal life as you build and expand your own fishing business. Start your journey on a charming island and explore a vast ocean filled with diverse islands, each offering unique economies and rare fish species to discover.




Navigate a Dynamic Economy

In Sea Town - Fish Market Simulator, the economy is always shifting, with fish prices fluctuating daily. Make smart, strategic decisions about when and where to sell your catch to maximize profits. data.name: Assimilate! (A Party Game)
data.detailed_description:
Assimilate! (A Party Game) consists of three rounds of finger-pointing fun. Each player is either a human, robot, or programmer (the robot's best friend) and needs to work together in order to win. The only problem, the humans don't know who their fellow humans are so they'll have to use logic, deduction, and teamwork to figure out who they can trust.


Team Humans
Objective: Identify (and kick out) that pesky robot!

  • Submit clues describing the password (that everyone but the Robot knows) to prove you're a human
  • Deliberate among the other players to determine who appears suspiciously robotic
  • If a majority of the humans correctly identify the robot (or programmer), the humans win!


Team Robots
Objective: Assimilate among the humans, undetected.

  • The Programmer helps the Robot bluff their way through the clue-entering phase
  • Deflect suspicion from your team and accuse humans as being untrustworthy
  • If a majority of the humans cannot correctly identify the robot or programmer, the Robot team prevails!

Features

  • "Classic" Play (3 rounds x 4 minutes each) or "Quick Play" (one short, 4 minute game)
  • Supports all HTML-5 enabled devices
  • Did a player drop mid-game? No problem. Just use our AFK Protection and give that player the boot!
  • Customize your game with user-generated lists

Note: This game can be played locally or online with remote players.

data.name: Frog Planter
data.detailed_description:
Pre-registration

If you would be interested in this game of racing mayhem, please visit our website and go through the Preregistration! Because if you do so, you will earn yourself exclusive rewards (only for the alpha testers) and you get to have a great chance of shaping the game to your likings!

Preregistration closes and alpha starts midst of October, around 16-17th, and would last for 2-3 weeks.


About the Game

Every lil' champion starts in a flowerpot of some sorts. Frog Planter mixes frog raising and home building, customizing and decorating with chaotic online races to reap your rewards. Grow your own competitors, shape their strengths, through what you build and what you decorate their rooms with. Then take them to the track with questionable gadgets (either crafted home or received during the race) while they bring their personalities.

Pick a pot, rip open an Egg Packet and plant the seeds of your racing career as the next big Frog Planter. Water your growing frogs, raise them from being a lil frogroot, through their restless froglethood into race ready adults.

Discover frogs of different rarities, and help your mom fulfill her dream of being the largest frog collector. Decide who joins the collection and who should take on the Champion's Crown. Specialist pots, hand crafted decorations, and other differently rated furnitures can give your little contender a head start before it ever reaches the track.

Meet dozens of frog species with different looks, strengths and quirks. A glutton might decide a fly is more interesting than the finish line. Other frogs would rather show off, make friends or cause trouble. Once you sign up your frog to the race, you have very little control over it. So you never know what's going to happen after the next track curve. Collect your favorites and get to know the characters behind the stats.

First steps are the hardest to take. Especially when you have to turn back, and take a step down to move back to your mother's. Turn your childhood room, and the living room, and the toilet, into a home for an increasingly unreasonable amount of frogs. Arrange furniture, make space for pots and training equipment and add decorations that suit you and your style. Every equipment has its use, even mom's toilet can teach a thing or two about swimming...

But don't fear, what's coming, and work on yourself everyday! Slowly chip away from your debts, fly by fly, and pull yourself up to get access again to the Ribbit Realty! After reaching the 15th Job Proficiency level you rent your own Apartment! So get to work towards a bigger place for your growing collection.

Join friends and rivals in eight-frog races across land, water, climbing and jumping only sections. Your frog keeps moving where they want, while you have the ability to steer ever so slightly and use powers or activate equipment. On the tracks: collisions, wandering wildlife and badly timed bonks can turn a comfortable lead into a very different story.

Race through the 3 different modes:

  • Short, around 5 minutes per race, but the reward is also less significant

  • Normal, around 10 minutes, but here natural predators are more keen to enter the race, to pick off the fastest or the slowest frogs in the race! But don't worry, you can redirect your guess on who's winning one time during the mid point. And beware... we cannot recover calories consumed by the Stork or the Alligators.

  • Tournament, where your Champion's Fate has already been sealed, you can't take back what has once entered the tournament. The last frog standing will have the pleasure to meet the Great Croak high-above. In exchange you get the ultimate token!

So choose your race items wisely and decide who gets them. Gear can go on your own frog or another entrant, giving you plenty of room for generous gestures and questionable gifts. Fire up a rocket, bounce from a portable trampoline, or let a bubble-wrap vest take the hit.

Features at a glance

- Plant, water and raise frogs through three life stages.

- Collect varied species, rarities and discover their personalities.

- Train froglets and develop their lasting strengths.

- Arrange your home and progress towards larger properties. After renting, you might consider buying your own property!

- Race online with up to 7 friends, through different biomes with bots filling in the open places.

- Draft and place equipment, steer your frog, pick up spicy power ups and try to make sense of the mayhem!

Disclaimer:

PLEASE DO NOT PLANT TADPOLES INTO FLOWER POTS IRL!!

data.name: SamVSTom
data.detailed_description:
Sam, stop Tom. If we don't, the world will perish.

Synopsis

The two have been childhood friends since elementary school. The two went to the same school in junior high and high school, and recognized each other as best friends.

In the summer of his second year of college, Tom dropped out. Due to family circumstances, Tom had to work. From then on, we gradually passed each other……

Later, Sam started his own business right after graduating from university and made a fortune with a social media app. He was living a smooth life until he realized, ``Even though I created an app that anyone could connect with, I still haven't met the person I really want to meet,'' so he decides to go see Tom on his birthday.

But Sam didn't notice. Tom isn't the Tom he was back then……

Third-person action battle

This work is an action battle game from a third-person perspective. Toms with different attack patterns will appear in each stage and will stand in your way. Observe Tom's movements carefully and find an opening to attack.

Conquer stages full of gimmicks

There are some places where you can't fight Tom unless you conquer the stage. Move Sam well and clear the labyrinth stages and falling stages.

A tense battle

Sam isn't a superhero in the comics, he's just a company president. Therefore, there is no way to recover HP, and you cannot continue. Break through the approaching Tom while maintaining your limited HP.

Time attack function

This game allows you to check the current time while playing the game. Play over and over and beat Tom the fastest to set a personal record.

data.name: Fading Light VR: Antiworld
data.detailed_description:
Join Our Discord


About the Game




Fading Light: Antiworld Chapter I is a first-person horror quest that takes place in a post-war world of nuclear disaster, developed by an indie game team SUPLIFE.
Combining survival horror with creative puzzle game, Fading Light: Antiworld ensures horror lovers a thrilling adventure that will keep your adrenaline pumping.



During WWIII, the explosion of a nuclear power plant has caused massive amounts of nuclear waste leakage into the city. You, an experienced nuclear engineer, wake up only to find yourself trapped in a dark antiworld that circulates between 12 am and 6 am. There seems to be a way of getting out, but be careful, you are NOT alone in here...



Blood traits, haunted TV, mysterious voices... Realistic graphics and sounds provide you with a truly immersive experience that will make your blood run cold.



  • Adventure: There you are, finally awake, feeling dizzy. The news of the air raid on October 31 seems to pull you back to the vague moment when the shock wave hit the city after the nuclear power plant explosion. What happened? Where are you? Embark on a chilling horror journey through confusion and fear.
  • Enermy: It's rumored that unknown entities are waiting for you in the dark. When facing with spooky entites, you will realize your weakness. While avoiding their hunting, you will find ways to escape. This will be a battle of wits and courage.
  • Collect: Collecting the antimatters in pairs will generate energy to charge the flashlight until it's time for you to escape the room. Luckily, as a senior nuclear engineer, you have professional tools to help you collect them.
  • Survive: The mysterious and evil voices follow you around. Keeping a weak light source in your hand seems like a good way to prevent it from getting close, yet the light becomes dimmer and dimer as time goes by. How to accumulate enough light energy to store power for the flashlight? You will be facing severe problems in the darkness.

data.name: System Says Normal
data.detailed_description:
You were hired to watch. Not to ask questions.

Night shift. Baseline Corporation. A terminal, a camera feed, a simple checklist. Observe. Report.
Confirm everything is... normal?

You've done this before. Or maybe someone else has. They didn't finish their shift.

Something is wrong with this building.

Not broken - wrong. Details that don't add up. Fragments of whoever was here before you, scattered across corridors that feel like they shouldn't be familiar. No body. No report. Just the system, still running, still waiting for someone to tell it everything is fine.

So you start piecing it together. Loop by loop. What happened here? What does it cost? Why does the system keep asking the same question - even after you've answered it twice?

The system doesn't punish mistakes. It notices them.

There are no jump scares. No monsters hunting you down hallways. The threat in System Says Normal is quieter than that: the slow realization that certainty is dangerous, that the right answer might not be the true one, and that something has been watching you far longer than you've been watching it.

Every loop changes what you see - or what you're allowed to see. Every choice you make is remembered by a system that never corrects you.

A first-person psychological horror experience built on dread, not fear.

  • Atmospheric investigation across repeating shifts

  • Uncover the story of your predecessor - and your own

  • No hand-holding. No explanations. No safe answers.

  • Multiple loops, layered secrets, unreliable systems

  • Minimalist retro aesthetic with deep environmental storytelling

Everything is normal. Please proceed.

Gather your best mystery solving team or go in alone, it's time to take on The Secrets Of The Professor...

data.name: Zen Universe
data.detailed_description:
Zen Universe

The Zen Universe brings the world to you through the magic of VR. Immerse yourself into high-detail realistic 3D environments powered by ground-breaking virtual reality technology. Visit real-life locations and discover hidden natural treasures wherever you are. Discover ruins of ancient civilizations, explore the past and the present.
Take your picks from a library of real and unreal experiences, all developed in Unreal Engine 4. Whether it’s the most famous landmarks you’ve never dreamt of visiting or places of fiction you’ve always dreamt of going to, the power of virtual reality will take you there. Our state-of-the-art technology raises the industry bar in realism, entertainment, and interactivity. Explore the many worlds of ZenArt VR to marvel, relax, learn or play.

Hyper-realistic visuals

ZenART VR is on the cutting edge of 3D-scanning technology. Our wide range of surfaces, textures, and materials, not only look stunning at first glance but hold up on close inspection. We use powerful tools to render photoreal images in real-time, while our post-processing technology allows us to put the finishing touches for Hollywood-grade image quality.

Historical guide

You are never alone. Our virtual guides are always there to help you with tips and suggestions. Learn about a location’s history and relive it from the perspective of the people who were there when it happened. Then tap into the world of magic by exploring the myths, legends, and unsolved mysteries throughout the millennia.

Dynamic weather

Every aspect of a Zen Universe location is fully rendered in-engine and adaptive to the dynamic weather system. Watch the rain pour down, snow cover the distant hills in the background and the rays of light play in the sky, piercing clouds and treetops moved by the wind.

Day & Night Cycle
Discover beautiful virtual worlds as they change before your very eyes. The Zen Universe day & night cycle and dynamic lighting technology give an accurate representation of the effects of time on the environment, but also allow us to create a larger-than-life movie-like atmosphere for you to immerse yourself in.

Real-life

Explore the world’s most renowned landmarks without leaving the comfort of your home. Our team travels there for you and spends countless hours recreating the locations as accurately as possible so you can feel like you’re actually there. The line between reality and virtual simulation has never been so narrow.

Early Access
This is an exclusive first look at the Zen Universe. Supporting us on Early Access will grant you access to 2 of 4 planned destinations: Tales of the Rocks - an ancient fortress and a natural marvel, and Olympus: Home of the Gods - a mythical quest for knowledge. This bundle will be upgraded to feature all 4 destinations FOR FREE when the complete Zen Universe is released.

data.name: SPQR: Panem et Lignum
data.detailed_description:
From the first plank to a bustling settlement

SPQR: Panem et Lignum is an economic strategy game set in a Roman province. Build workshops, organize supplies, and grow a settlement whose success depends on its roads and the flow of goods.

Every good has a journey

Timber, stone, food, and tools travel from producers to their destinations, carried by your settlers. The position of a sawmill, a warehouse connection, and the capacity of a junction all affect your settlement. Follow deliveries and uncover the causes of delays.

Turn production chains into a working economy

Organize resource gathering, process materials, and supply construction sites. Keep your workers supplied with food and tools. Each new workshop expands your settlement’s capabilities while placing fresh demands on its transport network.

Plan, watch, improve

Lay out roads, position buildings, and manage stockpiles. Your settlers carry out their work autonomously while you decide how to connect each stage. Expand an overloaded route, improve warehouse placement, or adjust delivery priorities.

Build your own corner of the Roman world

Develop settlements on randomly generated maps, adapting your plans to forests, mineral deposits, and terrain. Watch everyday life unfold through the game’s 2D visuals and animated settlers.

data.name: Ephesus
data.detailed_description:
Join Our Discord Channel!


About the Game



"It is a rough road that leads to the heights of greatness." - Lucius Annaeus Seneca

Ephesus is an ancient roman city which is located in aegean coast of Turkey. This city was one of the most glorious city of Roman Empire at the times. In Ephesus's massive open world you will explore the whole grandeur of this rich city as if you were walking down on it's streets. While you're chasing the quest line, trading, gathering or building you will see the real coverings of the Ephesus. Main goal of the game is that it will let you experience the Citizen of Ephesus's daily life while you're exploring this open world and surviving on it.



In Ephesus you will take on the role of Hector Remus at the 100 BC. Hector is a passionate young man with great dreams and dedication. You will try to set up your own path through this journey. You need to gather resources for hunting, crafting, building and you need to check your vital signs to stay alive.

This game is not going to force you to follow the questline. If you want you can just hunt, build and explore the map designed to surprise you. You can be a great trader or a farmer who makes more money that no one has ever done.

data.name: Warring Triad
data.detailed_description:
Warring Triad is a card battler online tradeable card game (TCG) that reimagines the beloved mechanics of other popular TCGs, and wraps it all with a rich, single-player roguelike adventure.

A mysterious spaceship falls from the sky, carrying Warring Triad into an unknown planet. The children who find it, once a disorganized and disconnected group, find ways to connect with each other through the cards, and they strive to build a vibrant community! But not everyone is happy with the kid's new encampment.

  • Play online on Casual, Ranked or Tournament pvp modes, and earn rewards and rare cards by climbing the ladder!

  • Play Single Player on Deck Building Rogue-like mode, with both a story mode and an infinite mode.

  • Uncover the story of Tala, an aspiring artist willing to draw new art for the rusty cards.

  • Collect more than 250 available cards

  • Play Classic Triad games.

  • Enjoy a new ruleset that recontextualizes the triad formula!

  • Better monetization than traditional TCGs: Pay for the game, get the whole collection, no need for microtransactions. Completing the collection is part of the Gameplay, and not the economy.

data.name: Command at your own Risk
data.detailed_description:
The bridge is yours. The consequences are everyone’s.

Enemy weapons are charging. Your engineer needs more power. Your pilot has a questionable escape plan. And someone just volunteered you to be Captain.

Welcome to Command at Your Own Risk, a cooperative starship bridge simulator where a crew of up to 8 players turns friendship, quick thinking, and occasionally terrible decisions into a spacefaring adventure.

One ship. Eight stations. Everyone matters.

Gather your friends and take your stations: Captain, Engineering, Tactical, Navigation, Science, Communications, Operations, and Fighter/Shuttle Pilot. Each role brings a different piece of the picture—and keeping your ship in one piece means working together.

Call the shots from the Captain’s chair. Reroute power as Engineering. Line up torpedoes at Tactical. Steer through danger at Helm. Scan for enemy weaknesses, handle communications, manage precious supplies, or launch into space at the controls of a small craft.

When the shields buckle and the alarms start, your greatest asset is the person at the next station.

Your friends join free.

Only the host needs to own the game. Your crew joins through a phone or desktop browser, with no separate game purchase or required mobile app. Put the action on a big screen for a living-room bridge crew, or bring your friends together online.

Short a few officers? Basic station automation helps smaller crews keep flying.

Find your fortune—or find trouble.

Take on contracts, hunt hostile ships, investigate strange anomalies, answer distress calls, and haul valuable cargo. Build a reputation through honest work, or try your luck with piracy. Coordinate your next move, weigh the risks, and decide together how far you’re willing to push your ship.

Sometimes the smartest order is “fire.” Sometimes it’s “run.”

Build a ship worth coming back to.

Earn credits, advance research, and customize your vessel with weapons, engines, shields, cargo capacity, and more. Shape your ship around the adventures your crew wants to tackle, balancing firepower, survivability, and the demands of keeping everything running.

But take care of what you build. Subsystems can fail, repairs consume supplies, and a destroyed ship takes its installed equipment with it. Knowing when to retreat can be the difference between a hard-earned victory and shopping for a replacement.

Make a plan. Improvise immediately.

Lighthearted sci-fi meets meaningful teamwork in sessions built for shared victories, frantic recoveries, and stories your friends will bring up long after you’ve docked.

Assemble your crew. Pick your Captain. Try to bring the ship home.

Command at your own risk.

data.name: Jurassic Paradise: No Escape
data.detailed_description:
Escape together. But who wants you to stay?

Dinosaurs roam a park you need to escape. The experts must restore facilities and gather supplies. A cultist hidden among them wants everyone to stay. Jurassic Paradise: No Escape is an online game of survival and social deduction where you still need the people you suspect.

What if the teammate who saved you is keeping you here?


They helped fix the pipes. Brought the supplies you needed. Pulled you out of a dinosaur’s path. Every good deed might be real, while their goal is very different. The cultist can help the team and quietly delay its escape.

Remember who stayed beside you in danger, and who disappeared just before the blackout. Compare their words, actions and eyewitness accounts, then vote to expel a suspect.

Share the work. Keep your own suspicions.


Connect pipes, fit fossil bones and move supplies to prepare your escape. Hands-on tasks and physical interactions leave plenty of room for plans to go wrong. Decide whether that delay was an honest mistake or someone buying time.

You can help without winning a fight. Bring supplies, restore a facility or warn the team. While one player holds a dinosaur back, another’s finished task could open the way out.

Split up to work faster. Stay together to stay alive.


The work is scattered across the park. Splitting up gets it done sooner, but leaves help farther away when a dinosaur finds you.

Dinosaurs hunt the cultist too. Even while you suspect each other, you may need to run together, clear a path and survive the immediate threat. Once you catch your breath, you can ask: “Where were you earlier, anyway?”

Hear the panic. Hear the excuses.


Use proximity voice chat to call for help, report what you saw and hear a suspicious excuse for yourself. Voices fade with distance, making who you travel with part of the plan.

Gather in the lobby with chat, then share emotes and conversations in the park. Someone buys the team enough time to escape. Someone you trusted turns on you. The round ends; the stories carry into the next one.

The deduction ends. The chase begins.


As the cultist, earn trust through cooperation, buy time with sabotage, and gather DNA by completing secret tasks. Keep your disguise and delay the escape, or transform into a dinosaur and block the way yourself.

Transformation ends the meetings. The teammate who was working beside you is now hunting you. The experts must buy time with tranquilizers and traps while finishing the tasks that open the exit. Discovering the traitor does not mean you have survived.



You need your teammates to open the way out.
Trusting them might be your last gamble.

Will you survive?

data.name: Backrooms: Beyond the Walls
data.detailed_description:
Backrooms: Beyond the Walls is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Something is wrong with this place. The halls never seem to end, the silence feels alive, and every step deeper brings you closer to something you were never meant to find.

Explore abandoned environments alone or with friends, survive deadly encounters, and uncover what lies behind the presence lurking somewhere within the endless maze.

Features

  • Oppressive and immersive horror atmosphere

  • Co-op

  • Reactive and intelligent enemy AI

  • Multiple difficulty settings

  • Survival gameplay focused on stealth

  • Large interconnected levels hiding secrets and danger

  • Unpredictable encounters and constant tension

  • Dynamic visibility influenced by movement, posture, shadows, and flashlight usage

Important Notes

This game is an original interpretation inspired by the Backrooms concept and does not strictly follow established community lore. It focuses on psychological horror, environmental storytelling, and adaptive enemy behavior to create a tense and unpredictable experience.

The game contains flickering lights, disturbing imagery, loud sounds, darkness effects, and intense audiovisual sequences that may affect sensitive players.

data.name: Mondrian Squares
data.detailed_description:
Overview

Mondrian Squares is a colourful, abstract puzzle game with random, procedurally generated levels so you never play the same game twice. Progressive difficulty with no upper limit ensures that you will always have a new challenge to face.

Throw in a chillout jazz soundtrack and a visual theme inspired by the works of Piet Mondrian and you have the perfect game to immerse yourself in whenever you have a little spare time.

Gameplay

Mondrian Squares is delightfully simple to learn, but fiendishly difficult to master.

The object of the game is to merge the coloured squares by clicking on the white spaces in between them until only one coloured square remains. If this coloured square is in the centre "goal" square you win and progress to the next level.

You begin with a puzzle that can be solved with a single move, but each level adds a new layer of difficulty and you will soon find yourself having to think dozens of moves ahead.

Your challenge awaits...

data.name: Don't Pray
data.detailed_description:
Don't Pray is the world's first magic-class team-based PvP shooter where aimbot and wallhack aren't hacks, they're core features. Gods won't save you here, but they might listen.

Assemble your team, combine your skills, and fight across shifting arenas where ancient deities grant game-breaking powers or unleash total chaos. We took the strategy of MMORPG arenas (the combos, the cooldowns, and the tactics) and put them into the fast-paced shooter game modes you love.

Forget flick shots and spray patterns. Winning here is about out-thinking your opponents and knowing when to ask the gods for a favor.

LOCK ON. COMBO UP. WIN.

Click tab to lock on your target and see them through walls (for a short duration) - tab is our core Wallhack + Aimbot mechanic. 

THE GODS ARE LISTENING

Scattered across every arena are ancient statues. Pray to them for help, but beware: you might not know who is listening.

A prayer might grant you god-like mobility, flash bombs, or the power to call down firestorms to control the map. But every blessing has a cost. Some gods take before they give. You might get a massive speed boost, or you might get nerfed into the ground when you least expect it.

In the arena, the deities are just as unpredictable as the players. Use their power to turn the tide, but beware of the risks.

COMBAT

We basically give you aimbot and wallhack. And before you report us: it’s a feature, we promise. Tap to lock on your target and your abilities do the rest.

Since aim is handled, the real skill comes from how you use your abilities and work together to do combos. Think classic MMO Arena meets hero shooter. You win by reading your opponent, timing your cooldowns, and knowing which combos to hit. If you lose, it's because you got outplayed, not because someone has 2000 hours of aim training.

Every class brings unique abilities to the fight:

Frostweaver: Control the battlefield with slows and freezes

Infernal: Burn everything. Ask questions never.

Windwalker: High mobility and knockback damage

Shadowstalker: Lurk behind enemy lines and delete targets

Harbinger: Big boi tank who can leap around like spidyman (it's copyrighted so let's call it that)

Luminary: Keep your team alive when everything goes wrong

Master one. Learn them all. Find the combos that break the meta.

GAME MODES

Capture The Flag

Classic. Grab the flag. Don't die. Two teams. One winner.

Domination

Hold the points. Control the map. Coordinate or crumble.

More modes coming..

We're cooking something. Competitive. Claustrophobic. Infectious. Did someone say tower climbing and zombieees? Stay tuned.

FEATURES

  • Aimbot

    Yes, really. Tap to lock on. Your abilities track. No more losing fights because someone's got better flicks. Focus on combos and strategy instead.

  • Wallhack

    See your locked target through walls. Know where they are. Plan your approach. It's not cheating if everyone has it.

  • The Gods are Watching
    Pray to statues for flash bombs, speed boosts, or firestorms. But be careful:you don't know who is listening. Some gods give power; others just want to watch you struggle.

  • Proximity Voice 
    Hear enemies when they're close. Trash talk. Coordinate. Panic. 

  • 6 Classes (No Grinding)
    Frostweaver, Infernal, Windwalker, Shadowstalker, Harbinger, Luminary. You get the full kit immediately: no grinding levels or gear for months.

  • Pick your POV
    Switch between first person, third person or a wide MMO-style view whenever you want.

  • CTF and Domination
    Classic capture the flag and two domination maps. More modes coming soon.

  • Play with Friends
    Squad up or queue solo.

  • No Servers, Just Player
    We use peer-to-peer networking. It's what lets us ship the game for free and move fast on your feedback. We'll move to dedicated servers as we get closer to 1.0 to handle more players and keep things competitive.

  • Free. And NEVER DUCKING Pay-to-Win.
    The game is free. Always. We hate pay-to-win. There are already cosmetics in the game if you want to support the development, but that's it. No gameplay advantages for money. Period.

  • Ranking System 
    Climb up the ladder from day one. Join tournaments and play to win unique in-game skins.
