data.name: Bastion Of Beginnings
data.detailed_description:
Bastion of Beginnings is a tower defense game that seamlessly blends roguelite elements and rich replayability.

Key Features:


Foundational Upgrade System: Start with a simplified upgrade system designed as a precursor to our comprehensive tech tree. This initial system allows us to build out the necessary elements, and will evolve into a more complex and branching tech tree system in the future, adding depth and richness to your progression.



Procedurally Generated Maps


Every game presents a new map, featuring unique terrain generated by our procedural algorithms. Our path generation system, which is tweakable, allows for both crazy and simple paths, perfectly tuned for tower defense.

Scaling/Varied Enemy Types: Face off against enemies that scale and grow tougher with each wave. Anticipate a boss wave every 10th wave, offering not just a challenge but also rewards that enhance your gameplay.

Adaptable Tower Upgrades: Embrace a versatile "attribute" system for tower customization, allowing you to fine-tune stats such as RPM for cannons or firing rate for snipers. Your strategy shapes their evolution. As bosses fall, you're offered a roll on the upgrade system, granting the choice to select enhancements for your towers. This system fosters numerous synergies, stacking effects, and unique special abilities.

Early Access Roadmap:

  • Driven by the Community: Your insights and input are crucial. Engage with us, share your thoughts on features, pinpoint bugs, and help direct the game’s progress.

  • Refinement and Enhancement: Expect ongoing enhancements that polish gameplay, graphics, and performance, delivering a seamless experience across a range of devices.

  • Fresh Threats and Defenses: Stay on the lookout for inventive tower options and new enemy variants that will join the fray.

  • Expanding Tech Tree: Delve into an intricate tech tree with diverse pathways, ensuring each choice has a significant impact on your play style.

  • Dynamic Landscapes: Look forward to more sophisticated world generation, including multiple enemy paths, alongside general improvements and optimizations.

Performance Improvements on the Horizon:
  • Behind-the-scenes work is set to majorly advance performance, paving the way for larger-than-life battles and a smoother gaming experience. Our future plans include transitioning to Unreal Engine’s Mass framework for unparalleled performance enhancements.

    We are currently maximizing what we can achieve with UE’s standard actor system. The shift to Mass is planned as our next big leap forward after we lay the foundation with our community’s support.

Join us in the world of Bastion of Beginnings and help us craft a game that’s as engaging to strategize as it is exhilarating to play.

data.name: The Hunt In Sanity
data.detailed_description:
About the game

The Hunt In Sanity (T.H.I.S) is a psychological atmospheric horror game that plunges players into a haunting descent through trauma, grief, and madness. Drawing inspiration from old classic horror games. T.H.I.S combines chilling exploration, cryptic storytelling, and visceral fear to deliver a deeply immersive experience.

Story Introduction:

After a crash returning home your wife vanishes.

You step out desperate to find her. You discovered that she's tied to a god’s awakening ritual and now you must not only save her, but also stop the ritual.

Your path is perilous and dangerous!

This is The Hunt In Sanity, Time is running out!

data.name: OAOA - Off And On Again
data.detailed_description:
Off And On Again tells the story of a hero tasked with rebooting time. The game world is created and destroyed during play, with the hero having the ability to turn parts of the world off and on again. You will be required to use both brains and skill to overcome the enemies and obstacles in your path.

Features

- A story about a dying world inside a computer system where you are the hero tasked with rebooting time
- A world that is created as you explore it
- Engaging puzzles using the ability of the player to turn parts of the world off and on in order to progress
- Lasers, because everything is better with lasers

Local Multiplayer features 4 game modes for 2-4 players. In each game mode players only have one shot, that they must recall and catch before being able to fire again.

Deathmatch
Elimination
Invasion
Break it

*** Please note that controllers are required to play the multiplayer modes ***

data.name: Into Oblivion
data.detailed_description:
Our Newest Game


About the Game

Into Oblivion is a drinking contest of ridiculous proportion. Each player is dealt five item cards per round and attempts to make one of many mixed drinks for themselves or their opponents. Some drinks have additional status effects, some will make you puke instantly, while others just leave a funny taste in your mouth. Mix, swap, and serve drinks to chip away at, or boost, each other's precious health, liver, and drunkenness to win.

In this game, it is all about how you drink. Into Oblivion features three main modes: normal, Top Shelf, and The Sobering. Half-way through all modes, there is a half-time, dice rolling mini-game called Midnight. Keeping at least one die per round, you will try to score a 1 and 4 then all other dice are your points. You'll net a fancy trophy and bonus points for your final score by winning.

In normal mode, you will compete to get the highest drunk score you can without going overboard. Of course you can always tank your opponent's liver to double the amount of drunk points they accumulate per drink, pushing them over the limit. Or you can reduce their health to zero and end the match fast. Use your accumulated drinks list, various status effects, or brutal mixology to win. If there is a tie, don't worry; everything is scored during a match so the points will decide in the end.

In Top Shelf, you can only use special mixed drinks. Generic sludge drinks won't have any affect but will, however, count towards your end score. Learn new drinks on the fly or buy the Bartender's Book from the Shady Merchant to get the upper-hand. Utilize status effects to your advantage and slang one of 209 drinks to win. Beyond that, same rules apply as in normal mode: higher drunk score the better, reduce health to zero, or score decides the winner.

In The Sobering, you are trying to keep your wits about you and your drunk score to a minimum. Ideally zero, or at least lower than your opponent. Keep an eye on your liver though, if it hits zero then you start taking double the drunk points per drink. Just like the previous two modes, knocking out the health score can instantly win the match and the score breaks all ties.

The game has the following features best laid out in list format with snappy phrases like:

  • Face off against eight different characters in single-player mode

  • Various outfits, hair styles, and accessories

  • Soundtrack by Macabre Gandhi and David Totten

  • Personal and global statistics on debauchery

  • Our favorite half-time mini-game Midnight

  • Steamworks multiplayer with invites

  • A leaderboard system of true alcoholics

  • 55 item cards to mix, match, and drink

  • 215 mixed drink recipes

  • 30 temporary buffs to save your hide or sabotage you

  • Drink in various locations around Starkham

  • Bet against friends and foes to acquire coins

  • Upgrade and unlock gear at the Shady Merchant's shop

  • 40 achievements to obtain

  • Halloween, X-Mas, St. Patrick's Day, and Easter Event modes

The game features online and LAN cross-platform multiplayer for Linux, Mac, and Windows so you can drink your buddies under the table no matter what operating system they use. Steamworks is now integrated so you can invite folks to your lobby through Steam or just browse for an open game.

Can't find a game? Don't like multiplayer? Face off against eight different "special" bots or a series of randomly generated generic ones in single-player.

data.name: Mecha Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Cleanse worlds. Survive the swarm. Upgrade your mech.

Mecha Survivors is a Survivors-like action roguelite where you take control of an advanced combat mech sent to purge hostile planets overrun by alien machines.

Dropped into endless warzones, you must face overwhelming waves of enemies, collect powerful upgrades, and adapt your build in real time. Choose from multiple mech classes, each with unique abilities and playstyles, and fight for survival on a planetary scale.

Key Features

  • Planetary purge missions: Deploy into procedurally generated battlefields to cleanse entire regions of enemy forces.

  • Top-down mech combat: Pilot heavy war machines in fast-paced, bullet-dodging action against massive enemy swarms.

  • Dynamic roguelite progression: Combine randomized skills and passive upgrades to create devastating builds.

  • Multiple mech classes: Unlock and master unique mechs with specialized skills and ultimate abilities.

  • Stylized sci-fi visuals: Vibrant low-poly environments filled with chaos, explosions, and reactive effects.

  • Replayable survival challenges: Every run is different. How long can you hold the line?

Survive. Adapt. Cleanse.

data.name: Ashes of Holloway Bay
data.detailed_description:
CASE FILE HB-2023-041

STATUS: ACTIVE INVESTIGATION

On the night of April 15th, 2023, a deliberate fire tore through 17 Seacliff Road, Holloway Bay. Three lives lost. One survivor was pulled from the flames.

You have been granted full access to the Holloway Bay Police Department’s restricted evidence system.

Examine police reports, fire department logs, witness interviews, digital messages, post-mortem findings, and a partially recovered hard drive containing archived footage that may rewrite the entire case.

Navigate an interactive case file interface: open folders, zoom into photographs, listen to interview recordings, crack password-protected partitions, and cross-reference evidence in the comparison viewer.

Every piece of media is real evidence. Every decision builds your theory.

At the end, submit your official report naming the individual responsible. One correct conclusion closes the case. The wrong one leaves it open.

Ashes of Holloway Bay is a single-player narrative mystery built like a real investigation. No hand-holding. No timers. Just you, the files, and the truth hidden in the details.

  • Fully interactive evidence system with zoomable images, playable videos, audio transcripts, and a functional password-protected HDD

  • Multiple paths through the case, review evidence in any order

  • Final report system with official resolution

  • Atmospheric dark police UI with authentic case-file presentation

  • Rich original writing and real-feeling documentation

“Truth is in the details.”

From Cold Case Inc.

Every piece of media is real evidence. Every decision builds your theory.

At the end, submit your official report naming the individual responsible. One correct conclusion closes the case. The wrong one leaves it open.

Ashes of Holloway Bay is a single-player narrative mystery built like a real investigation. No hand-holding. No timers. Just you, the files, and the truth hidden in the details.

  • Fully interactive evidence system with zoomable images, playable videos, audio transcripts, and a functional password-protected HDD

  • Multiple paths through the case, review evidence in any order

  • Final report system with official resolution

  • Atmospheric dark police UI with authentic case-file presentation

  • Rich original writing and real-feeling documentation

“Truth is in the details.”

From Cold Case Inc.
data.short_description: Immerse yourself in a chilling, interactive cold-case investigation. Review crime scene photos, decrypt restricted hard drives, compare evidence, and deliver your final report in Ashes of Holloway Bay, a dark, atmospheric detective experience where every detail matters.

Ashes of Holloway Bay is a mature narrative mystery investigation game that deals with the realistic aftermath of a fatal house fire in which three people lost their lives.

The game contains references to death, smoke inhalation, and a deliberate arson incident. These themes are presented through official police reports, post-mortem documents, news footage, witness interviews, and digital evidence, all in a documentary-style case-file interface.

Players should be comfortable with themes of loss, tragedy, and criminal investigation. The game is intended for a mature audience interested in realistic detective storytelling.

data.name: Martial Art’s History
data.detailed_description:
Martial Art’s History is a 1v1 traditional side-scrolling kung fu fighter shaped by classic Hong Kong martial arts films. Set in early Republican Shanghai, it depicts rival warriors settling grudges and competing for glory on arena stages. Take control of fighters mastering exclusive traditional kung fu to duel friends or strangers.

[h2] Gameplay Intro [/h2]

School Martial Arts: Characters master authentic styles including Hung Gar, Wing Chun, Tai Chi and Drunken Fist. A full system of strikes, grabs, counters and parries delivers weighty, grounded combat based on vintage fight choreography.

Offense & Defense: Light jabs, heavy crushing blows and finishing moves form your toolkit. Matches rely on spacing, reading enemy openings and tactical parrying, with zero over-the-top fantasy effects for pure realistic melee feel.

Arena Stages: Explore period-accurate maps: martial arts halls, open street arenas and old city alleys, built to support hit-and-run and close-quarters brawling tactics.

Battle Modes: Play single-player story or local two-player versus. Combos, blocks and counters create a complete fighting loop accessible for beginners and deep enough for competitive combo players.

[h2] Playable Warriors [/h2]

Unlock 11 original fighters, drawing inspiration from the diverse cast of Republican-era masters seen in classic kung fu cinema.

The roster covers hardened veteran dojo masters and hidden street experts: graceful lounge performers, skilled schoolgirls and quick-witted street youths. Every fighter carries unique backstories and signature moves, with totally distinct fighting styles and personalities.

[h2] Local Versus [/h2]

Duel friends offline to perfect custom combos and fight for supremacy on retro Republican fighting stages.

data.name: Tuition
data.detailed_description:
This is an incomplete project that was released for "early access" before ceasing development:

Placed in an abandoned university plagued by undead, you need to be creative and resourceful to have a chance of surviving. Your goal is to escape the building, but the hordes of zombies have other plans.

Everything in the environment is intractable and can be used to increase your odds of survival. Starting out with just a knife, pistol, and flashlight, you'll have to find better means of survival to make it through the night.

key Features
  • Zombies surge with increasingly challenging waves
  • Place wooden boards in doorways to barricade zombies
  • Use ladders, chairs, and anything you find to discover new powerful tools for survival
  • Try to escape while you can - a church bell will ring when you can expect another wave of zombies
  • Always keep an eye out - zombies like to trickle in

Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD-2D is an HD-2D turn-based RPG inspired by the legendary era of the Three Kingdoms.

Lead famous heroes such as Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang through a land divided by war and ambition. Relive epic historical events, recruit powerful generals, and build an army capable of changing the fate of the realm.

Combining nostalgic pixel art with modern lighting and visual effects, the game delivers a classic RPG experience with a fresh HD-2D presentation.

Strategically command your party and troops in traditional RPG combat.

■ Epic Three Kingdoms Story
Experience a grand historical journey inspired by one of China's most celebrated eras.

■ Recruit Legendary Generals
Gather famous warriors and strategists, each with unique strengths and abilities.

■ Equipment and Strategy Systems
Customize your army through equipment, formations, and tactical decisions.

■ Beautiful HD-2D Visuals
Enjoy a blend of retro pixel art and modern lighting technology.

Forge your own legend in the age of heroes and war.

data.name: Sweetest Monster
data.detailed_description:
"I love you for who you are. I’ve loved you from the moment I met you."

Robin Hawkins is down on his luck. His relationship with his wife, Sally, is stagnating, and his daughter, Melody, no longer speaks to him.
Stuck in an unsatisfying and draining job, Robin's life is one long, monotonous slog...
Until he meets the mysterious girl of his dreams in the middle of the night, Bell.
However, there is far more to Bell than meets the eye - and Robin's 'dreams' are fast in danger of becoming 'nightmares'.

  • It contains fanservice, sexual content/nudity, and some psychological horror elements readers might find disturbing.
  • Features entirely custom art and OST.
  • Most importantly, contains a cute catgirl! ❤

data.name: CORDURA
data.detailed_description:
Co-Op Psychological Horror Evolves the ‘Friendslop’ Formula with Premium AA Quality & a Mimic System.

CORDURA is an online co-op psychological horror game where your own voice can betray you. Communicate using proximity voice chat, but beware: The Night learns how you speak and uses it to impersonate your teammates . As your sanity slips, navigate procedural maps, extract the Roses of the Night, and trust no one, before paranoia makes you doubt everyone around you.

Descend into the dark in up to 4-player co-op. Enter shifting mazes for what sounds like a simple job: mine the Roses and escape. But when The Night learns to impersonate your squad, staying together only makes it easier for the dark to deceive you. 

Playing solo or with a smaller team? The dynamic difficulty system automatically scales the procedural maps and the aggression of The Night. Whether you brave the depths alone or with friends, the atmosphere of relentless paranoia remains just as lethal.

"It's a simple job, for men with nerve"

Science once dared to blur the boundaries of the Night, and now the darkness has returned to reclaim its own. Victorian buildings awaken corrupted by a primal influence, twisting their halls into procedural labyrinths and reducing inhabitants to empty shells that now stalk from the shadows.

Yet, desire proves stronger than fear. Deep within these walls grows the Rose of the Night, the source of the Ambrosia. A potent neurostimulant coveted by the aristocracy for their decadent gatherings. You will take on the role of the workers who enter to extract this prize before you lose your sanity.

Few return alive, but greed always finds new volunteers.

  • 4-Player Co-op Horror: Venture into the dark together. Manage your risks, make every effort to remain unseen, and communicate to escape the labyrinth.  In these places, silence keeps you hidden—but only communication will get you out.

  • Mimic System & Verbal Deception: The Night hears you and calls you by name. Proximity voice chat becomes a double-edged sword: the darkness can mimic the voice and appearance of your allies to lure you into the abyss.

  • Sanity & The Companion Bond: As the night darkens, your sanity shatters. The only way to restore it is to physically reunite with a teammate. But a lingering doubt remains: has your ally truly arrived in time, or is the Night wearing their face to finish you off?

  • Permadeath & Character Customization: Recruit your workers and customize them exactly how you want—but watch your step. A single misstep means permanent death. Don't worry, though; a new recruit is always ready to take their place.

  • Evolving Procedural Labyrinths: Two incursions are never the same. The mansion reshapes its halls in real-time, forcing you to mark the walls to keep your bearings. Do not rely blindly on external guidance; creeping corruption can make familiar routes vanish in seconds.

data.name: Sea of Leaves
data.detailed_description:
A young girl disappears from her hometown
What was behind her vanishing?

This story is not about facts and events, but thoughts and feelings mostly. You will live an experience through the perspective of a consciousness which will capture a multitude of sensory observations, in order to reveal a complex mosaic of places, people, feelings and happenings, piece by piece.

Features


  • Interactive fiction heart - Inspired by Dear Esther, Gone Home and Firewatch, Sea of Leaves uses the traditional point-and-click gameplay combined with a poetic style, a branching story and an incredible setting.
  • Psychological narrative style - Sea of Leaves features a branching, non-linear, semi-randomized story that tells the inner turmoils of a troubled character. The narrative method is inspired by the stream of consciousness which simulates the human thoughts' flow, in order to aim for an emotional truth.
  • Unique setting - The game is set in southern Italy, an amazing place with a dark folklore. The story unfolds through 5 levels set in real locations, characterized by specific vegetation. The environments are filled with hidden stimuli which are going to help the player to unlock new story nodes.
  • A complex story - Sea of Leaves story is a mix of mystery and drama. The disappearance is the pivot of an entire community's life, which will emerge from time to time in the form of thoughts and memories.
  • Replayability - Inspired by ergodic literature, Sea of Leaves story is semi-randomized and doesn't follow a unique path. Each branch will have multiple possibilities: once you choose yours you can only go with the flow. Sea of Leaves is about the journey, not the ending. By replaying the game you will get unique details and sensations.

data.name: Milling Machine Simulator 2: Machine Shop
data.detailed_description:
FROM RAW STOCK TO FINISHED PART


Step into an industrial workshop where every cut shapes your creation.

Milling Machine Simulator 2: Machine Shop brings hands-on machining and CNC programming together in one factory. Secure your workpiece, choose your tools, set your cutting parameters, and watch material disappear as your part takes shape.

Operate the machines manually or let your G-code drive the process. From a simple facing operation to a complete machining sequence, you control how the job gets done.

FIVE MACHINES. ONE WORKSHOP.


Move between different machines and discover how each one approaches the work.

  • Manual Milling Machine — Take control of the handwheels, position your cutter, and machine your workpiece directly.
  • Manual Lathe — Work with rotating stock to turn diameters, face surfaces, and create profiles.
  • CNC Milling Machine — Write programs for milling, drilling, and repeatable tool movements.
  • CNC Lathe — Program turning operations with roughing, finishing, and threading cycles.
  • 5-Axis CNC Milling Machine — Explore multi-axis machining and approach your workpiece from different angles.

All five machines are included in the base game.

SET UP. CUT. REFINE.


Machining starts before the tool touches the material. Mount and secure your workpiece, fit the right tool, and choose your spindle speed and feed.

Real-time material removal lets you follow the result of each pass. Mill surfaces, cut pockets, drill holes, and turn profiles as you work toward your intended shape.

Experiment with your approach, inspect the result, and plan the next cut.

PROGRAM YOUR CNC MACHINES


Bring your machining ideas to life with Fanuc-style G-code.

Enter individual commands through MDI or write complete programs in the integrated editor. Preview your toolpaths before machining, adjust your code, and watch the machine execute your instructions.

Start with straightforward movements, then build more advanced programs using cycles, offsets, subprograms, and macros.

Motion and positioning
  • Rapid positioning and linear interpolation: G0 and G1.
  • Clockwise and counterclockwise arcs: G2 and G3.
  • Selectable machining planes: G17, G18, and G19.
  • Metric and imperial units, plus absolute and incremental positioning.

Setup and cutting control
  • Work coordinate systems G54–G59 and programmable offset setting.
  • Tool radius and tool length compensation.
  • Feed per minute and feed per revolution.
  • Constant surface speed, fixed spindle speed, and spindle speed limits.
  • Tool changes, spindle direction, and coolant commands.

Machining cycles
  • Drilling, peck drilling, tapping, and boring cycles.
  • Lathe finishing and roughing with G70, G71, and G72.
  • Thread cutting with G32 and multi-pass threading with G76.

Macro programming
  • Variables and mathematical expressions.
  • Trigonometric and other mathematical functions.
  • Conditional execution with IF, branching with GOTO, and WHILE loops.
  • Subprogram calls for reusable machining sequences.

Available operations depend on the selected machine.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY TO PLAY


Free Play
Take your time, try different techniques, and create your own parts. Explore the machines and experiment with manual operations or CNC programs at your own pace.

Career Mode
Work toward defined machining objectives and put your setup, programming, and cutting skills to the test.

EXPAND YOUR TOOLBOX WITH MODDING


Bring custom tools into your workshop with tool modding. Expand your tool collection and explore new machining possibilities with tools tailored to your projects.

data.about_the_game:
FROM RAW STOCK TO FINISHED PART


Step into an industrial workshop where every cut shapes your creation.

Milling Machine Simulator 2: Machine Shop brings hands-on machining and CNC programming together in one factory. Secure your workpiece, choose your tools, set your cutting parameters, and watch material disappear as your part takes shape.

Operate the machines manually or let your G-code drive the process. From a simple facing operation to a complete machining sequence, you control how the job gets done.

FIVE MACHINES. ONE WORKSHOP.


Move between different machines and discover how each one approaches the work.

  • Manual Milling Machine — Take control of the handwheels, position your cutter, and machine your workpiece directly.
  • Manual Lathe — Work with rotating stock to turn diameters, face surfaces, and create profiles.
  • CNC Milling Machine — Write programs for milling, drilling, and repeatable tool movements.
  • CNC Lathe — Program turning operations with roughing, finishing, and threading cycles.
  • 5-Axis CNC Milling Machine — Explore multi-axis machining and approach your workpiece from different angles.

All five machines are included in the base game.

SET UP. CUT. REFINE.


Machining starts before the tool touches the material. Mount and secure your workpiece, fit the right tool, and choose your spindle speed and feed.

Real-time material removal lets you follow the result of each pass. Mill surfaces, cut pockets, drill holes, and turn profiles as you work toward your intended shape.

Experiment with your approach, inspect the result, and plan the next cut.

PROGRAM YOUR CNC MACHINES


Bring your machining ideas to life with Fanuc-style G-code.

Enter individual commands through MDI or write complete programs in the integrated editor. Preview your toolpaths before machining, adjust your code, and watch the machine execute your instructions.

Start with straightforward movements, then build more advanced programs using cycles, offsets, subprograms, and macros.

Motion and positioning
  • Rapid positioning and linear interpolation: G0 and G1.
  • Clockwise and counterclockwise arcs: G2 and G3.
  • Selectable machining planes: G17, G18, and G19.
  • Metric and imperial units, plus absolute and incremental positioning.

Setup and cutting control
  • Work coordinate systems G54–G59 and programmable offset setting.
  • Tool radius and tool length compensation.
  • Feed per minute and feed per revolution.
  • Constant surface speed, fixed spindle speed, and spindle speed limits.
  • Tool changes, spindle direction, and coolant commands.

Machining cycles
  • Drilling, peck drilling, tapping, and boring cycles.
  • Lathe finishing and roughing with G70, G71, and G72.
  • Thread cutting with G32 and multi-pass threading with G76.

Macro programming
  • Variables and mathematical expressions.
  • Trigonometric and other mathematical functions.
  • Conditional execution with IF, branching with GOTO, and WHILE loops.
  • Subprogram calls for reusable machining sequences.

Available operations depend on the selected machine.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY TO PLAY


Free Play
Take your time, try different techniques, and create your own parts. Explore the machines and experiment with manual operations or CNC programs at your own pace.

Career Mode
Work toward defined machining objectives and put your setup, programming, and cutting skills to the test.

EXPAND YOUR TOOLBOX WITH MODDING


Bring custom tools into your workshop with tool modding. Expand your tool collection and explore new machining possibilities with tools tailored to your projects.

SAVE YOUR WORK. KEEP CREATING.


Save your workpieces and return to them later. Export your creations in OBJ or STL format to use your finished geometry beyond the workshop.

Whether you enjoy operating machinery, exploring CNC programming, or seeing a finished part emerge from raw stock, there is always another cut to make.

data.name: RUNNING WITH RIFLES 2
data.detailed_description:
RUNNING WITH RIFLES 2 is a top-down military shooter set in a fictional Eastern Bloc-inspired country seized by the ruthless Vanguard Army. As the occupation tightens its grip, multiple factions emerge in the region, each responding to the conflict in their own way.

Your journey begins as a survivor exploring an open world where scattered survivor communities struggle to endure. They scavenge for supplies, trade resources between their shelters, and build defenses to protect against raiding bandits.

As survivors grow in strength, they begin to fight back against the bandits taking down their camps and hideouts across the region.

Some survivors rise to become the Rebels, operating covertly in cities under the watchful eye of the Vanguard Army. Hidden in plain sight, the Rebels wage a shadow war through sabotage, ambushes, theft of intel, equipment and vehicles, and targeted eliminations of high-ranking officers.

Disguising as regular civilians get them close to restricted areas, but stealth becomes vital once inside the military zones. Use tall grass and foliage for cover, move crouched or prone to reduce noise and visibility, and rely on suppressed weapons or silent takedowns to stay undetected.

Liberator Army stands as the opposing force to the Vanguard Army. Large-scale battles erupt across strategic locations, with waves of infantry supported by armed vehicles, APCs, tanks, and helicopters in relentless clashes for control.

Choose from a wide arsenal of weapons, including assault rifles, shotguns, SMGs, sidearms, light machine guns, sniper rifles, rocket launchers, and hand, smoke, or incendiary grenades. Some battlefields also feature deployable heavy weapons such as mounted machine guns and mortars.

Completing objectives earns experience and promotions, unlocking squad leadership abilities. Recruit up to four squadmates and command them individually or as a unit.

Direct their positioning and field of view, and order them to equip or holster weapons, throw grenades, pick up items, and more. Your squad will follow your commands — but they’ll also react dynamically to the battlefield.

The full campaign can be played solo or cooperatively with friends. A dedicated PvE mode, adapted from the campaign, will also be available on servers offering an experience reminiscent of RWR1's Invasion mode.

  • RWR on launch started with 12 maps à 1km² while RWR2 comes with single world with 25 km² area with no loading screens in between.

  • The campaign has a much larger variety of objectives, and advancing further in the game isn't entirely about capturing zones.

  • Some buildings feature interiors now, and some walls are destructible for entrance, and most walls feature damage effects.

  • Actual health is in play now along with self-healing, allowing player to spend time more surviving and less respawning.

  • Rotating camera control.

  • High grass and foliage help staying unnoticed, there are light sources to stay away from at night time.

  • Bots and commanders have learned plenty of new tricks, e.g. chasing, driving in a convoy, retreating, looting and moving items to storages, and a whole lot of changes in combat to improve on tactics and variety. They handle new types of objectives and communicate their intent to player better. Bot navigation has been rebuilt to better fit the larger and more varied world.

  • Vehicle physics have been reworked, vehicle trunks exist, using one-hand weapons while driving is possible.

  • You can now build actual gapless sandbag wall lines, and bots do it too.

data.name: Mad King's Lair: Tome of Destruction
data.detailed_description:
In "Mad King's Lair: Tome of Destruction," players are plunged into a dark and immersive world brimming with puzzles, formidable enemies, and an ever-ticking clock counting down to the game's calamitous finale. This is a storyline driven by the urgency of a time loop, which sees the protagonist re-living the same three days in a desperate bid to prevent an impending disaster.


The heart of the gameplay revolves around the "Tome of Destruction," a magical artifact granting the ability to control time, amongst other mysterious powers. Players will need to utilize this tome to unravel secrets, defeat enemies, and solve intricate puzzles spread across a landscape tinged with an eerie yet captivating atmosphere.

As players delve deeper into the rich lore of the "Mad King's Lair," they will encounter a wide variety of characters, each carrying their burden and tale of sorrow, revealing a tapestry of stories that weave together to form a larger, tragically beautiful narrative. The game's protagonist must use wit and courage to navigate through a series of trials, retrieving lost artifacts and unlocking the true potential of the Tome to save the world from the mad king's ruinous plans.


The Artificer Wheel (A Manual Music Box made of Words), allows players to transform and utilize different abilities to overcome challenges and adversaries. Through mastering various spells and unlocking the secrets within the tome, players would have a toolset to approach puzzles and combat in a versatile and dynamic manner, encouraging experimentation and strategic thinking.


Much like its spiritual predecessors The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask and Dark Cloud, "Mad King's Lair: Tome of Destruction" maintains a dualistic theme of dread juxtaposed against hope, beckoning players to race against time in a world cloaked with impending doom yet illuminated by moments of heartwarming interactions and the potential for salvation.

This 3D Action Adventure Platformer features over 200 weapons, across 10 weapon types. Additionally, it has 12 Legend of Zelda Styled Tools which allow you to rewind time, change game mechanics, blow things up, animate objects, jump, fly, glide, swim, and interact with the world they way a game hasn't since the Legend of Zelda Twilight Princess.

As you play, you Collect Magic Words which unlock entries in the Artificer Grimoire or 'Grimm' for short. These words of power can be called upon at any point to Change the World, Teleport You, Change the Flow of Time, and alter the very Perception of the NPCs through the Sea of Steam.


This vivid, complex, and slightly macabre world provides an exhilarating setting for a journey of determination, sacrifice, and the relentless pursuit of hope in the face of adversity, which makes "Mad King's Lair: Tome of Destruction" a title that promises an engrossing experience rich with deep narrative and intricate gameplay mechanics.

In this Western Isekai Reincarnation Story, you, a forlorn soul awaiting reincarnation, are given a Part Time Job in the Mad King's Lair. However, in a blunder you accidentally awaken, and then lose the Tomes of Destruction, scattering them across the Sea of Steam. Together with a Motley cast of Characters, the Living Narration Tome 'Grimm', and the Mad King's Dour Butler, you have to find a way to save the world within the three allotted days. Fortunately, with the help of some Time Traveling Shenanigans, you just might be able to stop the books from falling into the wrong hands, or worse, stop yourself from getting fired.

Fully Voiced by a formally trained Cast, with some extra special Guest Stars for good measure, this 80+ hour story should keep you collecting, exploring, unlocking and laughing for quite a few hours to come!

data.name: Re:Touring
data.detailed_description:
Re:Touring is a first-person puzzle game in which you'll explore the abandoned Luoni Energy Competence Center and uncover the facility's history, navigating through a total of 26 varied levels. Using a retro-style computer, you'll create color patterns to control elements such as doors, platforms and lasers. Each mechanism is carefully introduced to make the game accessible to everyone.

Think outside the box


In addition to familiar puzzle elements, the centerpiece of the game is the retro computer that generates color patterns. While in the beginning you only create simple patterns to open a door for example, in the later game you automate many elements at the same time to make your way through the levels.

Lets go on an adventure


Explore the abandoned Luoni Energy Competence Center through environmental story telling between each of the puzzles and uncover the history of Luoni Energy and their motivations.

Accessibility


In addition to different color palettes for visual impairments and closed captions that describe audio, there is also a hint system that gives clues to the current puzzle or can solve it completely.

data.name: Loading Zone
data.detailed_description:
The Loading zone is a puzzle game, in which you will by tasked to load up 4 different cars with boxes of different shapes and sizes. As you progress trough 84 preselected randomly generated loads you will by presented with different types of boxes. Some of which have a special conditions of placement, such as "HEAVY" which can not by placed on top of other boxes, therefore you have to think about arrangement where all boxes marked as heavy must by placed on a floor of a car. data.name: 20b
data.detailed_description:
Description:

Unlike her parents, all Sookie’s ever wanted is to live a normal and quiet life. She isn’t interested in getting wrapped up in other people’s business and instead chooses to live life as a background character. As just another cog in the machine. Unseen and unheard.

Unfortunately for her, she’s plagued with bad luck.

Outside of getting into a whole host of colorful, cartoon-like accidents, Sookie’s poor luck manifests itself in scenarios that thrust her into the limelight, actively working against her goal of being on the sidelines of life.

So much so that upon arriving at her new and mysterious school, Sookie is offered an ultimatum by the Principal.

“Defeat the seven MISFITS or face expulsion”

What started out with Sookie wanting to live peacefully ends up devolving into utter pandemonium. Amongst the madness of this hour-long, globe-trotting visual novel, will our poor protagonist ever catch a break?

Features:

  • Free
  • Short, kinetic visual novel with a unique structure and blistering pace
  • From New York to Paris, to Cairo and Rome... Live a life as you travel across the world and battle your new classmates
  • Mingle with a cast of dozens! From the strange and zany to the cryptic and unknown as you try to get away from it all
  • Original soundtrack
  • ...and more!

data.name: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 5
data.detailed_description:
Truly outstanding adventure in Pinecreek Hills National Park

Spend a sensational summer vacation helping Rangers run Pinecreek Hills National Park. It’s Centennial year and the Park is bigger and better than ever.

Fly the Floatplane back from HQ, see the NEW Centennial Miniature Railroad, Award winning Bridge, cosy Craft Café, Eagle pass Chairlift etc.. Explore stunning Waterfalls, Enchanted Caves and other gorgeous outdoor locations. Enjoy beautiful scenery, have barbecues, even rescue an orphan bear cub. See the spectacular Blue Angels airplane display and parachutists dropping onto Ranger Field.

Play great Hogs & Puzzles, Spot 100’s of Animals, Birds, Fish and Wildlife. Protect the environment, get Souvenirs and Awards along the way.

Enjoy this outstanding collection of Hidden Object Scenes and puzzles set in an idyllic national park. As well as finding Hidden Objects around the park you will need to perform your duties as a Park Ranger. Protect the environment by collecting all the bonus trash items to recycle and catalogue all the wildlife throughout the park in your Wildlife Journal.

data.name: Deadbeat Heroes
data.detailed_description:
London’s Super Heroes have been vanquished. Only the Deadbeat Heroes can put an end to dastardly evil-doers and their rotten plans!

Deadbeat Heroes is a movement based 3D brawler where you (and a friend) dodge bullets, steal super powers and crack wise. You play as the new wave of ‘Deadbeat Heroes’. Not born with their own powers, they are armed with a prototype super gauntlet - which has the ability to 'borrow' the powers of others. You will (both) vie to win the hearts of the public with your amazing daring do, while not getting shot, sliced, lasered, exploded, vaporized, eaten...

KEY FEATURES:
  • Power Fists Forever – Choose from one of 10 explosive abilities including a rocket powered punch, freeze ray and invisibility
  • London’s Streets – Over 35 levels set across London
  • Extreme Traversal – Wall Run & Air Dash through London
  • Alone or with a Friend - 1 to 2 player local campaign co-op
  • Twitch Streaming – Chat appears in the news ticker, chatters become baddies and are featured in end of level credits
  • Groovy Baby - A groovy cell shaded aesthetic bringing 70’s style to the 21st century
  • Bringing the Bass - A funky original soundtrack created by Pitstop Productions
  • Dulcet Tones - Featuring the vocal talents Jim Howick and more

Do you have what it takes to save London’s streets?

data.name: AutoBlobber
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to AutoBlobber, where your strategic skills will be put to the ultimate test!

In AutoBlobber, strategy is everything. You won’t control movement or combat. Instead, you’ll guide your Blob through wave after wave of enemies by choosing and placing upgrades between each round. Build powerful synergies, unlock enchantments, and evolve your Blob into an unstoppable force — then sit back and watch the chaos unfold.

Survive as long as you can and rise on the global leaderboard.

Equip Upgrades Between Waves


Unique upgrades with different abilities and target modes

Battle


Battle countless enemies with increasing difficulty per wave.

Combine Upgrades Into Stronger Versions

Evolve your simple Upgrades into stronger versions of themselves, with 3 different tiers of each upgrade variant.

Boss Fights!

See how your Blob can handle Bosses!

Improve Existing Upgrades With Improvement Upgrades

Improve all upgrades of one variant with "improvement-upgrades" that enhance the stats of all currently equipped upgrades.

Increase Your "Blob-Army" And See How Many Waves You Can Survive

Continue to play, grow, battle, and purchase new upgrades, and see how many waves you can last. 

A Global Leaderboard will display who the best AutoBlobber is. 

Will you be the best?

data.name: Out of Oblivion
data.detailed_description:
Out of Oblivion is a first person survival horror game. Explore a complex where you will face a mysterious threat and more. Can you find a way out?

Game features:

  • Oppressive atmosphere, totally addictive to the player
  • There are elements of nonlinearity
  • Solution on the surface. Mindfulness is your strength
  • Punching compositions that set the tone for the story
  • The game is made on the modern engine "Unreal Engine 4"

Out of Oblivion is a first person survival horror game. The game takes place in the scientific complex "CERERA". The main character is a captain of a special forces unit named Matthew, who will have to face unknown monsters. The task is one - to survive.
You are limited in resources, so spend each cartridge wisely, otherwise you will face an unenviable fate. The duration of the game depends on your attentiveness. A small oversight can cause your death. Find out what happened to the inhabitants of the complex by reading the notes. You may not be the only one to see, but don't expect help from nowhere.

NOTE:

  • The game was made by one person, with a small budget and will be improved on the basis of your feedback

data.name: Bit
data.detailed_description:
In Bit, you play as Bit. A little pixel alone in the void.

Bit has the urge to climb. Why does he want to climb? Find out with him across 10 unique worlds and help him find his purpose.

You will fight bosses, gain unique abilities and ascend through hand-crafted challenges that test your skill and resolve. Each world introduces new mechanics from dashing through galaxies to platforming across shifting terrain.

Features:

  • 10 Unique Worlds Each with its own theme, music, mechanics, and a boss standing between you and the truth

  • Skill-Based Platforming Tight, responsive controls with a move set that grows as you climb. Master each ability or fall trying

  • Epic Boss Battles Face towering guardians like Arbiter the Ancient, each with distinct attack patterns and phases

  • Earned Progression No upgrades to buy. No shortcuts. Every checkpoint is proof you earned your place

Steam Deck support right from the start!

data.name: Audio Factory
data.detailed_description:
Audio Factory is a VR experience (Daydream port) showcasing spatial audio capabilities of the Resonance Audio SDK by Google. Work your way through each factory floor to experience evocative sound design, compelling visuals, and fun interactive tasks. Experience how spatial audio contributes to the VR immersion. This is a Daydream port and visualizes the Daydream controller by mapping controls to the Vive and Oculus Touch controllers. Note: Wired headphones required (Bluetooth headphones not supported due to their increased latency). Vive controller or Oculus Touch controller required.

For more information on how you can add spatial audio to your VR experiences using the Resonance Audio SDK, please see our website link further down on this page.

Follow Jane Westlake on her quest to discover the secret of a mysterious train and stop it from leaving with its cargo.
Explore mysterious locations where you have to use your action skills to defeat enemies, solve puzzles and figure out clever ways to conquer objectives.
Your adventure takes place in a mountain forest around and old viaduct. There is a military operation looking to load and unknown cargo discovered deep in the forest, onto the train that rests on the viaduct above you. Defeat the soldiers and explore the environment to locate weapons and items needed to advance your mission.

The game takes place in one level, without sacrificing the quality and complexity of the game or requiring you to spend more than a night to complete it.

  • Death-defying environments - you have to find your way up an old and huge abandoned railway viaduct. A dangerous and very tall course awaits you.
  • Use Jane's athletic ability to navigate the environment.
  • Use action skills to defeat your enemies. Find weapons, ammo and explosives to aid your fight.
  • Use your intelligence to solve puzzles in order to advance.

### THE SEQUEL ###

Your favorite all-in-one VR FPS is back - and it’s better in every way!

Expect intense, cinematic firefights, airstrikes, a massive arsenal to unlock, improved weapon handling, full campaign (solo or co-op), and head-to-head PvP.

The story picks up right where the first game left off - only louder, faster, and more explosive.

### COMMUNITY ###

Want behind-the-scenes stuff, sneak peeks, and some chaotic dev energy?
Hop into our Discord, we’re in there when we aren't working on the release build - which is rare. Come join our community anyway!

Collection Quest is a simple story/lore-driven collectathon.
With an emphasis on Free Roam Exploration.
It was Inspired by Retro + Flash games.

Prepare for an Old-School adventure with modern twist!
Engage with its denizens and leave no stone unturned.

Complete quest, solve puzzles and get lost in a strange new world!

Remember to Interact with Everything!

Adventure Awaits!

  • Casual-friendly accessible gameplay with puzzles and story elements that still respect the player
  • Engaging and intractable world populated with unique characters

  • 100 Achievements to Collect!
  • Rich VO dialog
  • Controller support
  • Local and Remote-Play Split-Screen CO-OP
  • Retro style graphics with a flavorful bit of modern touches, hmm, Delicious
  • Attention to detail around every corner 🎱

data.name: God Faction
data.detailed_description:
Long ago, the gods of Axia walked the land and led their peoples into the Game of War. The gods are gone now, but their champions live on. Every warrior, beast and relic of that war is preserved as a memory in divine crystal, and that memory is a card.

This is the Age of Cards. The game of God Faction settles disputes, honours the fallen and proves devotion to the gods. Leave your hometown with a starter deck, travel to towns, cities and sacred shrines, and become the greatest Card Fighter of your generation.

The Card Game of the Gods

God Faction is more than a game. It is a living memory of the Game of War. Every god commands a faction of cards drawn from the armies, heroes, creatures and relics of that war: Eldric's time-bending End Strikers, Devora's gravity mages, the black-plate knights of Aragus and many more. Build a deck around the god you follow and outplay your rivals in battles that echo a forgotten age.

Explore Axia

Axia is yours to explore at your own pace. Visit the shrines of the gods, learn the stories and cultures of every region, and cross the land on foot or in the saddle. Card masters wait on the road, and each one guards a rare card for the Card Fighter who can beat them.

Life on the Road

Cast a line at hidden fishing spots and test your luck and bait for rare catches. Forage the wilds, pitch camp under the stars and keep yourself fed.

Cook what you catch and gather over the campfire. Every dish is a small reward of its own.

Puzzles and Treasure

Ancient puzzles guard chests across Axia. Solve them, follow the Starfalls to the treasure they leave behind, and uncover legendary cards in places most travellers never look.

Collect, Build, Conquer

Defeat the champion at each god's shrine to earn a Champion's Medal. Collect them all and take your place at the Supreme Tournament, where the greatest Card Fighters of Axia meet. Build the perfect deck, master your strategy and rise to the top.

Key Features

  • An open world to explore across regions shaped by the gods, each with its own lore and culture

  • A deep card-battle system built on god factions and the legendary armies of the Game of War

  • Hundreds of cards to win from champions or discover in hidden places

  • Complete freedom to build and refine your deck

  • Fishing, cooking, foraging, camping, puzzles and treasure hunting

  • Mounts to ride across the world your way

  • One goal at the end of the road: the Supreme Tournament

Not every legend is written in battle. Some are written by accident.

data.detailed_description:
Visual Novel, ADV, fantasy.

Time moves very slowly for Neoth — he's always in the spotlight and is forced to participate in all the royal festivities, which bring him no joy. In what little free time he has outside the castle walls, Neoth enjoys secluded walks in a nearby forest. During one of such strolls, he meets an unusually cheerful girl, who seems a total stranger in these parts... And she certainly needs his help.

Features:
• colorful illustrations;
• partially animated backgrounds;
• original soundtrack;
• two endings.

data.name: Bee Aware! 2.0
data.detailed_description:
Bee Aware!, an active clicker game for ages 14 to 122!

Help the bees get rid of all the bad, bad industrialists on every continent with the use of bags of biological pest control. Earn these bags by playing eight minigames. Games that will surely fit the needs of every casual gamer! As a bonus, there are three 'hidden' mini-minigames! See if you can find them!

Bee Aware! Not just another Bee Game!

*** PERMANENT PRICE DROP! 50% OFF! ***

Features:

Fun and relaxing gameplay for the casual gamer (perfect for a rainy day).
Beautiful ambient music (per game) by Polish composer Jacek Dojwa and a host of other composers. There's a total of 20 different songs in the game!
Beautiful images (well, some).
Some fun & cool sound effects.
80 achievements (11 hidden), ranging from easy to a bit more challenging.

Featured Games & Extra's:

  • Bee Aware!
    A simple clicker game with some fun animations, as well as the main hub for the minigames. This is where you spend your earned bags of biological pest control.
  • Bee vs Mites!
    This is a one level, endless (well, untill you get killed) arcade game where you have to pick up flowers and avoid varroa mites, though you can (occasionally) fight them with powerups. Billy Joe Henry Bob is hindering your progress with an axe, a super soaker, a leaf blower, a pesticide sprayer and his own bad breath. And... you will have to face the notorious Mega Mite! See if you can beat her! You can choose from three difficulty levels.
  • Bee Smart!
    Five original quizzes, with twenty questions each. The subjects are Bees!, Bees Revisited!, Mother Earth, The Universe and a silly quiz about the game and the game characters.
  • Bee Remembered!
    A simple and relaxing memory game, with three difficulty levels.
  • Bee Amazed!
    Save the eggs, and avoid the wasps, hive beetles, varroa mites and the angry ghost, hidden in the maze of the hive. You can choose from three difficulty levels. The game is always the same on the outside, but never on the inside!
  • Bee Puzzled!
    Relax a bit with soothing music and the 56 beautiful images in this jigsaw game. There are three difficulty levels to choose from.
  • Bee't the Bear!
    Try to outsmart the bear and warn your hive before the furry creature gets there. Watch out for the hornet scout though! One difficulty level, three stages, and fresh boards for each new game.
  • Bee Fast!
    Farmer Billy Joe Henry Bob scattered pieces of your hive (and honey!) all over his land. See if you can retrieve all pieces of honey within the given time, while the halfwit farmer tries to shoot and suffocate you, firing a shotgun, throwing explosives and steering an rc-plane loaded with pesticide. Play through three stages in this arcade game, on three difficulty levels.
  • Bee Brave!
    *dark and echoing voice* Dare you enter a dark and perilous world, just to help an obsessed bee get his prized golden honey jar? Dare you enter the Warped Wasteland, the Ferocious Forest, the Vile Village and the Gruesome Grotto? Well, you should have your head examined! No one in his (or her) right mind would go there for such a futile reason! Then again, you'll miss out on a great adventure! You wouldn't want that, would you now? So, buckle up, sharpen your wits and go help this bee in this classic text adventure!
  • Bee Helped!
    The help section, with detailed information on each game. Probably not necessary, since BB tells you (more or less) what you need to know when you start a game for the first time, but hey, you never know.
  • Last, but not least... BB!
    See what silly bee BB (What?!? [nothing, BB...] Ow... ok) has to say. Just for the record, I'm not responsible for, nor do I endorse his silly comments (Hey, I do provide the backstory as well! [True, BB, true… but the rest is silly] Hmpf!).
  • And... there are three 'hidden' mini-minigames, but you will have to find them yourself.

The game runs in fullscreen mode, with an optional slideshow in the back.

Be aware (ha ha): Bee Aware! does not run well with onboard graphics chips, however, you could try with an integrated Intel HD Iris (GT2) chip or similar/higher.

data.name: Death Machine
data.detailed_description:
Rejecting the dogmatic vision of the machine and its endless production, you are cast down into darkness. But in the darkness, a bargain is struck with a foe of old. Ascend the machine citadel with eyes open, and bring a reckoning upon those who ruined the world before it was all iron, blood, and bones.

Explore the machine citadel, find secret paths to hidden chambers, and establish a foothold in the belly of the machine. Return to a Sanctuary with your plundered skulls to discover new and unusual items. Or instead, set your sights on conquest, assemble a clutch of potent items, and risk it all against the monstrous denizens that lurk in the dark corners of the citadel. But beware, your mayhem in defiance of the machine will not go unnoticed - enemies assembled to defeat you will grow in potency and number the longer you wreak havoc.

Death Machine mixes the wonder of classic metroidvania exploration, with exciting combat powered by a versatile roguelite item system. Each run, you can choose to focus on exploration - discovering new items and powers, hoarding skulls taken from your enemies, and making it back to take to a Sanctuary to cash in your loot with your patron.

Use the spoils of your exploration to concoct mighty builds, letting you go toe to toe with the most dangerous residents of the citadel. Careful consideration when crafting your build will help you unlock certain pathways not accessible otherwise. Diverse builds will also let you wield potent hybrid items, bridging the mechanics of two elements together.

data.name: Cross The World
data.detailed_description:
Explore, gather, craft, fight, and survive the fantasy world with persistent world simulation as an adventurer party. Every part of the world is persistently simulated, environment interacts and changes over time with season and progress. Play alone or play together with your friends up to 4 in multiplayer!

"I guess it's another open-world survival craft RPG, how is it different this time?"

Ever thought of an open-world game where stuff in the background never disappears into thin air, or map chunks don’t freeze with everything in them—NPCs, trees, animals, etc.—until the player walks nearby?

How about an open world where nature and the environment constantly progress with the flow of time into the future, with weather, temperature, and seasons shaping the world as they go, and whatever changes you or the world have made are persistent throughout the entirety of the game world?

For example, the fruits you harvested from a tree would rot and eventually disappear even after you’ve moved away from the area, and the trees would change shape with the seasons and bear fruit again the following year.

Cross The World started as a very ambitious project, an answer to that itch I’ve always felt as a gamer who wanted a game just like that.

How does the game play?

  • The game world isn't procedurally generated. It is 6006x4026(24,180,156 tiles) sized world including ocean chunks on a ground level (z level 0), including 30 underground z levels, that'd be 400+ million persistent tile world.

  • Game offers 3 Game Modes, normal(The Ascended), difficult(Mad Lich), peaceful(Exiled Mother)

  • It's a party-based Roguelike RPG, you can control up to 4 characters or more in your party.

  • There's RPG Mode Available if you are more comfortable playing with 1 character with WASD to move.

  • You can choose between 28 classes and 5 races, while some classes can be similar to each other.

  • Game provides more traditional RPG elements of character progression with levels, exp from combat and quest, active and passive skills, equipment enchantments as well as the well-known open-world survival crafting genre's UI and experience like chopping tree, grass, breaking rock, crafting tools, cooking meals, etc.

  • Environment features such as temperature, weather, wet/dry/frozen, day and night, darkness and lighting, fog of war, permadeath, and 4 seasonal changes affecting the gameplay.

  • In multiplayer, you can host the game so your friends can control the characters together.

  • Everything in the game world runs persistently, nothing truly freezes and stops progression just because the player is away. Whatever progress or change you inflicted upon the game world will not just stay, but progress over time as well.

  • This also means there is no loading once you are in the game, switching between two characters, even if they are 500 or 1000 chunks away, is instantaneous. 

What future updates are planned?

  • Enhanced NPC behaviors: Animals, monsters, humanoid NPCs participate in routines that more actively reshape and influence their surroundings.

  • More Season/Biome-related content such as seasonal plants, animals, fish, etc.

  • This Includes large-scale simulations like animals crossing the continent by change of season, monsters raiding nearby town, mobs reproducing and taking combat each other.

  • Calendar-based events like Fishing Tournament or Harvest Festival thrown and carried out by NPC AI.

  • Controller, Steamdeck support.

  • Powerful and polished level-editor as good as a game engine would.

For more details on the game, please join our official discord via the link provided in this store page.

data.name: Hell of a Lie
data.detailed_description:
Hell of a Lie is a point-and-click adventure with detective and psychological elements where you play as a demon intern working in Hell’s bureaucracy.

Your job is to make deals for human souls. But nothing is ever simple — every person has their own fears, dreams, and weaknesses that must be uncovered first.

To close a deal, you must investigate people's lives and understand what they truly desire: love, power, success, money, revenge, or something else.

Investigate Human Stories

The gameplay focuses on investigating the lives of different people.

You will explore locations connected to each character, such as:

  • apartments

  • offices

  • streets

  • personal belongings

  • photographs

  • letters and messages

In these places you must search for hidden objects, clues, and evidence that reveal a person’s personality and hidden desires.

You may discover:

  • letters

  • photographs

  • diary entries

  • scattered objects

  • strange symbols

  • memories from the past

Every clue helps you better understand the character.

Puzzle and Deduction

Each discovered object becomes part of a larger puzzle that helps reveal what truly motivates the person.

Players must analyze information and connect clues together.

For example, finding unpaid bills, a photo of a former partner, and a diploma from an abandoned career may reveal that the character fears failure and loneliness.

Understanding these motivations is the key to making a successful deal.

Deals for Souls

After gathering enough information, you confront the person and offer them a deal.

Your offer must reflect their deepest desires and fears.

Each deal becomes a moral decision:

  • exploit their weakness

  • manipulate their dreams

  • refuse the deal

  • choose an unexpected outcome

Your choices determine the fate of the character.

Game Features

  • atmospheric point-and-click adventure

  • hidden object investigation gameplay

  • psychological analysis of characters

  • branching decisions and different outcomes

  • dark humor and supernatural themes

  • stories about human desires and their consequences

data.name: MioAquaria
data.detailed_description:
Mio Aquaria is a cozy sandbox aquarium management game set in a whimsical world of water.
Build your aquarium from nothing, care for fantasy aquatic creatures from across the world, and lead a team of cat staff as you rise through the ranks to become the world’s greatest aquarium.

Core Challenge

Design freely, explore the depths, and solve the core challenge of Mio Aquaria:
balancing the needs of aquatic creatures and cats to create a thriving, attractive aquarium.

🐠 Build and Customize Your Aquarium

Create your aquarium your way using sandbox-style construction.
Build spaces, place facilities, and design tanks that balance water quality, temperature, and creature compatibility.

Hosting a diverse mix of aquatic creatures increases your aquarium’s attractiveness — but only if their needs are met.

🌊 Discover Fantasy Aquatic Creatures

Explore the world to discover new resources, materials, and new inhabitants for your tanks.
The creatures of Mio Aquaria are inspired by real aquatic life, but reimagined as fantasy beings with unique traits and requirements.

Some aquatic creatures can only be unlocked through exploration or research.

🐱 Manage Cats, Not Just Buildings

Your aquarium is run entirely by cats — staff and visitors alike.

  • Staff cats need fair pay and comfortable working conditions

  • Visitor cats come to see their favorite creatures, but also expect food, drinks, rest, leisure, and shopping

  • Ignore their needs, and strikes or reputation loss may follow

Keeping cats happy is just as important as keeping aquatic creatures healthy.

🔬 Research, Progress, and Optimize

Research new policies and perks to improve your aquarium’s efficiency and appeal.

  • Unlock new aquatic creatures and gameplay mechanics

  • Increase visitor capacity, tips, and inventory space

  • Improve staff effectiveness and aquarium operations

Multiple resources shape your strategy, including Coins, Materials, Research Points, and Hearts earned by satisfying visitors.

🏆 Compete for Reputation

Take part in regular aquarium contests and compete against rival aquariums.
Earn reputation, climb the global rankings, and challenge the industry giant Star V. Co.

To truly complete your journey, you’ll need to discover and host a legendary creature — the ultimate test of your aquarium mastery.

🌦 A Living World

Weather conditions such as cloudy or rainy days affect atmosphere, visitors, and aquarium operations, introducing unique challenges that require thoughtful planning and adaptation.

data.name: Lofelia's Cozy Corner
data.detailed_description:
Help Lofelia fulfill her dream of being a writer! Lofelia’s Cozy Corner is a cozy clicker game that you can enjoy while working, studying or playing other games. The game sits in the corner of your screen, making Lofelia a relaxing desktop companion for your everyday tasks.

A cozy incremental clicker game

Every time you press a mouse button or key on your keyboard, Lofelia will write a few words for her next book. Once finished you can publish books and place them on your bookshelf. Based on her books, Lofelia gets increasingly more productive, allowing her to write longer stories.

Decorate your bookshelf

Customize your growing bookshelf with differently colored books, plants and decorations. You can shift around the objects on the shelf to create your own beautiful desktop library.

The power of books

When Lofelia finishes a book she does not only gain Quills, but the books themselves also have hidden powers: Each book that is placed in the bookshelf increases Lofelia’s attributes and thus, her writing skills.

Decorations provide powerful boosts based on the books surrounding them. You can find powerful combinations greatly affecting the speed and quality of Lofelia’s writing skills.

Unlock beautiful covers

Books come in various qualities, colors and covers. Unlock and collect different parts like icons and patterns based on a book's type and quality.

Customize books as you like making each book truly yours.

A cozy companion, but not a distraction

As Lofelia’s Cozy Corner is designed to be played while doing other tasks or playing other games, we made it easy to switch the corner or scale the game according to your needs!

Decorations provide powerful boosts based on the books surrounding them. You can find powerful combinations greatly affecting the speed and quality of Lofelia’s writing skills.

Unlock beautiful covers

Books come in various qualities, colors and covers. Unlock and collect different parts like icons and patterns based on a book's type and quality.

Customize books as you like making each book truly yours.

A cozy companion, but not a distraction

As Lofelia’s Cozy Corner is designed to be played while doing other tasks or playing other games, we made it easy to switch the corner or scale the game according to your needs!
data.short_description: Meet Lofelia, your dreamy desktop companion who writes books as you work, study or game. In this cozy clicker game, every time you press a key Lofelia continues to write her stories. How will you decorate Lofelia's Cozy Corner?

data.name: 纵横麻将 Matrix Mahjong
data.detailed_description:
*The following text was NOT written by AI. The parallel phrasing of the headings is simply a personal preference.

Mahjong, Intersected

The same pairs, chows, and pungs you know from Mahjong—but on a 3×7 grid, they can be formed both across and down.

A tile placed at an intersection becomes part of two patterns at once

Winning Hand (Hu), Redefined

Forget “four melds and a pair.” As long as every tile in your hand forms part of a valid meld, you win.

Newcomers only need to learn three basic melds to understand the game.

Experienced Mahjong players, meanwhile, will discover an entirely new way to think about waits and ready hands.

Faans, Reimagined

With winning redefined, the Faans you know have gained entirely new possibilities.

For example, 【All Honors】 no longer has to consist of four pungs and a pair.

【Four Identical Chows】? Come try 【Six Identical Chows】!

Small Wins, Long Runs

Wait for a monster hand every game? Here, you may not have the time. Your available turns are tied to your HP.

Rather than going big every round, a quick win with a small Faan—and knowing when to stop—can sometimes take you much farther.

A Bit Of Roguelike, But More Of Mahjong

Freely edit the tile deck, force a specific build, and chase exponential scoring? None of that is the point of this game.

Every round asks you to weigh your options on the spot and judge which tiles may still come. Items can help, but you must still find the answer within your opening hand.

Adapt to the situation and play with the flow. Isn’t that the essence of Mahjong?

【Pixels, Chinese Flair】

Handcrafted pixel and voxel Mahjong tiles. Hover over them, pick them up, and place them down —every action comes with smooth, responsive feedback.

Your items range from everyday folk objects to mythical treasures. Your opponents are legendary figures and a whole host of deities. Behind every effect, there may be a meaning waiting to be discovered.

Immerse yourself in the pleasure of crafting Mahjong hands, presented in a bright and clean art style.

data.name: La Porte des Fauconniers : Guerre Médiévale
data.detailed_description:
Short Presentation


Falconers’ Gate (FG) is a medieval action RPG, with a strong tactical component.

FG is an uchronia; its scenario is a rewrite of History, as it might have been with a few alterations of the past.

The game is set in a fictional version of 11st century medieval Normandy.

Key Elements:

  • Discover Medieval Normandy
  • Recruit and lead your own army in epic multiplayer battle
  • Customize your hero and your troops from levy to elite mailed troops
  • Enjoy a slow paced gameplay focused on tactic and manoeuver.

Detailed Presentation


October 14th, 1066: A Uchronia in the Skies

William the Conqueror is preparing to fight the Anglo-Saxons at the famous battle of Hastings. If he wins, a substantial part of England will be his to take.

On the other side of the Channel, in the heart of his duchy of Normandy, a comet streaks the night sky shortly before crashing down on the village of L’Aigle.

The fall of this celestial body on St. Martin’s Church is about to trigger a series of events that will upset the course of history as we know it, and unleash a terrible power struggle for the control of “Falconers Gate.”

You, the Comet’s Chosen One, are a Falconer at the head of your company, caught in the throes of a war that will lay waste to the region.

Will you be on the side of History or on the side of Change?

History Vs. Fantasy

Fantasy will be introduced progressively and will not be all over the game, much like in the universe of Game of Thrones. In particular, fantasy will be used as a means to integrate and rationalize the existence of certain comfort tools for gamers, such as Strategic View and even TPV (Third-Person View).

Combat Mechanics


Directional Fencing

FG uses a directional combo based combat system for the player. When you attack in a direction, its launch a side attack and 3 of its variation. At any time, you can change the side of your attack.

An armor worthy of the name

The pieces of armor used in FG will not only reduce the injuries you may suffer; if they are thick enough they will completely block the enemy strikes.

The game also features a damage system based on different kinds of strikes : slashing, blunt-force, and piercing, all with different properties depending on the three types of materials used for your protection: Fabric, Quilted, Mesh / Plates.

Health/Conscience/Stamina System

FG features a health system that seeks to reproduce the complexity of wearing armor on a battlefield during prolonged periods of combat, without excessively interfering with the game mechanics.

Each body part has its own hitbox and its own health points. Losing an arm will cost you the use of the corresponding equipment. However, as long as your chest and head are intact, you can always take flight or continue fighting with what you are carrying in your other hand. That is, if you still have your legs!

Your Army


Epic Battles

From the Forest of Écouves to the plains of the Pays d’Auge, you will do battle against your enemies in realistic environments!

FG will immerse you in battles involving hundreds of warriors in 1vs1 to 5vs5 battle, with each player leading 40 to 100 men at the same time.

Units

Each group of combatants uses its own particular set of military formations.

The game features a huge variety of units : spearmen, pikemen, swordmen, axeman, javelinmen, all coming with their particular ability and formation.
Spearmen can form a specific shield wall when swordsmen can gather around you and follow you in the middle of battle.
Archers and Javelinemen use a realistic ballistic with arrows hitting each other on their way to your ennemy and break on heavy armor.

Army Customization

As soon as you recruit a combat unit, it will start to grow and evolve over the course of time (and depending on the various encounters they follow you in). Units will vary in kind, depending on whether you are recruiting in a town or village (rural or urban militia) or on whether you are directly hiring mercenaries.

You may recruit up to 3 groups of 20 to 47 combatants, in order to form your 60 to 100-man company according to the style of gameplay that suits you best. You are free to staff your company homogeneously with soldiers specializing in a certain kind of weapon, or to form a versatile combat group skilled in fighting with different kinds of weapons.

An Endless Range of Possibilities

Each of your 3 combat squads will have its own combination of skills and experience. The skill tree may feature linear branches affording huge bonuses but require that you stick to a precise path, or may allow you to choose between different nodes whose effects can vary in interest but offer a broader range of choices.

You will thus benefit from a significant number of possibilities that can transform your unorganized and unruly peasants into robust soldiers, trained in a variety of devastating combat techniques.

From Footmen to Knights

FG’s combat units will be organized into Infantry and Cavalry:

  • The Cavalry will focus mainly on its ability to launch irresistible charges whilst carefully avoiding a wall of lances anchored in the ground.
  • The Infantry will occupy the field through sheer mass, the use of formations, and methodical progression.

Archers will work differently from classical units. Once unlocked and recruited, they will accompany you in battle as a support unit. You will decide when they should shoot their arrows “outside of the map” or when to order them to pick a fixed position where they can stick their arrows in the ground in order to shoot faster.

Shields Up!

The skills that you will be able to choose for your combat units will range from passive abilities (bonus health, increased stamina…) and active skills that you can use during battle.

For instance, being able to charge the enemy (slow or at full speed) is one of the most common abilities in FG.

But many other ability exist in the game with different effect and utility.

Other Features


An innovative tactical interface

Your character’s skills will be mainly practical. Falconers are no super-heroes; even though you will be definitely stronger than the average soldier, it will be impossible for you to take on an army on your own.

Falconer’s View will be your main practical skill. It will grant you a tactical view of the battlefield in an instant, allowing you to optimize your troops’ position in just a few clicks.

You will be granted a large choice of skills, ranging from a simple area buff or debuff to special strikes combos.

Much like your units, your skill tree (of which your Sergeants have a similar variant) will lead you to make decisive choices: specialize in one skill or unlock several of them, improve a wide range of characteristics or excel in one type of buff…

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We are looking forward to take you with us through Falconers’ Gate!
