data.name: Boulder Dash Deluxe
data.detailed_description:
Boulder Dash® Deluxe

THE retro game and legendary action puzzler for players young and more experienced alike arrived, combining up-to date-graphics with original game features – spanning 35+ years of Rockford™ and his friends, digging though caves to collect gems - Boulder Dash® Deluxe!
Created by two Canadian programmers in 1984, Boulder Dash has become one of the longest running videogame franchises! The original Boulder Dash® is a pioneering interactive game dating back to the early times of the home computer and video game era. Its many sequels have delighted and challenged casual and hard-core players of all ages and sexes for over nearly four decades.

Boulder Dash® Deluxe takes you, together with the game character called Rockford™ into a myriad of new and exciting challenges. Dig through spectacular caves with 3D elements; avoid falling boulders; collect valuable gems and avoid nefarious enemies along the way. Discover treasure chests with rare collectibles and strong power-ups. Boulder Dash Deluxe includes 180 new exciting and unique levels. Plus, dig through 9 brand new worlds with high-end graphics and their own textures, dive into the Classic 1984 World with its caves or enjoy The Liepa World; a set consisting of 20 of the most mind-bending levels designed by the creator of the original 1984 Boulder Dash version and video game legend Peter Liepa. And, if that’s not enough, you will be challenged by 15 new special opponents ranging from Octopus to Snow Tiger. Boulder Dash® Deluxe truly is the pinnacle in 35+ years of Boulder Dash®!

While providing classic Boulder Dash® core gameplay mechanics and features, Boulder Dash® Deluxe introduces exciting new elements such as diagonal movement, which opens up new and intriguing puzzles while creating a very different and organic look for the caves.

On top of legendary previous versions, Boulder Dash® Deluxe features include:

  • 180 all-new levels with advanced features!
  • Includes 20 levels from the original 1984 Boulder Dash version
  • 9 exciting, brand spanking new worlds with high-end graphics, having their own, unique textures, go to Macmarnua Sea or Urath Castle – or back in time to the Classic 1984 World with its caves
  • 15 new special opponents like Octopus, Shark Polar bear, and Snow tiger will keep your mind agile and you on your toes.
  • The Liepa World, a premium world by videogame legend Peter Liepa who returned to the game he created 35 years ago with 20 of the most mind-bending levels yet!
  • Full character customization of your game character Rockford™, e.g. shirt, pants, shoes, eyewear, headgear, hair, and facial hair
  • Languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Russian! More to come soon

Boulder Dash® is a trademark of BBG Entertainment GmbH, registered in the US, the European Union and other countries. Boulder Dash® Deluxe™, the names and likenesses of Rockford™, Crystal™ and Goldford™ are trademarks of BBG Entertainment GmbH. Boulder Dash® Deluxe™ Copyright © 1984-2021 BBG Entertainment GmbH. All rights reserved. The original Boulder Dash® was created by Peter Liepa with Chris Gray.

data.name: 无言战斗
data.detailed_description:
《无言战斗》是一款玩法上简单的游戏，核心就是拿着武器冲向敌人。

✳ 随机武器获取

游戏里有多种获取武器的方法

一：可以在关卡中找到十字架建筑，在建筑旁晃悠就有大概率出现随机武器。

二：游戏关卡中会随机掉落随机武器，不过需要细心寻找。

三：非常低的概率在击杀敌人时会掉落随机武器。

游戏里会掉落所有武器，直接拾取就可以使用。

✳ 敌人

击杀敌人时可能会直接出现更多敌人，而且这些敌人可能会更加狂暴。玩家需要及时应对。

✳ 操作

如果不注意观察周围，那么很容易就会被敌人包围，如果被包围那是及其危险的。玩家可以通过滑铲，跳跃，翻滚等方式逃离包围圈，如果操作够好也可以蛇皮走位逃离包围圈。

✳  游戏玩法

《无言战斗》没有养成系统，没有收集系统，也没有通关奖励。游戏中一开始就给与了玩家大量的弹药，去感受纯粹的射击和击杀体验。练习走位，枪法的训练，地形的利用对于通关来说是很有帮助的。

✳  游戏制作想法

《无言战斗》这款游戏是从90年代至2000年初的街机游戏中获得的灵感，街机中很多游戏都是反复练习从中获得成就感和快乐。这款游戏有很多的不足，我会不断的去完善。大家如果对这款游戏有任何的建议和意见或者是反馈我都希望能和你们交流

data.name: Market Warfare
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for a gaming experience like no other with Market Warfare – a strategy game that blends the accessible charm of Tower Defense with the heart-pounding intensity of real-time strategy games.

Enter the battlefield as the brave commander of the Fruit Army, entrusted with the pivotal mission of stopping the evil Vegetables and safeguarding the market’s very existence.

Use the individual skillset of each fruit under your command. The key to victory? Assembling a squad that synergizes flawlessly.

But be on guard – the Vegetables are far from mere pushovers. In a refreshing departure from typical Tower Defense fare, Market Warfare presents a challenge like no other. The adversary’s relentless assault seeks to dismantle your defenses with every attack. Numerous waves of enemies, armored foes, and the unexpected appearance of Special Units keep you on your toes.

Adaptation becomes the key; reinforce your defenses or pivot your entire strategy to outlast the storm. Get ready for a gaming adventure that pushes your tactical prowess to the edge.

Are you prepared to lead your Fruit Army to victory? The market’s fate rests in your hands!

data.name: Dude My House Is Haunted
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to a Haunted house full of ghostly shenanigans and spooky jump scares!

You are a top G ghost hunter and you must capture all the ghostly anomalies that terrorize this luxurious home.

You are a professional ghost hunter from a ghost hunting team called : "The Swimming Turtle Ghost Hunters".

Your objective is to capture all ghostly anomalies that are terrorizing the house dweller named: "Napoleon Pascal" in his home.

Things get increasingly more bizarre as you visit the house every single night.

You must record all paranormal activity before time runs out or else you will come face to face with a rather cute but extremely dangerous ghost.

However throughout your ghostly adventures, you discover that napoleon is someone who isn't exactly mentally stable.

are these hauntings even real or are they delusions of napoleons mind?

Features:

- Simple First person survival horror where you record paranormal anomalies.

- Atmospheric spooky ambiance that will fill you with dread and tension.

- Ghostly enemies that will occasionally chase you throughout your ghost hunt.

-As you explore the house, you will encounter all sorts crazy weird spooky scares and anomalies that will leave you frightened but leave you laughing like a braying donkey choking on water.

-A genuinely unique take on the VHS/analog horror sub genre with a comedic twist.

data.name: Rake
data.detailed_description:
Rake is a First-Person Horror game where you hunt down (or be hunted by) a creature known as "The Rake".

You have arrived in a forest where there have been a large number of mysterious  disappearances, You the perfectly sane Gordon Davis are tasked with hunting down The Rake whom you believe is responsible.

During the day you can explore the forest and place Trail Cameras on trees and animals.

You can also find items like Bear Traps and other weapons that can assist in your objective to hunt it down.

During the night The Rake will emerge. You can stay in your camper van and use the cameras you placed during the day to observe and locate The Rake.

data.name: The Mims Beginning
data.detailed_description:
The game is now completely FREE!

Enjoy and don't forget to check out our next game, "The End of the Sun", and please write a review!

“The Mims Beginning” is a god-like strategy game with a dose of cosmic humour.

Create structures, plant vegetation, breed animals, take care of your minions, use divine PSI powers, triumph in face of natural disasters, fight monsters, predict the future, reveal secrets and so much more.

Assume the lead over Mims as they journey across the galaxy in their epic quest!

The story takes place in an unknown space and time. In this galaxy, mythical floating islands give shelter to all kinds of unusual and dangerous creatures. The game combines elements of fantasy and sci-fi genres.

MAIN FEATURE LIST:

"God simulation"

Story mode

Survival mode and Sandbox mode (Create Your own gameplay rules)

Colony expansion

Autonomous characters

Technology research

Creating & upgrading structures

Various species of plants with different ways of yielding fruit

Livestock farming & trading

Skill acquirement by Mims

Special divine powers at player's disposal

Protecting colony from wildlife predators and vermin

Natural disasters (e.g. meteor shower, acid rains, infections and more)

Secrets to be found across numerous islands

Unique monsters (bosses)

Real-Time Physics (influence the gameplay)

Timeline mechanic allowing to predict future events

Smell sensor – excessive odor will attract pests and predators

Varied floating islands with many unusual adventures

Different landscapes and weather conditions

CRITICS OPINIONS:

"...it looks like a fairly deep, personality-rich god game revival. Given that good god games are in woefully short supply these days, we should probably count our blessings here."

"The Mims: Beginning has become the latest indie hopeful to head down the crowd-funding route, popping up on Indiegogo. And it’s a bit of a looker, putting many so-called “AAA” games to shame with a visual style which brings to mind titles as diverse as Spore and Black & White."

"Everything in a game has been crafted in a gorgeous way. From creature to building, you will find the Mims to be one of the best indie games of the year 2014. "

PLAY THE FULL GAME


About the Game



First Impact is the DEMO of FLY PUNCH BOOM! It's everything you've seen in your FAVORITE ANIME FIGHTS.



FLY FAST and SMASH YOUR FRIENDS so hard whole PLANETS BREAK in half. RAM SKYSCRAPERS, whales and asteroids in their face, CHASE them and unleash over-the-top SUPER MOVES. It's all about the JOY of punching!
Ever got UPPERCUTTED with such gusto that you got KIDNAPPED by aliens?
Wanna DIGEST your enemy, then FART them out so hard everything EXPLODES?
Wanna PUNCH an Elvis lookalike bird until they SHOOT into the moon's BUTT?

FLY PUNCH BOOM! says YES to all this, and more. Way more.

FULL GAME FEATURES:

  • LOCAL and ONLINE Multiplayer, up to 4 PLAYERS local & 2 online
  • ARCADE MODE, UNLOCKABLES and SECRETS for solo players
  • WORKSHOP SUPPORT: play/make INFINITE CHARACTERS
  • DESTRUCTIBLE STAGES where everything is a trap, and everything is a weapon!
  • ANIME SUPER FIGHTS with flying smashes, deformed faces and insane special moves
  • 40+ STAGE FATALITIES: get mauled by cats, break the planet in half, or explode in the moon's butt!

But beyond the actual licensed games, few games have attempted to capture the destruction and dynamic nature of those fights[...] Fly Punch Boom looks like it could change that." -- IndieGamesPlus

FLY FAST and SMASH YOUR FRIENDS so hard whole PLANETS BREAK in half. RAM SKYSCRAPERS, whales and asteroids in their face, CHASE them and unleash over-the-top SUPER MOVES. It's all about the JOY of punching!
Ever got UPPERCUTTED with such gusto that you got KIDNAPPED by aliens?
Wanna DIGEST your enemy, then FART them out so hard everything EXPLODES?
Wanna PUNCH an Elvis lookalike bird until they SHOOT into the moon's BUTT?

FLY PUNCH BOOM! says YES to all this, and more. Way more.

FULL GAME FEATURES:

  • LOCAL and ONLINE Multiplayer, up to 4 PLAYERS local & 2 online
  • ARCADE MODE, UNLOCKABLES and SECRETS for solo players
  • WORKSHOP SUPPORT: play/make INFINITE CHARACTERS
  • DESTRUCTIBLE STAGES where everything is a trap, and everything is a weapon!
  • ANIME SUPER FIGHTS with flying smashes, deformed faces and insane special moves
  • 40+ STAGE FATALITIES: get mauled by cats, break the planet in half, or explode in the moon's butt!
  • High impact cartoon graphics that zoom from space to a character's face
  • KICKASS ANIME SOUNDTRACK by Giorgiost

"Fly Punch Boom! is pure hyperactive anime-style fighting madness fused with Looney Tunes exuberance, where two combatants take to the air to pummel each other into cartoony piles of pulp.[...] The goal isn’t just to win, but to have a blast being as over-the-top as possible while doing it." -- Hardcore Gamer

"If you know anything about Dragon Ball Z, you're probably know it for the moments of mountain-shattering, world-cracking, energy-unleashing fighting. But beyond the actual licensed games, few games have attempted to capture the destruction and dynamic nature of those fights[...] Fly Punch Boom looks like it could change that." -- IndieGamesPlus

data.name: GCR1 Geoff Crammond
data.detailed_description:
Geoff Crammond Racing 1 (GCR1)

Geoff Crammond Racing 1 is where it all began—an authentic revival of the original classic that laid the foundation for the racing simulation genre. First released in the early 1990s, this legendary racing returns, retaining the pure spirit of the groundbreaking original.

GCR1 delivers the raw, unforgiving racing experience of the early 90s, featuring 16 international circuits inspired by real-world locations and a full grid of open-wheel machines, each recreated with meticulous attention to the original design and driving model.

Features:

  • The Original Racing Sim – Faithful to Geoff Crammond’s seminal work.

  • Deep Driving Model – Experience the physics, handling, and thrill of racing from the golden age of motorsport simulations.

  • Complete Season Mode – Compete in a full championship, managing race strategies, car setups, and rivalries.

  • Race Weekend Format – Practice, qualifying, and full-length races for every event on the calendar.

  • Track & Driver Customization – All tracks and drivers use fictional names by default, but can be renamed to your liking. Create your own drivers, teams, liveries, and track names.

  • Classic Replay System – Review your best laps and races with built-in replay and analysis tools.

  • Beginner-Friendly Options – Optional driving assists make it accessible for newcomers, while still challenging for veterans.

  • Dynamic Weather Conditions: Adapt your racing strategy to changing weather conditions. Rain can turn a dry track into a slippery challenge, testing your skills and decision-making on the fly.

  • In-Depth Car Customization: Fine-tune your vehicle's performance with various settings, including tire selection, fuel load, and suspension adjustments. Tailor your car to suit your driving style and the demands of each track.

  • Challenging AI Opponents: Compete against a field of intelligent AI drivers, each with its own racing styles and strategies. Can you outsmart them and claim the championship?

  • Multiple Game Modes: Choose from various game modes, including single races, full seasons, and time trials. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore racing fan, there's something for everyone.

  • Classic Graphics and Sound: Relive the nostalgia of early '90s gaming with charming pixel art graphics and an iconic soundtrack that captures the era's essence.

  • Realistic Racing Simulation: The game offers a highly detailed simulation of Formula One racing, including realistic physics and car handling.

  • Track Variety: Players can race on a variety of real-world tracks.

  • Pit Stops: Players must manage pit stops for tire changes, adding a strategic element to the races.

  • Keyboard and Joystick Support: Players can control their cars using a keyboard or joystick, allowing for flexible gameplay options.

Geoff Crammond Racing 1 (GCR1) captures the roots of racing simulation and brings it to a new generation. Whether you're reliving the past or discovering the origins of sim racing for the first time, MicroProse’s Geoff Crammond Racing 1 is a piece of gaming history.

Crimson Broadcast is a fast-paced top-down survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world, where you can wield up to 3 different weapons at the same time.

Broadcast from an abandoned radio station and tune into unknown frequencies, each transmission bringing greater risks. As the frequency rises, tougher missions and deadlier enemy waves emerge. In this endless struggle, every decision you make determines how long you survive.

Every wave is deadlier.
Every choice matters.

Create your own build with 50+ items and survive as long as you can.

Relentless Waves

  • Multiple enemy types

data.name: Byte Survivor
data.detailed_description:
Bank balance: ¥0. So she took the shadiest job she could find.

Shut-in gamer El suddenly loses every last yen in her bank account. As she despairs, her pet robot Puruya hands her a game: Byte de Baito — a job that pays you just for playing. It sounds way too good to be true.

 

BYTE SURVIVOR is a tinker-and-upgrade survivors-like where simple controls let you mow down massive hordes.

Battles are automatic. The carnage is not subtle.

Every attack fires on its own. In battle, all you do is move and aim your weapons. Anyone can instantly enjoy the thrill of melting the hordes that flood the screen. Enemies never shoot back — this isn't a bullet-dodging game. It's about how you handle the sheer mass bearing down on you.

But the job? That's all manual.

Your real work isn't fighting — it's mining. Gather resources to hit your quota, manage your oxygen on some stages, and work each site's mechanics. And since enemies turn vicious in the dark, keeping the lights on is part of the job too. The hordes are just workplace hazards. While auto-battle handles the fighting, your hands stay busy with work. One shift takes about 10 minutes — perfect for one more run before bed.

 

Build your power into your rig

 

Your work tool is your own PC. Swap in parts to power up your machine, mod your partner Puruya, and shape your weapons through skill trees. El suits up too — her "avatars," materialized from her inner psyche, change both her look and how she fights. Pick today's work outfit: lab-coated Hakase, profit-digging Digger, or hobby-obsessed Janshi. When a build clicks, the screen simply stops surviving. Max out your specs and dive deeper.

 

Quota met. Clock out — or work overtime?

 

This job has quotas. Earn enough and you're free to head home; get greedy, and overtime pays a bonus. But your PC keeps heating up while you mine, and when it hits its limit, the run ends — forcibly. The itch for one more payday versus a machine running hotter and hotter. Will you make it out on time today?

 

Every run reveals more of the story

 

Each shift you complete unlocks more of the story, and El's room slowly begins to change. Why did her bank balance vanish? What is Byte de Baito, really? Uncover the truth of this world at your own pace.

 

A world that's nostalgic — and a little weird

 

The stage: 2024, in another Japan whose history split from ours around the year 2000. A neon-pop cyberspace awaits, packed with creepy-cute enemies and a cast of lovable oddballs.

 

Grind to survive.

data.name: Fun Machine
data.detailed_description:
Fun Machine - A Fruit Machine Simulator from Robot Plums.

Each play gives you 50 Credits to score as much as possible, and get to the top of the High Score Table.

Just like a real Fruit Machine, you win by lining up 3 of the same symbols on the win-line (from 3 points for 3 cherries, to 50 points for 3 treasure chests.
You can also score 2 points for lining up just 2 of the same symbols on reels 1 and 2.

Scattered across the 3 reels are 3 different types of Jewel.
As these land on the win-line, they help light up the trail (Red = 1 light, Yellow = 2, Green = 3), but the Feature Trail isn't always held between spins.

You need to light up all the "Fun Machine" letters using the Jewels to gain access to the Feature Board.



Once you get to the Feature Board, you randomly choose a Feature from the many on the Board, although there are some not-so-good Features on there too, including "LOSE" in the centre of the Board.
Fingers crossed!



Once you've chosen a Feature, and presuming you haven't selected one of the bad ones, you will play one of the many games of Skill or Chance, all of which vary in how many goes/spins/turns you get, and how many points are up for grabs.



Fun Machine also features regulars like Nudge Pot and Cash Pot, which not only carry over to the next game, but are saved so that they are there the next time you play the game.

With these Pots, selecting the Cash Pot from the Feature Board will add whatever is in the Cash Pot to your score, and selecting the Nudge Pot will start the Nudge Feature, where you will be able to nudge the reels down one at a time, until you either run out of nudges, or achieve a win on the win-line.
Be careful when nudging, because even with many nudges in the Nudge Pot, it's easy to lose concentration while trying to get the 3 Treasure Chests for the Jackpot, and end up winning 2 points for getting the same symbols on Reels 1 and 2 (Been there, done that!).

At the end of your 50 Credits (although you may have had more than 50 credits because Extra Credits are available on the Feature Board), if you have a good enough score, you will be able to enter your name and see your name in lights on the High Score Table.
Get the top spot, and earn bragging rights with your friends and family.

data.name: Atrium Malum
data.detailed_description:
Atrium Malum - first person sci-fi survival horror. You are one of the last, (or maybe last) crew member. Your mission is to find out what is going on and get out from the spaceship. Will you survive, or not, will depends only on you.

You are an ordinary member of an expedition to explore new worlds. Your responsibilities include the maintenance of subsystems of the ship and maintenance of working equipment. After another expedition to the surface of the nearest planet, you began to notice some oddities in the behavior of electricians. One day you wake up as usual. But there's nothing usual on your ship anymore.

The outcome of this nightmare depends on you. What will you choose?

Key Features

You choose the method of the game and the ways of its walkthrough

You want to live. That's all that matters. The rest is up to you. Study the surroundings, look for clues. Define your path.

Simulation of the functioning of a real spaceship

A ship is not just a decoration or a place of action. It is a living organism that reacts to the events taking place in it. Have you turned off the power to the compartment for access to the locked room? Get ready to race with the expiring air. Or search for your cherished door. In the dark.

Different scenarios

Explore the ship, collect notes about the last moments of the life of the crew and find a way to get out of there.

Death is also a result

You can't lose. Even death leads to one of the endings, depending on the upcoming events. Any outcome is the final. Logical. Whole. Finished.

data.name: Secret Diaries - Royal Wedding
data.detailed_description:
Are you ready to experience an exciting adventure in a new Time Management game? Step into the 19th century world of lavish balls, aristocratic intrigues, and handsome bachelors. Can you organize a wedding that will be the talk of the town? But don't forget to take care of your own heart amidst all the chaos.

In the game, you play the role of Emily, an aspiring maid, who takes on the challenge of organizing a wedding for her friend Jane. But what she thought would be a simple task turns out to be more demanding and complicated than she ever expected.

As you progress through the game, you will have to make decisions on your own terms, set boundaries, and learn to treat yourself well. You will be responsible for everything from organizing the wedding dress to the wedding rings. And it's not just about pleasing your friend Jane, but also convincing the elegant crowd that what you have planned is worth their attendance.

As the game progresses, things become more complicated when an eccentric squire, a charismatic butler, and a charming captain come into the picture. Can you royal match the couples? Can you keep up with all the demands and surprises that come your way?

Forget burgers and pizzas in restaurants; serve some high-end food to your guests in palaces.

Get ready to immerse yourself in the 19th-century world of love, passion, and romance. And remember, even in the midst of all the chaos, you have the power to fight for your own happiness.
Break conventions by playing a strong female character who cares about others. Here, the heroines can save themselves and say "no"!

FEATURES:
❤️ Organize the most beautiful wedding in town
❤️ Immerse yourself in 60 levels
❤️ Addictive storyline
❤️ Five beautiful locations
❤️ Feel like royalty and attend a lavish ball
❤️ New mini-games
❤️ 3 difficulty levels
❤️ Time Management fun

Support Emily in her fight for happiness and love

data.name: City of Ashes
data.detailed_description:
A brutal post-apocalyptic fighting game set in the ruins of civilization. Fight to survive. Fight to rescue. Fight for redemption.


About This GameStep into the decaying streets of a ruined metropolis in City of Ashes, a visceral third-person isometric fighting game where every punch, kick, and improvised weapon strike carries weight. Set in a post-apocalyptic world where a devastating pandemic and the collapse of governments have plunged humanity into chaos, you play as a former MMA fighter searching for his kidnapped daughter in a city overrun by cannibalistic gangs.

Face brutal hand-to-hand combat as you fight through deranged enemies, gang leaders, and their twisted arenas to rescue the only family you have left.

Game Pillars

  • Melee Combat with Combos
    Master a dynamic melee combat system designed for fluidity and impact. Chain powerful combos, block and counter attacks, and adapt to enemy fighting styles in adrenaline-fueled encounters.

  • Special Melee Abilities
    Unleash devastating special attacks to turn the tide of combat. From crushing takedowns to cinematic finishing moves, your skills will evolve with your journey.

  • RPG Progression System
    Level up your fighter with a straightforward RPG system. Unlock new moves, enhance your stats, and customize your combat style to suit your playstyle.

  • Loot and Improvised Weapons
    Scavenge the urban wasteland for gear and loot to upgrade your abilities. Use improvised weapons—pipes, bats, crowbars, and more—to gain an edge in battle.

  • Photorealistic Environment
    Explore a hauntingly beautiful post-apocalyptic world brought to life with photorealistic visuals. Every ruined street, crumbling skyscraper, and derelict arena immerses you in a gripping atmosphere of decay and danger.

    A Story of Survival and Vengeance

    In the aftermath of a global pandemic and government collapse, you’ve struggled to survive with your daughter. But when a cannibalistic gang ambushes you and kidnaps her, your world is shattered. Fueled by desperation and rage, you’ll stop at nothing to bring her back—even if it means taking on the city’s most feared gang in their blood-soaked arena.

    The World of City of Ashes

    Navigate through hauntingly realistic ruins, from abandoned city and crumbling bridges to makeshift arenas where gangs hold brutal tournaments. Every corner of the city tells a story of its downfall, with eerie remnants of its once-thriving civilization now overtaken by violence and decay.

    Are You Ready to Fight for What Matters Most?

    Face the ultimate test of survival in City of Ashes. Fight through a city that’s as unforgiving as its inhabitants, and prove that hope can survive even in the darkest times.

data.name: IL13-Sonya E-Links
data.detailed_description:
"IL13-Sonya E-Links" is a 2D roguelite action game where you charge energy through enemy breaks, precise dodges, and parries to unleash powerful weapons and swiftly defeat incoming foes.

▼ Battle
Break enemies with consecutive attacks and deliver a powerful finishing blow!

Destroy enemy projectiles and counterattack after perfect dodges to eliminate smaller foes while charging energy into the powerful weapons on your back!

Unleash the charged energy to wipe out waves of enemies!

Tough bosses await, but use the equipment and experience you’ve gathered to take them down!

▼ Story
Sonya, the protagonist born as an IL13 model who fights even in death, boards her drop pod once again to charge into the battlefield.

One fateful day, while enduring the usual antics of her comrades, she encounters what seems to be a machine—but no, it is a girl.

data.name: petrichor
data.detailed_description:
Petrichor is a first person horror game inspired by Outer Wilds. Other older games inspired us for the graphics.

You are in a cabin in the woods, some strange things are happening here. You will have to solve the mystery of this uncanny space in order to get out of here! Don't even try to run into the woods...

The clock is not ticking like you are used to. Be aware of it, this might save your life.

The candle will help you find your way.

What you get:

  • An uncanny experience

  • Puzzles along your way

  • A short gameplay

  • Nice Graphics

  • A very unexpected ending (no clickbait)

data.name: Yeet the Chest
data.detailed_description:
Imagine being the most dangerous monster in the dungeon... that no one ever visits.

For years, this lonely Mimic waited in the deepest, darkest cave for a worthy opponent. But the heroes, knights, and adventurers simply vanished. Tired of the endless darkness, dust, and lack of epic battles, our toothy chest makes a bold decision: if the heroes won't come to the Mimic, the Mimic will go find them on the surface!

You'll have to overcome a long, grueling journey upward to see the sun and the real world outside this bottomless cave for the very first time.

🎮 Gameplay: How do you walk if you're a chest full of gold?

You have no legs, but you possess an unbreakable will to be free (and the brutal laws of physics). Yeet the Chest is a dynamic precision platformer where your main goal is to hurl yourself forward and... try not to go bankrupt!

  • Aim and Launch: Hold, choose your trajectory, and release to send the chest flying!

  • The Cost of Every Bounce: Even as a mimic, you are still a chest. Every touch of a surface and every wall bounce costs you coins! A careless flight will instantly empty your treasury.

  • Avoid Traps and Enemies: Enemies and treacherous dungeon traps hit you right where it hurts—your pockets. Every hit knocks your hard-earned gold right out of you. Can you protect your capital?

✨ Game Features:

  • Unconventional Protagonist: Play as a charismatic monster who just wants to find its place in the world (and keep its savings).

  • Unique Movement Economy: Movement is a resource. Calculate every impulse, because an extra bounce costs coins.

  • Intuitive Controls & Hardcore Challenge: Easy to understand, hard to master. Perfect for fans of physics-based reaction challenges.

  • Thrilling Level Design: Every level is a new test of your accuracy and your nervous system.

🗝️ Help the Mimic Escape!

The journey upward is just beginning. Add Yeet the Chest to your Wishlist and join our GooseBumpsOff Discord server to follow development, share your feedback, and not miss the release!

data.name: Spark Five
data.detailed_description:
Humans Are Here


Enhance Your Droid


About the Game


There was a time when humans moved freely across the Earth. 2029 and it is not the case. The world has turned dark. A shadow government comprising of high level officers, top leaders of powerful nations and some extremely rich multinational firms have come together to create an A.I. that has taken over every aspect of human life. They have employed cybernetic beings as guards that monitor and make sure you are a "good citizen", otherwise you are eliminated.

This oppressive rule soon led to a war after which we see the events of Spark Five unfold. Humans were almost wiped out, except for some colonies in moons of a certain gas giant.



This is your work in total if you buy and download the game. Check it out!​​
(For players playing for the first time the control panel may be empty, kindly add your own controls before starting to play).

  • SPARK CAMPAIGN

    Play the Spark Campaign. Search and collect all the bio-mass capsules scattered across the map. Outrun patrolling guards, evade defensive turrets, use phantom replicas and mines to carve your way out to the evacuation point. Good Luck and Have Fun.

  • NEMESIS CAMPAIGN

    Play the Nemesis Campaign. Search and destroy the experimental labs created by the Spark Project in order to disrupt their mission of renovating human civilization. You have only one chance to do it right and time is against us. Extremely challenging timed missions without checkpoints.

  • MERCENARIUM

    Play custom scenarios against the consortium as a hired mercenary. Objectives vary with each level. Great to hone your skills at the game.



    Following are some tips to make it all happen.

  • PLANT SOME BOMBS


    Plant some bombs to get those annoying guards out of the way. Halfway along the way you realize there are more guards than bombs. Trust me it is not challenging.

  • OPEN SOME BOXES


    Boxes are important. They contain very important things. Get a bomb or a replica, it is your luck.

  • FEEL ALIVE AGAIN?


    Everyone knows we are going to become ghosts someday, but check this android that comes back to life and starts moving again. Well it does more than just moving.

  • OUT OF TIME


    They are creating humans again I heard. In these chapters you are supposed to stop them from creating a top-level prototype. Those bio-pods have some time thing that might help you along the way.








    IMPORTANT NOTES

    Please note that this game is a one-man project, so updates will be slow. You can expect a major update every couple of months instead of minor updates every week. Although the game has partial controller support, it is highly recommended to use a mouse and a keyboard for unrestricted game-play and seamless navigation. Reviews would be much appreciated.

data.name: CoreVore
data.detailed_description:
Every change remains

CoreVore is a single-player, first-person voxel mining sandbox set across a persistent Atlas of mutable planets. Carve tunnels, scan for hidden deposits, extract valuable materials and deploy machinery underground — then get your cargo out before the planet turns against you.
Every planet remembers what you did. Return later and find your tunnels, damage, liquids, machines and discoveries exactly where you left them. But some consequences are permanent: if a planet collapses completely, its Atlas node is lost.

Carve your own route

There are no prebuilt corridors — the terrain is fully mutable. Switch Multi-Tool modes to extract ore precisely, clear large volumes of rock, breach resistant materials, or heat and cool the environment. Scan underground structures and deposits before choosing where to dig.

The planet fights back

The environment is not a backdrop. It is the system you must learn to read, reshape and survive. Removing rock weakens structural stability. A new passage can release flowing water or lava and expose collapsing ceilings, loose and sinking ground, extreme temperatures, darkness, regrowing tunnels, or volatile materials capable of triggering destructive chain reactions.

Decide when it is time to leave

Resources count only after a successful evacuation. Deploy your portable Escape Pod wherever you choose, clear its launch zone and start the departure sequence. While the pod prepares for launch, secure what you already have — or keep mining under growing pressure.
If your suit fails or the planet collapses completely, the current haul is lost. Your permanent equipment, storage, contracts and career progress remain. You can also leave without the cargo and keep the altered planet for a later return.
The question is not how much ore you can find. It is how much you can bring home.

The right machine for every world

  • Drill Rig extracts resources and sends them to your shared cargo.
  • Stabilizer protects an area from cave-ins.
  • Drainer removes nearby liquids.
  • Hardener secures loose and sinking ground.
  • Light Beacon illuminates light-starved depths.
  • Escape Pod lets you choose where the expedition ends.
A machine in the right place can make a dangerous route profitable. Poor preparation can bury the equipment together with the tunnel around it.

Build a lasting mining career

Between flights, sell resources for credits, fulfil local and long-term contracts, buy equipment on the Market, create tools and modules in the Fabricator and repay your growing ship debt. New tool modes, modules and machines give you new ways to reach materials that were previously inaccessible.

Key features

  • First-person voxel mining in fully mutable, persistent worlds
  • An expanding Atlas of procedurally generated planets
  • Systemic cave-ins, fluids, temperature, phase changes and material reactions
  • Scanning and specialized extraction of hidden resources
  • Autonomous machines and a portable Escape Pod
  • Trading, contracts, fabrication, permanent equipment and ship debt
  • Irreversible planetary collapse and lasting consequences
Dig deeper. Bring back more. Leave a world changed.

data.name: 白蛇
data.detailed_description:
Magic Survivors is a casual masterpiece that combines the essence of the gameplay in Vampire Survivors and is crafted in a cute and cartoonish style. The game transports players into a fantastical and interesting fantasy world, where the relaxed game rhythm and thrilling combat elements are skillfully integrated, offering a unique gaming experience.

Detailed Introduction

Character Creation and Cultivation: By continuously completing levels and defeating monsters, players can obtain experience and items to upgrade their character's level and skills. The skill tree is rich and diverse, covering aspects such as enhancing attacks, improving defenses, and increasing movement speed, allowing players to create personalized characters according to their preferences.

Endless Level Exploration: The game features a large number of levels, each with a unique scene. From the mysterious and eerie ancient castles to the graveyards bathed in moonlight, and then to the deep and quiet forests, the scene styles vary. Various monsters are randomly distributed within the levels, ranging from ordinary skeleton minions to troublesome ghost wizards. Players need to flexibly use their character's skills to survive the constantly surging waves of monsters and challenge higher scores.

Rich Item System: A variety of wonderful items can be collected during the levels. Some can instantly unleash powerful magic, causing massive damage to monsters; some can provide shields for the character to withstand attacks; and others can enhance the character's special abilities, such as strengthening the effect of life-stealing and recovery. Making rational use of items is the key to victory in difficult levels.

Other Highlights

The game's cartoonish art style is vibrant in color, and the character and monster designs are cute, adding a touch of a relaxed atmosphere to the intense and exciting battles. In addition, the simple and easy-to-learn operation method enables both novice and veteran gamers to quickly immerse themselves and enjoy the fun of the game.

data.name: Crossroads: Escaping the Dark
data.detailed_description:
Elephant Games AR presents the first stunning sequel in the frightening new series with Crossroads: Escaping the Dark

Crossroads is open for business once again, and Mistress Eve is back, serving up guidance as only she can! When a gamer wanders through the door fresh from a therapy session, our mysterious bartender offers a collection of special video games custom-designed to help them learn to overcome an array of phobias and anxieties that have plagued them for years. Make your way through three tales of terrifying horror as you help them cope with their traumatic past and deal with their fears, but be careful because when you’re at Crossroads, your choices matter! Will the troubled traveler learn a life lesson or crack under the pressure? The choice is yours in this reality-warping Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

Bullets:
• Replay previous chapters to explore alternate story paths!
• Guide a troubled gamer through three spine-tingling stories!
• Experience a game where your decisions matter!

data.name: Boomer Grandma
data.detailed_description:
Shoot, dodge, and defeat demons! This FPS condenses the basic elements of the genre into a small package. As "Boomer Grandma," the legendary demon hunter, you have once again descended into Hell. Your mission is to rescue your grandchild, who has been kidnapped by the Demon King.

Key Features

  • Dodge fierce attacks and fire your heavy guns! Enjoy the primal pleasure of shooting and taking down your enemies.

  • There is no time to play at a leisurely pace. You have a limited time to wipe out the enemies, find the keys, and reach the goal.

  • Discover the secrets hidden in each level and power up your character.

  • Keep trying each level and achieve a perfect score!

Main Contents

  • 25 levels and a detailed tutorial

  • 3 difficulty levels

  • 4 unique heavy guns (shotgun, minigun, plasma gun, rocket launcher)

  • 35 secrets

Additional Information

  • You can't jump because you are a grandma.

  • There is NO aim assist in this game, so playing with a gamepad can be more challenging.

  • This is a simple game where you defeat all the demons that appear. It is NOT suitable for those who want to enjoy story or exploration.

For YouTubers and Streamers

You can stream videos of this game as long as you follow these two rules:

  • Make it clear to your audience that you are playing this game. For example, include the name of this game in the title of your video.

  • Include a link to this Steam page in the description of your video.

data.name: Avem888 VR
data.detailed_description:
Feeling lucky? Can you beat it?


Avem is latin for bird, 888 is the lucky number... are you the lucky bird? You are hereby challenged to set the record.

This classic arcade style flying game takes you through a ever changing landscape of objects you should avoid.

Pick as many of the portals on the trail as as you can including specials scattered here and there. They will give bonuses... or not... Your ultimate goal is to stay alive as long as possible.

In the beginning it is hard, but you will get better.

In party mode you can challenge your friends on the same device, who stays alive the longest and gets the highest score? Always at the highest speeds!

Game Play Instructions

- Create you own Pilot made of 3 words and add a pincode to secure it. They are unique!
- Select the easy, medium, hard mode.
- Start playing the game.
- Mission is to stay alive as long as possible and catch as many red markers as possible.
- Glimmers are point multiplier for a timeperiod, applies both to red and green markers.
- Scatter changes the baselines curvation for timeperiod
- Avoid all objects in your path.

Pick as many of the portals on the trail as as you can including specials scattered here and there. They will give bonuses... or not... Your ultimate goal is to stay alive as long as possible.

In the beginning it is hard, but you will get better.

In party mode you can challenge your friends on the same device, who stays alive the longest and gets the highest score? Always at the highest speeds!

Game Play Instructions

- Create you own Pilot made of 3 words and add a pincode to secure it. They are unique!
- Select the easy, medium, hard mode.
- Start playing the game.
- Mission is to stay alive as long as possible and catch as many red markers as possible.
- Glimmers are point multiplier for a timeperiod, applies both to red and green markers.
- Scatter changes the baselines curvation for timeperiod
- Avoid all objects in your path.

data.name: Yardlings
data.detailed_description:
Yardlings is a local multiplayer battle arena about vegetables in a garden!

About

In this game your goal is to gain control over the entire yard and you are competing against others.
You play as a hero, like a tomato - a strong unit - you can easily take out 2 or 3 small mushrooms, but you won't stand a chance against bigger groups of enemies.
That's why the key to win is to gather your own forces and tactically place your troops at the right places at the right times.

Features
  • Free-4-all and 2v2 modes
  • AI controlled opponents in 3 different level (easy/medium/hard)
  • A short campaign mode
  • 30 minutes to 1 hour gameplay
  • 2 different maps types
  • over 10 different units
  • 9 different special abilities
  • 8 different player characters

Strategy

You have a few options.

  • attack potted plants to claim them. pots will spawn units over time! this is the fastest way to gain a following

  • attack flowers in flower gardens to claim those gardens. flowers heal and help evolve units in range. they also shoot seeds at enemies that are in range.

  • flowers will also grow petals over time and become stronger with them. when a flower is fully grown it'll spawn very strong units! the flowers grow faster when there are more units guarding it, so consider stationing some units in a garden once in a while.

  • you can either decide to run around picking up troops and stationing them, but from time to time you'll also want to help out in a fight. don't worry, you'll respawn at your base garden if you get defeated, unless your base got taken over..

  • when helping out, you might want to use your special ability. dealing damage will fill your special meter. once it's full use your special ability! there are different types of specials and they can make a real difference if used right. to get these special abilities, pick them up at special ability plants!

How to win

there are 2 ways to win

1. control enough flower gardens to take full control

2. destroy and claim the base gardens of your opponent(s). if you do so, you'll be the only one left standing!

Controls

spacebar (keyboard) or A (gamepad) to attack
Z (keyboard) or X (gamepad) to call units to follow you
X (keyboard) or B (gamepad) to dismiss units that follow you
C (keyboard) or Y (gamepad) to use your special ability

data.name: NTL: No Time Left
data.detailed_description:
No Time Left is a 3D capital-ship rogue-like that blends tactical decision-making with elements of space sim and full 360 combat. Every run is different and every event will uniquely respond to your ship.

  • Real-time Combat with Pause
    Issue precise orders at full burn or drop into tactical pause to line up broadsides, prioritize targets, and triage damage.

  • Power Is Survival
    Hot-swap power between engines, shields, weapons, and support systems on the fly.

  • Drones: Your Extra Hands
    Deploy attack, defense, and repair drones to tip the balance mid-fight, patch hull breaches, and keep critical systems online.

  • Shielding & System Damage
    Manage shields, fires, and failing modules as incoming salvos chew through your defenses.

  • Every encounter plays out differently.

    Weapons, drones, sensors, and power setup can change what options you have—revealing safer solutions, or bigger risks for better rewards. Some choices bank favors you can cash in later; others create consequences that follow you across the sector. Swap modules between jumps and the same event can resolve in entirely new ways. Build for combat, rescue, or cunning—and the galaxy responds.

  • Ship Progression
    Salvage, barter, and retrofit. Stack augmentations, unlock new hulls with distinct playstyles, and build the flagship that fits your tactics.

Discover the world of horseracing through horse races and challenge yourself to win the Glory Horse Racing trophies!

Based on the great work of H.G. Wells, explore the English countryside and encounter iconic concepts such as Black Smoke, Red Weed and of course the almighty Fighting Machine and it's Heat Ray!

Sneak, craft and trick the souls under Martian influence, and when it all gets too much. Use the environment to your advantage or upgrade Harper's ability to craft Throwables and learn how to neutralize or avoid enemies in new and interesting ways!

Iconic Setting - Inspired by H.G. Wells' incredible universe, encounter iconic Martian tools such as Tripods, Red Weed and Black Smoke

Crafting - Craft throwable weapons and experiment with them to neutralize enemies in interesting ways.

Stealth - Sneak your way through the English countryside, or take out enemies from the shadows!

Level Up - Progress Harper and upgrade her abilities to ensure you are prepared for the Martian invasion!

data.name: Escape the House
data.detailed_description:
"QUIET. SHE CAN HEAR YOU." You wake up in a locked house. Your sweet Granny has gone crazy and is now hunting you. You only have a few days to escape. Will you fix the old rusty car in the garage or try to break into the main door with its numerous locks? The choice is yours. But remember, she hears everything.

ADVANCED ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Granny doesn't just patrol the house. She reacts to the sounds of creaking doors opening, footsteps, and the crash of dropped objects. If you hide in a closet in front of her, she can set an ambush or pretend to leave to lure you out!

PHYSICS AND INTERACTION All objects in the house obey the laws of physics. - Carefully pick up and throw small objects to distract Granny with noise. - Carry heavy objects, but remember that it slows you down. - Be careful if you accidentally drop a wrench on the floor; the impact will echo throughout the house.

TWO WAYS TO ESCAPE: Carefully explore the rooms in search of the necessary items, which appear in random locations every new game. 1. Main Door: Find the wire cutters, padlock key, and keycard. 2. Car: Assemble the car from the parts—find the wheels, battery, gas can, and ignition keys.

ADAPTIVE DIFFICULTY: The game is suitable for both beginners and hardcore players. - Easy: Granny walks slowly, and you have plenty of days and noise hints. - Extreme: No interface prompts. Only margin for error. The enemy's deadly speed. For the insane only.

RETRO HORROR ATMOSPHERE: Pixel graphics, the style of old PSX games, distorted sounds, and an oppressive ambient sound create a feeling of constant paranoia. Turn around—she might already be standing behind you.

data.name: Miner's Mettle
data.detailed_description:
CHECK OUT OUR NEXT GAME


JOIN THE MM DISCORD!


About the Game



Miner’s Mettle is a blend of artillery shooting and real time strategy! Four factions fight for supremacy on an uninhabitable mining planet. Ensure your faction's survival and secure your rightful cache of the miracle mineral, Pentum.







Control a fleet of artillery-trains. Shoot at enemy trains kilometers away with precision. Overwhelm them with your economic superiority. Exterminate them with your technological ascendancy. The choice is yours.



Research and build new tech that expands your tactical options against your competitors. This tech can be installed on your trains, allowing you to customize each one and fulfill different roles in your strategic plans.



Play as Roland Derecho, a retired artillery captain, as a misunderstanding evolves into open warfare. The story campaign has 22 missions and lets you play all the factions.



Account for distance, windspeed, and trajectory on battlefields the size of dozens of kilometers.



Fend of waves of enemies in Horde Mode. Our 1.1 Pentum Update allows you to customize various aspects of the Horde to your enjoyment.



Four factions vie for wealth and supremacy on Pentum. Each has their own unique devices, facilities and play-styles to help you dominate.

data.name: Alpha Polaris : A Horror Adventure Game
data.detailed_description:
In the midst of the snowfields of Greenland lies Alpha Polaris, an American oil research station. High above, the ion storm of the century is gathering, bringing about a strange intermixing of reality and night terrors...

Alpha Polaris is an old-school adventure game focusing on character-driven horror and environmental themes. Previously released worldwide in retail, the game features professional voice-acted dialogues, hand-drawn dialogue portraits and an original soundtrack.

Alpha Polaris was developed by Turmoil Games, an indie game studio situated in Finnish Lapland, making the game an authentic Arctic production. Developed during two long and dark Finnish winters, inspiration for the game was drawn from such sources as inuit legends, Cthulhu mythos and the very real blight polar bears face today.

The Steam edition includes:
* Expanded resolution support (MINIMUM RESOLUTION 1280x768)
* Steam achievements & trading cards
* Minor tweaks & bug fixes, tweaked dialogues
* English voice acting, ingame texts available in English, Russian, German and Polish

data.name: Giana Sisters: Dream Runners
data.detailed_description:
Race to the finish in Giana Sisters: Dream Runners, a fast-paced, head-to-head platformer for up to four players.

Run and jump, dash and smash, daze and teleport, morph and cannon… oh you get the idea: mess with your opponents!

The game pits up to four players (or AI opponents) against each other in local and online competition, speed-running for the finish in an effort to push each other off the screen with the help of boosters and power-ups.
Switch the level layout on the fly as you rush through dreamgates. Collect gems to fill your speed booster and use your power-ups to knock out the other players and claim victory!


Key features:
  • Competitive pick-up-and-play platforming game
  • Supports a party of up to four simultaneous local & online players
  • Be faster than your opponents, push them off the screen and win!
  • Use your arsenal of boosters and power-ups to blast your opponents off track
  • Nine levels to race, four characters to unlock
  • Dual soundtrack: Chris Hülsbeck along with Swedish heavy metal legend Machinae Supremacy

data.name: The Space Bar
data.detailed_description:
A shapeshifting assassin is loose on the planet Armpit VI, and all signs of its whereabouts point to a local space bar, “The Thirsty Tentacle”. You are the only human on this bizarre planet, who happens to be a telepathic detective tasked with tracking down this dangerous criminal.

Your ability to enter the memories of those you connect with will take you on a mind-bending journey into the quirky lives of the galaxy's strangest lifeforms. Through their own eyes you can search for clues that are hidden in their stories and reveal if they are connected to your case.

The time is running out! You need to solve the puzzles and mysteries surrounding these characters to track down the killer before they get themselves off world!

The Space Bar is a classic one-of-a-kind comedic puzzle-solving adventure, now finally available for release on modern platforms.

  • Rousing conversations with curious lifeforms designed by Ron Cobb, famous for the original Star Wars® trilogy aliens and cantina scenes.
  • A memorable puzzle adventure from the mind of creator Steve Meretzky, known for the beloved text adventure rendition of The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy®.
  • Featuring the voice talents of Alan Rickman, John DiMaggio, Ivy Austin, Guy Paul and more.
  • Challenging and interesting puzzles solved with a classic point and click interface.
  • 8 different alien mindscapes to explore.
  • Non-linear progression, resolve the different storylines in any order.
  • Charming and stylistic pre-rendered 3D graphics and cutscenes.
  • A reinvigorated re-release celebrating the game’s 25th anniversary!

data.name: Jump Queen
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Jump Queen, a platformer whose goal is to get to the top.
In a gloomy tower overlooking the kingdom lives an evil vampire queen.
She brings terror and fear to everyone around her. Get to the very top, defeat the evil queen and bring peace back to your kingdom.

Gameplay

.Meet the main character who has three types of jump. Choose the right jump type and jump up.

- Hold down the space bar to accumulate jump strength and release it to jump!
Choosing the right jump force is not as easy as it seems at first glance.

- Think before you jump!
Once you have jumped, there is no turning back.
The higher you climb, the more unpleasant it will be for you to fall down.

- Fight or don't fight.
Sometimes, you will encounter enemies. You can engage them in combat or avoid combat.

  • Search for lives.


  • Collect Coins.
    You can buy additional lives with coins.
    .


  • Find a store to increase your lives or buy a new look!
    .

  • A look changes the heroine's appearance and gives her new abilities.
    .


  • Collect gems. For the gems you will be able to make appearance upgrades.
    .

    How many guises are there in the game? Let's do the math.
    Right now there are 3 skins and 5 types of armor in the game - a total of 15 types of guises.
    But! Each cloak has 3 upgrades - that means 45 different variants of the hero's characteristics! Prepare your gems.

  • Portals, secrets, is there a hell and a heaven? Is it worth searching for answers to these questions or is it better to just jump up?

data.name: Deck of Memories
data.detailed_description:
Deck of Memories blends card-based gameplay with an evocative tale about fading memories.

Play as Mina, a young woman returning to her grandfather's post at the lighthouse. Looking through his belongings, she discovers a wondrous deck of handcrafted cards. Suddenly, scenes from a memory begin to emerge…

Each short story features multiple card encounters on an immersive diorama board.

Discover new gameplay twists across every diorama, from shifting tides to moving machinery.

Combine your cards carefully to stabilize the memory, and recover every detail before it fades.

Tinker with cards at the crafting table using your grandfather's old supplies.

Collect and attach various trinkets to discover powerful synergies and refine your deck for greater versatility.

Spend memory shards to unlock new cards, crafting tools, and other curious collectibles.

What Deck of Memories offers:

  • Original, soft take on deckbuilding with lots of nostalgia baked in

  • Collection of lovely short stories based on thoughtfully designed card encounters

  • Campaign-style playthrough inspired by Inscryption Part 1 and Hearthstone Adventures

  • Calming atmosphere and beautiful artstyle, fully hand-painted (no AI)

  • Seamless blend of strategic and relaxing gameplay

  • Many unlockable cards, trinkets and tools

What Deck of Memories is not:

  • Roguelike (difficult challenges and endless runs)

  • Fast-paced, combat-heavy or violent

  • Walking Simulator

  • ​Multiplayer

Wishlist now to get notified when the demo is out, and try for yourself!

data.name: Doughjo
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to DoughJo, where pastries fight back.

Build a team of battling pastries and take them into fast-paced, turn-based combat where positioning, speed, skills, and a little bit of sugar-fueled chaos decide who gets served.

Explore a strange world populated by living pastries, eccentric bakers, questionable merchants, and plenty of things that would very much like to turn your team into crumbs. Recruit new fighters along the way, each based on a different pastry with their own abilities, personalities, and combat style.

BUILD YOUR TEAM

Discover and recruit a growing roster of pastry fighters. From dependable glazed donuts to heavyweight blueberry bricks, fiery pepper donuts, aristocratic bear claws, and highly caffeinated tiramisu, every pastry brings something different to the fight.

Experiment with different team combinations, abilities, and strategies to find the lineup that works for you.

FIGHT FOR EVERY SQUARE

Battles take place on a tactical grid where positioning matters. Move your pastries, protect vulnerable teammates, control key spaces, and use each fighter's abilities at the right moment.

Turns are driven by speed rather than a simple back-and-forth order, so faster fighters can act more often while heavy hitters may need more time to make their move.

Manage Proof, unleash powerful skills, use items, and adapt as enemies and battlefield hazards disrupt your plans.

EXPLORE A WORLD GONE A LITTLE STALE

Travel through a colorful pastry world filled with towns, forests, factories, shops, hidden paths, strange characters, and increasingly questionable baked goods.

One moment you might be helping someone along Crumbwood Trail. The next, you're inside the Sugarworks, an enormous candy factory that has continued operating without supervision and has started treating living pastries like raw materials.

Something is going wrong with the recipes of this world, and fixing it is going to require more than a good rolling pin.

GET STRONGER. FIND NEW PASTRIES. TRY NOT TO GET EATEN.

Train your team, discover new abilities, collect useful items, take on side challenges, and face increasingly dangerous enemies as you uncover what's happening to DoughJo's world.

It's a turn-based RPG about building a team, mastering tactical battles, exploring a ridiculous pastry-filled world, and proving that being delicious doesn't mean being defenseless.

data.name: Big Dipper
data.detailed_description:
A miracle beyond the polar circle. They say it's hard to find a place to call your own, but what if such a place was not uniquely yours? What if both of you were not willing to give it up? Big Dipper is a kinetic visual novel, available in English, Simplified Chinese, and Russian, which tells a romantic story of the unusual circumstances that brought two lovers together one fateful New Year's Eve.

Cast

Andrew
Family troubles forced Andrew to leave his childhood home and step into an an early adulthood. Cast out on his own by a cruel twist of fate, he was led far north, where he was saved from the cold by an elderly furniture maker. Andrew studied the old man’s craft, and worked hard independently for years to come. Soon enough, he was finally able to afford his own house. If there was one lesson he had learned throughout his life, it was that living without a home was not truly living at all.

Julia
Julia’s childhood was mostly spent at her grandfather's home. Her parents would go on year long business trips, during which she grew up falling asleep near the fireplace, lulled to sleep by the roaring winds and the sounds of grandpa's instruments. When she turned twelve, her family moved to a place thousands of miles away, but she always knew when the time came again, she would one day come back to her old home.

Features
  • An estimated 2-4 hours in length
  • Cut-in chibi and illustration art
  • Dynamic visual effects, including animated backgrounds
  • Available in English, Simplified Chinese, & Russian
  • 10+ CGs
  • Beautiful, Distinct High Resolution HD Artwork
  • A wonderful story detailing love, fate, and the decisions that guide us through life

data.name: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I : DayRise
data.detailed_description:
DayRise is an enhanced version of the first Welcome To... Chichester 2 visual novel, bringing the first episode to be more in line with the rest of the series and expanding the narrarative into areas that the original Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part I story never did.

Grendel Jinx, the megalomaniacal kleptomaniac, has returned to Chichester, England, for a secret mission.  This time, she has dragged (quite literally) the protagonist along with her.  Whilst Grendel is focused on her tasks, the protagonist is still suffering from having been forced to destroy The Council.

Meanwhile, Cindi Eglantine's job as a tourist guide is progressing well.  Unfortunately, she has now attracted the attention of a stalker, known as Leighton Pool.

Grendel has paid Cindi to keep the protagonist well away from the city for the complete week, which the protagonist instantly realises is suspicious.

Will the protagonist be able to figure out what Grendel is up to, and if necessary, stop her?

  • Play as a male or female protagonist

  • Choices lead to new story routes

  • Unique story for this episode, bringing it up to date with the rest of the series

  • New additional character

  • CGs are now included in the story

  • Internal and Steam achievements

data.name: Counter Ducks
data.detailed_description:
Two Sides. One Hunt.

Choose your side - become the hunter or the hunted. In Counter Ducks, the tables are turned, and the ducks are no longer willing to be easy prey.

Become a True Hunter!

In PvE mode, head out on a hunt solo or with your friends. Explore a vast area, hunt ducks, earn money, and use it to purchase new weapons, equipment, and vehicles. Along the way, take on jobs for the local people and discover everything hidden across the map.

Ducks Can Hunt Too!
In PvP mode, face off against other players in asymmetric battles between Ducks and Hunters. Each side has its own objectives, abilities, and path to victory. Ducks must destroy the Hunters' infrastructure and eliminate their opponents, while Hunters try to stop them and survive the hunt. Take the fight across a variety of maps, including Duck's Eye Lake, Gator Swamp, and many more!

Whether you're the one doing the hunting or the one being hunted...
You'll never know who the real predator is.

data.name: Taptiles
data.detailed_description:
Find pairs of tiles to complete puzzles in this exciting matching game with a unique twist! When you can’t find a match, just rotate the 3D puzzle to view the other side! Taptiles® includes three game modes, countless puzzles, and Daily Challenges.

Dash Mode
Clear tiles quickly in Dash mode to earn extra time. How many puzzles can you clear before the time runs out? Match quickly to earn special bonus tiles with game-changing effects, like the Wild Tile, Gem Tile, and Time Tile. Dash mode's short, simple puzzles are perfect for a quick round of exciting gameplay.

Origins Mode
Play Origins mode for a new kind of puzzle game. Origins mode includes larger, more challenging puzzles and a more relaxed time limit. Think through each brain-teaser and complete the level before time runs out to advance.

Relaxation Mode
This untimed mode is perfect for players who want a calming puzzle experience without the pressure of a ticking clock. Take a break and unwind with a puzzle in Relaxation mode!

Daily Challenges
Players receive new Challenges every day. Daily Challenges include a wide variety of twists on the basic game. Try Challenges like Color Charge or Tap Tower and see what we mean!

data.name: Escape: The Research Center
data.detailed_description:
Trapped. Isolated. Losing control.

You play as Nora, a brilliant scientist who wakes up locked inside the Research Center she once called home. But she’s not alone—her colleague Victor has turned against her, sealing every exit and injecting her with a mysterious toxin. As the substance courses through her veins, her mind grows clouded. The only way out? Solve Victor’s intricate puzzles before the toxin takes full control.

Navigate through a series of challenging, mind-bending puzzles, uncover the dark secrets behind the research facility, and outsmart Victor’s deadly traps. Can you escape before you lose yourself completely?

Features:

  • Engaging Puzzle Mechanics – Solve a variety of intricate puzzles that test your logic, memory, and problem-solving skills.

  • Thrilling Storyline – Piece together the mystery behind Victor’s mysterious toxin.

  • Atmospheric Environment – Explore a haunting research center filled with cryptic clues.

  • Take your time – There is no time limit. Play at your own pace (~4-6 hours on average)!

Escape… or lose yourself forever.

data.name: Acid Spy
data.detailed_description:
Acid Spy is a first person stealth action game set in a cyberpunk universe. Infiltrate heavily guarded bases and take down your enemies with skill and finesse. Master the art of quick, deadly stealth to become the acid spy.

Expect lethal opposition from cyber soldiers armed with laser rifles. Equipped with a silenced pistol and combat knife the odds may seem stacked against you, but in the right hands a silent attack is more dangerous than any rifle.

Combat arenas are designed around player freedom. Study your enemies and attack where they least expect it. Remain unseen or prepare to be hunted down.

Parkour and mastering the movement mechanics of wall jumping and crouch sliding is essential to overcoming obstacles and defeating your enemies.

Stealth is usually the best course of action. This doesn’t mean you have to go slow. A skilled assassin moves quickly and strikes with deadly precision.

Completing the retro futuristic theme is a melodic synthwave soundtrack from Wolf and Raven.

data.name: Russian Village Simulator on Mars
data.detailed_description:
This is a meditative game that refers you to village life with its everyday life.

The game presents the different activities that characterize life in a village colony on Mars, as well as the difficulties that prevent the village from being rebuilt.

Game Features:

- Unique Setting: Create a unique community where modern technology merges with traditional Russian culture.

- Variety of Activities: Farm, raise livestock and poultry, build structures, fish, gather mushrooms, berries and more. Life in a village won't let you get bored!

- Social Interaction: Every inhabitant has different needs, desires and dreams. Create a society where everyone can find their place.

Russian Village Simulator on Mars combines your fantasies of space and your love of earth into an incredibly detailed and vibrant world. Build your Martian dream village!

Are you ready to take on the challenge and create a new legacy in the most unusual colony on Mars?.

data.name: Tiny Thor
data.detailed_description:
Tiny Thor features 16-bit graphics and gameplay centered around using Mjölnir, leading our Norse hero through challenging levels filled with all kinds of obstacles. It offers tight controls, fast-paced action and an experience tinged with nostalgia.

Mjölnir, Tool of the Gods

“It’s your birthday Thor! Now take Mjölnir, the hammer that never misses its target!” —Odin

Everything has been carefully designed around this premise. The hammer can be freely aimed and bounces off surfaces and enemies, enabling all kinds of trick shots.

Old-School Platformer

Tiny Thor will feel familiar to retro fans, but also unique in its own ways.

It features true 16-bit pixel art from Henk Nieborg and an original soundtrack by Chris Hülsbeck. Starting as a relatively simple platformer, Tiny Thor unfolds along the way, as you unlock all kinds of abilities that you dreamed of having back in the day.

Boss Fights Worthy of a Young Deity

The platforming is punctuated with exhilarating boss battles which will test the son of Odin.

Each realm features a set of almighty adversaries who want to stop Thor on his way to becoming a true god. You will need to make use of everything you learned along the way to beat them!

Overview

Master ricocheting hammer throws to overwhelm enemies

Learn awesome special abilities

Explore over 30 handcrafted levels across three distinct realms

Challenging boss fights, each with unique mechanics

Rattle your brain to solve tricky environmental puzzles

Discover tons of secrets and collect hidden gems to unlock challenge levels

Enjoy the story of a boy taking responsibility

data.name: Messenger of Death: Blood Bond
data.detailed_description:
Edinburgh, 1828. Fear grips the city as it becomes the scene of murders and kidnappings. The victims' bodies gradually disappear for scientific purposes, but also for far more sinister reasons. It is under these dark circumstances that our two heroes, Joshua Gordon and Detective Norton, meet and are forced to work together against their will. However, like others of the Gordon family, Joshua is haunted by a mysterious curse that will affect not only his own fate.

Key elements

  • classic point-and-click adventure game with traditional gameplay

  • two playable characters whose fates and storylines gradually intertwine

  • powerful and compelling story, memorable characters and moments

  • modern audiovisuals with sophisticated animations and effects

  • dark and gloomy atmosphere, impressive music

  • prequel to the original game (Posel smrti, 2003) from the original developer and scenario co-writer

  • professional English dubbing

    ‎

Joshua Gordon's journey is just the beginning, yet his family history hides many more mysterious and terrifying tales from times long past. The prequel of the series titled "Blood Bond" delves into the past, venturing into the heart of several deeply unsettling events inspired by real life. However, the events in Edinburgh are not the only matters of concern to the protagonist and players alike. The danger comes not only from mere mortals, but also from an omnipresent curse…

‎

‎

Messenger of Death: Blood Bond is reminiscent of adventure games from the turn of the millennium, yet technologically it stands firmly in the present. The game features 4K resolution, sophisticated animations, realistic effects that breathe life into each location and amplify the oppressive atmosphere (environmental effects such as rain, fog, storms), the changing times of day, and more.

The gameplay follows the tried-and-true methods and mechanics of the adventure genre and the original game revolving around the Gordon family saga from 2003, making it suitable for both experienced players and veterans who want to reminisce, as well as newcomers to the series.

‎

‎

Joshua Gordon and Detective Norton are fundamentally two very different characters, which significantly affect the game in their own way, whether in terms of their behavior, interactions with other characters, or the places they take us to along the way.

The game's storyline and the fates of its characters will take players through the Edinburgh underworld and introduce them to its criminal elements, while also meeting the upper echelons of society at other times. The game will feature mysterious locations such as old dungeons, a dilapidated castle, an abandoned village, and a mysterious swamp.

‎ ‎

‎

Joshua Gordon and Detective Norton are fundamentally two very different characters, which significantly affect the game in their own way, whether in terms of their behavior, interactions with other characters, or the places they take us to along the way.

The game's storyline and the fates of its characters will take players through the Edinburgh underworld and introduce them to its criminal elements, while also meeting the upper echelons of society at other times. The game will feature mysterious locations such as old dungeons, a dilapidated castle, an abandoned village, and a mysterious swamp.

data.name: SCREECH OF STEEL: GLADIATORS
data.detailed_description:
Gladiator fights online in a free multiplayer game for PC and mobile devices. Create characters, buy weapons and armor, and participate in gladiator battles in up to 5x5 mode. Immerse yourself in the world of gladiatorial battles of ancient Rome!Feel like a gladiator in the arena of the colosseum, fighting with real opponents. Fight and win!
Win the crowd , and you will win freedom!

HISTORICAL MMO ACTION GAME


SCREECH OF STEEL: GLADIATORS is the world's first multiplayer cross-platform online gladiator battle simulator set in ancient Rome. A large selection of weapons, shields and armor, as well as the ability to improve items, will make each character special.
The game developer pays special attention to historical accuracy, as well as high realism of physics and 3D models, which allows each player to feel like a gladiator in the arena of the colosseum fighting for his life to the screams of the audience.
14 battle locations, more than 30 models of shields and helmets, 7 types of weapons (including clubs, axes, hammers, sledgehammers, swords, daggers, spears, and even brass knuckles and scissors), breast armor, as well as bracers, shoulder straps, belts, loincloths and greaves are reconstructed on the basis of real references and create an atmosphere of the Ancient era.

SKILL IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN EQUIPMENT

A unique battle management system has been developed for the game, which allows you to fully realize the potential of the player. During the battle, the player has full control over the dynamics of the character's movement, attack and block, which gives complete freedom of action in battle.
Battles are conducted only with real opponents in various battle modes: single and team. The player can choose from 3 battle modes: QUICK BATTLE, SANDBOX, SINGLE-ELIMINATION. Up to 10 players can participate in the lobby at the same time. The selection of opponents is based on the personal level of the character, which is determined both by the number of victories in battles and the equipment used. In the game about gladiator battles, the balance of opponents is designed as democratically as possible: neither expensive weapons, nor shields and armor, nothing will give a significant advantage in battle. Only the skill of using weapons and shields, as well as combat tactics, can give you a chance to win!

ESPORTS GAME

When creating the game, one of the main tasks that we were guided by was the development of esports in Russia. For this purpose, a special tournament system was created, linked to the game database and the official website. The system registers participants for the tournament, distributes the dates and times of the fights (the first, second and subsequent rounds), sends notifications to players, blocks the character to avoid pumping.

The key feature of the game SCREECH OF STEEL: GLADIATORS is the ability to participate in tournaments for real currency with the accrual of winnings to the player's virtual account, as well as the ability to sell a character and ammunition.

The game is developed on the basis of the Unity engine and will be developed throughout the early access period, taking into account the opinions of players.
