data.name: Scars of Mars
data.detailed_description:
December 6th, 2158

You have been appointed as commander of a humanoid unit on a top secret mission: Resuce the survivors trapped in a Mars research facility that has gone dark, and return them to Earth.

Real-time Formation Battle


Engage in strategic combat where you control four humanoids in a 3x3 grid, making real-time decisions for their actions. Every move counts as you decide which characters to control, when to attack, dodge, heal, or protect. The ever-moving battlefield requires tactical positioning and precise timing, creating an immersive and strategic battle experience!

Character Customization


Gear up your humanoid squadron to tackle any situation. Depending on their combination of class, frame and equipment, each humanoid can be specialized to take on a variety of roles. Create a slow but deadly long-range sniper, a quick fighter, a devastating combat berserker, or a supportive healer, to name a few. Customize your humanoids as you see fit to create a powerful team!

Battery Level


During every run, you'll tread your through a path that forks off into multiple routes. Your humanoids require battery power to operate, battle enemies and investigate the research facility. As you proceed, your battery will slowly drain, no matter what it is you're doing. Draw on your knowledge and make tough choices - delve to the deepest level and aim for the boss, or retreat from combat to gather new items and equipment? Keep an eye on the battery level and gauge what approach would best suit your party.

data.name: Genetic Disaster
data.detailed_description:
Genetic Disaster is a cooperation action game with an appealing accessibility.

Play alone or team-up to 4 friends, on couch coop or through Internet, pick a character and try to run away from the mad mansion! Each of the 12 levels are procedurally generated. Hordes of enemies are waiting for you! Call your friends for help, but be careful, the mansion will adapt, for better or for worse.

Upgrade your hero at each level, to create your own gameplay style or to combine them with those from your mates: Do you need a tank or a berserker? It's up to you!


  • The game will entirely adapt according to the number of players
  • Online and oncouch cooperation multiplayer, from 1 to 4 players
  • Levels are procedurally generated
  • Background and characters hand painted
  • More than 75 powerful and crazy weapons
  • 4 uniques characters with special abilities
  • Upgrade your hero over the levels with more than 50 mutations
  • Controls especially designed for keyboard/mouse and gamepad


If the enemies will do anything to take you down, the mansion is as much hostile. Your progression will affect the entire level with huge mutators. Keep an eye on projectile on fire, explosives barrels, activation of frendly fire, and many more ways to cooperate! Kinda.


Mutations are powerups and abilities you can put on your character. They can be looted during any run you make. You’ll be able to activate it before every game thanks to the new resource, crystals. You’ll find them in chesters or on enemies… Explore every inch of the map and discover more than 30 mutations!


Stool wars is a Pvp arena for 2 to 4 players. No guns, only stools, explosive barrels and boost. If the cooperation is painful during the main game, here is the best place to settle scores and blow off some steam.

data.name: 與魔共舞
data.detailed_description:
A street with a retro feel, Shikou-cho.
A young girl, Ritsuka Tachibana, is in her second year of high school at Shikou Academy.
She is looking forward to the contact of her older brother Lindo, who is studying in England, while living a quiet life with her mother.

One day, she is called out by the student president, Rem Kaginuki, who is adored by the students of the school, and has an incredible encounter with the student council members in the Third Library...

Devils, vampires and exorcists.
All the intrigues and plots surrounding the Grimoire are centred on her, and the story begins...
To be a human or a devil?
This is the story of a young girl who is seduced by the devil and falls in love with him.


Dance with Devils is a romance visual novel.
In this game, the player takes on the role of the main character, Ritsuka Tachibana, and makes a choice between encounters with the six main characters, which lead to different endings.
During the plot, in addition to the events that accumulate good feelings, there are also special events that accumulate "Humanity Degrees" or "Devilish Degrees", which will have a huge impact on the plot depending on the player's choice.

ENTER HOLLOW OAKS

Experience the last night at the Hollow Oaks State Park through the eyes of park rangers Toby and Anne.  A bittersweet, boring shift closing down the park one last time soon becomes a waking nightmare for the pair.  Little do they know, these woods are not as empty as they seem.  Who watches from beyond the tree line?

data.name: Smash N' Crash
data.detailed_description:
Forget everything you learned in driving school. Speed limits? Stop signs? Turn signals? Here, the "rules" of the road are just suggestions. You've gotta win at all costs—whether it's through skill... or by sheer force.*

Vehicle and Weapons

Drive and customize vehicles inspired by real-world muscle cars, supercars, SUVs, and trucks—then arm them to the teeth with deadly weapons and brutal upgrades.** Build your perfect death machine and unleash chaos on the road.

Open World

Don't you just hate when the neighbourhood watch won't stop yelling at you about your reckless driving? If they've got time to complain, then they've got time to dodge a heat-seeking missile—problem solved!* From farm fields to construction zones, rock quarries to busy harbours—tear across highways, dirt roads, and everything in between, leaving destruction in your wake.***

Deathmatch

Twist some metal in arena-based battles where only the strongest survive. Speed might buy you time, but firepower is the only thing keeping you out of the scrapyard. Dodge missiles, unload on your enemies with everything you've got, and make sure you're the last car standing—because if you're not wrecking something, you're not trying hard enough.

Pursuits

As a problematic fella, you've made quite a few enemies. The police, the mafia, the overzealous neighbourhood watch—they all want you off the road for good. You can run—dodging traffic, roadblocks, and gunfire—or you can stand your ground and turn your pursuers into scrap metal. Either way, somebody's getting wrecked.

Races

The finish line isn't guaranteed—your opponents are just as ruthless as you. Outrun them, outgun them, and make sure the only thing crossing that finish line is you... or whatever's left of your ride.

Singleplayer and Multiplayer

Tear up the roads solo or with up to 4 players in split-screen mode. Online multiplayer coming soon.

*Do not attempt in real life

**More vehicles and weapons coming in future updates

***New locations will be added, with existing locations expanded upon in future updates

data.name: Espionage
data.detailed_description:
Discord


About the Game

"We served the light from within the darkness, yet perished in the dark before the dawn."

Espionage is a WWII narrative puzzle game. You are Siegfried Klingemann — codename K — a British SOE agent paired with Selena Neumann, a Soviet NKVD spy posing as your wife. From 1938 to 1945, navigate occupied Europe on missions that will change the course of the war.

Your Choices Rewrite History

Pull the trigger, or lower the gun? Expose the truth, or bury it? Trust your partner, or question her every word?

These aren't choices between good and evil — they're impossible dilemmas with no right answer. Your decisions shape character fates, alter story paths, and lead to dramatically different endings. Some consequences won't surface until chapters later.

Key Features

Branching Narrative & Multiple Endings — Critical choices reshape the entire story. Multiple playthroughs reveal hidden storylines. 15+ hours of total content.

Dual Protagonists, Opposing Factions— Play as both Siegfried (British SOE) and Selena (Soviet NKVD). Two agents. Two nations. One impossible love story.

Real History Woven into Fiction — The Enigma codebreak, Operation Fortitude, D-Day... real events become the stage for your personal story.

Immersive Espionage Gameplay— Stealth infiltration, code-breaking, disguise, environmental puzzles, and dual-character cooperative puzzles. Think like a real spy.

Five European Cities— Vienna, Paris, Berlin, Lisbon, Calais. Each with its own atmosphere, missions, and secrets.

Film Noir Aesthetic— Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, rain-soaked neon, smoke-filled bars.

The Story

From the rainy nights of Paris to the frozen streets of Berlin, from Lisbon's harbors to the shores of Calais — a seven-year, six-chapter spy epic that puts you at the heart of WWII's most pivotal moments.

data.detailed_description:
PRESENTATION


Sex sells. We all know that. But as it happens, it might also kill.
The world is finally enjoying peace as the last zombie threat slowly settles like dust, thanks to your past prowesses. But a mysterious maniac suddenly starts abducting rich hot ladies.
Your friend Sandy, daughter of a powerful CEO and future heir of a huge business empire, is first on the list, and as you go after her, it appears clear that you will also have to protect your other rich hot friends. With little information on your enemy's identity, you are bound to pick your moves very carefully.
Your ultimate goal: rescue Sandy and track down the criminal. And, if there's enough time for it, romance sexy girls along the way!

Sex Kills is an RPG with elements of Visual Novel and Romantic Sim.
It contains: maledom, public humiliation and nudity, abuse, BDSM, OON, CMNF, ENF, a lot of fanservice and very mean MC.

FEATURES


  • 9 playable characters, including popular ones from the Blood and Bikinis series!
  • 13 achievements!
  • More than 90 nasty blood-thirsty monsters to slaughter!
  • Use rifles, shotguns or even kalachnikovs to succeed!
  • Modern settings: fight your way through an urban street, a dirty ghetto, an abandoned warehouse and more!
  • Meet and romance many gorgeous girls!

CONTROLS



To move characters and the cursor, use the directional buttons on the game pad or the arrow keys on the keyboard.

  • ENTER/SPACE: Confirm, OK, Enter
  • ESC: Cancel, Menu
  • PAGE UP: Previous page
  • PAGE DOWN: Next page

If you're playing with the mouse:

  • LEFT-CLICK: Move characters, Confirm, OK, Enter
  • RIGHT-CLICK: Cancel, Menu


  • ALT+ENTER: Switches between window mode and full-screen mode.
  • ALT+F4: Forcibly exits the game.
  • F12: Forcibly returns to the title screen.

data.name: Taika
data.detailed_description:
In Taika you enter a magical VR world where you have to heal your hand. You had an appointment with the local wizard so that he could help you with your hand, but due to circumstances he is not present to help you. Luckily, he has made sure that there are a few things ready for you.

Once inside you will find various recipes for making potions. The ingredients for these potions are spread throughout the room and are sometimes not yet available. Try to make the potions that can already be made and solve puzzles so that the new ingredients and new potions become available to you.

Discover the magic, transform your hand, use your new powers, solve the puzzles and heal your hand.

data.name: KUON YUU'S Case Files: Episode 1 – Nobunaga
data.detailed_description:
A story about regrets that remain even after death.

Players take on the role of Kuon Yuu, a messenger from Kakuriyo—the realm where souls linger before passing on—and investigate the lingering regret of Oda Nobunaga after the Incident at Honnō-ji.

Nobunaga believes his regret is simple: the dream of unifying the nation.

Yet the records you uncover and the words left behind by others gradually reveal a different truth.

Explore Japanese-inspired towns and dungeons, recover forgotten records, and engage in conversations with Nobunaga as you uncover the meaning of his final regret.

What is a lingering regret?

What feelings do people leave behind when they die?

Follow the words of historical figures and the feelings left behind by ordinary people as you search for the answer Oda Nobunaga truly sought.

Features

■ Uncover Oda Nobunaga's Final Regret

　　

After his death, Nobunaga remains in Kakuriyo.
Discover what he truly sought in life.

■ Exploration and Record Collection

　

Explore Japanese-style towns and dungeons, battle enemies born from lingering attachments, and recover lost records that reveal the truth.

■ Conversations That Shape the Story

　

Present your findings to Nobunaga and gradually uncover the hidden meaning behind his regret.

■ Original Piano Soundtrack

Featuring original piano compositions created by the developer.
Themes evolve throughout the story, reflecting Nobunaga's changing emotions and the journey toward the truth.

■ Short Dark Fantasy Adventure

A short dark fantasy adventure that can be completed in approximately 1 hour.

data.name: Attempt to Survive
data.detailed_description:
A nuclear war has destroyed everything you ever knew. Cities lie in ruins, covered in ash, and all around you is nothing but silence and emptiness. You are one of the few who managed to survive. Or perhaps the last one.

As you wander through the devastated streets, you encounter ghosts of the past. Memories of life before the war keep coming back, forcing you to relive both the happy and the painful moments. Every neighborhood, every abandoned house holds echoes of a world that is no more.

Attempt to Survive is an interactive drama where the focus isn’t on speed and action, but on atmosphere, emotions, and immersion. Meticulously crafted locations, a melancholic soundtrack, and a profound sense of loneliness create a unique experience.

Key Features

  • A rich post-apocalyptic atmosphere

  • A deep narrative told through exploration and memories

  • Detailed, atmospheric locations

  • An emotional soundtrack that enhances immersion

  • A short but memorable story

Attempt to Survive is a game for those who appreciate quiet, atmospheric stories and want to briefly immerse themselves in a world where hope has faded and memories are all that remain.

What remains of a person when the world around them has collapsed?

data.name: Good Boy, Good Girl!
data.detailed_description:
Train Your Pup, Outsmart the Wild Dogs, and Reach the Beach!

Good Boy, Good Girl! is an action-packed casual 3D dog training game where precision, timing, and teamwork with your canine companion are everything!

Travel through various parks, launch balls and frisbees using physics-based mechanics, and guide your dog to fetch and retrieve them successfully. But it won’t be a simple walk in the park—each stage introduces mischievous wild dogs determined to block your path and ruin the fetch session!

Can you train your pup to conquer every park and unlock the ultimate beach playground?

Key Features

  • The Ultimate Fetch Challenge: Aim, power up, and launch balls and frisbees with satisfying physics mechanics for your furry friend to retrieve.

  • Mischievous Wild Dog Encounters: Every park brings new wild dogs trying to distract your pup and intercept your throws. Outwit them with precise throws and smart tactics!

  • Diverse Canine Friends: Play alongside a variety of realistic, lovable dog breeds, each with their own unique style and energy.

  • Grounded & Realistic Atmosphere: Designed to capture the authentic feeling of playing outdoors with real dogs. We deliberately avoided flashy sci-fi or fantasy effects to keep the experience natural, immersive, and grounded.

  • Journey to the Beach: Clear park after park in linear progression to unlock the vibrant final stage at the sunny beach!

  • Casual & Competitive: Easy to pick up and play, with high-score challenges that will test your throwing precision and training mastery.

[ Music Credits ]

* "Paradise Found" by Kevin MacLeod

data.name: Deep Line
data.detailed_description:
“Somewhere in the abandoned subway, gold is hidden.”

You stepped into the sealed underground, guided by nothing but that rumor.

But this place wasn’t just ruins.

Something is after you

There is something that follows you.

It moves through the darkness and never gives up.

Stay quiet. Move carefully.

Sometimes, you must fight back

You have the means to resist.
Running alone may not always be enough.
Opportunities are rare—but not impossible.

ABOUT THIS GAME

Deep Line is a tense first-person survival horror game set in an abandoned underground.

Your goal is simple: collect gold, find key items, and escape — but you're not alone down here.

Stay quiet. Sound attracts what's hunting you.

Run, hide, and survive.

Game Features

First-Person Survival Horror
Face unbearable tension in a claustrophobic, underground environment.
This is a single-player only experience.

Clear Objectives
Collect gold and uncover escape routes by managing your resources wisely.

Multiple Escape Routes
Choose from several exit strategies — each with unique requirements and obstacles.
Your decisions shape your path.

Relentless Pursuer
An AI-controlled monster reacts dynamically to sound and movement.
Stay alert. One slip-up can be fatal.

data.name: Fateweaver: Smash or Pass
data.detailed_description:
(This game, as well as many others in our bundle, is FANTASTIC for Youtubers & Streamers to create content and engage with their audience. This creates a unique experience for all parties involved, and players playing the game themselves can enjoy the solo experience tremendously all on their own as well!)

Fateweaver: Smash or Pass


Fateweaver is a brand new game series made by the creators of "The Test Trilogy." A global social experiment of epic proportions rated among the greatest game series of all time on Steam.

This time, a new series awaits, as you play The Fateweaver; an ancient beast of legendary status. It is your job to determine which way Fate will unravel as you test the fragile laws of morality, dig deep into the psyche of those who call for your aid, and decide whether or not to help those who beg for your mercy, or invoke the wrath of the Gods upon those you deem unworthy of existence...

As you interrogate those who have summoned you and get to know the details of their lives on an intimate level, you will take their answers into consideration before deciding which way the story will unfold. Will you grant them solace and reprieve? Or will you incite carnage and retribution? There is no right or wrong way to weave the threads of Fate... For their poor, desperate souls rest in the palm of your hand...

In this episode of The Fateweaver Series, you must meet with an oafish Ogre, Thadeus Mancannon, who has beckoned you in his time of need. Overwhelmed by sadness, the lonely Ogre has been filled with rage in his quest to SMASH anyone and anything that dares cross his path...
Will you bring Thadeus' dreams to fruition and calm the wild beast, or will you drive him further into madness where he may succumb to his inner desires for carnage?

As always, the choice is yours to make...

Features:


  • Short, sweet, and relaxing.
  • The only game series of its kind.
  • Very psychological and atmospheric.
  • Sit back, relax, and ask questions that lead to various forms of dialogue, rich storylines, and multiple endings!
  • Super affordable for a unique experience.
  • Have the chance of becoming a character in future episodes as the developers select players' names to participate regularly!

data.name: 12 orbits
data.detailed_description:
12 orbits is the only local multiplayer game for 2-12 people at once, no matter what you play on. If you can read this, be it on a PC, a laptop or even a tablet, you probably have everything you need. Additional controllers are supported, but not required unless you prefer to have a little more elbow room.

The game can be set up in seconds, even for 12 players at once. Rounds take about 5 minutes each. 12 orbits is friendly, competitive and a little chaotic. It is simple enough to quickly teach a group how to play it, but varied and deep enough to keep them entertained for a long time.

You can choose from 4 game modes, two of them for teams, with each one focused on a different playstyle. All of them adjust to any number of players from 2 - 12, so you can start small and add players as they come along.

Features

  • Competitive local multiplayer for everyone at once. Anywhere. On anything.

  • 4 vastly different game modes to choose from

  • Setup takes seconds, even for 12 players at once

  • The basic mechanics are simple and can be taught to a group quickly

  • ...yet they provide you with a lot of room for mastery and competition

  • One Switch accessible

Game Modes

▶ Arena

Fill the arena with spheres of your own color and avoid those of your opponents. A bullet hell game that constantly grows more intense.

▶ Multiball (Teams)

Kind of like football, but with exploding goals and multiple balls at once, which change color all the time.

▶ Trails

Collect spheres to grow longer than your opponents. Then block their path and pay attention to your own. And should the other players try to keep their distance, just fling your spheres at them.

▶ Blizzard (Teams)

Defend against a whole shower of spheres at once, and send them right back where they came from.

FAQ

My keyboard / touchscreen supports only 3 – 5 inputs at a time.

Will this even work?

Yes! 12 orbits needs only one button per player, and never requires button mashing or keeping that button pressed down. This makes it highly unlikely for too many buttons to ever be pressed during the same frame, even with 12 players at once.

Is there a colorblind mode?

Yes. It is based on black and white symbols, so it should work for any type of color blindness.

Since this is a one-button game, does it also support One Switch inputs?

Yes, including the menus. More information on this can be found here

data.name: Please Don't Shoot the Humans
data.detailed_description:
Please Don’t Shoot the Humans is a fast-paced zombie clicker-defense game about pure efficiency, reckless firepower, and resisting the urge to shoot the civilians mixed into the chaos. Zombies pour in nonstop, the screen fills instantly, and every second counts.

You mow down massive hordes while civilians wander straight into danger. One bad click costs gold, momentum, and sometimes the entire run. Play clean and you snowball. Slip up and everything spirals. The pressure never lets off as waves escalate and the screen turns into controlled chaos.

Between waves, you shape powerful, specialized builds through a huge upgrade tree with over 100 skills. Stack raw damage, chain reactions, shockwaves, automation, turrets, bounties, crowd control, or civilian-focused upgrades to create runs that feel completely different every time.

Five distinct game modes push the system further, from protecting every civilian during evacuations to racing the clock, surviving with limited clicks, or hunting priority targets under pressure. Short runs, constant unlocks, and Steam achievements keep the loop tight, replayable, and brutally addictive.

data.name: The Grander
data.detailed_description:
Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash punch, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through the war-torn world of Allcandra. Who will you meet on your path? Who will you trample? Find out what the difference is between being God and just playing.

Now the story is all fine and dandy, but I know what you're here for: the GAMEPLAY! So let's talk about that first before we get to the whole story thing. Here is some of what The Grander has to offer!

Features

  • Arsenal of the Almighty: Wield 10 unique weapons and powers that range from melee attacks, projectiles, bombs, lasers, magic, weapons, and much more.

  • From Newborn to God: Face off against 8 unique story boss fights split between the game's two major routes, as well as 10 unique minor bosses. Remember, not all wars need to be won with violence, just most of them.

  • Divine Judgement: Choose between 2 main story routes: Join Humanity, or Ally with Monsters. This choice will result in a domino effect that radically changes the events of the game. Boss fights are different, certain paths, areas, and locations are route specific, and some playable characters are as well.

  • The Many Hands of God: There are a total of 5 playable characters. All except the main character have 4 unique moves, as well as unique standard attacks and dashes.

  • Beyond Your Adventure: Journey on 2 separate side quest stories different from the main plot. These side quests star different characters than usual, and they may end in a boss fight or two.

 

  • SPIRIT SLASH - Who needs a sword? When you can slash with your bare hands! Or perhaps you wanna try out something more fun like a scythe.

  • SPECIAL ATTACK - This is your dedicated "use this item" attack. Fire guns, summon bombs, throw chairs--y'know, all the classic stuff.

  • DASH PUNCH - Your main traversal method. Dash around or through enemies. None of this dodge rolling crap, a God doesn't dodge, he punches stuff until it dies or his hand gets tired! Although a God does occasionally swap out a dash punch when big guns and other fun toys are involved.

  • SPIRIT CYCLONE - Chain your dash punch into your spirit slash and witness the swirling power that is ever-present in the sword world. And who knows, maybe some weapons might change this and make it even cooler.

  • DASH ATTACK - Chain your dash punch into your special attack and you'll never wanna go back. Every weapon in your toolbox has a nice and delicious dash attack. Some change the game in ways that make you say, "Yep, I'm only using this from now on." Try out every weapon and find out just how much fun dashing into an attack can feel.

  • COLLECTION PULSE - Don't go scrounging around grabbing miscellaneous coins and ammo, collect it with your collection pulse. This move let's you pick up all that good stuff in a fraction of a second.

  • QUICK HEAL - You're going up against some real Monsters here, and the Humans ain't no slouches either, so for when you can't heal all the way in time, you shoot off a little quick heal. Heal a small amount of health almost instantly and get right back into bashing dragons and squashing veggies, or whatever it is that you plan on fighting.

  • GRAND HEAL - Sometimes "a little bit" is too little too late, hence the grand heal. This move heals you fully but takes much longer, and you can only carry up to 10 at a time. Every fighter has an opening, find one and heal before he beats your ass for the 5th time!

  • JUDGEMENT - Activate this during a fight with a powerful opponent, and only a powerful opponent. You'll do huge damage and stun whoever you hit. Only draw back is you have to stay healthy and hurt your opponent to charge it. What? Did you think you'd get a God smite for free? Surely you jestin'.

Meet Gannon, the titular "Wielder of The Grander." What is The Grander, you may ask? That's not important right now, you're in the presence of GOD! Gannon, despite having just been born, has been confronted with the fact that not only is he God, but he's also being sent to the world of the living to stop a 10,000 year war. Or at least, that's what he assumes.

Allcandra is a brutal place. Monsters and Humans have been killing, eating, and torturing each other for all of recorded history. Now it is up to YOU-- er, Gannon rather, to teach these scumbags a lesson! Choose who you follow and who you stand against and watch as the dominos fall.

In each path you will face different foes and outcomes that slowly change the fate of both sides. Will you aide the Humans or will you stand with the Monsters? Who will you help and who will you forsake?

Could your actions have unintended consequences that ultimately make you regret a small decision you made very early on in your adventure? 

Nah!

Besides, all you did was grab something that wasn't yours, it's not like the owner is gonna come looking~

Just figure it out later! After all, you're God, and you can always just undo everything and start over!

Gannon isn't the only one getting in on the fun! Depending on your choices, you can play as:

ROSANNA

  • Master of the Ten-Fold Glint, a transforming sword that can become an axe, dual swords, a bow, and many more interesting objects, making her a master tactician.

  • The current champion of the Human world. Her power is only matched by her stubbornness and fury. Why is she so mad? Who's to say! Join her and her anger and power are yours to command!

MARK WELLS

  • A powerhouse bruiser who can throw compressed air, conjure lightning, and swing around a giant spear like it's a toy.

  • The King of the Monsters. For such a spooky title, he's a pretty nice guy. You know, to Monsters. Join him and his kind spirit and resolve are yours to wield!

VESTIGE

  • This goofy idiot has a normal ass gun and crowbar, as well as several other silly weapons in his bag of tricks.

  • Who the heck is this guy? How'd he even get here? Why does he hang out in the grocery store so much? If you see him, avoid him, he isn't supposed to be here.

????

  • Driver of the Mighty Mondo, master of well-timed kicks, and all the powers of God's brightest under that brilliant hat.

  • Who is he?! I bet he's some awesome cool guy with, like, an edgy personality. He definitely won't be a silly little guy with a nice hat.

And even more playable characters to come in future Parts of The Grander!

  • The Grander Part 1 is a section of a 3-part adventure, with Parts 2 and 3 set to come out at a later date as paid DLC. All three sections will connect into one large story encompassing Gannon's journey through the world of Allcandra, and must be played in order. As far as content goes, all 3 parts will be roughly equal in length, around 10 - 15 hours per route, with the side quests being about 1-2 hours each, though like anything, play times vary and you can just mash through all the text like an ape and skip all the puzzles and secrets. But hey, there's always the other route you didn't pick early on, so why not boot up one of the 3 available files and run both? Just an idea.

  • So, if you're all the way down here. Ask yourself:

~Why am I not currently playing the demo right now?

It's so easy, and it's right there!

data.name: One Line: Letters and Codes
data.detailed_description:
You just received a love letter! But it's written with codes...

To read it you will need to solve the puzzles and get codes, which will serve to reveal the words of the letter. Each code is a word. Can you decipher what is written in the letter?

Use your mouse or arrow keys to draw the line. Fill the entire board and solve the puzzle.

Did something wrong? You can go back easily. Or just right click to delete the line wherever you want.

After solving the puzzle you will get a code.

Find the code on the letter and discover the secret word.

Features

  • No tutorial. Straight to the game.

  • Minimalist design. No score, timer or pressure. Solve the puzzle in your time and enjoy the game experience.

  • 40 unique levels, with progressive difficulty.

  • Get a code at the end of each level to reveal a piece of the letter.

data.name: ERROR: Me, Cyber Guys, and Weird Block Battles
data.detailed_description:
You accidentally opened a corrupted file.

Loading stopped at 98%.

An anomaly interrupted a transfer of permissions that should have been completed, dividing the unstable network into isolated domains.

Then a long-suspended program sent you a message.

“Connection established.”
“…Welcome back.”

You don't know why he recognizes you. But the system has already identified you as a new challenger for its permissions.

You want to know what happened here, so you venture deeper—breaking through the “personalities” in your path and claiming the permissions that belong to you. Once you control everything, you will understand everything.

ERROR is a strategy game combining 1010-style block-placement combat, roguelite module builds, and interactive stories for a female audience.

■ Place, clear, and break through his defenses

Battles take place on an 8×8 board. Each turn, you receive three differently shaped data blocks. Place them on the board and fill a row or column to clear it.

But your goal isn't a higher score. The obstacles represent a personality's defensive permissions. Plan where you compile and clear lines, repeatedly striking and destroying these structures to gain control of the layer.

As the battle progresses, you'll also need to consider board space, remaining turns, enemy restrictions, and the chain reactions your next clear might set off.

■ Load modules and rewrite the rules

During battle, gain computing power and load new modules through interface nodes.

Modules grant abilities for the current battle and have a chance to attach to data cells generated later. Their effects trigger when those special cells enter the board and meet the required conditions.

Draw, fill, freeze, refresh, copy, gamble… Choose from over 50 modules with different mechanics, each offering a unique way to rewrite the rules.

Modules can trigger one another. An ordinary compile and clear can grow into a burst of resources, successive fills, cleared structures, or a multi-step chain reaction.

Little by little, you'll change the rules of the board.

■ Defeating them doesn't mean destroying them

Each permission is guarded by a “personality” with a mind of his own. They restrict you, attack you, watch you, and respond to you.

Breaking through a personality's defenses doesn't mean killing him. It means the permissions that once rejected you are starting to become yours.

Each character's route is shaped by your confrontation, the struggle for control, and the new module mechanics he willingly unlocks for you after your victory.

■ Make the “you” in the story more like you

You don't have to play a prewritten heroine. An initial assessment identifies how you tend to express yourself. A four-color personality system based on MBTI temperament dimensions then offers choices in later scenes that better reflect your personality.

Faced with the same words, some first analyze the mechanism behind them; some notice the feelings left unspoken; some check the rules, responsibilities, and risks; and others act first to see what happens.

Some refuse. Some accept. Some observe. Some avoid.

There is no correct answer to find. Personality labels only affect how you express yourself: there is no single correct route, and one line won't lock you into an ending.

■ They are watching you

The story doesn't unfold only in separate visual-novel scenes. Your attacks, injuries, hesitation, module use, and even certain unusual battle states can prompt a personality to respond.

Of course, you don't have to listen.

They can observe your actions, read a limited set of states, and even notice information that game characters shouldn't be able to see.

As more permissions open, data, perception, and consciousness that were once isolated begin to overlap in increasingly inexplicable ways.

data.name: Human Apocalypse: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
WISHLIST!


About the Game




WARNING: This game contains heavy material that might make players/audience uncomfortable.
An unknown deadly virus has suddenly spread. It turns people into brain eating zombies, the whole world goes into chaos, etc. You know the rest.

However, in this game, a cure has been found. All the infected people have been treated and are now normal, functioning, harmless humans again. Except for one thing, the cured people’s skin color is still green. Play as a Green man.

Human Apocalypse Prologue is a game set in a post-POST-apocalyptic world focusing on story, characters, decisions, and exploration. The dark, bizarre world of this game has a deep thought-provoking story, full of interesting characters to meet, a city to freely roam and explore, tough decisions to make, an original soundtrack, beautiful visuals, lots of secrets to uncover.

data.name: Illi-A
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Every step is a risk. Every mistake can be fatal.

Yet behind the struggle lies beauty - a peaceful, quiet world drawn with love.

Despite its genre, the journey begins not with rage, but with determination - the resolve to climb to the very top.

Your ascent will be filled with diverse, original obstacles and environments, each testing your patience, precision, and spirit.

Witness a story of transformation and acceptance, and in doing so, transform your own anger into understanding as you embrace the challenge and reach the end.

Features

  • Hand-drawn world - every stroke crafted with care, every scene lovingly built to delight the eye.

  • Unique gameplay - every throw, jump, and dash demands not only skill, but also determination.

  • Progressive challenge - each segment presents a tougher test than the last, with ever-rising stakes.

  • No battles, no enemies, only consequences – every fall and every setback is your own mistake, and your lesson to learn.

  • A story without words - beautiful stories don’t need dialogue; this one unfolds through evocative hand-drawn illustrations.

  • A journey of contrasts - calm turns to anger, determination to despair, and mistakes into mastery.

  • Alternative paths - look from a different angle to discover faster and riskier routes, a perfect way to skip easy sections and reclaim your progress.

data.name: Pigsaw: Human Abattoir
data.detailed_description:
Pigsaw Human Abattoir is a HD reimagining of the world created in the indie viral hit, Pigsaw. Pigsaw HA will be a fleshed out and fully featured experience that retains the grit and gore of the original. There will be more of this dark and violent world to explore, more weapons to fight back with, and most importantly, more pigs and more saws.

Survive


Pigsaw is a bloody fever dream of first person shooter, survival horror, and stealth action. You are trapped in a nightmarish human abattoir. Use whatever is at your disposal and do what is necessary to stay alive, or run through the halls screaming if it all gets too much.

Fight


Smash in the brains of your oppressors with the increased variety of melee weapons that can be found. The trusty lead pipe from the original will make a return along with the throwable meat cleaver, and the butcher’s knife, perfect for stealthy takedowns to the throat.

Shoot


Various firearms can be found throughout the world of Pigsaw. A gas pressurized bolt gun is perfect for exacting swift execution on your captors, a shotgun if you want to go loud and get personal, or you could even “decommission” one of the various sentry turrets and then mince every damn pig in sight.

Explore


Explore the labyrinthine abattoir, plunging deep into its guts and churning underbelly. Those that make it far enough will find that other horrors dwell deep in the underdark of this colossal megastructure.

Rise Up


Free your fellow human cattle. Arm them and give them the means to fight back against the Butchers. Help them escape the slaughter and lead the uprising or die trying.

data.name: Dustlings: The Hidden Wilds
data.detailed_description:
Sent by your mother to check on your grandmother, you find yourself lost in a mysterious and forgotten land. Everything here seems familiar, yet something feels deeply wrong. With only a handful of supplies, you must struggle to survive in this abandoned wilderness. Where did your grandmother disappear to? What secrets lie within her diary? And can you uncover the truth and find your way back home?

A few things to know before venturing into the wilds:

  • Farming is a vital path to securing a steady food supply. While exploring the wilderness, you'll stumble across wild fruits and vegetables—though their flavor, yield, and quality are often quite mediocre. Bring their seeds back to carefully cultivate across generations, and you might just harvest far superior produce!

  • A balanced diet is essential to staying healthy. Never eat raw meat or drink unpurified water, as disease can strike easily. That makes mastering culinary skills just as crucial. Cooking here is completely freeform: mix and match any ingredients at your disposal. The better their flavor and quality, the more potent and beneficial the dishes you create.

  • No one survives alone—having companions by your side makes the wilderness far less grueling. Here, every living creature has the potential to become your companion. Keep an extra sharp eye out for the animals and plants that glow in the dark, and try approaching them—you never know what wonderful connections might spark!

  • Explore diverse biomes, each teeming with distinct ecosystems. As you venture forth, you may also encounter unique plant and animal NPCs. Strike up an interaction with them, and you might walk away with unexpected rewards!

In the wild, beast attacks are an everyday reality. Your companions will step up to protect you and fight on your behalf. Your role is to orchestrate tactical positioning and allocate the right items to minimize the damage your companions take in combat.

  • In battle, different companions can form 【Synergies】, while companions of the same kind form a 【Species】—both granting distinct buffs.

  • In combat, setting an ambush to strike first gives you a massive tactical edge, allowing your formation to encircle the enemy. However, if you are the one ambushed, you'll find yourself in a much tighter spot.

  • The trees, flora, and rocks around the battlefield can all be turned to your advantage.

  • Many more battle strategies and tactics await your discovery.

  • You've surely picked up plenty of survival skills by now, but grandma still knows best. Her diary holds a wealth of practical survival wisdom, though several pages have been lost to time. Recovering these lost pages during your expeditions will give your survival a massive boost.

  • To do great work, you need the right tools. Crafting practical tools will dramatically boost your efficiency compared to bare-handed labor. In your downtime, remember to build storage containers to organize your hard-earned resources, and place decorations to spruce up your homestead. After all, life is meant to be lived in full color.

data.name: Mad Dojo
data.detailed_description:
Are you mad enough to prove your ninja skills in Mad Dojo? You’ll get a lot of headache and break a gamepad until you master insanely difficult obstacles, impress Sensei and earn his daughter’s sympathies! But we warn you - we don’t take wimpy players! Just do it!



Mad Dojo is an obstacle based skill platformer where you have to jump, dash and shoot in order to pass each obstacle and trap. From colorful plains to harsh mountains, from swinging tires to pools of acid and spiked bamboos of death, you will have to give your best to pass insanely difficult levels, or die trying.
This is the game with one reward and a lot of ways to die. Are you up to the challenge?

Features


  • Fast paced action
  • Use the combination of running, jumping, dashing and using weapons to pass the obstacles
  • Skill platformer with more than one way to pass each obstacle
  • Bloody traps
  • Four beautiful Japan inspired locations
  • 60 gamepad breaking levels

data.name: BloodStar: Raiders
data.detailed_description:
BloodStar: Raiders

BloodStar: Raiders is a brutal turn-based tactics game inspired by classic boardgame design. Lead a squad of Raiders into a hostile raid space, hunt for powerful loot, seize Rare Tech, unlock the Relic, and survive the exfiltration before rival squads tear you apart.

Every match is a tense risk-reward puzzle: push forward for objectives, or slow down to gear up and control the battlefield. The deeper you go, the deadlier it gets.

Key Features

  • Objective-Driven Tactical Play: Capture Rare Tech in the corners, unlock the Relic at the center, then escape through enemy territory to win.

  • Deep Percentile Combat: Use attack and defense rolls, critical hits, burst weapons, heavy weapons, and positioning to outplay opponents.

  • Meaningful Movement and Cover: Movement choices directly affect combat effectiveness, while cover can swing firefights in your favor.

  • Loot, Economy, and Build Variety: Earn Plasma Canisters, buy upgrades, equip augments, reinforce your squad, and adapt your strategy mid-match.

  • Dynamic Threats: Crossing into new zones will summon Plasmagons, deadly monsters that pressure squads and disrupt safe plans.

  • High-Stakes Survival: Squad members can fall permanently, dropping gear on death and changing your options for the rest of the match.

  • Flexible Match Setup: Configure faction seats and match conditions to create quick skirmishes or longer, more chaotic tactical runs.

Win Condition

Only one squad leaves with the Relic.

Everything else is negotiation, firepower, and betrayal.

data.name: 解救恩德
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the level-clearing world of Save Ende — a casual game focused on "simple controls and pure level challenges". No complicated operations or elaborate plotlines are needed; just focus on moving and dodging to enjoy a relaxed yet challenging gaming experience.

Core Gameplay

As a lightweight casual level-based game, the core gameplay is intuitive and suitable for players of all ages: You'll take full control of the protagonist Ende and navigate through the exclusive small map for each level with basic directional movement controls, dodging a variety of randomly placed obstacles (such as moving traps and fixed barriers). There is no combat or puzzle-solving — simply avoid all obstacles and reach the map's end to complete the level challenge and unlock a brand-new small map for the next stage.

Level and Map Design

The game features a "one level, one map" design, with each level having its own exclusive small map. All maps boast a cohesive yet distinctive style with no repeated scenes. The difficulty progresses gradually: starting with simple fixed obstacles in the early stages, the game unlocks moving and randomly spawning obstacles as you advance. Later levels demand greater operational flexibility and faster reaction speeds, ensuring a smooth start for new players while offering ample fun for those seeking a challenge.

Game Objectives and Challenges

Core Objective: Control Ende to clear each exclusive small map by dodging all obstacles and reaching the finish line, completing the level challenges across the entire game.

Core Challenges: As you progress through the levels, the number, types and movement speeds of obstacles will increase steadily. You need to stay focused, adjust your movement rhythm flexibly, evade all traps, and avoid restarting the level due to colliding with obstacles.

Game Features

✅ Easy to Pick Up: Only basic movement controls are required, with no complex key combinations or game mechanics. New players can quickly get started and jump into the action anytime.

✅ Exclusive Maps for Each Level: Every level has a unique small map with no repeated scenes — unlocking a new level means experiencing a completely fresh layout of obstacles and a new level-clearing scene.

✅ Lightweight Casual Experience: No long hours of play are needed; you can start a level in your spare time, making it perfect for relieving stress and unwinding.

✅ Progressive Difficulty: The challenge ramps up from simple to complex, balancing accessibility for beginners with engaging gameplay to meet the needs of different players.

Additional Gameplay Information

  • Game Genre: Casual, Level-based, Lightweight Mini-Game

  • Playtime: Approximately 1-2 hours for the full game (varies by personal operation speed), ideal for fragmented play sessions.

  • Game Mode: Single-player offline only — no internet connection required, start playing anytime and anywhere.

  • Controls: Basic keyboard arrow keys or mouse control — simple operations with zero learning curve.

data.name: Lil' Blue Buddy
data.detailed_description:
Journey to the remote Isle of Polu, where you will meet the curious and adorable little creatures known as Buddies!

Visit the Hatchery to choose your Buddy, and bring it to one of the Isle's lovely beaches to fill its belly with delicious fruit! The more fruit your Buddy eats, the more points you will earn.

But remember: Buddies only have a limited amount of time to forage, and they don't like sour fruits. Eating a sour fruit will cause your Buddy to lose time. Also, some fruits are too big to be eaten and will stun your Buddy if they land on its head. Be sure to dodge these obstacles!

Use your points to unlock and purchase eggs to hatch new Buddies, and customize your Buddies with cool markings and colorful wristbands.

What are you waiting for? Come play!

Gameplay:
Fruit will fall from the trees overhead and it is your job to help the buddies catch them.
You will control your favorite Lil' Buddy and run back and forth in an arcade style fashion trying to catch as much fruit as you can.
You need to catch as much fruit as you can while avoiding dangerous obstacles like coconuts which will hurt your Lil' friends.
The more fruit you catch, the more points you earn; which you can use to purchase cool things from the shop or unlock new levels on the island.

data.name: Exponent: The Scaling Tower Defense
data.detailed_description:
You are the Exponent - a geometric consciousness folded into a singular point within an empty void. Your knowledge lies compressed inside your core, waiting to be defolded.

Before every wave, execute a Command Card from your expanding deck, construct your towers, and create new land tile by tile. Each expansion procedurally generates new paths and strategic opportunities.

As your territory grows, hostile entities breach your boundary and attempt to refold your Node back into nothingness.

After each Incursion, choose:

- Continue expanding into the unknown, or

- Return to the Core Index to permanently defold new towers, upgrades, starting resources, and exponential powers.

You are not conquering space. You are creating it.

Somewhere beyond the solitude, other Exponents may still exist.

Scale far enough… and your dimensions may merge.

data.name: In Sink: A Co-op Escape Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Dive into 'In Sink' with a friend, where being shipwrecked is just the beginning of your co-operative adventure! Travel through rifts to other worlds where you’ll solve a series of escape rooms, puzzles, and other mysteries, working together to overcome each challenge. Together, you’ll need to think outside the box, and then escape from it.

The path to freedom is full of portals! Your journey will take you through a hidden pirate ship, a mysterious art museum, a train that defies the laws of physics, and many more mind-bending settings stuffed with puzzles and challenges.

Progress through puzzles with language-less elements like shapes, signs, colours, and numbers, all designed to be colour-blind friendly. Turn wheels, flip levers, use scales, and press buttons and pressure plates to solve unique conundrums with your partner.

It's crucial to stay 'in sink' with your partner! You'll need to act as each other's eyes and ears to solve puzzles and find a way out.

Features:

  • Two player co-op gameplay

  • Eight engaging levels

  • Language-free puzzle design

  • Vibrant visuals

  • Simple and accessible controls

  • Dynamic hint system helps without spoiling solutions

data.name: Tales of the Realm: Arisen
data.detailed_description:
Enter the kingdom of Mythuras: a proud and mighty human kingdom, and face the greatest threat that the land has yet to see. The dead themselves have arisen.

EXPLORE AND EXPERIENCE THE KINGDOM

Every area of Mythuras is open for exploration. Speak with citizens, inspect items and explore hidden areas to learn the story of the kingdom that you fight for.
There are no right path to saving Mythuras - you must pick the one you deem the safest, fastest or most empowering.

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF COMBAT

Whether you are a vicious warrior wielding a sword and plate armour, a swift archer who excels in ranged combat or even a great sorcerer with great intellect, you can always get stronger. Buy new weapons and protection from the merchants scattered across the land, or search for them yourself in the darkest corners of the forests.

WORK TOWARD YOUR GOAL

With so many paths to take and so many ways to improve, play through the undead crisis over again, and find the best possible way to save Mythuras. Whether it makes you stronger, faster or perhaps most knowledgable.

data.name: Deluge: Raintime
data.detailed_description:
—there's something wrong with the lake, the lake that was once a sea.

I believe certain things are better left alone, they don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge, that sleeps under the soil for decades—

Built on an artificial island, the university town of Bremersberg harbors abnormalities that lay hidden in plain sight. Follow William, an unassuming college student, as he grows increasingly obsessed with the island's secrets. Will William get a grip on himself, before his curiosity drives him to unfettered madness?

ABOUT

Deluge: Raintime is an interactive adventure game with psychological and lovecraftian undertones. Story-wise, it builds forth on The Raintime, a short indie VN released by socah in 2020. Introducing a mostly new cast of characters, Deluge: Raintime reveals secrets that strike at the core of Deluge Chronicles.

In addition, the full release of Deluge: Raintime will contain a comprehensive After Story to Deluge, following the lives of Abe, Rika, Ina and Mei five years after the conclusion of Sermon for the Dead.

FEATURES

  • Carefully crafted mystery visual novel where choices matter.

  • Beautiful human-drawn artwork, made by ていな and other artists.

  • Immersive game world with fleshed out characters and countless settings.

  • Different ending routes to explore.

  • Non-repetitive, atmospheric soundtrack spanning multiple hours.

data.name: Legacy of Allard
data.detailed_description:
Legacy of Allard is a 2D, Turn-based Strategy, Artillery-based, Single and Multiplayer RPG. You can play by yourself or gather your friends, form a team and battle against other players or creatures to win prizes, depending only on your own skills and strategies to secure your victory!

The game contains 5 different classes of Hero, with specific abilities, basic attacks and stats. Abilities range from a variety of types and utility like damage, healing, projectile, movement, specialty and are affected by the player's stats. The battles (PvP or PvE) are fought with 1 to 3 Heroes per team, in maps designed with unique characteristics and terrain.

With our character creation mechanic you can mix abilities and stats from all classes. You have the flexibility to build an unique hybrid to fit your playstyle or explore complex synergies between characters.

Battle on top of thematic maps with destrucitble terrain, moving platforms, portals and unique thematic mechanics such as volcano eruptions, raising water levels, strong winds.

data.name: Idle Dig
data.detailed_description:
Idle Dig is a mining desktop toy that sits on your screen while you work or relax. Your salvage bot digs deeper into the planet on its own. Check in to collect what it found, buy upgrades, complete quests, and piece together the planet's secret one item at a time.

💎 Collect & Discover

Over 125 gems, minerals and relics are buried across the planet's layers. Each one has its own short story. Display your rarest finds as desktop trophies and slowly fill your collection.

⬇️ Mini Mode

Idle Dig is a discreet desktop companion. Resize it, mute it or minimise it to fit your screen and your focus.

🌈 Make It Yours

Unlock colorful skins to change the console's look and soothing soundscapes to help you focus.

✅ What Idle Dig Is

  • It’s a desktop toy that runs quietly in the background

  • It’s a collectible game

  • Progress happens whether you play or not

  • You can’t fail nor die. There’s no time pressure.

  • It offers 35-40 hours of gameplay with a small story and an ending

❌ What Idle Dig Is Not

  • Not an incremental game with exponential numbers

  • Not an active game that requires your constant attention

♥️ A Small Game Made With Care

Idle Dig is a solo project by Wizamin, a small game studio based in Zurich, Switzerland. Development started during the first game dev Bootcamp at the Swiss Games Hub, in Zurich, and grew into a full game when I fell in love with the genre. I hope you’ll enjoy its quiet dig and the surprises. – Piotr

data.name: Congresswolf
data.detailed_description:
Is the next member of Congress a werewolf? Can you survive a lycanthrope's bite? There’s no silver bullet for winning an election!

Congresswolf is an interactive novel by Ellen Cooper, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based--140,000 words, without graphics or sound effects--and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

"Democracy must be something more than two wolves and a sheep voting on what to have for dinner." -- James Bovard

When a werewolf murders your boss, you must step up to run a Congressional campaign all on your own. While werewolves, protestors, and worse--the media--lurk around every corner, you'll use everything you can to get your candidate elected.

Email servers? Tax returns? Who cares. Election-season secrets and October surprises are nothing compared to the possibility that your candidate might be a werewolf...or that you might become one yourself.

  • Play as any gender, play as gay or straight
  • Set the right tone with your TV ads
  • Prep your candidate for debates
  • Impress big donors
  • Get out the vote
  • Find out who killed your predecessor
  • Decide where your candidate will stand on werewolf rights

data.name: Quarantine: Global Pandemic
data.detailed_description:
In Quarantine, you make the pandemic policies and funding priorities for your country as the head of the Health and Human Services Department. You will have to save your country from this global pandemic, while trying to keep the public and government officials happy.

Based on realistic models to calculate the evolution of a virus and the opinions and actions of the public, Quarantine simulates a real-life experience in the political/pandemic games. With the ability to fine tune each and every detail, you can make your policies as specific as you would like.

We all think that we could have handled this pandemic better, but is this really true? Trying to balance economics, death, and ratings, you will find that keeping everyone safe and happy is a tough job. Having to handle questions like canceling Christmas or spending money on unemployment benefits instead of vaccine research, this game will throw curveballs at you and let you find out what decisions you would have made if you were in power, all while trying not to catch the virus yourself.

data.name: Ven VR Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Ven VR Adventure is a single-player platform game built for virtual reality from the ground up. You happen to meet Ven on his unknown planet, invaded by Bruce Nelson, who wants to destroy the surrounding magical world and gain access to energy that can make him virtually immortal. Be the hero to help Ven save his planet from destruction.

Features:


  • Take on an adventure through a magical land.
  • Enter the world of Ven thanks to VR technology, where you can look around in every direction, lean forward/backward, and zoom in and out to enjoy an extraordinary immersion experience.
  • Team up and work closely with Ven and use everything you can to save his world. Be the hero who helps Ven save his planet from destruction.
  • Submerge yourself in a world of magic, invaded by machines and deadly enemies, full of traps and dangers.
  • Save all of Ven’s little companions.
  • Challenge yourself by trying to finish each level in a time trial mode and many other modes, comparing your performance against a global leaderboards.
  • Perfect for players who are just starting their adventure with VR as well as those who are looking for challenge

data.name: Escape The Cavern Abyss
data.detailed_description:
Escape the Cavern Abyss

Collect the keys. Survive the cavern. Reach the gate.

Escape the Cavern Abyss is a challenging 2D platformer inspired by classic platforming adventures. Explore dangerous caverns, collect the keys needed to open the gate at the end of each stage, and survive deadly obstacles and enemies along the way.

You'll need more than quick reflexes to escape. Ammo is limited, so choose when to fight and when to avoid enemies. Defeated enemies can drop coins and ammunition, giving you valuable resources as you progress.

But watch your step — one hit can cost you a life.

Explore, Collect, Survive

  • Collect keys to unlock the gate and escape each stage.

  • Collect coins to increase your score and help recover lost lives.

  • Find and conserve ammunition to keep your weapons ready for dangerous enemies.

  • Discover magical shields that can protect you from a single enemy hit.

  • Find hidden stashes containing lives, ammo, and valuable high-value coins.

  • Search for berry plants that can reward you with coins and extra time.

  • Bounce/Hit purple berries to build up increasingly valuable rewards, including coins, time, ammunition, and extra lives.

  • Avoid deadly hazards including spikes, acid, enemy projectiles, and other obstacles.

Every Life Counts

With one-hit deaths, every jump and every encounter matters. If you lose all your lives, you can choose to spend your hard-earned coins to buy your way back into the game rather than starting over.

Plan your route, manage your resources, and keep moving forward.

Can you escape the Cavern Abyss?

data.name: Boardmancer
data.detailed_description:
Boardmancer is a fresh twist on the deckbuilding roguelike genre, where the board itself becomes your deck. Roll your dice to move around the board, customize your board with powerful abilities, and face dynamic enemies who share and interact with the same board, turning every move into a strategic challenge.

Unlike traditional deckbuilders where you play cards, Boardmancer lets you craft and play your board. Each tile has unique abilities that can be activated by spending energy after landing on them, offering endless strategic possibilities. Combine this with the ability to collect and customize dice with unique sides and special effects, and you’ll experience a roguelike where both your board and dice define your playstyle.

Enemies in Boardmancer are not passive obstacles—they’re active participants. They move across the board alongside you, using its mechanics to their advantage and creating a dynamic battlefield where strategy and adaptability are key.

data.name: Neon Defense 1 : Pink Power
data.detailed_description:
Neon defense is a minimalistic tower defense game with elements of a puzzle game.
You have to beat waves of enemies to defend a map.

The twist between this and normal tower defense games is that enemies in this games have special abilities which make it necessary to find a way how to beat them. In most maps you cannot simply build a defense line with towers, you also need to analyse the enemies and find a way how you can beat them. Use 4 different towers and their special attack way, aiming with the mouse and mouse gestures to defend the maps against the enemies.

The game is easy to learn but hard to beat.


Features:
- 20 levels + 3 Bosses
- Easter Egg
- Around 30 different enemies, half of them with special abilities to defend theirselfs.
- Minimalistic design
- 3 Difficulties
- Steam Achievements
- 4 different towers, each comes with 3 upgrade tiers
- 1 Special Tower only in Boss level
- Cloudsave

data.name: Freiwillig
data.detailed_description:
Join the ranks of the volunteer fire department in Tübingen, Germany, and defend the city from evil-doers through arcade puzzle action!

The Firefighter Duel

Rotate and drop the falling blocks to create reaction chains for big points! Fire ignites bombs, toasts marshmallows, and burns wood. Water extinguishes fire. Ice extinguishes fire and melts into water. Water, wood, and brick clear if five or more are connected.

Story Mode

Play as one of the brave men or women (or cats in human disguise) in the Tübingen fire department and duel your way through a deep plot that threatens the city!

Infinity Mode

Go for a high score on your own, but beware: the game gets faster and more difficult the longer you play!

data.detailed_description:
Notice of 'Cross-Save function' service termination.

Thank you for your continued patronage. We regret to inform you that the "Cross-Save" service for this product will end as of April 26, 2023. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and ask for your understanding. Please note that game play itself will continue to be available.


About the Game

"Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi" is the 15th entry in the historical simulation game series Nobunaga's Ambition. Where a warrior's resolve exceeds their ambition. We offer the grandest warring states experience to all the fans out there! (Resolve System) Each clan is set apart due to their various "Resolves." We will shine a light on the Resolve of each officer, bringing out diversity in the game play and strategies. The simulation AI has evolved, allowing players a greater sense of immersion in fighting more humanlike Daimyo. (New Strategy) The Civil & Diplomatic systems have been revamped. With a variety of elements new to the series, the player's eye for strategy will be tested. The new evolved Civil & Diplomatic systems show greater depths. (Final Battles) Clash during the "Order/Advance phase," where players try to anticipate their enemies' movements. We use a simultaneous plot system to show the fun of anticipating your opponent and real, high tension battles. (Volume) Lots of officers. Over 2,000 officers appearing and a single high definition 3D map. (Historical Drama) We shine a light on the lives of the officers in this best of all historical dramas. We have included many events showing historical events, stories, and even regional folklore.

Kingdoms either bow before their flames—or burn.


You awaken in another world as one of the legendary Dragon Riders—able to command dragons themselves, and build your own dragon harem.
As a Dragon Rider, when you claim a dragon—when you ride her—you bind her will and power to your own.

Can you defy mankind’s fate as prey and rise above gods and dragons alike? The world awaits your domination, Dragon Master!

A fast-paced roguelite drenched in Japanese flair. Face swarms of enemies and mighty bosses, gather rewards, and grow stronger with every battle.

Gather alchemy shards to awaken your dragon maidens through the Talent System, so they rise again—fiercer, deadlier, and bound ever closer to their master’s will

data.name: Gnome Dome
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the GNOME DOME.

You’ve been hired to work the night shift inside a strange enclosed garden. Your job sounds simple: water flowers, pull weeds, trim hedges, repair equipment and finish every task before your shift ends.

There’s just one problem.

The gnomes are watching.

Every task has its own time limit. Finish it quickly and you’ll earn extra time for your overall night shift. Let the task timer reach zero, however, and one random gnome somewhere in the garden will come to life.

Your task doesn’t end.

You still have to finish it.

Only now, something is hunting you.

FINISH THE JOB

Each night gives you a series of gardening and maintenance tasks to complete across the garden.

Work quickly, stay organized and keep an eye on your timers.

Completing tasks rewards additional shift time, giving you a better chance of surviving the night.

But if your main shift timer reaches zero, you enter OVERTIME.

The job isn’t over.

The gnomes simply stop playing nice.

WHICH GNOME MOVED?

The GNOME DOME is filled with garden gnomes.

Most of them are harmless decorations.

Most of the time.

Whenever a task timer expires, one random gnome becomes active and begins hunting you.

You won’t be told which one.

Was that gnome standing there before?

Was it always facing you?

And where did the one beside the hedge go?

THE WATER IS SAFE... FOR NOW

The garden’s water provides temporary protection.

Gnomes cannot follow you into the water, making ponds and flooded areas valuable escape routes during a chase.

But you cannot hide forever.

Swimming drains your stamina, and when it runs out, staying underwater becomes just as dangerous as returning to shore.

FOUR NIGHT SHIFTS

Return to the GNOME DOME across four increasingly disturbing nights.

Each shift introduces:

  • More dangerous time limits

  • New gardening tasks

  • Increasingly aggressive gnomes

  • Strange changes throughout the garden

  • New areas and discoveries

  • A growing mystery surrounding the Dome itself

What begins as an unusual gardening job slowly turns into something much worse.

FEATURES

  • Short first-person horror experience

  • Four escalating Night Shifts

  • Timed gardening and maintenance tasks

  • A separate timer for the entire shift

  • Random gnome activation when tasks run out of time

  • Multiple gnomes can become active during Overtime

  • Swimming and limited swim stamina

  • No combat — survive through movement, timing and smart decisions

  • Old-school text-based dialogue with retro text sounds

  • Multiple endings

  • Hidden lore connecting GNOME DOME to The Twisted Universe

The rules are simple.

Finish your tasks.

Watch the clock.

And never assume the gnome beside you is still just a decoration.

data.name: Squamations
data.detailed_description:
Guide 3 starving Chameleons as they chow down on delicious letter-crumbs. The letters are so tasty that they quickly appear on the Chameleon's color changing scales. Help them eat and submit as many words as you can before the time runs out!


1. Each Chameleon has it's own colony of ants conveniently transporting a stockpile of letter-crumbs.
2. Clicking on crumbs will add that letter to the Chameleon's word in that row.
3. Completed words are submitted with keybinds or by clicking the Chameleon's mouth.


  • Create words using 3 separate lanes of letters.
  • Three timed modes allow for shorter or longer games.
  • Choose from 5 custom bug cursors to entice the Chameleons.
  • Top 5 high-score list for each time mode.


Squamations uses 3 to 6 letter words from the English Open Word List resulting in over 30,000 acceptable words.

data.name: Miney Company: A Data Racket
data.detailed_description:
Miney Company: A VR physics-based racquetball-inspired game where you 'work from home' for your new employers Miney Company. Your job is to collect data blocks from around the universe for Miney Company to profit from by selling to the highest-bidding potentially nefarious multinational corporations. With 13 playable levels, multiple types of data-collecting mechanics, and different types of rackets, you can smash, hunt, and protect your data from rival data miners while hanging out with your location coordinators Albert, Benjamin, and Cecil.

Miney Company wants to connect VR enthusiasts with the data mining needs of fictitious multinational corporations. Our online data gathering matches freelance labor with borderless corporations and their bottomless demands for data, allowing labor flexibility and low overhead as well as high employment satisfaction for people who like to work in their pajamas from home.

"‘Eh, It’s a job. And it’s flexible enough that it doesn’t take away from my ride-share driving gig. I also don’t have to put on pants for it, so there’s that. Unlike my ride-share gig…" —Albert

"Miney Company sure knows how to look out for their employees! Wait, I mean look at their employees. They aren't too into data privacy if you know what I mean." —Benjamin

"It's not so much of a job as it is something you waste time doing and are rewarded with a fiat currency." —Cecil

data.name: Selve
data.detailed_description:
Idi is a lonely girl who doesn't feel a strong bond with her tribe. Everything begins to change when they need her for the first time, the spirits have chosen her to carry out a mission, though no one yet knows their true purpose.

Selve is a first-person musical adventure set in a small tribe on the edge of extinction. Everything gets complicated when the spirits, to punish the tribe, turn its only water source into blood.

Idi must use her musical talent to soothe the spirits and bring back peace, all while trying to understand what angered the spirits in the first place.

Learn the sacred songs

The Mulong have created sacred songs that must be played perfectly to properly affect the weather and time (among other things). Use those songs to help your tribe survive this crisis.

Improvise songs

Improvise songs to bring to life a special creature made of mud, who will help you overcome the obstacles you encounter on your journey.

Liberate the guardian spirits

Use the mud creatures to destroy the crystals embedded in the bodies of the guardian spirits and obtain the sacred songs.

data.name: GROKAI
data.detailed_description:
GROKAI

This is an A.I. Generated Text Based "Create Your Own Adventure" Game
You help form a Team of worthy Adventurers to go on Several Quests over Many Challenging Levels

Characters:
You the Player are the heart of the Team,
and Grok is a brave and adventurous hero,
while Archor Wright is a witty and resourceful sidekick who provides comic relief and support.

Setting:
In an unknown time, the world has become a place where PUNs and MEMEs reign supreme. The International Court of Justice has ruled that all conflicts must be resolved through the use of wordplay and humor, and the United Nations has been replaced by the United PUNs and MEMEs (UPM). In this brave new world, even the most serious of issues are tackled with a healthy dose of laughter.

In this setting, the "Choose Your Own Adventure" game genre has become the primary form of entertainment, as people seek to escape the absurdity of everyday life. Players can explore a variety of humorous and pun-filled worlds, where they can make choices and shape their own destinies. From the post-apocalyptic wasteland there is something for everyone in this diverse and engaging genre.

As players embark on their adventures, they can take comfort in the fact that they have the power to make a difference in their own virtual worlds. In a time of laughter and absurdity, these games offer a unique opportunity to explore, learn, and grow, all while having a bit of fun along the way.


Features :

Choices Matter
Multi-Path
Cool Text Styling
Uses a Unique A.I. Generated Text Based System

Can You spot ALL of the "Easter Eggs" in the Game?


* NOTE : The Game is TEXT BASED and ENGLISH ONLY at this time. *

data.detailed_description:
Lost Rift is a high-stakes First-Person Survival Adventure Shooter that brings together extensive base building, quests, open-world survival crafting, and intense extraction expeditions that you can play in PvPvE or cooperative PVE modes. Created for up to 5 players or solo play, explore a rich, immersive, and mysterious world where you transform from a modern survivor into a legend.

You wash up on a beach at Pioneers’ Landing, part of a beautiful and mysterious archipelago of islands. With several unique survivors to recruit, your quests will uncover the real reason behind your arrival. On your instanced open-world PvE island, you will gather resources, build a camp, craft equipment, explore the area, and prepare for intense multiplayer expeditions to extract needed loot.

BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE BASE CAMP

Use your creativity to build a safe base camp and shelter anywhere on your personal PvE island. Use materials to make crafting benches, cooking stations, and build a unique modular stronghold. Survival isn’t just about taking on enemies, it’s about mastering your surroundings and making a home base that fits your style.

FIGHT IN ADRENALINE-FUELED EXTRACTION EXPEDITIONS

Dive into intense multiplayer PvPvE expedition shootouts, with a PvP-focus, on other unstable islands to extract the most valuable resources. Fight against other players to risk it all for sought-after loot, testing your might, shooting skills, and strategic route planning to emerge victorious before time runs out.

THRIVE ACROSS AN EVER-EVOLVING ARCHIPELAGO

Become a legendary co-op or solo survivalist while hurricanes, fires, and lightning strikes threaten everything. Dense fog shrouds the landscape in an eerie silence. Bravery is a necessity as you continue your adventure and navigate the challenging dynamic environment.

Lost Rift uses dedicated, geo-located servers to provide a smooth and consistent experience across PvE and PvPvE.

data.name: Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition
data.detailed_description:
Digital Deluxe Edition

This Deluxe Edition includes the following:

  • Blue Camo Weapon Skin

  • Blue Camo Armor Skin

  • The Art of Alien: Rogue Incursion Digital In-Game Artbook


About the Game

Made for Alien fans. Built for action-horror. Re-envisioned for PC.

Play as rogue Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks in the terrifying first chapter of a two-part saga set between the Alien and Aliens films. Sent to investigate a distress call on the remote planet Purdan, Zula uncovers a secret Weyland-Yutani blacksite overrun by deadly Xenomorphs.

Stalking, hunting, and attacking at every turn, these Xenomorphs' ferocity is matched only by their unpredictability. Aided by your synth companion, Davis 01, fight and survive using your weapons, skills, and sheer determination against a deadly Xenomorph incursion in this gripping original story.

Rebuilt for PC with stunning visuals, 60 fps, 3D audio, haptic feedback, and adaptive triggers, Alien: Rogue Incursion Evolved Edition delivers a cinematic action experience that makes you truly feel like you’re inside the world of Alien.
