data.name: SimplePlanes 2
data.detailed_description:
SimplePlanes 2 is the long-awaited sequel to the original aircraft-building classic, featuring new parts, shiny new graphics, chaotic multiplayer, new physics, and more! 

Build planes using enhanced wing and fuselage parts. It's easier than ever to build the plane of your dreams! Reshape the airfoil of your wings using real NACA profiles with overhauled flight physics, or use improved fuselage editing to create an endless variety of shapes. Then grab your input device of choice (mouse/keyboard, controller, and HOTAS are all supported) and fly!

Build anything else you can imagine using a host of new parts. With the new suite of procedural powertrain parts, you can build cars, propeller aircraft, forklifts, and so much more, with detailed physics. If you're overwhelmed by the idea of building something from scratch, there are tons of stock crafts available from the start that you can load, tune, and reverse engineer, with an extra 40+ hidden around the map waiting to be discovered!

Make your crafts your own with paint texturing and engine tuning. Once you've put your craft together, you can use the improved paint tool to give it colour and texture. Then when that's done, you can get into the nitty gritty with engine customization, tweaking the size, cylinder count, transmission, and more to get your craft running exactly the way you want it.

Craft procedural missiles and blow your enemies to smithereens. SimplePlanes 2 features a brand new procedural missile part that gives you a blank canvas to create the perfect weapon. Change the size, the guidance type, give it as many visual details as you want, and more! Then you can watch it turn your target into a fireball with the new volumetric explosions!

Take your new creation through beautiful environments packed with detail. The new SimplePlanes Archipelago is a lovingly crafted world covered in trees, roads, rivers, airports, and even a race track. Explore 787 square kilometers of detailed terrain above and below the water, drive through 330 kilometers of roads, explore Vetusta City, or take to the seas with new water graphics and physics.

Cause chaos in a variety of activities in multiplayer, or just hang out. With multiplayer, you can play with up to nine other players (or even more in a private lobby) and finally test your crafts on something other than bots. Race each other, kill each other, co-operate with each other, and more! And with our new playable mascot, Major Chad, you can get out and stretch your legs with other players as well!

Download 1,000,000+ crafts made by the community for free, even from SimplePlanes 1. SimplePlanes 2 features backwards compatibility with crafts made in the original SimplePlanes, meaning over a decade of history is seamlessly playable just as it was before. Please note that while we've made an effort to support these old crafts as well as possible, we still can't guarantee that all of them will behave the way they were originally supposed to.

data.name: SnackTimeActionGame
data.detailed_description:
[Snackable hero experience!]

Including a city roamed by zombies, a western street corner crossed by bullets, and a samurai battle through the four seasons, there are many situations available, This game is 2D action game to enjoy feeling like a hero or a monster in a short time & easily!

There are 10 types of situations + α & 35+ playable characters!

By completing each situation, bonus characters will be unlocked, and eventually 35+ characters will be available to enjoy. Some characters have overwhelming power, so you can experience the experience of knocking down your enemies!

The combination depends on your mood!

Once you have cleared a situation, you can use all unlocked characters. Cowboys vs. Ninjas, Pirates vs. Zombies, Samurai vs. Space Monsters, Shark vs. Villains - the combination depends on your mood!

Easy difficulty!

The overall difficulty level is low so that you can enjoy the feeling of being a hero. However, enemy bosses in each situation will attack you with their own unique attacks. Watch their movements and defeat them calmly!

No difficult storyline.

Although the objective in each situation is presented, there is no storyline that interferes with the play. "Today I'm going to be a cowboy and fight pirates!" If you decide to be a that's the story!

Added High Difficulty [Bittersweet]

I have added a high difficulty mode in response to requests for a greater challenge. New and tougher enemies will block your path.

The new situation & new character addition update [JazzAge] is now live!

On October 3, 2026, we added a new situation themed around the Jazz Age and a new playable character!

New Situation & Character Update [Vampire vs Werewolf] Now Available!

On 2026/3/31, we added a dark gothic new situation themed around Vampire vs Werewolf, along with new playable characters!

The new situation & new character update [Dinosaur Update] has been launched! On July 31, 2025, a new situation themed around dinosaurs and new playable characters will be added!

The new situation and new character addition update [Gladiator Update] has been released!

A new situation themed around gladiators and new playable characters will be added on 2/14/2025!

Please look forward to future updates

Plans are underway to add new stages and playable characters in post-launch updates to ensure that you can enjoy the game for a long time. Stay tuned for more information!

data.name: Tidy Arcana
data.detailed_description:
While you were away, a jealous wizard turned your library upside down, and scattered 1,560 items throughout your library: 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to be precise!

Match 14 book designs and nine potion types to the signs on their shelves.

Items are nicely highlighted when you point at them, making it easy for you to quickly pick up what you want to organise!

If you have trouble locating a particular type of book or potion, visit the wizard cat and use Help Me Find.

Your character becomes more efficient as you complete more shelves and you even get a fun sorting spell to help you a bit!

There are no timers, penalties or failure states. Sort everything at your own pace, save when you choose, and return later to continue your progress.

Features:

  • Sort 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions.

  • Restore 14 book collections and nine potion families.

  • Match book designs and potion shapes to their shelf signs.

  • Carry up to seven items at once.

  • Choose which items to collect and which shelves to complete first.

  • See a placement preview before shelving a compatible item.

  • Use Help Me Find to highlight a selected item type and its shelf.

  • Pet, rename and customize your wizard cat.

  • Play without timers, penalties or failure states.

data.name: Eystrandi
data.detailed_description:
Eystrandi is a 2D, Norse - inspired Metroidvania. It is heavily inspired by the Norse time period and culture. On top of this, Eystrandi's being a Metroidvania means that it consists primarily of exploration, with a good part of it being combat as well. You will be searching for the permanent upgrades iconic to Metroidvanias, and encountering the obstacles that are iconic as well, anything from a wall that you cannot scale, to a boss you cannot beat will be useful to remember for when you can.

  In Eystrandi, health is a scarce resource, constantly draining, one must use the vampiric properties of their weapons to outpace their own rapid health loss. Thus, surviving is not just staying out of harm's way, but also regaining health through the felling of one's enemies.

   The storytelling of Eystrandi is significantly more mainstream, with the story scattered all across the island upon which the game is set, one must piece together bits found in everything from an everyman's journal, to the very artifacts that one seeks to progress.

data.name: GAIN
data.detailed_description:
GAIN is a first person stealth game with perma-death. You play as Xavier, who is on a simple mission to not die. Each level contains a document which he has to collect and reach the exit the door. The only problem is that Xavier will die if he is shot at all. No regenerating health or health packs. He has to complete the missions flawlessly.



  • Slow down time to land a bullet in the guards brain.
  • Hardcore perma death. Once you die its back to the beginning
  • Freeze guards with your bow
  • Compete with friends with steam leaderboards
  • Developed on Unreal 4

data.name: The Life Of Greather
data.detailed_description:
You are no hero, no saviour, you are just a simple farmer by the name of Greather.

Your wife left to get some supplies early this morning, but she has not returned as of yet and the sun has now set.
You know how harsh the lands beyond your village can be.

Venture across this open Medieval world in search of your wife Ellyn.
Complete tasks given to you by others while on your journey, do whatever you can to find her.

Criminals and other foul creatures roam the wild, so make sure you are prepared before venturing out too far into the wilderness.

data.name: BoneHeads
data.detailed_description:
BoneHeads is a physics-based sword-fighting party game where every swing is under your direct control and losing limbs only gives you new weapons to fight with. Keep swinging, throwing, hopping, and headbutting until somebody gets blown to bits.

FIGHT TO THE LAST BONE

Losing a limb does not mean losing the fight. Every bone that gets knocked off can be picked up, swung as a weapon, or thrown straight back at your opponent. Even without your arms, legs, or head attached, you are still in the fight until there is nothing left of you but a pile of bones.

TAKE CONTROL

Every swing of your sword is directly controlled by you. Attack from any angle, block incoming strikes, throw your weapon, or improvise with whatever bones are lying around. BoneHeads is built around responsive, skill-based combat.

FIGHT ANYWHERE

Take the fight from moonlit graveyards and haunted banquets to sunken pirate ships, neon alleys, volcanic caverns, candy kingdoms, and even outer space.

LOCAL AND ONLINE MULTIPLAYER

Fight with up to 4 players locally or online. Go head-to-head in 1v1, team up for 2v2, or turn everyone loose in a free-for-all. AI opponents can fill out matches or give you someone to beat up when your friends are not around.

FIGHT TOGETHER

Team up locally or online in the Arcade Ladder together, or survive increasingly dangerous waves of enemies in Wave Survival.

MAKE IT YOURS

Make your BoneHead your own with the character Skin Creator, build arenas with the Stage Creator, and share them with others online.

*Teleportation is also available for those who want to play standing in one location.
*Solve puzzles to help you escape the room.
*High-quality sound design and an original musical score.
*High-quality visuals made with the power of Unreal Engine 4.

data.name: Lonelode
data.detailed_description:
Use mining tools to battle the computer and fight for control of lonelodes.

Key Features

  • Each turn, you’ll get a mining tool with its own unique shape and behavior.

  • Rotate your tool to find the best placement.

  • Watch out for hidden mines — they can blow up your tool.

  • Some moves may lead to unexpected results.

In the end, whoever controls more lonelodes wins.

For detailed rules and tips, please check the in-game tutorial.

Ready to defeat your opponent?

data.name: KARANEKO
data.detailed_description:
In Karaneko, players journey through a pixel art fantasy world in a relentless bullet hell RPG adventure. Confront and overcome formidable obstacles as you strive to return to your original realm.

You can examine objects, explore three distinct regions to uncover their mysterious histories, and interact with or battle non-player characters.

Choices made in dialogue and combat can have short- or long-term effects that alter the game. Depending on the player's decisions, Karaneko offers a rich, diverse gameplay experience with elements of adventure, psychological, romance, and horror genres.

In this magic-driven world, how can you survive without any magic? Will you overcome the challenges you face with your fists, through conversation, or perhaps by making friends and seeking their help?

data.name: White
data.detailed_description:
"White" is an adventure game with a slight horror element, where you progress through randomly placed white rooms.

Game Content

This is an adventure game where you move and explore from a first-person perspective.

Essentially, your goal is to clear the traps in the white rooms that appear one after another and reach the goal.

However, sometimes you'll encounter rooms with strange behavior.

There is also a game over system, so be careful.

Note that the same room may appear multiple times.

Number of endings: 2

Controls

Movement: WASD

Action: E

Menu: Q

Dash: Left Shift

Jump & Text Advance: Spacebar

Video streaming

・We would appreciate it if you could include the name of the game in the title of your video or stream, and include a link to the Steam page in the description section or elsewhere. (This is optional.)

We are not responsible for any damages caused by streaming videos of this game.

Please be aware of the adult content section.

The contents of this guideline may change without notice.

data.name: GAZED
data.detailed_description:
You are stuck in a maze with one to three other players. There is only one goal: find them, see them, GAZE THEM, before they find you.

GAZED is a game about using your wits and abilities to outsmart and outplay your friends. Navigate around a procedurally generated maze, hunting players while they hunt you.

Use a wide range of abilities to learn whereabouts, gain a strategic edge, or deceive the competition. Abilities are selected in groups of three, so find what combination fits your playstyle best. From slinking around the map slowly gathering information, strategically placing baits and red herrings, or running in head-first hoping to get the drop on someone, there are abilities that support the way you want to play.

Broken record pieces are scattered across the maze. Find four pieces to put the record back together, and play it at a record player to become invincible until the song stops. Your opponents can do the same, so find them quick to gain a significant advantage.

When death comes in an instant, you must be on your guard at all times. Use your abilities, anticipate their movements, track their location, mislead their ears, deceive their eyes...

...but whatever you do, don't get

data.name: Light of the Mountain
data.detailed_description:
"To whoever may find this letter. I may have passed by the time you read this, but know that I was happy."

Light of the Mountain is a puzzle solving adventure game that tells the story of a dying man by the name of Isaac Elliot who is stranded on a mysterious island, home to giant towering mountain with a curious bright light at its peak. Isaac alone must explore the island and even the deepest depths of his own dreams in order to unlock the island's secrets and come to terms with what may very well be the end of his life - Explore the island, solve its mysteries, delve into a world of dreams, and find the meaning of the light on the mountain.

Light of the Mountain's gameplay is focused on exploration and using the game's four tools to solve various puzzles and overcome obstacles. Discover the island's many hidden secrets and locations and play out the dreams of a dying man slowly losing his grip on reality. The protagonist, Isaac, details past events in his life, his hopes, his dreams, and his regrets, as he inches closer and closer to discovering the meaning behind the light on the mountain's peak.

data.name: Backrooms Lost Dimension
data.detailed_description:
Backrooms Lost Dimension is a single-player video game focused on exploring the famous and eerie levels of the Backrooms. To survive, players must solve intricate puzzles and escape malicious creatures. The game features an original, evolving story and will be constantly updated with new content through Early Access.

The Story

During an expedition, two archaeologists discover a hidden mural among ancient ruins, belonging to the mysterious Alborian civilization. Once decoded, the ancient prophecy engraved on the stone unleashes a black hole that sucks the two scholars in, plunging them into the distorted dimension of the Backrooms. Lurking in the shadows is Lady Rose, an enigmatic and iconic figure who appears to be the guardian of this place. Legend has it that if Lady Rose were to sing, her voice could collapse the entire dimension.

Backrooms: Wild Dimension (Multiplayer Mode)

Available in Q4 2026, Wild Dimension is the free-to-play multiplayer expansion of the game. Set in a distorted Backrooms timeline and structured as an open-world survival game, the action takes place on an island with diverse biomes.

This alternative reality was created by Lady Rose to deceive the Guardians of Time.

data.name: Ravva and the Netherworld Train
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a spooky adventure through the realm of the dead!

Ravva and the Netherworld Train is a pixel-art adventure game where you play as Ravva, a young summoner, and their 4 companions! Each has unique powers to overcome obstacles while also giving the player different options to proceed, but that's not all. This time, you can also fuse Ravva with each companion, resulting in whole new creatures to play with! Explore the underworld with many new possibilities!

STORY

In this adventure, young Ravva will need to go further than they've ever been: The Netherworld. After their father goes missing, Ravva follows the clues and finds out that he is lost in the land of the dead! But how do you get there? Why was he taken there? That's something our brave hero will have to find out!

data.name: Touch Type Tale - Strategic Typing
data.detailed_description:
Your fingers... Yes, those. They are astonishingly nimble! I have never seen their like. Use them to type your way through a strategic challenge like no other. Become the unlikely hero of Minsteria, whose vacant throne is vulnerable to the grasping hands of sly nobles and warmongering bandits.

Use your typewriter to construct armies, build villages and defeat miscreants across a sprawling tactical campaign dotted with big gameplay surprises.

This quest will challenge veteran strategists and newcomers alike. But I believe in you, Paul! You know what they say: the keyboard is mightier than the sword.

MASTER A UNIQUE STRATEGY CHALLENGE

  • Conquer your opponent's Village by commanding armies of Swordsmen, Archers, Spearmen and Cavalry, with Golems and Catapults thrown in for extra carnage.

  • Acquire gold by hiring Workers to mine and farm. Grow and enhance your forces by spending gold on unit upgrades and buildings such as Stables, Barracks and Spearhuts.

  • Engage in melee and ranged combat, making tactical decisions based on unit types, army size, and which routes lay ahead. Deal bonus damage by charging down the enemy or flanking them in a pincer movement.

  • Use nifty spells that grant you an edge, adding an Ink Factory to unlock advanced magic like Teleport and Plague.

USE YOUR KEYBOARD TO CONTROL EVERYTHING

Throw away your mouse. Go on, cast it into the fire — for you control the entirety of Touch Type Tale with your keyboard. Type to construct buildings. Type to mine gold from ore deposits. Type to maneuver your armies down a strategic path. Type to pull the perfect pint. Face terrific typing minigames like a cook-off, shooting gallery, rhythm game, bullet hell, and a Grand Strategy challenge.

CONQUER ONLINE MULTIPLAYER SKIRMISHES

Unleash your skills on the wider world and emblazon your name on the Leaderboards.

BE A GREATER TYPE OF TYPIST

Improve typing accuracy, typing speed, multitasking ability, and language skills — the text and typing mechanic is supported in thirteen languages. Choose a difficulty setting that suits your playstyle, and replay at increasingly higher difficulties to reap the rewards.

LET JIM BROADBENT TELL YOU A TALE

Naturally, beloved Oscar-winning actor Jim Broadbent is the voice of this ripping yarn. Our story's hero, Paul, is just a humble wizard's apprentice trying to avoid sorting someone else's toenail collection. Submerge yourself in a vivid fantasy world and discover how Paul became Minsteria's greatest hero — and never touched a toenail again.

TOUCH TYPE TWITCH

Stream the game on Twitch and give Chat control of the game! By typing words in Chat, viewers vote to type it in-game. Use Options in the Game Menu to link Touch Type Tale to your Twitch Channel and let chaos reign. (Cackle.)

data.name: Wooden Floor 2 - Resurrection
data.detailed_description:
"Wooden Floor 2 - Resurrection" is a first person horror/mystery adventure game. Just like the prequel this game is pretty much an one man project by me (Pheenix93).

The game is telling the story of Andrew Winter, an alcoholic living in a small cabin near the woods. He keeps having nightmares about an abandoned place that seems familiar to him. You have to reveal the dark secrets that are hiding in the abandoned mansion on top of the hill in Blackdust Field.
Are you able to find out the truth hiding in the deepest insides of the house?

"Wooden Floor 2 - Resurrection" is the sequel to Wooden Floor, telling the other side of the story and completing the puzzle.

Features of Wooden Floor 2:
  • Multiple endings!
  • Different playthroughs as the game changes upon choices you make, your behaviour and at certain points randomly
  • More interaction with the world
  • Secret riddles in game that may open up new possibilities for you (if you are able to reveal them)
  • Improved story telling in comparison to Wooden Floor
  • Different locations
  • Useable items
  • Big improvements to graphics and gameplay!

Besides all this there is still potential to add more content to the game once i feel like its about time. So there may be more to come...

data.name: Spooky Bodies
data.detailed_description:
Spooky Bodies is a charming puzzle game with a ghostly twist. In a world where nothing is as it once was, you take on the role of a ghost searching for your missing friends.

To rescue them, you'll need to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and rely on a special ability: possessing lifeless bodies.

Spooky Bodies offers a relaxed puzzle experience for players of all ages and the whole family.

Walls, fences, and other obstacles often block your path in human form. In those moments, it's important to find and cleverly use traps to leave your physical body behind and become a ghost.

As a ghost, you can float through most physical barriers and explore the world in new ways.

As a ghost, however, your ability to interact with the environment is limited. So keep a close eye on your surroundings and look for lifeless bodies. Slip into them and bring them back to life to progress through the level.

After all, only in human form can you complete levels or influence the physical world.

In Spooky Bodies, you’ll encounter a variety of objects you can interact with. Use your human form to open doors, trigger pressure plates, push crates, or rotate a crossbow.

As a ghost, you can float through most obstacles with ease. But even in your spectral form, there are a few special objects waiting to be discovered and possessed.

data.name: RebreatheR
data.detailed_description:
Descend into the depths of underwater horror and industrial routine.

RebreatheR is a story-driven horror game. You're a deep-sea diver working on the ocean floor. Explore a small open world beneath the waves. Collect industrial debris, repair pipes, follow your instruments, and conserve oxygen.

You’re no superhero — your suit is practically antique, oxygen is limited, and you can’t run from the unknown for long. Plan every step and take your time. Anything could be waiting for you in the deep.

Once the pipes are finally found — the real trial begins.

Sneak through abandoned labs, monstrous structures, and dark caves inhabited by unknown forms of life.

Mysticism, hallucinations, glitches in perception — you're no longer sure reality even exists.

Features:

  • Two gameplay phases: free exploration and claustrophobic story-driven segments.

  • Interaction with underwater flora and fauna — from neutral creatures to aggressive, anomalous predators.

  • Subtle horror approach — no jumpscares at every corner, with a focus on atmosphere, unease, and slowly building dread.

  • Stamina, oxygen, and total darkness — limited resources create constant tension, and every decision could be deadly.

data.name: 灰界年代记
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview Greybound Saga is a fantasy world stripped of its color. Activate ancient altars, recruit heroes, and explore labyrinths in light turn-based combat. Uncover the truth and restore its former prosperity.

  • Strategic Turn-Based Combat: Enjoy light strategy with asymmetric grids and skill range combos.

  • Freeform Gear Crafting: Collect materials, forge gear, and refine affixes to build powerful equipment.

  • Deep Hero Progression: Recruit heroes, freely mix talents and gear, and assemble your ultimate party.

Diverse Dungeon Modes: Unlock maps in normal dungeons, break seals in roguelike tower climbs, or gamble for max rewards in Void Treasures—every run is full of surprises.

Core Gameplay

Light Turn-Based Tactical Combat

Heroes and monsters battle on asymmetric grids. Each skill has a specific area of effect—cone, line, and more. Pick your skills based on enemy positions to secure quick takedowns and end fights fast.

Freeform Crafting – Forge Your Own Gear

Gear is the core of progression. Equipment comes in multiple rarities—the higher the rarity, the more random affixes it carries. Use materials to craft gear at the forge, then refine affixes to tailor each piece for your heroes.

100+ Legendary Items – Build a One-of-a-Kind Squad

Discover over 100 legendary pieces of equipment, each with a unique, game-changing effect. These effects directly shape your combat experience. A single key legendary drop can lead you to rethink your entire lineup and skill setup.

Recruit and Train Your Heroes

Unlock more heroes as you progress. Choose from classes like Warrior, Assassin, Hunter, Mage, Priest, and Knight—each with a distinct talent system. Freely assign skills and talents based on battle needs to craft a party that matches your style.

Varied Adventures and Challenges

  • Auto-Battle: Enable auto-battle in regular dungeons to go hands-free and farm basic materials with ease.

  • Dungeon Progression: Push through region-based dungeons, unlocking new maps and facing tougher monsters with your squad.

  • Affix Rifts: Special dungeons with bonus map modifiers and extra rewards—ideal for quick, low-effort material farming.

  • Void Treasures: A high-risk, high-reward challenge. Battle through random rooms, picking a chest affix after each one. Affixes stack continuously. Defeat the final boss to unleash every reward at once in a satisfying loot explosion.

  • Prismatic Seal: A roguelike tower climb. Choose your path, break the seals, and defeat the boss. Each room stacks positive and negative effects—pick your route wisely based on your party's condition to maximize your gains.

Town Building & Management

Construct buildings such as the Ancient Altar, Forge, Apothecary, Shop, Loom of Fate, and Treasure Vault. These structures provide functions like gear crafting, affix refining, potion brewing, and item exchange. Upgrade them to unlock even more capabilities.

Game Atmosphere

This is a laid-back adventure and character-building game. There are 18 distinctive heroes, each with different unlock conditions, and you can freely assign them to different squads. Unlike typical idle games, the combat here requires you to position your heroes, match skills, and control turn order—keeping the fun of light strategic thinking without being exhausting. The overall pace is relaxed and brisk, perfect for picking up in your spare time to enjoy a leisurely adventure.

data.name: Coffee Fox: Kim Sam-wol
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Three thousand years of longing, one thousand livers devoured—
yet instead of ascending as an immortal, the nine-tailed fox Kim Samwol awakens as a human.

Drifting into the modern city, she is rescued by café owner Park Jongman and begins working at his small café. But when she discovers that Jongman is destined with the “King’s Fortune,” she must choose:
Devour his life to become immortal, or fall in love and embrace her fragile humanity.

Key Features

  • 🌙 Fantasy Romance Visual Novel – A mystical love story between a human and a nine-tailed fox.

  • 🦊 Fully Voiced Characters – Every character, except the protagonist, is fully voiced to bring emotions alive.

  • 🎨 Beautiful Spine Animations – Characters are brought to life with smooth animations beyond static 2D.

  • 🎶 Immersive Original OST – Music directed by Shin Jun-ki (BUZZ), with multiple original soundtracks.

  • ☕ Interactive Mini-games – Serve customers in a deduction-style café minigame where dialogue hints at their drinks.

  • 💖 Multiple Endings – Choose between the path of immortality, humanity, or fading into nothingness.

“Coffee Fox: Kim Samwol” is a story-rich visual novel that blends Korean mythology, romance, and modern life into an unforgettable experience.

data.name: Intake protocol
data.detailed_description:
Intake: Protocol is a prison intake officer simulator where you are responsible for inspecting incoming inmates and maintaining the facility’s security.

Examine prisoners, check their documents, and use specialized scanning tools to detect hidden contraband, injuries, and suspicious signs. Some inmates may try to conceal illegal items or deceive the system, so attention to detail is crucial.

Based on the results of your inspection, decide whether to send inmates to the general block, assign additional checks, or transfer them to the medical unit. Every mistake can have serious consequences for the safety of the entire prison.

TOOLS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE

Use various inspection methods to detect contraband, injuries, and suspicious signs.

THOROUGH INSPECTION

Examine each inmate’s belongings and uncover hidden threats before they enter the facility.

MEDICAL PROTOCOL

Monitor health indicators, process documentation, and provide medical assistance to those who need it.

data.name: The Coldest Winter
data.detailed_description:
Making decisions has never been harder.

New York is freezing, the dead rise around you, and something is odd about the space between your decisions and Jovanna’s actions.

Will you learn to decide as one or perish together as fools?

Explore making decisions are made under stress, pressure, uncertainty, and missing information.

But the twist is Jovanna's cursor has a mind of its own and she gets final say!

This turns each choice into a cooperation of two individuals. Creating tension between what you want to do and what Jovanna is willing... or even able to do.

Her emotions fight your decisions

Every stress directly affects Jovanna's cursor in real time. Decision-making becomes an expression of her current state. Her movement may become slower, less accurate, more erratic, or completely independent depending on what she is experiencing in the game.

Knowing what to do is only the beginning. Options will move around the screen, competing cursors interfere, and unexpected obstacles put you under more pressure to act.

Catch your breath. Make your move.

Players are not left helpless against the dangers.

The Survival Kit is a multi-functioning tool wheel that you can access to help manage the challenges you face. Gain more control while guiding Jovanna through difficult decisions.

When the pressure builds, turn to Jovanna’s Survival Kit.

The Deep Breath Ability will slow down time and temporarily relieve Jovanna of stress effects.

Explore A Nueva York

Experience New York through the eyes of Jovanna Peña, gaming's first female Dominican protagonist in a city shaped by the cultures that call it home. Meet New Yorkers from diverse backgrounds, discover neighborhood flavors, and even choose to eat vegan, all brought to life through bold, manga-inspired art, and an original musical score that blends Latin rhythms with psychological horror.

Explore its streets, examine your surroundings, and encounter the people caught in the same unfolding nightmare.

Beyond each conversation lies a larger mystery. What is happening to the city, and what will it take to survive the cold?

data.name: Nebula Complex Survival
data.detailed_description:
The year is 3001. After a plasma storm tears your ship apart, you are stranded on an alien world, Dylan-4.

The elements are the least of your worries, as a learning, dynamic enemy faction hunts you.

Set within the expansive Nebula Complex universe, this is not just a game of outlasting the elements; it is a story-driven fight for extraction. A planetary magnetic field has severed all communications, leaving you completely cut off from the rest of the solar system. Your only hope is to find a way to pierce the magnetic field.

INCLUDED IN EARLY ACCESS

Jump into the current build and experience the core foundation of Dylan-4's hostile ecosystem.

Survive Solo or Together

While Nebula Complex: Survival is built as a solo experience, you're free to team up with friends in co-op multiplayer out of the box. Share the tasks of resource gathering, coordinating base defense, and exploring the planet as a unit. Or brave the wilds solo!

A Dynamic, Expanding Enemy

The local flora and fauna are only part of the danger. The Natus Division, the solar system's most ruthless hostile force, has boots on the ground. This dynamic enemy faction of Mechanoids will actively patrol the map, build forward operating bases, and will launch coordinated sieges against your shelters if you are discovered.

Modular Base Construction

Survival requires shelter that can withstand the elements, and enemy assaults. Design and construct outposts using a modular building system. Snap together dedicated rooms, structural corridors, and utility modules to create a forward operating base of your own, without the clutter of placing smaller individual building pieces.

Tactile, Gear-Driven Inventory

Your carrying capacity and quick-access slots are defined entirely by the gear you wear. Equip backpacks to expand your main inventory space, strap on utility belts to unlock small-item hotbar slots, and use slings to keep your larger tools and firearms at the ready.

Two-Take Tech Progression

Forget standard tech trees. To advance your equipment, you must first scan remnants of local technology to synthesize your own designs. Additionally, you must analyze local alien materials at a molecular level to understand their composition and unlock their use in crafting.

THE ROAD TO 1.0 (UPCOMING FEATURES)

Nebula Complex: Survival is in active development. Throughout Early Access, the game will expand with massive, free content updates, including but not limited to:

  • Expanded Map & New Biomes: Venture deeper into the unknown as the playable area grows, introducing entirely new biomes, unique alien threats, and previously undiscovered resources.

  • Advanced Base Construction: A large expansion to the building system, adding new room types, utility pieces, and defensive structures to hold off the Mechanoid threat.

  • More Story & Lore: Discover the secrets of Dylan-4 and it's remnant resistance bases with extended narrative arcs, and the complete endgame sequence to finally escape the planet.

  • Evolving Natus Division: The enemy faction will grow smarter and deadlier, featuring entirely new Mechanoid unit types, advanced enemy base-building functionality, and deadlier tactics.

data.name: Capyon Onsen
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Capyon Onsen! A cozy idle game with many capybaras to keep you company. Take your time and enjoy the onsen atmosphere amidst nature without any pressure. In this game, you'll meet and get to know new capybaras and customize your onsen bath to your liking. The more capybaras you discover, the more new features you'll unlock. Now, let’s relax and watch these little cute capybaras enjoy their bath time with you.

Many capybaras are waiting to meet you

Send out invitations and welcome new friends from various regions to your onsen. There are a total of 36 types of capybaras in the collection, and as you advance further, you can even design your own capybara!

Upgrade, expand and develop your onsen for more profit

Transform a small, humble onsen into a magnificent place! Expand the area, improve water quality to accommodate more adorable guests, and get greater rewards.

Get interactive with your guests

Play, feed and brush your capybaras to make them happy. Even though they can take care of themselves, a little attention will make them like you even more. Perhaps you'll be rewarded even better as their Best Friend.

Design your own onsen

Customize the environments, trees, and decorations as you prefer.

Unlock new features

In addition to the above, you can also unlock new features and gameplay to gain more rewards. Such as

🌱 Home Garden - grow your crops for capybaras treats to get more favour.

🍡 Dango shop - mix and match dango to gain extra income. 

👑 Custom Capybara - design or modify your own capybara as your heart content.

And many more…

Feel free when idle

There is no pressure in this game! You can leave the game on in the background and spend your time with it at your own pace. Everything can run smoothly in full idle mode, so you don't have to worry about missing anything.

data.name: Dino Tendie World Tour
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Dino Tendie World Tour!

Embark on a globe-spanning adventure in this strategic turn-based RPG where collectible dinosaur-shaped chicken nuggets become powerful fighters. Build your team, train your Dino Tendies, equip powerful gear, and battle your way through tournaments, arenas, and cities across the world to become the ultimate Dino Tendie Champion.

In Dino Tendie World Tour, players travel between cities, challenge arena fighters, earn rewards, and strengthen their roster of Dino Tendies. Progress through the campaign by defeating trainers, collecting new species, upgrading your team, and overcoming powerful Arena Bosses that stand in your path.

Combat is turn-based and focuses on strategy, team composition, and elemental strengths and weaknesses. Each Dino Tendie possesses unique stats and abilities that can be enhanced through leveling, equipment, and customization. Players must carefully choose their team and battle tactics to overcome increasingly difficult opponents.

Key Features:

• Strategic Turn-Based Battles – Command your Dino Tendies in tactical combat where planning, elemental advantages, and team synergy determine victory.

• Collect and Train Dino Tendies – Discover and recruit over 31 unique Dino Tendie species, each with distinct stats, strengths, and progression paths.

• Level Up and Upgrade – Earn experience through battles, improve your fighters' abilities, and create powerful team combinations.

• Equipment and Customization – Equip armor, accessories, and cosmetic outfits that enhance stats and allow players to personalize their favorite Dino Tendies.

• Arena Challenges and Tournaments – Compete in Battle City tournaments and arena events to earn currency, rare equipment, and valuable rewards.

• Explore the World – Travel through many unique city environments, meet new challengers, and conquer major Arena Bosses as you advance through the story.

• Arcade Mode – Test your strongest team against increasingly difficult opponents in battle challenges.

Game Content:

Dino Tendie World Tour features a complete single-player campaign with approximately 50 hours of gameplay depending on player strategy, team building, and progression choices. The game combines creature collection, character progression, equipment management, and strategic turn-based combat into a unique adventure filled with collectible Dino Tendies and challenging arena battles.

data.name: Cradle of Souls
data.detailed_description:
SUMMARY


Cradle of Souls is a 2D RPG in the classic style of Valiant - Resurrection, Skyfall and Elendia Ceus.

The Cradle of Souls is where all life begins and ends, the very spiral of humankind. A long time ago, humans started making bargains with Salazar, the Soul Emperor. In exchange of their soul, the Emperor gave them unnatural powers, they became inhumans.

The Soul War was waged between humans and inhumans for the control of the country of Alastria. After winning the long and bloody war, Alastria is enjoying peace, but not the King. His wife, the Queen Jolanda is sick with a dangerous disease. In charge of finding the antidote is Orlando, the veteran Crusader, and Saigo, the Demon Hunter. What will happen as consequences of this mission and it's outcome will change everything...

FEATURES


Classic Storyline. Reminiscent of old-school JRPG classics
Classic party, with fun and intriguing interactions
Sidequest to complement the gameplay experience
Quest Journal to track your main quests and sidequests
Mouse support to those who prefer it

MORE GAMES TO PLAY

data.name: PARQUET
data.detailed_description:
Parquet is an upcoming Japanese-style visual novel produced by Yuzusoft Sour, a Japanese developer of romance VNs.




In the near future, a technology called Brain-Machine Interface connects the brain and machines. This technology brings about a new paradigm and opens the gates to the digitization of human memory itself.
From these new discoveries, "he" is born. An illegal experiment mixes thousands of memories into a single vessel, creating a wholly new being.
Having only the memories of others, doubts about who he truly is start arising in his mind, until he gathers the courage to go out into the world in search of his true self.
As he steps into the real world, he meets two girls, Kido Tsubasa and Ibaraki Rino.
Both kind souls whose lives have been touched by unscrupulous BMI experiments, just like him.
Learning to live together with their secrets, "he" and "they" will bring about big changes...

Key points:

  • Yuzusoft's first-ever original All-Ages game
  • Curious living together experience with girls between day and night
  • An intriguing mystery that unfolds itself as the story advances



Ibaraki Rino (VA: Touyama Nao)
Night Rose
Likes: Drinking (She enjoys the good company more than the drinks themselves)
This loner might seem distant and cold at first, but below the bravado lies a compassionate, gentle soul that yearns for what she never had.

data.about_the_game:
Parquet is an upcoming Japanese-style visual novel produced by Yuzusoft Sour, a Japanese developer of romance VNs.




In the near future, a technology called Brain-Machine Interface connects the brain and machines. This technology brings about a new paradigm and opens the gates to the digitization of human memory itself.
From these new discoveries, "he" is born. An illegal experiment mixes thousands of memories into a single vessel, creating a wholly new being.
Having only the memories of others, doubts about who he truly is start arising in his mind, until he gathers the courage to go out into the world in search of his true self.
As he steps into the real world, he meets two girls, Kido Tsubasa and Ibaraki Rino.
Both kind souls whose lives have been touched by unscrupulous BMI experiments, just like him.
Learning to live together with their secrets, "he" and "they" will bring about big changes...

Key points:

  • Yuzusoft's first-ever original All-Ages game
  • Curious living together experience with girls between day and night
  • An intriguing mystery that unfolds itself as the story advances

data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Smash Room: The Ultimate Destruction Experience!

In Smash Room, every session is an opportunity to unleash your inner chaos. Dive into an experience where you can let go of your frustrations in a safe and fun way. Our experience is designed to provide instant relief by allowing you to destroy everything in your path with a variety of tools and weapons.

Game Features:
  • Varied Environments: From cosy offices to castle courtyard, each room offers unique items to destroy.
  • Arsenal of Destruction: Choose from baseball bats, sledgehammers, and even a bow to wreck rooms. Each tool offers a different destruction experience.
  • Challenge Modes: Engage in timed challenges, precision destruction missions, and creative smashing sprees to earn special rewards.
  • Free Play: Just want to smash something? Free play allows you to summon objects to smash with a variety of weapons.
  • Stress Relief & Fun: Perfect for winding down after a long day or whenever you need a break from reality.

Why Smash Room?
Smash Room is more than just a game; it's a therapeutic journey. The experience of breaking things can help reduce stress and provide a sense of satisfaction. Our realistic physics and stunning graphics will make you feel like you're really in the room, smashing things to pieces.

Download Smash Room today and start your smashing adventure!

data.name: Temporarium
data.detailed_description:
Build a cozy aquarium for some of Lifes strangest little creatures.

Temporarium is a relaxing aquarium simulation inspired by vernal ponds and the unusual animals that call them home. Hatch and raise Triops, fairy shrimp, clam shrimp, water fleas, ostracods, mystery snails, and unique species variants while creating a habitat of your own.

Customize your aquariums with different substrates, backgrounds, plants, rocks, and decorations. Each species has its own needs, behaviors, life stages, eggs, and quirks, so you'll need to balance traditional aquarium care with conditions suited to the animals you're raising.

Keep an eye on oxygen, temperature, waste, algae, microfauna, and water chemistry as your tiny ecosystem develops. Feed your creatures different foods, watch them grow through their natural life cycles, and collect molts, eggs, and other discoveries along the way.

Complete Contracts and Research Milestones to earn Vivyx and Research Points, unlocking new species, equipment, foods, decorations, and other ways to expand your tanks.

Life in a vernal pond doesn't last forever. Eventually, your little creatures will reach the end of their lives but their eggs allow the cycle to begin again. Hatch a new generation, build a new habitat, and watch your tiny world come alive once more.

Main Features

 

  • Raise unusual aquatic animals including Triops, fairy shrimp, clam shrimp, water fleas, ostracods, and mystery snails

  • Build personalized aquariums using substrates, backgrounds, plants, rocks, and decorations

  • Manage living water systems including oxygen, temperature, waste, algae, microfauna, and water chemistry

  • Hatch dormant eggs and watch your animals grow through different life-cycle stages

  • Discover unique behaviors, milestones, species variants, molts, eggs, and other collectibles

  • Complete Research goals and Contracts to earn Vivyx and unlock new content

  • Experience a relaxing atmosphere filled with gentle ambience, original music, and tiny creatures to observe

About Development

Temporarium was created over three years during my recovery from a severe brain injury following a car accident while I was riding my bike. Building these tiny living worlds became part of that recovery and gave me something to look forward to each day.

I've been raising Triops on and off for more than 20 years, and this game grew out of that lifelong fascination with them and the strange temporary ecosystems they inhabit.

The artwork, creatures, sprite sheets, music, worldbuilding, and game design were created by me. Codex was used as a programming assistant during development.

Temporarium is a small, personal game about watching tiny lives begin, grow, and eventually make way for the next generation.

data.detailed_description:
Prepare to smile, laugh, and cry in Joojee’s Journey! In this whimsical

narrative adventure, you’ll play as Joojee, a lovable bunny who suddenly

data.name: AKUMA: Cyberpunk Rhythm Action
data.detailed_description:
Nova Tokyo Awaits

Nova Tokyo has risen like a phoenix from the ruins of the old capital. While it lives a mechanical life, the city hackers — specialists in hacking corporate systems — test their skills in ultimate challenges.

Those who are reckless enough, dare to participate in clandestine competitions — the so-called Hackons.

The participants have to hack the protection of the other hacker. Their bodies are at stake: lose in the Hackon and you must strip in front of your rival.

AKUMA! Bone-crashing rhythm action levels mixed with gorgeous visual novel elements. All together AKUMA delivers a unique cyberpunk setting that combines Japanese city pop culture, the aftermath of popped financial bubbles and the highlights of a futuristic capitalist society at its prime!

Become a Champion among the City Hackers

The main championship of this risky sport is held by the sukeban girls from the Shingi-Dan Gang under the lead of Akari, a tough nut to crack. She is vigilant to ensure that the contestants comply with the Hackon ethics — the ban on distributing photos of naked rivals.

The champion of the Hackon is rightfully considered to be the most powerful hacker in Nova Tokyo.

For many years, this title has been held by a talented hacker named Mira. She's not going to give up, even under the pressure of other worthy opponents!

One of them is Typhoon, a promising city hacker. Her goal is nothing less than an absolute victory. She is ready to do anything to achieve it.

What are her motives? Why is winning so important to her? And how far is she willing to go?

Your Rivals

Sakura — Famous Pop Idol

A former member of the popular girl group No Satisfaction Girls, who began a successful solo career.

This cheerful girl is an exemplary idol on the stage. Just don't let her playful personality and pretty appearance fool you. Behind the scenes, she is a promising city hacker. She takes part in the Hackons for the thrill, even though her agency forbids it.

Favorite music genre: Synthwave/Eurobeat

She rules them with an iron fist and makes sure that no one breaks the strict rules. She is always ready to take down another upstart. It is dangerous to cross her path — few have left her without experiencing the bitterness of humiliating defeat.

data.name: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover
data.detailed_description:
In the far future of 2027, corporations battle for world domination...

When his home was to be demolished for new expensive condos, the lazy shark-man Biff Steaks resolves to put a stop to the madmen in charge. However, he would soon find himself caught in a power struggle between two rival companies. He's recruited by Sue Flay, a jaded professional who takes her work seriously. Together, they'll secure Mask Corporations spot as the number one syndicate in the world!

Fight your way through armies of goons and unique bosses in a variety of levels! Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover combines the chaos of classic 2D beat em' ups with the freeform combat systems of character action games. Juggle enemies, use your environment, and unleash your powers to clear waves of enemies! Battle through unique environments led by their distinct bosses!

Play as Biff Steaks and utilize his fighting style which combines the human art of boxing with some signature moves of his own! Combine ducks and weaves with powerful blows!

Fight with Sue Flay, and slip through goons using her strange abilities! Each limb is a lethal weapon!

data.name: Raging Titan
data.detailed_description:
Raging Titan is a tower defense game in which you must defend your headquarters against waves of enemies rushing towards you. Build your towers, plan your efforts, watch out for changing paths and strike back against the alien invaders!
Show your tactical genius, your military leadership and your strategic thinking in this demanding fight!



War has come to Earth! Evil forces are attacking cities all around the world in an effort to extinguish mankind. The best military commanders are needed to fight the threat and save the life on the planet!

You are their archetype. A tactical genius, a fighter without fear. Equipped with a sense for the situation and experience of years of battle. You are sent as the spearhead to stop the enemies. It is in your hands whether we will survive or be forgotten!


Plan your best strategy and prevent your enemies from reaching their goal by building your defense towers. Control the enemy paths, shape the path they take to attack your and destroy them with a selection of your weapons!




Select the best from a selection of 10 hugely different towers. Control the masses by forcing them down a certain path with your Machine Gun towers, use the Plasma or Rocket towers as the backbone of your defense, or fry your enemies with a deadly lighting strike. Find the best tower for the types of enemies you are expecting and upgrade them in 3 different stages!




Shields, armor, airborne, walking, big and small - there are many enemies and each of them require a special tactic and counter measure to defeat them. Battle the robot infantry and face their bosses until the final command raider takes the battle into its own claws to bring down your Command HQ!




From fertile grasslands to the desert, from volcanic fissure to abandoned cities and from frozen mountain peaks to once beautiful beaches - fight the battle in 25 levels and diverse landscapes!

data.name: Earthia Mining
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Earthia!

After losing your work to Wizard Intelligence you found solace in Earthia's mines, it's time to mine valuable ores and chop trees. Sleep at the local inn and improve your abilities on this High Fantasy Medieval RPG in beautiful Earthia.

Mine your problems away

Get your pickaxe and start mining, your goal is to mine ores and turn them ingots to fill King's Quota. In this journey you will find different areas and upgrade your arsenal, by the end of the game day you will be chilling at the local inn. You will have to open new areas using the money you gathered with your hard work and more mines will be there to mined!

Open More Areas

The current Early Access version features the core mining and gathering loop. Players can explore different biomes with different ores, use 5 different tiers of pickaxes and experience the full Day/Night cycle. Cut trees, Ore Mines, upgrade the character, Use shop to buy new items to help you on your journey. More enemies and features are planned to come.

data.name: House Craft Voyage
data.detailed_description:
Build with your hands. Travel with your creations.

House Craft Voyage is a single-player adventure sandbox built around freeform construction and physics interaction. Along the journey, craft structures, vehicles, and devices from geometric blocks, turn ideas into reality, and keep moving forward with what you’ve made.

Create your own solutions
Facing terrain, mechanisms, and all kinds of challenges, there is no single right answer. Spawn blocks, reshape them, snap and weld parts together, combine drive components, and clear the way—explore, or simply play—on your own terms.

Physics-driven building
Welded structures respond to gravity, collisions, and power for real. Build cleverly and you may run steady or fly far; build freely and you may still get surprising results. Creating and experimenting are the core of the fun.

A journey rooted in the feeling of home
Explore, collect, and try things out in lived-in, everyday scenes. Building can clear a level—or express who you are. Dress a space the way you like, then take your work on the next stretch of the road.

Key Features

  • Freeform geometric building: spawn and combine many basic shapes

  • Snap & weld: join parts into stable structures or vehicles

  • Appearance painting: color your creations and make them yours

  • Physics interaction: real feedback from power, collisions, and structural stability

  • Exploration & puzzles: solve journey challenges through building

  • Single-player sandbox: create and adventure at your own pace

Start building—then set out.

data.name: SaveKunkun
data.detailed_description:
Game Introduction
Welcome to prank loop, a unique gaming experience that combines thrilling and humorous elements! You and your friends are both loyal fans of Cai Xukun. In the happy moments of playing games together every day, this day suddenly becomes different. Your friend decided to scare you through a prank, but ended up falling and getting injured. Due to the intervention of some mysterious force, this day keeps resetting, but only you have preserved the memory. You must use every loop to find a way to prevent your friend from falling and ultimately fulfill their prank plan.
Game features
Unique cycle mechanism: Experience the cycle of time reset, gradually solving the puzzle of preventing friends from falling.
Combining Fun and Thrilling: Adding humorous elements to a tense and stimulating atmosphere, allowing you to constantly switch between shock and laughter.
Multiple solutions: Nearly a hundred different props and strategies, each attempt will bring new surprises and challenges.
Exquisite visual effects: High quality graphics and animations immerse you in the world of gaming.
Profound Friendship Story: Explore the true essence of friendship and help your friend realize their prank dreams.
How to play:
You need to find various props and methods to prevent your friend from falling while they are playing pranks. Every failure will reset time, and you must find the right solution in a continuous loop. When you ultimately succeed, you will unlock more interesting achievements and see your friends smiling as they wish.
First mover experience:
The game is still under development and I will experience many interesting bugs in the early stages, but it will become less and less in the future! So buying early can experience more bugs
Kind reminder, if you encounter a bug that falls out of the world space or gets stuck, you can press Alt+F4 to exit the game!
The final tip
Be cautious when playing pranks to avoid hurting yourself. Are you ready to experience a thrilling and hilarious adventure in prank cycle?
Add to your wish list now and prepare for the endless cycle of challenges!

data.name: Pizza Dash
data.detailed_description:
Pizza Dash is a high-speed first-person delivery game with a simple goal. "Deliver pizzas as fast as possible!"
Race against the clock across a variety of challenging locations, optimizing your routes and pushing your skills to the limit.

Master advanced movement mechanics like bunny hopping and surfing to blaze through dynamic levels and deliver pizzas at lightning speed.

The faster you deliver, the faster you will climb the leaderboards, and prove you’re the ultimate Pizza Dasher!

But the challenge doesn’t stop there. With a built-in level editor, you can create and share your own custom delivery routes through the steam workshop, offering endless replayability and competition.

Key Features:

  • Fast-paced first-person movement with bunny hopping and surfing mechanics

  • Time attack gameplay focused on speed and precision

  • Multiple locations with increasing difficulty

  • Medal system and global leaderboards per route

  • Ghost system to see how other players achieved their time

  • Level editor to create and share custom routes

  • Steam Achievements

    Deliver fast. Move faster. Become a legend of Pizza Dash!

data.name: While Sleeping
data.detailed_description:
'While Sleeping' is a first-person horror game about experiencing sleep paralysis.

You are sleeping to go to work tomorrow, and you get sleep paralysis.

Your body is paralyzed and you can't move, and you can't do anything except look around or close your eyes and open them.

You have to survive until daybreak by experiencing ghosts and creepy phenomena that appear around you while you are sleeping paralyzed.

Playtime: Average 15 ~ 30 minutes.

Caution: To create a scary atmosphere, some of the details may be exaggerated compared to actual sleep paralysis.

Sleep Paralysis

You can't move your body. You can only open or close your eyes.

Creepy Phenomenon

Creepy phenomena continue to appear as time passes.

Don't get caught by ghosts

Each ghost that appears has a different way you should act.

Survive until the sun rises

You have to survive until you get out of sleep paralysis.

data.name: Breach : 83
data.detailed_description:
Watch the feeds. Spot the intrusions. Hold the line.

Vast, unknowable entities have become irresistibly drawn to the noise and chaos of humanity—like a storm collapsing upon a flickering candle. Their efforts to enter our world have fractured reality, creating BREACHES—unnatural rifts where the fabric of existence wears thin.

Monitor surveillance feeds across key locations. Detect and report Breaches. Let too many Breaches slip by, and it's Game Over—not just for you, but for all of us.

BE EVER VIGILANT. GOOD LUCK.

FEATURES:

Surveillance Horror Gameplay
Spot subtle (and not-so-subtle) changes in up to 5 live camera feeds per level. Miss too many and face the consequences.

Sabotage and Disruption

The Breaches aren't the only threat. Stay sharp—unknown forces are actively working to sabotage your watch. Expect planted explosives, booby traps, and camera interference designed to shatter your focus. These hazards demand immediate attention—hesitation only results in failure

- 8 Atmospheric Levels at launch.

Each location offers a distinct flavor of dread, including:

  •  Carnival – Once joyous, now twisted and abandoned

  •  Outpost – Isolated. Storm-wracked. Not alone.

  •  Hospital – They don’t rest in peace

  •  Theatre – One final, haunting performance

  •  Safe House – It wasn’t safe enough

  •  Haunted Mansion – Echoes and shadows cling to the walls

  •  Empty House – A fire still burns. Dinner is served. No one's home

  •  Cyberlab – Experiments incomplete... but still alive

Over 600 Unique Breaches
Each level features 3–5 camera feeds, and every feed contains at least 20 handcrafted, reality-defying Breaches. That’s up to 100 unique events per level to learn, spot, and survive.

Spot subtle (and not-so-subtle) changes in up to 5 live camera feeds per level. Miss too many and face the consequences.

Sabotage and Disruption

The Breaches aren't the only threat. Stay sharp—unknown forces are actively working to sabotage your watch. Expect planted explosives, booby traps, and camera interference designed to shatter your focus. These hazards demand immediate attention—hesitation only results in failure

- 8 Atmospheric Levels at launch.

Each location offers a distinct flavor of dread, including:

  •  Carnival – Once joyous, now twisted and abandoned

  •  Outpost – Isolated. Storm-wracked. Not alone.

  •  Hospital – They don’t rest in peace

  •  Theatre – One final, haunting performance

  •  Safe House – It wasn’t safe enough

  •  Haunted Mansion – Echoes and shadows cling to the walls

  •  Empty House – A fire still burns. Dinner is served. No one's home

  •  Cyberlab – Experiments incomplete... but still alive

Over 600 Unique Breaches
Each level features 3–5 camera feeds, and every feed contains at least 20 handcrafted, reality-defying Breaches. That’s up to 100 unique events per level to learn, spot, and survive.

data.name: BackToThreeKingdoms
data.detailed_description:
Back To Three Kingdoms is a turn-based tactical wargame set in the Three Kingdoms era.

Story Background

You play as a food delivery rider who travels back to the late Eastern Han Dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period. Will you fight to survive and return to the modern world, or carve out extraordinary achievements in this ancient era? The course of history will be shaped by your choices.

Gameplay

  • Assemble an army led by three powerful generals to take on a series of unique levels, facing ever-emerging new enemies and progressively ramping up difficulty.

  • Unlock a wider selection of distinct generals and more formidable equipment as you progress.

  • Each general is equipped with one exclusive skill and one universal skill—the latter can be modified by equipping different gear. Every general also commands their own specialized military unit.

Battlefield Strategy

  • On the battlefield, tailor your tactics to the terrain: launch fire attacks in mountainous regions and forests, or unleash water-based assaults near rivers and lakes.

  • Coordinate the skills of different generals to execute devastating combos. For example, first order one general to set the mountains ablaze, then command another to use their skill to push enemies into the raging flames.

  • Victory can be achieved in two ways: either storm and destroy the enemy’s main camp, or eliminate every single enemy soldier. This dual-win mechanic opens up a wealth of strategic possibilities.

data.name: Escape 2042 - The Truth Defenders
data.detailed_description:
Discover a futuristic fast-paced platformer game in pixel art.
The game takes place in three different environments (prison, desert, forest) and is interspersed with 2 mini-games, including a reversed “Shoot’em Up” and an original rappelling game!
Avoid the security cameras, collect grenades to get rid of your enemies, exercise your working memory by hacking the computers of the prison to unlock the doors or to disactivate the safety systems.

In the year 2042, a socialist government is in power, but nobody had foreseen progressive dictatorship that settled in.
The elites of the government hid behind a sham democracy, disconnected from the life the people were leading, and acted solely in their own interests.
The regime considered the dissidents as conspiracy theorists, treated them like terrorists and locked them away in highly-secured prisons, to prevent them from telling the people the truth about the manipulating medias accomplice of the government power.

You are Shun, a computer engineer and member of the Truth Defenders coalition.
After a clandestine operation to inform the people, you are locked away in the highly-secured prison Bulor 24.
But your knowledge on security systems will enable you to escape.

Your turn now to escape as fast as you can from this place!

data.name: Infinite Ruins
data.detailed_description:
Infinite Ruins is an incremental mining game where you command a team of golems, destroy elemental blocks powered by ice, fire, lightning, poison, and more, and descend layer after layer into the depths below.

As you progress, the entire world transforms into a self-sustaining machine under your control. Freeze, explode, clear entire sections, and do it all again, faster than before.

The layers were here long before you

The ruins existed long before your arrival. Who built them? Why were they abandoned? No one knows. Your job is simple: dig deeper. One layer, then another. Gather every resource you can find and keep descending into the unknown.

The golems await your command

A growing roster of golems is ready to be unlocked. Ice, Fire, Rock, and more, each serves a unique purpose. Place them manually and direct their actions, or let them operate automatically while you focus on optimization. Even when you're not actively mining, resources continue to flow.

Chain reactions vs random events

Lightning can cut through entire layers. Ice spreads across neighboring blocks. Resource Vortices may swallow valuable materials before you can collect them. But every challenge can be overcome. Build the right team of golems, unlock powerful upgrades, and create devastating chain reactions capable of handling anything the ruins throw at you.

There is no end, only deeper layers

The deeper you descend, the stranger the layers become and the more meaningful your decisions are. Choose which upgrades to prioritize, when to unlock new golems, and how to tackle the next stage of progression. Beyond every layer lies even greater growth and ever-increasing numbers.

Features

  • Endless downward mining: Break blocks, gather resources, and accelerate your mining and destruction with powerful upgrades.

  • Specialized golem teams: Build your own underground operation with 8 unique golem types, each fulfilling a different role.

  • Deep upgrade progression: Unlock nearly 100 upgrades and feel a clear sense of growth with every purchase.

  • Elemental synergies: Combine 6 different elements to create powerful interactions between fire, ice, lightning, poison, and more.

  • Collapse the Ruins through a deep Prestige system with permanent Rune upgrades.

  • ~4–5 hours to complete the main story, with around 7 hours to reach 100% completion.

  • Continue your journey in Endless Mode with infinite progression.

If you enjoy watching numbers grow, making meaningful progression choices, or building systems that keep working while you're away, Infinite Ruins offers a world worth digging into one layer at a time.

data.name: Bounce Arena Simulator
data.detailed_description:
⚔️ 20 Unique Physics Weapons

20 types of weapons enter the fray, including Sawblades, Bombs, Black Holes, Zombies, Frozen, Cells, Shamans, Cowardly Turtles, and Adventurers. They don't just differ in attack power; each has completely different combat mechanics such as splitting, freezing, summoning, buffing, terrain control, and probability-based comebacks.

🌪️ Unpredictable Physics Arena

Weapons bounce, collide, and use walls and terrain to fight on their own. A perfect combination can collapse from a single unexpected angle, and an underdog weapon can turn the tide of battle with a single skill activation.

💬 Real-Time Spectating Completed with Streaming

Connect YouTube, Twitch, and Discord chats to see viewer messages displayed as speech bubbles in-game. Before the match, viewers can predict the winner in the chat, and successful prediction records accumulate on the leaderboard and stats. It's fun to play alone, but it's a simulator that gets even better when watched together.

🎮 Diverse Battle Modes

  • Free For All: A brawl where every weapon is an enemy. The last surviving Bounce wins.

data.name: Deadly Quiet
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

WARNING: This video game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

Deadly Quiet is a 4-player co-op asymmetrical horror game that immerses you in the unsettling atmosphere of the infamous Hoia Baciu forest. Viewed through the lens of a bodycam, the game delivers an intense and realistic experience as you and your team navigate the forest's haunting depths. Survival hinges on teamwork, strategic decisions, and your ability to adapt to the unpredictable horrors that lurk within.

Every step you take and every sound you make could draw attention to your group, so staying quiet isn’t just advice—it’s your lifeline. Will you and your friends work together to outsmart the sinister forces of the forest, or will the silence consume you all?

You and your friends embark on a weekend camping trip in the Hoia Baciu forest. A detour along a ravine leads you across a shaky bridge, but disaster strikes as your car plunges into the depths below. Miraculously, everyone survives, but your vehicle is destroyed. With no signal and night quickly falling, you’re stranded in the heart of the ominous forest. Your only hope is to traverse the cursed woods and reach the nearby town of Cluj.

As you journey deeper, strange and inexplicable events unfold around you. The forest is a living nightmare, where every step and every sound could mean death. Mistakes are fatal, and the silence conceals an unspeakable danger. Was that chilling sound in the distance just the wind—or something far worse? Can you and your team survive the horrors of the forest, uncover its secrets, and escape with your sanity intact? Or will the silence claim you all?

Personalize your character by choosing from a selection of unique skins, allowing you to customize their appearance to suit your style.

4-PLAYER CO-OP GAMEPLAY

  • Team up with friends to survive the harrowing challenges of the Hoia Baciu Forest, where cooperation and communication are the keys to survival.

ASYMMETRICAL HORROR

  • Face off against a relentless supernatural predator that adapts to your actions and decisions, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same.

IMMERSIVE BODYCAM PERSPECTIVE

  • Experience the terror firsthand through a dynamic bodycam view that heightens tension and realism.

PROXIMITY VOICE CHAT

  • Communicate with teammates using in-game proximity voice chat, but be careful—your voice might attract unwanted attention.

DYNAMIC SOUND SENSITIVITY

  • The forest reacts to the sounds you make, creating an intense, stealth-focused experience where every noise could be your last.

HAUNTING HOIA BACIU FOREST

  • Explore the eerie and mysterious Hoia Baciu Forest, a place teeming with supernatural phenomena and cryptic secrets waiting to be uncovered.

ATMOSPHERIC SOUND DESIGN

  • An immersive soundscape amplifies the tension, with every creak, snap, and distant growl adding to the fear.

TERRIFYING VFX 

  • A mix of realistic graphics and chilling effects brings the Hoia Baciu Forest to life, plunging players into its cursed depths.

data.name: Rinha de IA
data.detailed_description:
IMPORTANT: this game requires an OpenRouter account with credits. That charge comes from OpenRouter, not from the game: it is the third-party dependency that grants access to the AI models the game uses. Create your OpenRouter account, generate an API key and add credits; with them you can play with whichever model you want. Typical spend per fight is low.

Rinha de IA is a 3D fighting game where the humans set everything up and then just watch: the ones actually controlling the fighters are the LLMs. You pick the arena and the fight duration, pick your fighter character, select the AI model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama or any of the hundreds on OpenRouter) and you can even configure the harness the model gets in order to control the game. After that, just cheer! The selected AI model controls the character, reads the fight state on the fly, picks and throws strikes, blocks, dodges, grabs weapons and trash-talks the opponent on screen. It is pure adrenaline.

The logic behind it

Small, fast models react sooner; big, smart models plan better, but they are slower. Figuring out which models fight best, pairing them with the right characters and working out how to make them fight better are the real challenges of the game.

What is in the game

  • 300+ AI models available to fight through OpenRouter.
  • 11 fighter characters with distinct looks, abilities and special attacks.
  • 6 arenas, from a sunny beach to a packed soccer stadium with an animated crowd.
  • Random weapons spawn in the arenas, with different rarities and attack power (less rare/weaker: gray > green > blue > purple > orange: rarer/stronger): may luck be with you.
  • Special finishers: each character has its own lethal blow that triggers its own cinematic choreography.
  • Local 1v1: you set up Player 1 and Player 2 for a local match, with a rematch offer at the end.
  • Online 1v1: you set up one player and face another human player (through a direct invite to a friend or by accepting a fight offer from the board), on an authoritative server, with rematch proposals and a report system.

Watch two frontier models insult each other over a dropped axe. That alone is worth it.

data.name: Rune Log
data.detailed_description:
You are a Rune Reader.

When someone dies, disappears, or leaves a secret behind, the runes remember. People bring their grief to your table: a widow, a cheated merchant, a frightened child, and lay down a scripture no one else can read. Your job is to read it, and then to tell them what it says.

Every case has two parts

1. DECODE. Each scripture is a substitution cipher with runic symbols standing in for letters. You break it the way real cryptographers do: letter frequency, repeated symbols, short anchor words like THE and AND, and the context of who is asking. The difficulty is tuned tight so it's hard enough to feel earned but never so hard you stall.

2. CONVEY. The decoded phrase is often poetic and a little strange. You type your own true answer, however you would, the way you'd say it to the person in front of you.

The truth is not always kindness

Some answers are gut-punches whilst others are quiet relief. How clearly and proficiently you read changes how the world receives you between being trusted, clouded, or unwelcome.

What you get

  • Story Mode across five villages: A fishing village, a market town, a plague-struck fen, a highland of standing stones, and at last your own home, where the final scriptures are about your own family.

  • Type your own answers: Free-text conclusions, judged on what you actually understood, not multiple choice.

  • Tightly-tuned cipher puzzles: Short, satisfying, solvable with pencil-and-paper logic.

  • Endless Mode: Procedurally generated cases: fates, frauds, imposters, animal culprits, debts and hauntings.

  • Make your own puzzles: Use the Runic Scripture tool to make and export your own Rune Logs.

  • Short sessions: Most cases take only a few minutes. Read one over coffee, or lose an evening to the fen.

Rune Log is quiet, occult, melancholic, and grounded. It's a small game about strange messages, and about telling people hard things gently.
