data.name: Shadow Play: Nezha
data.detailed_description:
Journey to the West is over. The debts of the gods remain.

Shadow Play: Nezha brings kung fu-inspired spear combat, divine powers, and Chinese shadow puppetry to a 2D side-scrolling action adventure. Wield Nezha's spear through roguelite battles and Metroidvania exploration, uncovering an ancient calamity across repeated lotus rebirths.

Spear techniques meet divine powers

Fight at close range with spear techniques, movement arts, and supernatural abilities. Combine your attacks with skills, relics, and talismans to respond to the enemies in your path. Martial arts-inspired weapon combat and mythological powers come together in a side-scrolling hack-and-slash adventure with room to shape your own approach.

Build a fighting style around spear techniques, divine skills, movement, combat tactics, and cultivation. Develop combinations that suit your preferred abilities, or adapt your choices to the enemies and routes of the current run. Face celestial warriors and legendary demons with a growing understanding of both your martial techniques and your divine arsenal.

Build across lives. Explore beyond familiar paths.

Death begins another cycle, with rearranged routes and enemy encounters. Combine skills, equipment, relics, and talismans, grow through repeated challenges, and discover new events, characters, and secrets along the way. Each choice changes how you fight and explore during that life.

Travel through interconnected mythological regions and revisit them as new abilities open previously unreachable paths. Double jumps, barrier-breaking abilities, and water-crossing arts lead to hidden routes, relics, encounters, and story events. Roguelite variation meets Metroidvania exploration, giving you new reasons to return to places you thought you knew.

Vintage Chinese animation. Stories on a shadow-puppet stage.


Vintage Chinese animation is central to the visual identity. Inspired by classic Chinese animated films, the art brings traditional shadow-puppet forms and lighting into an animated mythological world. Characters, environments, and story performances share this distinctly Chinese retro-animation sensibility.

Shadow puppetry is more than a visual style: it is also how the story is performed. Numerous shadow-puppet story cutscenes bring mythological characters and their conflicts to the stage. Beyond combat and exploration, these theatrical sequences invite you into Nezha’s story through the characters and their unfolding drama.

Characters, landscapes, lighting, and battles unfold like a living Chinese shadow-puppet performance. Real-time lighting evokes translucent materials and projected silhouettes, while paper-cut and ink-wash influences reshape mythological figures and supernatural powers.

Articulated silhouettes, light projection, and the distinctive movement of shadow puppets define the visual language. Traditional Luogujing percussion also interacts with combat flow, attack feedback, entrances, and skill performance. Martial action and theatrical rhythm turn each encounter into part of the shadow play.

The gods return. Old conflicts endure.

After the Journey to the West, Heaven wages another campaign against the demons of the Northern Continent. As the war stalls, a calamity older than the conflict begins to surface. Grudges from the age of Investiture draw familiar figures into turmoil again.

Nezha once sacrificed his flesh and bones, returned in a lotus body, and rose among the gods. Now stripped of his divine status and hunted by Heaven, he is trapped in cycles of destruction and rebirth. Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, Li Jing, Zhong Kui, celestial warriors, and figures from Chinese folklore cross paths in this original continuation of the myths.

data.about_the_game:
Journey to the West is over. The debts of the gods remain.

Shadow Play: Nezha brings kung fu-inspired spear combat, divine powers, and Chinese shadow puppetry to a 2D side-scrolling action adventure. Wield Nezha's spear through roguelite battles and Metroidvania exploration, uncovering an ancient calamity across repeated lotus rebirths.

Spear techniques meet divine powers

Fight at close range with spear techniques, movement arts, and supernatural abilities. Combine your attacks with skills, relics, and talismans to respond to the enemies in your path. Martial arts-inspired weapon combat and mythological powers come together in a side-scrolling hack-and-slash adventure with room to shape your own approach.

Build a fighting style around spear techniques, divine skills, movement, combat tactics, and cultivation. Develop combinations that suit your preferred abilities, or adapt your choices to the enemies and routes of the current run. Face celestial warriors and legendary demons with a growing understanding of both your martial techniques and your divine arsenal.

Build across lives. Explore beyond familiar paths.

Death begins another cycle, with rearranged routes and enemy encounters. Combine skills, equipment, relics, and talismans, grow through repeated challenges, and discover new events, characters, and secrets along the way. Each choice changes how you fight and explore during that life.

Travel through interconnected mythological regions and revisit them as new abilities open previously unreachable paths. Double jumps, barrier-breaking abilities, and water-crossing arts lead to hidden routes, relics, encounters, and story events. Roguelite variation meets Metroidvania exploration, giving you new reasons to return to places you thought you knew.

Vintage Chinese animation. Stories on a shadow-puppet stage.


Vintage Chinese animation is central to the visual identity. Inspired by classic Chinese animated films, the art brings traditional shadow-puppet forms and lighting into an animated mythological world. Characters, environments, and story performances share this distinctly Chinese retro-animation sensibility.

Shadow puppetry is more than a visual style: it is also how the story is performed. Numerous shadow-puppet story cutscenes bring mythological characters and their conflicts to the stage. Beyond combat and exploration, these theatrical sequences invite you into Nezha’s story through the characters and their unfolding drama.

Characters, landscapes, lighting, and battles unfold like a living Chinese shadow-puppet performance. Real-time lighting evokes translucent materials and projected silhouettes, while paper-cut and ink-wash influences reshape mythological figures and supernatural powers.

Articulated silhouettes, light projection, and the distinctive movement of shadow puppets define the visual language. data.name: CHAMBER 13
data.detailed_description:
You wake up suddenly in an underground chamber. You have no idea why you are here, and the only sound breaking the heavy silence is the sound of your strikes against the extracted rocks from a strange machine. CHAMBER 13 is an immersive incremental clicker game that combines a dark, atmospheric mystery with satisfying progression mechanics.

Every rock you shatter brings you one step closer to freedom

KET FEATURES

  • Atmospheric & Mysterious Setting: Experience a unique vibe inside a dark underground room filled with suspense.

  • Incremental Progression: Start with basic tools, then scale up your earnings and efficiency to automate and speed up your escape.

  • Upgrades: Reinvest the wealth earned from mining into powerful equipment, faster digging speeds, and ultimate efficiency boosters.

  • Satisfying Growth Loop: Watch your progression transform from a slow, exhausting struggle into an unstoppable, automated resource-generating powerhouse.

UPGRADES CATEGORIES

  • Workers Upgrades to increase their profit

  • Laser beam Upgrades to Automate Minning

  • Player related Upgrades

  • Hammer related Upgrades

  • Machine related Upgrades 

  • Rocks Related Upgrades

  • Chamber related Upgrades

  • Revenue related Upgrades

  • Ore related Upgrades

Can You Break the Chains and Escape Chamber 13?

The darkness surrounds you, and the stones won't smash themselves. Grab your hammer, start digging, and fight your way out!

data.name: CRUFT
data.detailed_description:
CRUFT is a cozy, incremental, crafter where you pull up to a vacant lot and craft however you like. It's all about bootstrapping from next to nothing and making a space that represents what you like to do and make.

There's tons of things to craft, some contacts on your cell phone willing to buy and sell items, and you can always just pack some things up in your van and sell items in town.

The process of crafting items also creates CRUFT. CRUFT is garbage, waste, the bits of the tomato plant you don't eat, even just wasted effort. Keep your yard clean and free of CRUFT so that you have space to do what you want to do. Or... go full goblin and make a mess. It's your yard.

data.name: Fractured Balance
data.detailed_description:
Keep the World Alive—Or Die With It

The world is falling apart, and so are you.

In this fast-paced action-platformer, your health is directly linked to the stability of the world around you. Platforms crumble, spikes emerge from the depths, and the laws of reality begin to decay. At the heart of this fragile balance are ancient cores—mystical devices that prevent the world from collapsing into chaos.

But something is wrong.

A haunting swarm of floating magical skulls has begun attacking the cores. If they fall, so does everything else. Your mission: defend the cores, destroy the skulls, and repair the damage before it's too late.

Survival isn’t just about staying alive—it’s about keeping the world itself from dying.

data.name: Growing Pains
data.detailed_description:
Growing pains is a fast and furious platformer which gives the genre a shake up with sleek graphics, a thumping soundtrack and an ingenious twist that you’ve never seen before. The "Vessel" which you control continually grows and expands leaving you in a permanent race to clear the area and escape before you get too big and find your butt wedged in a tight spot. Combine this with tight controls and levels crammed with devious traps and you've got a heart-pounding race guaranteed to leave you with sweaty palms and a sense of overwhelming satisfaction when you reach the goal.

Growing Pains features 9 massive levels each with 3 difficulty levels that radically change how each level plays out. This is the kind of game that makes you want to show everyone your skills so all the leaderboards include replays, allowing you to compare high scores against your friends and the rest of the world. This is a game you can really grow into!

data.name: Wasteland Train: Conductor
data.detailed_description:
In the wasteland after the collapse of civilization, cities lie like islands at the ends of broken rail lines. As the conductor, you will command an ever-expanding mobile base, travel between survivor settlements, haul vital supplies, make a living through trade, and protect the last lifeline of civilization against monsters, broken tracks, and extreme weather.

Your Train Is Your Base

Install cargo, combat, research, training, and living facilities within limited carriage space. Assign crew roles and balance transport capacity, defense, production, morale, and growth. Every expansion and layout change will directly affect the efficiency and risk of the next journey.

Trade, Supplies, and Route Decisions

Each city has its own stock, demand, and price fluctuations. Filling every slot with high-value goods means carrying less ammunition, repair parts, and daily necessities. The choice between shorter but more dangerous main lines and longer but safer side routes is yours.

Real-Time Combat and Track Repair Defense

Enemies can pursue your train while it is moving, and they can also launch full assaults when you stop to repair damaged tracks. Configure train-mounted weapons, deploy engineers and fighters, and protect key carriages and the workers repairing the rails if you want to keep moving.

Train Your Crew and Unlock Crystal-Core Technology

Survivors have different attributes and responsibilities. Improve your team's capabilities through training, research, and carriage facilities. Recover crystal cores from monsters to develop weapons, shields, and special techniques, and gradually turn your train into a true steel fortress.

Close In on the Truth Across the Wasteland Rails

Explore unknown towns and branching routes, retake lost settlements, complete contracts, build reputation, and investigate the source of the catastrophe across an ever-expanding rail network. Every departure may bring back resources, companions, technology, or new scars.

data.name: Tip of the Tongue
data.detailed_description:
Tip of the Tongue: The Ultimate Word Association Game!

Everyone's been there: knowing what something looks like, but unable to find the word for it. "Tip of the Tongue" transforms that experience into a thrilling game, pushing your vocabulary skills to the limit.

Game Features:

Survival Mode: Keep up the pace! Identify objects correctly to stay in the game. Stumble too much, and it's the end of the line.
Vast Categories: From birds and celebrities to kitchen appliances and tools, there's always a fresh challenge awaiting.
Educational & Entertaining: Whether you're an English learner or a native speaker, this game offers an enjoyable way to sharpen your language skills.
Flexible Gameplay: Dive in for a quick challenge or indulge in extended play sessions. It's all about how much you're ready to test yourself!
With "Tip of the Tongue," learning becomes an adventure. Can you keep up with the pace and master the vast expanse of the English language? Dive in and find out!

data.name: Global Workforce VR Career Training (GWPro.io)
data.detailed_description:
Global Workforce VR Career Training

Practice high-risk work in VR before you do it for real. GWPro puts learners on realistic job sites, from an H2S alarm on a wellsite to a high-voltage switchgear room, where they follow the real procedure, make mistakes safely and see what each mistake would have cost.

GWPro is a library of 34 VR safety and career training simulators. Colleges and vocational schools use it to make students job-ready; companies and HSE consultancies use it to train crews before they reach the site.

WHAT’S INSIDE: 34 MODULES

  • Oil and gas: Gas Detection & H2S, Well Control (10 scenarios), Hot Work, Confined Space Entry, Maintenance Safety (Pipes & Acids)

  • Electrical and energy: Electrical Safety, Electrical Safety (Type 2 Switchgear), Arc Flash (Pump Station), Arc Flash (Office), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), Solar Panels Maintenance (Rooftop)

  • Construction and trades: Work at Height, Scaffolding (Wedge), Scaffolding (Baker), Trenching & Excavation (Road), Trenching & Excavation (Field), Load Slinging, Asbestos Handling, Welding (SMAW)

  • Logistics and driving: Forklift Inspection, Forklift Hazard Recognition, Truck Pre-Drive Inspection, Dangerous Goods Road Incident, Risk Acknowledgement (Delivery Safety), Van Driver: Distractions & Hazard Awareness (City), Van Driver: Distractions & Hazard Awareness (Rural)

  • Mining: Rock Scaling (Underground)

  • Core safety and emergencies: Workplace Safety, Risk Assessment, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), First Aid & CPR, Fire Safety (Workshop), Fire Safety (Office), Emergency Response

HOW LEARNERS TRAIN

  • Three modes in every module: Learning guides each step with voice-over and visual cues, Training lets learners work on their own, and Exam scores them.

  • Each job runs in the real order: briefing, work permit, PPE and tool checks, the task itself and sign-off, with supervisors and co-workers alongside.

  • Mistakes play out safely. Get it wrong and the arc flash or the collision happens in VR, not on site.

  • Hazards and faults change every session in the inspection and hazard-spotting modules, so learners can’t pass by memorizing.

BUILT FOR CLASSROOMS AND TEAMS

  • Single-player for individual practice and exams; multiplayer for instructor-led group sessions.

  • Exam scores and completion certificates give you a record for every learner, and results flow to your LMS via SCORM/xAPI.

  • One-button start: no prior VR experience needed.

  • Developed with NEBOSH-certified HSE professionals; scenarios follow OSHA, NEBOSH and ISO 45001 practice.

  • 30+ languages, including Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic and French.

data.name: The Deadly Tower of Monsters
data.detailed_description:
The illustrious space explorer Dick Starspeed has crash landed onto the mysterious planet Gravoria. With his rocket ship out of commission and his trusty companion Robot nowhere to be found, he sets out to explore this new world and its hostile inhabitants.

In the midst of a battle between the good and evil factions of ape men, he meets the stunning Scarlet Nova, heir to the planet's tyrannical Emperor. Unwilling to follow her evil birthright, Scarlet tells Dick of the Emperor's atrocities... and never one to turn down a fight—or to turn down a beautiful blonde—Dick agrees to help overthrow her father's cruel regime!

After a chance reunion with the resourceful Robot, our heroic trio embarks on a fool's errand to topple Gravoria's greatest menace and restore peace to the planet once more. However, in order to accomplish this feat, they will have to ascend... THE DEADLY TOWER OF MONSTERS!

Filmed in the 1970s, The Deadly Tower of Monsters is an action-packed adventure, full of time-honored literary themes: the daughter versus the tyrant father, the planet full of innocent ape-creatures, the dashing space-age liberator, the robot companion, the tower full of treacherous mutations... A timeless classic for all ages!

Despite the film's low budget, director Dan Smith was able to craft an engrossing story about strange alien beings and titan-size monsters (sometimes filming without a script!). It is a thrill ride overflowing with elaborate weaponry, eye-catching special effects, lots of technological noises, and of course: plenty of explosions! For the first time in decades, this tour de force is coming to DVD, so a new generation can experience this sci-fi cult classic. Movie highlights include:

  • Laugh-a-minute director commentary! – Director Dan Smith lends his decades of industry know-how to deliver side-splitting anecdotes and insights on the film's production. You won't want to miss a single syllable from the genius mind behind this masterpiece!
  • Got vertigo? Too bad! – Experience the awesome verticality of the tower at every step of the journey, with wide-angle camera shots and impressive aerial stunts. Watch as our heroes fearlessly dive off the tower or glide effortlessly across chasms, all in search of hidden secrets and intergalactic glory!
  • Over half-a-hundred imaginative monsters! – Squid people, nukular ants, dinosaurs-gone-wild, giant blobs, robo-monkeys, and more are brought to life using state-of-the-art effects, including stop-motion, rotoscope, image compositing, and even some elaborate costumes covered in real fur! You and the family are guaranteed a good ol' time!
  • Ray guns, crystal swords, and laser whips. Oh, my! – At the heroes' disposal are a wide variety of weapons used to smack!, pow!, and ker-splat! their futuristic foes. Watch as our plucky protagonists collect hidden scrap metal pieces and upgrade their arsenal, right before your very eyes!
  • Did someone say, "Special powers"!? – I sure hope so, because this film's got 'em! From time-slowing vortexes to speed boots... Wait, what's that on the ground? Is that a bird? No, it's a land mine! These aliens are in for a bang, and so are you!
To get your hands on all of this—and more!—be sure to pick up The Deadly Tower of Monsters, the all-new single-player, action-adventure video game developed by ACE Team and published by ATLUS.

data.name: Parallel Park
data.detailed_description:
Racing, Drifting, Building, Fixing, Tuning - there are so many games about cars, but until today not one of them allowed you to live out every car owner's ultimate fantasy: PARKING.

We here at Pouchmouse Studios understand that parking one car never feels like enough. That's why we invented time travel: for the express, and only, purpose of letting you park multiple cars at once. Each time you park a car we'll rewind time and force let you park another one at the same time. Just try not to hit your past self. Seriously. Stop hitting yourself.

Okay, we admit it. We have an ulterior motive. We had hoped it would be enough to play off your finely honed instinct to park cars. But I can see you've glimpsed the truth: the future is in desperate peril. You see, on this day in Earth's history, what you quaintly call 'today', there was a pivotal change in the timeline. People who should have arrived at their destinations on time were instead late. Appointments were missed, meetings were postponed, and a particularly malevolent butterfly flapped its wings, sending the Earth into a new chaotic Dark Timeline. That's why we need YOU - a proven parking champion - to park the world's cars, get people to work on time, and make sure Earth stays on the Good Timeline. *

What's in it for you?! Honestly we weren't expecting that question. Is saving the world not enough? It seemed like enough to us. Okay, here: As a reward we'll allow you to participate in the future's most popular sport: competitive parking. Here's how it works: You and three other players will all try to park a car at the same time. Then we rewind time and you each need to park your second car while your first cars repeat your moves from before. Then a third, and a fourth, and so on until the map becomes pure vehicular chaos.
Go ahead: block your opponents off and dominate the parking lot in our reenactment of Ancient Earth's bloodiest tradition: Black Friday. Heck, that sounds like so much fun we'll make the single player game competitive too. There'll be leaderboards so you can even 'beat' people at the single player levels by getting higher scores.

Shoot, you know what? We have this pocket universe left over from development. How about we toss it in as well? You can use it to build your own custom levels with our level editor and share them with the world using the Steamworks Portal.

Oh yeah, and it looks like we have room to include one more thing: our sincere gratitude. Parallel Park is made by a mere handful of people. By buying and playing the game you help us in a very concrete way! Specifically, you help us make -more- games. So thank you! And we'll see you again in the future.



-Pouchmouse Studios

data.name: Barry the Antivirus
data.detailed_description:
Your PC is infected. Barry is the cure.

Barry the Antivirus is a pixel-art arcade game where you are the weapon. There's no gun and no bullets — just one furious bear, a slingshot, and a screen full of viruses.

Aim. Pull. Launch.

Drag back to aim, then release to fling Barry across the screen, ricocheting off the walls to smash through as many viruses as you can in a single shot. Every launch is a little physics puzzle.

Know your threats

  • Regular viruses drift in predictable lines.

  • Spyware dodges erratically.

  • Malware hunts you down.

  • Worms multiply and drain your coins on contact.

  • Botnets swarm together.

Upgrade, customize, survive

Defeated viruses drop coins you can spend to boost Barry's health, attack, defense, and speed, with each upgrade costing a little more than the last, and to unlock skins, wallpapers, and desktop themes for your in-game "operating system".

A desktop from another decade

The whole game lives on a lovingly fake '90s desktop, complete with a Start menu, taskbar and themes like Doors 96 and Doors XD.

Features

  • Slingshot-and-bounce arcade action, easy to learn and hard to master

  • Endless waves that keep getting harder

  • Coin economy with escalating upgrades

  • Unlockable skins, wallpapers and desktop themes

  • Achievements that unlock cosmetics

  • Mouse and controller support

  • Handmade pixel art, no generative AI

data.name: Commander Keen
data.detailed_description:
Commander Keen: Invasion of the Vorticons:
  • Episode 1: Marooned on Mars (Dec. 14th 1990)
  • Episode 2: The Earth Explodes (1991)
  • Episode 3: Keen Must Die! (1991)
Commander Keen's very first adventure, and the debut of id's groundbreaking side-scrolling technology. In the game you play the role of Commander Keen: the alter-ego of an eight year-old genius by the name of Billy Blaze. When Billy learns that the Earth is in danger, he dons his brother's football helmet and his homemade interstellar spaceship to become Commander Keen -- Defender of the Earth!

Commander Keen in Goodbye Galaxy!:
  • Episode 4: Secret of the Oracle (1991)
  • Episode 5: The Armageddon Machine (1991)
You are eight-year-old Billy Blaze, boy genius to your neighborhood. Commander Keen to the rest of the universe. It's time to grab your trusty pogo stick and neural stunner, climb into the cockpit of your homemade Megarocket and blast off for the Shadowlands. To prevent the obliteration of life as we know it, you'll have to battle your way past deadly hazards and devious creatures, or end up as space toast.

data.name: Void Observation
data.detailed_description:
Void Observation is a suspense-filled, atmospheric horror game set in a remote Soviet research facility in 1989. Players take on the role of Dmitri Voltkov, a reluctant engineer caught in a web of mysterious events far beyond his control. Tasked with managing malfunctioning systems and strange technological anomalies, Dmitri soon discovers that something far darker and more dangerous lurks within the facility. As he navigates the complex, he faces not only technical failures but an increasingly unstable environment that threatens his survival.

The game blends classic horror elements with unique puzzle mechanics, creating an intense experience that builds tension and dread. Using a mix of computer terminals and real-world tools like wire cutters and spanners, players will need to balance solving puzzles and managing electrical systems, all while being pursued by an unknown force. As the story unfolds, Dmitri uncovers secrets that hint at extraterrestrial interference, government conspiracies, and a catastrophic failure that may have been set in motion long ago.

Key Features

  • Immersive Environment: Explore a detailed, atmospheric Soviet research facility filled with hidden secrets and eerie visuals. The dark, claustrophobic spaces and unpredictable technology set the stage for an unforgettable horror experience.

  • Tense Puzzles: Solve complex puzzles that combine computer commands and physical tools. 

  • Dynamic Threats: Encounter an ever-present, otherworldly force in the form of a mysterious spherical entity that stalks the player. Survival depends on quick thinking, timing, and managing both environmental hazards and systems failures.

  • Realistic Mechanics: Engage with the facility's technology, using terminals to access important data while repairing or altering equipment with physical tools like spanners, wire cutters, and diagnostic devices.

  • Atmospheric Horror: A tension-filled soundtrack, flickering lights, glitching systems, and subtle environmental cues all contribute to a growing sense of unease. Expect random sounds, power outages, and glimpses of strange occurrences to keep you on edge.

data.name: NEVER TURN BACK
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

You wake up with no memory, trapped inside an endless, pitch-black tunnel. There is no weapon, no way to fight back — only a fading flashlight and whatever you can scavenge along the way. Something moves in the dark ahead of you, and you are not supposed to see it.

NEVER TURN BACK is a slow-burn psychological horror experience built entirely around proximity, sound, and helplessness. A presence stalks you through the tunnel — hands reaching from the walls, a single eye watching from the shadows, a shape that appears and vanishes at the edge of your light. One glimpse too many, and it's over.

Best played alone, in the dark, with headphones on.

Features

  • A first-person psychological horror experience with no combat and no way to fight back

  • Proximity-based scares — hands, eyes, and a stalking shadow react to how close the danger gets

  • Full 3D spatial audio: hear footsteps, breathing, and movement before you see anything

  • Manage hunger, thirst, and a failing flashlight battery while searching for a way out

  • One mistake ends the run — permanent vulnerability keeps every step tense

  • A tunnel that grows darker and more disturbing the deeper you go

  • Achievements that reward exploration, survival, and the choices you make along the way

More than the tunnel

The tunnel is only the beginning. NEVER TURN BACK is being built as an expanding horror experience — new environments, new threats, and new mysteries are planned beyond this first

data.name: Dungeon Crusher: Soul Hunters
data.detailed_description:
An endless adventure awaits you. How much? We guarantee that you can expect no less than 1.78e692 + hours of gameplay.

PvP combat mechanics that are unique for clicker / idler games. The heroes you collect aren’t just for getting through the game. You can deploy them in squads and compete with other players in the weekly ranking.

In effect, the gameplay is endless. You collect more and more new heroes who delve deeper into the dungeon. The game offers over 150+ unique heroes, over 100,000 levels, and over 60 artifacts. 

Collect loot drops from monsters and craft new items and equipment for heroes. 

Tired of playing a basic clicker / idler? No problem.

There are many other modes in the game. For example, Dragon Draft. This is a unique game mode inspired by the popular Autochess genre.

You can bring your heroes into the game, and other players will bring theirs. These heroes are added to the standard selection of heroes in Dragon Draft, ensuring that no two games are alike. When playing in this mode, success depends entirely on your skills and understanding of the game mechanics.

Continuous new game seasons with unique rewards.

You won’t be alone. Clans are an important component of the game. Players gather into clans and help each other out. They also receive bonuses for joint development of the clan.  The Clan Arena provides an inflow of unique rewards. Clan Science gives bonuses. 8 science trees with over 100 different branches of knowledge.

While some of your heroes are dungeon-crawling, you can use other heroes in the battler. Gather squads of heroes and compete against other players in the Leagues. 

5 leagues. Receive unique rewards and heroes for taking part in the Leagues. No tactical restrictions. You choose your own attack and defense decks. You choose who to attack. Plot with other players about who to attack together, or who to help. In the League, the strength of your heroes is important, but cooperation with other players is even more so.

For those who want even more alongside PvP and clicker modes, there is a special PvE mode - Boss Siege. You get to assemble another deck of heroes, and fight bosses. There are small, medium, and big bosses for you to face. Each requires a different amount of effort and brings a different reward. You can become the ultimate boss-killer, if you have a strong deck. Or a helper - if you’re still building up your own might. The other players will help you gain strength during the siege. Players fight bosses side by side: sometimes it takes entire clans to take down the most powerful bosses.

Every week, there is a new siege, with new bosses and rewards.

Global battles. Global battles between clans. We have these, as well!

You can assemble your clan, conquer the King of the Realm’s castle, and show who is the strongest clan on the server.

You can also capture the Monster Lair, and defend it against other clans. You get to claim all the rewards and the chance to fight the monsters in the lair single-handedly. But twice a week, other clans have the opportunity to attack you and claim the lair for themselves.

There is an open market in the game. You can acquire items and goods in the game, in ratings, and in the Dragon Draft - and then exchange them

data.name: DERACE
data.detailed_description:
DERACE is a chaos-driven racing game for 2–6 players that you can play with friends or in public lobbies. Winning isn’t just about driving fast. Use the right ability at the right time, outplay your rivals, and hold your line.

What’s Waiting for You?

  • Host a lobby to play with friends, or open a public lobby to race with new people.

  • Races can end quickly, or stretch out and turn into pure chaos. The pace is entirely up to you.

  • Here, sometimes the goal isn’t to win, but to make sure your friend doesn’t.

  • Collect abilities on the track, use them at the right time, and stir up the mayhem.

Speed

When you need it, press it to close the gap. Or use it to pull away and create an advantage by escaping the chaos.

Oil

Drop oil behind your vehicle to cause chaos in strategic spots. Anyone who drives over it will slide, and things quickly spiral out of control.

Engine

data.name: Summoner's Tale
data.detailed_description:
A World Divided Monsters and humans once lived as allies, bound together by ancient pacts. That era is over. War has shattered the old bonds, and the truth behind the conflict has been buried. As a young summoner, you'll journey through a world still scarred by betrayal, piecing together what really happened and fighting to restore what was lost.

Four Monster Classes

Four Ways to Fight Every monster belongs to one of four classes, and each one changes how you play:

  • Companions: Follow and fight beside you until their energy runs out.

  • Attackers: Appear briefly to unleash devastating attacks.

  • Supporters: Provide instant support with special skills, then vanish.

  • Enhancers: Give you new mobility options and special enhancements to conquer your journey.

Build a squad that matches your style by mixing classes for different strategies.

Tame Monsters In Many Ways

Earn Their Trust Taming isn't just about winning fights. Each monster has its own trial: battle a fierce challenger, outrun a speedy rival, solve a puzzle, track down rare items, or complete a unique task. Every recruitment feels earned.

Level Up & Evolve

Evolve and Transform Your monsters grow alongside you. Level them through battle and watch them evolve into new, more powerful forms with expanded abilities and a completely transformed look.

Development

Stay updated on Summoner Tale! Fresh content, progress insights, and weekly sneak peeks shared on X @NegmWorldGames Follow along and join the journey!

data.name: Palland: Creature Tamer World
data.detailed_description:
When you stepped onto the ancient marble circle, the ground vanished beneath your feet - and your story began.
The world of 🌌 Palland greeted you with glowing skies, endless meadows, and mysterious creatures known as pakemons. They look adorable by day... but when night falls, beauty turns to danger. Only those who understand them can survive.

Gather resources, craft weapons and armor, and build your shelter to endure the wilds. 🪓🔥 Tame powerful creatures to fight by your side - each one unique, with its own skills and personality. Some help you collect materials, others guard your camp or explore forgotten ruins hidden deep in the forest. 🐾

But Palland is more than survival - it's a journey between worlds. 🌀 Ancient portals hide forgotten secrets, and lost civilizations whisper of a relic called the Eye of Chaos, capable of twisting the minds of creatures and men alike. Solve ancient puzzles, uncover hidden temples, and seek the rune stones that can open the path home.

Every step makes you stronger. Every loss teaches you something new. 💫 Beyond the darkness lies your final test - destroy the Eye of Chaos and restore balance to a world where even the wildest beings can show loyalty... and friendship.

🏕️ Palland: Creature Tamer World is an open-world survival adventure about taming, crafting, and discovering what it truly means to bring harmony to chaos. Build, explore, befriend - and find your way home. 🌿✨

data.name: DIE as HEROES
data.detailed_description:
Die as Heroes is a tabletop dark fantasy game inspired by games like Dungeons & Dragons and other tabletop games like HeroQuest or Journeys in the Dark in a video game format. Ideal pizza night fun!

It is designed to allow you to play solo or with friends, with a single character up to a full party of 4, or mix and match (2 players each control 2 characters, etc)

Die as Heroes ships with several adventures that provide several hours of fun. However, the fun doesn't end when players complete the iniitial campaign.

Die as Heroes comes with a robust editor, hooked into steamworks that allows players to create and share their own stories and adventures with the world. Feel free to create short adventures, stand alone stories or sweeping massive multi-adventure storyline campaigns!


Customize:

  • Maps

  • Locations - chain maps together for continuing stories

  • Encounters

  • Props

  • Triggers

  • Traps

  • NPCs

  • Story

  • Treasure

  • Weather

  • Time of Day

  • Tile Sets

  • Dictate how many players an adventure is for and more

We hope you thoroughly enjoy connecting with new friends around the world and for the nights where everyone else is busy, we still got you - there is always adventure to be had here.

data.name: 空匣子 Empty Box
data.detailed_description:
Step into a fantasy metropolis where humans and beastfolk coexist. Beneath its prosperous surface lie hidden secrets and swirling dark undercurrents.

Play as a destitute, unemployed journalist at rock bottom. An enigmatic hyena extends a mysterious investigation offer, drawing you into the city’s shadowy underbelly. Embark on a journey of inquiry, wander through urban streets, encounter all kinds of people, and unearth the truth behind bizarre, unsolved incidents.

The game features hardcore binary-choice storytelling. Every pivotal decision carries no absolute right or wrong, directly shaping four core attributes. Maintain careful balance at all costs—any attribute collapse will terminate your investigation and trigger a tragic ending.

Gather fragmented clues, experience peculiar urban tales, and interact with distinctive characters. As scattered cases intertwine, layers of fog lift to expose a grand conspiracy, with a hidden mastermind controlling the city’s fate.

Game Features

  • Original Fantasy World

    A vivid 2D atmospheric cityscape where humans and beastfolk cohabit, blending daily mortal life with dark underhanded schemes.

  • Binary Choice Gameplay

    Every choice affects your fate and plot progression, unlocking rich story branches and diverse outcomes.

  • Immersive Suspense Narrative

    Journalist-led detective experience with fragmented, progressive storytelling, keeping suspense high all the way.

  • Multiple Endings

    Your decisions write the finale. Uncover the truth and escape, or sink deep into the conspiracy—every path is your own to make.

data.name: Brawl Street
data.detailed_description:
Knock them off the street.

Brawl Street is a free 3D platform fighter starring the internet's favourite meme mascots. There is no health bar to drain. Every hit you land pushes your rival's damage percent higher, and the higher it climbs, the further they fly. Launch them off the edge of the stage to take the stock and the win.

A roster of meme legends

Every fighter has their own moveset, specials, grabs and personality, and every one of them is unlocked from your first match.
  • Distinct movesets built around each mascot
  • Specials and grabs for every fighter
  • Everything unlocked from the start: no grind, no store, nothing to buy

Stages that fight back

Moving platforms, ledges and hazards are part of the fight, not just scenery. Learn every stage, use the edges, and turn the arena against whoever is winning.

Couch chaos for up to four

Put up to four players on one machine, on keyboard or controllers. Run a free-for-all where everyone is against everyone, go one on one, or take on the CPU.

Easy to pick up, hard to put down

Simple controls get you fighting in seconds. Comebacks, edge-guards and last-second recoveries keep every match close until the final hit.

Features

  • Free to play, with nothing to buy
  • Percent-based knockback platform fighting
  • Up to 4 players local on one screen
  • Full controller support
  • Free-for-all, 1v1 and CPU matches
  • Fast to start: open it and fight

data.name: ROGUE MAFIA
data.detailed_description:
The streets are unforgiving.
Rogue Mafia challenges you to fight, loot, and survive in a world where rival gangs, armed thugs, From rain-slick back alleys to windblown industrial yards, every environment tests your skills, awareness, and nerves.

Your safehouse is your sanctuary — where you stash your hard-won loot, upgrade your arsenal, and prepare for the next raid. But once you hit the streets, it’s all or nothing: grab the goods, make it out alive, and build the respect you never had.


The city is calling. Will you make it out alive?

Every Zone, Every Threat

Each raid takes you into handcrafted urban and rural zones — streets littered with burned-out cars, abandoned banks, fenced-off container yards, overgrown forests, and gang-controlled hideouts. Some buildings you can breach, others remain locked, tempting you with the promise of loot inside.

Dynamic Weather 

Rain pours from the rooftops, wind howls through alleys, fog rolls in to cut visibility, or the sky clears to reveal every threat. The weather shifts without warning, forcing you to adapt your tactics on the fly.

Gear Up Like a Gangster

Loot explosives, guns, armor, and backpacks to carry your haul. Each run offers a chance to find rare weapons or vital supplies hidden in safes, vehicles, or guarded caches.

Smart Enemies

Face off against gangsters and armed criminals who flank, ambush, and hunt you with tactics that keep you on edge. They know the streets — and they know how to use them.

Your Safehouse, Your Advantage

Store your loot, upgrade your weapons, improve armor, and stockpile supplies for future runs. Every improvement increases your odds of making it out alive next time.

Risk vs Reward Survival

Go in heavy for maximum firepower… or go in light for speed and stealth. But remember — whatever you take into the streets can be lost forever if you don’t extract.

Rogue Mafia delivers the raw tension of survival, the thrill of a perfect escape, and the crushing weight of a bad decision.

The city is calling. Will you make it out alive?

data.name: Farm & Feast
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Farm & Feast! 🌿

Farm & Feast is a relaxing simulation game where a warm little farm meets an adorable cozy restaurant. Everything moves at your own pace. Your fields are waiting, your restaurant is open, and so are your customers. Every day something new grows, and every service turns into a little moment of happiness.



The more care you show your customers, the warmer your restaurant becomes. Every smile, every order made with love, builds a bond that reaches far beyond the tables.



Take a little break by the shore and cast your line into the gentle waves. Wait for that tiny tug, reel in your catch, and bring it fresh to your kitchen.



Harvest your golden wheat row by row and watch your little machines turn every grain into warm loaves of bread. From a single seed to your customers' tables, every step carries a little piece of your love.



Sometimes the loveliest moments are the quietest ones. A gentle breeze, a path winding between the fields, and a world that feels made just for you. As you gently tend the soil, time slows down; only you and the greenery growing day by day remain. Caring for your field isn't a chore, it's a quiet peace where you get to be alone with yourself.



Greet every guest with a warm smile and welcome them to a comfortable table. Even a small "Welcome" can set the tone for an entire day.



Every service has a rhythm of its own. Fill your tray with drinks, move from table to table, and leave each glass with just the right owner. As you carry the drinks, gather up the smiles along the way and savor that delightful flow that keeps your restaurant cozy and warm.



Bring the orders to your chefs, and they'll handle the rest. While the pans sizzle, sweep the floors and clear the tables at your own rhythm. A cozy restaurant is built with patience and care for the little details.



Taking the bill is the finale of every lovely moment you share with a customer. The warm bond you've built throughout the day, the care you've shown, and every little smile all pay off in this final moment. When your guests leave the table happy, those little tips they leave alongside the bill become the sweetest thank-you for your hard work.



Take every order with care and listen closely to your customers. A wrong dish or a forgotten request upsets your guest and casts a shadow over your restaurant's warm reputation.



Your day begins in the morning on your farm and ends in the evening with happy customers at your restaurant. No rush, no pressure, just your day.

FEATURES

🌾 Farming and Harvest - Plant your seeds, water your crops with love, and watch them grow. When harvest time comes, gather your fresh produce and send it off to your restaurant.

🎣 Fishing - Head down to the shore, cast your line into the gentle waves, and reel in fresh fish for your restaurant's kitchen.

🍽️ Restaurant Management - Greet your customers with a warm smile, seat them at their tables, and take their orders with care. Let every service turn into a little moment of happiness.

🎮 Mini Games - Add a little fun to your day with the charming mini games waiting for you at your restaurant.

🛒 Market - Pick up the seeds and supplies you need at the market and stock up on what's missing. Grow your little business step by step.

🌍 Your Little World - Find your own rhythm between the farm and the restaurant. Plan your day at a calm pace and savor every moment of it.

A warm little farm, an adorable restaurant, and a little world that belongs to you alone. Farm & Feast is waiting for you.

data.name: Alone Again: The Countryside
data.detailed_description:
Alone Again is an indie horror game set in Caçapava, countryside of São Paulo state, Brazil. In this adventure game, the player must explore the mysterious events that occur around your house, such as odd noises and mysterious creatures that appear only by night. You live in a small neighborhood where the news spread fast, but no one besides you seems to realize what is happening here…

Investigate what is happening, look for evidence and mostly…
survive!



"You live in Caçapava, in an isolated neighborhood, in the countryside.
In Brazil, carrying guns is forbidden.
Mysterious creatures move around your house, you can’t protect yourself…
Reach them or they will reach you!".

Alone Again is available in English and fully dubbed into Brazilian Portuguese!

data.name: The Odds Are Stacked Against Us
data.detailed_description:
[desc1_horde.gif]

STEP RIGHT UP! YOUR LUCK IS ABOUT TO RUN OUT!

The house wants its money back, and it's sending ALL of it!

  • THOUSANDS of tiny coins with tiny legs!

  • Marching down YOUR street!

  • Wave after wave after wave!

Your only defense? A SLOT MACHINE!

[desc2_spin.gif]

YOU LOAD THE REELS. THE REELS DEAL YOUR TOWERS!

  • Wanted a sniper? Here's a flamethrower!

  • Needed frost? Enjoy three gunners!

  • Merge them! Move them! Sell them! Stack them!

Turn a TERRIBLE hand into a wall of PURE DESTRUCTION!

[desc3_merge.gif]

WATCH THE GOLD BURN!

  • Rockets rain down on the horde!

  • Tesla lightning arcs through every coin in reach!

  • Flamethrowers melt entire columns!

  • Frost slows them down! Glaciers freeze them solid!

  • Marksmen pick them apart!

When it all goes off at once, the screen turns into a SHOWER OF POPPING GOLD!

[desc4_late_wave.gif]

EVERY RUN IS A NEW HAND!

  • 23 towers!

  • 6 rarity tiers!

  • 144 waves across 12 maps!

  • 4 BRUTAL boss waves!

The machine NEVER deals the same hand twice!

[desc5_boss.gif]

CASH OUT!

Survive, grab your tickets and hit the Prize Counter!

  • New sounds!

  • New machine finishes!

  • New coin styles!

  • 7 living worlds for your main menu!

[desc6_menu_worlds.gif]

The Odds Are Stacked Against You. PROVE THEM WRONG!

data.name: Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Build a Business Around Tennis and Padel

In Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator, you run a racket shop and care for the courts that bring players to your venue. Start with very little and build a business around both sports.

From Zero to Hero

Begin with an almost empty store. Collect stray balls from the court and find broken rackets. Repair them, add fresh strings and grips, and earn your first money. Reinvest in stock as your shop, first courts and academy area grow into a lively destination.

Run the Shop and Care for the Clay

Order and sell tennis and padel rackets, balls, strings, overgrips, vibration dampeners, court shoes, clothing and more. Fill shelves, serve customers at the till, and offer racket stringing and grip replacement. Then step outside to maintain the clay court for the next match.

Keep the Courts Booked

Manage hourly reservations for tennis and padel courts. Follow the schedule, welcome arriving players and keep each court ready for its next booking.

One Venue Two Sports

Move between open tennis courts and enclosed padel courts as matches bring the facility to life. Build a place where players come to shop, book a court and enjoy both sports.

Collect, repair, sell and reinvest. Grow your tennis and padel business from zero to hero.

data.name: Sky Rush
data.detailed_description:
This fun and competitive racing game challenges players to smoothly slide down mountains, using momentum and skill to achieve the fastest descent. Play as a variety of quirky bird characters and race against friends to beat the clock - times are always recorded, driving you to improve and set new records. Distinct themed worlds, such as Mushroom, Grass, and Ice, add visual variety and depth, making every run feel fresh and engaging. Perfect for those who love friendly rivalry and mastering tricky slopes together.

More Features will be added soon.

data.name: Temple Of Snek
data.detailed_description:
JOIN THE DISCORD SERVER!

visit to join the Aetheric Games Discord community.


About the Game



Deep in her lair slumbers an avatar of the goddess Snek, guardian of her secret and mysterious temple. When raiders and grave-robbers come seeking ancient treasure, the stern priestesses sound the alarm and Snek awakens to defend the temple, monch the infidels, and grow and grow ...and grow?



Play as a giant snake in an intercoiled tile-based puzzle dungeon. Explore, master puzzle mechanics and special abilities, and uncover secrets... all is not what it seems in the Temple of Snek.

Featuring:
  • a continuous, interwoven puzzle dungeon with 5-8 hours of gameplay
  • rhythm and length-based traps and puzzles
  • procedural music that changes as you play
  • Classic mode: eat-and-grow score attack
  • Mek-a-Snek: design your own snake-skin pattern
  • five environments with distinct art, music and puzzle styles
  • 4 NPC types with unique puzzle mechanics
  • secret powers to discover and master
  • a wordless, environmental narrative with a twist in the tale
  • Level Editor: make and share your own snek puzzles!

data.name: MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE
data.detailed_description:
Welcome back recruit! MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE is a frantic VR FPS roguelite where players craft powerful hand-held weapons and struggle to survive — er defeat — the MOTHERGUNSHIP. Experience room scale movement*, dodging, limbo-ing and even relishing the satisfaction of literally punching through clouds of bullets, all while perfecting your weapon masterpiece.



Survive the MOTHERGUNSHIP’s metal minions and earn gun parts to add to your weapon, easily picking them up and snapping them into place in VR. You’ll choose from a wild array of distinct gun parts and upgrades like chainguns, railguns, and pizza launchers (yes, explosive pizzas) to forge hell-ish combinations. Design your weapon, then destroy the MOTHERGUNSHIP fleet as alien machines, explosive traps, metal pests, and deadly bosses do everything they can to blast you and your weapon back to square one.



*MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE includes accessibility modes to support all players. Seated-mode enables stationary gameplay, and free movement mode enables the player character to dodge with the controller. More accessibility information can be found in the game’s settings.

*MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE supports Meta Quest 2, Valve Index, HTC Vive, and HP Reverb G2.

data.name: GeoJet
data.detailed_description:
THIS IS GEOJET! 

GeoJet is a high-octane arcade experience that throws you into the pilot seat of a sleek ship racing through vibrant, neon-drenched courses. It's easy to pick up but challenging to master, offering addictive gameplay that will keep you coming back for more.


Master the Tracks:

Navigate twisting tracks, dodge obstacles, and collect score boxes to build your combo and boost your speed. Chain together boosts and utilize the air roll maneuver to achieve blistering speeds. With tight controls and responsive handling, GeoJet demands precision and skill to conquer its challenging courses.

Key Features:

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Intuitive controls make it simple to jump in, but true mastery requires skillful maneuvering and strategic use of power-ups.

  • Air Roll: Quickly dart left and right to dodge obstacles and collect those crucial score boxes.

  • Boost System: The more boxes you collect, the faster you go! Chain together combos for maximum speed.

  • Overdrive Boosts: Strategically placed overdrive boosts give you the edge you need to navigate tricky sections of the track.

  • Pulse-Pounding Synth Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the retrowave aesthetic with a pumping synth soundtrack that complements the high-speed action.

  • Tight Controls: Responsive and precise controls give you complete command of your ship.

  • Arcade Action: Classic arcade gameplay with a modern twist, delivering a thrilling and addictive experience.

  • Challenging and Engaging: Push your skills to the limit and strive for the highest score across a variety of challenging courses.

data.name: On the Rocks
data.detailed_description:
Water almost ran out. What's left is toxic. You run the only bar that still serves something worth drinking with your friends.

A hands-on brewing system lets you purify toxic liquids into safe water, or ferment them into rare drinks worth real trade value. Your machines are visible, mechanical, and satisfying to run. Upgrade them. Push them harder.

Customers come with caps, grudges, and requests. Manage your stock, your prices, and your reputation.

Grow your establishment from a dusty shack into a sprawling post-apocalyptic tavern. Customize the layout for your customers, but don't forget to build heavy barricades to hold off nighttime raiders or mutants.

Venturing into the wasteland isn't just about scavenging resources. Find rare, toxic chemical deposits and turn them into the most addicting, high-margin beverages the survivors have ever tasted.

Discover a living wasteland metropolis surviving amidst the ruins. Interact with desperate local inhabitants, trade rare loot with sketchy merchants, and risk your hard-earned profits at the casino while exploring the dead city.

Endure brutal radioactive storms, sudden supply shortages, and chaotic customer fights. Adapt your management strategy to the harsh realities of the wasteland to keep your outpost alive.

The wasteland is dark. The bar is lit. Keep both alive.How long can you stay open?

data.detailed_description:
因为《公开模拟器—数量关系部分》10月23日上架，10月22日开始优惠一周。

第3群：781757265；第2群：302219333；第1群：697138589

手机版已上架苹果应用。

*********************

12月31日升级更新说明：增加了语音朗读功能，很多情景都会自动进行语言朗读，让使用更加方便。

11月30日升级更新说明：

题库增加了数千道有解析的题目，相信对要参加考试的学生来说是个好消息。

之前的题库有部分试题没有解析，这次也保留下来，所以会遇到没有解析的题目，但是比例不多。

我对题库的看法很正面，不会做题的学生很难成为一个好医生，当然要成为一个好医生，除了会做题外，还需要很多综合能力的锻炼，所以做题是成为一个好医生的必要但不充分条件。

在线PK原先是伤寒论，但是曲高和寡，所以改成了中医理论基础知识PK，希望大家多参与。群里约好对手，同时进入PK模块，会自动匹配。一局25道题，答对得10分，答错扣10分。

9月18日升级更新说明：

本次升级，根据反馈，增加了自由选择关卡功能并解锁了患者数量功能。

增加中医体质数据存储功能，可以看到上次的测试数据。

制作了新的操作流程原型，操作步骤更加清晰。

声音和全屏设置参数自动保存。

看病时的背景音乐替换成了中国古典音乐。

五运六气章节增加了很多解释，可以帮助玩家边学习边过关。

修改了很多反馈的BUG。

下一次升级估计在11月份。

*********************

虽然游戏目前比较硬核，但是对于外行来说也可以利用游戏自带信息过关，不需要额外知识。小白也可以顺利玩这个游戏，如果掌握了下面这个策略。

游戏中带有很多注释，掌握好规则，游戏的核心是辨证；首先四诊得到症状和体征，这一步比较简单，然后点击右侧各个证（病），注释面板会出现该证（病）的解释，需要看注释面板的内容，这样能大概比较出哪个证（病）和现在的症状更吻合，不能完全确定也没关系，点击右侧的证候分析，就可以打开病机分析面板，病机和症状可以进行比对，只要症状符合病机分析面板上的条件，那么就可以判断患者病情属于该证（病）。

游戏不要求玩家记住很多知识，但是要求玩家动脑筋，理解注释面板中的内容，通过注释面板的说明来猜测相应的答案，病情配合各种面板进行核对。游戏会增加一个学习模块，把游戏中的内容做成可以随时查询的模块，所以不需要刻意记忆。

本页和b站和知乎上有操作解说，一图胜千字。

另外该游戏的社会意义也非常不错：

1，健康必要性：游戏玩家因为长时间玩游戏，体质会变差，容易生病或者有其他症状；而中医比较擅长处理这类亚健康及由此而产生的各种身体不适。本游戏虽然比较专业，但是也有中医体质相关的内容，而且相关内容会持续增加。

2，健康提示：相对于FPS，roguelike游戏，模拟器看起来会比较乏味，界面简陋。但即使游戏性很强的游戏，也有大多数玩家买了吃灰；即使中医模拟器买了也吃灰，但是当身体经常不舒服，感觉需要学习些中医养生知识的时候，如果库里有中医模拟器，就会提示你打开游戏或者加入群进行交流。

*************************************

玩家qq讨论群，中医0基础STEAM玩家讨论群 684594520，同时也可以加入有中医经验群 302219333（第2群），697138589（已满），欢迎参加讨论。

抢先体验版是目前试玩版的完整版，包括五章游戏（中成药，辨证入门，内科，五运六气和伤寒论）。工具及题库包括 中医体质测试及内容，执业医师题库及伤寒论题库，伤寒论在线竞赛，伤寒论背诵。

抢先体验版会有提示不全的情况，因为很多症状还没有收录到字典中，但是不影响游戏体验。正式版会弥补这一状况。

正式版还会增加很多内容（可能会更换一些新内容）

入门模块，病机，辅行诀，舌诊，中药，不同题库的在线竞赛，金匮，题库的数量也会大幅增加。

玩家自己添加内容，生成题库和帮助记忆对比的小游戏。

中医积木式字典加辨证。

游戏第一章，玩家是在时间管理局的药店工作，玩家的客户都是中国古代名人。

游戏把看病比作破案，四诊就是勘察现场，寻找线索，线索就是症状。嫌疑犯就是各种已知证型，证型的作案手法，对应有不同的线索组合，即不同的症状组合。

游戏就是通过四诊，得到患者的所有症状，然后选择对应的证型，再根据兼症，选择合适的中成药。

2，健康提示：相对于FPS，roguelike游戏，模拟器看起来会比较乏味，界面简陋。但即使游戏性很强的游戏，也有大多数玩家买了吃灰；即使中医模拟器买了也吃灰，但是当身体经常不舒服，感觉需要学习些中医养生知识的时候，如果库里有中医模拟器，就会提示你打开游戏或者加入群进行交流。

*************************************

玩家qq讨论群，中医0基础STEAM玩家讨论群 684594520，同时也可以加入有中医经验群 302219333（第2群），697138589（已满），欢迎参加讨论。

抢先体验版是目前试玩版的完整版，包括五章游戏（中成药，辨证入门，内科，五运六气和伤寒论）。工具及题库包括 中医体质测试及内容，执业医师题库及伤寒论题库，伤寒论在线竞赛，伤寒论背诵。

抢先体验版会有提示不全的情况，因为很多症状还没有收录到字典中，但是不影响游戏体验。正式版会弥补这一状况。

正式版还会增加很多内容（可能会更换一些新内容）

入门模块，病机，辅行诀，舌诊，中药，不同题库的在线竞赛，金匮，题库的数量也会大幅增加。

玩家自己添加内容，生成题库和帮助记忆对比的小游戏。

中医积木式字典加辨证。

游戏第一章，玩家是在时间管理局的药店工作，玩家的客户都是中国古代名人。

游戏把看病比作破案，四诊就是勘察现场，寻找线索，线索就是症状。嫌疑犯就是各种已知证型，证型的作案手法，对应有不同的线索组合，即不同的症状组合。

游戏就是通过四诊，得到患者的所有症状，然后选择对应的证型，再根据兼症，选择合适的中成药。

data.name: Between Horizons – A Sci-Fi Detective Adventure
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THE GAME

Between Horizons is set aboard the Zephyr, humanity's first generation ship en route to another star. You assume the role of Chief of Security Stella, who was born on the ship 24 years ago. Dive into the conspiracy behind the incident that threatens to disrupt the Zephyr's social order and foil its mission.

Between Horizons is a modern 2.5D pixel art adventure that brings a branching narrative into a semi-open world. The team at DigiTales has applied numerous lessons from their first game Lacuna and proven solutions to detective game design problems to maximize player agency in the investigation process – all the while maintaining the tight pacing of a meaningful story that will ask you to reevaluate your moral compass and make increasingly tough decisions as the situation aboard the ship spirals out of control.


FEATURES

  • An Unusual Adventure: Between Horizons merges investigation gameplay with a branching sci-fi story in an ever-expanding Metroidvania-style environment.

  • Think For Yourself: The flexible evidence system lets you assign clues to cases, confront people about them, and solve any case with at any point in time. Everything you find on the ship may or may not be connected to the mystery at hand.

  • Failure is Very Much an Option: There are no second chances — submitting an incorrect solution means that consequences may follow as the story branches and ends based on your decisions.

  • Set Your Course: Underneath the game's exciting and plausible sci-fi plot lies a number of thought-provoking problems inviting you to weigh intergenerational responsibility against personal freedom.

  • A New Dimension: Timeless pixel art merges with 3D environments and modern visual effects to create a unique art style. Prefer old-school 2D? No problem, you can switch any time!

data.name: Undying Lantern
data.detailed_description:
Undying Lantern is a third-person action game set in the fantasy world of Zagrat. You work for the Holistic and Abnormal Unit for Nabbing Tricksters, also known as HAUNT. Pursue, Preserve, Persist. That is the Haunter code.

Explore Mysterious Locations


Tricksters are dangerous criminals who will stop at nothing to escape justice. They hide in places only a Haunter can reach.

Master the Lantern


Haunters use a power known as Luminancy. Their source of power comes from the lantern that hangs from every agent’s hip. Understanding and mastering these abilities is paramount to overcoming the dangers you will face.

Uncover Secrets


Everyone has a story, and every Trickster has a weakness. It is up to you to piece together what is going on. Only then will you have a chance of taking down your target.

Capture the Trickster


You will face difficult odds that will require you to think on your feet. A fight with a Trickster is rarely a straightforward duel.

Core Features

  • Each stage has a core puzzle that needs to be solved
  • Unlock new abilities after every level
  • Each boss has one or more weaknesses
  • A story told through fragmented pieces of information
  • Includes a story mode difficulty
  • Relatively short game with six stages in total

  • The game features Automatic Wall Climbing with 3D platforming mechanics not key bound

  • "Terrifying entities stalk your every move. From bloodthirsty demons and vengeful ghosts to grotesque clowns, deadly spiders, savage minotaur, and other nightmarish creatures, each level introduces new horrors that heighten the tension. With every soul you gather, the danger intensifies, forcing you to outwit and outrun your relentless pursuers."

data.detailed_description:
"자신만의 모험을 하며 섬의 문제를 해결하고 꿈의 섬에 도달하세요!" 플레이어는 회색 고양이 ‘레이’가 되어, 신비로운 섬을 탐험하며 다양한 리듬 전투를 펼칩니다. 각 지역에는 개성 넘치는 고양이들이 살고 있으며, 그들과의 리듬 배틀을 통해 섬을 혼란에 빠뜨린 원인을 하나씩 밝혀나갑니다. 음악의 박자에 맞춰 적의 공격을 피하고, 정해진 타이밍에 리듬을 맞춰 사격을 성공시켜야 합니다. 섬 곳곳에는 레이의 과거와 꿈의 섬의 비밀이 얽혀 있으며, 플레이어의 선택에 따라 서로 다른 대화와 사건이 전개됩니다. 모험의 끝에서, 레이는 무엇을 보게 될까요?

"Embark on your own adventure, solve the island’s mysteries, and reach the dream island!"
You play as Ray, a gray cat exploring a mysterious chain of islands while engaging in various rhythm-based battles. Each region is home to unique cat residents, and through rhythm duels with them, you uncover the cause of the chaos spreading across the islands.
You must dodge enemy attacks to the beat and fire at precise timing cues aligned with the music. Scattered throughout the island are clues tied to Ray’s past and the secrets of the dream island, leading to different dialogues and events depending on your choices.
At the end of the journey, what truth will Ray discover?

data.name: Columbine
data.detailed_description:
Demo planned for August 2026.

A story-driven dark fantasy 2D shooter with four branching endings.

The Blooming Plague is a mysterious disease that slowly transforms people into trees.

When the merchant girl Frelle becomes infected, the young lumberjack Stober sets out to find a legendary remedy hidden deep within a dangerous cave. As the plague spreads and time runs short, the two are drawn into a truth far darker than either of them imagined.

Fight your way through monsters, uncover the secrets behind the plague, and face choices that will shape the fate of both the characters and the world around them.

Features

  • Story-driven dark fantasy adventure

  • Top-down 2D shooter combat

  • Four unique endings based on your choices

  • Multiple routes that reveal different sides of the story

  • A short narrative experience (20–40 minutes per playthrough)

Four Endings, Four Answers

Your journey can lead to four different conclusions:

  • A wish fulfilled together

  • A future carried forward by memory

  • A lonely journey in pursuit of hope

  • A vow to move toward tomorrow

Each ending reveals a different perspective on love, loss, sacrifice, and the meaning of moving forward.

What Will Remain?

This story does not ask which choice was right.

Instead, it asks:

What remains after the choice is made?

Streaming and Video Guidelines

Streaming, gameplay videos, and live broadcasts of this game are welcome.

data.about_the_game:
Demo planned for August 2026.

A story-driven dark fantasy 2D shooter with four branching endings.

The Blooming Plague is a mysterious disease that slowly transforms people into trees.

When the merchant girl Frelle becomes infected, the young lumberjack Stober sets out to find a legendary remedy hidden deep within a dangerous cave. As the plague spreads and time runs short, the two are drawn into a truth far darker than either of them imagined.

Fight your way through monsters, uncover the secrets behind the plague, and face choices that will shape the fate of both the characters and the world around them.

Features

  • Story-driven dark fantasy adventure

  • Top-down 2D shooter combat

  • Four unique endings based on your choices

  • Multiple routes that reveal different sides of the story

  • A short narrative experience (20–40 minutes per playthrough)

Four Endings, Four Answers

Your journey can lead to four different conclusions:

  • A wish fulfilled together

  • A future carried forward by memory

  • A lonely journey in pursuit of hope

  • A vow to move toward tomorrow

Each ending reveals a different perspective on love, loss, sacrifice, and the meaning of moving forward.

What Will Remain?

This story does not ask which choice was right.

Instead, it asks:

What remains after the choice is made?

data.name: Valfaris: Mecha Therion
data.detailed_description:
Join Us On Discord


About the Game



Therion returns as the hunt for Lord Vroll continues. Pilot an advanced machine of death and destruction in this explosive 2.5D side-scrolling shoot ‘em up, and sequel to the critically acclaimed Valfaris. Strap in and unleash mecha hell!



After escaping Valfaris, Therion’s hunt for the evil Lord Vroll has taken him across the galaxy. As the final, inevitable showdown looms, Therion harnesses the awesome combat ability of his secret weapon – Mecha Therion!



A formidable suit of weaponised metal, Mecha Therion can be equipped with an array of devastating firepower, including Therion’s trademark Hellwraith – a minigun that shoots tormented souls.

Strap in and unleash mecha hell!


  • Fight through multiple levels of hostile alien territory
  • Master a range of Destroyer, Melee, and Auxiliary class weapons
  • Configure your Mecha loadout with your favourite weapon combos
  • Earn Blood Metal to upgrade weapons and add-ons
  • Take on the all new challenge mode after beating the game for the first time!

Play the new Challenge Mode!


  • The player is equipped with lives instead of a health bar
  • Weapons are upgraded on-the-fly by collecting pick-ups
  • Earn a score by defeating enemies and destroying anything that's destructible
  • Weapons can be downgraded if you're hit by an enemy
  • Gain extra lives at score milestones and by collecting Blood of Valfaris
  • Checkpoints can be destroyed as a way to earn Blood of Valfaris

data.name: Project Zero Deaths
data.detailed_description:
Grab your friends or prepare to fight alone in the action-filled and super fast-paced free-to-play online platform shooter Project Zero Deaths! Choose between 7 different characters with unique skills and upgrade and customize every aspect of your character and fighting gear. Put your skills to a test on a varied selection of team vs team game modes, from the classic Capture the Flag to the exciting Bomb Delivery or Payload and the frantic Ring Collecting. Feel your adrenaline pumping while you fight in a varied selection of dynamic maps with destructible environments and physics-based traps. Gear up and prepare your weapons, it’s time to brawl in Project Zero Deaths!

FIGHT ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS IN ACTION-PACKED ONLINE MULTIPLAYER


Team up with your friends or other fighters from all over the world to fight in super fast online matches! Your skill makes the difference in this perfectly balanced F2P experience – only the best warriors reach victory!

PHYSICS-BASED AND DYNAMIC ENVIRONMENTS


Bounce grenades off the wall into your enemies’ faces, destroy bridges under their feet, push them into a black hole, block their way with heavy objects… Physics are one of the most powerful weapons in your arsenal!

CHOOSE YOUR HERO BETWEEN UNIQUE CHARACTERS


Pick the hero that best adapts to your playstyle between 7 unique characters (as of yet – more coming soon!). Each of them has their own sets of skills. Wanna go fast? Rookie is ready for you! Stealth is your thing? Grouch will be sneaky enough! Mayhem and destruction, please? B-Man awaits your orders!

PICK YOUR WEAPON FROM AN INSANELY VARIED ARMORY


From simple plasma guns to portable black hole launchers or explosive spears, this armory has all kinds of crazy weapons to satisfy even the most exquisite fighter! Find your favorite weapons and customize and upgrade them to hone their destruction capabilities to their full potential.

4 COMPETITIVE GAME MODES IN VARIED MAPS


Four different team vs team game modes so you never get bored with the rules! Hoard rings and fight to protect your treasure in Harvest, bring the flag to your base in classic Capture the Flag, set a bomb in your enemies’ base in Bombing Run, and protect your payload all the way to your base in Payload. Every game mode has its own set of unique maps, up to a total of 30 maps!

A GAME THAT IS ALWAYS NEW


Project Zero Deaths is constantly evolving with regular updates with new content such as characters, weapons, maps, and game modes. This game will always have something new waiting for you!

data.detailed_description:
The phone rings. The voice on the other end is filled with desperation. Something terrible has happened, and now it’s up to you to uncover the truth. Mystery is a 2D platformer in pixel art, where exploration and interaction are essential to unravel a mystery hidden in the darkness.

Step into the shoes of an investigator and immerse yourself in an atmosphere heavy with tension, where every detail might hold a crucial clue. Traverse mystery-rich environments, from silent hallways to unknown basements, as you search for answers hidden in objects, documents, and markings left behind.

🕵️‍♂️ Key Features:

  • 2D pixel art platformer, with a detailed and nostalgic visual style.

  • Free exploration, allowing you to investigate every corner of the mansion and beyond.

  • Interaction with objects, examining clues that reveal hidden secrets.

  • A dense atmosphere of suspense, enhanced by an immersive soundtrack.

  • Puzzles and challenges, testing your ability to connect the fragments of the story.

Silence can be just as unsettling as the unknown. Are you ready to discover what lurks in the shadows?

data.name: Back For Loot
data.detailed_description:
Bad run? Good haul.

In Back for Loot, getting knocked out sends you back to the entrance. Luckily, you get to keep the gold. Spend your haul on permanent upgrades, send your party back into the fray, and get past the boss that flattened you last time.

A solo incremental roguelite with short runs and a taste for fantasy nonsense, Back for Loot follows four ordinary people trying to escape a kingdom where adventures never end. They'd like to go home. You might want another upgrade first.

Give the boss a good shake

Your party keeps moving, and your health keeps ticking down. Hold to attack as you fight your way through each region, or unlock Auto Attack and let the party take it from there.

Each region ends with a boss sitting on a pile of treasure. Every hit knocks out gold. You don't have to win to walk away with something. Even a failed attempt can pay for the upgrade that gets you through on the next run.

Put your last defeat to work

Back at the entrance, it's time to spend. Pick your way through the skill tree, invest in permanent perks, and decide what your party needs before heading out again.

  • Skills and perks: strengthen your heroes with upgrades that suit your playstyle.
  • Prestige: reset the map and come back stronger.
  • Constellations: your first Prestige opens a second progression tree with more upgrades to work toward.
  • Mutators: raise the stakes with tougher runs and bigger rewards.

Chosen heroes. Questionable qualifications.

Raul, Iris, Nilo and Berenice only wanted a go on a fairground attraction called The Last Adventure. They were promised an exit through the gift shop. They got the Kingdom of Eve.

Now there's a prophecy to fulfill, a way home to find, and Master Severin, the Brief, to explain it all. At length.

Meet The Bad Omen Company:
  • Raul, the Contrarian Squire: will put himself between you and a monster. He will also say “I told you so.”
  • Iris, the Witness Hunter: armed with arrows of light and a few questions the monsters would rather not answer.
  • Nilo, the Wizard by Insistence: firmly believes there's no problem that more fire can't solve.
  • Berenice, the Saint of Sass: keeps a healing cauldron handy. Chosen one or not, you're eating before you save the world.
Need a little extra muscle? Hire mercenaries to back you up. Heroism is their business. Literally.

An entire kingdom with unfinished business

Explore 25 regions, each with its own boss, in a world that never quite gets to “happily ever after.”

The royal wedding is tomorrow. It has been tomorrow for six hundred years. At the Cemetery of the Provisionally Deceased, the dead are still waiting for their memorials to wrap up. The dwarves at the Forge of the Perfect Sword insist their weapons need just one more adjustment. And in the Hell of Pending Appeals, even a demon's vacation request can be stuck in limbo.

Somewhere beyond all that is the way home. And quite a lot of gold.

Also included: Steam Achievements, weekly leaderboards and Steam Cloud saves. Play in English or Brazilian Portuguese.

One more run. Then you're definitely leaving.

Start your journey now and start solving this sim!

data.name: Imperfections
data.detailed_description:
Imperfections is a 2D space shooter, where you build your own battleship, manage energy and heat to fight off enemies and bosses.

You can use various parts to build your spaceship including thrusters, turrets, shockwaves and more! 

You also need to be careful and build your ship wisely as it can overheat or parts may function differently depending on where you place them. For example if you place your thruster on the side, your ship will rotate like in the real world!
You can unlock many central room types that modify your survival experience! 

Each electrical part uses energy and produces heat on use, you need to manage your temperature using coolers or you can overheat and explode! You also need to manage energy as without it, none of your parts would work! You can generate energy using solar panels or heat recyclers.

There are many different enemies and bosses that will try to take you down. They can be ranged, melee or even mixed! Each boss has their own unique abilities that will test your ship in different aspects from movement to firepower! There are also different enemy types that make your experience much more thrilling!

data.detailed_description:
Have you ever had so bad day that you just wanted to go away from the humanity and relax? Now you can go to the Moon. Or to the Mars. That isn't far enough? No problem, go to another star system. Check yourself why TRAPPIST-1 planets don't have any forms of life.

Another feature of the Virtual Telescope is to give you the actual star sky and solar system state which depend on your current geolocation and time. You can change zoom or lens size and get information about a selected object or just watch events like solar and lunar eclipses.

data.name: Voidigo
data.detailed_description:
Unleash chaos in Voidigo, a vividly animated roguelite shooter packed with dynamic boss battles, zany weapons, and playful humor.



Select from an array of ranged and melee weapons to combat the looming corruption. Master the art of dodging and stun your enemies with stomps to tip the balance in your favor.





Voidigo's numerous bosses, corrupted by the void, offer fierce resistance. They may flee mid-battle, giving you a choice: pursue or regroup. However, hesitate too long, and they'll begin hunting you.





In your battle, collect diverse power-ups for exciting synergies. Trade weapons and resources to customize your playstyle.

data.name: Anime Shop Simulator ✨
data.detailed_description:
Anime Shop Simulator is fun first-person simulation where you become the manager of your very own anime shop!

Play solo or join forces with friends in online co-op to expand your shop, attract more customers, and create the ultimate otaku and trading card paradise!

MANAGE YOUR SHOP

Build your dream Anime Shop! Arrange manga, figures, and collectible cards on the shelves to create a seamless and enjoyable shopping experience for your customers.

CO-OP GAMEPLAY

Join forces with your friends online in 4-player co-op mode to manage your anime shop together, divide responsibilities, and plan strategies to maximize your profits.

COLLECT THEM ALL AND FIGHT IN PVP!

Unbox booster packs and discover unique treasures! Find rare collectible cards to sell for a profit or keep them to complete your ultimate anime card collection. Fight with other players in PvP TCG game and find out who's the best! 

CUSTOMIZATION

Transform your anime store into a one-of-a-kind otaku haven! Choose your favorite wallpaper, give your shop a unique name, and decorate it with items to reflect your personal style.

GROW

Enlarge your shop, upgrade its decor, and stay in tune with the dynamic trends of the anime industry to remain competitive.

In Anime Shop Simulator your decisions shape your journey. Can you transform your small boutique into a thriving otaku hub while balancing customer satisfaction and financial success?

data.name: CatDude & Karsh
data.detailed_description:
CatDude & Karsh is a boss rush adventure that combines moderately challenging combat with a relaxing hub world experience. Fight your way through a series of ranked encounters while taking time between battles to enjoy a variety of cozy activities, including fishing, hotel management, and market trading.

As CatDude and Karsh rise through the ranks, they will need to strengthen their abilities, manage their resources, and prepare for increasingly demanding fights. Progress in both combat and hub world activities to build your standing and move closer to the ultimate goal.

Reach the top and save Princess Emma from the clutches of Count Dooshenmire.
