data.name: Sagger
data.detailed_description:
Sagger is a historical strategy simulator where you stand in the position of the commander-in-chief during the Yom Kippur War.
Your decisions will lead you to victory and glory of Israel or significant loss and nuclear catastrophe!!

In Sagger, you can decide and play the "WHAT IF.." game
No more guessing is needed!

Sagger is first a kind decision-making simulator based on historical facts, which allows you to check how a single decision would impact war results.

You will struggle with time, incomplete information from the battlefield, and a tremendous sense of responsibility for the country's future.

Will you prove to be a great leader like Golda Meir? Now it's your turn!!
Will you be able to make good decisions based on the knowledge you receive?

PROVE YOURSELF!!
Take the lead and command the Israeli army through the actual historical events of the Yom Kippur War in our interactive strategy simulator system.

Sagger allows you to walk trough historical path of Yom Kippur War, but test alternative decisions that were considered during the war.

It starts September 13th and goes through all battle decisions made during Yom Kippur War, and all "WHAT IF..." scenarios.
This simulator will show you how your decisions impact the war and diplomatic arena.


The exploration of Sagger's HUGE historical database will show you all the events from Yom Kippur War as well as other topics from 1973 such as cold war politics and oil as a weapon.


The knowledge database contains 5 categories that you can explore:
*People
*Military
*History
*Tactics
*Geopolitics


Report Database

While things change on the battlefield and in diplomacy, you will receive reports from generals on all fronts as well as other major world leaders such as Henry Kissinger

You will learn how to use acquired information and make good decisions based on it.

Due to Sagger's historical accuracy and its entertaining form, this is the best way to learn about the history of the Yom Kippur War.

You can check your progress with a detailed map of the Israeli military movements during the Yom Kippur War, based on actual staff maps!

• Unit movements are based on your decisions
After making a decision, the units follow your orders.
You will see the consequences of your leadership in real time.

Make Your own decisions and lead Israel to victory or defeat in the Yom Kippur War.

data.name: 2064: Read Only Memories
data.detailed_description:
2064: Read Only Memories is a cyberpunk point-and-click adventure set in the colorful future metropolis of Neo-San Francisco. Meet a huge cast of fascinating characters, solve a far-reaching mystery, and think carefully about your choices — you never know how they will affect this dynamic, branching narrative further down the line.

The world is changing.

Genetic alteration of humans is now commonplace, with many choosing to radically alter their bodies to express their individuality. Virtual intelligences called ROMs (Relationship and Organizational Managers), created as simple digital assistants, are exerting greater control over people's lives. Some are terrified by this rapid change, and they are willing to go to extreme lengths to prevent it.

A lost ROM named Turing breaks into the apartment of a struggling journalist to ask for help. They claim to be the first sapient machine — not a simulation of life but a genuinely self-aware artificial being — and the technical genius who created them has gone missing. Can you unravel the shocking conspiracy that threatens to rock an entire society? Or will the darkness that lies behind the bright neon lights of Neo-SF consume you?

  • Old-school, cutting-edge — Classic point-and-click adventuring inspired by the likes of Gabriel Knight and Snatcher is melded with modern branching storytelling that delves into identity, individuality, and what it means to be human.

  • People of the future - Get to know a diverse cross-section of Neo-SF's population, brought to life by some of the best voice talent working in games today, including Melissa Hutchison and Dave Fennoy (The Walking Dead), Erin Yvette (Oxenfree), Austin Creed (WWE's Xavier Woods), and SungWon Cho (ProZD).

  • High tech nostalgia — The city of Neo-San Francisco is rendered in beautiful pixel art, and your adventure is accompanied by a catchy lo-fi electronic synth soundtrack.

  • Solve the mystery — Over ten hours of adventure across exploration, dynamic branching conversations, multiple endings, and plenty of challenges to overcome.

  • The complete edition — Packed with years of improvements and additions including new characters and voice performers, additional facial animations, Japanese language support, and the "Endless Christmas" extended epilogue that lets you hang out with your favorite Neo-SF locals.

Note: Steam cloud saves currently only work on the same platform (i.e. Windows, Mac, etc.)

data.name: Berserkers
data.detailed_description:
TWO ROPES

Left hand and right hand, fired independently. Hold both and you are on a

pendulum; drop one and you are on an arc; drop the other and you are falling.

Reeling is a zip rather than a nudge, so the line pulls you straight to what

you hooked. Everything else in the game sits on top of that.

ONE AXE, AND THE HEART

A clean cut on the heart kills anything, whatever its size. The window is

small and the difficulty lives in reaching it, not in surviving long enough to

grind something down. Miss the heart and you land a body blow worth a third of

the creature; hacking works and takes three times as long.

BLESSINGS

More than sixty of them, drafted two at a time as a match runs. Every one is a

trade. Lose the ability to reel in and carry double the tank. Throw your shield

like a frisbee and give up the bubble that was keeping you alive. Shrink to a

third of your size and become genuinely hard to hit, including by the aim

assist. Nothing here is a permanent upgrade; the run ends and so does the

blessing.

THE MODES

Holmgang · one against one, first to five rounds, no shelter

Warbands · four a side, Aesir against Jotnar, five minutes

Gjallarhorn · carry the horn and score while you hold it. Everyone in the hall comes for you

The Hunt · up to four, holding a ward against endless waves

Bosses · Jormungandr under the frozen mere, and Fenrir on Lyngvi

Fridr · Alfheim, with nothing hunting you. Eighteen rings and a long way down

SEVEN REALMS

A black forest in Vanaheim. The inside of a mountain in Muspelheim. The rainbow

bridge over the void in Asgard, with the island and Odin's seat at the end of

it. A frozen mere in Niflheim. The bound wolf on Lyngvi. The holm in Midgard.

The long light of Alfheim, where nothing wants anything from you.

WHAT YOU EARN

Titles, ropes, winds, cloaks and crests. Twenty-four titles and forty-one

cosmetics, and not one of them makes you stronger. The rule has held since the

first line of the progression system: rewards are what you wear, never what you

hit with.

HONESTLY

This is my first game made from start to finish as a solo dev. I hope it's worth your time, but if reviews and feedback call for it, I'll continue putting time into the project to make it a game you want to play!

data.detailed_description:
The eternal harvester of galactic empires has returned! Witness massive waves of Creeper flood across the 3D terrain in this real time strategy game where the enemy is a fluid. Build out your economic base with energy and mined wares. Assemble your forces and struggle against the creeper on all fronts as it floods and fills the map. Take the high ground with your forces to avoid the creeper as waves crash around your base. Increase your lines of sight and range on high ground, but beware the aerial units. And, if you last long enough, launch orbital weapons and call down devastating strikes on the enemy.

Creeper World 4 continues the iconic and well received Creeper World RTS franchise, expanding into a new dimension of strategic possibilities and threats. The galaxy once again finds itself culled and utterly in ruins. Guide a scientist and cohorts through the ultimate test of survival and restore hope to the galaxy... one world at a time. Play small maps casually, while pausing and issuing orders. Alternately, play massive maps in real-time with full save support. The choice is yours. Play the story missions, the community crafted missions, or use the built in mission generator for infinite possibilities. Use the map editor to make your own maps for fun and sharing. Create custom units, or even custom game play modes, and share those as well.

Features

  • 3D Terrain with numerous strategic options.
  • Enhanced graphics
  • Physics-based flowing 'Creeper' enemy with wave mechanics.
  • Land, Air, and Orbital weapons.
  • Custom unit support with scripting.
  • Online map database.
  • Story/Campaign missions.
  • Experimental Co-op multiplayer.

Get started, and become the master of your Berlingus Idle empire!

data.name: The Horror Story: Rebirth
data.detailed_description:
NEW LINEAR DLC EXPANSION INCLUDED!

Get The Horror Story: Rebirth and get the KaleidoMode Expansion DLC for free! The KaleidoMode is a free DLC that unlocks once you completed the base game by getting the true ending. Your mission: Unknown!


About the Game



The Horror Story: Rebirth is a remake version from the original Horror Story powered by Unreal Engine 5. Collect an item to unlock the next level, and to proceed with the game, but be careful though. Someone may be lurking around in these levels.

There are 3 levels you need to beat in order to unlock the "secret bonus level". You will start off in the Basement. Look around to see if you can find an item you need to proceed. Then there's the Bush Maze. It's small, so you should be able to find the item pretty quickly. The last level is the Maze. You must find your way around the maze in order to find the item you need to proceed. The "Secret Bonus Level" is a secret, so complete all 3 levels to unlock it.

Like all horror games, it contains jumpscares, flashing lights, and loud noises.

Features:

  • Unlockable levels
  • Collectable items
  • Flashlight
  • Scary elements
  • 3 levels
  • 1 bonus level

data.name: ZOMBIECAM
data.detailed_description:
OUT NOW

Zombies. Guns. Bodycam. ZOMBIECAM blends realism and immersion in a well paced first person shooter arena experience. Fight against hordes of zombies in round-based arena environments, achieve in-level weapon unlocks and use explosives and the environment to your advantage.

LEVELS: Map environments look and feel authentic with realistic lighting and effects. Some photorealistic assets are also in the game.

COMBAT: Hordes of zombies get bigger and more diverse throughout each round. Apex zombies are harder to kill. Use the layout of the arena to your advantage and use the right weapon for each horde situation you are in. 

WEAPONS: Weapons feel powerful and do the job of reducing the horde. Unlock more weapons are the initial rounds go by. Flamethrower and explosive crossbow are the ultimate zombie killing tools. 

HUD: ZOMBIECAM has a realistic display with no HUD other then the bodycam-style border. Temporary blood on screen when taking damage. The overall display of the game leans towards realism along with lifelike audio effects as well. 

NIGHTVISION MODE: A separate nightvision-only mode that can be played at any time.

CHAMBER OF PAIN: An open level with scattered bouncepads. Adds an extra dimension to the gameplay.

Press and Inquiries: contact@zombiecamgame.com

data.name: Portolan
data.detailed_description:
Your chart begins as an empty sheet of paper.

Not fogged. Not greyed out. Empty. There is no wind arrow on it, no current, no

coastline, no sounding — because nobody has been there and written one down. Everything

that ever appears on that chart, you put there yourself, one measurement at a time.

Four instruments and a great deal of patience

You have what a ship in 1821 actually carried, and nothing else.

  • Compass and log — a course and a speed, hour after hour, which is a position

  • only for as long as the sea agrees with you.

  • Sextant — the sun at its highest gives you a latitude. It gives you nothing at

  • all about your longitude, and it gives you nothing on a cloudy day.

  • Thermometer — sea temperature, hourly. It is how you find the edge of a current

  • before you can see it.

  • Lead line — the bottom, if the bottom is within 150 metres. Where it answers,

  • You are closer to land than you thought.

Your mistakes are the data

This is the mechanic the whole game is built from. You reckon your position from course

and speed. Then you take a sight, and the sight disagrees with your reckoning. That

disagreement is not a failure state — it is the current, measured. The difference between

where you thought you were and where you are gets written back along the track you

sailed, cell by cell, and becomes an arrow on your chart.

Navigate carelessly and the arrows land in the wrong squares. The chart will go on lying

to you about that stretch of ocean for as long as you let it.

A plan is worth exactly what your chart is worth

Lay marks across the water and the game tells you the date you reach each one, the days

of water you will have left when you get there, and — in plain numbers — how much of that

forecast rests on cells you have actually measured. On a blank sheet the certainty reads

[b]0%[/b], and the panel says so outright: the rest is extrapolation, not prediction.

That number is the reason to survey. Not points. Not currency. The planner simply stops

lying to you.

Water is the second deadline

Twenty-four sailors, a hundred days of provisions, fifty days of water. Water runs out

first, and it is bought with time alone — days idle in harbour, or hours spent putting a

boat ashore in a bay that may or may not have a stream in it. Whether a stretch of coast

gives water is a fact about that coast, fixed from the moment the world was made, and

finding it out is the same loop as finding a wind: go, look, write it down.

Ice closes the north in its season. Cyclones close the south in theirs. You do not learn

this from a tooltip. You learn it by arriving.

The ship is expendable. The chart is not.

Run out of water at sea and the ship is lost. You may take a new one out of your home

port with [b]the same chart[/b] — every rose, every sounding, every watering place you

ever wrote down. That is the whole proposition of the game in one line: the voyage ends,

the knowledge stays.

What this is not

  • No combat. Nothing shoots at you.

  • No economy. No gold, no cargo prices, no shops, no upgrade tree. Provisions are

  • Counted in days, not coins, and buy nothing but time.

  • No quest log. Nobody hands you a checklist. Where you sail is your own idea.

  • No sail trim. You set a heading and stand the watch. The interesting decision

  • is where, not how tight the sheets are.

The world

The Atlantic as it is — real coastline, sixteen real harbours from Falmouth to Cape Town,

real wind belts, real calm latitudes — and a generated ocean that plays by the same rules

when you want water nobody has ever charted. Every world is a seed: the same seed gives

the same ocean, so a passage that beat you can be sailed again.

data.name: Infected Mushroom Pinball
data.detailed_description:
Available for PC, with native VR and Virtual Pinball Cabinet support.

Warning: Neural pathways may rewire during gameplay.

Side effects include questioning existence, seeing m﻿usic as pinball trajectories, loss of objective reality and uncontrollable urge to replay. Infected Mushroom and Rayworks are not responsible for any lost sense of time, space, or sanity. Consult your shaman if effects persist.


Quick tips for making the top 10

Game Modes - You earn the most points by completing Game Modes

Mode selection begins when the middle mushroom eats the ball. By completing game modes, you earn a lot of points, and new modes will unlock as you progress.

Skill & Combo Shots - Your path to the Extra Ball starts here

When you see the metal rails moving, it means a combo or skill shot opportunity is active. These shots are a great way to earn points. A successful combo skill shot returns the ball to the plunger, giving you a chance to attempt the Extra Ball skill shot.

Special Modes - Chase the ball into alternate dimensions

Find a way to unlock Special Modes, and flow through the melodies with perfect rhythm to make your score skyrocket.

Multiball - Jackpots grow with every locked ball

During Multiball, every mushroom on the playfield turns into a Jackpot target. Jackpot value is determined by how many balls are locked when Multiball begins.

Bonus Multiplier - Boost your game mode completion bonus, up to 4X

Earn even more points from game modes by increasing your bonus multiplier. Light up all the top lanes by passing the ball through each one.

Nudging - Don’t be shy. This machine likes it rough

Standing still won’t get you anywhere. Get physical. This baby wants action, and it likes it rough. Shake it and slap it like you mean it. If it tilts, you might’ve gone too far… or maybe not far enough.

Difficulty Multiplier - Find the perfect balance for your playstyle

Crank up the table difficulty to boost your point multiplier. Shrink the flippers, raise the challenge of game modes, and fine-tune how easily the machine tilts.

Mushroom Multiplier - Every flip matters. Build it, don't burn it.

Side effects include questioning existence, seeing m﻿usic as pinball trajectories, loss of objective reality and uncontrollable urge to replay. Infected Mushroom and Rayworks are not responsible for any lost sense of time, space, or sanity. Consult your shaman if effects persist.


Quick tips for making the top 10

Game Modes - You earn the most points by completing Game Modes

Mode selection begins when the middle mushroom eats the ball. By completing game modes, you earn a lot of points, and new modes will unlock as you progress.

Skill & Combo Shots - Your path to the Extra Ball starts here

When you see the metal rails moving, it means a combo or skill shot opportunity is active. These shots are a great way to earn points. A successful combo skill shot returns the ball to the plunger, giving you a chance to attempt the Extra Ball skill shot.

Special Modes - Chase the ball into alternate dimensions

Find a way to unlock Special Modes, and flow through the melodies with perfect rhythm to make your score skyrocket.

Earn even more points from game modes by increasing your bonus multiplier. Light up all the top lanes by passing the ball through each one.

Standing still won’t get you anywhere. Get physical. This baby wants action, and it likes it rough. Shake it and slap it like you mean it. If it tilts, you might’ve gone too far… or maybe not far enough.

data.name: Dive and Dine Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Early Access 

🎣 Dive Deep for Your Restaurant’s Success

Suit up and plunge into a vibrant underwater world where every dive is a new opportunity. In Dive and Dine Simulator, you’ll catch a wide variety of fish using specialized gear - from classic spears to high-tech traps. Explore colorful ocean zones, discover rare marine creatures, and upgrade your diving equipment to reach greater depths and reel in even bigger rewards.

🦑 From Deep Sea to Delicacies

Every catch is more than just fish - it's a gateway to culinary creativity! In Dive and Dine Simulator, transform your fresh catch into exquisite dishes that will delight your customers. Use your fishing skills to catch everything from small, tender shrimp to massive, exotic fish that only the bravest divers can reach. In the kitchen, prepare meals using realistic cooking mechanics: grill, fry, bake, and steam, each with its own intricacies. As you progress, unlock new recipes, sophisticated kitchen tools, and special ingredients that let you craft gourmet dishes.

The better the dish, the higher the tip - and the more satisfied your customers will be! Build and customize your restaurant to match your culinary vision, and create a menu that keeps customers coming back for more. Manage the dining area, deliver meals on time, and keep your guests happy to maximize your earnings.

🤿 Built for Co-Op Fun

Want to run your sea-to-table empire with friends? Dive into the co-op mode and team up! Split roles or swap around: one dives, one cooks, one serves - or tackle everything together. It’s teamwork, strategy, and chaos in the best possible way. Whether solo or with friends, there's always something to do beneath the waves.

Dive and Dine Simulator is a rich and relaxing simulation experience where exploration, creativity, and cooperation come together. Whether you're building the perfect kitchen, hunting exotic fish, or just vibing with friends - this is your chance to make a splash!

Add Dive and Dine Simulator to your wishlist now, and  become a world-class ocean chef

data.name: Baacadia
data.detailed_description:
A long time ago, this world sang. The Noise sings over it now. Under the dunes and the dust, a faint melody survives — patient, waiting to be heard again.

You're a small recorder robot, and they're your flock—sheep-like creatures crossing a post-apocalyptic land of dunes, ruins, and stranger life. You're here to listen, to bring this world back sound by sound, and to lead the flock home.

Baacadia is a unique puzzle exploration game built around sound.

Sound is your only tool. Capture what the world still keeps — a tone in the wind, a stirring of buried machinery, a call from something you'll never see — and play it back where it might matter. Sound is how the Clofen know you. Play them what they recognize and they come. The world itself answers in its own way: long-still places stir, hidden routes open, pieces of the old melody return.

The world hasn't sung in a long time. Together, sound by sound, you give it its voice back.

What you'll do

  • Record. Replay. Restore. Build a library of sounds and use them to wake what the Noise put to sleep.

  • Shepherd a flock that knows you by sound. Play the Clofen what they recognize and they follow.

  • Explore an open, ink-lined world. No quest markers, no objective text, no hand-holding. Stone, ruin, and stranger life.

  • No fail states, no timers. Move at the pace of your flock.

  • Uncover what was silenced. Piece the old melody back together, one echo at a time.

The melody is still here, faint under everything. The flock is still listening. You can be there when the world sings again.

data.name: StarGazers
data.detailed_description:
StarGazers is an interactive experience that allows players to explore a magical forest from the perspective of three different creatures.



A mind-bending ‘Alice in wonderland’ troupe experience where the user journeys through an enchanted forest that isn’t what it seems. Players transform into the various life forms they interact with, taking them deeper and deeper into the layers of the experience as the world gets progressively stranger. The environments react to the player’s movements and actions for added immersion.



KEY FEATURES

  • Transform into four magical creatures.
    Bringing out your wild side has never been easier than in StarGazers. Through use of the constellations, change your form into multiple different animals. Each animal comes with a separate movement mechanic, from jumping to flying. You must use your new found skills as an animal to traverse the diverse and colorful environments around you.

  • Explore four drastically different environments.
    Deep dive into dark and twisted forests, rocky swamps, an underwater chasm, and a cloudy escape from reality. In this VR experience, discover the vastness of the world animals live in.

data.name: Bladeless Sword: Tale of Qin
data.detailed_description:
Bladeless Sword: Tale of Qin is a 2D pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure inspired by Metroidvania exploration and Sekiro-style combat, set in a mythic world of ancient Chinese fantasy. Players take on the role of Qin, a young girl bound to a mysterious duty and armed with a sword that has no blade. On the sacred slopes of Mount Sixiang, a legendary mountain divided by the four seasons, Qin must train, endure, and uncover the truth behind her mission — and the hidden fate of the world itself.

In this world, dragons, humans, Yao exist in a fragile balance. But as the day of destiny approaches, Qin is forced to confront not only powerful enemies, but also the secrets buried within her own purpose. Qin's fighting style stems from her unique bladeless sword, the bladeless sword cannot wound enemies by ordinary means. Instead, she channels her Qi into the weapon, forming a radiant blade of energy. This Qi blade is not used to strike, but to parry, deflect, and turn enemy attacks against them, gradually building Heart Sword energy — the key to unleashing Qin’s true strength. Journey across the four seasonal regions of Mount Sixiang, master the rhythm of battle, and discover what truly lies beneath this ancient fantasy world.

data.name: Legends of Eisenwald
data.detailed_description:
Knight's Edition

The Knight's Edition contains Legends of Eisenwald OST in MP3 and FLAC formats and artbook. The last two screenshots above in the carousel are from the arbtook.


About the Game

Legends of Eisenwald is an adventure game with tactical battles, RPG and strategy elements. Take the lead of a small feudal army and try to defend your right to survive in this ruthless medieval world.

The mysterious lands of old Germany are waiting for you - it's a land where the superstitions of the time have come to life. This isn’t a fantasy game. There are no elves or dragons here. There are only people - and their passions, sins and fears that often take a tangible form. Which path will you choose? Live according to your conscience? Or live by power and might? Or will you live by justice? And what is your justice, really?

Game features

  • A unique and dynamic combat system - each move is also an attack
  • The ability to individually equip *each* fighter in your army
  • A large selection of weapons, spells and abilities, including the option to use mounted units
  • Diverse upgrade trees, and each unit level up provides cosmetic changes
  • An intriguing non-linear story
  • A distinctive game world without common fantasy cliches
  • Over 50 hours of gameplay within the game. A main campaign consisting of eight chapters plus two additional scenarios.
  • A beautiful symphonic soundtrack in a medieval style
  • An accompanying Scenario Editor with the full set of developer tools

IMPORTANT NOTICE: Similar to games like Disciples 2 and HOMM, there may be points farther into the game where you lose it all, troops, gold, inventory. All those things you worked so hard for. This is part of the game, not a bug. And you wont know when.... Be warned.

data.name: Bonsai Life
data.detailed_description:
Bonsai Life is a peaceful life-simulation game about bonsai, nature, and choosing a quieter way of life.

Looking for a change, you purchase an old, neglected bonsai nursery and begin the slow process of bringing it back to life. What starts as an overgrown property with only a handful of trees gradually becomes your own thriving nursery — shaped by the bonsai you grow, the gardens you create, and the people you meet along the way.

At the heart of Bonsai Life is the art of growing bonsai. Care for trees throughout their lives by watering, pruning, repotting and shaping them. Watch them grow and change through the seasons, develop your skills, discover new species and eventually create beautiful old bonsai of your own.

The world changes throughout the year. Spring brings fresh growth and blossom, summer fills the landscape with life, autumn transforms the trees with colour, and winter brings a quieter landscape. Changing weather, wildlife, day and night, and a dynamic seasonal soundtrack make each part of the year feel different.

As your nursery grows, so can your surroundings. Restore the property, improve your home, build new bonsai displays and create your own Japanese-inspired garden. There is no single correct way to build it — the nursery gradually becomes a reflection of the trees you choose to grow and the life you choose to create.

Bonsai Life is about taking your time.

Spend a day working on an important tree. Go fishing beside a quiet pond. Sell Bonsai. Talk with the locals, work on your garden, or simply watch the seasons change.

There is always something to do, but there is never a need to rush.

Because in Bonsai Life, the most beautiful things take time to grow.

At the heart of Bonsai Life is the art of growing bonsai. Care for trees throughout their lives by watering, pruning, repotting and shaping them. Watch them grow and change through the seasons, develop your skills, discover new species and eventually create beautiful old bonsai of your own.

The world changes throughout the year. Spring brings fresh growth and blossom, summer fills the landscape with life, autumn transforms the trees with colour, and winter brings a quieter landscape. Changing weather, wildlife, day and night, and a dynamic seasonal soundtrack make each part of the year feel different.

As your nursery grows, so can your surroundings. Restore the property, improve your home, build new bonsai displays and create your own Japanese-inspired garden. There is no single correct way to build it — the nursery gradually becomes a reflection of the trees you choose to grow and the life you choose to create.

Bonsai Life is about taking your time.

Spend a day working on an important tree. Go fishing beside a quiet pond. Sell Bonsai. Talk with the locals, work on your garden, or simply watch the seasons change.

There is always something to do, but there is never a need to rush.

Because in Bonsai Life, the most beautiful things take time to grow.
data.short_description: Bonsai Life is a peaceful life-simulation game where you restore and grow your own bonsai nursery. Water, prune, repot, sell and shape your trees, design a Japanese-inspired garden, explore the town, meet its residents, go fishing and watch your world change through the seasons.

data.name: OOTY : Silence Remains
data.detailed_description:
Four friends travel to a remote, abandoned palace hidden deep in the misty hills, searching for thrills. What starts as an adventure turns into a nightmare when darkness falls. Play as one of them, alone and hunted, and uncover the hill’s secrets to survive the night. Escape or become part of the night forever.

First-Person Survival Horror

Experience intense first-person horror focused on atmosphere, tension, and psychological fear.

Explore haunted forest and caves

Navigate a massive, abandoned forest surrounded by dense forest and shrouded in mist. Explore crumbling buildings, forgotten towers, and hidden warehouse structures, each filled with environmental storytelling that reveals the location’s dark history through its decaying architecture, scattered belongings, and unsettling details.

Puzzles & Investigation

Solve environmental puzzles to unlock new areas, uncover the location’s dark history, and find essential tools and keys needed to survive. Every puzzle is designed to push you deeper into danger while revealing disturbing truths about what happened here.

Escape monsters

Each monster hunts differently, forcing you to adapt your playstyle.

Immersive sound design

Every footstep, whisper, and distant noise is designed to keep you on edge. Play with headphones for the full experience.

Find your friends before dawn

Piece together notes, clues, and environmental details to uncover the horrifying truth behind the palace and escape the place before dawn

data.name: Bharat Police
data.detailed_description:
EVERY CALL NEEDS A DIFFERENT APPROACH

A heated argument may require authority. An unclear situation calls for intuition. A dangerous confrontation demands operational skill.

Read the situation, select your officers, and decide how to divide their efforts. Balance Operations, Intuition, and Authority while managing each officer’s workload. A capable team still needs a good plan.

KNOW YOUR PEOPLE, NOT JUST THEIR NUMBERS

Officers have different strengths, weaknesses, and perks that influence how they work. Someone who thrives alone may struggle in a group. Another officer’s performance may depend on having the right partner alongside them.

Build a roster of complementary abilities and learn when to use them. Choosing a team means considering both the assignment and the people you are asking to handle it.

THE NEXT SHIFT STARTS WITH TODAY’S CONSEQUENCES

Experience helps officers develop, while successful assignments can build their confidence. But fatigue accumulates, injuries take people out of action, and repeated failures can damage morale.

Your most dependable officer cannot carry every shift. Decide when to push, when to rotate the team, and when someone needs time to recover. Keeping the department effective takes more than winning the current assignment.

KEEP YOUR DEPARTMENT TOGETHER UNDER PRESSURE

Neighborhood disputes, public unrest, and political pressure compete for your attention. Your budget and available officers only stretch so far.

Hire staff, manage your resources, and decide how much of your team to commit to each call. Sending your best officers may solve the immediate problem - but who will be ready when the next call comes in?

data.name: We Are So Cooked
data.detailed_description:
IT WAS AN ACCIDENT. PROBABLY.

DEAD WEIGHT

A dead body is heavy, floppy, and incredibly awkward.

  • Solo Struggle: Dragging the body alone is slow and leaves a bloody trail.

  • Team Lift: Grab a limb each to move faster, but coordinate carefully—if you pull left and your friend pulls right, you’re going to drop him down the stairs.

  • Physics Chaos: The body snags on doorframes, knocks over vases, and slides off laundry carts. Every step is a potential disaster.

THREATS

The world is watching.

  • Civilians: If a guest sees the body, they scream. Screams attract Guards.

  • Security: They hunt noise. If they catch you with the body, it’s over.

Eyes & Noses: Security Cameras watch the hallways, while Guard Dogs can sniff out the body even if it's hidden inside a locker.

IMPROVISE YOUR ESCAPE

You have no weapons. You have no plan. You only have what you can find.

  • Scavenge: Turn the environment into your toolkit. Find a Wheelchair to roll the body past reception. Use a Mop to clean up blood trails. Throw a Squeaky Toy to distract a guard.

  • One Hand Only: You can hold an item, OR you can drag the body. You can’t do both. You’ll have to scream at your friends to open doors for you.

UNIQUE SCENARIOS

You aren't just hiding in one building. Every environment forces your team to adapt to new physics hazards and AI threats.

  • Crowded Public Spaces: Sneak through luxury hotel lobbies and balance the dead weight on top-heavy luggage carts. Just panic quietly when a nosy maid accidentally rolls away the laundry bin you used as a hiding spot.

  • High-Security Compounds: Survive freezing, heavily guarded bunkers where getting caught means the firing squad. Throw scavenged meat to distract sniffing guard dogs, or desperately hide from a terrifying, medal-clad Marshal who patrols the halls with a booming voice and zero patience.

This game is independently developed by the author in his spare time after work, so please go easy on any criticism.

Try to have fun using different skills to occupy the territory.

data.name: Witch girl got killed.
data.detailed_description:
Witch girl got killed. is a first person fantasy horror action game inspired by Japanese anime.

Features:

∙Your mission is to infiltrate a labyrinth that has appeared in town and destroy its brain.
∙The town and the labyrinth are crawling with troublesome monsters. If you stumble upon one, run away as fast as you can.
∙The monsters respond to footsteps and light, but are particularly sensitive to magic. Exercise caution when using your powers.
∙The game’s total play time is between 40 and 60 minutes.
∙Your progress is saved automatically.

You are a witch girl in training.

Your magic abilities haven’t yet matured.
Still, you can use basic magic.
Traces of sigils drawn by a predecessor are scattered throughout the town and the labyrinth.
Use magic atop one of these sigils and you’ll be able to warp to a new location.
Moreover, while using magic, you’ll be able to see things that aren’t of this world.
Do your best to make effective use of your magic, escape from monsters, and conquer the labyrinth.


Controls:
Movement : WASD
Jump : Space
Options : Tab
Dash mode ON/OFF : LSHIFT
Action (Get/Use Item) : Left Click
Select Item : Mouse wheel
Sights in the center of the screen ON/OFF : R
Flashlight ON/OFF : Right click
Use/stop magic : E

does not notice you until you are in the field of view, you can run away, hiding around the corners and changing rooms. This evil is beyond your power, you will not be able to kill it, survive and find a way out - this is the only solution.

data.name: Lumen: The Last Hope
data.detailed_description:
Lumen: The Last Hope is a story-driven adventure where you absorb light around you. Each color grants a unique ability that helps you explore the mysterious world and overcome its challenges. But light comes at a cost: every time you use an ability, you lose health, forcing you to think carefully about when and how to use your powers.

Core Abilities

  • Red – Strength: Push and move heavy objects.

  • Yellow – Revelation: Reveal hidden objects, paths, and clues.

  • Purple – Distraction: Distract enemies and slip past danger.

  • Blue – Time Slow: Manipulate time to outsmart traps and puzzles.

  • Green – Heal: Restore health after spending it on powers.

Key Features

  • Story-Driven Adventure

  • Puzzle Variety

  • Reactive World

  • Single-Player Focus

data.name: Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars
data.detailed_description:
Fantasy Kommander invites you to embark on a strategic journey through a medieval-inspired isometric realm of fantasy, with 90s style pre-rendered graphics for an immersive retro experience. Set on a hex map filled with diverse terrains, this operational-level strategy game presents a real high quality window into games of the past, with challenging battles, engaging character voice overs, and a competent AI opponent.

Battles take place on a hexagonal map and are regulated by our complex proprietary tactical simulation system "Archangelus" which for each clash considers multiple factors such as terrain, ZOCs (zones of control), morale, orientation, the combat fronts, the offensive and defensive power and the specific typology of each unit.



At the beginning of each battle you can deploy units that each represent hundreds of soldiers, but there are also unique units such as heroes and dragons. Each unit is similar in structure to a classic role-playing game character, with distinct characteristics and special abilities that can be improved by levelling them up thanks to the accumulation of experience points on the battlefield.

The plot unfolds within four compelling campaigns narratively linked to each other. In the role of a valiant general who finds himself in the midst of a devastating war that has broken out for unknown reasons, you will receive messages from Emperor Karl and the Grand Council of Mages that will guide you to discover a mysterious enemy plotting in the shadows.

Alongside you stand three mighty Heroes representing Humans, Elves, and Dwarves, ready to assist in your trials, challenges, and triumphs. Explore the great Empire of Adamantia, invaded by the forces of Kaos, and venture into mysterious uncharted lands as you seek victory and freedom.



Each campaign consists of multiple battles with primary and secondary objectives of escalating difficulty. As you progress, you'll unlock victory levels determined by completing objectives within time limits, with "Epic" Victories making you richer and more famed. Achieving higher levels rewards you with gold, fame points, and various benefits such as unit upgrades, resurrection of fallen troops, new powers, and expanded recruitment options. Visit the encampment after battles to level up your army.



Lead your troops strategically by deploying them before each battle, considering facing and movement options. Engage in melee and ranged combat, utilizing spells and missile weapons to gain an edge. With 32 special abilities, 32 spells, and six different races, the tactical possibilities are vast.



Remember that you can only move one unit at a time, and combat follows a strictly symmetrical turn-based approach. Adapt to these constraints and overcome the scripted challenges that lie ahead.

Features:
  • Complex Battle System incorporating various tactical factors
  • Immersive storyline inspired by European medieval traditions and fantasy narratives
  • Four single-player campaigns with 25 epic battles, heroes, enemy generals, and side quests
  • Over 70 unique units to recruit, upgrade, and unleash upon the battlefield
  • RPG-like units with customizable stats and abilities
  • Powerful spells to wield and hordes of enemies to face





Developer Note:

This game is part of AgeofGames list of re-released videogame artifacts, developed by a small indie team using the full potential and limitations of development technology now phased out of use. We apologize for any technical problems or inconveniences you may encounter in your playthrough, unfortunately we no longer have the ability or opportunity to enter into the code, make meaningful edits or updates to the build of the game. We hope that with these limitations in mind, you may still enjoy the experience!

data.name: Pondemonium
data.detailed_description:
Pondemonium is a charming 2D puzzle-platformer where three determined ducks waddle, jump, and quack their way through dangerous levels to restore their homeland. The once crystal-clear ponds have been poisoned, and only by recovering their own colored eggs can the ducks purify the waters and bring life back to the land.

Each duck has unique abilities that must be combined to outsmart traps, solve puzzles, and survive contraptions left behind by those who defiled the ponds. Success won’t just require creativity — it will demand puzzle-solving skills, precise timing, and precision.

From triggering pressure plates to open doors to dodging spinning saws and avoiding deadly traps, every stage tests both your brain and your platforming precision. Dash over spikes, glide through peril, smash through obstacles and guide each duck to recover their egg. Only when all eggs are claimed can the pond be restored, allowing your feathered friends to advance.

Perfect for fans of classic platformers, Pondemonium blends lighthearted humor with challenging gameplay, rewarding creative problem-solving and quick thinking.

Features

  • Play as three ducks, each with special abilities: Chuck Duck, Mac Mallard, and Peggy Pekin.

  • Collect each duck’s colored egg to purify poisoned ponds and complete each level.

  • Handcrafted levels full of hazards and environmental puzzles.

  • Physics-based contraptions including e.g. boulders, levers, switches, and trapdoors.

  • Deadly enemies like saws, vultures and other twisted machines left behind by the saboteurs.

  • Leaderboards for extra replayability. Do you have what it takes to be #1?

Can you outwit the traps, recover the eggs, and cleanse the poisoned ponds?

data.name: Vindictive Drive
data.detailed_description:
Vindictive Drive is a Thriller/Action game with cyberpunk elements and Real Time Action/Stealth mechanics following Arris Fern, a young woman in her cold blooded revenge against her father, the president of the most powerful nation, for the assassination of her mother 12 years ago.
Completely consumed by hatred and resentment, Arris will use the most cruel methods at her disposal to achieve her goal.

Features:

  • Vindictive Drive's "battle system" rely on outsmarting security systems, avoiding cameras, and fooling your enemies using your computer and jamming devices, leaving the pistol as last resort.
  • Stealth is an important part of the game, you will be able to disable alarms and create distractions.
  • Story rich scenarios and suspense.
  • Talkative and friendly NPCs.
  • A lot of illustrations and animations made frame per frame.
  • Arris' very sour behavior.
  • Multiple endings.

data.name: Rebecca and the Sword of Nasty Curses
data.detailed_description:
✤Story✤

The female warrior Rebecca is the strongest warrior in this small border village.

Rebecca is not only powerful with swordsmanship but also very kind-hearted.

She plays a role similar to the village guardian and is deeply trusted by the villagers.

One day, Rebecca's village was attacked by a group of bandits.

Almost all the villagers were kidnapped, including Takezo, the person of her unrequited love.

So Rebecca embarked on a journey, vowing to defeat the bandits and save the villagers.

In a new continent, Rebecca obtained the magic sword "Cursed Sword".

And this magic sword will greatly change her destiny...!?

When the bandits are defeated and Rebecca successfully takes back her sweetheart, what will happen to the strongest female warrior in the village?

According to the progress, there will be more places to go to.

▲Various materials will drop on the map, and these materials can be exchanged for money.

data.name: GEO-DEUX
data.detailed_description:
“Wake up, wake up! Can you hear me Geo-Duck? The moment of truth has arrived.”

You are but a lowly lizard summoned to greatness by celestial voices. Jesus has gone missing and only you can bring him back alive.

Lead a band of angels on a quest to find Jesus and save Christmas from hyper-secularization. Dress those angels up in the latest fashions, including but not limited to khakis, polo shirts, dreadlocks, hotpants, mohawks, and many more.

Collect many instruments along the way, each with a unique play style, and use them to dissemble inanimate objects through the power of sound. Never forget your cosmic origins! Walk the line between fantasy and reality in a world that really is out to get you.

GEO-DEUX is the long-awaited sequel to Geo-Duck, a 2d musical platformer from the pioneering glitch-hop duo Your Infamous Harp. Based to some extent on a true story, and featuring a lovable cast of characters that were personally trained, housed and fed by the developers.

“Are you feeling lonely? Are you tired or depressed? Come visit the CLINIC to get rid of your stress!”

Pay a visit to the CLINIC to dissolve your ego and resolve your existential angst - forever. Traverse a 6x6 grid of levels encompassing the entire visible universe and beyond. Described as “fun” by one tester, you just won’t not want to play!

data.name: Unsouled
data.detailed_description:
- Fast-paced, stylish combat
Enemies in Unsouled react to every move you make. Keep your guard up at all times as the slightest mistake will be met with relentless enemy attacks.


- Expert controls and timing
Execute various skill combos and counterattacks for maximum damage. Use the “Abyss” system to get a closer look at the game’s unique mechanics. Players may be tempted to turn down the difficulty settings, but mastering true combat requires practice.


- Chained attacks
Each skill combo in Unsouled have their own unique triggers. Whenever using a skill, your character flashes for a brief second. Use this opportunity to turn your initial strike into a deadly series of blows by performing one skill after another. Learning each skill’s wind-down pattern is crucial to mastering chain attacks.


- Counterattacks
Combos aren’t the only tool under your belt. The counterattack mechanics stay true to the high-risk, high-reward principle, allowing you to decimate multiple targets in one seamless attack when done correctly. Mastering the chain-counterattacks is key to turning the tide on your assailants.


- Interactive objects
Slamming an enemy against a wall, pushing them off the ledge, cutting a tree down to crush them, or even bringing down a large object to create a makeshift bridge are but a few of many ways to overcome various obstacles and threats in the game.


- Passive and Active Souls
You may come across special Souls as you fight and explore. Passive Souls take effect immediately after being obtained, enhancing abilities, unlocking new skills, or upgrading existing ones. Active Souls are manually activated through button interaction which can unlock skills normally reserved for bosses, and are used for combos as well as escaping from enemies.


- Beautiful pixel art
"Travel across five distinct locations each filled with unique retro style visuals with enemies that are spooky and fun.
Each individual pixel is affected by real-time lighting, meaning, you can enjoy the rich, vibrant pixel graphics in all its glory!"

data.name: Ninja Village
data.detailed_description:
Next Kairogames

Coming soon


About the Game

Rewrite the history of feudal Japan with an army of the ultimate guerrilla warriors: ninjas!

The shogun has fallen from power, plunging the land into chaos as feuding feudal lords scramble to take his place. But the shogun has an ace up his sleeve: you! As the head of a leading ninja clan, it's up to you to rally your followers and help unify Japan!

As their fearless leader, you'll need to train your fellow ninjas in the ways of modern 16th-century warfare--including the use of those newfangled matchlock guns! Assign them to infantry, cavalry, and other units to form an army fit for a shogun!

Of course, war is costly in more ways than one. Between battles, your followers will raise funds by producing food, handicrafts, and other goods to sell to passing travellers.

Arm your ninjas with the best gear, training, and skills and lead them to victory in the struggle for unification! You may even meet some of the era's greatest generals along the way...

▼Game Flow
Earn money by having your villagers make goods to sell to visiting travellers. Defeat warlords or use items to acquire new territory and expand your village.

▼Unify Japan
As the game advances, your villagers will be able to join the shogun's forces in battle. Send them to fight regional warlords and help unify Japan under the shogunate.

▼Increasing Villagers
Local lords join your village if you defeat them in battle. Defeating warlords can reveal other potential villagers who will join you if the price is right.

▼Training Villagers
You can spend money to strengthen your villagers through training, raising their levels and making battles easier to win. Some may also learn new skills.

▼Travellers
You can earn money by selling travellers food from your fields or goods from your shops. New visitors may appear whenever you defeat a warlord.

▼Shops and Goods
Workshops produce goods from raw materials transported there, and those goods are then sold in nearby shops. The closer a workshop is to the source of materials, the more efficient its production.

--

data.name: Grim-World:Survival
data.detailed_description:
Grim World is a survival and adventure game in which you can build your home, create your character and shape it to your liking . You can become a warrior, a hunter or even a magician.

The equipment you wear will improve your skill, you may well be halfway between a hunter and a magician or a thief or any combination you wish.

Many creatures as well as many resources are recoverable in order to create your equipment.

You will be able to improve your equipment throughout your journey and at the same time venture into a more dangerous world.

Some hidden place will allow you to sell your equipment and resources in order to earn gold!

This game was created by a single person with the help of Unreal Ungine 5 and who had no basic competence in this area.

The game is therefore in early access and could have modifications throughout your journey.

data.name: HotlaneX
data.detailed_description:
OUTDRIVE. OUTSMART. OUTLAST.

HotlaneX is an arcade driving game where the lanes are your arena, and everything on it wants you gone.

Pick your car and take on chaotic arenas packed with tricky lanes, traps, ramps, and relentless enemies. No weapons, no complicated combat - just your car, your skills, and the arena.

MASTER THE CHASE

Every enemy in HotlaneX moves differently. Some chase you down and never let up. Some try to guess where you're headed before you get there. Some wait for their moment and hit you when you've stopped paying attention.

Learn how they move, and you can turn that against them.

SURVIVE 108 LEVELS

Race through 9 distinct arenas and 108 handcrafted levels, each introducing new combinations of enemies, hazards, and challenges. What begins as a simple chase steadily develops into controlled chaos where positioning, timing, and quick decisions matter.

DRIVE YOUR WAY OUT

Start. Turn. Smoke.

That’s all you need.

Simple controls make HotlaneX easy to pick up, but surviving its later arenas demands precision, awareness and a little audacity. Dodge attacks, bait enemies into mistakes, launch over ramps, and find your way through situations that look increasingly impossible.

BUILD YOUR GARAGE

Unlock new cars as you progress, each giving you another machine to take into the arenas. Push deeper into HotlaneX, complete challenges, collect rewards, and build out your garage.

EVERY ARENA CHANGES THE GAME

Burn through scorched desert lanes, tear across farmland, fight for space in frozen landscapes, and eventually enter a neon-soaked city where the chaos reaches its peak.

New arenas don’t just change the scenery. New enemies, layouts, and hazards force you to rethink how you survive.

THEY HAVE THE NUMBERS. YOU HAVE THE WHEEL.

Welcome to HotlaneX.

New arenas don’t just change the scenery. New enemies, layouts, and hazards force you to rethink how you survive.

THEY HAVE THE NUMBERS. YOU HAVE THE WHEEL.

Welcome to HotlaneX.

data.name: Ash Dawn
data.detailed_description:
Hardcore Bullet-Hell RPG with PvE multiplayer and singleplayer modes. Deep build customization, brutal bosses and rare loot.

Pick from 8 classes 

Choose a class to suit your play style. With various abilities including high damage attacks, healing, buffing/ debuffing, summoning, shape-shifting and much more. Each character has unique talents choices and gearing options letting you customize your experience even more. 

Persistant PvE Multiplayer mode

Join many other players fighting the monsters and demons of Allonia. Slowly level up and carefully gather the best gear you can as death will be the end of your long journey. 

Single Player and small group co-op Content

Go solo or gather a party of up to 3 and face the mysteries of the Serpent Isle's or the hidden Lich's Fortress.

Seamless multilayered world

Everything is connected. There are no loading screens in-game. Whether you are going into buildings, up towers or deep into caves, everything is smooth and seamless. 

Lots of unique items

Gather powerful items from slaying monsters and trading with others.

data.name: Fortfall
data.detailed_description:
Build the fort. Fight for every wall.

FortFall brings third-person fantasy combat to a battlefield you fortify yourself. Build around the Core, prepare for the next assault, and take the fight to the enemies tearing at your defenses.

Shape your defense

Connect walls and gates, establish firing positions, and spend your resources where they matter most. Repair damaged structures, replace a broken section, or specialize your walls to help hold an approach. Your fort stays with you as the run advances.

Choose how you fight

Take the field as one of five classes: Vanguard, Ranger, Mage, Engineer, or Barbarian. Swing into melee, line up bow shots, unleash spells, or support the defense with a shotgun, repairs, and Field Sentries. Each class brings its own abilities, resource and passive to the fight.

Defend together

Play solo or gather up to five players in a private online game. Share a join code, choose your classes, and coordinate combat, repairs, and fortifications around one Core.

Adapt between assaults

Earn talent choices during the run and strengthen your defenses for the next wave. Face enemies with different combat roles, protect the Core as the pressure rises, and work toward a confrontation with the Siege Warden.

Hold the Core

Every breach changes the fight. Stay close enough to protect what you built, move where the next threat appears, and keep the Core standing.

data.name: Zanerdin: The Unbound
data.detailed_description:
Zanerdin: The Unbound is a strategy-driven, hero-collecting turn-based RPG where every choice—from your heroes’ action order and party composition to your card and equipment loadouts—is yours to make. Journey across Kalatos, a planet imbued with the power of the six Blessings, meet Zanerdin and a colorful cast of heroes, and uncover the vast conspiracy hidden beneath the surface of the world. Take the party and strategies you perfect in single-player into real-time PvP and co-op raids.

The Unblessed, Defying Fate

  • Kalatos is a planet where the power of the six Blessings shapes the order of the world. Yet, paradoxically, at its heart lies the Chaos Region, a place entirely devoid of the power of Blessings. Take the first step on an epic journey alongside Zanerdin, who was born in the Chaos Region.

  • Meet characters with different beliefs and pasts, and confront the conflicts surrounding the six Blessings and the truth hidden within Kalatos.

Heroes You Meet Along the Way

  • Follow the main story, meet distinctive heroes with diverse backgrounds and abilities, and recruit them as allies.

  • Make use of each hero’s unique skills and role, develop their abilities, and complete a party of your own.

Strategic Turn-Based Combat—Right Down to the Action Order

  • Decide the order in which your heroes act, analyze the unique mechanics that change from battle to battle, and overcome every challenge.

  • Build your party around attributes, classes, themes, and nations, then use combat themes such as Joint Attacks and Counters to discover the optimal synergy.

Turn the Tide with Cards

  • Collect cards imbued with the power of Blessings and use them at the right moment to support your heroes.

  • Combine cards to summon powerful Synergy Cards and turn the tide of an unfavorable battle in an instant.

Gear Builds Forged with the Power of Guardian Deities

  • Collect Guardian Essence through gameplay, summon a variety of equipment, and unlock your heroes’ potential.

  • Enhance and customize equipment to adjust your heroes’ abilities and expand your tactical options.

  • All currency required for equipment summoning can be earned entirely through gameplay. There are no paid equipment summons.

Real-Time Friendly PvP

  • Invite another player and enjoy real-time turn-based combat.

  • Anticipate your opponent’s party composition, action order, and skill choices, then adapt at every moment to claim victory.

  • Prove your strategy using the heroes you have developed and the equipment you have enhanced in single-player.

Conquer Co-op Raids with Allies

  • Join forces with other players in real time and challenge powerful raid bosses.

  • Divide roles among your allies, respond to the boss’s attack patterns, and execute cooperative tactics that would be impossible alone.

  • Defeat raid bosses and earn a variety of cosmetic items.

data.name: Bunnyrama
data.detailed_description:
Bunnyrama is an unique and challenging puzzle adventure game where your goal is to lead the old man through the magical forest full of huge bunnies. Each level is a labyrinth with different puzzles, and only one exit. Bunnies will help you, carry and stack them properly, use their unique features to build your way to the portal, and help the old man find his way home.



Puzzle mechanics is easy to get, but complexity growing as more elements added in each level. There are different types of bunnies, platforms, portals, elevators, buttons, doors and etc. After the first episode it will be a real challenge for your brain!

THE STORY


Ok... Anyone curious about the Bunnyrama story? Strange… but who we are to judge you? So please, make yourselves comfortable, and I will begin...



A long time ago and far far away (well... maybe not so long and not so far, but humor me, it sounds much more dramatic this way). In his small wooden house, lived an old man. His name is not important because even he didn't remember it.

His house was deep in the forest, and he loved nature and animals. Sadly when he tried to sing to them, those ungrateful creatures scattered in all directions and attempted to gnaw off their own ears (he was not a beautiful princess with the voice of a songbird). But the old man was a very amiable person, so he didn’t care and tried to help every little creature in the forest. Especially he loved hares and rabbits, because they are so cute (aren’t they?..).

One very rainy day, a flood came to the forest. All the poor little creatures were trapped on a small island. Even though he was drunk, (well what would you do if you’d lived alone in the forest?) our old man jumped onto his raft...

No one knows what happened next. Did he really see the white rabbit? or it was a result of his new recipe?… But here the true story begins…

data.detailed_description:
Robbie 2 is an expansive open-world fantasy RPG with satisfying combat, strategic elements, and epic boss battles. Traverse vibrant forests, ancient dungeons, snowy mountains, and forgotten ruins. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden lore, forge powerful gear, and experience captivating quests.

Solve intricate puzzles, conquer epic bosses, and unravel ancient mysteries to gain powerful rewards. data.name: Surf Club
data.detailed_description:
Relive the past and discover the present.


6 years after Holly moved away from Olive Bay, she is contacted by her former best friend and romantic partner Bede, who wishes to reconnect with her. The two once imagined a life together, but parted on painful terms.

Despite her apprehension, the allure of the past and her affection for Bede compels her to return to her home town, where she hopes they can finally live out their dreams together.

Gameplay Features:

  • Short, intimate story; Inspired by real life experiences and locations (average playtime: 3 hours)
  • Narrative-driven gameplay: explore Olive Bay in the past and the present as the timelines blur together
  • Fully interactive environment: plenty of characters to meet, locations around town to visit and secret collectables to discover.
  • Immersive maritime soundtrack: lead by Eli Rainsberry (No Longer Home, Wilmot’s Warehouse, A Monster’s Expedition)
  • And yes, surfing!

data.name: Contract Cooks
data.detailed_description:
You're a contractor in the food industry. The agency cares about one thing: whether you can hold down a midnight shift at a diner or a heatwave at a coffee shop where everyone suddenly wants ice. You pick the jobs off the board. Sometimes you walk into a clean kitchen. Sometimes the last cook ran out the back door an hour ago.

Each contract gives you a location, a stint of three to seven days and a set of conditions that fit the place. Office cafes get rush hour. Fine dining gets critics. Airlines get... whatever's wrong with airlines. You start with one dish on the menu and it's usually something simple. Then it gets worse.

Cooking is grounded but quick. A coffee is grind, pull, froth, pour. Bread is mix, shape, prove, bake. Every step is something a cook would recognise, none of them take longer than they need to.

You've got two hands, your co-op partner has two more. Hand things off, top each other up or just work on the same dish together. At least when the milk frother gets left on, there's someone else to blame.

At the start of each day you pick a modifier. Some make your life harder (blackouts, impatient customers, a new dish on the menu you've never made before). Some make it easier (auto stock subscriptions so you're not reordering ingredients every morning, loans for better equipment at the cost of your revenue). Want a chill shift? Stack the easy ones. Want a massive payout? Work for it. 

Stock doesn’t refill itself. Order resupplies, collect deliveries from a very reliable delivery company, organise things on shelves or let the boxes pile up. We're not going to tell you how to run it. Rearrange the space, upgrade stations, put in an open fridge if you're tired of opening the fridge. Just don't mind the electricity bill.

Every contract pays. The harder you make it, the more you get. The money builds your resume and unlocks new dishes, cuisines, locations and special contracts. The unlocks carry over. The kitchens don't.

Take a casual contract for chill cooking - no timers, forgiving on mistakes. Take a heroic contract for the chaos - patience timers, real consequences, a payout that reflects it.

data.name: Don't punch me
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the adrenaline-pumping world of "Don't Punch Me," the ultimate test of reflexes and restraint! Brace yourself for an exhilarating experience where precision and self-control are your greatest assets.

In this captivating mobile and computer game, your objective is to navigate a relentless onslaught of adversaries without resorting to violence. Prepare to confront a multitude of enemies as they approach, determined to provoke you. Resist the urge to retaliate physically and instead, showcase your lightning-fast reflexes.

At every level, you'll face a countdown, heightening the anticipation. When the timer hits zero, a random doorway materializes before you, serving as your gateway to progress.

Each door you encounter unlocks a new challenge, presenting a fresh set of obstacles to overcome. Move swiftly to the door's location, as time is of the essence. Successively conquering these stages will test your dexterity and earn your passage to new levels.

Navigate this captivating journey by evading enemy attacks, employing evasive maneuvers, and showcasing nimble footwork. Master the art of dodging and weaving, gracefully sidestepping the blows aimed in your direction.

But remember, the true victory lies in your ability to exercise restraint. Refrain from punching, retaliating, or giving in to the temptation of violence. Embrace the game's essence as a testament to your self-control and composure under pressure.

Prepare yourself for an array of dynamic environments and challenges, each meticulously designed to put your skills to the ultimate test. Adapt to various scenarios, hone your strategy, and outsmart your foes with swift precision.

Get ready to immerse yourself in the gripping world of "Don't Punch Me," where finesse and self-restraint reign supreme. Are you up to the challenge? Step into the fray now and prove that you possess the grace and control to overcome any obstacle!

data.name: Zeta Wolf Chronicles
data.detailed_description:
Zeta Wolf Chronicles is a dating sim with a hyperrealistic focus, that hones in and examines the struggles of adolescent dating. Experience the journey of Rayen as he navigates his senior year in high school. Learn about the nuances of love and its many intricacies along the way.

Dispirited by his lack of progress, Rayen initially seeks out extravagant means to reach his end. One day, he is approached by a mysterious visitor, who quickly alters his fate. Suddenly, he must choose to befriend one of four girls in his rehabilitation process! Meanwhile, he continues his agenda to pursue Siona, his fateful crush. In this tale inspired by real-life events, Rayen is forced to change his life, and commit time and energy toward what his heart desires the most. Will desperation win out, or will knowledge, patience, and logic pave the way to success?

4 Romancable Girls with a Fifth Wheel

Gameplay Features

  • Visible Male Protagonist & 4 girls to befriend, intertwined with the MC's original crush!

  • Point-and-Click "Insight and Reflection" system where you get a glimpse of certain characters' thoughts during gameplay.

  • Converse Time scenarios where you can chat with your peers at your leisure and learn more about them.

  • Expansive cast with their own unique personalities.

  • Extensive Glossary system of over 300 lore-related definitions to be unlocked.

  • Vibrant Sprites and CG art with subtle animations.

  • Partial English Voice Acting! 3 Routes are fully voiced (Alphi, Maikah, and Ravia).

data.name: PNG BATTLE
data.detailed_description:
One day, someone had a thought.

"What if a Tyrannosaurus Rex fought a sentient dump truck — who would win?"

"Could a cosmic being and an elephant shrew actually go toe-to-toe?"

Every wild, magnificent idea you've ever had — we make it real.

"PNG BATTLE"

🛠️ Customized to Your Core! The Beyond-Imagination Meme Machine

  • More than just a game — it's the ultimate meme machine in the universe!

    • Effortlessly bring those bizarre, hilarious match-ups you've only ever imagined straight into the game.

  • Simple controls, infinite outcomes

    • No complicated tools needed! With just a few clicks, customize your own sounds, outrageous attack effects, and unique skins on top of your base hero.

  • Everything in the world can be your fighter

    • Extinct dinosaurs, your favorite anime characters, random objects lying around the house, cosmic entities — whatever you set your sights on becomes a powerful champion on the battlefield.

  • Create your own 'infuriating' ultimate character and send them into battle right now!

💥 From 1v1 Showdowns to All-Out Brawls — An Unpredictable Battlefield!

  • Breathtaking 1v1 head-to-head battles

    • Who wins between a T-Rex and a dump truck?! Enjoy intense, straight-up matches decided purely by precise mechanics and careful matchup calculations.

  • Chaotic and thrilling free-for-all Battle Royale

    • All kinds of imaginary beings collide as you fight to be the last one standing in a relentless all-out brawl.

  • Unpredictable situations and hilariously wild gimmicks that can trigger anytime, anywhere!

    • Can you prove your imagination right by becoming the last champion standing on this unpredictable battlefield?

data.name: Garden Simulator
data.detailed_description:
The love of gardening is a seed once sown that never dies.



Fresh vegetables, healthy fruits and beautiful flowers - now you have the chance to take care of your own allotment and harvest the crops. Boredom at home is a thing of the past - today you’ll enjoy nature. Cultivate your own virtual garden, take care of the plants, then harvest and sell them.

With Garden Simulator you’ll get your own patch of land, place decorational elements, and nurture the plants, before you harvest them. The richer your yield, the more you can sell and the more money you can spend to enhance your piece of paradise. With countless unlockable features and additional content, your green thumb will be challenged to the max!

Lawnmower, watering can and seedlings are waiting for you - get ready for a beautiful and relaxing time in nature. And don’t forget: Gardens are not made by singing ‘Oh, how beautiful,’ and sitting in the shade.



  • PLANT a wide variety of fruits and vegetables and decorate your garden with a colorful array of flowers.
  • CARE for your plants, OBSERVE the growth stages and HARVEST the fruits. Whether it's strawberries, lettuce or different types of flowers - the variety of plants makes your garden unique.
  • DESIGN your garden as you please! Place your flowers and vegetable beds and frame them with different fence elements. Hedges, furniture and many different items in numerous designs will turn your piece of land into a unique vacation spot.
  • KEEP your garden CLEAN! Not only at the beginning will you find trash in your garden that needs to be removed, but also during the game your efforts to keep it clean will be rewarded! Mow your lawn and turn your property into a gardener’s dream.
  • EARN money and spend it! The more fruits and flowers you sell, the more money you have available to invest in better tools, new plant varieties and more.
  • HAVE FUN and experiment with realistic physics! Throw the design items around, place them as you like, build towers of fences or hedges, and do lots of crazy things you probably wouldn't do in a "real" garden. There are almost no limits to your imagination.

data.name: wasteland of east
data.detailed_description:
In 2077, the war between the two superpowers ultimately triggered a global nuclear war blow, and the nuclear bombs falling from the sky plunged the world into a dark silence. Many years later, in the university town area of northern Huaxia, an underground shelter was opened, and you were ordered to repair the information cable damaged by the nuclear bomb. The first time I stepped on the wasteland of Huaxia, this scorched land was filled with unknown dangers.

In "Waste Land Huaxia", there are abundant firearms and local "garbage" for you to collect. Not only can you wield knives and slash at enemies on the battlefield, pour your ammunition, but you can also disassemble and synthesize new props to become a bloodthirsty collector.

The game provides players with four career plans, allowing you to go further and further on the evil path of self indulgence or striving for strength. These include: brainless and bloodthirsty commandos, eloquent salespeople, sneaky spies, and scientists with strong hands-on abilities (there is also a hidden profession that you slowly discover without fear of challenges... Tip: Learn? It’s bullshit！).

Additionally, in your adventurous career, you may encounter characters that make you feel a bit excited.

Disadvantage: Due to limitations in software development, it is not possible to replace the magazine during battles, and you are never required to replace the magazine during battles. In addition, the game is really Pixel art style, because RPGmakerVA has no choice, and the number of animation frames is small. Due to being developed by one person in their spare time, it is inevitable that there will be a lot of unsatisfactory BUUUUGs. Please understand in advance and notify me of any modifications in a timely manner.

Furthermore, why do the people in 'Waste Land Huaxia' dress in the style of the 1980s? The history of this world is slightly different from our existing world.

game operation tips: keyboard arrow keys to control character movement, dialogue and search use the space bar, the call menu is the ESC key, and the quick access to all items is Shift + space bar.

data.name: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
data.detailed_description:
STAY INFORMED

Ready to be part of the K-pop Idol Stories journey? 🚀

Join our vibrant community on Discord or Twitter for exclusive updates, behind-the-scenes peeks, and connect with fellow gamers or K-pop fans! 🌟Your backstage pass awaits!🌟


About the Game

Rise to the top of the K-pop charts, become the next sensation, and earn the love of fans. Lead your group to stand out and conquer the hyper-competitive music scene. In this one-of-a-kind idol life simulator, step into the shoes of a powerful manager and shape your girl group’s destiny on their journey to the Hall of Fame.

Step into the spotlight behind the scenes! Build your dream idol group as you scout rising stars, shape their weekly schedules, and guide their journey to fame. Mix work, training, and downtime to help your idols shine their brightest, while you enjoy the thrill of creating a superstar career you can’t experience in real life.

Your decisions extend far beyond management. The relationships you build and the choices you make will define your group’s future. Whether you’re offering unconditional support, navigating rivalries, or representing your group in the public eye, every action has consequences. Randomized events mirror the unpredictable challenges of the real K-pop industry, testing your judgment at every turn.

Your ultimate goal? Debut. Along the way, your trainees will face off against rivals in thrilling, RPG-style battles that will prove whether they have what it takes to shine. Once your group is ready, you’ll choose their signature look, define their fan club identity, and produce a debut album that captures their essence.

The road to debut isn’t an easy path, but it’s where every dream begins, and every step you take becomes a story worth remembering.

Your Dream K-Pop Group

Choose from eight unique trainees, from the cheerful Minji to the shy Ai, the lineup and skillset of your group is in your hands, and it's your job to shape them as stars.

Plan Their Schedule

As the manager, it's your job to balance stamina, finances, and workload. Push your idols too hard and risk burnout, but pamper them too much and you'll quickly run out of funds!

Relationships Matter

The bonds you build shape every outcome. Your decisions influence how each character perceives you, unlocking new encounters, storylines and endings.

Original K-pop Soundtrack

Featuring exclusive music and special vocal tracks for your group's debut, produced just for this game. K-pop fans will be clamouring for the tracklist.

Minigames

Scout new idols, hit the right notes during vocal practice, and master dance routines in rhythm challenges. Your performance in these mini-games determines your success as an idol manager.

Visual Adventure

Stunning hand-drawn artwork brings a rich world to life. Beautifully animated emotions and gestures make your idols feel truly alive, letting you connect with them like never before.

data.name: Wait, is THAT me?
data.detailed_description:
You are being recorded. Each step you take, each weapon trigger you press, each melee swing and each word you say are being monitored. Be wary of your actions, as each of these recordings will be redone by exact replicas of you, soon.

As enemies start swarming you, your task is to keep them at bay. Enemies drop experience which can level up your character, granting a random upgrade out of the many existing ones.

Upgrades will be inherited by your clones. Become too strong and you might struggle to dodge your clones. Stay too weak and the swarm of enemies might become too much to handle.

Don't do it alone. The game features both coop and versus modes. Imagine the fun of watching and hearing your and your friend's clones having the argument about stealing that one chest.

Features

  • Multiplayer with proximity voice chat + clones that mimic your voice = dumb fun

  • 3 Unique environments with various secrets, enemies and loot to discover

  • Tens of weapons to choose from to withstand your foes

  • 100+ Upgrades that will likely affect you and your clones in interesting ways

  • An underlying narrative that will catch you off guard

  • Many enemy types whose sole purpose is to put you in fun and difficult scenarios

And yes, that is you.
