data.name: Avalon: The Journey Begins
data.detailed_description:
Depart your homeworld of Avalon to embark on the longest journey ever attempted by mankind to find the end of the universe. What is at the end of the universe and where is the end of the universe? This is where your journey begins. Collect electronic data chips that are scattered about throughout universe to get the location of the end of universe. Journey through space and explore unlimited sectors, stations, and planet surfaces in this sci-fi adventure game. Take command of a large starship, it's shuttles, rovers and even crew! Interact with many ships from large capital ships to small fighter groups, some will help you, others will attack. Dock at stations to talk to other travelers and personnel, visit shipyards, or shops such as manufacturers, science labs, bars, casinos, academies and more. Fly shuttles down into planet atmosphere, land and use rovers to explore planet surfaces and even exit rover to explore on foot! On planets there are many things to find and discover such as resources, artifacts, lifeforms, alien creatures, ruins, facilities, and more. Features a full random creation system where no two games are ever the same!





• Randomly generated space sectors, stations and planets for unlimited exploration!


• Numerous space ship types including everything from massive capital ships to small fighter groups.


• Interact with ships such as a prison cruiser, which will allow you to hire prisoners to train as crew, price is cheap but watch out they can cause troubles on board such as theft, murder, hijack, etc.


• Visit shipyard to purchase new modules for your ship such as a science lab and/or upgrade various components such as laser turrets or cargo storage.
• Visit space industries such as a materials plant to buy and sell materials used to construct planetary facilities.
• Dock and visit space facilities such as a service dock or trade post. To purchase much needed necessaties or buy and sell items or resources for maximum profits.


• Actually see your ship image change with added ship modules and upgrades.


• Dock and board space stations to do things such as meet people and aliens, buy or sell items, repair and maintain ship, visit science labs or other shops, and even gamble at a casino to win or lose big!


• Multiple planet types such as ice, desert, tropical, volcanic, prehistoric, arid, or alien all with randomly generated surfaces so no two planets are ever the same!


• Land on planets and explore their surface with shuttles, rovers and even on foot as crew to find items and resources, search ruins, facilities, battle alien creatures and much, much more!
• Build structures on planets such as refineries, starports, agricultural domes and several other types of facilities for steady income or production.


• Interact with multiple ship captain characters from several different races and factions from humans to aliens and robots.


• Destroy asteroids to collect valuable resources.


• Hire and train various personnel for different positions on board your ship. Manage roster such as personnel, crew, pilots, explorers, engineers, leaders and high officers.


• Multiple ways to win including several minor goals as well as the main goal.


Note: This game has been designed with expandability in mind. As a result there are extra empty place holders in certain areas throughout the game such as in shops.

◆Story


I, Li Zhiyuan, was an ordinary university student.
Although I was just living an ordinary life, I was quite content with a stable daily routine.

The mysterious man who suddenly appeared claimed to be an icubus and seemed to have a strange obsession with me.
Could I really believe what he said? And why was he so insistent?
What was even stranger was that this strange man had always seemed familiar to me for no apparent reason…

data.name: DEEP STATES STORY
data.detailed_description:
In 3025, the Blonde president was delivering the State of the Union address. A teenager came in, overturned the table, and fought with the president. The conspiracy behind the president gradually emerged when they were wrestling with each other.

1. In the first-person combat method players will face their hands directly during the game and experience the feeling of fisting to the flesh.


2.Scar System Each time you concentrate, you will accumulate scars on the opponent's hit. There will be no blood tank design in the game. Whether to defeat the opponent is completely judged by the scars caused.


3. Smooth game and unexpected ending The game fights from the beginning. After smoothly passing five levels, you will usher in an unexpected ending.

The conditions for each level of the game are different, and the difficulty will gradually increase.The opponent's actions will increase accordingly. The fighting will leave the body covered with scratches.
Most of the design is completed by hand-drawn. The game engine is unity, which guarantees the fluency and violency. This is the first game of our team, thank you for your support.

data.name: Damage Xiangqi
data.detailed_description:
A xiangqi where you don't capture — you grind them down.
Damage Xiangqi rebuilds Chinese chess around HP, Attack and Defense. Pieces no longer fall in one hit. You chip away their HP, and only defeat them when it reaches zero. Damage is randomized, and an attacked piece may strike back. Every point on the board becomes a gamble.

Three actions a turn — dense, deliberate play.
Instead of one move, you take three actions per turn (Red's very first turn: one). Advance, corner them, and strike. There is no checkmate — check is only a warning. The first player to burn the enemy General's HP to zero wins.

The Cannon's bombardment, weaponized.
The Cannon moves like a Chariot but attacks only over exactly one screen piece — and when it lands the killing blow, it leaps onto the target's point. Because of its attack pattern it is almost never countered. Line up your screens and shell the palace.

Xiangqi traditions, kept intact.
Horse legs and Elephant eyes can be blocked, Elephants stay on their side, Advisors and Generals guard the palace, and Soldiers gain sideways movement after crossing the river. The face-off (flying General) ban is in by default — and it becomes a positional weapon.

Tune the luck yourself.
Damage variance, counter success rate, actions per turn, rule toggles — the rules are yours. You can even edit each piece's HP, Attack and Defense individually.

A CPU with real bite — and friends around the world.
Four CPU tiers: Weak / Normal / Strong / Expert. Play friends online via deterministic lockstep sync (friend invite / room code, with reconnection).

Features
- 🎯 A fresh xiangqi battle driven by HP / Attack / Defense (defeat a piece to advance onto its point)
- 💥 Cannon screen-bombardment with leap-on-kill — the signature move of the game
- 🌊 River crossing, Horse legs, Elephant eyes, palace and face-off ban fully implemented
- 🎲 Randomized damage and counterattacks create constant tension (adjustable variance & rate)
- ⚡ Three actions per turn for deep tactical sequencing
- 🤖 Four CPU tiers
- 🌐 Online play (friend invite / room code, with reconnection)
- 🛠 Fully customizable rules and piece stats
- 🌏 Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and English

Manage your own sushi restaurant and enjoy a calm kitchen experience. Take orders, prepare fresh sushi, source ingredients, and serve your customers. The gameplay is designed to be simple, clear, and smooth.

Gain popularity in the city and welcome more customers to your restaurant. Prepare custom menus for each customer and deliver them on time.

Within the daily work routine, you can make your restaurant more efficient and enjoy the satisfaction of organized work. Over time, you can improve your workflow and create a smoother service experience.

data.detailed_description:
Street Karate 3 immerses players into an adrenaline-pumping beat 'em up experience where they assume the role of a fearless and adept fighter. Confronted with daunting odds, players engage in intense duels against waves of formidable adversaries.

Game Features
  • Dynamic Beat 'em Up Action: Engage in exhilarating battles against multiple opponents, showcasing your martial prowess and adapting strategies to overcome challenging odds.
  • Immersive Weapon Utilization: Harness a variety of improvised weapons like rebars and knives strategically placed throughout levels, transforming everyday objects into potent tools of combat.
  • Ultimatum Strike System: Unleash a game-changing ultimatum strike to disperse adversaries in dire situations, but exercise caution as its use comes with tactical trade-offs.
  • Strategic Resource Management: Carefully manage healing techniques to maintain your fighter's endurance, ensuring survival through intense encounters and enabling progress.
  • Diverse Combat Techniques: Execute throws, jump kicks, and grabs to craft a personalized fighting style, enhancing your abilities and forming essential tactics for victory.

data.name: Terra Tanks: Defenders of the Earth
data.detailed_description:
The invasion is never ending. The Terra Tanks' only hope is to destroy the mothership.
Can you muster the strength to save humanity in our darkest hour?

Features


Your Score Is Your Health
Your Terra Tank gains energy from blasting away alien scum. Terra Tanks lose more energy from each hit as they reach higher power levels, and running out of power will mean the doom of the human race.

Your Score Unlocks Upgrades and Abilities
Every 100 points will unlock your Terra Tank's next unique ability or upgrade for that round. Fight your way through hordes of aliens with lasers, rockets, grenades, explosive shell jumps, bullet time and so much more.

Five Unlockable Tanks
Each tank has a unique gun, upgrades and abilities custom tailored for their play styles. Carve through the invaders with Machine-Gun or bombard enemies from above with Orbital. Unlock each tank by successfully repelling alien invasions with a higher score.

Difficulties For Everyone
Terra Tanks has all the charm of an 80's arcade box without any of the hassle. Normal offers a more casual experience while Insane will give experienced players a true challenge. Higher difficulties grant score modifiers and more aliens to destroy.

Radical 80's Inspired Soundtrack
Terra Tank's soundtrack features a unique blend of 80's synth, hip-hop and spooky alien atmosphere for your xeno-blasting adventures.

Credits


Soundtrack & Audio Design: Kimo The Beatmaker.
Enemy & Level Illustration: Fernando Angelo.

data.name: ONE DAY for Ched
data.detailed_description:
Wishlist Shop Crush on Steam

Hey friends!

If you survived ONE DAY for Ched (or at least laughed at it),

Why not wishlist our new game — Shop Crush?

It’s very different: narrative, weird, full of illusions.

Your wishlist helps us finish it, and you’ll probably get a game you actually enjoy :)


About the Game

DIVE INTO THE WORLD OF OLD SCHOOL Ched SHOOTERS

Fight the monsters, shoot 'em up with your skills and powerful guns. Complete the whole story and find out the secrets of Ched's mind. ONE DAY for Ched makes you feel like you're back in the glory days of gaming, and brings you the ultimate in hardcore gameplay, interesting story, and quest elements.

Use your gaming skills to complete the levels and kill all enemies. Victory can be yours, but you will have to fight hard. ONE DAY, Ched will never forgive your mistakes!

ULTIMATE HARDCORE GAMEPLAY

Player skills mean everything in the world of ONE DAY for Ched. No saves, no health recovering, no margin for error!

COMIC / CARTOON ART STYLE

In-game graphics are cell-shaded with cartoon-ish render. The story features hand-drawn comics that reveal Ched's story.

EASY TO ENGAGE, HARDCORE TO STAY ENGAGED

ONE DAY for Ched runs on a weak PC, has its own charming humor, catchy phrases, low price, and trade cards.

data.name: Split Spirit
data.detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in a vibrant world overflowing with color and charm as you traverse mountainous woodlands to rejoin with your other half. Seek the aid of the forest as flowers and deer pick you up and carry you along on your journey.



  • Beautiful natural environments
As you traverse the world, you’ll experience the likes of windy savannas, waterfall caves, primordial jungles, and more! Every environment comes with its own hand-crafted artwork, each as breathtaking as the last.

  • Relaxing, easy-to-pick-up gameplay

Trot, jump, and throw as you make your way through the forest. Whether you’re looking for a more casual experience or are new to games, Split Spirit offers gameplay where you can enjoy the world without having to worry about losing or complicated controls.

  • Simple physics-based throwing mechanics
Toss yourself from the deer and flowers that aid your journey. Aiming is assisted with a visible throw arc to help you make trickier shots and there is no penalty for missing - the flower or deer you last threw from will happily pick you back up again so you can try again!



This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

data.name: Chronon
data.detailed_description:
Chronon is a first-person puzzle game.
The abundance of puzzles based on logic and laws of physics awaits you. Submerge yourself in a magical Chronon’s atmosphere full of music, pleasant graphics, and various puzzles. The main point of the game is solving brain teasers and gathering items you need to unlock the doors, obstructing your way.

This game is full of riddles and they may be solved by using your logic and interacting with surroundings.
After your success, you get an item – a key from the next level. To solve some of the puzzles you may have to move, push or spin objects around you, interact with surroundings, build through your path or activate hidden puzzles. Some of them may require just pure logic, solve the riddle, gather the item and you are done.

Each puzzle is unique in its own way, some of them have different solutions so it is up to you to decide how you want to do them. The ambiance plays softly in the background and increases your problem-solving skills.

Explore every season of the year and get lost in their unforgettable atmosphere.
Can you make it to the end?

data.name: Backyard Birdwatching
data.detailed_description:
Designed by an Ohio Certified Volunteer Naturalist and bird enthusiasts, Backyard Birdwatching is your virtual window to a relaxing afternoon feeding birds in a Midwestern backyard.

It's a simple, colorful idle game with light management elements that teaches you about birds native to the region and how to attract them to your yard.

  • Build your own birdwatching haven. Collect and spend resources to set up poles and fill your bird feeders to attract birds to your virtual backyard.

  • Observe a variety of bird species through your binoculars to unlock new feeders, seeds, and field guide entries with real facts about the birds.

  • Relax and watch the birds outside your window as they enjoy your little backyard bird retreat.

data.name: Racecar Bed
data.detailed_description:
A Social Sim + Turn-Based RPG with a 3rd grade protagonist! 📆PLAN your days, 🧑‍🤝‍🧑BEFRIEND characters, 🧱COLLECT+CRAFT unique attacks, and ⚔️FIGHT in Turn-based combat with Action Commands!

Face Your Nightmares!


- Weird recurring nightmares are showing up all over!
- Solve the mystery of who or what is causing chaos!
- Each nightmare has different enemies representing the dreamer's darkest fears.
- Defeat them in Turn-Based Combat with Action Commands!
- Time your attacks well enough, and deal bonus damage!

Collect Toys, Create Skills!


Take your toys to use as weapons in the dream world!
- Find, earn, and trade different toys to get stronger!
- Craft your own Plastik Sword with unique skills to use in battle.
- Do you want an attack that's cheap and reliable? Or how about that will end quickly end a battle? It's your choice!

Hang out with friends!


Overcome your shyness and make friends with your classmates, parents, or unlikely strangers!
- Play in all kinds of different places and in different ways!
- Each of your friends give you different rewards
- Create different combat builds based on their rewards!

Play your days carefully!


- You only have a limited number of days to meet your deadlines.
- While hanging out with friends will help, there are imminent threats to face that won't wait for you.

data.name: Witherbloom
data.detailed_description:
Venture into a surreal, post-apocalyptic fantasy while experiencing Witherbloom's unique combination of Survival-RPG and Dungeon Crawling. The world has been shattered, and its up to you to rebuild something meaningful... if you can survive.

Explore otherworldly labyrinthine dungeons

Enter the twisted realms of Ingenuity, Harmony, and Passion – the abandoned domains of absent gods. Gather loot, resources, survivors, and answers. But weigh your choices and decide when to retreat with your spoils. If you delve too deep for too long... death and worse will find you.

Endure a challenging mix of combat and survival

Plunder what you can while using your unique combat abilities to overcome the twisted aberrations that haunt these mysterious places; delve deeper using your survival abilities to succeed against the elements, hunger, injury, exhaustion, and the mysterious Withering. In Witherbloom, survival is not a marathon - each dungeon run is a survival-challenge, requiring careful planning and skill to overcome.

Forge a fresh start

Build a dynamic Hub with the NPCs and rewards you gather. Forge relationships and make hard choices about whom and what you will invest in. Improve your Hub, equipment, what you can craft, and what the characters in your Hub can do - all while you level up your own abilities across each run.

Choose your path with a new take on dual-classing

Combine a robust combat class with a dynamic survival class. There are 16 distinct dual-class combinations - including the Overseer, Ritualist, Guerrilla, and Predator – each with their own unique skill trees and utilities!


Rebuild a community - alone or with friends

Brave the dangers of Witherbloom alone, or experience its unique take on multiplayer-survival with up to four friends. Coordinate your survival and combat skills to overcome the dangers of the world as you forge your community.

Uncover meaning in a strange world shrouded in mystery

Witherbloom offers a beautiful and vibrant world unlike anything you have seen before. Its hand-crafted-levels, creatures, and items are inspired by frightening – and hopeful – psychological phenomenon. The deeper you delve, the more rewards, challenges, and mysteries you will uncover.

What awaits you within the deepest recesses of these forsaken places? Why did the gods abandon creation? What kind of society can you build when the entire world has lost meaning? Luxurious questions, if you survive to ask them.

data.name: Chronoform
data.detailed_description:
Chronoform is a sci-fi puzzle-platformer about movement, timing, and using your own past actions as tools.

Navigate dangerous industrial sectors filled with lasers, doors, pressure plates, switches, moving platforms, and environmental hazards. Each run leaves behind a ghost echo that repeats your previous actions, letting you cooperate with your past self to solve puzzles that one body alone cannot complete.

Master dashes, air movement, mantle boosts, object pushing, and route planning as each sector asks you to think in layers: what you do now, what your echo will do later, and how both timelines interact.

Key Features

  • Ghost Echo Puzzle Solving
    Loop your past runs as ghost echoes that help press switches, hold plates, and move boxes.

  • Precision Movement
    Dash, air dash, jump with variable height, mantle boost, and push objects through timing-focused platforming challenges.

  • Interactive Sector Machinery

data.name: Termination Live
data.detailed_description:
In this future world, corporations control everything.

You are just another ordinary employee.

Every day, you walk through massive corporate towers, follow the rules, complete assignments, and wait for your next performance review. But when you discover that you have become another “pending case” in the company’s system, you decide to carry out a termination ahead of schedule.

Target: Corporate executives.
Method: Unlimited.

Termination Live is a cyberpunk pixel-art stealth assassination game. Explore heavily guarded corporate facilities and use the environment, disguises, cybernetic enhancements, and various tools to complete your missions.

You can choose direct action or carefully observe patrol routes, create accidents, and manipulate facilities to achieve your goals. Every assassination is a plan, and every choice shapes your approach.

Key Features:

  • Cyberpunk pixel-art visuals exploring futuristic corporate spaces in a neon city

  • Multiple infiltration routes and creative ways to eliminate your targets

  • Cybernetic enhancements that push beyond human limitations

  • Observe, plan, and execute your own assassination strategies

  • A dark futuristic story about capitalism, identity, and personal rebellion

Here, the company evaluates your worth.

Now, it’s your turn to evaluate the company.

data.name: INK MAZE
data.detailed_description:
INK MAZE is a short, turn-based metroidvania with a strong focus on unique puzzles about exploring and charting treasure maps.

CHART YOUR PATH

  • Design your own mapping language consisting of cryptic symbols so you can safely explore the fog.

  • Use your creativity to solve unique communication problems with your future self. It might be a while before you explore that room you've just charted.

  • Observe the maze in a non-linear fashion. You might chart a room that gives you a sneak peek at areas and loot you've yet to discover.

EXPLORE AND IMPROVE

  • Decipher your mapping language as you explore rooms filled with traps, puzzles, loot, and secrets.

  • Use hidden knowledge to outsmart the dungeon and bypass its locks.

  • Find power-ups that recontextualize the way you play.

MEET QUIRKY ADVENTURERS

  • Connect with a small but unique cast of characters also looking to put an end to the mist.

  • Complete charming quests that breathe life into the world of INK MAZE.

  • Experience how each character uses the charting mechanic in their own silly way.

WHAT IS IT NOT?

  • There is no combat. This game is about outsmarting danger instead of facing it head-on using weapons.

  • It's not a long game. This game is a short but dense, puzzle-focused metroidvania about the unique prospect of map-making.

WHO IS THAT?

  • That is Oolix. Say hi, Oolix!

data.name: The Exile Princes
data.detailed_description:
The Exile Princes is a story focused, procedural RPG designed for short playthroughs in which you as a knight gather companions and fighters to bring your house to victory throughout the unique fantasy setting of the Exile Realms. Starting out in service to the current lords of the land, you can gain power and influence and ultimately through strength or guile ensure your faction's place at the helm of every city in the realms.

The game's design is old-school, with a text readout core to the interface and simple tile-based maps, decision screens, and battle stat interfaces available. The interface graphics are lovingly produced based on actual medieval artwork, and show a lively medieval world for you to discover.

Features

  • Explore: procedurally generated worlds and cities offer a varied experience with every playthrough. Forest altars, dungeons, fortified manors, ruined chapels, bandit camps, stone circles and more may be encountered on your travels.
  • Wonder: at a fantasy imaginarium from across the medieval world with a world of blemmyes, grotesques, cockatrices and wood sprites as well as creatures specifically named and adapted from medieval artwork for this game.
  • Lead: a simple turn-based combat system with an exhaustion mechanic gives quick but tactically interesting combat choices.
  • Rule: become leader of a city through election or conquest and hold court to deliver justice and develop your lands.
  • A living world: as the player travels, the city-states of the realms will squabble, hold events, make raids and declare wars, changing the world around you in a dynamic way.
  • Choose your house: four different factions allow you to vary your playstyle between the heroic Phoenixes, the exploration driven Scholars, the militaristic Generals, and the wealthy Wyrms. Each faction comes with unique military units and bonuses.
  • Choose your difficulty: five difficulty settings let you vary your play between the relaxed exploratory style of the easy "John Mandeville" mode, through the classic "Moriaen" RPG experience, to the ultra-tough "Silence" mode for those who want a tougher roguelike-style experience.
  • Events: join tournaments and feasts to boost your prestige and gain skills.
  • Companionship: with a range of generated characters: six companion classes and varied character traits give a wide range of potential characters with stories, quests, interests, and opinions on the world. Nameable pets provide further possibilities for building a found family of companions and allies.
  • Romance: party members may enter romances with you and with one another, unlocking unique interactions to further the romance throughout the game.
  • Soundtrack: a unique set of 12 tavern songs gives a folkloric depth to the Exile Realms setting.

data.name: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War
data.detailed_description:
The whole war, forty muddy yards at a time.

Dirt & Viscera is a real-time roguelike about the worst job on the Western Front: holding a trench, and then leaving it. You don't command a tidy army — you command whatever the cards deal you, whatever you can afford this second, and whatever's still breathing after the last barrage.

Two economies, one terrible decision.

Cards decide what you can field. Requisition decides whether you can afford it right now. Riflemen, machine guns, snipers, flamethrowers, trench raiders, Mark IV tanks, gas, walking barrages, a biplane strafing run — you draw them, you pay for them, you place them in the mud.

Then you choose when to go over the top.

Holding is safe. Holding loses. Sooner or later you blow the whistle and send your men across — into wire, into machine guns, into artillery zeroed on the open ground. Push too early and they're scythed down; push too late and the trench is overrun. The whole game lives in that one decision.

A front that fights back, and remembers.

Barbed wire snags both sides. Tanks grind green fields into the iconic cratered mud. Flamethrowers and shells reduce woods to splintered stumps. The dead stay where they fall — and the next barrage mangles the corpses all over again.

Build a run worth dying for.

A branching, FTL-style campaign across four sectors: pick your route, see the upgrade each position rewards, and snowball a force from ~70 upgrades — half earned through your own deeds. Choose one of eight commanders, lock in a doctrine, set your difficulty, and stack optional hardship mutators for more glory and more pain. It ends where it should: a super-heavy land cruiser, rolling for your trench.



And when the campaign's done — Endless.

Hold against a horde that never stops growing. Take a trench and the front lurches forward onto fresh ground; lose one and you fall back to the reserve line. Draft an upgrade every trench you capture. Suspend and resume any run. Chase your best.

Grim, and quietly hilarious.

"Sarge says morale is high. Sarge is lying." The horror is real — but so is the gallows humour. This is the war as told by the men at the bottom of the ditch.

No microtransactions. No licensed anything. Just dirt, viscera, and the next whistle.

data.name: Toy's Paradise
data.detailed_description:
Wake up a toy ready to tear the world apart!
Move around the house, trying to tear everything down in a way to gain resources. Use these resources to build more toys, as well as other tools to increase efficiency in pulling this poor family's house apart.



Learn to manage resources, do quests for other toys, as well as level up specific toys in a way to take control of one room of the house at a time.



In Toy's Paradise, you only first start off with one toy to help accomplish the task to tear apart the room. Although as time goes on, your resources allow for the increase of man-power (toy-power?).



▼ 3D Printers
Use the 3D Printer as a way to create more builder toys. Although you will need more plastic to do so...

▼ Increased Builder Toys
With more Builder Toys under your arm, everything is faster; Be that building, breaking objects as a team (increases break speed), or having each go off and destroy their own.

▼ Plastic Generators
Constructing your own Plastic Generators from resources allows you to create plastic every minute, and with the help of an upgrade, that speed can be increased. Create more and more plastic generators to increase the amount every time period. This is important, as plastic is a form of currency. Although this cannot work without the infamous Plastic Converters.

▼ Plastic Converter
These bad boys are basically how you turn the raw plastic into actually usable plastic. Place them in front of plastic generators and instantly witness, for the first time, plastic conversion.

▼ Trading Posts
Trading posts are a great way to gain more resources once you've tuckered yourself out with mining. Place yourself a trading post, and let the resources walk to you... with a price.

▼ Tents
Yes, it is well known in the world that toys don't sleep like us. But, with the amount you are working them, you might as well add that to the lore, because they will need it. More builders can only be made once there are tents added, each tent is an extra builder you can make in the 3D printer.




▼ Hiring Toys
Yep, you heard that right, with the amount of room in this household, there are so many toys that would be willing to work for you; each having their own abilities and skills, different from the default builders.

▼ Influence
What is the point in destroying a household if no toy notices? Well, no need to worry, the toys in each room notice. Each object destroyed out of the overall amount in the room increases your influence on the surrounding toys. Depending on the toy's view on what you are doing, each will either reject your plan or give you deals on hiring based on your influence.

▼ Exploration (COMING SOON)
Once your toy army is big enough, it is time to leave the bedroom... and enter the vast space of the house. Explore rooms, pull it apart, and become the most feared toys the world has seen.

data.name: Neotrie VR Multiplayer
data.detailed_description:
NeoTrie VR is a software that enables users to create, manipulate, and interact with 3D geometrical objects and 3D models in general, of several types. Allows the teacher to easily design 3d mathematical activities with text, photos, videos and sounds.

Aims

  • Plane geometry visible through the eyes of a third dimension.
  • 3D geometry and modelling meant for 3D printing.
  • Develops handicrafts and 3D visual skills.
  • Stimulates deductive and inductive reasoning skills.
  • Highlights cooperative work and positive interdependence.
  • Motivates pupils by means of recreational, collaborative and competitive games.

Subjects

  • 2D and 3D Geometry: parallels and perpendiculars, angles, lengths, areas, volumes, ...
  • Multiview projection planes and scanner for the study of sections and figures.
  • Manipulate round bodies and find curved intersections.
  • Construction and study of polyhedra (Platonics, pyramids, prisms, antiprisms, Archimedean, Johnson, Kepler, etc.).
  • Basic operations with polyhedra (duality, truncation, rectification, extension, etc.),
  • Spatial symmetries of 3D figures, translations, rotations, reflections, dilations, etc.
  • Geodesic spheres and cupola.
  • 3D graphic calculator to represent curves and parametric surfaces.
  • 2d and 3d geometric fractals.
  • Crystalline networks from fundamental cells.
  • Euler 3D graphs (Seven Königsberg bridges problem).
  • Hamiltonian graphs in space (Salesman’s problem).
  • Coloring graphs in space (based on Four colours theorem).
  • Varied dynamic constructions.
  • More in development...

Features

  • Galleries of hundreds of pre-designed geometric figures.
  • Speech Recognition System to insert figures in the scenario. (Compatible only with languages that support speech recognition in the Microsoft API).
  • File system to load and save scenes created by users.
  • Import-export STL objects from other softwares.
  • Import GeoGebra applets (wip).
  • Multiplayer tool that enables users to create, play and learn together in the same scene
  • Photo camera and video recording inside the VR scene.
  • More in development...

Find out more activities on the Neotrie VR community website.

data.name: Pyramid Scheme
data.detailed_description:
Chase the high. Then chase the high… score.

Pyramid Scheme is a procedurally generated arcade roguelike about hopping across a pyramid of cubes, painting every one you land on, and completely losing the plot along the way. Stack relics, mix drugs, and build wild combinations to beat the Cube Lord.

A love letter to the arcade games of the ’80s and ’90s, when a high score earned you bragging rights and three initials at the top of the board.

Hop. Paint. Lose the plot.

Paint every cube to clear the floor. Grab pickups along the way and land on event cubes to see what fresh trouble you’ve found.

Take a crack blast and call for air support. Eat bad sashimi without a bathroom nearby? Turn it into an advantage. Befriend a depressed clown. Go dumpster diving for drug paraphernalia. Stack questionable decisions into a winning run.

Every high has a comedown. Go too long without a fix and risk nodding off. Take too much and risk an overdose that ends your run.

Every floor is a new low.

Visit a Blood Donation Facility floating in space. Attend Behavioral Therapy under the watchful gaze of a giant eye and an eyeball flower. Discover the bleak majesty of a big-box store parking lot.

The locals don’t want you here: a purple worm, a pink muscle man, a panhandler searching for booze, and a giant grabbing hand.

Take your meds.

Survive a floor, collect your chips, and choose one of three prescriptions.

One prescription per patient. No refills.

Your relics stack throughout the run. Find combinations that feed into each other and push the frenzy further.

Open for questionable business.

Between runs, sell secondhand prescriptions out of the back of your car. Collect bennies and spend them on permanent unlocks: new events, relics, pacts, and routes for future runs.

Chase the high score.

There’s no final boss. No “beating the game.” The floors are procedurally generated, and the goal is simple: set a score worth chasing. Stack synergies, push your luck, and give your next run something to beat.

One more run. One more… hit.

data.name: Fishing: Barents Sea
data.detailed_description:
Take the helm of your very own fishing boat in Fishing: Barents Sea and explore the vastness of the Norwegian sea in search for the best fishing zones. Start with the little boat inherited from your grandfather, catch fish and earn money for upgrades as well as bigger and better boats. Enjoy the beautiful Barents Sea and make your fishing industry dreams come true.

Learn how to catch different kinds of fish with various fishing equipment on several different boats. Every method is easy to learn, but hard to master – time to show what you are made of!

Use officially licensed Scanmar equipment like door sensors and the TrawlEye to have complete control over your trawl. Upgrade it to make sure you get the biggest catch! But be sure to stay under your yearly fishing quotas, every step and every fishing run needs to be planned. 20 years of weather data recreate a realistic environment for the schools of fish in the Barents Sea, which move according to season and water temperature. It's up to you to keep track of everything.

Visit the harbor pub to hire crew members or accept missions. At the port you are also able to repair or upgrade your ships, get a loan from the bank or buy supplies and bait at the shop.

Freely explore an open world environment which recreates the stunning landscapes of northern Norway. Look for the best fishing zones with the help of your sonar, radar and GPS and catch yourself the biggest profit.

Features:

  • Unreal™ 4 Engine for a beautiful open world environment
  • A huge map based on real landscapes in Norway
  • Dynamic day, night and moon cycles
  • Seasonal time effects and shifting weather
  • Seven playable ships
  • Semi-realistic fishing methods - easy to learn, hard to master
  • Advanced fish AI that influences your prey’s behavior
  • Includes licensed Catch Control Systems by Scanmar and officially licensed Hermes trawler
  • Inventory system to store knives, hooks and binoculars
  • Beautiful and lively environment with AI ships and fishing boats

data.name: Dandelion Void
data.detailed_description:
Single Player Demo Out Now!

A focused, single-player introduction to the doomed generation ship Pergola. Familiarize yourself with the ship’s systems, fend off unfamiliar foes, and uncover your first hints as to what happened to the Virgo Module and its inhabitants.

Dandelion Void is in active development ahead of its Early Access launch, with many improvements, changes, and additions still to come. We’d love to hear your feedback on Discord, the game’s Steam forums, and the in-game form to help us make the game as good as it can be!


Roadmap


About the Game

  • Survive on a ruined generation ship full of peril, from starvation to shipquakes to highly-evolved botanical horrors

  • Craft, scavenge, and repurpose tools, clothing, weapons and the finest tech that 1970s Earth had to offer

  • Construct shelters and bases in the abandoned chambers of the Pergola; decorate with looted furniture, or craft your own

  • Customize your character’s lineage, backstory, traits and appearance

  • Face new challenges on each run as the hand-authored ship map is modified with randomized overgrowth and decay

  • Work together to survive alongside friends in optional co-op multiplayer

  • Make the game yours with full mod support at launch

A civilization in a bottle, the starship Pergola carried everything its crew would need for a generations-long voyage: living quarters, hospitals, bars, libraries, reactors, farms, factories, and so much more, now all gone to seed.

Pick your way through ruined halls and corridors in your hunt for resources. Craft and scavenge what you need to survive. Make use of all technology at your disposal, restoring power to doors using computer terminals or fashioning weapons from metal shards and plant stems. Defend yourself against the ship’s horrors new and old: hazardous materials, collapsing structures, broken airlocks, and the over-evolved descendants of its original plant life.

With each attempt, the details of the ship change. The undergrowth spreads differently, doors break or open, medkits are spoiled or water pipes cease to function. Even as your knowledge of the Pergola grows, each run presents a new set of challenges.

There’s more to life than just staying alive. In addition to hunger, thirst, and shelter needs, you must balance your comfort and happiness. Build a home wherever you can: an abandoned air duct, an office supply closet, or a leafy hovel by a reactor cooling pool. Furnish your dwelling with cozy furniture and decorate it with strange artifacts to boost your morale.

In the late 20th century, the brutality of capitalism reached its zenith. Amidst popular uprisings and military expansions, a cadre of artists, scientists, and controversial financiers in the autonomous San Francisco Bay founded the Acorn Starship Collective. Visionaries to some, gutless cowards to others, the ASC launched the Pergola towards an exoplanet with speculated life-sustaining capability, a dozen generations away.

You know nothing of this. Your eyes have never seen these long dead founders, and your feet have never known the soil of Earth. Your world is one of cold steel bulkheads, winding jungle corridors, and the groan of unfamiliar machinery. You are alone. What happened to this place?

Explore and survive with friends in co-op-focused PvPvE multiplayer, either peer-to-peer or with player-hosted servers. Band together to tackle dangerous expeditions, spread the load of base management, or interfere with your friends’ attempts at survival. Even playing solo, you’re bound to encounter unlikely interspecies allies amongst the Pergola’s jungles…

Our game director originates from the modding community of Project Zomboid, which has inspired us to center customization and player agency in this new title. The full game includes Dandelion Void’s custom map editor and its robust Lua API.

Create and modify maps, import custom clothing and weapons, or dream up whole new Lua-scripted scenarios and biomes. Dandelion Void is a game made by modders, for modders.

data.name: Cardopolis
data.detailed_description:
Out Now, Check out the Bundle! Out Now, Check out the Bundle! 🏙️


About the Game

Welcome, Mayor! Congratulations on obtaining this highly respected position! Sadly, after your predecessor mysteriously disappeared, it is now your job to achieve greatness in Cardopolis.

Take control of the city!

As Mayor of Cardopolis, you have full authority over both the design and the laws of the city.

Reach the required population goals!

Your investors expect a lot from you, especially when it comes to reaching each sector's Population target. Be careful! If you fail to meet it, you might join your missing predecessor!

Features

  • Design a city with an ever-growing population, sector by sector!

  • Find and use up to 50 different Legislation Cards!

  • Use up to 150 Building Cards to populate your city!

  • Play with 5 completely different themed Building Decks!

  • Finished your city? Enjoy endless mode and build the biggest city you can!

data.name: 吞天食地666
data.detailed_description:
**化身天命之主，招纳乱世英杰，铸就无双神兵，终结三国纷争！在《吞天食地666》中，你将扮演落魄皇叔刘备，从楼桑村启程，踏上一段利用神秘“山河社稷图”之力复制各类名将、锻造绝世神兵、最终一统天下的传奇史诗！**

**▶ 宏大的三国史诗，由你书写**

* 故事始于东汉末年黄巾之乱，终于天下一统。亲身经历虎牢关下三英战吕布、三顾茅庐、赤壁烽火等经典历史事件，但你的选择将改变历史的走向！

* 以刘备的视角，体验从织席贩履到开国帝王的波澜壮阔。招募关羽、张飞、诸葛亮等耳熟能详的三国英豪，组建你的梦幻阵容。

**▶ 颠覆传统的“吞天食地”核心玩法**

* **【名将复制】** 这不只是简单收集名将的游戏！利用刘备祖传的“山河社稷图”，在特定条件下**复制**你击败的强力敌将！成功复制后，将其化为己用！想象一下，让吕布的无双武艺、郭嘉的鬼谋神算、周瑜的赤壁烈焰都能为你所用！

* **【神兵锻造·威震寰宇】** 收集散落九州的神异材料，拜访隐世匠人，**亲手打造并强化属于你的绝世神兵**。每一把神兵都拥有独特的属性和强大的特效，配合麾下各路名将，打造出独一无二的战斗流派。

* **【深度养成·运筹帷幄】** 精细的回合制战斗系统考验策略。合理搭配各路名将、装备的神兵、以及将领的固有技能和兵种克制，在战场上克敌制胜。培养你的将领，提升等级，学习技能，打造一支所向披靡的王者之师。

**▶ 终极目标：问鼎中原，一统天下**

* 你的目标是终结乱世，**统一全国**！从一个小小的楼桑村起步，招兵买马，攻城略地，逐步扩张你的势力版图。

* 面对曹操的雄才大略、孙氏的江东基业、以及众多割据枭雄的挑战，运用你的“山河社稷图”和智慧，扫平六合，成就霸业！

**▶ 丰富的挑战与内容**

* **史诗战役：** 体验精心设计的经典战役和原创关卡，运用策略克服强大的敌军和复杂的战场环境。

* **名将云集：** 收集和交互数百位性格鲜明、能力各异的三国名将与传奇人物。了解他们的故事，决定是招揽、复制，还是为敌。

* **探索与成长：** 在广袤的三国地图上探索，发现隐藏任务、稀有材料和传奇装备。不断搜集、锻造、升级，让你的势力无可匹敌。

* **深度策略：** 回合制战斗融合天赋、连协组合、神兵特效、兵种相克等多重元素，每一场战斗都需要深思熟虑。

**《吞天食地666》是一款融合了经典回合制RPG、名将收集养成和神兵打造系统的三国策略RPG游戏。如果你渴望：**

* **体验从草根到帝王的逆袭人生；**

* **掌控“复制”强敌、集各路名将于麾下的超凡力量；**

* **亲手锻造各类神兵利器，打造个性化战斗体验；**

* **运筹帷幄，在深度搭配战斗中统一三国；**

* **沉浸于波澜壮阔的三国史诗与丰富的人物故事中；**

**那么，请在此开启你的“吞天”霸业，书写属于你的三国终结篇章！**

data.name: Song of Slavs
data.detailed_description:
In Song of Slavs you have to try on the role of a young Tsar who must establish his settlement and withstand hordes of treacherous enemies. You will have to demonstrate your leadership skills throughout the day and under different weather conditions. Increase the population of your village, assign jobs and turn your village into a glorious city of the ancient Slavs.

The Tsar's Retinue

Each warrior in your retinue can become unique with the help of a combat system tied to the squad and builds of each individual unit.

Turn to the powers of the ancient pagan gods

Keep faith in your gods! Mighty oak trees are suitable not just as a resource, but also for creating powerful idols that will help protect your settlement. Choose which idol to sacrifice to. You can sacrifice your settler for the sake of peace and prosperity, or you can sacrifice food for the sake of new knowledge.

Develop yourself and your people:

Having sufficiently developed your settlement, you will unlock horses and be able to saddle a steed, and your peasants will have access to a cart for transporting more resources.

Strengthen and develop your settlement

Place and upgrade various buildings to suit the needs of your settlement - a house, a farm, a barn, a bathhouse, and even several idols. Each type of building requires certain resources, but provides different development bonuses. Need new units or resources? Place new buildings in your settlement.

Set your priorities

You choose what and where to build. You can strengthen your defenses or expand your army by wisely managing the settlement's resources. Each building has its own purpose and will help you implement your strategy.

Handcrafted pixel art and music

Immerse yourself in Slavic culture with magnificent music, sound effects, and incredible pixel art.

data.name: MIDNIGHT Remastered
data.detailed_description:
Overview

A remastered version of the 2017 web game 'MIDNIGHT', collect the seven letters of the deadly sins and repent your past offences in this horror game.


MIDNIGHT Remastered features a non-linear storyline where the game takes place after major events, you must collect and read optional documents if you wish to understand the story.

New Features

  • Better Performance - Built from the ground up in a different game engine, the performance of MIDNIGHT Remastered is greater than that of the original.
  • New Content - New events have been added as well as completely new post-game content.
  • Lighting - With a better lighting system, the game looks better than ever and creates a more atmospheric experience with real-time shadows.
  • 3D Audio Panning - Use sound to detect the direction of nearby enemies and events with improved 3D Audio Panning.
  • Controller Support - Both PlayStation 4 & Xbox One Controllers are now supported.
  • Much More

data.name: Sid Meier's Colonization (Classic)
data.detailed_description:
The Tradition of Civilization Continues

The New World lies before you with all its peril, promise and infinite possibility. Your colonists anxiously follow you to shore. The treasures of an entire continent await you.

Finally, the much-anticipated follow-up to Civilization is here! Sid Meier's Colonization takes you into the Colonial Era to discover, explore and colonize vast territories that promise both danger and reward.

Play one of four colonial powers as you set sail to discover the New World. Explore new lands and strategically plant your first colony. Direct its growth, manage its resources and establish lucrative trade routes. Balance economics, political and military strategy to create your own powerful nation.

But beware of your enemies! Angry natives and rival powers can encroach upon your territory. You'll have to overcome your foes with superior military strategy and wily diplomacy. Only then can you launch your revolution and declare your independence.

Colonization, The newest strategy game from Sid Meier continues the great tradition of Civilization.

  • Manage your growth, development and trade to create a powerful nation.
  • Pit your strategic skills against Colonization's advanced artificial intelligence.
  • Play either the French, English, Dutch or Spanish colonial powers each with distinct characteristics and political situations.
  • Customize your games and choose your own level of difficulty so you never play the same game twice.
  • Discover and explore the Americas or create your own scenario with a random map generator
  • Same design principles and interface as award-winning Civilization, making game play easy and fun.
  • Bonus soundtrack included!

data.reviews:
“The game is a rich and varied Gestalt of top colony activity. Strategies must be divined with care, and constantly modified to ride the chaotic rapids of the thousands of interactive elements in this opus of creative genius. Perhaps. Or it could just be a damn fine game.”
95 – Amiga Format

“Colonization offers hours and hours of entertainment. I played it for over a week to write this review and it commanded my total concentration all the time to play it once through. Because the game can be very different every time you play it, this means that Colonization is the sort of game you could play for ever.”
93 – Amiga Power

“"Go and make a world", they said. "Do it by Wednesday night", they said. "And bring us back some chips". Colonization is a fairly simple idea in theory but, thankfully, much more involved once you get going. Set sail in your little ship, bump into a bit of land that rightfully belongs to someone else, then claim it as your own. Ah, the American way...”

data.name: Phantom Rend
data.detailed_description:
In the world of Phantom Rend you find yourself on an abandoned island nation as an ancient forgotten foe of humanity awakens, after an experiment gone wrong.

Each area you enter offers its own enchanting oddities, alive with unfamiliar beings and faces. Soak in the scenery as you uncover ancient secrets hidden far from the usual routes.

If old school action, eerie-yet-adorable characters, big adventures, and hauntingly beautiful worlds appeal to you, Phantom Rend is your next destination!

Game Features :

  •   Non - Linear adventure! The vast, open world in Phantom Rend lets you decide which routes to explore, which threats to confront, and how your story unfolds.

  • Journey through a sprawling, interconnected world filled with forgotten ancient caverns, the hidden depths of a half-deserted modern city, open countryside and more.

  • Collect Rare crystals that fit in the new weapons of Humankind making them capable of hurting phantoms—your only way to fight back against the rising phantom threat.

  •  Unlock new Maps as you progress or trade items with willing characters for additional Maps.

  •  Enjoy precise - combo, parry, dash, double jump and slide as you navigate the chaos that has befallen the world in Phantom Rend.

  •  As humanity discovers new ways to fight this ancient foe! Acquire Latest tech, boost your power and speed, and tailor your skills and equipment to different challenges.

  •  Engage in gripping boss battles as you meet unrelenting creatures. Study their patterns, withstand their overwhelming assaults, and overcome them through skill and determination.

  • Meet, fight and befriend variety of charming and unsettling characters, each animated with handcrafted, frame-by-frame 2D artistry.

  •  Soundtracks that shift between uplifting and eerie tones follow you as you uncover the perilous mysteries hidden within Phantom Rend.

data.name: Demon Stick
data.detailed_description:
After a successful exorcism, the priests trapped your demonic soul inside a stick and cast you back into Hell. You awaken at the very bottom determined to climb your way back to Dad's throne to ask him to turn you back into a demon.

This is a rage game.

As a stick, you’ll navigate through the twisted layers of Hell, each inspired by the haunting and surreal visions of Hieronymus Bosch.

Use simple controls to master precise movement, solve punishing physics challenges, and endure endless falls as you fight your way upward.

Every mistake will send you tumbling back down. Every success will feel like a miracle.

Features:

  • Environments inspired by the paintings of Hieronymus Bosch

  • Simple mechanics, unforgiving difficulty

  • You’ll truly feel like you’re in Hell while playing this game

data.name: Pozionista
data.detailed_description:
Experiment with ingredients and discover new ways to make potions, since each potion is the result of specific combinations of elements, what you will need is to mix herbs in the correct way and not necessarily a recipe.

Rediscover potions forgotten in time through an old map showing where the knowledge of each forgotten potion is kept.

There is a problem, the valley has changed and the map is no longer very reliable, so use the libraries in each town to find information about this forgotten civilization and tales of local mysteries, to reach such places deep in the forest and recover the knowledge lost from them.

Use mushrooms, flowers, roots and herbs gathered in the woods to make magic potions.

Learn the art of potion making with the cauldron and use the two other tools you will unlock during your adventure, to make increasingly advanced potions.

To explore the valley you need to fund your travels, and what better way to get that than to sell the potions you make to potion stores.

data.name: Omenwheel
data.detailed_description:
90% of gamblers quit right before they hit it big.
Omenwheel is a roguelite role-playing autobattler set in mythic Edo Japan. Prepare your samurai's cards, gear and living roulette wheel before each fight. Then watch your build go to work: the battle plays itself.

Prepare the wheel

  • Shape your wheel with cards and equipment.
  • Choose sectors and target priorities before battle.
  • Check landing odds and refresh your options before committing.

Set off a chain reaction

  • Watch automatic battles unfold, spin by spin.
  • Build combos around Extra Spins and special wheels.
  • Your living companion reacts to good luck and bad.

Face wheels that fight back

  • Enemies spin wheels of their own.
  • Prepare for curses, forced sectors and hidden threats.
  • Bosses hold surprises: be ready for anything mid-fight.

Read the omens

  • Explore a branching chapter map that changes each run.
  • The Omen Wheel alters battles and their rewards.
  • Pick your route or let the path wheel decide.

Tempt fate at the shop

  • Buy cards and gear straight off the shelf.
  • Drop coins into the Plinko and chase the jackpot pocket.
  • Haggle with the Exchanger and trade cards across his scale.

Forge a stronger build

  • Reforge a card into one of two upgrades...
  • ...or shuffle the cards and pick right for its super upgrade.
  • Grab the hammer and forge upgrades for your samurai.

Two brothers, two wheels

  • Samurai brothers Ren and Tetsu awaken with most of their past gone.
  • Each fights beside a living wheel with a mind of its own.
  • Play solo or in two-player online co-op.

data.name: Tomboy Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Ever wanted to escape into a virtual world? Now is your chance!

Finding yourself on a secluded island, a wonderful summer awaits you.

Beside you is your girl-friend, Natsumi! You have known her for a long time but your relationship never moved past "friends".

This might be your last summer together. If you want to make your feelings known, now is your chance!

Features

Tomboy Adventure is an interaction driven dating sim where through your choices you unsuccessfully try to romance your companion. Exploring the island unlocks new dialogue options and interactions, creating new opportunities for getting your feelings across.

  • Branching dialogue

  • Headpatting

  • Explorable island

  • Fishing

  • Day/night cycle

  • Dynamic weather

  • Camping

  • Advanced headpatting

  • Both VR and non-VR play is supported!

The summer is short so lets enjoy it!

data.name: Galactic Breakout
data.detailed_description:
Galactic Breakout is a modern interpretation of the classic Arkanoid, where you need to break different types of blocks with the paddle - your best friend.

Each of the 75 levels has been thoroughly created by hand and the difficulty will gradually increase with each level.

Main features

  • 3 acts with 25 levels in each
  • 10 unique power-ups - with 3 ultimate ones

  • 10 unique and challenging debuffs - some can easily reduce your score points

  • Various visual effects for different types of blocks

  • Custom and Deterministic paddle physics - control your ball movement as you wish
  • Full gamepad support - use your gamepad to control your paddle and navigate through the UI. You don't need a mouse or keyboard

  • Steam achievements - 15+ various game achievements to encourage you in your journey

data.name: High Hell
data.detailed_description:
High Hell is a neon-soaked, arcade-action first-person shooter from Terri Vellmann (Heavy Bullets) and Doseone (Enter the Gungeon, Gang Beasts). Descend upon the criminal underground with the most blessed of shotguns and bring lethal salvation to those that have fallen from the light. Righteous fury and fancy footwork are crucial to survive an escalating, absurd series of outlandish missions. Pop brainwashed chimps, deface corporate effigies, and dismantle the business dealings of the unrepentant cartel in a vibrant remix of the classic first-person shooter.

BREAKNECK COMBAT

Unleash pump action fury and fancy footwork in a quick shot first-person shooter with a twist of neon and the absurd.

OUTLANDISH MISSIONS

Bring down the disciples of evil as you destroy and deface their business operations in over 20 bizarrely satisfying missions. Save sacrificial goats, raze drug labs, and clash against an eccentric collection of bosses.

DROP KICKS & PYROMANIA


Choose your plan of attack by either slinking around to find a tactically advantageous position or just kick down the door and murder every son of a bitch in the room. Then take a quiet moment for yourself and burn stacks of cash to add financial insult to fatal injury.



QUICK SHOT ACTION: Kick down every door in your path during the 1-2 hour single player campaign.

FULL LENGTH FACE MELTING OST by doseone.

REPLAYABILITY: Find new shortcuts, strategies, secrets and carefully placed cigarette butts on every handcrafted level.

SPEEDRUNNIN': Compete for bragging rights on Steam Leaderboards for highest score and fastest completion time.

NO GAMEPAD COMPROMISE: Twitchy fast FPS gameplay tailored for KEYBOARD and MOUSE control.

MORE SHOOTING LESS READING: Nonsensical interactive cutscenes that only make the barely existing narrative even more confusing.

data.name: Choo Choo Kingdom
data.detailed_description:
Choo Choo Kingdom is a 2D survivor-like train defense game where your entire kingdom rides on rails.

Build a moving fortress, recruit fantasy troops, and defend your castle-train from endless monster hordes. Each run, choose from different units, place them onto your train, and watch them automatically fight as enemies swarm from every direction.

Your formation matters. Put melee troops near the front, ranged units behind them, and powerful support units where they can protect the kingdom. Between battles, reorder your Choo Choo Kingdom to create stronger synergies and survive the next wave.

Recruit troops from different factions, including Royal Humans, Arcana Elves, War Orcs, Super Dwarves, Storm Vikings, ancient Lizardkin, forest Druids, and fiery Emberborn. Each faction brings its own style of attack, from arrows and magic bolts to giant cannons, wind blades, cleaving axes, summons, buffs, and explosive fire spells.

Fight through multiple stages, collect gold, upgrade your army, and push deeper into dangerous lands. Every wave brings more enemies, stronger monsters, and new pressure on your moving kingdom.

Can your tiny army protect the train, hold the castle, and keep the kingdom moving?

Features:

  • Survivor-like auto-battle gameplay

  • Train and tower defense combined

  • Recruit and upgrade fantasy troops

  • Reorder your train formation

  • Many factions with unique attack styles

  • Swarms, elites, bosses, and chaotic battles

  • Pixel art fantasy warfare with a cozy-but-chaotic style

data.name: Crown of Lust
data.detailed_description:
The gods are sleeping. The demons are waking. And the prince is... indisposed.

Crown of Lust is a fantasy adult visual novel set in a kingdom on the brink of collapse. When the ancient Veil separating the righteous kingdom of Vaelthara from the corrupted realm of Lunaris begins to crack, war looms on the horizon. Too bad the kingdom's best hope is a charming prince who'd rather be chasing girls than attending war councils.

Raised on terrifying tales of Lunari savagery, you arrive at their borders expecting the worst...only to discover that the "barbarians" are a kingdom of beautiful women who find your royal mannerisms equally as strange as you find their customs.

Flirt and seduce your way through a dangerous foreign court, navigate treacherous political intrigue, and unravel the secrets behind a sinister conspiracy hell-bent on dragging the two kingdoms into a bloody war.

                     

  • Multiple endings based on decisions and choices made throughout the game

  • Multiple romanceable love-interests

  • Animated spicy scenes

  • Translations for multiple languages

  • Achievements

data.name: Agricultural Simulator 2013 - Steam Edition
data.detailed_description:
Best In Farming!

An idyllic farming environment surrounded by inviting & untilled mountain panoramas set in the beautiful landscapes of Tuscany, The Alps and USA await all fans of the Agricultural Simulator series.

At their own farm hobby-farmers undertake the daily tasks and challenges of a professional: The production of food, sustainable resources and delivery of eco products all have to be managed.

Fields have to be worked and farm animals cared for. The dynamic ground makes the whole game more realistic! Future farmers have to invest tactically and with foresight – the rapid spend of budgets by running costs and seed bills must not be underestimated. To realize a profit takes financial and tactical skill.

Key Features


  • Including Interactive Tutorial
  • Includes 4 Maps
  • Includes more than 100 machines
  • Free placeable building including:
    • Solar Energy Plant
    • Greenhouse
    • Windmills
    • Dung Tank
  • Extensive Help System, including Transport tasks

data.detailed_description:
Dream #46 is a contemplative ride game in an idyllic world that could come out of a dream.



You control a small sailboat in a tiny world made up of 6 areas where each of them has its own color palette, its inhabitants.

Scrolls are scattered across the dream. Collect one and a positive affirmation will present itself to motivate you...about you.

Like any dream, this one has an end. To do this, you must collect petals in order to reconstitute flowers and create a bouquet of flowers to finally give it as an offering...

Have a nice dream.

data.name: Jrago III Requiem of the Night
data.detailed_description:
JRAGO III Requiem of the Night is the third entry of the JRAGO video game franchise, a gothic Metroidvania Action RPG series.  This latest installment features a major graphical overhaul from the previous entries, as well as a new combat system.

Play as JRAGO and SYNGE, the Guardians of Eden, in an epic conflict of spiritual warfare.  Fight the ultimate battle of Light versus Darkness as you storm Dracula's Castle filled with demons, monsters and more!  Overcome the forces of darkness to save the world and restore the light!

Slay your way through hordes of demons and monsters to a heavy metal soundtrack!  As with the previous JRAGO titles, Requiem of the Night features an original soundtrack by JRAGO the band of the same name.  An invigorating blend of heavy metal and classical music set the ominous tone of this medieval fantasy.

JRAGO III has a fresh new look with stunning high resolution 2D visuals and classic animation techniques.  Featuring stylized digitized character sprites, life-like imagery, and new high-definition enemies, Requiem of the Night brings the JRAGO Series to the next level!

GAME FEATURES

  • Become a demon slayer using an updated combat system featuring new ways to punch, kick, and slice your way through the forces of darkness!

  • Gain experience and level up in true RPG fashion.

  • Find new weapons and armor with an in-depth inventory system.

  • Learn enemy spells and unlock new abilities. 

  • Explore an immersive world, with a classic blue square Metroidvania mapping system.

  • Unlock over 150+ enemies in the detailed bestiary.

  • 100 Unlockable achievements.

  • 10-20 hours of playtime.

Add to your WISHLIST today!

This game does NOT use any Generative AI.

data.name: Carnaval Marbles
data.detailed_description:
Carnaval Marbles fuses a systemic roguelike with French billiards. In a dark-fantasy carnival world, every shot counts: positioning, rebounds, and the synergies between your Talismans, Marble Bonuses, and Runes turn a simple game of billiards into a true combinatorial engine. No two runs are ever the same.

Key features

  • A unique gameplay loop: hijack French billiards with hundreds of Talismans, Bonuses, and Runes to build infinite synergies.

  • A deep roguelike: every run is different; craft your strategy and face Bosses that can rewrite the rules mid-run.

  • 8 playable characters to discover the game’s core mechanics.

  • A striking universe: dark fantasy inspired by European folklore and old carnivals, blending anachronisms and mythology.

  • Accessibility + depth: easy to learn thanks to a clear UI and integrated tutorials, yet designed so expert players can “break the game” with ruthless builds.

  • Endless replayability: after defeating all Bosses, Endless Mode lets you keep pushing your limits.

A systemic approach
Carnaval Marbles follows in the footsteps of games like Balatro, where simple core rules hide dizzying combinatorial depth. Here, trajectory is your language: every shot can upend the run.
Ready your Talismans. Line up your marbles. The demo is only a taste—the carnival has just begun.

data.detailed_description:
CASHTRONAUTS is an arcade space combat & trading game that takes place in an alternate universe where capitalist dinosaurs rule the galaxy. Fighting viciously to climb to the top of the economic food chain; how your make your millions is entirely up to you. Will you be a bounty hunter, a pirate, a smuggler or a miner?

As you progress, you unlock Risks: gameplay modifiers that are toggled on/off at your whim. Each one will introduce new elements and dangers to your next run, but also grants you a bonus to your income. If you rise to the challenge your profit margins will soar!

The stealthy Raptor pirates are always looking for their loot, especially if that loot is your burnt-out remains. And then, there's the soft-skinned mammalian threat looming on the horizon... but you'll burn that bridge when you reach it. Space is a dangerous place even at the best of times. Will you have what it takes to beat out the competition and dominate the market?

Key Features

  • Unique gameplay: Space combat & trading sim meets fast-paced arcade action
  • Varied ship types: Everything from the nimble Vermin fighter to the lumbering Stego mining barge
  • Splitscreen multiplayer: 1-4 players all contributing to the same bottom line. Will you cooperate or fight for the company's number one spot? (Gamepad required)
  • Constant challenge: The game evolves as you do: unlock new Risks as you progress to raise the stakes of your next run
  • Dynamic factions & AI: Tricera-cops are trying to stop a Raptor attack a Stego mining vessel. Do you jump in and help, or wait until it's all over and scavenge the remains?
  • Tight controls: Enjoy fine-tuned controls for keyboard & mouse and gamepad with "juicy" weapon recoil, kickback and effects
  • Beauty: Stylized, colourful flat-shaded 3D world paired with striking 2D character portraits
  • Steamworks: Steam cloud, achievements, trading cards and leaderboard
  • Kickin' tunes: New soundtrack from Patrice Bourgeault (Mercenary Kings, Curses & Chaos)

data.detailed_description:
Forza Horizon 5 Version Comparison


About the Game

Your Ultimate Horizon Adventure awaits! Explore the vibrant and ever-evolving open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in hundreds of the world’s greatest cars.


This is Your Horizon Adventure
Lead breathtaking expeditions across the vibrant and ever-evolving open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in hundreds of the world’s greatest cars.


This is a Diverse Open World
Explore a world of striking contrast and beauty. Discover living deserts, lush jungles, historic cities, hidden ruins, pristine beaches, vast canyons and a towering snow-capped volcano.


This is an Adventurous Open World
Immerse yourself in a deep campaign with hundreds of challenges that reward you for engaging in the activities you love. Meet new characters and choose the outcomes of their Horizon Story missions.


This is an Evolving Open World
Take on awe-inspiring weather events such as towering dust storms and intense tropical storms as Mexico’s unique, dynamic seasons change the world every week. Keep coming back for new events, challenges, collectibles, and rewards, and new areas to explore. No two seasons will ever be the same.


This is a Social Open World
Team up with other players and enter the Horizon Arcade for a continuing series of fun, over-the-top challenges that keep you and your friends in the action and having fun with no menus, loading screens or lobbies. Meet new friends in Horizon Open and Tours and share your creations with new community gift sharing.


This is Your Open World
Create your own expressions of fun with the powerful new EventLab gameplay toolset including custom races, challenges, stunts, and entirely new game modes. Customize your cars in more ways than ever before with new options such as the ability open and close convertible tops, paint brake calipers, and more. Use the new Gift Drops feature to share your custom creations with the community.


Begin Your Horizon Adventure today!

data.name: Feeble Origins: Path of a Hero
data.detailed_description:
Feeble Origins is a small adventure with a retro tone that puts the spotlight on the melee class of adventurer and trades away the complexity of modern gaming for a classic feel. Instead of experience points and sprawling skill trees, your progression comes from meaningful gear upgrades, the story you uncover, and the world itself.

Begin Your Feeble Journey

Your travels have led you to Makestone, a quiet village perched on ruins so old only the Giants can pronounce them. Adventurers have chased its rumors for generations, and the few who return don’t offer much in the way of details. The abandoned loot they left behind is what brought you here in the first place. Now that you’ve arrived, it’s up to you to discover what lies beneath Makestone Village…and pick up whatever you can carry out along the way.

Explore at Your Own Pace

The world of Feeble Origins is non-linear and becomes more open the more you progress, letting you choose your path with each quest. Venture further into the woods, descend into crypts, or brave the caverns. Each location holds its own secrets, puzzles, and fragments of a deeper story.

Meaningful Loot

Every new weapon or armor piece is a meaningful upgrade, with each choice making a difference in gameplay style. Combat is straightforward but viscerally satisfying, with each swing, block, and dodge feeling earned.

Uncover the Mystery

With each quest, you'll uncover pieces of a growing mystery: Why are the dead rising? Who is behind it? And what lies beneath Makestone Village?

Nostalgia, Reimagined

Feeble Origins is built to evoke the warmth of retro RPGs--not through pixel-perfect imitation--but through tone, pacing, and simplicity. It's a game that respects your time, rewards your curiosity, and invites you to settle into its rhythm.

data.name: XinvDawn
data.detailed_description:
Game Background

Village of Xi is an idle simulation management game with light RPG elements and story content woven in.

Xi was an infant found by a matchmaker by the river and raised in the village. Years passed, and the day of Xi’s Rite of Coming-of-Age arrived. This birthday feels like a ritual: once it passes, Xi is to take charge of all village affairs. Though a subtle sense of unease lingers, Xi accepts the duty all the same — for she loves this warm, bustling way of life.

Gameplay Overview

Playing as the protagonist Xi, you build a village from nothing. Empty dwellings draw new adult villagers to settle in, and existing villagers may also have children.

Seasons shift. Every year, villagers require rations and supplies to be provided. As the village grows larger, resource demands keep rising. You must construct more production buildings to craft these goods.

Buildings rely on villagers to operate. Xi can step in temporarily to cover work, yet the village ultimately sustains itself through its residents. Xi may personally assign jobs, or build a hiring hall so idle villagers can seek work on their own.

Each building features short casual story animations when Xi visits. These small moments make up the trivial, everyday life of Xi.

Main story arcs for Xi unlock gradually as the village expands.

Bonus Mode

After finishing the full storyline, the Map & Creation system unlocks. You may design custom scenery and buildings, which you can then use in new playthroughs.

data.name: Axon Hero
data.detailed_description:
Unleash Your Logic And Creativity In This Mind-Bending Machine-Building Adventure.

Axon Hero is more than just a puzzle game - it's a creative playground where logic meets imagination. Build, code, and conquer your way through many hand-crafted challenges, each one more mind-bending than the last.

Build Your Factory Masterpiece


  • Design your own intricate factories filled with conveyor belts, splitters, color converters, and more.
  • Experiment with different machine layouts to find the perfect solution to each unique puzzle.
  • Watch your creation come to life as boxes navigate your circuit, guided by your logic code.

Choose From A Wide Range Of Machines


  • Discover a diverse collection of wacky machines, each with its own special function.
  • Master the art of manipulating boxes, changing their colors, and directing their path.
  • Combine machines in ingenious ways to overcome increasingly challenging puzzles.

Code Your Own Logic


  • Unleash your inner programmer and code your own custom logic circuits.
  • Use logic gates like AND, OR, and NOT to control your machines and solve puzzles in unique ways.
  • No coding experience required - just drag, drop, and connect to bring your genius to life!

Build, Code, Conquer - Axon Hero awaits!

data.name: Murder by Numbers
data.detailed_description:
Collector's Edition


About the Game

Solve Pixel Puzzles to find clues.
Use those clues to interrogate witnesses.
Work your way to the truth...
...and uncover the mystery of Murder by Numbers!



Los Angeles, 1996. Honor Mizrahi was just an actress on a hit TV detective show. But when her boss ends up dead just minutes after he fires her, she finds herself starring in her own murder mystery. Teaming up with SCOUT, a reconnaissance robot thrown away after a mysterious incident, she sets out to clear her name - and a new detective duo is born!

Investigate a range of murders across TV studios, glitzy award shows, drag clubs, and more - all set to an energetic soundtrack from famed composer Masakazu Sugimori (Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, Ghost Trick and Viewtiful Joe).

Uncover a dark conspiracy by interrogating a wild range of weird and wonderful characters, designed by the incomparable Hato Moa, creator of Hatoful Boyfriend.

90s fashions! Upbeat jams! Sass dialled up to 100! Questionable jokes! Drag queens! All that and more awaits... in Murder by Numbers!

data.name: RoboShock
data.detailed_description:
Blast through relentless insect hordes in this adrenaline-fuelled, twin-stick 3D arcade shooter!

Inspired by legendary arcade classics like Robotron, RoboShock delivers fast-paced, top-down bullet hell action designed to push your reflexes to the absolute limit. Dodge lightning-fast attacks, obliterate screen-filling bosses, and chase the ultimate high score in a pure, addictive arcade experience that will keep you coming back for "just one more run."

Key Features

  • Intense Twin-Stick Action: Classic, fast-paced top-down 3D arcade shooter gameplay

  • Relentless Insect Hordes: Battle massive, diverse waves of deadly robotic insects

  • Hand-Crafted Levels: No algorithmic repetition. Every stage is meticulously designed to offer a unique mix of strategic dodging and all-out blasting

  • Epic Boss Battles: Test your skills against screen-filling boss fights at the end of every world

  • Devastating Arsenal: Collect powerful weapon upgrades, including Missiles, Lasers, Multi-Shot, Energy Shields, Freeze Blasts, and the ultimate RoboShock weapon!

  • High-Stakes Scoring: Complete the game without a Game Over to maximize your high score—but beware, losing all your lives wipes your current score run!

  • Flexible Controls: Full support for both fluid Mouse & Keyboard or classic Twin-Stick Controller layouts—swap between them instantly

  • Silky Smooth Performance: Built from the ground up in pure C++ and OpenGL for maximum frame rates, even on low-spec PCs.

Gameplay & Mechanics

Learn, Adapt, and Survive

Every hand-crafted level in RoboShock evolves as you play. To survive, you must master enemy movement, learn distinct firing patterns, and adapt your strategy on the fly.

Risk vs. Reward Scoring

Your progress saves automatically after every completed level, letting you pick up right where you left off. But true arcade champions know the real challenge: finishing the entire game without a single Game Over to lock in the ultimate high score.

Retro Aesthetics, Modern Performance

Immerse yourself in vibrant, low-fi retro 3D graphics inspired by the golden age of arcade gaming. Backed by a powerful, hand-crafted original sci-fi soundtrack and explosive sound effects, RoboShock looks, sounds, and feels like the ultimate nostalgic trip.

System Requirements

  • Platform: Windows

  • Engine: Pure C++ / OpenGL (Engineered for hyper-efficient compatibility and flawless performance on low-end hardware)
