data.name: Wreck Runners
data.detailed_description:
Join the Community


About the Game

Wreck Runners is an up to 4 player online co-op extraction game set in a haunted and ever-changing Bermuda Triangle. Hired by the suspiciously cheerful Trustwell Corporation, your crew of runners is sent in to recover valuable salvage. We expect you may find far more than sunken wrecks waiting in the Fog.

RECOVER THE IMPOSSIBLE

Use the powerful Scrapjack to haul salvage onto your all-terrain vehicle. Everything is physics-driven - every grab, every throw, every desperate attempt to secure loot while the world falls apart around you.

ONE VEHICLE, ONE CREW

Out in the Triangle, the ORCA is more than just transport. Across land, sea, and air, it is the only constant when you’re running. Keep the haul moving, keep each other alive, and get home in one piece.

GROW YOUR OPERATION

Cash in your salvage between runs and put your hard-earned money toward better equipment, new upgrades, and fresh cosmetics. The more you brave the Fog, the better your crew gets at surviving it. 

NO TWO TRIPS ARE THE SAME

The Triangle never stays still. Every run starts differently, loot turns up in new places, and whatever's lurking in the Fog keeps your crew guessing. Adapt fast, trust your friends, and expect your plans to fall apart.

data.name: Tiny Vikings
data.detailed_description:
In Tiny Vikings: Journey to Asgard, Loki has cursed your village, turning all the adults into otters. With the grown-ups out of action, it’s up to the kids to break the spell and cause a little trouble along the way.

Their plan is to sail beyond the edge of the world, reach Asgard, and ask the gods for help. The adults probably wouldn’t approve. Luckily, they’re otters.

Six kids, six ways to cause trouble

Each kid has unique abilities and limitations. Switch between them and pick the right Viking to get past whatever stands in your way.

Put your heads together

Combine the kids’ skills to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles that no single Viking could tackle alone.

Mix it up in battle

Bash enemies with a wooden sword, fire stones from a slingshot, or set their clothes alight. Mix the kids’ abilities to give your foes more than they bargained for.

Extreme Vikingery!

They may be small, but these kids know how to make a mess. Leave a trail of mischief and mayhem wherever your adventure takes you.

PUSH PUSH PUSH!

Whether you're playing solo or in co-op, it's all about PEDAL, PEDAL, PEDAL! But on this journey, speed alone isn't enough. If you can't steer the pedals in the right direction, the obstacles won't let you off the hook.

ISLAND TO ISLAND

Use the realistic physics and collision system to overcome challenging obstacles and reach new islands. Each new island saves your progress, but the courses get progressively more difficult.

UPGRADES

Use the add-ons you’ve collected to upgrade your vehicle, make the tracks easier, or troll your friends.

TORNADO IS APPROACHING

The massive tornado course will turn everything into chaos. The storm will test not only your vehicle but also your patience.

TROLL

Knock your friends off the track, send them flying with a hard collision, and dive into each other with sea noodles to turn the course into total chaos.

data.name: 鬼鎮村の危険な因襲 - Dangerous Village Tradition -
data.detailed_description:
"Dangerous Village Tradition - 鬼鎮村の危険な因襲 -" is a visual novel game that depicts a married couple who have moved to the countryside being manipulated by the strange local tradition of "Onibarai" (Demon Purification). Eventually, they find themselves unable to escape the stimulation of this tradition.
A Bishojo Game released in 2016 under the "Black Currant" brand has been reworked for the "PandaShojo" platform for players around the world to enjoy.


◆Introduction
After refusing to participate in the "Onibarai", the harassment by the villagers continued.
Every day, their well-tended fields were vandalized, and even the windows of their house were shattered...

"Even so, I... want to live with people who coexist with nature."
Ayako was firmly resolved. Even if it meant ultimately betraying Yuto...


◆Synopsis
Yuuto Sumii and his wife Ayako moved to a rural village after getting married.
Contrary to the closed-off image often associated with rural areas, they were warmly welcomed by the villagers who surrounded them with a cheerful atmosphere.
Despite the inconveniences typical of the countryside, they were determined to build a happy life.

However...

In this village, there was something fundamentally deranged.
The "Onibarai" tradition.
A tradition where several young women from the village were selected to act as lovers with men dressed as demons.

Yuuto got entangled in it, and even his wife, Ayako...
Gradually, they were engulfed by madness, manipulated by the villagers.

Trapped by the dreaded tradition, can the two of them ever regain their peace...


◆Characters
・Ayako Sumii
"I want to spend my whole life in this village. Even until I become a grandmother."
Yuuto's wife Ayako is very kind and manages both household chores and farming work.
They have just recently married and are enjoying their newlywed life.
Due to Ayako's wish, they moved to the countryside, and Yuuto feels a slight sense of indebtedness as he adapts to the inconveniences typical of the countryside.

・Chinatsu Suzubayashi
"I've finally become accustomed to it. So please, just leave it be."
She has an outstanding figure, but she's a shy girl who struggles with social interactions having grown up in the village.
While tending to the village's general store, she met Yuuto when he came shopping.
She has been participating in the "Onibarai" since childhood and sees the tradition as perfectly normal.

・Misaki Toudou
"Wonderful... I wanted to be with a cool guy like Yuuto."
She has a straightforward personality, with her charming features being her blonde ponytail and smile.
She takes extreme actions in her desire to possess Yuuto exclusively.
She has an interest in the "Onibarai" and moved to the village before the protagonists did.

・Masuda
A resident of the same village who is a freeter. He participate in the "Onibarai day and night.
Acting on instincts, he tries to approach Ayako, whom he met for the first time.

・Kawayama
The village chief who oversees the "Onibarai". He pretends to be a kind elderly man with a forced smile.
But his true nature is the embodiment of desire. Under the guise of a ritual, he indulges with young women day and night in a cave.

・Yuuto Sumii
A city dweller who moved from the city to the countryside after marrying Ayako.
He initially found the ritual repulsive, but after participating himself, he lost his resistance to it.

Every day, their well-tended fields were vandalized, and even the windows of their house were shattered...

"Even so, I... want to live with people who coexist with nature."
Ayako was firmly resolved. Even if it meant ultimately betraying Yuto...


◆Synopsis
Yuuto Sumii and his wife Ayako moved to a rural village after getting married.
Contrary to the closed-off image often associated with rural areas, they were warmly welcomed by the villagers who surrounded them with a cheerful atmosphere.
Despite the inconveniences typical of the countryside, they were determined to build a happy life.

However...

In this village, there was something fundamentally deranged.
The "Onibarai" tradition.
A tradition where several young women from the village were selected to act as lovers with men dressed as demons.

Yuuto got entangled in it, and even his wife, Ayako...
Gradually, they were engulfed by madness, manipulated by the villagers.

Trapped by the dreaded tradition, can the two of them ever regain their peace...


◆Characters
・Ayako Sumii
"I want to spend my whole life in this village. Even until I become a grandmother."
Yuuto's wife Ayako is very kind and manages both household chores and farming work.
They have just recently married and are enjoying their newlywed life.
Due to Ayako's wish, they moved to the countryside, and Yuuto feels a slight sense of indebtedness as he adapts to the inconveniences typical of the countryside.

・Chinatsu Suzubayashi
"I've finally become accustomed to it. So please, just leave it be."
She has an outstanding figure, but she's a shy girl who struggles with social interactions having grown up in the village.
While tending to the village's general store, she met Yuuto when he came shopping.
She has been participating in the "Onibarai" since childhood and sees the tradition as perfectly normal.

・Misaki Toudou
"Wonderful... I wanted to be with a cool guy like Yuuto."
She has a straightforward personality, with her charming features being her blonde ponytail and smile.
She takes extreme actions in her desire to possess Yuuto exclusively.
She has an interest in the "Onibarai" and moved to the village before the protagonists did.

・Masuda
A resident of the same village who is a freeter. He participate in the "Onibarai day and night.
Acting on instincts, he tries to approach Ayako, whom he met for the first time.

・Kawayama
The village chief who oversees the "Onibarai". He pretends to be a kind elderly man with a forced smile.
But his true nature is the embodiment of desire. Under the guise of a ritual, he indulges with young women day and night in a cave.

・Yuuto Sumii
A city dweller who moved from the city to the countryside after marrying Ayako.
He initially found the ritual repulsive, but after participating himself, he lost his resistance to it.
data.short_description: The strange custom of "Onibarai" held in the village they moved to. The countryside life of the newlywed couple is infiltrated by the villagers' sinister intentions...!?

data.name: Deadroad Pickup
data.detailed_description:
The city fell on the first night. All you have is a pickup truck, a tank of fuel that never stays full, and a few terrified survivors in the back.

Drive. Scavenge. Survive the night.

Each run lasts 25–30 minutes. Loot the streets by day, plow through hordes after dark, survive the boss at the 20-minute mark, then race to the evac point and hold out until the helicopter lands.

Build wherever you park

Stop the truck and your crew climbs out to raise walls, turrets, mines and floodlights while you cover them. Manned guns, quick fortifications and base upgrades turn any street corner into a last stand.

Find the way out

Nobody tells you where the helicopter will land. Ask the survivors you rescue, or wait for the military broadcast between 15 and 20 minutes, then get there alive.

A crew that remembers

Every survivor has a name, a role and a voice. Lose them and they are gone for good. Level up your crew, unlock commander talents, craft gear and modify your vehicles between runs.

Features

  • Six-chapter story campaign: Escape the City, Farm Lights, Broken Bridge, Refinery, Black Forest, The Source
  • Endless mode and challenge mode
  • Day/night cycle and weather: after dark you only see what your headlights reveal
  • Rare premium cars, hot-wiring, sunroof gunners and desperate escapes on foot
  • 53 achievements
  • Interface, subtitles and crew voice acting in 14 languages

data.name: The Silence
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the dark depths of an abandoned hospital in The Silence, a thrilling single-player horror game. Alone and abandoned, you awaken in a gloomy corridor, surrounded by crumbling walls and an oppressive feeling of isolation. But the silence is deceptive because you are never truly alone. A sinister presence stalks you, watching your every move from the shadows.

In this intense but short horror game you will constantly feel uneasy and threatened. The darkness is omnipresent, the corridors are labyrinthine, and every room holds new horrors. The echo of your footsteps and the creature scratching on the cold ground are the only sounds that break the oppressive silence. Your heartbeat becomes the only beat that tells you that you are still alive - at least for now.

The atmosphere of "The Silence" is designed to push you to your psychological limits. The game creates a deep sense of unease as you frantically search for a way out. Your senses are overwhelmed and your fears are increased immeasurably. Every second in this hospital is a test of your nerves and sanity.

FEATURES

  • PERMANENT DEATH

  • MULTIPLE ENDINGS

  • REALISTIC GRAPHICS

  • JUMPSCARES

  • CREEPY ATMOSPHERE

  • HIDING SYSTEM

  • STORY

  • MONSTER AI

data.name: Contradiction: Spot The Liar
data.detailed_description:
64bit Mac Version

Please note: The Mac version is now 64-bit, so will work on all Mac OS platforms. Please note that this version currently doesn't support either Steam achievements or steam cloud saving. Unfortunately thanks to Apple we now can't update this version any further and it may be removed at some point from the store.


About the Game

Contradiction is a unique adventure / murder mystery game that uses live-action video for the entirety of the game play. All you have to do is interview characters, spot their lies and catch them out! Contradiction is a brand new take on the concept of an interactive movie and brings the genre to a whole new level of playability. It plays as smoothly as a 3D graphic game. You can wander freely around the game environment, collecting evidence and witnessing constantly changing events. But the game is all about interviewing the characters you meet, questioning them about all the evidence you’ve collected and things you’ve seen, then spotting contradictions in their answers. Pair two contradictions together and watch them try to worm out of it! Works best plugged into a TV preferably with a bunch of people to help spot the lies - but can be played alone on your laptop or PC just fine! The legacy version of the game with French subtitles by Pierre-Laurent Batut is also available for download on a Beta branch, again instructions are pinned to the top of the discussions forum.

data.name: Celestials Door
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Embark on a Mysterious journey in The Search of: Celestial's Door, an atmospheric slow burn game that plunges you into the heart of a chilling mystery.

Story

At the pinnacle of her television career, investigative journalist Dee Harris took a dangerous interest in a secretive cult known as Celestial's Door. Her sensational interview with their enigmatic leader captivated millions, but her curiosity got the best of her.

Ignoring all warnings, Dee ventured to the cult's eerie compound, determined to uncover their darkest secrets. The locals whispered of strange occurrences happening around the area. Now, Dee has gone missing, and the police have found no trace of her, in or around the area.

Desperate and driven by love, you step into the shoes of Dee's husband. Determined to face his fears as he seeks the truth behind her disappearance. Explore the haunting grounds, uncover hidden secrets, and confront the malevolence that lies within.

Features

  • Immersive Narrative

Experience a gripping, emotional storyline filled with suspense and unexpected twists.

  • Atmospheric Exploration

Begin your journey in the haunting woods, navigate through shadowy campsites, and explore multiple ominous buildings. Each step brings you closer to the foreboding temple at the heart of Celestial's Door.

  • Mechanic gameplay

Offers challenging and diverse gameplay mechanics. Players must solve puzzles, collect objects, and avoid the dangers in every corner, walking in circle.

  • Dynamic Soundtrack

A hauntingly beautiful score that heightens the tension and immerses you in the game's dark atmosphere.

data.name: Hard Life
data.detailed_description:
Surviving while reaching at the point


A mode where you try to go to the farthest point of the map by surviving.

Levels

We have added some sections so that the game has a purpose for now. You can access them by pressing the 'Play' button.

It is not very useful as the save system is not complete in the Sandox option, but we will fix it as soon as possible.

Game Mechanics


There are mechanics in the game such as building, crafting, chilling, collecting materials, speeding up time.

This game is a survival game. Even though there are zombies in the game, the biggest challenge is the cold-temperature balance. The SandBox mod of the game is under construction. Apart from that, there are 3 different sections. The goal is to reach the farthest corner of the map.

data.name: Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaira
data.detailed_description:
Explore and Face the Dangers of Nebegarde

The inhospitable open-air prison on the icy side of a distant planet, where the worst criminals are sent with their memories erased. Venture forth and immerse yourself in a dense plot filled with dilemmas and choices that will reveal the different faces of a reality previously unknown as you seek to understand the reason for your own exile.

Learn new attacks by facing challenging enemies

As a warrior, every battle is also an opportunity to learn. Observe how powerful enemies move, attack, and use their special abilities. By defeating them, you can absorb their techniques and transform them into new special attacks, adapted to your character’s combat style.

Forge Alliances

Develop relationships with various NPCs; depending on your decisions, some may join your adventure as companions. Switch control between them in real-time, accessing unique challenges and previously inaccessible areas.

Upgrade Your Gear

Use N'skita Crystals to imbue your equipment with special properties. Insert them into available sockets and witness the results—both in the attributes of your gear (damage type, defense, etc.) and in the visual effects seen in your attacks.

Face Unique Enemies

Challenge creatures ranging from native beings of a new planet to genetically modified creatures and even futuristic machines. Encounter creations inspired by mythological elements from various cultures and Brazilian folklore.

Survive

Gather and loot resources to be used in crafting recipes that can be completed with NPCs. If managed well, your results can bring advantages to your journey, including potions, food, and even equipment.

Master your Skills

Use a combat simulator to hone your abilities. A secret training capsule created so that exiles can secretly increase their chances of survival.

In this Capsule, we’ll have some extra game modes such as:

  • Wave Survival (solo)

  • Wave Survival (co-op – split screen)

  • PVP (split screen)

data.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Lullaby
data.detailed_description:
Step into the night as Zak Riley and Diane, mortal and Kindred, as their fates intertwine in an ominous plot involving a weakened Camarilla, the vampiric sect that wants to remain hidden, and a rising Sabbat, the fanatical group that sees humanity as cattle.

Meet dozens of characters, venture deep into the shadows and see the world through the eyes of both mortal and vampire, as you explore the Heartless Club.

Take your chances with the dice, face the consequences of your actions, and embrace the duality of Humanity and the Beast in this story rich cRPG set in the World of Darkness.

Covering just the prologue of the story, with well over an hour and a half of gameplay and several different endings, Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Lullaby was created in less than a month in celebration of the Vampire: The Masquerade Jam.

Features

- Use your vampiric Disciplines (powers) to influence the world. Either by supernatural strength, sinister charm or sheer cunning, take your place in vampire society.

- Semi-open locations with several ways to approach every situation. Leave no stone unturned.

- A detective story embedded in a personal horror setting: heed the call of the Beast, or cling to your Humanity.

- Experience the rule system of Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition like never before; a seamless transition between pen & paper and cRPG.

data.name: Proverbial
data.detailed_description:
“Imagine that a million monkeys have been trained to type at random on the keys of a typewriter… these volumes would contain the exact copy of the books of all kinds and all languages preserved in the richest libraries in the world.”

-Émile Borel, 1913

Welcome to Proverbial!

You just got hired as a monkey in a monkey office where you type on typewriters to spell words. As you progress you will hire monkeys to help you collect words. As you and your monkey underlings type words you gain points. Points can be spent on upgrades, items, and abilities. Words you find are worth more points depending on if it is your first time finding them and how long the words are. Words can also be a part of collections.

Collections

Collections have different categories. The categories are Themes, Quotes, Proverbs, Passages, and Hapax Legomenon. As you collect words you will fill out your collection book, when a collection is complete you will earn skill points. So you want to collect as many words from as many collections as possible. You might be wondering what a Hapax Legomenon is. Those are special words that only appear a single time in a work of literature. These are super rare words that are worth a large amount of skill points if you manage to complete one of their collections.

Upgrades

The upgrades in Proverbial range from increasing the number of keys each of your monkeys type per second to teaching your monkeys which letters often follow other letters. Anything to give you and your monkeys and advantage.

Items

As you progress through the game you will unlock the ability to purchase items. These grant you permanent bonuses to the amount of points you gain.

Abilities

There are multiple abilities that you can purchase and use whenever you see fit. These are very powerful and each of them can only be used so often. You can upgrade their potency, duration, and reduce their cooldown. These are very important for earning as many points as possible.

Minigames

Play minigames like Last Monkey, Hanging Monkey, Duominos, and more.

Workshop

Workshop support for custom words and collections.

data.name: Absent
data.detailed_description:
Absent is a story which follows the character of young-adult and college student, Murray Schull. He and his two best friends, Eve and Steve, attend a college in which students are disappearing daily. It’s up to them to find out how this is happening, why this is happening, protect their other friends, and to put a stop to it once and for all.

This series of events began when Crystal, a three month girlfriend of Murray’s friend, Steve, disappeared on her way home from college via mysterious means. Over the course of the investigation, however, Murray realizes that the abduction of Steve’s girlfriend was not from anything of this earth. Murray is haunted by visions of the past and future, confronted with puzzles, with friends turning against each other, and all for one reason. The Reaper.


Special Features

-A point/click, easy to use interface.
-Approximately twenty NPC's to interact with.
-Around forty playable rooms in the whole game.
-A completely original story with original art and characters created by James Fenton.
-A game so varied, I flipped a three sided coin to choose it's genre!
-Full Voice Acting, including the talents of Esme Brand, James Fenton, Shannon Hayes, Rebecca Hanssen and Matt Haynes.
-Full MP3 Soundtrack composed by Adam Haynes.
-It's completely free!

data.name: Hayaku! Island of Darkness
data.detailed_description:
Wishlist and follow HAYAKU!


About the Game

HAYAKU! is a retro metroidvania that combines interconnected exploration, fast-paced combat, and ability-driven platforming.

The game pays homage to classic titles from the 8-bit era.

Explore abandoned laboratories, overgrown cities, crystal mines, military strongholds, ancient forests and the last surviving human settlements. Download map data from forgotten terminals, reconnect the transport network and return to previously inaccessible places as you acquire new movement and combat abilities.
Dash through hazards, cling to walls, bounce from enemies, cross electrical networks and uncover shortcuts, hidden rooms and optional challenges.

Master a dynamic arsenal

Fight with three primary weapons, each built around a completely different playstyle:

  • Crimson Star: A versatile energy blade for fast, directional combat.

  • BeastBreaker: A heavy weapon capable of powerful strikes, launched attacks and devastating impact.

  • TurboDrill: A mechanical chain weapon used to attack, grapple and control space.

Weapons can reach three combat levels, gaining stronger attacks and changing their behavior as they grow. Maintaining that power is part of surviving the island.

A secondary weapon wheel provides even more options. Throw bouncing bombs, rapid daggers and more! These weapons consume crystals and can interact with your main attacks, enemies and the environment in unexpected ways.

Pilot and customize Power Armor

Board a combat-ready Power Armor with its own movement, health and weapon systems.

Mix cores, arms and legs from four distinct armor families to create your preferred machine. Equip shields, energy cannons, drills, chains, axes and rapid-fire weapons, then combine them with different mobility options such as gliding, hovering, aquatic movement and specialized dashes.

Every combination changes how the armor moves, fights and survives.

Help the island's survivors

The island is still inhabited. Meet travelers, engineers, scavengers, strange machines and communities struggling to endure outside Reikan's control.

Accept favors, follow leads and keep track of your discoveries through the Notes & Favors journal. Optional quests, forgotten recordings, photographs and pieces of Dr. Geno's research reveal stories that the island's rulers would rather keep buried.

Face dangerous enemies and cinematic bosses

Battle malfunctioning defense robots, Reikan soldiers and the anomalous creatures known as Tenebris.

Each region introduces its own enemies, environmental hazards and traversal challenges. Large-scale boss encounters combine demanding combat with elaborate pixel-art animation, dramatic camera work and powerful visual effects.

Uncover the truth behind Hayaki

Hayaki awakens inside the Forgotten Lab with no memory of who he is or how he got there. His only companion is SecSy, a sarcastic security AI contained inside a cat-shaped robotic mask.

A fragmented memory gives him a name: Yusuke, a soldier Hayaki believes to be his missing brother.

Their search leads across an island ruled by Reikan, an organization that promises protection while controlling its people, resources and history. As Hayaki learns more about the Tenebris and his own impossible abilities, the difference between monster, human and machine begins to disappear.

How deeply you confront the island's past will shape its future.

data.name: Madness within
data.detailed_description:
Chapter 1 - is a free chapter of Enelia: Dawn of Madness.

If you'd like to continue your journey we're planning to release it episodically ou our Early Access page!

Wishlist Chapter 2 on Steam





Enelia has dreamed of becoming a druid since childhood. In order to fulfill her dream she must defy the established Za'ani traditions. On the way to her goal, she learns a terrible secret that jeopardizes not only her own but also lives of her loved ones.

Game features
- Use Astral Vision to see what no one does.
- Make fateful choices and shape your own path.
- Build relationships with characters and creatures.
- Solve adventure style puzzles and mysteries.
- Collect lore in your diary.
- Reveal the truth about Madness.



In search of salvation, Enelia ventures into an uncharted world with unique natural phenomenas, mythical creatures, ancient secrets, and members of a dark cult. You will embark on a dangerous and mysterious journeywith Enelia and her pet Shio in order to gain the power of a druid and find cure for a mythical disease called madness.



During the path you will explore wonderous landscapes, meet various characters, make fateful choices, reveal ancient sanctuaries, uncover world secrets and solve puzzles.

Our inspirations include Avatar, Princess Mononoke, LOTR, World of Warcraft, One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen and many other!

data.name: Balaball
data.detailed_description:
"Balaball" is a rouge-like game based on physical collision and deck building. Experience the pleasure of constantly getting high scores in chaotic collisions. Find the strongest scoring combination in different situations, trigger crazy chains and high scores, constantly break through the original balance, and get new high scores step by step.

Collision brings both chaos and luck.

Game Features

Shoot the pinball to collide with various items in the scene and earn scores. Choose and deploy new items in each round, and constantly improve the diversity of the scene. Earn higher scores in chaos!

In each round, there is a chance to obtain BUFFs and upgrade items that would gradually break the original balance and find a new way to win.

Dominate a variety of situations. The game provides many levels and a variety of situations. Maybe you have found the winning strategy in the "fast food truck" level, but how will you deal with it in the "dungeon"? Many unique situations require you to find new combinations to build, try more strategies and ideas, and break the original records.

A variety of items and BUFFs. Ore generates jewels, eggs generate chicks, chicks may turn into fire dragons, and there are black holes that can swallow everything... Try a variety of different combinations to explore more possibilities!

"Balaball" provides you with endless playability and brings you unlimited fun!

data.name: Distorted world
data.detailed_description:
Distorted World – is an indie first-person shooter with horror elements. The action in this game takes place in a parallel reality. The main character, Oleg Antonov, is an operative of the secret department engaged in research on anomalous phenomena under the President of the Russian Federation. Together with his partner Eva, he is sent to investigate the nature of the energy surge in the Caucasian mountains, which was recorded by space reconnaissance. Upon arrival, they discover many oddities and an abandoned temple of unknown origin. Upon entering this temple, they discovered an interdimensional portal. Eve is ordered to go through this portal to another dimension. Oleg goes after her. Once on the other side, they see a world similar to their own, but with many oddities. In this world, there is a war between the human race and the alien race. After collecting intelligence, Eva sends Oleg in search of a portal that could return them home. While searching for the portal, he meets Sergei Zakharov, the head of the Human Resistance. Zakharov in all its glory describes the situation to Oleg and asks him to stay and help defeat the aliens. Oleg realizes that his world is next in line and agrees to help. Further, in the person of the main character you have to save your world and the remains of Zakharov's world.

Features

- An incredible journey through a world almost destroyed by aliens.
- Survival in a hostile environment where there are almost no normal people left.
- A beautiful and hostile world.
- Intense battles with insane. Collect gold and upgrade weapons.
- Full immersion in the atmosphere of Distorted World.

data.name: 7WORLDS: The Dreaming Dale
data.detailed_description:
This game is a 2D Pixel Adventure Platformer where you need some running and jumping skills to get through an amazing story shown nicely in a form of comic book pages!

This game is a challenge for speed runners! Gather your friends, check if they can beat your time!

This game is HARD!! :D

What to expect:

Beginning of a new adventure!

Awesome and climatic music!

3 Different Difficulties

EASY

For the beginners!

NORMAL

For the experianced!

IMPOSSIBLE

For all the psychos who do not fear to die thousands of times!

A hidden Speed Run Chamber where you can enter any stage of the game to check how good you are using a timer and death counter!

(You will need to quit the game once you enter the stage you want to speedrun and launch it again, because the counter starts with the game launch!)

Some Oopsies for this moment!

If the game runs at 1 Frame Per Second, plug in your controller and restart your game!

The game crashes on its first launch, but you're good to go after that! The game might crash after finishing multiple levels in one sitting, but don't worry, your progress is saved!

If you're using a gamepad controller, you need to use the keyboard & mouse to pause the game and move around the menu. The default and prefered controller is keyboard with mouse.

What's so special about this game?

7WORLDS: The Dreaming Dale is made with Platfinity! A Legacy engine which is sadly not available anymore for sale.

Don't hesitate to long! The Dreaming Dale is in danger and only Ronnie led by your decisions can save his beloved village!

If you want to be updated on what's going on with the game, please check my Facebook fanpage! I'm back at it and ready to finish this project! :D

data.name: Polygrounds
data.detailed_description:
Your Movement is a Weapon. Forget rigid, pixel-perfect top down shooters. Your ship operates on custom anisotropic friction—meaning it handles like a rally car on a slick neon track. Slide sideways through narrow corridors, drift around swarms of geometric foes, and use your articulated manual-aim barrel to blast targets while your momentum carries you out of danger. Tie this all in with a 45 degree tron style twist allowing you to "dash" and quickly change direction but don't waste them all, they need to charge.

Room-Locked Carnage There is no running backward to kite your enemies. As soon as you cross the threshold into an uncleared sector, the blast doors slam shut. You are trapped in a procedural, variable-scale arena with a randomized swarm. The doors only open when the room is quiet.

Draft a Cursed Arsenal Crack open hidden chests to draft from a massive pool of game-changing modifier cards. Equip a card that dumps ammo at double the rate but halves your impact, or sacrifice your top speed for armor that turns you into a sluggish dreadnought. Every Epic card forces you to completely rewrite your playstyle.

data.name: EMOTIONLESS : The Last Ticket
data.detailed_description:
EMOTIONLESS: The Last Ticket is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere and exploration. You are James Anderson, a son returning to the abandoned amusement park his missing father built.

Not everything you see is real, and not everyone you see is alive. Not everything in this world belongs to it. Venture into a surreal world inspired by liminal spaces and cosmic horror.

Search for clues, find audio logs and navigate a haunting narrative without immersion-breaking combat.

Paranormal activity or something ordinary seen from another plane of existence? Some events simply can’t be explained.

Get lost, find the right path, and then get lost again. Not every hallway in this twisted amusement park makes sense… Test your nerves and your sense of direction as paths change and corridors twist.

Why not take a moment to experience the amusement park’s attractions? Just don’t get too relaxed, who knows what awaits on these one-of-a-kind rides.

data.name: Hollow Heart
data.detailed_description:
Blasphemous Sister‑Obsessed Human Transmutation

Hollow Heart is a growth‑simulation game built on the theme of blasphemous, sister‑obsessed human transmutation. As the elder sister, you will do whatever you can to resurrect your beloved little sister who has died. Gather materials, strengthen her soul and body, and bring forth a sister who is ever more “perfect” and “complete.” At the end of this profane path, will you truly be able to reclaim the sister you once knew?

Human Transmutation

Your sister can be revived by offering a body and a sacrifice. To erase the sacrifice’s personality and anchor your sister’s soul, you must fuse different bodies together. Prepare stronger vessels and superior sacrifices to resurrect the ideal little sister.

Raising / Growth

After transmutation, your sister’s soul and body are fragile and short‑lived. Educate her, train her, and build a bond of trust as you face hardships together. If she reaches the end of her lifespan, use her remaining body as the foundation for the next transmutation.

Exploration / Combat

Venture out to gather the materials needed for transmutation and growth. Along the way, primitive creatures and humans bound by trivial notions of morality will stand in your path. Work together with your sister to overcome them and carve your way forward.

data.name: Brain Damage
data.detailed_description:
Brain Damage, a chaotic 2D action roguelite space adventure where power comes at a cost! As you obliterate wave after wave of relentless enemies, your upgrades not only boost your abilities, but also crank up the "brain damage"—increasing particles, font sizes, and camera shake!

Dive into an endless torrent of cosmic baddies, each more menacing than the last, and test your skills as the game becomes increasingly difficult to see. In this wild space ride, the more powerful you get, the harder it is to make sense of the mayhem on your screen.

But don't let the chaos deter you! After conquering each wave, you'll have the chance to upgrade your arsenal and abilities. Choose wisely, as every upgrade comes with a side of extra "brain damage."

So, buckle up for a space adventure that's equal parts thrilling, hilarious, and downright insane. Are you ready to embrace the chaos?

Features:
  • Fast-paced 2D action roguelite gameplay
  • Wave-based combat with challenging enemies
  • Rewarding yet risky upgrade system
  • Mind-bending visual effects that escalate with each power-up

data.name: Nonogram Animal Griddlers
data.detailed_description:
Nonogram Animal Griddlers, is a logical puzzle game, known as Nonograms, Picross or Griddlers.
These puzzles can be solved with the numbers on the side of the grid cells. These indicate a group of contiguous filled squares. Between the groups there is at least one empty square.
Completing these puzzles will form a picture. In this game all the puzzles will form images of all different kinds of animals.

The game is designed so you can solve puzzles as if you had a puzzle book.
You can take your time.
Play any puzzles, without having to unlock puzzles.
No punishment for errors or miss clicks.
The game automatically saves any change to the puzzles, making you able to quit and continue a puzzle anytime you want.

The puzzles are divided into 6 different packs, with a 1 to 6 star rating based on the size of the puzzles.
It’s best to begin with the smaller more easy puzzles, before starting on the bigger puzzles.

Features:
- 120 unique puzzles.
- All puzzles will form pictures of animals of all kinds.
- Relaxing classical music.
- Various puzzle sizes from 10x10 to 20x20.
- Logic puzzles without pencil and paper, but it plays exactly the same!
- Train you logical and abstract thought processes.

data.name: The InVincible Iron Ivy: Enter the Pretty, Pretty Princess
data.detailed_description:
Take to the role of The InVincible Iron Ivy ("Iron Ivy") in this Soulslike 3rd person role-playing game (“RPG”) who has superpowers that harness properties encompassing concepts of science called "Sci-fi Powers."



Iron Ivy’s powers are labeled as Geokinesis, which provides her with the ability to manipulate and control both the elements of earth and nature. This dynamic includes synthesizing lightning bolts, controlling and manipulating, moisture, and barometric/atmospheric pressure to form, and manipulating gases and liquids to cause chemical reactions.



Additionally, she uses this ability to manipulate ivy leaves to make her ivy board that provides her with flight. Finally, Iron Ivy has the ability to transmute plants into humanoid and animaloid ("animal-like") creatures like her A.I. companions Sunny, Snapper, and Lily.



You will unlock Iron Ivy's Sci-FI Powers by accumulating experience points (“XP”), deactivating enemy troopers, acquiring items and special attributes, rare tools; and the exploration and completing quests.

data.detailed_description:
(Please Read) About Playtest

What's Included

The playtest opens in early development with 3 playable characters in total, and will be kept on until the final release. There will be more characters added later on, and an announcement will be made when a new character is ready for some testing. The "new game mode" stated in the game's description section is not included.

Invite Friends

Before using the Private Invite functionality, you would need to have some friends on Steam who are also in this Playtest. Once your access is granted, you should see the option to invite up to 2 friends while viewing the game from your library.

Feedback

You're welcomed to provide feedback or bug report through any publicly available method of contact. However, social media is not the best place since they're not being monitored. The preferred method would be the discussion board.

Thank you for your support and have fun!


About the Game

The committee has spread the words - regardless of your background, the Fighting Pageant welcomes everyone from the city of Navalia. The pageants embody the Empire's martial spirits deeply rooted in its traditions. The only rule the participants should follow is to respect and appreciate each other's fighting prowess.

You, the player, will participate in the Fighting Pageant as one of the residents of Navalia in this card battler. Master the unique turn system based on time frames - calculate your risks, and exploit your opponent's hasty decisions. Explore a range of playable fighters with distinctive play styles, each of whom has their own unique move set and mechanics.

data.name: A Quiver of Crows
data.detailed_description:
A difficult twin-stick shmup set in a grim world cursed by demons and ghouls.

Frantic Battles in a Grim World

  • Unlike most shmups, this world is made up of flesh, bones, and dirt instead of the common rigid objects such as ships set in space.
  • Each enemy type has a unique set of behaviors.
  • Most foes do not follow preset patterns. Instead, they try to hunt you down.
  • Some enemies fly in close for melee combat. Others will shoot from a far away range.

Co-op Twin-Stick Action

  • The game blends the insanity of shmups with the free range of motion of twin-stick shooters.
  • Find a friend. Find a couch. Have tons of fun with the optional single-screen couch co-op!

Upgradeable Weapons, Bombs, and Shields

  • Collect and enhance a variety of weapons. Influenced by traditional shmups, watch as your weapons’ firing trajectory and pattern change with each upgrade.
  • From heat seeking quills to things that go BOOM, collect them all and use them to crush your foes!
  • Upgrade your shields to withstand relentless attacks.

Play on Windows, Mac, & Linux

  • Best played with a twin-stick controller. Steer with the left stick, aim with the right.
  • Never fear! You can also use your keyboard and mouse.

data.name: MACE: Mapinguari's Temple
data.detailed_description:
Play with up to 10 players online, venture deep into the Mapinguari's Temple and collect all three hidden artifacts to ensure a successful expedition! Be careful, however, for not only a dreaded monster roams the Temple's corridors but also an amalgam of deadly traps and a deceitful cultist, disguised between you.


Explorers:
  • Win by collecting all the three idols hidden inside the dungeon.
  • Talk to nearby players (or using the radio) to coordinate the exploration.
  • Find the lost gun so the bodyguard isn't alone defending you comrades, and do it before the cultist finds it first.
  • move items around, such as keys or barrels, and solve the puzzles scattered throughout the dungeon.


Cultist:
  • Summon the Mapinguari so it may hunt down your enemies (be careful, he may kill you as well).
  • Be the last one alive to win the game!
  • Use tricks such as turning off all the lights, blocking paths with objects, or stealing and hiding the idols!!
  • Find the lost gun to slow down or even kill the other players.
  • Travel the dungeon quickly through secret passages only you can access.


Bodyguard:
  • Be the judge, jury and executioner, as only you starts the game with a gun.
  • Be careful, for everyone knows who the bodyguard is.
  • Protect the explorers and hunt down the cultist.
  • Slow down the monster with your bullets.


MACE: Mapinguari's Temple is a game where you can:
  • Talk in-game with other players, either by proximity or usign the radio function.
  • Customize your experience: not up for a competitive game? Play without a cultist and transform the game into a group horror game.
  • Choose a character to play and customize it by changing it's colors!
  • Play with accessibility features, such as high contrast.
  • Find any match quickly by searching the server list!

data.name: Jetpack Mosaic: Fly & Build Together
data.detailed_description:
Every Masterpiece Starts with a Single Tile and a Jetpack

Jetpack Mosaic: Fly & Build Together is a massive, cozy co-op puzzle sandbox where art takes flight. Strap into your jetpack, collect colored tiles from the depot, and take to the skies to fit every piece into a colossal, living mosaic. Play solo for a relaxing session, or drop into huge community lobbies to assemble art together in real time.

Massive 100-Player Co-Op

Building a tiny picture is fun; building a colossal canvas with an entire sky full of players is an event.

  • Up to 100 Players Per Puzzle:Hop into public lobbies or host private builds with friends.

  • Divide and Conquer: Assign colors, tackle distinct corners, or coordinate aerial bucket brigades to carry tiles across the canvas.

  • Zero Stress, Pure Satisfaction: A collaborative, grief-free sandbox where every single placed piece helps the community finish the big picture. 

Upgrade Your Flight & Carry Capacity

  • Bigger Backpacks: Upgrade your inventory to haul multiple tiles in a single flight run.

  • Jetpack Tuning: Boost your top speed, acceleration, and fuel efficiency to reach higher corners effortlessly.

  • Cosmetic Trails & Suits: Customize your flyer with colorful smoke plumes, helmets, and jetpack styles.

Draw It. Build It. Share It.

Never run out of canvases to solve. Use the built-in pixel editor to turn your own artwork into playable puzzles.

  • Custom Drawing Tools: Draw pixel art directly in-game or import designs to generate fresh puzzle maps.

  • Community Workshop: Publish your puzzles for the world to solve, or fly into community-crafted creations ranging from mini badges to multi-thousand-tile behemoths.

data.name: Dead Reckoning: Reborn
data.detailed_description:
The world has fallen. Civilization is gone.

You are reborn into a zombie-infested wasteland, carrying memories of your past life. This time, every choice you make will shape a different outcome.

In a world stripped of order and resources, survival is not just about fighting the undead — it's about navigating trust, betrayal, and the limits of human morality.

Gameplay

QTE — React or Die At critical moments, respond fast — evade, fight back, or escape. Your success or failure directly determines whether you live and how the story unfolds.

Dark Exploration & Reconnaissance Use tools like night vision devices to scan ruined environments and detect hidden threats. Decide whether to fight, hide, or slip away unnoticed.

Explore, Gather & Solve Search abandoned locations for resources and clues. Solve environmental puzzles to reconstruct events and push the story forward.

Moral Choices That Shape Your Story In the most desperate moments, you must decide. Save her or leave? Take by force or negotiate? Every choice reshapes relationships and alters what comes next.

Branching Narrative & Multiple Endings

The game features a multi-branch narrative powered by a built-in Story Tree system that tracks every decision you make. Each choice can redirect the story — leading to vastly different outcomes and endings.

Style & Experience

A grounded post-apocalyptic world, told through cinematic immersive storytelling. Every moment is shaped by tension, survival pressure, and emotional weight.

data.name: Tri6: Infinite
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the Tri6 cyberspace, avoid procedurally distributed obstacles and beat the evil Virus enemies as long as possible to reach the top of the global leaderboards! Play locally in up to 4-player multiplayer and make life difficult for your friends using different powerups from missiles and mines to boosts and jumps.


  • 3 playable vehicles with different steering characteristics
  • 11 unlockable powerups
  • More than 300 obstacle variations
  • Global leaderboards per vehicle across all supported platforms
  • Up to 4 players splitscreen support


More than 300 obstacle variations that are randomly distributed and get harder with every lap will lead to endless variations of the track. And be careful, not every obstacle is just static! There are also Virus vehicles driving along the track with you, trying to put an end to your existence.


While playing you will collect electrons that unlock new powerups. The powerups will allow you to survive longer and defeat the Virus constructs. They are grouped in active ones that are reusable (e.g. missiles) and passive ones that are consumable (e.g. shield).















Play together with up to three friends on one PC. Drive the track, avoid obstacles and survive longer than your friends. Of course you can use all your powerups against them to decrease their three lives down to zero.

data.name: Antropico: Colonies
data.detailed_description:
Antropico: Colonies is a large-scale space strategy game about building power inside a living galaxy.

You begin with a single foothold: an outpost on a hostile world. From there you expand across planets, infrastructure and institutions, shaping not only what you control, but how your authority works.

This is not a purely abstract map. You build real structures on real worlds. Placement, geography and access matter, and long-term development is never guaranteed.

There is no scripted ending and no forced victory condition. You play for survival, dominance or stability on your own terms, inside a galaxy that does not revolve around you.

Before you start, you can decide how old the galaxy already is. The world can begin as a young frontier, or as a space shaped by centuries of prior expansion, collapse, migration and conflict.

Some worlds can be changed over time. Most cannot. Fully habitable planets are rare, and when you secure one, it rewrites the scale of what your authority can become.

Power in Antropico is not only measured in territory. It is measured in legitimacy and control.

You define how your authority operates: what is allowed, what is enforced, what is tolerated. Your political structure shapes daily life across worlds, and worlds respond.

Choose the direction of your system: corporate freedom or state planning, rigid security or permissive civil rights, centralized command or distributed autonomy. These choices affect loyalty, unrest, productivity, diplomatic standing and the stability of your internal order.

Politics is not a decorative layer. It is pressure. The rules you set decide which parts of your empire hold and which parts begin to fracture.

Your economy is built from real constraints: energy, consumer supply, heavy industry, services and the logistics that keeps them connected.

You do not unlock prosperity. You construct it. You decide whether to spread outward, consolidate density, or specialize into a clear identity. A compact industrial core. A network of outposts. A self-contained agricultural world. A trade-centered hub.

Specialization creates efficiency, but also dependency. If one world feeds another, the link matters. If you rely on imports, access matters. When supply breaks, the effects are not cosmetic: shortages create unrest, markets tighten, production stalls and political stability is tested.

A strong economy is not just output. It is resilience under pressure.

You are not alone. Other powers exist, and they have their own interests, thresholds and fears.

Diplomacy is access: to markets, legitimacy, protection and time. Treaties can stabilize your growth or trap you in dependence. Blocs can provide safety or force you into rules you did not write.

Aggression, instability and ideological choices trigger reactions. Condemnations, restrictions, sanctions, escalating isolation. Smaller powers may follow dominant blocs. Others will exploit cracks for profit.

Diplomacy is leverage. But leverage cuts both ways.

Force is expensive. It should feel expensive.

Fleets are not decorative counters. Ships require industry, logistics, upkeep and long-term commitment. Losses leave scars, not only in firepower, but in the economy that supports it.

War is never clean. Raids can disrupt trade. Blockades can starve entire supply networks. Invasions can win territory while breaking the system that made it valuable. Even victory can cost years of recovery, and defeat can reshape your authority into something smaller, harsher or forced to move.

If you escalate, you do it knowing the consequence: markets react, alliances shift, internal stability tightens and future options narrow.

A multi-world authority cannot be managed by willpower alone. It needs structure.

You can rule from the center and accept fragility. Or you can delegate: governors, administrators, private entities, regional authorities. Delegation reduces micromanagement and keeps expansion viable.

But delegation creates internal politics. Local power accumulates. Interests diverge. Competence varies. Some leaders stabilize your empire. Some become liabilities. Some become threats.

Territory is not just land. It is institutions, influence and people who believe they deserve more.

The world runs. It does not pause to ask permission.

Populations grow, consume and react. Corporations pursue profit. Markets respond to scarcity and oversupply. Trade moves between planets and stations. Pressure builds where systems are weak.

The simulation is not there to drown you in noise. It exists to make choices matter over time. When you build, the system changes. When you break something, it stays broken until you fix it. When you rely on fragile chains, you feel the tension.

The galaxy can begin with a history. It can already contain old borders, forgotten catastrophes, rising powers and decayed worlds. What you discover depends on how much time you allow the universe to live before you arrive.

Populations grow, consume and react. Corporations pursue profit. Markets respond to scarcity and oversupply. Trade moves between planets and stations. Pressure builds where systems are weak.

The simulation is not there to drown you in noise. It exists to make choices matter over time. When you build, the system changes. When you break something, it stays broken until you fix it. When you rely on fragile chains, you feel the tension.

The galaxy can begin with a history. It can already contain old borders, forgotten catastrophes, rising powers and decayed worlds. What you discover depends on how much time you allow the universe to live before you arrive.

data.name: Dragon's Hoard
data.detailed_description:
Grow Big or Go Home!

Hunt down dangerous enemies and hoard loot to help your pet dragon grow. Once fully matured, take to the skies and ride your dragon to guide it back home! Go solo or join others in this Online Multiplayer Action-Adventure game.

Multiplayer Madness

Sometimes it's scary to go alone, but be careful what you wish for. Difficulty scales with the number of players so nothing will ever feel too easy. Have your friends, frenemies, or complete strangers join in and take on the hordes of monsters together. There is no limit to the amount of players that can join in.

Choose your Adventure

Kill mindlessly or help the residents. While fetch quests and tracking hunts are the basic asks from the locals, you can explore the world to discover additional quests and hidden secrets.






Dragons Hoard

Dragon's Hoard is a Peer-to-Peer Online Multiplayer 3rd-person Action-Adventure Game about helping your adopted Dragon get to their home in the sky.
Use the weapons and equipment you loot, to hoard your way to a fortune.
You'll need all the loot you can find, because in this world a Dragon doesn't get bigger with age but with the size of its hoard!

My Mission

  • No NFTs
  • No Block Chain
  • No Pay to win
  • No microtransactions
  • Just a box price and a game.



Unlimited Multiplayer

Difficulty will scale with number of players.
The only limit to how many players will be the host (The game may be stable with 2 players but no limit will be set).
Current test was 18 people with no signs of performance loss. (I need more friends join the discord for testing!).



Quest

Explore the world and discover Quests and hidden secrets,
Some quests are simple kill quests or go to location quests,
Others are secret and must be discovered.



Dungeons

Explore dungeons and Fight bosses.
There are many unique Bosses each with their own mechanics.



Loot

Lets be honest its what we're all here for
There's the common, rare, epic and legendary loot.
Each with different Statistics for your style of play.



Mount

Ride your Dragon if your hoard is big enough!
Once you reach the required Hoard size youll be able to ride your dragon into the sky where a secret awaits.

data.name: The Cooking Game VR
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to "The Cooking Game VR," the ultimate gastronomic battleground where your culinary skills are put to the ultimate test. In this immersive, virtual reality game, you'll step into two incredibly themed restaurants: a bustling fast food joint and an authentic Italian pizzeria.

Prepare to serve a mouth-watering array of dishes from sizzling hotdogs, juicy burgers, crispy fries & fizzy sodas to baking perfect pizzas in a traditional oven, creating creamy risottos, and serving up some of Italy's finest wines and cheeses.


But it's more than just cooking! You'll have to compete in a "Battle of the Chef," where you'll go against a formidable AI in a race against time to serve a line of hungry customers. Or you could challenge your online friends in an adrenaline-pumping PvP mode.

Be prepared to manage chaotic situations like kitchen fires, pesky spiders, and mischievous pigeons trying to steal your food. Your ability to keep your cool under pressure will truly be tested!


The fun doesn't stop there. As you complete missions, you'll earn coins that can be used to upgrade your kitchen items. Spatulas, pans, ovens, and more can be enhanced to help you keep up with the increasing pace and demands of your customers.

With a multitude of levels, each with its own unique goals, you'll be cooking, serving, and battling your way to the top of the culinary world. It's time to don your chef's hat, sharpen your knives, and get ready for the most exciting cooking experience in VR

data.name: Decopins -Asset Fighters Series-
data.detailed_description:
"Decopin" is a traditional Japanese "Flick" action to express friendliness.

Flick, flick, flick... Click, click, click... Decopins is a tower defense like game with simple action. Don't let Donuts escape from your donuts shop by clicking and Magic. 20 stages, Hell/Death mode and bonus stage. Level up your Decopin skill and make full use of MAGIC.

Don't think difficult. Just clicking and clicking Donuts!!

*"Decopin" means Flick or Click in Japanese.

*Don't do Decopin or use Magic in real world, thankyou.

*Gamepad(XInput), Mouse and Keyboard controls are supported.

*Mouse aiming is more confortable.

*Decopins2 will be launched on Jan, 2024.

data.name: Illvelo Swamp
data.detailed_description:
—Enter the Swamp

Multiple goals. Multiple routes. Multiple endings.

Complete Orders (missions) to unlock new paths in a branching stage layout.

As soon as you dip your toes in, you'll find yourself sucked deeper and deeper into this bottomless quagmire of a shmup.

100 stages. Over 1,000 Orders.

Get lost in a hundred-stage maze, carving out your own path to the goal.

Complete over a thousand Orders to expand branching routes and unlock new stages.

Push beyond the depths to reach the true ending.

Double the fun with twin-stick action.

Your machine is equipped with a devastating weapon: the "Dolls."

Detach them from your ship and aim them freely to unleash precise, powerful attacks.

You also have a variety of unique special attacks along with the Megalophaz, a high-damage bomb.

Unravel the mystery of disappearing players.

Lusie spends her days shut in her room, playing her favorite online game.

One day, rumors begin to spread about players disappearing—both online and in real life.

To make matters worse, her partner AI called Cheep'O develops a malfunction that corrupts her linguistic programming.

As they search for answers, Lusie and Cheep'O find themselves drawn closer to a hidden conspiracy, one lurking beneath the game... and the real world, too.

data.name: 愛する妻の穴は他人の穴だった…… ～美尻を差しだし、兄貴の肉棒をおねだりする淫ら妻～
data.detailed_description:
//----------------------------

◇あらすじ


主人公・篠宮宏明は、先日結婚したばかりの新妻・柚香とラブラブな新婚生活を送っていた。
そんなある日、海外でフリーライターをしている兄・隆一から 一ヵ月ほど帰国するという連絡があった。
そこで、家を借りるのもなんなので、ひと月程度なら自分の家に住んだらどうだと提案する宏明。

こうして主人公・ヒロイン・兄の、三人での暮らしが始まっていく。
それが、すべての悪夢の始まりとも知らぬまま……


//----------------------------

◇ヒロイン

//----------------------------

篠原 柚香　CV：小波渡陸

　可愛い顔の割にナイスバディな肉体を持つ無邪気な奥さん。
　かつては主人公と同じ会社に勤めており、その縁で主人公と付き合い、結婚することになる。

　また会社の仕事繋がりで隆一とも宏明との結婚前から面識がある。
　隆一の書く記事の密かなファンだったりする。

//----------------------------

◇寝取り男

//----------------------------

篠原 隆一

　海外を飛び回るフリーライター。
　弟とは対照的に気さくな性格で、誰とでもすぐに仲良くなれる。

　やや遊び人の傾向があり、それが後に悲劇を生むことに……。

//----------------------------

◆主人公

//----------------------------

篠原 宏明

　ごく普通のまじめなサラリーマン。
　少し前に柚香と結婚したばかり。

　新居を構え柚香と幸せな新婚生活を送っていたが、
　海外から戻ってきた兄とひょんなことから同居生活を始めることになる。

//----------------------------

ゲームについて


//----------------------------
シングルプレイ
クリックで読み進めるノベルゲーム
選択式ビジュアルノベル

data.name: Zui's Witch Academy
data.detailed_description:
Zui's Witch Academy is a boss rush roguelike-styled action game. You build a deck of 3 magical cards to take down one of many bosses. Each boss has an arena specifically tailored to them. Can you help Rysa graduate from Zui's Witch Academy with flying colors?

This game was originally made for the Boss Rush 2025 Game Jam!

Features

  • 18 unique cards to collect and build your deck with!

  • 3 difficulties to attempt and conquer, I doubt you can beat impossible mode (no like seriously, give up).

  • Practice and master against every boss in training mode.

  • 8 bosses each with their own arena specifically designed around them.

  • An energetic and fun soundtrack! Complemented by a charming modern pixel-art aesthetic.

What are you waiting for?

The game is free! Download it and play it now! Rysa is waitin' for you to wake her up, how else is she going to graduate from Zui's Witch Academy?

data.name: Suzerain
data.detailed_description:
Dive into Suzerain with the Expanded Edition


Purchase the Kingdom of Rizia DLC!


Embark on a royal journey in Suzerain's first DLC. Embrace the crown as King Romus Toras, and lead the Golden Kingdom to a new era. Reclaim lost territories through diplomacy or force. Engage with noble houses and oversee the resources of Rizia. How will you reign?


About the Game

Embark on a thrilling story as President Anton Rayne, steering Sordland through a pivotal time. Confront potential border conflicts, deep-seated corruption, and economic turmoil while navigating complex political dynamics in Anton's first term. As the leader, your choices will shape Sordland's destiny.

  • Gripping Story: Traverse a 1 Million+-word branching political saga packed with deep and layered conversations.

  • Choices with Impact: Make critical decisions on security, economy, welfare, and diplomacy. Your values will be tested beyond the confines of your office.

  • Your Legacy: Drive Sordland towards one of 9 unique major endings and more than 25 sub-endings. What will your legacy be?

  • Grand Cast: Engage with a diverse cast of more than 50 characters, each with unique personalities and ideologies.

  • Duty vs. Personal Values: Witness how your presidential decisions influence the country but also your family and relationships.

  • Stay Informed: Keep tabs on the state of affairs through country or interactable city tokens, policies, situations, news and reports. See the impact and result of your actions.

  • Discover the Suzerain Universe: Read about newly introduced nations, codex articles about history, and feel the pulse of the world events.

Emerging from the vestiges of a traditionalist regime and wrestling with a challenging transition to economic liberalization amidst a recession, the populace of Sordland craves democratic reform. Economic uncertainty casts a long shadow as the political landscape transmutes, with rival superpowers casting keen, watchful eyes on the unfolding scene.

Stepping into this maelstrom, you, as President Rayne, must forge effective policies alongside your Cabinet and influential figures. Balance the precarious scales of politics by retaining loyal allies, gauging your values against political necessities, and steeling yourself against potential adversaries. Remember, each character in this narrative carries unique ambitions, fueling the complexity of the political landscape.

As the drama unfolds, the delicate equilibrium between your duty to the nation and commitments to your family will be put to the test - a balancing act that challenges the essence of leadership. Can you hold the reins of presidency successfully while being a good parent?

Best of luck, President Rayne - Sordland awaits your leadership.

data.reviews:
“Through a combination of a choose-your-own-adventure-style visual novel and a Paradox-esque game, you have to pull the young republic out of a terrible recession while dealing with entrenched, corrupt political factions and a looming border conflict.”
- PC Gamer

“The press will lie. Parliament will ask you to sign bills with misleading titles. The people will inspire a song called "My Electorate Are Stupid Pigs". Your principles may be your strongest weapon or your downfall. This is politics. This is Suzerain.”
- Rock Paper Shotgun

“The nuanced dilemmas it presents, set against a detailed and convincing backdrop of mid-20th century history in a fictional world, make it one of the most fascinating political strategy games of the past several years.”
- VICE

data.name: Adventures of Isabelle Fine: Murder on Rails
data.detailed_description:
Izzy gets a facelift!!!

Isabelle Fine released with a very simple and over-simplified art style. Although it was charming in a way, it just wasn't getting the job done, so it's time to give old Izzy a facelift.


We've revved the art on almost every aspect of the game to create a look that's much more appealing and much cleaner and easy to read. Even with these pretty major changes, Izzy's personality shines right on through.

Thanks to everyone for the support, we look forward to further fine tuning on Isabelle and development of her next adventure.


About the Game

Isabelle Fine; a space faring, time traveling, dimension jumping smart mouth is off on her first adventure. First, "documented," adventure at least, she's had a ton of adventures up until now. This new adventure should be just like any other, save some lives, save the universe. Simple, but things don't quite go as planned. Do they ever?

An evil that Isabelle has never encountered finds her and attempts to stop her, capture her and worse. Isabelle and her partner Conway have their work cut out for them as they unravel the mystery of these nasty creatures, save some lives and maybe the universe.

Gameplay

Adventures of Isabelle Fine: Murder on Rails is focused heavily on story, characters, classic adventure mechanics and some simple puzzle solving. Sometimes charming, sometimes absurd, sometimes funny and always a little weird.

Secret Forest Games

Secret Forest Games was formed early in 2019. It's the cliche story of a crotchety old game developer (really, I'm almost 42 :) ) who found himself without a job and is trying to strike out on his own. We needed Isabelle to prove to ourselves that we could take a game from start to finish as a solo indie. We're proud of Isabelle and it's reception so far, and are excited to bring you more titles in the future.

data.name: COLLECTION of SaGa FINAL FANTASY LEGEND
data.detailed_description:
Experience the origins of the SaGa series with the COLLECTION of SaGa FINAL FANTASY LEGEND, the first complete port of these hugely popular titles.

This collection includes new enhancements like high-speed mode, and the ability to switch between a vertical or horizontal screen layout.

Enjoy the the three original Game Boy titles SaGa, SaGa 2 and SaGa 3 (released as THE FINAL FANTASY LEGEND, FINAL FANTASY LEGEND II and FINAL FANTASY LEGEND III in North America) in one package!

Titles Included

THE FINAL FANTASY LEGEND
The memorable first instalment of the SaGa series, which sold over a million units.
Choose from the human, mutant or monster classes for the protagonist, and enjoy the special progression system which comes with each class - including the notable monster progression system, which was ground-breaking at the time.
With an eye fixed firmly on Paradise at the top of the tower, the protagonist fights strong enemies awaiting them in a diverse world, as they continue their journey towards the top of the tower.

FINAL FANTASY LEGEND II
The second instalment of the series, which gained popularity through its refined gameplay system and journey through a diverse world.
Experience the refined and improved gameplay with a new class, Robot, and appearances from guest characters.
The adventure unfolds surrounding the relics of the gods – MAGI.

FINAL FANTASY LEGEND III
A unique story which travels across time and features the first levelling system in the series.
Featuring six classes to choose from, as well as the ability to transform into different classes.
An adventure which spans the past, present and future unfolds with Talon, a fighter aircraft which can dash through time.

KEY FEATURES

  • High Speed Mode: Change your movement speed and the message speed to high-speed.
  • Screen settings: Freely switch the screen resolution and display settings between “horizontal” or “vertical” mode. 4K resolution is also supported.
  • Switch languages: Switch between Japanese and English.
Switch to Japanese and play SaGa, SaGa 2 and SaGa 3, the versions of the games released outside of Japan.
---------------------------------------------
*These titles have largely been faithfully replicated in their original forms, but several changes have been made to meet evolving cultural and social norms.

data.name: Queen,Don't be afraid
data.detailed_description:
In this game, you play as the Queen of the Insectoid race, instead of being a righteous messenger. Your objective is to create intricate mazes underground in the city to resist the human soldiers who come to vanquish you! From thugs to mechanical warriors, they possess a wide range of classes, but fear not, for the Queen is undaunted! You will cultivate a mighty army of insects to withstand the invaders.

Build Your Own Maze

Freely excavate mazes to confuse the human soldiers in their pursuit of you, and have them fall prey to your monsters.

Ecosystem

Your minions are true insectoid creatures. They not only kill enemies but also prey on their own kind, nurturing your ecosystem and allowing it to thrive sustainably.

Monster Evolution

Choose to enhance your favorite monsters, making them more powerful, and cultivate armies with characteristics that align with your preferences.

Diverse Array of Enemies

At first, your enemies may be thugs, but soon you will face soldiers, bounty hunters, and even mechanical warriors...

data.name: Moonchild
data.detailed_description:
Moonchild is a turn-based RPG set in 2000s America, with a strong emphasis on strategizing and combining abilities and passive buffs.

In the year 200X, trouble is brewing- the Moon is on a collision course with Earth, and only three kids and a teenager can stop it!

Thus begins the epic quest of Max, Sophie, Thomas, and Diva (don't ask her real name) as they try to stop total catastrophe in Frankland, USA!

Oh, and this kid named Benedict is trying to stop them. Don't pay any attention to him, he's a real jerk.

FEATURES:

-Over 170 abilities and passive buffs to play around with. Try to make the most busted strategies you can, and send the enemies back to space!

-Nightmarish dream sequences. The Moon is always watching...

-Expertly composed original soundtrack featuring only stock MIDI instruments! (mostly.)

-Immensely detailed environments filled with sight gags and flavor text galore! Frankland, USA is a fun place!

-Plenty of pop culture references and surreal humor!

-You can beat up the incarnation of every childhood bully you've ever had! UNLEASH YOUR INNER RAGE!!

-Adorable childhood antics wrapped around heartfelt emotion!

-Created mostly by one guy.

data.name: Plucked Up
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Kitchen... Now Watch Out for Cars! Plucked Up: Duck Dash takes the frantic, relationship testing chaos of co-op cooking games and throws it straight into oncoming traffic. You and up to three friends are in charge of running the most unhinged food service in town. But cooking the perfect meal is only half the battle.

Dine In or Dash Chop, fry, and plate up orders as fast as you can. You will have to constantly divide your attention, juggling impatient sit in customers right there in the dining room while boxing up to go orders for the neighborhood. Coordinate with your team to keep the kitchen from catching fire, because the clock is always ticking.

Dodge Traffic, Deliver Food Once the delivery is boxed up, you have to physically get it to the customer. Your biggest threat isn't a kitchen fire it's the streets. Dodge speeding cars, trip over your friends' wobbly physics, and do whatever it takes to get the meal dropped off before it gets ruined or you get flattened.

Risk It All Made it through the shift with a pocket full of tips? Take it straight to the slot machine. Risk your hard earned delivery money for a massive payout to upgrade your crew, or accidentally lose the entire day's profits in seconds.

Key Features:

  • Physics Based Nonsense: Unpredictable character physics mean every kitchen shift and delivery run is a hilarious disaster waiting to happen.

  • Multitasking Madness: Balance serving high maintenance sit in customers while simultaneously running deliveries across the map.

data.name: How to Build a Flying City
data.detailed_description:
Dissatisfied with the taxes the empire is imposing, Miru, the mayor of Tisryle, activates the engines beneath her city and takes to the skies! Not wanting other cities to follow her example, the council that rules the empire immediately sends their armies to destroy Tisryle. Miru must build her forces, recruit new allies, and most importantly, make a whole ton of money if she wants to stand a chance.

As the acting mayor of Tisryle, it is your job to manage the city's resources. You can purchase and upgrade items, build up industry, and much more. You are also in charge of defending the city. As enemies approach, you will choose a line-up of fighters, equip them with your best weapons, and send them out to fight. From common bandits to imperial goons, can you defeat all those who would take away your freedoms?

Gripping Storyline

There's more than just building a flying city. Dive into the interactions between characters and personally experience the twists and turns in this gripping story.

Combinations Galore!

With over a hundred weapons and items and over fifteen characters, each with their own unique active and passive skills, you can create your dream team by exploring all the combinations you can find!
