data.name: Purr Box
data.detailed_description:
A little box, plenty of purrs and a cozy corner to call your own.

In Purr Box, every new kitten brings more life to a cozy little pixel art room. Click the box, collect purrs, welcome new friends and turn little moments of affection into a collection full of whiskers.

MORE PAWS, MORE LOVE

From Ginger to Rainbow Cloud, discover kittens of different breeds and rarities. Pet them, answer their requests for playtime and treats, and join in at snack time. With every little heart, your feline family keeps growing.

Spend your purrs in the shop to unlock upgrades, boost production and welcome even more kittens. When it's time for the Big Nap, start again with Golden Yarn Balls and bonuses to continue your journey.

CUTE COMPANY FOR YOUR DAY

In pet mode, your kittens wander around your desktop while you study, work or go about your day. The little box stays close by, with access to the shop, minigames and your memories.

Want to plan a focus session? The Pomodoro timer keeps you company through periods of concentration and rest, with a little meow to remind you to take a break.

A BREAK TO PLAY

Find matching pairs in the memory game, jump over obstacles in Ginger's Run or uncover safe squares in Cat Sweeper. Three ways to spend a little more time with your companions, both in the room and in pet mode.

LITTLE MOMENTS, BIG MEMORIES

Complete diary tasks, discover new breeds and unlock photos to fill your album. Each memory tells a little piece of your story with the kittens, and a few surprises are waiting to be found.

YOUR CORNER, YOUR PACE

Care for your collection in short sessions or stay a little longer to watch your purrs grow. Once passive production is unlocked, your kittens also collect purrs while the game is closed, up to the offline progress limit.

Open the little box. A new friend is waiting for you.

From Ginger to Rainbow Cloud, discover kittens of different breeds and rarities. Pet them, answer their requests for playtime and treats, and join in at snack time. With every little heart, your feline family keeps growing.

Spend your purrs in the shop to unlock upgrades, boost production and welcome even more kittens. When it's time for the Big Nap, start again with Golden Yarn Balls and bonuses to continue your journey.

CUTE COMPANY FOR YOUR DAY

In pet mode, your kittens wander around your desktop while you study, work or go about your day. The little box stays close by, with access to the shop, minigames and your memories.

Want to plan a focus session? The Pomodoro timer keeps you company through periods of concentration and rest, with a little meow to remind you to take a break.

A BREAK TO PLAY

Find matching pairs in the memory game, jump over obstacles in Ginger's Run or uncover safe squares in Cat Sweeper. Three ways to spend a little more time with your companions, both in the room and in pet mode.

LITTLE MOMENTS, BIG MEMORIES

Complete diary tasks, discover new breeds and unlock photos to fill your album. Each memory tells a little piece of your story with the kittens, and a few surprises are waiting to be found.

YOUR CORNER, YOUR PACE

Care for your collection in short sessions or stay a little longer to watch your purrs grow. Once passive production is unlocked, your kittens also collect purrs while the game is closed, up to the offline progress limit.

Open the little box. A new friend is waiting for you.

data.name: Olympia Rising
data.detailed_description:
Olympia Rising is a 2-D action platformer starring Iola - a young warrior who has been cast into the Underworld after meeting an untimely end. She must navigate through the various twisted regions of Hades' domain, fighting through hoards of deadly creatures as she attempts her escape, making her way to Mount Olympus. Lush pixel graphics and fluid animation bring this stylized world to life as you jump, climb, slash, and incinerate your way through each stage.Taking inspiration from beloved titles such as Castlevania, Sonic the Hedgehog, and Kid Icarus, Olympia Rising delivers an exciting, action-filled experience.

- Fight your way through the Underworld, battling creatures of all shapes and sizes. Fast-paced aerial combat propels you upward as you slash enemies to bits with your blade or incinerate them with powerful magic.

- Navigate through deadly environments with fluid maneuverability. Make your own paths as you traverse through each stage looking for the most efficient way to climb to the top.

- Fierce boss encounters await Iola at the end of each Underworldy region - from gargantuan crabs to bone-crunching cyclops'.

-Chain enemy kills as you jump through the air - build up a big combo to earn even more coins to pay Charon the Ferryman and pass through the many gates of the Underworld.

- Simple to pick-up but difficult to master, Olympia Rising awards those willing to challenge themselves as they climb through the Underworld. Collect coins and other treasures scattered throughout the levels as you race through each stage.

- Explore 6 unique, twisted environments of the Underworld - each offering different challenges and creatures to overcome.

data.name: Gardens Of Celestial Globes
data.detailed_description:
LOCATIONS:
Cursed Lands,
Enchanted Valley,
Abandoned Arboretum,
Ice Canyon,
Dark Dungeons,
Mushroom Gorges,
Coral Desert,
Putrid Catacombs.
RACES:
CRAB WARRIORS are crab-like creatures covered with durable armor. They activated during a long battle, becoming more aggressive. Crab Warriors excel in defense.
ELEMENTALS are the creations generated by magical energy. A special magical attraction allows their bodies to maintain their shape. Elementals excel at manipulating magic.
KEEPERS OF TIME are the embodiments of periods of eternity formed by mixing time and space. They are superior to everyone else in the control of time.
PARASITES are the countless clusters of endoparasitic worms. They live in the ducts of their secretion. Parasites excel in antagonism.
ALCHEMISTS are the creatures who have devoted themselves to the study of the nature of magical matter. They heal wounds by the universal composition, which they concentrate from disintegrated fragments of hypermaterial clouds. Alchemists excel in the ability to regenerate.
MYCELIUM are the vegetative bodies of highly developed fungi. They feed on electricity, which they need to maintain the higher functions of the mind. They can grow wherever there is a source of electricity. Mycelium excels in possession of lightning.
DRAGONFLY is the materialized hallucinations caused by the fumes of dangerous bromine compounds, known for their ability to ignite other elements quickly. They cause a dangerous state of "bad trip," from which there is no way back. Dragonfly excels in possession of fire.
SOUL ABSORBERS are the primitive creatures that mutated by feeding on the arcane. Astral mystical energy, permeating their bodies, complements their primitive instincts, creating a most dangerous combination. Soul Absorbers excel in possession of the arcane.
WAR OS is the bio-robots in high-tech suits. They are under the control of a combat operating system while using high technologies to calculate and destroy enemies. War OS surpass everyone else in speed.
SHADOW SPINNERS are the arachnid insects predators that once have entirely fused with their shadow. Their spider webs are very durable, and their wool practically does not reflect light. Shadow Spinners excel at stealth.
each has more than ten abilities, five buildings and three satellites that open up access to unique weapons in keeping with the effect of a special aura.
GAME FEATURES:
† 3 game modes: ARENA, QUEST, TOWER
† random world generator working with 30 level templates
† 77 identified creatures that inhabit the game world
† 103 (simple) items and 23 crafted artifacts
† many kinds of structures and map objects (181)

data.name: Driftfort: The Drowned World
data.detailed_description:
Four planks. Endless water. Whatever you pull from the sea becomes your home.

Driftfort: The Drowned World combines survival, raft building and resource management on the open sea. Hook drifting supplies, catch fish, and turn a tiny platform into a base with workshops, gardens and machines. By day, your home grows. At night, you defend it.

From driftwood to a floating home

Expand your raft with permanent upgrades for up to 128 deck tiles. Plan workshops and storage, secure the edges, and leave room for your next idea.

Make the deck your own with different floor finishes, flags, writable signs, plants, furniture and display cases for your finds. Take a seat on a deck bench or let your character rest in a hammock.

Build supplies that keep working

A sip of drinking water becomes a supply system: purify seawater, grow crops, and organize your stores.

Progress to solar panels, batteries, irrigation and automatic fishing. Manufacturing stations process orders while you focus on salvage, exploration or your next expansion.

When the deep reaches your deck

Night changes your priorities. Light your raft, prepare your weapons, and defend your platforms against creatures from the deep.

Weather, changing sea regions and encounters along the way make preparation matter. What you build by day must hold up after dark.

A coast beyond the horizon

Travel through five sea regions with different resources, weather and dangers. Recover supplies and explore encounters along your route.

Go ashore to discover beaches, forest paths and supply locations, then restore the lighthouse in three repair stages. After reaching the campaign goal, you can keep building and maintaining your base.

Your pace, your choices

Choose from eight characters, customize their equipment, and shape your journey with three difficulty settings and six travel speeds. Building and crafting recommendations help you get started; search and filters support your larger projects.

Features

  • Single-player survival with raft building, salvage, fishing and crafting
  • Gardening, water purification, energy and automatic production
  • Personal deck layouts with furniture, flags, signs and display cases
  • Day and night, weather, five sea regions and attacks from the deep
  • An explorable coast and a campaign goal at the lighthouse
  • Eight characters, three difficulty settings and six travel speeds
  • Eight supported text languages and multiple local campaigns with backups

data.name: Mad Wave
data.detailed_description:
Mad Wave is a stealth-horror game in which you must escape from an island inhabited by ghosts without being seen by them. To achieve this, you need to stealthily steal canisters of fuel and refuel your boat. As you navigate around moving obstacles, you can use distracting flash grenades and demonstrate stealth. However, keep in mind that the ghosts have acute hearing and can hear you.

Backstory
You are a geo-anomalist who has been researching anomalously appearing and disappearing islands for the past 5 years. At one point, you notice that a new island has appeared on the maps of the Geoanalyzer. You decide to immediately go there and study it. Upon arrival, you find an abandoned pier and realize that you lost fuel on the way due to a leak...

data.name: Numina
data.detailed_description:
Step through the 4th Wall…


…into the world of NUMINA. You get in contact with Shawn who is able to hear your voice through the 4th wall! You meet in a very critical moment where Shawn loses someone very close to him while being swept up in a conspiracy that involves your mutual bond. A plot threatening to shake the foundations of the world.

The world of Alterna is filled with a mysterious power called Life's Breath. It enables magic, fueled technological advances, and brought great prosperity to many. Ships no longer needed to solely depend on wind, perishable food could be refrigerated, and barren soil brought bountiful harvests with Life's Breath.

This was all done under the supervision of the Ecclesia, an omnipresent organization representing the teachings of Proserpina: a goddess who once walked Alterna like a normal human and brought the gift of Life's Breath to all. In Alterna, no one doubts Proserpina's existence, as her body is freely displayed to all in Ecclesia's center of power, Cor. In her favor temples are erected everywhere, which allow Life's Breath to flow into the world. But is it really that simple?

Shawn and you slowly uncover the dark secret of Ecclesia and together you will experience a captivating adventure that combines many classic RPG aspects: A character-driven story in which your relationships change the course of the story, a dynamic battle system, challenging puzzles, towns waiting to be explored and other exciting locations!

✨ Play the full story now!! ✨
Numina released in two parts. The base game was released in July '22 and Part II released as DLC in March '23.

Key Features

  • Breaking the 4th Wall
    The 4th wall is a concept from theater where the actors on stage directly interact with the audience. In the same fashion, you partake in the story of Numina as a character in the form of a bodiless voice that only Shawn can hear - a guardian spirit. You can interact with Shawn and influence his decisions through dialogue choices in the game.

  • Branching Decisions
    The decisions you make influences the relationship Shawn has with the other characters you'll meet in the game. Having good relationships with your party members unlocks powerful combo-attacks in battle and may open up the opportunity to take your relationship to the next level ♥ Your decisions also influence the overall course of the story to conclude into one of the four possible endings.

  • Battle with the Elements
    Engage in a round-based combat system with action inputs for some attacks that require you to make timed inputs for maximum damage! Each character also has unique elemental abilities to exploit enemy weaknesses. Incorporate this into your strategy to quickly win battles.

  • Explore the World of Alterna
    Most side quests in NUMINA allow you to dive deeper into the backstory and lore of the world. But you can also explore the beautiful scenery with your grappling hook to reach higher places and find new gear, spell scrolls or rare items.

data.name: Tomahawk: Diesel Ants
data.detailed_description:
Everyone around has gone crazy!

It was the year 2092. Shade found himself in a not very pleasant situation... After all, this was the peak of a man-made disaster. As if possessed by the Devil himself, the android ants came to life and created a real Hell. The plant turned into an anthill that grows with every moment. Metal, blood, ruins... This must be put to an end.

The Tomahawk rifle will help you

With the help of this weapon, you can do more than just shoot. It is equipped with an axe that can be used to chop down enemies, throw them over a distance, and even control them in flight.

The ants are right there!

They constantly run after the hero, attacking with a chainsaw. If they can't catch up, they use saws. They can dodge shots and jump to any heights, and also hide in pipes.

The crazy Buggy racer is heading towards...

An ant on a one-wheeled impenetrable bike. It can shoot from a turret and ram. Its weak point is the red gas cylinders on the sides.

You can activate traps with a Tomahawk strike. The press crushes enemies, and the pendulums knock them down with their blades.

Don't forget about supplies

Health and ammo can be found by exploring locations. They also drop from killed enemies.

There is a trap everywhere...

data.name: Motile Works
data.detailed_description:
Motile Works is a game about the survival of a wandering colony. The colony is on a mission that future generations depend on. You will have to manage the preparation and execution of the task, despite logistical, production and political difficulties.

During the journey, you will have to make many important decisions and adapt to the current situation.

Direction

Where should the platform be moved to ensure resource collection and survival. Is it possible to send a squad of scouts to the location or at least launch a radio drone and obtain data on materials and the presence of settlements. Is there enough fuel and food for a forced march?

Deployment

Where to place the platform in the location. Where will the main collection and production nodes be? Is it necessary to build recreational buildings, or will those built on the platform be enough? Where to lay passages to minimize the travel time of workers. Where to store provisions and can it be illuminated at night to avoid theft.

Production

Can we generate electricity under current conditions, with wind, heat or chemicals? Or will we have to rely on manual labor. Is it possible to avoid injuries in production and protect people from a toxic environment? Are there any buried ruins or valuable materials under the washed soil? Where to start scanning and digging first. Is there soil suitable for planting seedlings and will they have time to sprout before the next poison cloud or our forced departure.

Visibility

Should you avoid noisy production facilities and lots of lighting at night so as not to disturb hunters and not to scare away animals? Or should you power up lighting devices to attract the attention of travelers and local settlers, if there are any hostile ones among them?

Population

What work schedule and thresholds for satisfying needs should be chosen. Is it worth promising people rest and abundance if this can complicate the fulfillment of the mission. How to resolve conflicts between those who are on edge due to difficult living conditions. What to attract new recruits: wealth must be obtained somewhere, religion will force people to be distracted by rituals, and coercion will require armed guards.

Packing

What should we fill the limited space of the platform deck with? Providing comfort will give the workforce a rest on the way and reduce social tension. The placement of found machines will allow the production of high-tech products. A set of different containers and tanks will allow us to take away more raw materials, avoiding dependence on on-site processing. Can we provide fuel for a large weight on the way or will low fuel consumption increase the travel time.

data.name: Bluff Roulette
data.detailed_description:
The Black Fog has swallowed the world.

As refugees struggle across the frozen wasteland toward humanity's last safe haven, a fanatical cult forces them into brutal games of Russian roulette. Every shot can change the fate of your group. Every sacrifice may be necessary. Guide a band of desperate survivors through impossible odds, and make sure at least one of them lives to see tomorrow.

Every round begins with a choice: how will you load the chamber?

Track bullet placements, study the results of previous shots, and piece together the secrets hidden within the revolver. A well-loaded chamber reveals the truth, while a manipulated one hides it.

Remember: luck favors the informed.

Nobody said you had to play fair.

Mock your enemies. Endure the pain. Augment yourself with machinery. Use every trick. Take every advantage.

Nobody plays fair in a game like this.

Neither should you.

Death is permanent—but that doesn't always make it a loss.

Survivors who die leave behind powerful Relics that can strengthen those who remain, opening new strategies for future battles. Sometimes, the dead are more useful than the living.

And if you're willing to cross certain lines, there may be ways to bring them back...

data.name: The Golden Rose: Book One
data.detailed_description:
You are a recent member of The White Company, a mercenary guild on the far side of the law. Your job consists of hunting artifacts and roaming ruins that the Church has forbidden to mention. One of your expeditions, however, leads you down a path that is much deeper than you ever anticipated.

"The Golden Rose: Book One" is a thrilling 1.2-million-word interactive fantasy novel by Ana Ventura, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Juggle friendships, new alliances, and flames of romance in this epic adventure that will take you to a Europe where History took a different turn.

  • Play as male or female; straight, gay, or bisexual.
  • Find romance, friendship, or rivalry with a cast of colorful characters.
  • Hunt down the thief that stole your forbidden maps!
  • Fight against bandits and city guards while trying to stray away from the all-seeing Eyes of the Church.
  • Explore ancient ruins and the cobble-stoned streets of the medieval city of Tarragona. Step into a grand cathedral, a sprawling market, a multicolored harbor, the dark gates of the city, or an aqueduct that no one dares to come close to.
  • Bond with a stubborn old horse.
  • Choose to ally with a street urchin or the feral captain of the Guard.
  • Uncover what is true in a world where denial reigns supreme.
  • Start to unravel your own mysterious past.
  • Immerse yourself in a world rich with characters, story, and lore.

Do you believe in Destiny?

data.name: Aery - Calm Mind 2
data.detailed_description:
Aery - Calm Mind 2 is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes.

Because there are no enemies or any other danger in this game you will be able to lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying. It is a great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day full of hassle.

Of course, you can always select the level that you feel helps most to relax yourself. Most levels can be finished quite quickly so that you can freely choose spend time exploring the environment but you don’t have to stay for too long if you are just looking for a short moment of peace and enjoyment.

This game features a collection of some the most beautiful sceneries from the Aery franchise.
We hope you like them. So lean back and take a deep breath…

The game also features:
  • 15 different landscapes
  • Unlimited replayability trough randomized level goals
  • Beautiful visuals and soundtrack
  • The experience of flying
  • Intuitive and relaxing gameplay
  • A moment of peace and enjoyment in you daily life

data.name: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden
data.detailed_description:
Voice of Cards Trilogy + DLC set


A set containing the Voice of Cards Trilogy that brings together all 3 titles from the Voice of Cards series and all the DLC items for each title.


Voice of Cards Trilogy


The Voice of Cards Trilogy bundles together all three titles from the series; Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars, Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden and Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden.


Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden ＋DLC set


This product is a set containing the game: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden, as well as multiple DLC releases.


About the Game

Outline

This is the tale of a girl who swears revenge on monsters.
After losing her home, she joins hands with a mysterious boy and sets out into the unknown.
But will it be the light of hope, or the darkness of despair that awaits them at journey's end..?

The Voice of Cards series are RPGs, told entirely through the medium of cards.

data.name: Core Remnants
data.detailed_description:
Command. Survive. Evolve.

You are the last Biocore Pilot — a survivor stranded on a dying alien world.
Your only hope lies within the Biocore system, an ancient technology capable of creating life, weapons, and power beyond human understanding.
But every pulse of energy draws swarms of hostile creatures closer.
Survive long enough to rebuild, upgrade, and uncover what remains of humanity’s final outpost.

Lead Your Squad

You don’t fight alone — command a squad of AI-controlled soldiers, each with unique stats and weapons.

Soldiers automatically shoot enemies, protect you, and level up alongside you.

Merge duplicate soldier cards to strengthen your team — each merge grants a permanent +5% damage bonus to all allies.

Equip alien weapons, experiment with mutators, and customize your formation for any threat.

Customize Alien Weapons

Discover alien tech with unpredictable behavior:

  • Homing missiles, bouncing projectiles, or exploding shots

  • Every run reshapes how your arsenal behaves

  • Combine weapons with soldier perks to create unstoppable synergies

Unlock Perks Through Achievements

Your greatest breakthroughs come from survival itself.

Complete achievements during your runs to unlock powerful Perks — rare, permanent augmentations that change how you and your squad fight.

  • Each achievement unlocks a specific Perk

  • Perks can be equipped to soldiers to grant stat boosts and unique effects

  • Build specialized roles: glass-cannon snipers, poison spreaders, explosive bruisers, or support units

  • Perks are permanent unlocks, but loadouts are yours to customize every run

Progress is tracked across sessions — every milestone brings you closer to your next evolution.

Evolve Through Upgrades

Collect Biocores to upgrade everything — permanently.

Choose between randomized upgrades every level.

Unlock permanent enhancements between sessions.

Increase projectile counts, lifesteal, speed, raw damage… and now, Perk power.

Every run feels different, every upgrade matters.

Race Against Time

Each session has a strict time limit.
Defeat enemies to extend your life — or watch the clock run out.
Every boss kill adds 60 seconds, but with each passing wave, enemies grow stronger.

Survive Endless Waves

Face escalating hordes across alien biomes:

  • Enemies scale every wave

  • Defeat bosses with massive HP bars

  • How long can you survive before the planet consumes you?

Set Your Challenge

Adjust the difficulty slider to define your experience:

  • Higher difficulty = stronger enemies, higher Biocore multipliers, and bigger rewards

  • Each difficulty tracks its own highest wave record
    Prove your dominance at every level.

Core Features

  • Procedural wave escalation system

  • Dozens of weapon mutators and stat effects

  • Fully automated companion AI and soldier formation

  • Merging system for team-wide permanent buffs

  • Achievement-driven Perk unlock system with soldier loadouts

  • Explosive boss fights with arena-wide attacks

  • Difficulty slider, upgrade trees, and XP leveling

  • Persistent save system across sessions

data.name: Altstadt
data.detailed_description:
Altstadt is a little town builder for slow evenings. Put down a house, then another, and watch them settle in next to each other: sharing walls, tipping their roofs together, opening doors onto the lane.

There’s nothing to manage and nothing to lose. You can’t build it wrong. Just keep nudging it until it feels like a place.

Let a canal wander between the houses and throw a stone bridge across it. Tuck a garden into the corner nobody else would use.

Then sit back. Villagers wander out, sparrows land on the rooftops, and when dusk comes the windows light up one by one. That part never gets old.

Your town saves as you go, so you can come back tomorrow and add one more house. You will.

data.name: Flight 666
data.detailed_description:
Flight 666 - Unmask the Fake Passengers!
Prepare for a hilarious and suspense-filled journey aboard Flight 666, the most unusual flight you'll ever take! As you step into the shoes of a keen-eyed passenger, you'll quickly realize that something is amiss on this 747 jumbo jet. Among the 340 fellow passengers, disguised in spooky costumes, there's an imposter lurking in plain sight. Your mission, should you choose to accept it: expose the fake passenger before it's too late!

Gameplay
Simple Controls
Flight 666 offers an accessible and engaging gaming experience for players of all ages. With straightforward keyboard and mouse controls, you'll be ready for takeoff in no time.

Accuse with 'E'
Suspect someone of being the imposter? Hit the 'E' key to make your accusation! Choose wisely, as you only have three chances.

Try Again with '666'
Whether you win or lose, a new round is just a keystroke away. Press '666' to embark on another thrilling flight!

Quitting Made Easy
Need to take a breather from the suspense? Press the 'Escape' key to exit the game.

The Mystery Unfolds
On this fateful Halloween flight, everyone's in costume, from zombies to Santa, mummies to yetis, witches to skeletons, and wizards galore. The challenge lies in distinguishing the genuine passengers from the "not real" imposters.

Can you trust your instincts and detective skills to unveil the fraudster before time runs out? Your task is far from simple, as the chaotic Halloween attire makes it a true test of perception. Remember, if you can't expose the imposter in time, you might just find yourself escorted off the plane for being "crazy"!

A Flight for Everyone
Flight 666 offers a delightful blend of suspense, humor, and mystery, making it the perfect game for a night of laughs. Test your observation skills, embrace the Halloween spirit, and embark on a quirky adventure that will leave you guessing until the last moment.

Get ready for a flight like no other. Can you pinpoint the odd one out on Flight 666? Buckle up, and let the hilarity and suspense take flight!

Note
Flight 666 is not responsible for any unexpected turbulence or in-flight costume parties. Enjoy your flight, and may the real passengers please stand up!

TinyAttack is an action roguelite that puts you through endless hordes of enemies that gets increasingly harder over time.

PERSEVERE THROUGH UNIQUE LEVELS:
Try to find the Portal to the next level through uniquely generated maps, making no two playthroughs the same. Your enemies will slowly increase in size and power, allowing you no rest while you explore, loot and fight.



UNIQUE CHARACTERS:
Each playable character comes with an unique set of skills, discover your own combat style and combine items into the mix in order to plow through your enemies. Master your strengths and play around your weakness in order to bring the best of your potential.



CHALLENGING BOSS FIGHTS:
Bosses are literally armed to their teeth! A carefully hand crafted experience in order to bring you the best possible challenge, while random enemies and items keep the freshness in each fight. Each defeat a learning step and every victory bringing you closer to the real truth of this endless war.

data.name: Skeleton War
data.detailed_description:
After experiencing various crises created by small skulls, face the final boss head-on and defeat it by combining your maneuvering skills with the unique builds you've accumulated from previous levels!

Game Features
Weapons preset to auto-fire!
Fast-paced (about 30 minutes or less)!
There are dozens of skills waiting to be unlocked by you, so I'm sure you'll be able to come up with a satisfying play style out of the whole thing (High Risk Output, Iron Bastard, Running Fast, Spell Mechanic Style, and many other categories)!
Hundreds of props and weapons for you to pick from (Judge's Pen, Grand Wizard's Staff, Water Gun, Samurai Sword, and many more)!
Each skeleton wave lasts 25~120 seconds, find a way to destroy as many enemies as you can in that time and survive!
Pick up Skull Coins for upgrades and get some items from the store in between each wave!

Free to choose your start
Starting Character of Your Choice: You can choose from a number of characters with different styles of gameplay and experience, each with their own unique talents and growth mechanisms, bringing differentiated and enjoyable interactions!
Initial weapon of your choice: Before entering a new adventure, you can choose the initial weapon you want and the only one you can rely on in the first level (slingshot is highly recommended for newbies, version T0), and find out which one suits you best to start your journey!

There are dozens of skills waiting to be unlocked by you, so I'm sure you'll be able to come up with a satisfying play style out of the whole thing (High Risk Output, Iron Bastard, Running Fast, Spell Mechanic Style, and many other categories)!
Hundreds of props and weapons for you to pick from (Judge's Pen, Grand Wizard's Staff, Water Gun, Samurai Sword, and many more)!
Each skeleton wave lasts 25~120 seconds, find a way to destroy as many enemies as you can in that time and survive!
Pick up Skull Coins for upgrades and get some items from the store in between each wave!

Free to choose your start
Starting Character of Your Choice: You can choose from a number of characters with different styles of gameplay and experience, each with their own unique talents and growth mechanisms, bringing differentiated and enjoyable interactions!
Initial weapon of your choice: Before entering a new adventure, you can choose the initial weapon you want and the only one you can rely on in the first level (slingshot is highly recommended for newbies, version T0), and find out which one suits you best to start your journey!

data.name: Bloodthrone: Eternal Reign
data.detailed_description:
🩸 THE NIGHT IS YOURS

Bloodthrone: Eternal Reign is a gothic survival RPG where you rule the darkness as an immortal vampire sovereign. Every evening you descend upon a living village — but true power was never in the killing. Power is the decision you make over each and every life.

🌙 CORNER YOUR PREY

When darkness falls, you stalk a living village from the shadows. Villagers wander the streets while you wait unseen — then you corner your prey, one by one. The night is your feast.

⚰️ KILL OR TURN

Every victim is a single, tense decision. Drain them on the spot for their blood, or turn them into a vampire and add them to your army? Farmer, merchant, warrior and witch — each becomes a different vampire. But every kill leaves the village a little more terrified.

🏰 RULE YOUR CASTLE

By day you retreat to your gothic castle, where the sun cannot reach you. Manage your growing bloodline, upgrade your chambers and feed your vampires every night — or hunger will weaken them, they will lose their loyalty and be lost to the dark.

🔮 UNLEASH FORBIDDEN POWER

Sacrifice vampires at the altar to gather Dark Power, then spend it across a deep five-branch skill tree. Forge your lord into a manipulator who seduces, a warlord who commands, or a predator nothing can stop.

🗡️ DEFEND AGAINST THE HUNTERS

The more you hunt, the higher the village's panic climbs — until the hunters march on your castle. Militias, professionals, executioners and sunlight-bearing fanatics come in waves. In cinematic battles beneath a blood moon, only your army stands between your throne and ruin.

💀 FACE LEGENDARY HUNTERS

On certain nights, elite hunters come for you personally, dragging you into a duel against a legendary vampire slayer. Strike, hypnotize or retreat — but the sun always rises.

👑 REIGN THROUGH THE AGES

Survive one age and you ascend to the next — from a medieval village to Victorian London and beyond. Five distinct eras, each filled with new enemies and new dangers, carry your growing power forward in a loop built to be replayed.

🦇 KEY FEATURES

  • Kill or turn — every victim is a single decision with no way back
  • 4 victim classes — farmer, merchant, warrior and witch, each a different vampire
  • Castle management — upgrade chambers, feed your bloodline, hold their loyalty
  • 5-branch skill tree — manipulator, warlord or predator
  • Wave-based hunter raids — militias, executioners and sunlight-bearing fanatics
  • Legendary hunter duels — strike, hypnotize or retreat
  • 5 eras — from a medieval village to Victorian London and beyond

How long can your reign last before the sun finds you?

data.name: Ralkoz
data.detailed_description:
ENTER RALKOZ

Explore a forgotten land filled with abandoned structures, ancient ruins, and inexplicable phenomena. The traces left behind by the missing research team will draw you deeper into the darkness consuming Ralkoz.

EXPLORE DANGEROUS LOCATIONS

Search a variety of locations, from dark forests and forgotten ruins to abandoned settlements. Every detail in the environment may reveal another piece of what happened here.

FOLLOW THE SIGNAL

Track the radio signals left behind by the missing team. As you approach their source, the truth behind Ralkoz and the mysterious organization connected to it will begin to surface.

UNCOVER FORGOTTEN SECRETS

The ancient structures and unnatural events of Ralkoz conceal a mystery far greater than they first appear. Piece together the clues and discover what truly happened to the missing research team.

DANGER CAN STRIKE AT ANY MOMENT

The creatures of Ralkoz lurk in the shadows. Listen carefully, watch your surroundings, and react quickly when something emerges from the darkness.

FIGHT TO SURVIVE

Fight back with melee weapons or search for a way to escape. Every encounter forces you to decide when to stand your ground and when to retreat.

FACE DEADLY ENEMIES AND BOSSES

Use your weapons and ammunition wisely as you confront the most dangerous entities in Ralkoz. Formidable enemies and intense boss battles will test everything you have learned.

GAME FEATURES

  • First-person survival horror experience

  • Psychological horror and reality-distorting events

  • Melee and firearm combat

  • Formidable enemies and intense boss battles

  • Dark forests, ancient ruins, and abandoned structures

  • A mysterious investigation driven by radio signals

  • Exploration and environmental storytelling

  • An atmospheric, story-driven horror experience

data.name: Gates of Avalon
data.detailed_description:
Storyline

Awaken in the mystical Isles of Avalon, a fantasy world steeped in Arthurian mythos. Explore and discover its secrets as you meet a diverse range of characters. Uncover the mystery of a dark and growing menace as you seek the key to the Gates of Avalon.

This is the first module in the Avalon series, a Gates Game Adventure.

Environment

Immerse yourself in an expansive world of rich and vibrant visuals and sounds, traveling by land, water, air and magic.

Encounters

Meet and make friends with the peaceful denizens of Avalon, learning their story along the way. Battle dozens of different foes, natural and unnatural, as you make your way into increasingly dangerous areas. Your intelligent and playful pet will accompany you and provide help with its magical powers.

Challenges

Complete over 20 quests to develop skills and acquire the resources needed in order to survive the final battle and reach the Gates of Avalon.

Features

  • First-person action RPG
  • Adjustable combat difficulty based on real time D20 system
  • Craft potions and recipes
  • 3 mini-games
  • 12+ hours of gameplay

data.name: The Last Comfort
data.detailed_description:
The Last Comfort is a Metroidvania set within a child's subconscious mind. You play as Tedd, his favorite teddy bear, set on a mission to save the boy from a terminal illness. You must traverse through the child's memories, dreams, and nightmares, find the sickness and heal him.

The world in the boy's mind is vast, filled with enemies and obstacles. You have to fight through many enemies and bosses that each have different attack sequences, and you have to learn their patterns, know how to parry/block, stun them, and strike!

Master the block system to knock enemies off balance, use fade-away slashes to control the gap, and parry at the exact second an enemy strikes to unleash a devastating counter-attack.

The world is full of danger in this decaying mind, but some places are still safe and clean from the sickness. This is where you get a breather before you continue on ahead in search of the dark. 


You aren't forced into one specific way to fight. Throughout the world, you will find unique bracelets with different abilities and skills to help you build the way you like to play. Find keys to unlock more slots to equip more bracelets.

  • Key Features:

  • Interconnected Exploration: Find your own path through a non linear map, from toxic bogs to deep, dark caves.

  • Customization: Tailor your combat approach with unique Bracelets.

  • Tactile Progression: Find Memory stones statues to acquire powerful new skills that fundamentally change your movement and combat potential.

  • Vital Rewards: Defeat overwhelming bosses to earn coins for the shop and collect crucial Star Shards to keep yourself healed during difficult fights.

  • Multiple Endings: The child's ultimate fate rests on the secrets you uncover and the choices you make in the dark.

data.name: Mecha Force
data.detailed_description:
Mecha Force, developed by Ming Studio, redefines mech games by blending immersive 3D cockpit gameplay with modern Roguelite elements. This first-person mech action game channels the passion for classic Japanese mecha anime into an unprecedented combat experience.

Command Your Mech to Resist Invasion

Step into the cockpit, synchronize with the "Kylin", and drive the giant mech into battle against mechanized enemies of varying forms. Experience pure mecha aesthetics through immersive combat encounters.

Customize and Upgrade Your Mech

With each sortie, you'll discover new weapon types, abundant upgrade options, diverse combat environments, and mysterious unknown powers that recreate those deja vu moments of brilliance in gameplay.

Guided by the Enigmatic "Maki"

"Machineera" connects with the "Kylin" through Neural Link as your navigator. This mysterious girl will fight alongside you, helping reclaim humanity's future with every battle.

Confront Terror in a Chaotic Future

Now, pilot humanity's last hope - the mech "Kylin" - rallying all surviving forces to protect Earth's lifeforms and launch a counteroffensive against the alien invaders.

data.detailed_description:

加入官方qq群769472534；
在百度贴吧《三千世界游戏吧》发帖或回复；

联系qq2414972595
感谢所有人的支持。

《三千世界》是一款沙盒角色扮演游戏。游戏旨在构建出不同的世界供玩家游玩。你可以创建自己的角色或在世界中选择任意一名角色开始游玩，与栩栩如生的npc交互，通过各种方式强化自己，经历一段属于自己的冒险之旅。

独一无二的世界

你所创建的每一个世界都是独一无二的，不同的角色，不同的物品，这些使得每次游戏都会是一次崭新的冒险。如果你对程序生成的世界不满意，游戏提供世界编辑系统，以供对不满意的地方进行编辑。

高自由度的游戏系统

在游戏中，你可以与志同道合的npc结为好友，组成队伍，共同冒险；
通过学习技能，修炼功法，装备武器等方式强化自己，甚至可以自创技能，功法和武器；
游戏对玩家的行为基本上没有限制，无论是行侠仗义还是无恶不作，你的所作所为都由自己决定；
交易，夺宝，复仇，交友，你的一举一动都会影响世界的演化。

与众不同的人机交互

在游戏中npc与玩家完全平等。除了少部分行为比如对话之外，大部分玩家能够完成的行为npc也能完成。他们也会主动的寻找目标进行交易，战斗等，甚至玩家就有可能是他的下一个目标。正是基于这个特性，你完全可以在同一个世界中选择扮演不同的角色。

data.name: Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches
data.detailed_description:
Build the farm. Grow the business. Make a life worth working for.

Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches is a single-player farming and business management RPG inspired by a real working farm and its owners, Nick & Ashley Riggin. Guide Nick and Ashley as they turn 25 acres of undeveloped woodland into a diversified agricultural business over a campaign spanning up to twenty years.

Start with raw land, limited resources, and a shared ambition. Clear space for your home, establish your first growing beds, and decide which enterprises deserve your time and money. Watch the property take shape as gardens, orchards, pastures, high tunnels, and working buildings become part of everyday farm life.

Every expansion changes the job. More crops need more harvesting. More animals need more feed. A bigger market display needs enough products to fill it and someone with enough energy left to sell them.

  • Two farmers, different strengths. Control Nick, Ashley, or both together. Divide the workload or team up on suitable jobs, making use of Nick’s strength in physical work and Ashley’s precision. Develop their abilities across six skill disciplines and choose perks that support the farm you want to build.

  • Grow the soil alongside the crops. Start seedlings under grow lights, transplant into prepared beds, and manage vegetables, orchard crops, and protected growing spaces. Soil fertility, crop rotation, cover crops, compost, weeds, and water all influence production. Harvest whole crops or return for successive pickings as plants visibly change through their growing cycles.

  • Raise animals that need real care. Build enterprises around chickens, pigs, and cattle. Manage feed, breeding, housing, fencing, and routine health inspections. Maintain the infrastructure that keeps animals safe, and round up escapees when a damaged fence turns an ordinary workday into an unexpected chase.

  • Turn the harvest into a product. Wash and bag salad, harvest and pack microgreens, cook preserves, and develop other value-added foods. Equip your Wash Pack building as the business grows. Ingredients, packaging, labor, refrigeration, freezer space, and dry storage all matter when deciding what to make and how much you can handle.

  • Get hands-on when you want to. Play optional mini-games for a chance at bonus XP, or watch the assigned farmer complete the task automatically. Collect eggs, milk cows, unload feed, mow pasture, prepare products, and tackle the market rush. The work still uses farm time and resources whichever approach you choose.

  • Build a business around what people buy. Prepare your farmers-market booth, organize displays and back stock, set prices, and respond to customer demand. Expand into farm-store sales and commercial accounts with restaurants and other buyers. Balance fresh inventory, delivery commitments, operating costs, and debt; a bumper harvest only helps if you can store it and sell it.

  • Give customers a reason to follow your farm. Take actual in-game photos, crop them, and choose a caption about farm life, growing practices, or upcoming products. Watch the feed fill with likes and comments. Marketing can build demand, but advertising products you leave behind (or selling out before the early rush is over) can damage your reputation.

  • Plan around weather, energy, and each other. Seasonal daylight and changing weather shape the working day. Heat, hard labor, fatigue, and lingering soreness affect what Nick and Ashley can accomplish. Make room for morning coffee, recovery, and time together while managing the pressure that a growing farm places on their morale and relationship.

  • Grow into the owner’s role. Build infrastructure yourself or hire contractors, maintain equipment, recruit employees, and eventually develop a manager who can take on more responsibility. Decide what to delegate and where your own time matters most. Work toward a farm that can support its owners and give them room to enjoy the life they have built.

Plans will change. Storms roll in, equipment fails, employees call out, and repairs compete with harvests for the same afternoon. Sometimes the interruption is a serious business problem. Sometimes the barn cats have simply decided that your empty crates belong to them now.

A playable demo will be released in October 2026. This two-day slice takes you to an established farm in Year 6, where you’ll guide Nick and Ashley through Friday’s farm work and product preparation before heading to the Farmers Market on Saturday.

Inspired by the satisfaction, strain, and occasional absurdity of running a real diversified farm, Riggin Farm: Raw Land to Riches asks you to build something that lasts. Wishlist the game and find out whether you can run Riggin Farm better than its real-life owners.

data.name: UR CHIMERIC SAI
data.detailed_description:
This is a visual novel depicting the taboo relationship and crucial decisions between a "Chimera" girl—an artificial lifeform—and the young man who becomes her tutor.

■ Story

Meeting you was a calculated trap.

Can I truly say, with my head held high, that I’m glad we met?

I am still searching for the answer.

Since the day we met, the gears of my life have spiraled out of control.

I don’t blame you. I know it couldn’t possibly be your fault.

If I were to let go of your hand, I could surely return to my ordinary life.

And yet, looking at you, I find I cannot let go.

Is this feeling merely pity?

Or is it————

________________________________________

Yoshifumi Akiyama is a part-time cram school tutor who has abandoned his dream of becoming a school teacher.

One day on his way home, he is approached by a suspicious woman who wants to "scout" him as a private tutor.

The pay is extraordinary. Struggling to repay his student loans, Yoshifumi decides to take the job.

Following the address he was given, he arrives at a mysterious facility called the "Integrated Life Sciences Research Center."

Led into a private room, Yoshifumi meets a young girl named Hamal.

Before long, he discovers a shocking truth about Hamal and is forced to make a life-altering decision.

■ Characters

【Yoshifumi Akiyama】

The protagonist. The story is told from his perspective.

He possesses an exceptionally strong sense of responsibility and self-control, which has become a burden to him.

He once dreamed of becoming a teacher, but his passion withered after witnessing the corruption of "educators" and the harsh reality of the field.

Just as he is about to give up his dream and seek other work, he is offered a high-paying tutoring job.

At the mysterious "Center," he meets Hamal and falls into a carefully laid trap.

Favorite drink: Ginger ale.

【Hamal】

The heroine.

A "Chimera"—a composite lifeform created at the Center.

She had never received an education until meeting Yoshifumi.

She is incredibly eager to learn, growing rapidly as she acquires knowledge and wisdom.

She possesses several abilities characteristic of a "superior specimen."

Favorite drink: Hot milk.

【Yuko Fuyushiro】

A mad scientist.

The woman who scouted Yoshifumi to the Center to be Hamal's tutor.

She has poured her entire life into the existence of "Chimeras."

She has recently noticed more fine lines and wrinkles on her face.

Favorite drink: Cappuccino.

【Kiyomi Natsukawa】

Yoshifumi's mentor from his school days.

He still consults her for life advice from time to time.

One of the few people Yoshifumi can truly open up to.

She has recently started worrying about her sagging midsection.

Favorite drink: Iced coffee.

【Rikao Haruhara】

Yuko Fuyushiro’s "servant."

He views Fuyushiro as an absolute authority.

He leaves Yoshifumi with a cryptic warning regarding Hamal.

Lately, his muscle aches don't start until the second day after exercise.

Favorite drink: Tea.

【Shirou Yae】

An elite researcher and former subordinate of Yuko Fuyushiro.

He chose a different path from Fuyushiro and seeks the "salvation of Chimeras."

He is expressionless, as if devoid of all emotion.

Lately, he finds people apologizing to him more often, even when he isn't angry.

Favorite drink: Black vinegar.

■ Game Features

  • A Dark, Sweet Story with Branching Fates

    The narrative branches significantly based on your choices. There are three main routes, and your decisions will determine the ultimate fate of the two characters.

  • User-Friendly Flowchart System

    The game features a flowchart allowing you to visualize chapter beginnings and divergence points. You can jump to any scene instantly, making it smooth and easy to unlock all endings.

  • TIPS System for Deeper Lore

    Includes a glossary function that explains technical terms and special settings. Dive deeper into the mysteries of the facility and the biology of Chimeras.

  • Memories Gallery

    Unlock numerous event CGs that color the story. Once seen, artwork can be viewed anytime in the Gallery Mode.

  • Genre & Playtime

    Genre: A Taboo Romance with a Non-Human Student

    Play Time: Approx. 5 hours (All routes cleared)

data.name: Survival and Rise: Being Alive
data.detailed_description:
Adversity Reborn "is an easy to learn post apocalyptic survival game，The game dynamically sets up battle scenarios, requiring survivors to quickly enhance their strength to face imminent full-scale conflicts. Beyond the classic survival gameplay, the game introduces new stress-reducing mechanisms and unique features such as "No Combat at Start" and "Dinosaur Hunting." It strives to provide a fairer competitive environment while remaining simple and accessible, allowing more survivors to immerse themselves and enjoy a low-barrier survival journey in adversity!

Peaceful Start, Cooperative Survival

You can only rely on primitive survival skills to stay alive, which undoubtedly enhances the immersive experience of survival. However, during the first three days of the battle, PvP is only allowed in specific areas, while most regions remain non-combat zones. This gives survivors ample time to build their homes and stockpile resources. It also means that even if you lack "post-apocalyptic survival experience," you can still peacefully develop and team up with other survivors.

Dinosaur Hunting: Fun and Excitement

The interaction between dinosaurs and humans within the same ecosystem is a key source of fun in our game. As humans begin to dominate the ecosystem, they will inevitably tame dinosaurs for their own use. Dinosaurs will help you build your home, generate electricity, or serve as mounts to chase the wind and moon, or even dominate the battlefield amidst gunfire.

Team Development, Strategic Planning

The island environment is treacherous, requiring you to not only fend off hostile creatures but also face threats from other survivors. It is recommended that survivors form teams of four to deploy heavy machine guns, traps, and other defenses. Even if your home is damaged, there's no need to worry—you can repair it with a single click without having to rebuild from scratch. Of course, the best defense is often a good offense. Choose to actively attack other survivors' homes, using advanced weapons like C4, TNT, or rocket launchers to besiege and destroy other teams' shelters, plunder their safe resources and medals, and ultimately secure victory in escaping the mysterious island.

Repel Zombie Hordes, Explore Strongholds

The island features 16 large map gameplay modes and is home to 59 types of hostile creatures. The threats from AI mechanical beings and mutated creatures are everywhere, and from time to time, zombie hordes will attack your structures. By heading to the strongholds on the map, you can discover the hiding places of their bosses. However, this may require you to undergo a series of challenges such as exploration, puzzle-solving, and parkour. In addition to the bosses hidden in the strongholds, you must also be wary of the world bosses lurking in the wild mountains. The AI mechanical beings and mutated creatures in zombie hordes, strongholds, and world bosses all possess extremely powerful combat abilities, so it's recommended that you team up before venturing out!

Transform into a Boss, Wreak Havoc

The island boasts six types of terrain features and ten weather effects. However, the environment on the experimental island is becoming increasingly harsh. Some airdropped supplies from a mysterious scientific organization contain toxins, and if you accidentally come into contact with them, you will "transform into a boss" and become hostile to other survivors. Nevertheless, you will still receive generous resource rewards.
data.about_the_game:
Adversity Reborn "is an easy to learn post apocalyptic survival game，The game dynamically sets up battle scenarios, requiring survivors to quickly enhance their strength to face imminent full-scale conflicts. Beyond the classic survival gameplay, the game introduces new stress-reducing mechanisms and unique features such as "No Combat at Start" and "Dinosaur Hunting." It strives to provide a fairer competitive environment while remaining simple and accessible, allowing more survivors to immerse themselves and enjoy a low-barrier survival journey in adversity!

Peaceful Start, Cooperative Survival

You can only rely on primitive survival skills to stay alive, which undoubtedly enhances the immersive experience of survival. However, during the first three days of the battle, PvP is only allowed in specific areas, while most regions remain non-combat zones. This gives survivors ample time to build their homes and stockpile resources. It also means that even if you lack "post-apocalyptic survival experience," you can still peacefully develop and team up with other survivors.

Dinosaur Hunting: Fun and Excitement

The interaction between dinosaurs and humans within the same ecosystem is a key source of fun in our game. As humans begin to dominate the ecosystem, they will inevitably tame dinosaurs for their own use. Dinosaurs will help you build your home, generate electricity, or serve as mounts to chase the wind and moon, or even dominate the battlefield amidst gunfire.

Team Development, Strategic Planning

The island environment is treacherous, requiring you to not only fend off hostile creatures but also face threats from other survivors. It is recommended that survivors form teams of four to deploy heavy machine guns, traps, and other defenses. Even if your home is damaged, there's no need to worry—you can repair it with a single click without having to rebuild from scratch. Of course, the best defense is often a good offense. Choose to actively attack other survivors' homes, using advanced weapons like C4, TNT, or rocket launchers to besiege and destroy other teams' shelters, plunder their safe resources and medals, and ultimately secure victory in escaping the mysterious island.

Repel Zombie Hordes, Explore Strongholds

The island features 16 large map gameplay modes and is home to 59 types of hostile creatures. The threats from AI mechanical beings and mutated creatures are everywhere, and from time to time, zombie hordes will attack your structures. By heading to the strongholds on the map, you can discover the hiding places of their bosses. However, this may require you to undergo a series of challenges such as exploration, puzzle-solving, and parkour. In addition to the bosses hidden in the strongholds, you must also be wary of the world bosses lurking in the wild mountains. The AI mechanical beings and mutated creatures in zombie hordes, strongholds, and world bosses all possess extremely powerful combat abilities, so it's recommended that you team up before venturing out!

Some airdropped supplies from a mysterious scientific organization contain toxins, and if you accidentally come into contact with them, you will "transform into a boss" and become hostile to other survivors. Nevertheless, you will still receive generous resource rewards.

data.name: Hop's Awakening!
data.detailed_description:
Shoot 'em up!

  • Level up your firepower by grabbing power-ups to unlock 13 weapon upgrades for your front and back guns.

  • Destroy enemies to grow and maintain your score multiplier.

  • Eat food to boost your multiplier and target high-value enemies to earn extra lives.

  • Collect gems to charge your super weapon and pulverize your enemies.

  • Use the super weapon to destroy enemy bullets, earn bonus points, and escape dangerous situations.

  • Activate the super weapon to gain temporary invincibility during the blast.

Controlling Hop:

Use focus mode to slow down the ship, avoid obstacles, fly through tight spaces, and dodge enemy bullets with precision.

Packed in:

  • 12 action-packed levels, each with a unique boss (sometimes more than one per level).

  • 3 different routes to reach your goal (a fourth route will be available as a free add-on).

  • 2 bonus stages designed to help you maximize your score.

  • Hidden warp zones to skip levels or switch routes, letting you create your own strategy for higher scores.

  • Hand-drawn pixel art with a comic-style presentation.

  • More than 30 original music tracks composed by singer-songwriter and soundtrack composer Eden Cruz.

  • 2 different final bosses. 

  • Wait, There is secret stages too?

data.name: Colonies End
data.detailed_description:
Colonies End is a sci-fi, adventure, sandbox game set among the stars. You’ll be mining, constructing, advancing and discovering to survive in this dimension spanning game.
Here's an overview of what Colonies End has to offer:
  • 🪐 Space-age combat with jetpacks, bounce pads, lasers and more! 🪐
  • 🚀 Explore a strange world comprised of six-dimensional realms. 🚀
  • 🛠 Build exciting spaceships and space colonies with 6 tech tiers. 🛠
  • 🌌 Uncover the mysteries of the Desecrators and the lost expedition! 🌌
  • 🧰 Scavenge for resources to stay alive in the world’s unforgiving dimensional realms. 🧰
  • 👽 Find creatures ranging from the common pig to the uncommon alien trader. With creatures also ranging from close ally to deadly foe. 👽



While scouring the great unknown realms the worlds are yours for the taking, build humble or grand spaceships and colonies utilising our six increasingly powerful tech tiers! With over 70 different blocks such as turret blocks, thruster blocks and even music and video playing blocks you are in control of what you build.



Travel across space on your expedition to uncover the mysteries found beyond as you travel through alien worlds; strange space stations and the Desecrators realm! Scour between dimensional realms for resources to further your journey and survival. Discover obscure aliens and creatures both friend, foe and somewhere in between...



Go alone, find allies or foes along your adventure. Fully customise your spaceship and it’s loadout.


Games that inspire us:

Space engineers, RoboCraft, Avorion, Minecraft

data.name: Topdeck Duel
data.detailed_description:
Topdeck Duel is an addictive card roguelike with incremental elements. Test your luck and tactical thinking as your main goal is to claim the opponent's entire deck and beat 10 challenging levels. Every drawn card can turn the tide of battle!

⚔️ SIMPLE RULES, HIGH STAKES

The core of combat is familiar to everyone: you and your opponent simultaneously draw the top card. The one with the higher power takes both. But if the power is equal, a "War" begins: players draw additional cards face down and face up, raising the stakes to the limit!

🧩 SMART POSITIONING & DEEP TACTICS

Once you collect enough cards, you enter the Arrangement phase, where you draw random cards from your discard pile and place them on a 6-slot board. This is your chance to turn the game around:

  • Each card has its own unique effect that allows you to increase the power of the cards on the table.

  • Your cards provide you with buffs, increasing card power:

  • But when you claim enemy cards, their effects flip 180 degrees—instead of buffs, they inflict debuffs on you, reducing card power:

  • Card effects depend on their position, neighbors, enemy cards, or even active debuffs.

  • Position your cards wisely to maximize buffs and minimize debuffs.

  • It's impossible to calculate the perfect combo in advance—you have to adapt on the fly.

  • Use unique tactical abilities: Reroll unwanted cards, Swap their positions on the board, or use Predict to peek at the opponent's future moves!

🔥 INFLUENCE MANAGEMENT

Placing and manipulating cards costs a special resource: Influence. If you position your cards suboptimally, an exhausting tug-of-war will begin, quickly draining your reserves. Once your Influence drops to zero, your run is over.

🃏 MERGING & CRAFTING THE PERFECT DECK

After defeating an enemy, you claim a part of their deck permanently. But be careful, the captured cards are still considered enemy cards and provide debuffs. You also unlock the following options:

  • Merge 3 identical cards into one of a higher rarity (from Common to Legendary) to get a card with a stronger effect:

  • Burn unwanted cards for Influence.

📈 INCREMENTAL PROGRESSION

Lost? No problem! Every attempt makes you stronger. Gold earned in battles is kept permanently. Spend it on global meta-upgrades between runs:

  • Tactics: Unlock new board management abilities.

  • Economy: Increase your Influence reserves.

  • Deckbuilding: Start the game with higher rarity cards, claim more trophies, and improve card alchemy.

Start small, adapt your strategy, hoard gold, and become the ultimate master of Topdeck Duel!

data.name: Main Assembly
data.detailed_description:
You’re the designer, engineer and architect if you can imagine it you can create it! Construct robots of any shape or size from eight-legged spider bots to eerie UFO contraptions. Engineer each and every appendage with powerful visual programming letting you dictate the bots every move. When you’ve completed your masterpiece, open the world builder and craft the ultimate obstacle course to push your bot to its limit.

Alone or with fellow inventors, envision your design then make it a reality.

Create a world in which your bots will be challenged. Craft tracks for racing or complex obstacle courses that tease out all those lovely design flaws you didn’t know you had.

Show off your designer skills first-hand with up to three friends. Build worlds together to challenge each other's bots in different obstacles courses and tracks. Or smash each other's creations into metallic pulp (more coming soon).

No friends? No problems. We’ve created a single-player mode with over 100 challenges to test your inventions.

Don’t panic, we don’t expect you to code in C# (we’re doing that). In fact, it’s entirely optional, but if you’re up to the challenge we’ve designed a powerful visual programming tool for you to enhance your creations.

Add (or take) from the thousands of already created bots and worlds hand-crafted by our dedicated fans from all over the globe.

If you want to test the limits of your construction, then drive it off a cliff.

data.name: Jellyfish
data.detailed_description:
Jellyfish is a game which tells you a story.
The story takes place in the depth of the ocean where the player takes the shape of a simple jellyfish.
Jellyfish presents the full life cycle of a jellyfish, a soft bodied, free-swimming aquatic animal with a gelatinous umbrella-shaped bell and trailing tentacles.
Most people are only familiar with the full-grown jellyfish, the translucent, bell-shaped creatures that occasionally wash up on beaches and swim almost in every ocean on earth.
And yet jellyfish have several very complex life cycles, in which they go through a number of different developmental stages that are presented in Jellyfish(this game).
As the story goes, the player will guide and accompany the jellyfish from it's very birth to the very end of it's journey.
Using the arrows(or WASD keys) to eat, solve various puzzles, fight hostile creatures, and then to chase a suitable mate, *and then find new life soaring the skies on a flying snail*.

Features:

1.The game features 10 different levels.
The first two levels are mostly a casual game, the next two are more of a puzzle game, and then comes an RPG game.

2.Control the jellyfish using the arrow keys(or the WASD keys) to guide it through it's journey.

3. Jellyfish is designed as an "art game".
All the characters within the game are created by complex programming math codes, the movement is designed to be as smooth and elegant as possible.

4. This is a short game, a work of interactive art, which bring the most beautiful animal to your screen.

**Just like a painting of a sunflower on the rough canvas, imagine a jellyfish on your computer screen.
Jellyfish are among the most handsome and unique beings in our world, just like the growing flowers.
I have made this game to demonstrate how rich, deep, unique and beautiful our life is.**

data.name: Iron Core: Mech Survivor
data.detailed_description:
Iron Core: Mech Survivor is a single-player roguelike top-down action game that combines the shrinking safe zones of battle royale, the strategic elements of tower defense, and the fast-paced gameplay of survivor-like games. The shrinking safe zone limits player movement but can be expanded through mining tasks. Meanwhile, resources are more abundant outside the zone, creating a high-risk, high-reward system that offers a fresh and thrilling experience for fans of roguelike and survivor games.

A Post-Apocalyptic Tale of AI and Humanity

Ever heard a story of AI in a post-apocalyptic world? In Iron Core, AIs have guarded humanity’s last shelter for over a century, waiting for survivors. Each AI has its personality and motivations, but they are united by one mission: to save humanity and rebuild a shattered world—or so it seems. Featuring full voiceovers, rich storytelling, and subtitles, this narrative will keep you hooked.

High-Intensity Roguelike Survivor Action

Take control of advanced AI mechs, wield both melee and ranged weapons, upgrade elemental bullets, unleash devastating artillery strikes, summon laser drones, and trigger massive AoE soundwave attacks. With a variety of powerful skills and dazzling effects, battles fill the screen with chaos. Upgrade through card draws, but only the luckiest players will make it to the end.

Rescue Missions and Mech Progression

Complete exciting missions to strengthen your mech. Destroy mutant nests, rescue and escort human survivors, establish satellite links for advanced weaponry, help rogue labs develop doomsday weapons, or repair broken bridges to rebuild the world. Every mission brings new challenges and rewards.

Reactor, Resource Gathering, and Safe Zones

Under constant attacks from mutants, gather radioactive fuel, deploy mining drones, and transport reactor fuel back to your base. Power up the reactor to activate the climate control system and expand the safe zone. The farther you venture from the zone, the more resources you’ll find—but the risks grow exponentially.

Tower Defense: Use Terrain to Your Advantage

Strategically build various towers to aid your missions. Some towers annihilate enemies, while others slow them down. Smart use of terrain and towers will make even the toughest missions easier to handle.

Launch Content

The initial release will include:

  • 3 Maps

  • 3 Mechs with unique weapon loadouts

  • 5 Types of Defense Towers

  • 20 Enemy Types

  • 3 Boss-Level Elite Enemies

Prepare for a fast-paced, immersive, and strategic survivor-roguelike experience like no other!

data.name: Trainwatch
data.detailed_description:
Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper at a desolate railway crossing in the middle of nowhere, desperately trying to save his marriage. The job is supposed to be simple: spend one month at the Tower, control the crossing gate, stay sober, and prove to his wife that he can change.

While train schedules and daily errands keep you inside, something waits in the fog beyond the crossing. Unraveling the mystery and helping Troy fix his life will be harder than you think.

Trainwatch is a new time-management psychological horror from Harvester Games, the acclaimed solo developer behind The Cat Lady, Downfall, Lorelai, and Burnhouse Lane.

Check the timetable. Lower the gates, watch the train pass, and raise them again. A Gatekeeper’s work is simple, repetitive, almost tedious – until every errand, every strange call, and every step into the fog makes you question what is really important.

Learn the routine, respect the clock, but most importantly keep your promise to call your wife every single day.

Something is calling from the fog beyond the crossing. Venture outside to meet strange neighbors and explore occult grounds.

Discover locked places, hidden paths, and secrets never meant for you.

Keep Troy’s sanity and stamina meters high. If you fail, then hunger, exhaustion, fear, and neglect will wear him down, while every missed call with his wife pushes him closer to a relapse.

Work the shift, unlock new skills, go fishing, brew the coffee – do whatever it takes to stay sober.

Trains come and go, strangers ask for help, while daily errands and distractions pile up. All the while, the fog keeps calling as you try to be a better man. You're on the clock, and you can't chase every lead, keep every promise, or make every day perfect.

Decide what matters most and learn to let go. You have only one month to try and fix Troy's life.

data.name: Hoverloop
data.detailed_description:
In Short: Hoverloop is a Multiplayer Arcade Arena Combat game. The game is currently in Early Access containing community hosted servers that you can host yourself and offline splitscreen. Online matchmaking and season pass progression will become available upon release, this fall 2019.

Access an array of customizable drones with unique abilities. Use teleportation, deathrays, control jammers and super speed to carry your team, or yourself, to victory!

Fight against or work together with friends in splitscreen/online multiplayer (online matchmaking only at full release fall 2019). Alternatively, you can play together with AI-Bots.
We'll launch with a focus on Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch and Invasion, releasing multiple exciting new modes later on.

Story:

Following the technological advances of the early 21st century, arena combat began surpassing
all other forms of entertainment, giving rise to the biggest industry on earth.

In the year 2077, one league has taken centre-stage, and become our modern-day
colosseum. Drone gladiators from around the world battle for glory in the Hoverloop
arena, risking everything in the process. The crowds chant their names, revel in their
victories, and delight in their failure. While the champions are rewarded with fame and
fortune, losers are shunned and humiliated, becoming outcasts of our volatile society.

Build your following, customize your drone. Battle your rivals for glory in the Hoverloop Arena.

Key features:

  • Customization: Pick your favorite customizable drone from a vast variety of materials, colors, hats, trails and emotes, paired with unique abilities like teleportation or death ray.
  • Combat: Obliterate your opponents with the large weapons arsenal at your disposal. Blow them up, stun them and punch holes in them with the machinegun.
  • Multiplayer: Play with up to four friends locally or eight players online.
  • Arenas: Fight on a variety of maps across a wide array of game modes including deathmatches and cooperative PvE modes against waves of AI.

data.name: TrackBlitz
data.detailed_description:
Race for the best time!

Every round gives you three minutes on one track. Drive as many laps as you can, your best one counts. Miss a corner and restart in an instant, or jump back to the last checkpoint.

Incredible variation

  • 5 difficulty tiers, totalling 60 unique tracks
  • Unlock endless customization for your ride in the garage
  • Overcome obstacles like loopings, jumps, bobsleds, pipes, and much more
  • 11 worlds featuring high variety, from neon city nights to alpine snow, volcanic rifts and hot sandy dunes

Race against the world

  • Compete against your friends on 60 unique tracks for the best lap time.
  • Matchmake against up to 4 other players in one round.
  • Become number #1 worldwide, in your region of choice or among your friends.
  • Steam fully integrated, invite your friends directly to your lobby.
  • Crossplay between Steam and other platforms.

data.name: SAND CRUISER
data.detailed_description:
Late afternoon. The drill is deep in a rich deposit and making a lot of noise. Whatever lives under the sand will have felt it by nightfall. This deposit is why you drove out here. You can pull the drill in and be gone before dark, or keep drilling, set the guns to automatic and get ready for a hard night.



Sand Cruiser is a colony sim where the colony drives and fights. Your settlement is a land cruiser crossing a dead desert under a sun that swelled into a red giant long ago.




A new game starts on a finished cruiser. In the shipyard you rebuild it deck by deck, along with the modules that keep people alive: power, water tanks and water traps, a galley, quarters, weapons and sensors. Get your survivors under a roof, because heatstroke can kill by day, and at night the freezing cold comes for you.




Every crew member has skills, traits and a mood. They all need food and sleep, and they take turns at their posts. You set priorities for each person individually. Under fire, some lose their nerve and run, or freeze on the spot. You hire new survivors in settlements you first have to find. But take care, because every new crew member is one more mouth to feed. And the dead have never woken up again.




People fled underground from the sun and woke the swarm down there. The nights belong to it. It lives under the sand and is blind, so your lights mean nothing to it. It feels the vibration of engines, drills and gunfire, and in the cold nights it senses every bit of heat you give off. The richest ground lies above its nests. Some creatures attack from range with acid that eats into a module for a while, until it is spent or a crew member repairs the module.




Some cruisers are hostile, while nomads mostly stay out of fights. Contacts show up on radar. Through the periscope you measure the range to your targets and walk your artillery in until the salvos hit. Batteries fire on their own or wait for your order. Flak and point defense keep swarm creatures away from the hull. But every shot also shakes the ground, and the swarm feels that. The tactical pause lets you get the full picture.




The map only fills in where you have already been. Seismic surveys find deep deposits, and every deposit runs dry eventually. Drones lift off from their landing pads to strip wrecks. At night you rely on your instruments to navigate, because searchlights light your way but also give you away to every other ship nearby. With a flare you can light up the terrain for a while. If a sandstorm catches you, you can barely see, and not even your searchlights get through.



Sand Cruiser is in Early Access and is being made by 3 Duckz, a small independent studio. The foundation is in place, and it stays: the ship, its crew, the sun and the swarm.

At the moment we are working on combat and weapon balance and on how the crew takes up its battle stations. The sound of combat and the performance of the game still need a fair amount of work. We are replacing placeholder art bit by bit.

There is no fixed roadmap. What players suggest to us on our Discord decides what we work on next.

data.name: Anji -Implication-
data.detailed_description:
Anji 【Implication】

- Stimulation that gives the mind, unconsciously, certain notions.
This game is a horror walking simulator where you just go down the stairs.

Story

You are about to go home after working overtime.

However, the building's elevators are not in operation.

and you have to go down the emergency stairs from the top floor to get home...

Playthrough Time

15 ~ 20 minute

Game Features

・16:18 vertical play screen
　Vertical play screens look similar to smartphone screens.
　On a normal 16:9 display, black bars appear at both ends of the screen.

・Photorealistic visual effects created with Unreal Engine 5
　Viewing angle, depth of field, etc.
　Visual effects are represented as close as possible to the way the human eye sees.

Uploading and livestreaming Guidelines

-Include the game's name in the title of the video or livestream.
-Include the store page URL in the summary or description section of the video or livestream.
-Some of the submitted videos and live streaming footage may be used on the Bunbukuzu Youtube channel.
-Posting or livestreaming content limited to paid members, such as YouTube memberships, is not permitted.
-Bunbukuzu will not be held responsible for any damages incurred by the publisher or any third party resulting from the posting or livestreaming of videos.
-Please note that these guidelines are subject to change without prior notice.
