Place your guitarist playing hard rock to attract zombie hordes and shoot them with your soldiers in a perfect mix of modernized tower defense and challenging strategic gameplay.

data.name: Echo Maze
data.detailed_description:
You awaken to find yourself in complete darkness.

"Echo Maze" is a completely new auditory exploration puzzle game that entirely eliminates visual information.

The only thing players can rely on is their own sense of hearing. You must accurately perceive the direction and distance of the various sounds you hear around you, drawing a map of the Mazes in your mind.

However, not every sound will lead you to the exit.

If you cannot distinguish the danger hidden in the sounds, death may be just one step away.

Can you escape from this Mazes of sound with your sharpened hearing and concentration?

A total of 51 Mazes lie in wait for you.

Key Features

  • [Innovative Gameplay with Zero Visuals]

    The main gameplay screen is complete darkness. Without relying on any graphics, players are immersed in a pure audio experience that stimulates their imagination. The thrill of navigating the darkness, sharpening only your hearing and concentration, offers an unprecedented gaming experience.

  • [Realistic Navigation with 3D Binaural Audio]

    By wearing headphones or earphones, you can identify the direction and distance of sound sources. The ticking of a bomb, the cracking of a glass floor, the sound of an anomaly... Use these sounds to accurately grasp your position and surroundings, and create a mental map.

  • [Tension Where Sound is Both a Hint and a Trap]

    Some sounds will guide you, while others may be traps that lure you into danger. Is that sudden noise in the silence a crucial hint, or an invitation to your doom? A tense soundscape that allows for no lapses in concentration awaits the player.

  • A Variety of Gimmicks to Test Your Hearing: This is not a simple maze; various traps await to test the player's ability to listen and distinguish sounds.

For a fully immersive experience, the use of headphones or earphones is strongly recommended.

[Other]

Gameplay Videos & Livestreams OK.

Monetization of videos and livestreams using this game is permitted.

You can display a HUD from the options menu that shows the player's input direction.

data.name: Amenti
data.detailed_description:
Description

How were the pyramids really built? What was the connection between the ancient Egyptians and alien beings? Is the legend of Amenti real? To find the answers, you must enter the newly discovered tomb of Rudamon, a terrifying site buried 50 meters underground. No one has dared to explore its endless, dark corridors—until now. According to legend, entering this tomb disturbs the pharaoh’s spirit and his royal family, with disastrous consequences.

In Amenti, you play as a historian and photographer, willing to risk it all to uncover the truth about Amenti and the ancient Egyptians' supposed connection with extraterrestrials.

Gameplay

Amenti is a horror game that takes you deep into the dark secrets of ancient Egypt. You’ll explore your surroundings like a true historian, investigating mysterious artifacts and discovering hidden truths. The game features a photography mechanic, where you capture images of various subjects. At first, you might only notice frightening details in your photos, but as you progress, the horror will reveal itself in real time.

Realistic graphics and high-quality 3D sound fully immerse you in the eerie atmosphere of a 5,000-year-old mysterious structure.

data.name: The Hero's Journey through Time
data.detailed_description:
400 years ago, a bitter war between humans and magicians began, which is still going on today. As you flee your home to escape violence and death, you are suddenly homeless and alone. But instead of letting your desperation overwhelm you, you let your spirit of adventure guide you and embark on a journey to find out the real reason behind the war.

On your journey you will meet a wide variety of heroes who are as different as fire and ice. You will meet brave warriors who risk their lives for their beliefs, but also benevolent magicians who use their powers for the good of others. You even travel through space and time to uncover the mysteries of the past and change the future.

Although you have to face many challenges and dangers on your way, your courage and determination will not let you down. You will become a true hero who can end war and bring peace.

Characters:

Keji:
This is you: A small villager from Waka Village.
His home planet is Barun and he is a human.
He is always very eager and spontaneous, but sometimes he thinks carefully about what he is doing.
So far he hasn't seen much of the world, but one fateful day that changes.

Helena:
Helena is a magician from a village in the magician area.
Their home planet is also Barun. She is still young and inexperienced and also on the trail of the mysteries of war.
Due to her slight clumsiness, she also causes one or two laughs in the village.

Christa:
Christa is a thief from Waruun.
Her home planet is Kemonomimi.
She loves shopping and eating treats.
She is, literally, a real sweet tooth, although she has a particular weakness for noodles.
If someone steals her food, she quickly becomes angry and can hardly be tamed.
In general, she is always optimistic, but sometimes she tries to show a slightly stricter side of herself.
Among other things, Christa loves striking techniques.
She also has a tendency to rely on her luck, which sometimes works more or less well.

features:

-Travel through different worlds
-Day/night system
-Quests between worlds
- World jump possible at any time (if you have unlocked the corresponding world)
-Own house with housing and furniture from different worlds
-Casino with some mini games
-Special daily changes

data.name: Adecke - Cards Games Deluxe
data.detailed_description:
Realistic cards games with emotions close to reality.

Adecke include six cards games. Cultural games played around china, europe and america since the old ages.

The six cards games can be played with differents variations and options. Adecke contain solo games. All games is accesible at anytime in the main menu.
You start the game and play. Very simple and quick. A good time, playing cards games, in front of a table, within a couple of seconds.

The six selected games contain differents kind of gameplay. The best of every style, and the best of all ludic cards games.

data.name: Two Bad Fellas
data.detailed_description:
In this first person, horror, casual game, you have to protect your Teddy from the Two Bad Fellas. Find quickly a safe spot to hide your buddy and than move him to the next one. Explore the house and solve riddles but be aware, if you hold your Teddy for too long, you will be in big danger!

the dancers

The hideout

Your Teddy

The scientist

Salvation





In the dark scenario of "Two Bad Fellas," immerse yourself in a first-person horror experience where your sole mission is to protect your loyal friend, Teddy, from two mysterious antagonists. Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, and find safe havens for your precious companion. But beware: if held for too long, your Teddy may attract unimaginable dangers!

FEATURES:
1. **Protect Your Furry Companion**: Face horror firsthand as you strive to protect your faithful friend, Teddy, from two wicked antagonists. Quickly find safe hideouts for your companion and move cautiously through the haunted house.

2. **Explore a Maze of Mysteries**: Immerse yourself in an intricate and mysterious house, where every room hides dark secrets and crucial clues for your survival. Solve puzzles and uncover the truth behind the nightmare that surrounds you.

3. **Multiple Difficulty Levels**: Challenge yourself with three distinct difficulty levels, tailoring the gaming experience to your preferences. Whether you're a novice seeking a relaxing adventure or a terror veteran looking for an extreme challenge, "Two Bad Fellas" offers a personalized experience for every player.

4. **Immersive Thrill Atmosphere**: Dive into an enveloping and tense atmosphere, enriched by an evocative soundtrack and unsettling sound effects. Every step you take, every breath you take, brings you closer to the heart of the horror surrounding you.

5. **A Gripping Story to Uncover**: Follow the journey of a young boy as he delves into a dark dream, searching for his lost mother. Confront your deepest fears and delve into the recesses of the protagonist's mind to uncover the truth behind his troubled reality.

Prepare for an unforgettable adventure, where courage and determination will be your only weapons against the forces of evil. Enter the world of "Two Bad Fellas" and confront terror with every fiber of your being.

data.name: Dodge Mayhem
data.detailed_description:
A fast-paced top-down endless fighting game that turns it into an all-out arena fight. Pick up balls lying around, throwing it at anyone who moves, and keep moving yourself, because the other side is aiming at you too.

Drop into Endless Mode and survive as long as you can. The longer you last, the faster enemies arrive and the more of them fill the arena, until it becomes total mayhem. Fight it out on a variety of maps.

Leaderboard

Every run counts. Climb the Steam leaderboards for Most Kills and Longest Time survived, compete against other players, and unlock Steam achievements.

Enemies don't just stand there. They pick up balls, charge their own throws, sidestep yours and Fight you until death. Tougher enemies take several hits to bring down.

Each type fights its own way, and special abilities

Visit the The In-Game Wardrobe to customize your fighter with hats, head, body and hand items.
A full options menu lets you rebind every key and mouse button and tune graphics, audio, screen shake, UI scale and more.

Key features

  • Top-down dodgeball action with a ball in each hand and charged throws

  • Two-charge dash with no invincibility frames, so positioning matters

  • Many ball types, including stunning basketballs and double-damage spike balls

  • Many distinct enemy types with special abilities

  • Endless Mode with escalating difficulty on many maps

  • Steam leaderboards for Most Kills and Longest Time, plus Steam achievements

  • Character customization in the Wardrobe

  • Fully rebindable controls and detailed graphics and audio settings

data.name: The Backrooms Footage
data.detailed_description:
An atmospheric Horror game inspired by the popular internet creepypasta, The Backrooms.



You have found a camera with a footage in it. For some reason you can't rewind the video, and as soon as you try winding it forward you find yourself in the Backrooms. Figure out whats in the footage and try to ESCAPE AS FAST AS POSSIBLE!

There are multiple levels and it seems impossible to escape, but dont give up! You have to get out of here!



Linear space in Level 0 is altered drastically; it is possible to walk in a straight line, return to the starting point, and end up in a completely different set of rooms than the ones previously passed through. Due to this phenomenon, and the visual similarity between each room, consistent navigation of Level 0 has proven very difficult. Devices such as GPS locators and compasses fail to function within the level, and radio communications are audibly distorted and often prove unreliable.



"If you're not careful and noclip out of reality in the wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms, where it's nothing but the stink of old moist carpet, the madness of mono-yellow, the endless background noise of fluorescent lights at maximum hum-buzz, and approximately six hundred million square miles of randomly segmented empty rooms to be trapped in.

God save you if you hear something wandering around nearby, because it sure as hell has heard you."

data.name: Opposyte
data.detailed_description:
"Why hasn't anyone made a game like this before? We don't know, but we're really happy to bring this experience to you..."

Memorable Moments, that's what we hope to provide for Opposyte players. Have fun with friends in quick matches or add a little excitement to the experience by participating in ranked and championships.

DEVELOPMENT STAGE

This page is dedicated to OPPOSYTE original game, which is in the early stages of development and will use the OPPOSYTE System for Combat Racing Games, the system, with patent deposited, it already has a functional operational version as an Island within Fortnite where the main mechanics of the system can be seen and played by anyone who is curious.

WHAT IS THE OPPOSYTE GAME

Where did the idea come from?

“When I started showing the idea to colleagues, they asked where did I come up with this? I never knew how to answer how the idea entered my head, but in a kind of crazy dream the gameplay mechanic just appeared and when I woke up I thought... oops... we have something here... Since the idea was something I had never seen seen before and although innovative, it was something relatively simple, I went to research if there was any gaming using that and... NOTHING, so one thing led to another" (Will Emmerich)

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM OUR ORIGINAL GAME

We will use the Opposite System for Combat Race games as we did in Fortnite, where we managed to include the base mechanics, however, with our own project we will be able to go much further and include a series of new systems and mechanics.

The main formation of the game in Classic Mode will also be in TRIOs, with teams of 3 players through the matchmaking system, although we also have other Game Modes if you want to go SOLO.

NEW FEATURES

- Characters with different attributes and stats so you can choose the one that best suits your gameplay style, be it running to avoid enemies or clashing to prevent them from completing their laps.

- Each character will have native skills, in addition to the dynamic slot that will change according to the random loot system along the track.

- Many possibilities to customize your character, mainly aesthetic resources and character skins.

- Play Natively by APP on your Mobile without Cloud Streaming with a game design made for this purpose. Crossplatform with PC and consoles.

data.name: GRADUATER
data.detailed_description:
Climb the mountain for Graduation!

After passing a hard exam, you entered the university you wanted so much.
But you know that your study begins now.
You should climb a rough mountain to get good grades and graduate the university.
Though, with riding on an electric wheel.

Each stage contains events you can experience while attending University, such as course registration, classes, assignments, and midterm exam. And in these stages, you will meet friends, kind seniors, and excellent professors.



Interesting control that makes you mad.

This game is a precision platformer action game that requires the handling of an electric wheel that is simple but difficult to get used to.

The electric wheel is controlled with ASDF keys (not WASD) and has a delicate acceleration system divided into 1, 2, and 3.
It won't be easy to find such a control method in any game in the world.

You won't get what the fxxx this means just by reading the description.
you gotta play this game yourself.


Welcome to the pit again!

With just one mistake, you can fall down a cliff from where you came up for hours. The process of climbing this long way again must be hard and painful. However, it will be much easier than when you've raised for the first time.

This is because, at first glance, this game seems to be difficult and meant to cause pain to the player, but it is designed to find answers and targets through the process of falling and rising.

Like the lines in the Dark Night Trilogy, you'll be able to get back on your feet and climb again.
"Why do we fall? So that we can learn to pick ourselves up."

So... Prove yourself and RISE!

With just one mistake, you can fall down a cliff from where you came up for hours. The process of climbing this long way again must be hard and painful. However, it will be much easier than when you've raised for the first time.

This is because, at first glance, this game seems to be difficult and meant to cause pain to the player, but it is designed to find answers and targets through the process of falling and rising.

Like the lines in the Dark Night Trilogy, you'll be able to get back on your feet and climb again.
"Why do we fall? So that we can learn to pick ourselves up."

So... Prove yourself and RISE!

data.name: Throne of Lies®: Medieval Politics
data.detailed_description:
Live on Discord!


on Discord now!


About the Game

Throne of Lies is a 3D Werewolf/Mafia game that requires social deduction skills to defeat the enemies. It is a game of deceit, investigation, strategy, and role play.

How to play

The game ranges from 6 to 16 players. Each player is randomly assigned to the roles from one of the four factions:
The Blue Dragon (Good/Protagonist)
The Unseen (Bad/Antagonist)
The Cult (Bad/Antagonist)
The Neutral

If you are one of the good factions, you need to find out the bad faction for the execution to defend your throne, but you can also be converted by the Cult leader.

If you are one of the bad factions, you will be able to communicate with each other at night and overturn the throne by taking down all the good faction in the game.


Game modes

Quick Mode (6 players)
Selected roles (4 Good + 1 Bad + 1 Neutral) will be assigned, no conversion possibility. Best for new players.

Duel Mode (7-9 players)
Selected roles will be assigned from the blue dragon, the unseen and the cult, excluding Neutral faction.

Classic Mode (8-16 players)
Randomly assigned roles from all 4 factions. Highest complexity of all modes.


Game phrases

The unique Day/Night cycle allows players to congregate around the table, discuss their findings and accuse players of treason during the day and use their abilities to occupy, spy on, conspire against and even kill their fellow players at night.

Day
You can share your investigation results in the chat box to all players or you can whisper to the King privately. Starting from Day 2, you can vote one suspicious player for execution, it takes at least 3 players to start the trial before the suspect gets executed.

Trial
Starting Day 2, if 3 or more players voted the same suspicious player, the trial will begin and all players get to vote for “Execute” or “Pardon”.

Night
Each role would have different skills to use at night. If a Cult or Unseen member decides to make a kill, all players will see the result in the following day phrase. The conversion also happens at night and the good guy will be allied with the bad guys the next Day.


Features

Log Book
A notebook to keep track of your investigation results for Day and Night phases. You can also put in false information to mislead other players as the Log Book will be revealed and available for all players when your role gets killed.

Deathnote
A note you can leave as a signature or graffiti and will be shown to all when a player gets killed by you.

Chat Box
Send messages to the room or join the discussion during the game. All notification messages, such as the voting results, the death of a player, or your personal conversion information, will also be shown.

Whisper
You can send a whisper message to the King if you have valuable information about a certain player from your investigation. Or you can send false information to trick the Good King when being a member of Unseen or Cult.

data.name: Planet Killer
data.detailed_description:
You are a Planet Killer.

Seek hostile worlds.

Reduce them to molten ash.

Planet Killer is a physics-driven destruction roguelite where every shot permanently reshapes the battlefield. Unleash devastating weapons into fully simulated pixel-based planets, carve massive craters, trigger chain reactions, and survive relentless planetary defenses with up to 6-player online co-op.

Choose your starting ship, each with unique strengths and weaknesses, and unlock new ships by destroying planets.

DEVASTATING PLANETARY DESTRUCTION

  • Fully simulated destructible planets

  • Real-time crater carving and shockwaves

  • Chain explosions and cascading destruction

  • Every shot leaves a permanent impact

Terrain fractures. Defenses collapse. Worlds crumble beneath sustained bombardment.

A GALAXY OF UNIQUE WORLDS

Advanced procedural planet generation makes every planet unique with detailed cities, surface features, cloud/storm systems, continents, islands, and oceans. Even the background of space is unique with various star fields, nebula, and galaxies.

ESCALATING PLANETARY DEFENSES

Planets fight back.

  • Surface cannons

  • Missile batteries

  • Defensive countermeasures

  • Increasingly dangerous worlds

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT

  • Stack hundreds of modular weapons to create devastating combinations

  • Missiles, cannons, lasers, rapid-fire barrages, experimental weapons

  • Defensive/Utility modules for limitless build variety

  • Adapt your build to counter evolving planetary defenses

Every run offers new upgrades, new strategies, and new ways to annihilate.

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

Each run pushes you deeper into hostile space.

  • Procedurally generated encounters

  • Increasing difficulty and deadlier planetary variants

  • Elite planets, storm worlds, and bosses

  • A galactic shop to buy weapons, modules, and ship upgrades

  • Permanent run-based death

  • Rank up your unique Planet Killer emblem and title

  • High-score chasing destruction

  • Unlock over 128 unique starting ships for endless replayability

  • Chart your path, upgrade your ship, and see how far you can get

How many worlds can you erase before you fall?

data.name: Puzzle Chronicles
data.detailed_description:
Enter the dark and savage lands of the Ashurin Empire as you battle to avenge the atrocities the Empire brought upon your tribesmen. On your heroic quest to topple the Empire you will fight fierce beasts and battle hardened warriors in this new Puzzle RPG hybrid game. Featuring an active puzzle combat mechanic, deep story, and robust character development Puzzle Chronicles will bring you into the next era of Puzzle RPGs.
  • Puzzle Combat RPG – An active puzzle combat mechanic blends the fun and skill of puzzle games with the strategy and adventure of RPGs for a truly epic gaming experience
  • Dungeon Exploring – Seek out hidden treasures and equipment that only true Heroes should have by battling your way through dungeons throughout the Ashurin Empire
  • Versus Mode Battles – Challenge your friends locally or online to a puzzle battle to see who will reign supreme as the ultimate champion of the Ashurin Empire
  • 5 Mini-Games – Test your puzzle skills in 5 mini-games that will unlock items and provide even more enhanced abilities
  • Persistent Hero – No matter what mode you are playing in, Single Player, Versus, Quick Battle, or Mini-Games, your Hero will acquire skills and experience, unleashing new ways to experience the game
  • Loot and Battle Skills – Customize your hero’s puzzle combat style by using mighty weapons, enchanted armor, special battle skills, and more

data.name: Neokaiju
data.detailed_description: NEOKAIJU is a game all about causing destruction and gaining power as fast as you can. You control a small kaiju, trapped in a lab and used as a power source for the nearby city — break out, and go break buildings. When you save your friends, you grow in size until you’re absolutely monstrous. Your abilities, a dash attack and a laser beam, become more powerful as you level up as well! Maneuver the city by climbing walls and smashing through windows, avoiding the deadly swarm drones that will try to stop you.

data.name: Death In The Bunker
data.detailed_description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD


About the Game

An unknown virus is been changing people into bloodthirsty zombies. Many fled to the largest bunker in the world, house to a laboratory where the virus is being investigated. Most of the survivors hibernated in the bottom levels of the bunker. Unfortunately, during an attempt to isolate the pathogen from infected blood samples, one of the scientists from the team becomes infected himself. The bunker becomes a zombie lair, together with all the hibernated people. A year afterwards, due to a malfunction, some of the hibernation chambers open on their own.

Death In The Bunker is a first person post-apocalyptic survival horror game set in the largest bunker on Earth. You play as one of the people who were hibernated in the lower levels.



With no map to lead you, you need to carve your own path through the gloomy, blood-drenched hallways. Watch out, some places might prove extremely dangerous!

  • Explore rooms, hallways, caves and ventilation shafts.
  • As you explore, watch out for dead ends and zombie lairs – they might be the last place you’ll ever see.
  • Search for keys and access cards to get into locked rooms.




    Before you go out to explore the halls, make sure you’re properly equipped for the task. Check every corner, and you might just find something that’ll come in handy for your survival. Keep your mags loaded – meeting a zombie horde head-on without a weapon ready to fire is not the best idea.

  • Upgrade your weapons by adding attachments. Death In The Bunker boasts an extensive weapon upgrading system based on attachments such as: laser sights, flashlights, suppressors, grips, etc.
  • Equip your character with the best gear possible! You can find a helmet, bulletproof vest, knee pads, glasses, gloves, shoes, pants, T-shirt, night vision goggles, and more.
  • Collect food! You will need food and water in the game to survive. The lower your hunger, thirst, and endurance bars go, the more damage you’ll receive.




    Fight for your survival! The bloodthirsty zombie might be a common sight, but it might just happen you’ll encounter other creatures too, and some of them you might have to run from. You will also encounter dangerous spots, such as contaminated labs or zombie lairs, where you should stay quiet.

  • Unarmed combat! Your most used weapon throughout the game will be your fists. Use different combos to crush your opponents. You can use your fists, elbows, knees and feet.
  • Find a melee weapon! Use those to dispose of your enemies faster and more efficiently, but watch out – your weapon might break at any time.
  • Fight from a distance! With a firearm, you will surely destroy your target in a heartbeat. But that comes at a price – there’s a high chance you’ll be heard by other zombies in the area, and you might not have enough bullets then. Firearms will definitely come in handy when fighting hordes.




    Surviving inside the bunker is next to impossible – constant hunger and thirst, zombies, dead ends, contaminated zones, and a lack of suitable weapons won’t make it any easier, especially when going at it alone! The game has a multiplayer mode, up to 6 players. When playing with friends, you increase your chances of survival.

  • Replenish your health, hunger, thirst and endurance.
  • Collect loot, upgrade your weapons, get the best gear.
  • Invite your friends into the game, try to get out of there together.
  • Avoid zombie hordes, don’t make a noise, and watch where you’re going.
  • If you die, all your gear is left with your body, and you start the game from scratch as a new character.




    There’s one goal to this game! You need to escape the bunker as fast as possible! The supplies might not last you long, and after a while you might just encounter something even worse than the zombies!

data.name: Pea Pod Power
data.detailed_description:
Play as an adventurous pea pod on a lush garden planet.

A race of evil alien fungi have invaded our tranquil world, and taken control of our normally harmonious fruits and vegetables. You must use an array of Pea Pod Powers - including long vines and exploding peas – to defeat the alien scourge and save our world!

Explore a wide world of fantastical islands

Each island level is carefully (painstakingly) designed with a different theme and artwork, to complement the crops that live there! Watermelons live underwater, peppers live in a volcano, and who knows what else you’ll find in the other levels! If you make it to a village, you might even get some helpful hints from the locals!

Power up your Pea Pod!

Woah… like the name of the game! Your pea pod earns experience by defeating enemies, and gets stronger when it grows to a higher level! You can learn new attacks and upgrade its stats after finding enough minerals. Every new game gets randomized base statistics, so each pea pod is different!

Defeat the alien fungi

The aliens have really run amok! They conquered most of the island locals, teamed-up with giant insects, and even made grotesque hybrid bosses that now rule each island. To stop the fungi you’ll need to defeat the insects and the boss of each level... and ultimately face-off against the lord of all fungi!

Find collectables

Every island is absolutely loaded with collectable items! Some items heal you, others give you minerals, and rare ones can even upgrade your pea pod! Sacred seeds are the most important items… the islanders hid them when the aliens invaded. After you defeat the boss, you’ll need to find the sacred seeds hidden on each island!


Can you power-up your pea pod, find the sacred seeds,
and defeat the alien fungi once and for all?

We really hope so… these fungi are not fun guys!

Features

  • 12 Exciting attacks and abilities
  • 16 Large and diverse levels to explore
  • 14 Bizarre bosses to defeat
  • Tons of enemies to fight and collectables to find!
  • Upgradable player stats and player level system
  • Custom music composed for each level
  • Full support for keyboard or game controller
  • Detailed UI, including menu, settings, full maps, and mini-maps
  • All artwork and music were custom-made by the game developer for this unique digital experience!

data.name: Paint Rumble
data.detailed_description:
Feature List

🔥 Special Feature – Online & Local Multiplayer! 🎨

Play Paint Rumble like never before! In addition to the classic local mode to challenge your friends on the same PC, now you can connect with the whole world with our online multiplayer mode!

✅ Create your own room and invite friends for epic battles.
✅ Join public matches and compete against players from around the globe.
✅ Fast-paced real-time action, full of strategy and power-ups!

Now, the fun has no limits – challenge, win, and paint the screen like a true champion!


Feature List

🌎 Special Highlight – Available in 6 Languages!

Paint Rumble is translated into English, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, German, and Simplified Chinese.

The interface, menus, buttons, and all game information are 100% translated.

✅ Play with total comfort, fully understanding every option and command, no matter where you're from.

✅ Make the experience even more accessible for you and your friends around the world.

No barriers! Just fun, strategy, and lots of paint on the screen!


About the Game

Paint, Compete, and Win!

Welcome to Paint Rumble, the most colorful, chaotic, and fun party game you've ever seen! Here, quick reflexes, strategy, and lots of craziness decide who comes out on top.

The challenge? Simple (or maybe not): in insane 2-minute matches, paint the largest area of the screen with your color. Sounds easy... until your friends start painting over your work!

Choose Your Character and Jump into the Madness!

Join the fight with one of the four most charismatic paint warriors: 🎨 Wolfy – The blue wolf, fast and clever.
🎨 Quacky – The yellow duck, always excited!
🎨 Tigro – The green tiger, fierce and competitive.
🎨 Lucky – The purple mouse, small but quick!

Each brings their own color to the battle, but only one takes the victory!

Game Modes

🎮 Free-for-All – Every player for themselves! Whoever paints the most, wins!

🎮 Team Battle (2v2) – Form your duo and show who rules the arena!

How to Play?

✅ Control your character using keyboard or controller — your choice!

✅ Play against your friends or challenge the CPU in solo matches.

✅ Run, dodge, and paint as much as you can before others paint over your color!

✅ Crazy power-ups appear during matches — grab them before others and turn the game in your favor!

✅ Set how many rounds you want: best of 3, 4, or 5. The battle is yours!

Simple, Fun, and ADDICTIVE!

Paint Rumble is that kind of game that starts with laughs... and ends with screams like “STOP PAINTING OVER MY STUFF!”.

Whether on the couch with friends, online with the world, or solo against the CPU, one thing is guaranteed: frantic and competitive fun from start to finish!

Play with anyone… and get ready for chaos!

🌎 Online Multiplayer – Challenge players from around the world or create a private room and show your friends who rules the paint!

🛋️ Local Multiplayer (Couch Co-op) – Gather your friends, share the keyboard or connect controllers… and let the madness begin on the same screen!

Paint Rumble is the kind of game that looks simple… until it starts. Then it’s shouting, laughter, rivalry, revenge, and LOTS of paint flying everywhere!

✅ Easy to learn. Hard to put down.

✅ Perfect for testing reflexes, strategy… and your friends’ patience.

✅ Great for all ages — whether for a casual session or a serious battle for honor on the couch (or online).

And the best part? The game is fully ready for players worldwide, with a 100% translated interface in 6 languages: Portuguese, English, Spanish, German, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.

So… who’s gonna dominate the screen? Who’s gonna paint over whom? Who’s taking the crown?

There’s only one way to find out… join the chaos!

Author’s Letter

Letter from the Creator

You know… I was never that person who spent hours and hours playing video games. In my childhood, teenage years, and youth, games appeared only from time to time — simple, almost rare moments. But even so, there’s one game that left a mark on me. I didn’t spend endless hours playing it. It was just a few moments… but they were magical.

I remember it like it was yesterday. We were all together: my mom, my dad, my siblings… and sometimes even my school friends. All squeezed into one chair, sharing the same keyboard. Each of us using two little fingers, trying to control our characters in the middle of all the chaos. It was deliciously messy — and, at the same time, one of the most fun things I’ve ever experienced.

Laughter. Shouts of celebration. The panic when someone hit the wrong button. That silly fight over who would be the champion… or who was just there to get in the way. But above all, those were moments of connection. Of being together. Of creating memories that still live here, in my heart.

Years went by… and today, I have the chance to turn all of that into something real. This isn’t just a game. It’s an invitation. An invitation for you to experience this too. To laugh. To compete. To connect — with those you love, with your kids, with your friends, with your parents, with whoever is by your side… or even across the world.

Paint Rumble is, in truth, a tribute. A tribute to the joy of simple things. To the magic of being together. To those moments that, often, we only realize how special they were… when they become memories.

I sincerely hope this game helps you create memories like that. That one day, years from now, you’ll look back and think: “Wow… those moments were truly amazing.”

Thank you for being here. And above all… have fun.

With love,
The creator of Paint Rumble

data.name: Sujimon Quest
data.detailed_description:
A peaceful village is being threatened by the Sujimon, bewitching monsters that can reduce men to lifeless husks. A woman named Gaaru sets out on a journey to find the Legendary Sujimon, a being that can supposedly combat this threat. As it turns out, the Legendary Sujimon is a yakuza named Tatsumi, who has been brought here from another world. Together, the pair will unravel the mysteries behind the Sujimon and bring an end to their reign of terror!

Vanquish dangerous creatures in traditional turn-based combat.

Explore the village during the day as well as at night.

And capture the Sujimon and have them fight alongside you.

Explore the Village, Night and Day

Explore the village by day and accept requests from the villagers. You can also engage in nightly activities to uncover some of the village's more guarded secrets and strengthen your characters.

Catch 'Em All!

The Sujimon bosses can all be captured, and once you've fulfilled certain conditions, you can have them fight by your side!

data.name: Twins of Olus
data.detailed_description:
18 years ago, the invasion began. Thousands were hunted, captured and possessed. Now your training is complete and it's time to dive into exhilarating battles against your corrupted foes.

In Twins of Olus, you take control of Lions, an orphaned Uthran native and his spectral partner Creo as they emerge from years of hiding after an otherworldly force invaded their homeland. Players will master the art of dual combat, seamlessly switching between characters as they battle their way through hordes of creatures, solve puzzles, collect power ups and meet plenty of quirky allies along the way.

By exploring a beautifully crafted world filled with secrets and challenges through fast paced traversal - coupled with a little creative thinking - only you can uncover the intent and identity of the nefarious force pillaging Lions' home world.

Control two characters in tandem to experience a co-op adventure as a solo player. Seamlessly swap between playstyles to make the most of either characters best attributes.

Travel together day and night uncovering alternative routes as the sun rises and sets on each region. Encounter curious and remarkable creatures who may aid or deceive you during the journey.

Dash, launch & jolt at high velocity to cover vast stretches of terrain. Activate spectral bridges shared between the living and the dead to reach places once forgotten.

Enlist a squad of potent creatures that will lend you their powerful combat enhancements. Gather rare materials along the way to unleash the full potential of their skills.

Local co-op puts you and a friend in control of each character individually to create a new way of adventuring together.

data.detailed_description:
Lace up your bowling shoes and experience the most realistic bowling simulation ever created with PBA Pro Bowling!


The Professional Bowlers Association and FarSight Studios have partnered to create an officially licensed PBA video game. The game features a career mode with over 100 tournaments set in dozens of venues, quickplay and local multi-player modes, online tournaments and more. 19 PBA pros will be included in the launch of the game with in-game commentary from Rob Stone and PBA legend Randy Pederson.

Features

  • Officially licensed PBA product.
  • Real PBA Tour Professionals! Belmo, Butturff, Tackett, Norm Duke, Walter Ray, and many more.

  • Extensive career mode with over 100 virtual tournaments.

  • Compete against other players in online tournaments.

  • Authentic PBA Tour oil patterns.
  • Power-up special balls.
  • Over 100 bonus challenges.
  • Brunswick licensed pins and lane equipment.
  • Real licensed bowling balls from many different ball manufacturers.

data.name: NeverLight
data.detailed_description:
ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST

Be first to know when the Beta or Early Access hunt begins. Get notified about launch, sales, and major updates as we journey deeper into the endless night.


About the Game

Demons conquered the world, plunging it into an endless apocalyptic darkness. The last survivors fled into the Underworld, an ancient realm deep beneath the surface. There, you discovered the lost Sanctuary—and a magical artifact that can banish the apocalypse above, restoring daylight for a precious, limited time. As the artifact's power weakens, the demons gradually return to reclaim what belongs to them. Complete your mission, gather vital resources, and reach extraction before the darkness consumes everything—including you.

🌑 SURVIVE THE DAY/NIGHT CYCLE

The artifact restores the natural day/night cycle to the world above. Initially it lasts only 1 day (~20-30 minutes). Upgrade it to extend surface time to multiple days (~40-60+ minutes), unlocking harder content and greater rewards.

☀️ DAY — EXPLORE & CONQUER
  • Navigate a handcrafted map with diverse biomes: burned villages, dark forests, swamps, apocalyptic ruins, and caves
  • Discover randomized Points of Interest with powerful rewards
  • Complete mission objectives: rescue survivors, gather resources, eliminate threats
  • Battle roaming monsters and loot equipment, materials, and secrets

🌙 NIGHT — DEMONS RULE
  • Demon Patrols hunt survivors across the map
  • Hell Portals spawn waves of attackers
  • Night Monsters emerge from the shadows
  • Find defensible positions, use stealth, or fight until sunrise

💀 DARKNESS RETURNS — EXTRACT OR DIE
When the artifact expires, the apocalypse returns with a shrinking safe zone. You have 5 minutes to reach extraction before the darkness reclaims the world, bringing the most powerful demons with it.

⚔️ BUILD YOUR HUNTER


6+ character classes planned, each with distinct combat identity and progression:
  • 4 Active Ability Slots — Define your role (damage, control, support, mobility)
  • Skill Tree — Permanent progression unlocking new active and passive abilities
  • Diverse Weapon Types — Swords, bows, staves, axes, daggers, and more
  • Dual Weapon Sets — Switch between Primary and Alternative weapons during combat
  • 6 Consumable Slots — Potions, buffs, and tactical items
  • Gear & Loot — Weapons, Rings, Amulets, and Talismans with rarity tiers and randomized effects

🎲 ROGUELITE ELEMENTS


⚡ SINS — TEMPORARY POWER
Collect up to 7 Sins during each run—powerful temporary upgrades that dramatically alter your playstyle:
  • Boost core stats (damage, speed, health, resistances)
  • Modify how your abilities function (additional effects, changed mechanics, new combos)
  • Stack multiple Sins to create unique builds each session
  • Experiment with combinations to discover powerful synergies

💀 DEATH & CONSEQUENCES
Die on the surface and you lose All Sins and your Current Inventory.

However:
  • Your lost inventory can be reclaimed — Find your dropped loot in future runs
  • Character progression is permanent — Skill tree upgrades stay with you
  • Crafting materials are safe — Resources for base building are never lost

Every death is a setback, not a restart. Your permanent progression ensures you're always moving forward.

🏰 UPGRADE YOUR SANCTUARY

Return to your Underworld base between missions to progress:

🔨 BUILD FACILITIES
  • Crafting Stations — Forge gear from discovered blueprints
  • Vendors — Purchase equipment and materials
  • Training Halls — Unlock abilities and skill tree upgrades

🧑 RESCUE SURVIVORS
Bring NPCs back from the surface to unlock specialist vendors, questgivers, master crafters, and story progression.

✨ UPGRADE THE ARTIFACT
The ultimate progression goal—extend your surface time from 1 day to multiple days, accessing new content and greater challenges.

📦 PERMANENT STASH
Successfully extracted loot is safely stored. Death means losing your current inventory, but your stash remains intact.

🗺️ HANDCRAFTED WORLD, RANDOMIZED CONTENT

Fixed geography lets you learn terrain and plan routes. Randomized Points of Interest ensure every session feels fresh—ancient structures, mythical shrines, and power nodes spawn in different configurations.

Mission variety includes rescue operations, resource gathering, target elimination, zone exploration, and artifact recovery.

Secret rewards await those who explore: hidden caches, environmental puzzles, locked zones requiring special keys, and rare materials in dangerous locations.

📖 UNFOLDING STORY

You are among the few who survived the apocalypse. While seeking refuge through underground rivers, you discovered a hidden waterfall concealing the Order's lost Sanctuary—and their artifact.

The Order fought demons for generations before falling in the final battle. They left maps to secret surface exits and one last tool to push back the darkness.

Activate it. Find survivors. Gather what you need. Discover what remains of your world.

And perhaps find a way to reclaim it.

🛠️ FULL MODDING SUPPORT

Host dedicated servers with complete customization. Create and share:
  • Custom character classes and abilities
  • New weapons, gear, and items
  • Points of Interest and structures
  • Enemy types and boss encounters
  • Mission types and objectives
  • Game rules and difficulty modifiers

🌙 WISHLIST NOW

Add NeverLight to your Wishlist. Humanity's counterattack begins soon.

data.name: Scary Teacher 3D
data.detailed_description:
Scary Teacher 3D puts you in the role of a mischievous student determined to outsmart your terrifying scary teacher, Miss T, by setting up hilarious pranks in her house.

Gameplay Highlights:

Explore & Prank: Navigate a detailed 3D environment, find clues, and execute creative traps to annoy Miss T.

Stay Stealthy: Avoid detection as Miss T patrols, sets traps, and locks doors to catch you.

Solve Puzzles: Use logic and timing to complete tasks and unlock new pranks across different levels.

Dynamic Challenges: Each level introduces fresh obstacles keeping you on your toes.

Laugh & Strategize: Experience the thrill of suspense mixed with humor as you watch Miss T’s over-the-top reactions.

With engaging puzzles, unpredictable challenges, and endless pranking fun, Scary Teacher 3D delivers a unique mix of strategy, humor, and stealth action. Can you stay ahead of the Scary Teacher?

data.name: Be a Pirate
data.detailed_description:
Be a Pirate - a game about a small but brave pirate, whose goal is to collect all the coins and escape faster.

At first glance, the goal is quite simple: to run from door to door, but not everything is so easy. On the way, you need to collect all the coins, sometimes they are hidden and you need to find them, solving riddles and completing tasks, while your time is limited, and at every step enemies are waiting for you - other ruthless pirates, guns, whales eating bombs, live cucumbers. Also, you can perform additional tasks, finishing off all the enemies on the map with your bombs to earn more stars per level.
A platformer type game made in pixel art with a side view.

What awaits you in this game:

< 25 different levels

< 6 unique enemies
< atmosphere of heavy pirate everyday life
< interesting logic tasks and riddles
< good background music

data.name: 鹿易想要活到世界尽头
data.detailed_description:
20XX年，人类为了探索宇宙的奥秘，将长颈鹿塞进太空船，决定让鹿氏族做一次无限期的长久太空旅行。
30XX年，鹿易诞生后不久，飞船坠落异星，但此时的长颈鹿氏族，已经因为长期宅在飞船里，四肢退化，只有脖子还能灵活运动。
为了生存，鹿易打开舱门，选择用仅存的运动能力，在异星存活。。。

好想活到世界尽头啊！

游戏中玩家通过鼠标移动控制鹿易摆动脖子移动身体，左键挥舞武器战斗或在空中调整姿态。
游戏因为开发时间比较短，暂时只有一个关卡主题也就是森林，和一个boss，通关后获得分数进行全球排名~
分数与战斗中击杀的外星人和通关时间挂钩，努力获得更高的分数吧！

这是两个人非常短时间做出来的小品游戏！希望可以在生活闲暇带给大家一丝欢乐~
我们已经开始制作新的作品了，想要关注的可以加QQ群1128505960哦~

data.name: Out of the ground
data.detailed_description:
Strange things happen on a mysterious island, whence out of nowhere, evil spirits begin to crawl out of the ground and you, the greedy pirate "Redbeard", are sent to this island to figure out what's wrong. Dark filth is growing in the depths of the island, threatening to turn the entire island into a decaying cemetery of the dead! You have to eradicate all evil spirits, otherwise the island and you will fall.

The game is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements. Find yourself on the island, travel around the location, destroy enemies, use all available weapons and get to the pirate ship to go further. The game world is divided into different levels, which will open as you progress through the story.

In Out of the ground, find a way to stop the spread of corruption on the island by fighting hordes of undead, thugs and feel the effects of corruption on yourself.

Game Features:
- Nice pixel graphics
- Huge game world
- Interesting tasks

data.name: Macrolens: The Slimes
data.detailed_description:
Macrolens: The Slimes simulates a camera’s perspective watching a slime in a small garden corner. You can control the yellow slime, move around, and play mini-games to collect Earth Energy.

With its cute visuals, the game can sit in the corner of your screen. It includes a Pomodoro timer, music player, and notes feature to help you relax and work more efficiently.

Hold right-click to move the slime around the scene.

Bring mini-slimes into your garden and raise them. The scenery will be so bustling!

There are plenty of fun little things to interact with in the scene

You can play cassette tapes in the game, or import your own .mp3 or .ogg files into the folder to play your own music.

One scene just for playing music and… letting everything sit there. Added a slider to adjust the time of day.

You can go fishing, but you’ll have to wait a bit for a bite.

Featured mini-games:

Card Showdown,

Little Purple Demon Battle

Slide Puzzle

Jigsaw Puzzle

You can take notes and manage checklists right in-game.

Pomodoro timer 

Can’t decide? Leave it to chance!

Infinite Bullet Hell: The battle against the UFOs.

data.name: Hollow Parish: Dead Frequency
data.detailed_description:
You are not a hunter. You are the voice in the earpiece.

You sit in an old house at the edge of the parish. You have an archive, a board of open cases, a radio — and people who drive into the dark instead of you. You will never see what they meet out there. You will only hear it.

Day — the investigation

Cases do not arrive labelled "ghost". They arrive as testimony: cold spots, missing livestock, marks on a threshold, a child speaking in someone else's voice. You work the archive and assemble a theory out of evidence.

Evidence lies. Some of it is conclusive, some contradicts itself, and some mimics another signature entirely. A developed branch of the archive filters false signals — an undeveloped one sends your team out nearly blind.

And not every call is a monster. Sometimes the case is empty. Sometimes it is a person, and that is worse.

The loadout — what a decision costs

You choose who goes and what they carry. Hunters have perks, injuries, loyalty, and a breaking point. You know Remy should not go tonight, and you send Remy anyway, because there is no one else.

Success does not follow from a strong team. It follows from a correct investigation. Send veterans on a wrong theory and lose all of them. Send rookies on a right one and bring everyone home.

Night — the radio

At night the lights go down and what is left is a desk, a lamp, and a blinking light on the radio. They call in from the site. A voice describes what it is looking at and asks what to do. You have seconds.

You answer from what you know. If you called it a vampire and it is a demon, your answer kills someone who trusted you. Then the line breaks. Sometimes you hear it break.

In the morning you see what you did

The team comes back changed, or does not come back. You keep that ledger yourself: who is whole, who is broken, who is gone, and which of your decisions did it.

Then a new case appears on the board.

How it ends

One campaign runs from the first call to the last. The final threat is an entity of unknown type, and that type changes every campaign — the ending cannot be memorised. On the last night three channels are live at once and every surviving hunter is in the field. You cannot be everywhere.

Good to know

  • A single-player campaign of 22 days, played from one desk.

  • The horror is never shown. It exists as a voice, a text, and a piece of evidence.

  • Hunters who die stay dead. The campaign continues without them.

  • Fully playable in English and Russian — interface and subtitles.

data.name: Voidsayer
data.detailed_description:
Voidsayer is a dark monster-taming jRPG, set in a world cursed by the Abyss. As its malevolent influence spreads and consumes the world, take on the role of a valiant warrior and fight back using over one hundred types of powerful tameable monsters. Refine their power with gear, special effects, and of course, evolve them into higher classes of monsters. Cross a vast interconnected world full of challenges and random events, all procedurally generated to ensure no two playthroughs are the same.

This is the classic turn-based jRPG monster tamer with multiple modern twists on the gameplay and an uncompromising approach to difficulty: Every fight is a challenge, every random event is a risk of crippling your team, and resources are extremely limited in a dark, cursed world where everything will eventually be consumed by the Abyss.



Or will it?

  • Dark, Complex Monster Taming: Each of the one hundred monsters you can catch is defined by a sophisticated stat system, which includes genetic predispositions and distinct personalities affecting their performance. Each can be further tuned and enhanced with carefully selected gear and other upgrades. They will need it, even if they evolve into higher forms.

  • Challenging Turn-Based Combat: Monsters are one side of the coin. The other is a large catalog of attack moves, effects, passives, combined with an easy to understand type system. Grass is beaten by fire, but fire is beaten by water - and it doesn't affect just damage dealt, but can dramatically change the course of battle. Strategic thinking and creative tactics are essential to victory.

  • Procedurally-Generated Levels Full of Twists: Every level is unique, with a generated map combining countless random encounters, pitched battles, and unforeseen events that can dramatically alter the gameplay. Your carefully-prepped and upgraded team might suddenly suffer injury - or trigger an abyssal distortion with severe consequences. Or... Maybe you'll encounter an opportunity that will require careful consideration of your options.

  • Bespoke, Powerful Bosses: A boss is not just a particularly powerful monster. Every boss is confronted at the end of a dedicated level, full of unique challenges reflecting their might. They range from tweaking the underlying gameplay slightly to completely upending gameplay you're used to, forcing your monsters to adapt - or die.

  • Settlement System: Hope is not yet completely snuffed out, as some human settlements still exist, strongholds of humanity against the encroaching Abyss. Your base of operations can be upgraded with materials brought back from each expedition, upgrading buildings to enhance their functionality or unlock new ways to tackle the Abyssal threat.

data.name: Blooby Block
data.detailed_description:
Help Block rescue his friends from the terrible bluebies in this puzzle adventure. To do this, you must solve puzzles by pushing rocks, avoiding enemies and traps, and using spells.

This cube pushing puzzle Game is an evolution of the clasic sokoban and box pushing puzles with a multilevel 3D environment. Enemies, spells and traps add another level of complexity to the puzles. After the some initial simple levels, the difficulty grows fast, and the puzles become unforgiving, sometimes even frustrating. You will need to be smart if you want to help Block.

This game includes:
-120 original levels with increasing difficulty
-4 different types of enemies
-3 kinds of traps
-4 different spells
Just play whenever you feel like it and enjoy the different puzzles you will encounter along your journey.

data.name: Deadhunt
data.detailed_description:
Deadhunt is a first-person arcade shooter (FPS) game that merges the best features of arcade and FPS action games with fresh ideas and new twists.

An addictive 3D-shooter game where you consistently develop your character by killing endless monsters and getting bonuses. Stay as long as possible on fighting pits against hordes of zombies and skeletons.

Features:
- Non-stop adrenaline-pumping gameplay
- 4 episodes with total of 40 missions
- Two additional modes: Survival and Greed
- Armed combat against multiple enemies
- Three classes of monsters with 50 kinds of weapons
- Unique system of monster destruction
- Seven varieties of weapons plus grenades
- 10 runes and 37 bonuses, including Slowdown, Double Damage, Nuke
- Remote picking of bonuses, runes and weapons
- 10 varieties of monsters' armor
- 15 original soundtracks
- Four difficulty levels

***

The game was released in 2005.

data.name: Wide Ocean Big Jacket
data.detailed_description:
An aunt and uncle take their middle-school niece and her boyfriend on an overnight camping trip in WIDE OCEAN BIG JACKET

Take part in a classic camping trip: Roast hot dogs on the fire, go birdwatching, tell ghost stories, grab a beverage from the cooler and do cartwheels on the beach.

WOBJ is a short story game including 20 chapters, 4 playable characters, 10,000 words of dialog and 8 explorable areas, all rendered in a beautiful 2D/3D art style.

\

Playtime: 60-90 minutes
(like watching a good movie with friends or curling up to read a book)

\

Made in 2019 by Turnfollow

\\

CW: Includes a scene in which an adult and a tween have a (platonic) conversation about sex and consent. Also a scene depicting older teenagers verbally assaulting tweens.

Coin War is a multiplayer party game where players take on the role of penguins in a virtual world and compete against each other. Each round, players are assigned unique roles and complete various missions to earn coins. Use your coins to invest in stocks, grow your fortune, and become the wealthiest player.

However, building your fortune is not an easy task. Other players are also competing for wealth and can disrupt your plans in various ways. You may be ambushed while collecting coins or encounter unexpected events that force you to change your strategy. At the same time, you can sabotage your opponents and gain an advantage through clever tactics.

The stock market constantly fluctuates throughout the game, and knowing when to buy or sell can determine the outcome of the match. Whether you choose a safe investment strategy or take greater risks for higher rewards, every decision can change your fate.

With strategic investments and intense competition between players, the player with the highest total assets at the end of the game becomes the winner.

Features

  • A party game combining mission-based gameplay and investment strategies

  • A real-time fluctuating stock market system

  • Psychological warfare through player sabotage and interference

  • Unpredictable matches shaped by strategy and luck

  • Unique gameplay experiences with different roles every round

  • Strategic asset management through a taxation system

data.name: Direct Investigation
data.detailed_description:
Direct Investigation (직접조사)

Seoul, 2035. In a city where the line between real and fake has all but dissolved, one man's job is to draw it again.

Seoul, 2035.

Autonomous taxis glide by in silence. The fluorescent lights of unmanned convenience stores burn until dawn. On the giant outdoor screens, AI persona celebrities smile without blinking. People no longer bother to verify whether the voice on the other end of the line is really their friend — not because they can't, but because they've long since realized it doesn't make much difference either way.

Park Eunkyul is the man who verifies the things nobody wants verified.

Isu Information Integrity Consulting. A six-pyeong office with a single private investigator's license framed on the wall. By day, he takes on corporate internal audits, deepfake authentication, voice forgery analysis. By night, together with his longtime partner Sungjae, he handles a different kind of work. The kind that leaves no paperwork. The kind the public isn't meant to know about.

What he does can be reduced to one thing. He investigates directly. He does not trust the screen. He does not trust the document. He does not even trust what the witness tells him, not at face value. He goes to the site, and he sees with his own eyes.

It began with ninety seconds.

Late one night, power across the greater Seoul area cuts out for exactly ninety seconds. In that brief silence, the servers of Ondam — the nation's leading conversational AI platform — are breached, and vast troves of personal data are stolen. For a few days the press blames foreign actors. The public soon forgets. Eunkyul is ordered not to.

An erased trace. People who remember the same night differently. A target with no reason to be a target. One clue leads to another, and Eunkyul is pulled deeper and deeper in.

And the things he had been so certain of, one by one, begin to fall away.

What Kind of Game Is 〈Direct Investigation〉?

◆ A three-hour walk through Seoul's cold night. Read. Observe. Deduce. There is no spectacle here — only tension built out of silence and negative space. The real dialogue begins in what the characters don't say.

◆ Everything, through Eunkyul's eyes. A first-person text adventure. What he cannot see, you cannot see. What he believes, you believe — until the moment that belief no longer holds.

◆ Once for the case. A second time for the truth. Lines you glossed over. Objects in the background. A character's small, offhand habit. On your second playthrough, they will read as something else entirely. The story was designed to be replayed.

◆ A noir for the age of AI. In Korean, from Seoul. Seoul, 2035. Incidents unfold beside the convenience store shelves, in the back seat of a driverless cab, in the last car of the pre-dawn subway. This is not the spectacle of a distant future city — it is the story of the streets you'll be walking tomorrow night.

◆ Three hours. One breath. No branching paths, no mandatory second playthrough. From the moment you sit down, it plays out like a single film, straight through to the end. But when those three hours are over, you will already be starting the game again.

data.name: Talaire
data.detailed_description:
Talaire is a fast-paced competitive multiplayer party game where up to 6 players go head-to-head in

skill-based mini-games.

After a rescue mission left them permanently stranded on a crumbling lunar base, six

astronauts must work together to fix their ship. They have also become a wee bit delusional falling

for a rock with a wig, the Moon Princess.

Each 8-minute round is a scramble to claim tasks from a shared repair pool, zip across the lunar

base on your trusty office chair, and complete mini-games before your rivals. The winner gains the

points and affection multiplier. Each tasks have different points and multipliers, so you must choose

strategically. Arrive at a task with another player, opt for the easy mode over the hard mode to finish

earlier but with decreased points and multiplier.

Visit the base merchant to stock up on items between tasks. Items grant you buffs such as Turbo-

boosting your chair or give you traps/debuffs for your opponents. Debuffs included inverted controls,

uncontrollable spinning, and speed caps.

Play in a private group with friends or public area with players and/or bots

Additional feature:

Racing Mode: Chair racing around the spaceship. Enjoy the competition with bots and friends.

data.name: pearlessential
data.detailed_description:
AN EXAM LIKE NO OTHER.

Uncover the mysteries surrounding a rather peculiar exam in this exploration-focused RPG.

Take charge of seven student Divers amid their comprehensive certification exam. Situated in the allo-dimensional magi-tech nation of Euphoria, work your way to a passing grade against all odds. Encounter tenacious beasts, amusing characters, and intriguing environments as you EXPLORE, PREPARE, and BATTLE!

q1. ✦⭑

ACROSS THE PLANES OF REALITY.

Delve into another world, one which has been superimposed upon your own. Navigate through various locales and interact with their inhabitants. On your way discover new skills, weapons, and more to prepare for what's to come.

q2.a ✦⭑

COMPREHEND, FORMULATE AND IMPROVISE.

Grasp at the unfamiliar scenes around you and hone in on what’s important. Select from seven characters to assemble a three-unit party to your liking. Equip them with skills and gear of your choosing from that which you’ve discovered on your adventure.

q2.b ✦⭑

TO OVERCOME WHAT OBSTRUCTS.

Press forth past those unwilling to negotiate. Using force if necessary in a traditional turn-based battle system. But there are no levels or experience points. Explore further, discover more, and use your spoils of war to better equip yourself for future confrontations.

q2.c ✦⭑

Features

  • An isometric Euphoria. Explore a monosaturated environment filled with all sorts of characters, encounters, platforming, and more.

  • Filled with knowledge and instruments. Discover new skills, weapons, and so forth to help you on your journey.

  • With seven unique playable characters. Carefully balance their strengths and weaknesses to prepare a bespoke team.

This game is currently in development. Details on this page and other important aspects of the game may change before release.

data.name: Legends Of Iona RPG (2007 arcade mod)
data.detailed_description:
Play as Zaak, a young man trapped in an ancient underground world. He must face many dangers in order to escape. However, during his adventures, Zaak will awaken a past long-lost forgotten…

Before You Rate the Game, Please Read:

This is a late publishing of a 2006-2007 arcade video game afterwards, adapted for the Windows PC keyboard and controllers. This is why the controls and camera might seem different from standard games. The game was built by passionate fans of Phantasy Star (1987 Sega (c)) and volunteers. Ok, now let's have fun and play!
*** Press CTRL or press right bottom joystick for FREE CAMERA *** (We added this in case you need to look around!).

To Start:

Talk to the first guard to start your quests. There is a button (lower right) for the list of QUESTS to do. This game is aimed at quests and discovery, not complicated battle systems. If you like battles, for more information, turn on the BATTLELOG. You must play at least dungeon 3/5 to unlock all special attacks.

Features:

  • 5 giant levels filled with dungeons, treasures, monsters and open spaces with a lot of important characters to meet and help through enjoyable quests.
  • Story-line, species, and characters are well-developed serves as foretold of the upcoming MMO Worlds Of Iona.
  • The atmosphere of this game takes the best gameplay seen in RPG's from the '80s and '90s merged with modern gameplay and wide areas.
  • Different gameplay: traditional spells and skills gameplay is now combinations of Ionix crystals and special armor and weapons crafting.
  • Unlock 3 special attack combo moves.
  • Similar to old school RPG's, this game is an average 30+ hours of gameplay. There is no blood/gore in this game.

We were on the verge of upgrading the 3C: camera, control and a new and better animated character, but development was on hold with this version of the game with Unity3D. Maybe we will remake this game better completely in Unreal at a later time. Nevertheless, it is a very good indie game, enjoy! :-)
data.about_the_game:
Play as Zaak, a young man trapped in an ancient underground world. He must face many dangers in order to escape. However, during his adventures, Zaak will awaken a past long-lost forgotten…

Before You Rate the Game, Please Read:

This is a late publishing of a 2006-2007 arcade video game afterwards, adapted for the Windows PC keyboard and controllers. This is why the controls and camera might seem different from standard games. The game was built by passionate fans of Phantasy Star (1987 Sega (c)) and volunteers. Ok, now let's have fun and play!
*** Press CTRL or press right bottom joystick for FREE CAMERA *** (We added this in case you need to look around!).

To Start:

Talk to the first guard to start your quests. There is a button (lower right) for the list of QUESTS to do. This game is aimed at quests and discovery, not complicated battle systems. If you like battles, for more information, turn on the BATTLELOG. You must play at least dungeon 3/5 to unlock all special attacks.

Features:

  • 5 giant levels filled with dungeons, treasures, monsters and open spaces with a lot of important characters to meet and help through enjoyable quests.
  • Story-line, species, and characters are well-developed serves as foretold of the upcoming MMO Worlds Of Iona.
  • The atmosphere of this game takes the best gameplay seen in RPG's from the '80s and '90s merged with modern gameplay and wide areas.
  • Different gameplay: traditional spells and skills gameplay is now combinations of Ionix crystals and special armor and weapons crafting.
  • Unlock 3 special attack combo moves.
  • Similar to old school RPG's, this game is an average 30+ hours of gameplay. There is no blood/gore in this game.

We were on the verge of upgrading the 3C: camera, control and a new and better animated character, but development was on hold with this version of the game with Unity3D. Maybe we will remake this game better completely in Unreal at a later time. Nevertheless, it is a very good indie game, enjoy! :-)
data.short_description: Zaak is trapped! Retro five-level dungeon crawler, hack and slash. Focus on the quests-story, get Ionix crystals for special attacks to exit the dungeon! Role-playing arcade joystick game converted for the PC. (Dev by fans of Phantasy Star 1987)

data.name: Alexio
data.detailed_description:
Does anything be better than party whit a friends at weekend, when you have the Quacktendo Entertainment System and cool game for it?! Join to our party and take a gamepad, buddy! If you are with us let’s play Alexio a proven hit, you will like it!

So, listen. Alexio is a retro platformer about the youthful duckling Alex. On his sixth birthday, his father imparts upon him knowledge of the Monobrow, which prompts the young Alex to hit the road. Together with Alex, you must travel through flower meadows, lakes, forests, mountains, caverns and ancient ruins to reach the coveted shrine, where only glory awaits. Well, what are you waiting for? Let's begin our journey! Push START!



Game features:
  • Time-tested gameplay with some special game mechanics.
    Too hard? Try the "birdie mode"!
  • 12 levels in 6 different locations each with their own features
  • Several types of headgear granting our hero with different abilities
  • Many secrets and collectable items

data.name: Kromaticube
data.detailed_description:
KROMATICUBE is a simple arcade game where you have to avoid obstacles while listenning to chiptune musics. Stay alive for at least 60 seconds to complete a level. It is designed for tryharder gamers and all retro gaming lovers.

Each level has it own chiptune music and ramdomly generated obstacles.

-----

Features List

  • 6 different levels with their own atmosphere
  • 25 different patterns and obstacles
  • Infinite scoring possible

Addictive

Technically you can finish the game in only 6 minutes BUT you need to practice a lot before reaching a satisfying level of skills and reflexes. Kromaticube is an alchemy between music and obstacles. A great person said "Just because you fail once, doesn’t mean you’re gonna fail at everything", and this is the point Kromaticube.

Satisfying

Kromaticube is a really good game for training your brain reflexes. It's all about learning patterns while discovering new atmospheres. Each level is about one ne particular feeling like joy, sadness or fear for example.

data.name: Faerie's Bargain: The Price of Business
data.detailed_description:
Become the greatest of the goblin merchants in a magical market beneath Victorian London that trades in memories, wishes, secrets, and more. Will you line your pockets, defend the Queen, or plot to put a puppet on the Throne?

Faerie’s Bargain: The Price of Business is a 291,000-word interactive fantasy novel by Trip Galey where your choices control the story. It’s entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

You are a merchant of the Untermarkt, the goblin market that has existed beneath London since High Queen Elizabeth first forged the Treaty with Titania, Queen of Faery. You are skilled in dealing in all manner of impossibilities: new faces and voices, silks spun of starlight, bottled time, twists of fate, and other stranger things. Devote yourself to growing your wealth, or use it for political, social, and magical advantage. If a rival merchant threatens you, fight back with wits and wisdom, or ruthless, underhanded tricks. It’s all in a day’s work.

When a mysterious business opportunity takes you by surprise, you have the chance to deal in something new: political intrigue! High Queen Victoria sits upon the Throne, but there are many who would prefer to rule in her place. Do you defend the status quo or use your newfound wealth to fund a little revolution? Your fellow merchants certainly won’t allow an opportunity for profit to slip away. Do you undercut their efforts at the Merchant Conclave, or ignore all the politicking in favor of growing your wealth? Whatever you decide, one thing is certain: It’s time to get down to business!


  • Play as male, female, or non-binary; gay, straight, bisexual, pansexual; asexual and/or aromantic.
  • Play as mostly-human, mostly-faery, or an even balance between the two, and shift the levels between the two extremes as the tory progresses.
  • Make an alliance with a sentient aspect of reality such as Roses, Mirrors, or the Fog of London!
  • Romance—or betray!—a socialite, a Lord, a Lady, maybe even your Supernatural Ally!
  • Make deals with creatures both fey and mortal; trade in favors, memories, magic, bottled time, twists of fate, and more!
  • Attend society balls and grand galas, investigate scheming nobles, and defend (or betray) the Empire from threats without and within!
  • Advocate for the rights of children trapped in factories and labor contracts, or exploit their plight for your own gain.
  • Play politics to bolster or break the relationship between the Empire and Faery, to make your own fortune, or to put a puppet on the Throne!

data.name: Reverse Defenders
data.detailed_description:
- Many "one more time" for you.

How you prepare your defenses is key to victory in this game. Pair your unit's skills and abilities with items well to turn the tide of battle in your favor.
You'll need to know your stuff because the timeline of the world is ever-shifting.
All you need to have a good time is careful thought and consideration.
In fact, it doesn't take long to clear a run, though a grand adventure awaits if you pursue the perfect run.
Either way, this game is sure to satisfy that tower defense itch you've been waiting for!

- Flip the Script on Failures

Don't let the cute art fool you; this game is chock full of challenging stages.
Getting to the end won't be easy.
Failures and setbacks will prepare you for the road ahead, so take what you can learn from them to rethink your strategies and try, try again.
With a myriad of ways to build your defenses, you are free to devise your own unique way to victory.
Reverse Defenders is sure to keep you thinking to the very end. Stick it through, and this game is certain to be a gaming experience that boosts the confidence of both newcomers and veterans alike.

  • Flipsides Bring Potential:
    In this game, each unit in your defense lineup can have different classes on the front and back "side" of them. Reverse Defenders brings near limitless possibilities to explore since each front class will be affected by a unit's Flipside class and vice versa. Get in the zone and create brilliant real-time combinations by flipping your units to beat back the hordes of monsters.

  • Strategize and Prepare:
    On each run, the world resets which gives you ample opportunities to try out different rewards from overworld chests. Finding out which ones you like with every subsequent playthrough is part of the fun.

  • Satisfying Challenges:
    Every stage has a solution, but sometimes it might not come to you the first time around. There's nothing quite as satisfying as tweaking your defense strategy till you get things just right.

  • Timing is Everything:
    Each unit needs to be switched between Meditation and Attack modes. Things can get pretty hairy when trying to maximize Meditation gains because you don't want to let enemies get past and wreck your life total. Timing everything to a T will give you a real thrill.

  • Experience Exciting Gameplay:
    Brute forcing your way through with the same strategy just won't work. Each stage delivers new and interesting challenges. Never a dull moment with the stage variety on offer in Reverse Defenders.

  • A Flipping FUN Game:
    Reverse Defenders is designed to be as unobtrusive to repeated playthroughs as possible. It is a game, after all, so we made it a breeze to pick up and retry as many times as you like.

  • Brainbusting Challenges:
    Reverse Defenders will flip your lid and push the boundaries of how you approach situations. After all, mindfully reflecting on failures is an important part of learning. Reverse Defenders is for all ages. It's a game that gets your brain thinking! Don't flip a coin! Give this game a shot.

- Sound

Sera Mikaru, best known for Airman ga Taosenai, composed the Reverse Defenders soundtrack.
He also created the Vocaloid-style voice that you hear upon activating Resonance.

- Story

Oh no! Sasha Sweetvanilla and Aria Murphy somehow got sucked into the game world.
Could there be some evil mastermind behind it all?
Only one way to find out. Time to get your game face on!

- Video streaming

You are free to post and stream videos of this game.
It would be helpful if you could include the game title, a link to this page and hashtag.

- hashtag
#ReverseDefenders
#RDstream

*Please note that mouse operation is not supported at this time.
