data.name: Peculiar Tales of Mid-Lake Pavilion
data.detailed_description:
"Peculiar Tales of Mid-Lake Pavilioni" is a collection of five short word games produced by Zhi Yi.
Subjects include ghost stories, urban legends, sci-fi suspense, warm love, etc.




【Midsummer Night·Last Train】
"I" who is confused about the future, stays away from parents who keep arguing and wanders on the streets all day.
Should have been sitting on the last subway that day, going home as usual.
Unexpectedly, I encountered an unexpected accident...
On the last midsummer night of high school, the reunion of boys and girls.
The observed future--


【Ghost Tower】
"Under the mysterious ancient pagoda are buried treasures from the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom era."
The protagonist Beichuan strayed into the ghost tower by chance.
Entangled by ghosts, he was rescued by a Taoist priest at a critical moment.
But since then it became possible to see things that shouldn't exist in the world.
The truth of this curse is...?


【Ratman】
The protagonist wakes up and finds that he is imprisoned in a dark iron box.
With a splitting headache, he received a call.
"Call in half an hour to get enough for two million, or I'll crush you."
He who was told so.
Picked up the phone by his side and began his journey to survive ......


[Mirror Room]
The protagonist is poor and lives in a rumored murder house.
On a rainy night, the protagonist's college roommate comes to stay with him.
Mirrored hallucinations, inner entanglements.
Disgusting memories of the past make the atmosphere gradually become spooky ......


【Xiangsi Bridge】
This is a remake of special chapter of “The Adventure of Fei Duanmu” with new artwork and dubbing!
The story takes place in the ancient city of Gusu, Pingjiang Road.
It is about the first encounter between the popular heroine Jin Liu and Fei Duanmu.
Heavenly water town, warm story. Heal your heart.

data.name: Off The Tracks
data.detailed_description:
Combine a heap of chaos, some physics-based fun, a dash of fluid movement and some poorly driven trains, and what is the result? Off The Tracks - a chaotic physics-based first person platformer.

Make your way through each level competing with obstacles of varying and increasing difficulty, and if that doesn't sound difficult enough, you're on top of a terribly driven train carriage at high speed where the floor is lava, metaphorically.

Features

30 levels, 5 worlds.
Make your way through 30 individual levels on the top of poorly driven high-speed train carriages, what could go wrong, right?

Physics-based fun.
There is no such thing as physics bugs, and physics-based unpredictability only adds to the fun.

Full Controller Support.
Play in a way that suits you. Off The Tracks has full controller support and the ability to switch between mouse/keyboard and controller on the fly.

Global Leaderboards.
Each individual level has a high-score based global leaderboard to top. Remember, it's not just about being fast, you collect style points throughout the course of each level which contribute to your overall score.

data.name: Black Jacket
data.detailed_description:
The blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deck builder where you gamble your way out of hell, supercharge your deck and play impossible combos. 

BLACKJACK EVOLVED

Play Black Jack against the restless souls wandering the hellish afterlife. You play for their coin, and you’ll need lots of them to bribe the ferryman and escape. But watch your bet because this isn’t your regular game of Black Jack:

  • Stack your deck with powerful cards

  • Control the table, bend the rules, and beat the odds

  • Unlock near-infinite possibilities of card combinations and strategies with each run

  • Collect Artifacts, Card Suits, and Curses to get an edge over your opponents

  • Get to know your opponents, their stories, and yourself to break the cycle

POWERFUL CARDS

The cards will bend and change the rules of the game:

  • Force your opponent to overcommit

  • Increase and decrease their card values

  • Control their deck or peek into your own

  • Swap cards with your opponent

  • Uncover secret combinations within your deck

READ YOUR OPPONENTS

Learn to read your opponents and listen to their story unfold with every encounter:

  • Opponents are shown only through their hands

  • Familiarize yourself with their playstyle and curses

  • Deepen your relationship with them to break the cycle

data.name: A Brown Rabbit's Story
data.detailed_description:
A Brown Rabbit's Story is a minimalist, interactive storybook where different choices result in different outcomes. The game is primarily text-driven, and the player will have to read and make choices accordingly.

In an orphanage, a boy discovers that his old toy rabbit can move and speak. Playing in the perspective of the toy rabbit, you and the boy navigate the bleak, unforgiving orphanage life together, and uncover strange secrets hidden in the forest beyond the orphanage playground, where stone tablets whisper of ancient kings and forgotten wars....

Content Notice

Contains depictions and references to death, violence, bullying, child endangerment, and animals in peril.

data.name: X4: Foundations
data.detailed_description:
Start Small. Command Everything.

Your journey begins with a single ship - but what you become is up to you.

Trade, fight, explore, and build your way to power as you grow from a lone pilot into the leader of a vast space empire. Command fleets, manage resources, and shape the future of the galaxy through your decisions.

A Living, Simulated Universe

The universe of X4 is fully simulated and constantly evolving.

Factions trade, build, and wage war independently, reacting dynamically to both your actions and each other. Every station, ship, and economy is part of a living system that continues to grow - with or without your influence.

Build Your Empire

Construct space stations, establish trade networks, and control entire production chains.

Design and expand your infrastructure using a modular system, building stations that power your economy, manage supply chains, and automate production as your empire grows into a self-sustaining powerhouse.

Fight and Command

Engage in real-time combat and take direct control of your ships - or command entire fleets strategically.

From small skirmishes to large-scale battles, every encounter is shaped by your tactics and decisions.

A Universe in Motion

  • Thousands of ships and stations carry out their tasks
  • Factions build and expand stations
  • Trade routes evolve as the economy develops
  • Instigate war or broker peace through subterfuge and diplomacy

A Universe That Keeps Evolving

X4: Foundations continues to grow with major updates and expansions that introduce new systems, mechanics, and opportunities for players. Make the universe your own alongside a thriving modding community.

Whether you’re returning or starting fresh, there’s never been a better time to build your empire.

data.name: CounterShots 1.0
data.detailed_description:
CounterShots 1.0 is a very well-developed action game, from which you will get a lot of positive emotions. It is interesting to play CounterShots with friends, fighting for the best points in the game that you can score by killing opponents. For each killed enemy, you will receive his ammunition for your weapon in order to continue the battle, ammunition will lie located in the place of the killed enemy. Also, it is very important to monitor the Health indicator in the game, as there are many opponents, and you will receive medicine quite rarely in a random place on the map.

Opponents are not only well drawn, but also have a fairly high-quality intelligence, do not forget about it, two or more can start fighting with you right away, so consider the ammunition! The game has a pleasant landscape on which, with each launch, a random map is formed with obstacles, opponents, first-aid kits and ammunition.

Control the movement of your character in the game using the keys "W", "S", "A", "D", to open fire on the enemy, use the space key.

CounterShots was created primarily for those who love 2D games, withfriends you can have fun playing this game and creating disputes about who will score the best points or who will survive the longest.

Enjoy the Game!

The game has a pleasant landscape on which, with each launch, a random map is formed with obstacles, opponents, first-aid kits and ammunition.

Control the movement of your character in the game using the keys "W", "S", "A", "D", to open fire on the enemy, use the space key.

CounterShots was created primarily for those who love 2D games, withfriends you can have fun playing this game and creating disputes about who will score the best points or who will survive the longest.

Enjoy the Game!
data.short_description: CounterShots 1.0 is a very well-developed action game, from which you will get a lot of positive emotions. Fight for the best points in the game in the company of friends, in a pleasant landscape with opponents who have strong intelligence.

data.name: Carpe Noctem - Yuri Visual Novel

Carpe Noctem is a Gothic lesbian romance inspired by Castlevania and Sheridan Le Fanu's Carmilla.

This visual novel takes place in an alternate Victorian England plagued by creatures of the night. Adelaide Hadid, an orphan trained by The Church to slay monsters, is dispatched to a rural town to eliminate a powerful vampiress.

After a fateful duel with the seductive Cordelia, Adelaide finds herself growing closer to the vampiress and her charming maid, Lily. With her life suddenly beginning to change, the monster hunter must grapple with her conflicted feelings about her target and The Church...

data.name: Tranquil Isle
data.detailed_description:
While away the hours on the sunkissed shores of your own tiny paradise! Tranquil isle is a minimalist townbuilder, set on idyllic, randomly generated islands. The sun will rise and set as you work to grow your town to keep everything humming along nicely.

There’s no combat, no trading - just focus on making your little islands the best they can be.

The game has 2 main modes: Classic Mode, where players must strategically place buildings to build up your high score and unlock new buildings and islands, and sandbox mode for those looking to chill out and build purely for aesthetics and vibes. There's also a Daily challenge, where all players will play for a high score on the same fixed map.

  • A unique mix of townbuilder, roguelite and strategy mechanics. Each island is procedurally generated, offering a fresh challenge each time!

  • Relaxing gameplay that drops features like combat and trading in favour of a more chill, focused experience

  • Islands come with day/night cycles and different visual themes: grasslands, winter, desert, and more

data.name: The Island Story
data.detailed_description:
The Island Story is leisure simulation game. Players can change the appearance of the island by placing different animals, plants and decorative items freely. Plants and animals also produce fruit and dust resources for further exploration and play.

Island

  • The player has an unmanned island from the beginning, with some ruins and stone mountains on it, player will decide what the island will become.

Day Circle

  • The game time is based on 24 hours. There is a separate day and night system, including sunrise, sunset, and the absence of the moon, etc. The atmosphere of the sky and the environment will also change with different times of the day.

Placement

  • player can freely choose the animals and plants location in the game, decorative items can be Piled up and rotated.

Explore New Species

  • The game provides more than 50 plants, 20 animals and 30 decorative items from various continents.
  • Obtaining new species requires players to explore the world map. Entering 3 values in the exploration interface, which respectively represent the temperature, humidity, and sunlight. When the 3 values all meet a preset value of the system, players can obtain the samples of specific plants.
  • Each plant in the game will have a text prompt to tell players the approximate values.

Grow

Plants have their own unique lifespans. Each plant will slowly grow until it matures. After death, it will generate new animals and plants and start a new life.

data.name: Derange
data.detailed_description:
Welcome back to the world of Survival Horror...


May 2nd, 2002. A mysterious email from a long-lost mentor sends you traveling to an isolated Gothic estate in the primeval wilderness of rural Massachusetts. When you arrive, you find yourself dragged into a nightmare beyond comprehension, hunted by eldritch foes and forced to fight for survival in the aftermath of a terrible fate.

Derange is a retro-styled spiritual successor to the survival horror classics of the '90s. Immerse yourself in gameplay from a forgotten era of horror as you struggle to unravel a terrifying mystery and put an end to an evil that threatens existence itself.

Features

  • Traditional old-school survival horror, complete with fiendish puzzles, deadly enemies, inventory management and limited saves.
  • Play as college student Jessica King or tech whiz Nathan Romero, each with their own unique playstyle and personality.
  • Dynamic “Hive Mind System” which reacts to your playstyle: enemies get stronger, smarter or faster depending on how you play.
  • Multiple difficulty levels, for casual horror buffs and survival horror purists alike.
  • A haunting mystery to solve, inspired by the works of H.P Lovecraft and classic horror movies like The Thing.

data.name: The Witch Shoot
data.detailed_description:
ENTER THE BAYOU… OR BE CONSUMED BY IT

The Witch Shoot is a fast-paced Roguelite Bullet Hell where quick reflexes, powerful builds, and pure survival instinct are the only things standing between you and death.

Venture deep into a cursed swamp corrupted by dark voodoo magic, fight through relentless hordes of twisted creatures, and confront the one responsible for it all: the Voodoo Master who kidnapped your dog for a sinister ritual.

The Bayou is alive…

And it wants you dead.

RECLAIM WHAT WAS TAKEN FROM YOU

Descend into the depths of the haunted Bayou, where every new area becomes more dangerous than the last.

Face waves of enemies, storms of projectiles, and nightmarish creatures born from voodoo curses.
Every run is different — new rooms, new challenges, and new chances to create devastating combinations of abilities.

The deeper you go, the more brutal the fight becomes.

And the stronger you grow, the closer you get to saving your companion.

ADAPT OR SINK INTO THE SWAMP

The Bayou shows no mercy.

Collect resources, discover cursed powers, and create unique builds every run.

Adapt your playstyle, combine upgrades, and turn your character into a storm of destruction in the heart of the swamp.

But be warned…

The swamp is watching.

KEY FEATURES

• Intense Bullet Hell combat against hordes of cursed creatures
• Roguelite progression system with upgrades between runs
• Dozens of upgrades and abilities to create unique builds
• Enemies inspired by voodoo folklore and swamp horrors
• Powerful bosses guarding the darkest secrets of the Bayou
• Procedural generation, ensuring every run feels different

THE VOODOO MASTER AWAITS

Something terrible is being prepared deep within the swamp.

Your dog has been taken…
And you are the only thing standing between him and a ritual that should never be completed.

Enter the Bayou.
Fight the horrors within.
Break the curse.

And bring your friend home.

data.name: No One Here But Me
data.detailed_description:
You got a job as a night administrator at a small computer club. There aren't many visitors at night, and the job seems simple: keep order, serve customers, and close the club before morning.

But among the ordinary visitors, there are sometimes those who shouldn't be here.

CHECK THE VISITORS

Keep an eye on everyone who enters the club. Talk to customers, observe them, use the security cameras, and watch for anything unusual.

Not every anomaly reveals itself right away.

GET RID OF THE ANOMALIES

If you discover something abnormal, simply telling it to leave may not be enough.

Find the items you need, search for clues, and figure out how to force the anomaly to reveal its true form.

THE NIGHT ISN'T OVER YET

Finishing your shift successfully doesn't mean the night is over.

Some anomalies don't want to leave.

data.name: Possession
data.detailed_description:
Possession is a turn-based traditional roguelike where you play as a ghost trying to make your way to the surface. You are incredibly frail, but have one advantage: you can possess the bodies of the monsters you encounter, and use their strength and abilities as your own. Hop from body to body as you attempt to make it back to the surface.

Features:

Dozens of possessable monsters, from the horrifying to the hilarious, with a wide variety of powers.

Special themed levels with unique hazards, creatures and layouts. Randomly generated, and each floor has multiple possible levels, so each playthrough is different!

Item-less gameplay. The dead have no need for worldly possessions, they just slow you down.

Quick to pick up and play. Unlike most roguelikes, Possession doesn't require you to memorize dozens of weird key commands, or puzzle over confusing skill and ability lists before you start playing.

Entirely playable with just the keyboard, just the mouse, or a combination of the two.

Mod support! Add your own creatures, powers and special levels, or change the ones already there.

@ Choice between graphics or ASCII mode, for the oldschool roguelike fans.

Note: The "demo" is the full game. Feel free to play it as long as you want, but if you like the game, please purchase to support its creation. Purchasing also gives you a Steam key (though you can play for free on Steam as well).

data.name: Tales of Immortal Cultivation
data.detailed_description: Cultivation Chronicles is a strategy text-based RPG rooted in the culture of Xianxia (immortal cultivation). Begin as an ordinary mortal and step onto the path of cultivation, progressing through six major realms—Qi Refining, Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Spirit Transformation, and Ascension—to uncover the truth behind your family's destruction and ultimately ascend to the immortal realm. Unlock romance companions, construct your personal cave manor, and explore a vast world map. This is a slow-paced cultivation simulator, perfect for players who enjoy strategic planning and Xianxia-themed adventures. The Great Dao has three thousand paths—seize the moment, for your journey to immortality begins today.

data.name: Cosmic: A Journey Among Shadows
data.detailed_description:
ADD TO WISHLIST


About the Game

Cosmic, a small creature, is thrust into a shadowless realm teeming with monsters and mysteries. His only hope to return home? Reclaim his lost shadow. But in this dark, dangerous world, there’s a sinister figure who offers protection. Why are there no shadows here, and what secrets does this realm hide?

Explore the dark and treacherous Shadowland—a world where shadows hold the key to survival. Forge alliances with bizarre creatures, master new skills, and harness the power of light to battle hordes of demonic enemies. Unravel the mystery of your shadow’s disappearance, and discover the truth behind this strange land.

Experience smooth, fast-paced platforming in a richly designed 2.5D metroidvania, packed with intense combat and intricate movement challenges. Inspired by the best of the genre, every step takes you closer to the answers you seek—if you can survive.

FEATURES

▸Explore the dangerous Shadowland, a world divided into four unique realms: the enigmatic Riversoul, the unforgiving Crab Sands, the majestic Jellyfish Kingdom, and the perilous Grim Jungle. Each realm offers distinct challenges and mysteries to uncover as you fight for survival.

▸Engage in dynamic combat where agility is key! Fight, dodge, and jump as you chain together devastating attack combos. Harness the power of your ally—the shadow of a mighty beast—to overwhelm your foes. But remember, every shadow requires light to emerge...

▸Experience character development like never before! Collect darkflies, the magical energy source of Shadowland, to acquire new powers and unlock essential skills. Empower Cosmic to reach his true potential as you navigate this mysterious world.

▸Prepare for intense boss battles against formidable monsters! Employ diverse tactics to outmaneuver their deadly attacks and unleash your unique abilities to claim victory. Each encounter is a test of skill and strategy that will push you to your limits!

▸Secrets to uncover: the world you will explore is filled with hidden places and mysterious creatures. Some of them will be eager to help you, while others will expect something in return. Dive into the history of the Shadowland to better understand the events that led you there and gain knowledge that might prove useful in your journey.

Beware… you may never know what’s lurking behind the veil of shadows!

data.name: Contract Work
data.detailed_description:
Contract Work is a savage, sneak and shoot roguelike in a cyberpunk universe. Wreak havoc as a hi-tech mercenary freelancer: break into buildings, evade security, blow up enemy robots, then steal and destroy corporate assets. Earn profits from ever-more-challenging contracts, then use your hard earned cash to upgrade your cybernetic enhancements.



Unrelenting Combat: Vaporize robots with your portable laser cannon. Blow up foes with ammo ranging from micro rockets to high-explosive flechettes. Disable enemy security systems and program their robots to do your bidding.



Customize Your Freelancer: Build your own destiny. Your character is a blank slate with customizable traits to fit your playstyle. Want to be stealthy? Or go in guns blazing? It’s up to you, and you can choose a new mix of traits with each new game. Shop the black market to install and unlock up to 50 unique upgrades.



Dynamic Gameplay: Procedurally generated levels offer new challenges and opportunities with every play. A different run every time means limitless replayability.

data.name: Lawn Order
data.detailed_description:
🎃 NEW IN v0.15.0: HALLOWEEN AND THEN SOME

This started as the Halloween update and kept going. It's the biggest update since Early Access launched.

  • Two new jobs. The English Garden is a long back garden with a three-legged dog named Dogbro. The Ninth Floor is an office where a window broke and the whole floor filled up with leaves.

  • Spooky jobs. A new SPOOKY card on the Backyard and the Clearing takes you to Gnome Night or the Haunted Clearing, two Hardcore night jobs with their own leaderboards.

  • Bigger surroundings. The Backyard, the Churchyard and the Lot now sit in a real neighborhood, a foggy New England village and a city at night. The Hedge Maze got a makeover too.

  • Everything else. Rebuilt menus, rebindable controls, better controller support, real background sound on the levels, and a short How to Play guide for new play.

***

THE LEAVES ARE REAL. YOUR PATIENCE IS NOT.

Lawn Order is a first-person leaf blowing game. You get a blower, a yard full of leaves and a job to do.

I spent a ridiculous amount of time making the leaves move like real leaves, and it turns out that makes one of the most boring chores there is weirdly satisfying.

Clear the yard. Build a huge pile. Jump in it. Try not to launch a lawn chair through it.

🍂 THE LEAVES

Every leaf you blow is simulated on its own. They lift and race ahead of the air, tumble and flutter when they drop out of it, bank up against fences, fill corners and pile into heaps.

Sweep across the lawn and thousands of them go at once. Hold the blower on a pile and you can bore a hole straight through it. Hit it from the wrong side and you've just undone ten minutes of work.

🌬️ BLOW STUFF AROUND

Sticks, acorns, boxes, barrels, lawn chairs, laundry, office paper. If it's light enough, the blower moves it, usually somewhere worse.

Wind gusts can scatter a finished pile. Rain glues the leaves to the grass. Fire is its own problem: leaves burn, the wind carries the embers, and a campfire next to a leaf pile goes about how you'd expect.

🏡 THE JOBS

  • The Backyard. A suburban yard, an angry neighbor, and garden gnomes you really shouldn't break.

  • The Clearing. A bone-dry forest glade with a campfire that should not be anywhere near this many leaves.

  • The Churchyard. Fog, headstones and wet leaves that stick to everything. It's always raining here, and something about the place feels off.

  • The Lot. A parking lot on the night shift, two hundred stalls, and a drag racer who thinks the lanes are theirs.

  • The Hedge Maze. A topiary maze buried in leaves. Don't stay in one place too long.

  • The English Garden. A long back garden full of the neighbor's oak leaves. Go easy on the fence and the shed. They're both barely standing.

  • The Ninth Floor. Blow an entire office's worth of leaves back out the window they came in through.

Every job has three difficulties with their own pay and leaderboards, from Normal (hazards stay away) to Hardcore (hazards can end the job). Play solo or online co-op with up to four players.

🧰 TOOLS OF THE TRADE

  • The blower. You start with a small electric one. Earn enough and you can buy bigger blowers and nozzle tips for corners or wide sweeps.

  • The rake. For when you blew the pile into the wrong corner and need to drag it back.

  • The nut gatherer. Acorns are too heavy to blow. Roll this little cage over them and it picks them up.

  • The tarp. Blow the leaves onto it and bag them up.

🛣️ WHAT'S NEXT

Lawn Order is in Early Access because I want to keep finding dumber things to do with a very serious leaf simulation. Planned, not in the game yet:

  • More jobs, with new places, hazards and weather.

  • More gear, including a leaf vacuum and the mysterious AERO leaf conveyor.

  • Minigames with their own leaderboards, where shaving three seconds off your friend's time matters way more than it should.

  • More multiplayer modes, like Blower Curling and a climbing race.

  • Twitch integration, so viewers can dump leaves in a streamer's yard, mess with the wind and generally make things worse.

Plus whatever good ideas the community comes up with, and whatever bad ones I come up with.

🍁 WHY DOES THIS EXIST?

I wanted to make a game where blowing leaves around felt really, really good. So I spent an unreasonable amount of time making leaves behave like leaves.

Then I added weather. Then acorns. Then fire. Then an angry neighbor. Then ghosts.

Things got away from me.

The lawn is out of order. You know what to do.

data.detailed_description:
In “Duel Paean”, players will experience the most exhilarating third-person 3D platform multiplayer free-for-all combat! Get ready to engage in intense and exciting battles with players from around the world!

Combat Gameplay

Use a series of attacks and combos, judge the battlefield situation flexibly, and knock your opponents out of the arena through brilliant mind games! The meticulously designed combat system has a low entry threshold but a high skill ceiling. It allows you to easily master basic combat techniques while also improving your skills and mastering more advanced combat strategies through repeated practice, engaging in thrilling and rich battles with other players!

Game Modes

The game offers various modes, including team battles, individual competitions, and duels, ensuring that every battle is full of fun and challenges!

Diverse Characters

Each character in the game has uniquely designed skills and combat styles. By playing and practicing, master the various combat techniques of the characters and become a master!

data.name: Trash
data.detailed_description:
Explore an world years after humans have died out. Playing as a Morphite, new resin based lifeforms, venture out from the safety of your Cradle into a wild hazardous levels to collect rubbish resources.





Craft & Attach Forms to gain abilities that help you; explore, survive hazards, avoid creatures, help other players & collect resources. Players can attach up to 4 forms at once.





Each level contains a different procedurally generated Hazard Dungeon, ensuring high replayability. Their level locations are fixed, while the puzzles, layout and hazards within are generated.





The world consists of a series of 7 levels, each with hazards preventing resin life from flourishing. Help spread the influence of The Nexus (resin hive-mind) by solving Hazard Dungeons to remove these hazards while uncovering the story behind humanity’s ruin and the origins of resin life.

data.name: Dreamt
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Dreamt!

In this VR puzzle game you will be exploring a mysterious but nostalgic feeling house that has a lot of strange quirks about it.

Feel free to do whatever you wish!

Find hidden minigames and puzzles around the house in order to unlock more and eventually beat the game!

While the puzzles are important in the gameplay of Dreamt, the most fun can be had just exploring the environment, picking up interesting objects, and SMASHING THEM!
We encourage it!

Upon the first release, the game will be early access and only have its core mechanics in place with more polish and its overall conclusion coming in future updates.

data.name: Megabonk Apocalypse
data.detailed_description:
Players will battle against enemy vehicles and buildings of similar size across a vast, desolate wasteland.

Each level has a different objective; eliminate the designated objective to advance.

Game Features:

1. Weapons can be obtained by collecting chests; weapon types are randomized, sometimes rifles, sometimes shotguns, sometimes rocket launchers, etc. Levels contain numerous supply crates that can be used to pick up special weapons and skills.

2. Vehicles are available in levels; the number of items in the environment far exceeds the player's, so the actual size of drivable vehicles is roughly the same as the player's vehicle. The game includes a wide variety of vehicles; players can drive planes and tanks, most of which are mobile.

3. The game has thirty levels. Players can collect coins to purchase weapons and prepare for each level.

4. Experience thrilling and varied explosion effects, and feel the chaos of battle.

data.name: Sort Labs
data.detailed_description:
Sort Labs thanks you for your participation in our experiment!

Sort Labs is a first-person organizational experiment conducted in a state-of-the-art facility dedicated to the categorization of geometric objects.

Your assignment is simple:

Put every shape where it belongs.

Sort by shape. Sort by color. Arrange each shelf from smallest to largest. Restore order to laboratories filled with cubes, spheres, pyramids, stars, prisms, and many other scientifically approved objects.

Your cooperation is appreciated.

No prior sorting experience is required.

A Place For Every Shape

Each experiment begins in a state of "controlled disorder".

Carry objects between rooms, group matching colors together, separate different shape types, and arrange every shelf into perfect order by size. Watch cluttered laboratories transform into clean, organized storage systems one object at a time.

There are no monsters, no survival mechanics, and no urgent crises. There are shapes. Many shapes. Only shapes.

Endless Experiments

The laboratory's research budget appears to be entirely dedicated to producing more things to sort.

Choose from 24 different geometric object types and create custom experiments using up to 48 sets of objects. Populate laboratories however you wish:

  • A balanced mixture of every shape

  • Nothing but spheres

  • Familiar friends like a set of TTRPG dice

  • An alarming quantity of octahedrons

  • Whatever configuration best advances science

Experiment layouts are randomized each time, ensuring every assignment presents a new organizational challenge.

Organize Your Way

Whether you prefer a relaxing session or an efficient speedrun, Sort Labs supports multiple ways to play.

  • Predefined experiments ranging from simple to complex

  • Custom experiment creation

  • Laboratories designed for 1 to 48 shape sets (Sort 8000+ items!)

  • Time tracking

  • Achievements

  • Replayable randomized layouts

Take your time and enjoy the process, or attempt to achieve maximum sorting efficiency for the benefit of laboratory records and the advancement of science.

Featuring:

  • First-person shape-sorting gameplay

  • Casual and satisfying organization mechanics

  • 24 geometric object types

  • Customizable experiments

  • Randomized layouts for new experiences every time

  • Completion tracking and achievements

  • Dry laboratory humor and experiment reports

  • A near-endless supply of shapes requiring categorization

Sort Labs reminds all participants that geometric objects should not be consumed under any circumstances, regardless of color, shape, or apparent deliciousness. Thank you for your cooperation!

data.name: The Tally
data.detailed_description:
a life, itemized.

You wake up in Corvid City with a coffee to try, a job to find, and rent that does not care about your feelings. So you live. You work shifts, meet the regulars, take photos for the Tourism Board, ride a skateboard you probably cannot afford, and make a thousand small choices that feel like nothing at the time.

They were not nothing. Something was counting.

When your time is up, and it will be up, you receive THE RECEIPT: every kindness, every shortcut, every held door and quiet lie, added up and handed back to you. Then you are sorted. Where you end up is between you and the arithmetic.

In the box:

  • A hand-built PS2-era city that actually lives: jobs, shops, weather, regulars who remember you

  • A full life, start to finish, in around 90 minutes

  • Eight jobs, a phone full of apps, a camera, and a skateboard

  • An ending. A real one. Most games don't have one.

  • Whatever is on the other side of THE RECEIPT (you will see)

No tutorials nag you. No meter tells you if you are being good. You just live, and it is all written down.

Made and developed by aninsecurecarrot.

data.name: Paranormal Research Society
data.detailed_description:
Who told you to get such a useless college degree!? Neck-deep in student loans and looking for a job, Conrad Coldwood gets a call from his sister—she's had an occupational accident and is in dire need of a substitute. With no choice but to accept the offer, he gets roped into working for the Paranormal Research Society!

It's time to clock in and help research the local paranormal phenomena to figure out what's getting all those ghosts to start acting up all of a sudden! You'll have to deal with your less-than-lovely coworkers, and it looks like your boss is making you pay for your own equipment, but it can't be that bad, right? Right!?

This exciting experience includes:

  • Nine exciting job assignments for you to risk your life in!

  • Completely safe and legal firearms!

  • Fun paranormal phenomena for you to exterminate help research!

  • Menial labor!

  • Your horrible life choices haunting you!

  • A functional (?) bathroom!

Become a functional and contributing member of society as you run through dilapidated buildings and other various paranormal sites collecting samples and gunning down ghosts in this exciting first-person shooter. ​Collect, deliver, rinse, repeat...

Reviews from employees:

"This employer is actually insane. Seriously, do not approach that guy. Also, there's some kind of weird thing in the office bathroom and I feel like I'm being watched all the time? I wouldn't work here again for any amount of money. I hate it here. I want to quit."
- Anonymous

"The boss paid my college tuition, basically. Would recommend."
- Anonymous

"Hey, I'm still stuck between the wall and the radiator! Can someone please come help me out!?"
- Anonymous

data.name: TowerClimb
data.detailed_description:
TowerClimb is a difficult and rewarding procedurally generated platformer with roguelike elements.

TowerClimb is set in a fantasy world where enormous and mysterious towers of ancient unknown origin stand above humanity, extending to the heavens. Humans are driven by curiosity to climb them, usually dying in the process. Struggle forward as a weak human, driven by an iron will to reach the top.

The game borrows elements from the roguelike genre. A different adventure awaits each man; you will never play the same exact level twice. Run, Climb, Jump, Swim, and Fly your way up the tower's atmospheric and lethal worlds, using items and resources you find along your way. Quick thinking and strategy will keep you alive as you navigate the tower using unique platforming mechanics.

TowerClimb is challenging, and rewards reflexes, skill, knowledge and problem solving ability. Quite often, The tower throws your character into dangerous situations which require you to think very carefully about your actions. A unique, randomly generated level system ensures players must always come up with interesting ways to complete a level. Hundreds of men will die before you posses enough skill and knowledge to conquer the tower. A screenshot of every man's death is saved, along with how he died, to track each and every attempt.



  • TowerClimb at its core is an adventure platformer, with procedural levels and elements based on the rogue-like genre. It features local multiplayer support with an option for split-screen/single-screen. (a maximum of 25 simultaneous players is the limit. However, the game only supports 4 controllers (Xinput limitation). The remaining players must use the keyboard. A program like Xpadder can remap additional directinput controllers to keyboard keys)

  • The game features a TON of content. The Tower is tall and daunting to conquer, with plenty of areas and secrets throughout the game. Getting/seeing everything will take players a long time. There's bonus modes to unlock and play on top of the main game as well.

  • Each time you play the game, everything changes. The levels are different, random events can occur, rare items can be found, etc. The game will always keep you on your feet and give you refreshing challenges and experiences.

  • The platforming mechanics in the game are set up to feel very tight and responsive in combination with the climbing mechanics. You always need to be on your feet and aware of your surroundings, while continually planning how to climb higher. As you progress higher, different worlds introduce new mechanics that mean your play style must evolve.

5 years in the making, by Davioware and Quazi, a team of two brothers who have been developing and playing games since childhood.

data.name: The Witch's Cauldron
data.detailed_description:
The Witch's Cauldron – a medieval witch simulator from the young indie team Harvey Games.

 

You’ll practice your craft in a town where good rumors spread just as fast as bad ones, with the latter quickly reaching the ears of inquisitors. Balancing your popularity among townsfolk and the inquisitors’ growing attention is essential for survival here. And if your witch’s intuition tells you the end is near, you can always find refuge in another town—there are plenty nearby.

But that’s for the future. For now, bards, vampires, innkeepers, and even the king himself come to pay their respects! Fulfill their requests, brew potions, but remember: every good or evil deed will bring inevitable consequences.

  • Over 60 unique characters, each with their own story and multiple playthrough options;

  • A vast array of potions, each capable of leading to a unique story outcome;

  • A variety of witch skins that unlock unique quests, present challenges, and subtly alter gameplay;

  • 6 main story endings that affect not only your life but also the entire kingdom;

  • Numerous nighttime events reflecting the outcomes of your choices;

  • High replayability, allowing you to explore the world, uncover the witch’s past, and understand the kingdom’s morals.
    Each day, locals will visit you. Some come seeking healing, others out of curiosity, and some with a desire to engage in darker deeds. Their fates are in your hands—it’s up to you to decide how to handle them.
    With your choice of potions, you influence the course of events. However, only a few basic potions are available from the start; you’ll need to unlock new and more complex ones by mixing ingredients or obtaining recipes and hints from NPCs.

    Unlocked potions, no matter how each story ends, will carry over to your next life cycle. The abundance of potions and story twists allows for a highly variable playthrough experience. Some endings, potions, and game mechanics will only be available after completing the main story once or reaching certain game events that conclude the story.

data.name: RunBean Galactic
data.detailed_description:
Step into the shoes of RunBean, an astronaut who landed on a hazardous planet that tries its best to kill the intruder! Try to delay your inevitable fate by running around the globe, jumping over spikes, sliding under killer platforms, collecting bonuses, and quickly reacting to sudden direction changes! The longer you stay alive, the higher will be your score, and the more envious the next poor space travelers visiting this planet will be.

• Gameplay •


Staying true to the arcade genre, this menacing ecosystem generates all the obstacles on the fly. Each of your runs will be different, and the longer you keep this planet waiting for its meal, the angrier it will be! Its arsenal was carefully crafted by eons of evolution and its patience is unparalleled. It knows that you will make a mistake... sooner or later!

• Features •


• Easy to play & hard to master: any child can learn to press 2 buttons on time, but not everyone can handle the ever-increasing difficulty!
• Short play sessions: on average, your run will take between 30 and 90 seconds, which is perfect for short breaks!
• Randomly generated levels: every time you press the restart button, you'll get an entirely new experience!

data.name: Hauma - A Detective Noir Story - Prologue
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT HAUMA

Hauma is a noir deduction visual novel set in the heart of Munich. Step into the shoes of Judith, a former detective with a sharp wit and a knack for getting things done, as she uncovers a conspiracy amongst the city's upper echelons of society. Explore real locations in a unique art style, immersing you in the world of Bavaria's capital. From the historic House of Art to other unexpected locations, discover pieces of hidden history that shed light on the city's past.

Collect items, solve puzzles, and overcome dialogue riddles as you make your own investigative deductions using the mindboard, the heart of the game which functions like an inventory containing items and thoughts.

Featuring a diverse cast, Hauma is a fully voiced cinematic adventure with an intriguing story. Embark on a journey of deduction and intrigue, uncover the secrets of Munich's society and piece together the puzzle of the conspiracy that lies within.

  • [❖] A thrilling noir-inspired journey through Munich

  • [❖] The mindboard, an innovative inventory of interconnected items and thoughts

  • [❖] Engaging investigation mechanics, including a variety of puzzles and challenging dialogue riddles

  • [❖] A visually unique art style

  • [❖] Fully voiced cinematic adventure, featuring a diverse cast

data.name: One Million Dominoes
data.detailed_description:
One push. Then another. Then a million.

Every run starts with a table of dominoes and a burning fuse. Hover to see exactly how many will fall, pick your spot, and watch the chain race down the line, turn corners and stop at the gaps. Every domino that falls pays out.

Spend your coins on a tree of 28 upgrades: bigger tables, tighter lines, faster hands, and strange new dominoes.
  • Gold dominoes worth far more
  • Clocks that buy you time
  • Powder that blasts across gaps
  • Rockets that fire to the edge of the table
  • Rainbows that multiply a whole chain
Early on you'll topple twenty. By the end, a single push sends a wave through tens of thousands. Reach one million to meet the last domino.

After the credits

  • Timed loops: start again with your upgrades and race to one million. Every loop adds a new rule (powder everywhere, small tables, no clocks...), counts dominoes faster and makes upgrades cheaper.
  • Free play: keep going with x5 coins and max out the tree.
  • 24 achievements, from your first chain to a sub-6-minute loop.

Easy on your hands

Hold the mouse button to push whenever a push is ready. Screen shake can be turned off.
  • About 1 hour to the credits, 2-3 hours for every achievement
  • No microtransactions, no ads, no timers to babysit
  • Every domino, sound and note is drawn and synthesized in code

data.name: Balls in Windows
data.detailed_description:
The internet is your marble run.

Open a real website in the game’s browser. Its visible text, images and controls become the terrain. Arrange the windows into a contraption and guide five fresh balls from A to B. That perfectly respectable webpage is about to become a very silly machine.

Just one more window.

Move, resize, scroll, zoom and tilt to find a useful edge. Website buttons bounce balls. A link becomes a portal when its destination is open in another game browser. Try a different page or change the angle: the solution is something you build.

A little adjustment goes a long way.

Work through authored puzzles with checkpoints, gates and branching routes. Pause, retry, use a hint, or return with another website. There is no countdown to race.

Requires internet access, a mouse and keyboard. Play happens inside the game’s own browser windows. Websites can change or restrict access; choose another page when needed. Ball impacts do not click links or submit forms. Progress saves locally.

data.name: Dimension Doctor: Succubus Clinic
data.detailed_description:
Dimension Doctor: Succubus Clinic- An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Story Introduction

Vincent, the youngest chief cardiac surgeon in Los Angeles, was poisoned by an undercover agent of the FX Group during a highly difficult cross-blood-type heart transplant surgery. At the moment of cardiac arrest, he formed a symbiosis with Liu Zihua, a super digital life form from a high-level civilization. Wielding the dimension scalpel that can slice through space and inheriting the art of Taoism, he not only guards the peace of the hospital with his exquisite medical skills but also confronts supernatural assassins with his dimensional power. From the undercurrents surging in the hospital to the eerie weirdness of the internet-famous haunted house, Vincent teams up with a gentle nurse, a bold investor, and his reclusive uncle-master to uncover layer by layer the FX Group’s conspiracy to plunder yin-yang energy and attempt to open dimensional channels. He forges his own dimensional medical path in the gap between the real world, the spiritual realm, and the supernatural world.

Game Features

Exclusive HD Scene Concept Art

The precise and solemn aura of hospital operating rooms, the eerie and uncanny vibe of the internet-famous haunted house, the bleak and dangerous atmosphere of the abandoned dock, the quiet and antique charm of the ancient Taoist hall — dozens of exclusive HD scene images fully restore the yin-yang world of Los Angeles in all dimensions. Every detail is crafted to maximize immersion, making you feel as if you are in a real adventure scene.

Immersive Plot Experience

The linear plot unfolds layer by layer with a tight and concise rhythm. From the life-or-death crisis in the operating room to the supernatural terror in the haunted house, and then to head-on confrontations with the FX Group’s supernatural beings, the interlocking plotlines keep you fully immersed throughout. Follow in Vincent’s footsteps and unlock one earth-shattering secret after another.

Integrated Setting of Multidimensional Powers

Seamlessly blending modern medicine, Taoist arts, digital dimensional energy, and supernatural power to create a one-of-a-kind combat and exploration system. Witness how a scalpel is not only a life-saving medical tool but also a demon-subduing weapon that can slice through space, and experience an unprecedented sense of adventure excitement.

Rich Cast of Character Portrayals

Every character has a distinct personality and a unique backstory. From the symbiotic digital life form to the reclusive uncle-master who is both mentor and friend, from the gently guarding nurse to the bold and supportive investor, vivid character depictions endow the plot with greater warmth and dramatic tension.

Highlights of Female Character Interaction Scenarios

Isabella: The Gentle Guardian Angel in White

A nurse who fights side by side with you in the operating room. She will hand you a hot cup of coffee during overtime shifts and step forward to shield you when you are in danger. Interactions with her are filled with delicate warmth — from the tacit understanding of handling emergency casualties together to her unconditional trust and support for you, every small detail outlines the most touching workplace affection.

Sophia: The Bold and Resolute Rose of the Business World

The investor of the haunted house project, stunning and formidable yet fearless in love and hate. From initially questioning and resenting you to being awestruck by your supernatural powers and becoming your strongest backer, she provides you with unlimited financial and resource support. Interactions with her are full of dramatic tension; ambiguous overtures and steadfast companionship add a fiery hue to the adventure journey.

Fully Immersive Exclusive Interaction Scenarios

Interaction scenarios with the two female characters are deeply integrated into the main storyline. From daily caring conversations to fighting side by side in times of crisis, and to heartfelt revelations in private moments, every interaction aligns with the characters’ personalities, allowing you to experience delicate emotional bonds while on your adventure.

Scene Features

Central Los Angeles Hospital

The starting point of the story. It is equipped with sophisticated medical equipment and host to intense surgical scenes, yet it also hides the FX Group’s assassins and eerie vengeful spirits. Beneath the calm medical environment, undercurrents surge — every ward and every corridor may conceal unknown dangers.

The Underworld Wander Haunted House

Renovated from an abandoned factory, it is ostensibly an internet-famous check-in spot for supernatural experiences, but an experimental stronghold of the FX Group lies hidden underground. Shrouded in yin energy and haunted by supernatural entities, Taoist talismans interweave with eerie scenes, making it a key location for Vincent to uncover the conspiracy.

Vincent’s Taoist Hall

A quaint traditional courtyard located in the old town of Los Angeles, it is both a pure sanctuary for Vincent to practice Taoist arts and a temporary strategic stronghold. Its serene environment stands in stark contrast to the perils of the outside world, serving as a warm haven along the adventure journey.

The Abandoned Dock in the Old Town

Deserted and swept by the bleak sea breeze, it is littered with containers and trash, and acts as the main battlefield for confrontations with high-ranking assassins of the FX Group. Beneath the dim moonlight, flames collide with dimensional rifts, unfolding the most intense supernatural battles.

Gameplay Features

Unlimited Offline Play

No internet connection is required. After downloading, you can experience the complete plot offline at all times, embarking on your dimensional adventure anytime and anywhere. Bid farewell to internet lag and data consumption — the immersive experience is free from spatial and network restrictions.

Convenient One-Click Rewind

Equipped with a one-click rewind function: no reloading is needed, and you can return to any plot node with just a tap. Revisit thrilling combat moments and delicate interaction scenarios, never missing a single plot detail for a more flexible experience.

Immersive Reading Experience

Optimized text typesetting and scene transition effects, coupled with plot-appropriate atmosphere creation, make reading a pleasure. You will feel as if you are immersed in a movie-level plot, enjoying total immersion without distractions.

Auto Plot Progression

Supports an auto plot progression function; you can adjust the playback speed according to your own reading rhythm, freeing up your hands to easily experience the exciting plot. You can also pause at any time to take control of your own adventure pace.

data.name: LiveScream
data.detailed_description:
Armed with nothing but your curiosity, streaming equipment, and insatiable need to impress others, you approach a long-abandoned house in your small town.

What could possibly go wrong?

LiveScream is a horror/comedy visual novel with point-and-click elements. Step into the role of an intrepid ghost hunter-slash-live streamer-slash-average high schooler and explore a haunted house with your adoring audience.




Play as a character you identify with! Customise your name, screen name, pronouns, and appearance.



Snoop to your heart’s content! Click on objects around the house to inspect them up close.



Watch your stream chat react to your choices! Win them over with your ghost-hunting prowess, or disappoint them with your cowardice.



Try to cross everything off your bucket list! With its short playthrough time of 20 minutes and multiple endings, LiveScream is an easily replayable game.

data.name: Writificer: Typing the Classics
data.detailed_description:
A typing game, with high quality text

Type and read the books that have been loved for hundreds of years — go at your own pace and save your place anytime.

A fully featured tutorial for touch typing.

Complete a multi-lesson touch typing course that starts from the basics in your chosen keyboard style (QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ, Dvorak, Colemak, Workman).

A 3D keyboard and hands are available to show the proper hand placement for the next key press. 

Over one-hundred works to choose from

  • All thirty-seven plays of Shakespeare, and his 154 sonnets

  • Plays: Faust, A Doll’s House, Pygmalion and The Importance of Being Earnest

  • Novels: Pride and Prejudice, Moby-Dick, A Tale of Two Cities, Great Expectations, Dracula, Frankenstein, The Count of Monte Cristo, The Great Gatsby, The Picture of Dorian Gray and more

data.name: Look Again: The Anomaly Assessment
data.detailed_description:
You applied for a job. ORRIVEX has a test for you.

LOOK AGAIN: The Anomaly Assessment is a single-player, first-person psychological horror game about observation, memory, and doubt. To qualify as a Field Observer, you must complete three assessments for a secretive organization that investigates anomalous environments.

OBSERVE. REMEMBER. REPORT.

Study each location in its normal state. On later visits, compare what you see and hear against what you remember. An object may disappear, a familiar detail may change, or a sound may come from somewhere it should not.

If nothing has changed, report that no anomaly was observed. If something is wrong, report the anomaly. Your decisions determine whether you pass.

THREE ASSESSMENTS. THREE DISTINCT LOCATIONS.

Each assessment takes place in a separate environment with its own details and anomalies. Return to the ORRIVEX Assessment Chamber between tests, review your results, and unlock the next assessment.

TRUST YOUR OBSERVATIONS.

Every incorrect report lowers your Reality Coherence Rating. You need at least 80% to pass. Take your time, examine the environment, and listen carefully before making your choice.

FEATURES

  •  Three distinct assessment environments with visual and audio anomalies.

  •  Observation-focused gameplay with no time limit for inspecting each loop.

  •  Psychological tension built around familiar places becoming subtly wrong.

  •  Persistent results and anomaly discovery statistics.

  •  Replay completed assessments to find anomalies you missed.

  •  Keyboard, mouse, and Xbox controller support.

data.name: Path to Ruin
data.detailed_description:
From Gulag To Glory!

Sub-human inmates Mallet and Barrow are about to unwittingly embark on an adventure that will lead them out of the gulag and into the wide-open world that they know absolutely nothing about! Help guide them through unknown territories as they battle ferocious blood-thirsty monsters, meet new friends, explore abandoned ruins, and gain assistance from the gods themselves!

Classic RPG Gameplay

Heavily inspired by classic NES/SNES top-down RPGs.

- Classic turn-based combat
- Story and exploration driven progression
- Hybrid visual style combining hand-drawn and pixel art
- Dark comedy combined with heartfelt character interactions
- Original soundtrack specifically written to fit the story and events

Unique Episodic Releases!

Play through all of "Day One: Unwitting Liberation" now! Each additional chapter will be released as free "updates" every 6 - 8 months (as development progresses). No DLC or Microtransactions! Once you buy the game, that's all you pay! We are a small development team dedicated to only this project! We are both deeply passionate about the genre, this story and its characters.

data.name: Starling
data.detailed_description:
Starling is a student-developed third-person base-building exploration game. As an employee of Starling Corp., your mission is to gather resources from across the galaxy and send it back to the corporation to supply your home planet with resources essential for survival.

These cute creatures will guide and accompany you throughout your journey.
Finding legendary items might unlock cosmetic for your new cosmic friends!

  • Explore the world around you using your jetpack

  • Delve into deep mines to extract valuable minerals

  • Chop down alien trees for wood

  • Fish in serene waters to secure essential supplies

  • Upgrade your tools to access more resources

Use these resources to upgrade your gear, repair your base, craft consumables and more!

A catastrophic space incident has left your once-thriving space station in ruins, its fragments scattered across the galaxy.
Now, it’s up to you to rebuild your base.


By repairing various stations in your spaceship, you will unlock the ability to:

  • Smelt ores and refine resources

  • Craft essential items for progression

  • Trade goods with the Starling Corp.

  • Grow crops for supplies and buffs

  • Customize your spacesuit at the cosmetic station

data.name: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
data.detailed_description:
"The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape" is a dark fantasy style pixel Arpg. Players will use three heroines to travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

·Game Features

·Players can operate three heroines with different combat experiences, choose "talents", equip "imprints", and combine "skills" to explore the most suitable combat style for themselves.

 

·Exquisite dark fantasy art style

Ancient and desolate primitive villages, snow covered dragon nests in snowy countries, and plague harbors shrouded in thick fog... You can freely explore this dilapidated and dangerous world, fight against the filthy 'descendants', defeat countless terrifying' Scarred-Scions', and even challenge the crazy 'monarchs'.

·Rich storyline divergences

Experience this dark tale filled with sorrow and despair from the perspectives of three different heroines.

The main storyline features dozens of core NPCs, over 10 major endings, and more than 20 different branching paths.

Save those you wish to save, sparing no effort; destroy those you wish to destroy, even if it means making an enemy of the world.

 

·'Blooming'

At a critical moment, the girls will experience a 'bloom', transforming into the true form of their souls, even if the cost is the withering and extinguishing of their lives.

 

·Unique 'branding' inheritance mechanism

In the same playthrough game, if the "imprint" held by the heroine controlled by the player is completely shattered due to defeat, they will face irreversible death in that playthrough. Players can choose the successor of the "branding" among the remaining two heroiness until all three heroines die.

data.name: RollRift Arena
data.detailed_description:
Bet It All on a Roll of the Dice

RollRift Arena is a fast-paced dice strategy battler. Every round, both players roll at the same time — and whoever stops on the higher number seizes control of the turn. Timing your stop is timing your win. With control in hand, you move, attack, or rush into a special room to grab gear. Meanwhile the board itself is crumbling: every few rounds the outer ring of tiles cracks and collapses, forcing everyone toward the center — and a final, single-tile showdown.

Core Gameplay

Dice Showdown — both sides roll in sync; the higher roll acts first, and your stop timing decides everything

Grid Tactics — move, block, and set traps on a procedurally generated board

Collapsing Arena — outer tiles crumble round after round; stall too long and you'll be teleported off a vanishing tile

Special Rooms — Kitchen: Pot (+1 HP), Spatula (+1 Attack); Bathroom: Water Gun (+1 Range), Toilet (teleport your opponent)

Final Duel — when one tile is left it stops collapsing, and fully geared warriors clash head-on

Multiple Battle Modes

Online PvP — quick auto-match or pick a room to duel a friend directly; results count toward the global leaderboard

Player vs Computer — three AI difficulty tiers, from learning the ropes to a real challenge

Local Multiplayer — two players, one keyboard, same screen

Make Your Own Warrior

A built-in pixel-art Character Workshop with brush, bucket, eyedropper, and mirror tools. Craft a one-of-a-kind avatar to carry into battle — edits save automatically.

Easy to Learn, Deep to Master

A match takes only a few minutes and the rules click instantly — but your stop timing, item choices, and positioning before each collapse are all mind games against your opponent. Climb to the top of the leaderboard and prove you've got the luck and the brains.

data.name: Fate Crawler
data.detailed_description:
Fate Crawler is a dynamic and colorful rogue-like game.

You are the Chosen One, owner of the mysterious Relic, made to alter the very Fate itself. Participate in the breathtaking adventure to uncover the true nature of the Relic, and save your world. Visit various places, from the green forests to forgotten ruins and floating isles, swirling with wild magic. Meet unexpected allies and face deadly challenges. Claim mighty artifacts and magic powers to create your own combat style.

Features:

  • Four acts filled with various enemies, trials, and rewards. Your adventure includes not only dynamic battles but also some text-based encounters and occasions.
  • Each adventure is unique: participate in many different events during your travel, from caravan robbing to artifact-hunting in forgotten mage towers. Use the power of mysterious Relic to change the Fate into your favor. But beware - this power comes with a price!
  • Unique combat styles: use various magic spells to obliterate your enemies, clad yourself in impenetrable armor or rain a hail of arrows on your enemies!
  • Extreme variety of equipment: reflect hostile magic with your mirror shield, drain life force from your enemies with a vampire sword, or challenge them to duel by throwing a gauntlet to their faces!
  • Combine different abilities to create your own playstyle: the trap can zap your enemies with the chain lightning, while the lightning will teleport you to your next victim!
  • Use environment: focus not only on your own abilities but also on your surroundings. Magic crystals and terrain features can create a huge advantage in combat. Or doom you as well.
  • Game changes each run: the adventure is randomized and you can unlock new items and abilities by making achievements and participating in unique events!
data.about_the_game:
Fate Crawler is a dynamic and colorful rogue-like game.

You are the Chosen One, owner of the mysterious Relic, made to alter the very Fate itself. Participate in the breathtaking adventure to uncover the true nature of the Relic, and save your world. Visit various places, from the green forests to forgotten ruins and floating isles, swirling with wild magic. Meet unexpected allies and face deadly challenges. Claim mighty artifacts and magic powers to create your own combat style.

Features:

  • Four acts filled with various enemies, trials, and rewards. Your adventure includes not only dynamic battles but also some text-based encounters and occasions.
  • Each adventure is unique: participate in many different events during your travel, from caravan robbing to artifact-hunting in forgotten mage towers. Use the power of mysterious Relic to change the Fate into your favor. But beware - this power comes with a price!
  • Unique combat styles: use various magic spells to obliterate your enemies, clad yourself in impenetrable armor or rain a hail of arrows on your enemies!
  • Extreme variety of equipment: reflect hostile magic with your mirror shield, drain life force from your enemies with a vampire sword, or challenge them to duel by throwing a gauntlet to their faces!
  • Combine different abilities to create your own playstyle: the trap can zap your enemies with the chain lightning, while the lightning will teleport you to your next victim!
  • Use environment: focus not only on your own abilities but also on your surroundings. Magic crystals and terrain features can create a huge advantage in combat. Or doom you as well.
  • Game changes each run: the adventure is randomized and you can unlock new items and abilities by making achievements and participating in unique events!
data.short_description: Fate Crawler is a dynamic and colorful adventure featuring both classical and new Rogue-like elements. Choose your hero and lead his fate by changing various events into your favor. Combine unique abilities and artifacts to form individual play style for each run.

data.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
data.detailed_description:
Deluxe Edition


The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Tales of Eternia Remastered
• Battle BGM Pack
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
• Super Growth Support Item Set


About the Game

Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.

• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at Stake


Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.
In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.
Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and Freedom


Featuring the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.
Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.

• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to Play


Gameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.
Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.

data.name: Skyrest
data.detailed_description:
Skyrest is a first-person roguelike action game where you play as a deceased person at the gates of the afterlife, confronting your unresolved inner issues before reaching eternal rest. Summon procedurally generated islands, gather resources, upgrade your boat, craft items and weapons, and fight ghostly enemies using an arsenal of spirit weapons and runic attacks to reach the gates of Skyrest.

COMBAT


  • Fast-paced and dynamic first-person combat, with melee and ranged options.
  • Face unique enemies and bosses in each biome, unlocking the ability to summon biomes of your choice.
  • Create Spiritual Weapons and Attack Runes to expand your arsenal and aid you in combat.
  • Create food and drinks to give you temporary boosts that will help you overcome challenges.

PROGRESSION


  • 4 unique biomes, each with its own enemies, traps, items, interactions, and level design.
  • Unique islands with procedurally generated content to create coherent and diverse experiences across runs.
  • Discover different interactions, events, and hazzards in each run.
  • Choose between different Ascensions and Amulets to improve the character in unique ways each run.

META-PROGRESSION

  • Your boat is also your home and base of operations; store items, build, and craft new items.
  • Collect items and resources and send them back to your boat to use them in constructions and item creation.
  • Build new structures on your boat to enable and expand your item crafting capabilities.

data.name: Welcome to Paradise Island
data.detailed_description:
It's summer. You and your friends are on vacation, when suddenly the sea carries your boat away to an unknown island in another world. This island—Paradisiem Island—is small, with one village. According to the village chief, the island's Guardian Deity foresaw the arrival of you and your friends, and they want you to help the island return to its former glory. Without more tourists, there aren't enough people to worship the Guardian Deity, whose powers you need to return to your home world. Work together with your friends, Sahoto, Mei, and Chiyo, as well as some new friends you make on the island, to help it grow and prosper into a popular tourist destination!

Explore Paradisiem Island and all it has to offer! Take a companion of your choice and visit areas like the lush Paradisiem Forest or serene Vienni Quarry to gather materials like wood, stone, ore, and gems to further the development of the island. If you're lucky, you'll find some premium items that you can sell at the Shop!

Once the Shop opens up, you'll be able to buy and craft special items that can help you gather more items, improve your bonds with your friends, and help work more efficiently.

Gather Materials All Over The Island
Along with resources like wood, stones, ore, and gems, there are plenty of materials to gather around the island! You'll explore the island with a companion of your choice and encounter fun events as you search for items. As you develop the island, you'll unlock new locations and be able to get your hands on rare materials!

Missions and Rewards Galore!
With dozens of different missions, you'll be busy every day! Complete missions and obtain useful items that can aid you in gathering or crafting new resources. Not only do missions help with your work on the island, but some people may give you unique special rewards. Whether you are a completionist or just want some bonus items, there's something for everyone!

data.name: A Home Below
data.detailed_description:
A Home Below is a single-player, story-driven hermit crab game where you explore an underwater house in search of a real seashell.

Each room is a world. From skittish sea urchins, and friendly anemones, to a scary wrasse, and a curious octopus. Make hasty retreats and temporary alliances. Interact with a thriving, rambling community under the sea.

Climb over ancient furniture and ride on bubble currents to reach high places. Squeeze through gaps in the walls between rooms to access new worlds. Acquire awesome skills and learn how to do all the funny things that crustaceans do to survive.

In your quest to find a real seashell, you’ll find all kinds of halfway homes that mostly suck. But you can enjoy customising and repairing them, which can have a BIG effect on how you’re seen by others. Do you want to be seen as toxic or a tasty treat?

As you explore, you keep coming across personal items that contain little fragments of the past. Useless to a crab, but still… it feels like the house is trying to tell you something. Explore all the rooms to learn more about the family that once lived here. Discover their story and see if it can help you come to terms with your own strange, crabby existence.

data.name: Cats in the Ancient City of Gu Su
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to "Cats in the Ancient City of Gu Su", a charming game about finding cats. Set against the backdrop of the painting "Prosperous Suzhou" by the Qing dynasty artist Xu Yang, the game features 600 adorable cats, creating amusing interactions with historical scenes and characters.

"Prosperous Suzhou" is a magnificent scroll painting in Chinese art history, following the tradition of "Along the River During the Qingming Festival". It spans over 12 meters, more than twice the length of "Along the River During the Qingming Festival", and holds immense historical value. Completed in 1759 after 24 years of work, it is currently housed in the Liaoning Provincial Museum.

The painting depicts over 12,000 people, nearly 400 boats, over 50 bridges, 200 shops, and more than 2,000 buildings, using a combination of scroll format and scattered perspective to portray the everyday life of Suzhou at that time. With meticulous layout, grandeur, and detailed brushwork, it presents the bustling scenes of Suzhou's streets and markets, providing valuable insights into the prosperous era of the Qianlong reign 250 years ago.

----- Game Features -----

- Click on the game title to enjoy the complete high-definition "Prosperous Suzhou" painting.
- 6 different scenic environments.
- 600 charming hand-drawn cats.
- Relaxing background music.
- Adorable cat sound effects.
- 100 carefully crafted achievement icons.

----- Game Controls -----

- Press ESC to toggle visibility of in-game buttons.
- Click the hint button to quickly locate a cat in the scene; can be used once every 60 seconds.

------------------------

data.name: Libi
data.detailed_description:
A survival horror where you peek into the mind of a hero saving her kidnapped lover while making excuses for her crimes. fight an undying jestress ruling an uncivilized world, scavenge for limited resources, avoid enemies, trick them with food and lay traps. for you are the hero... right? ​

EDAN HAS BEEN TAKEN

Edan has been taken. His trail leads into a land ruled by an undying, inhuman jestress. Libi will follow it anywhere and do anything. For she is the hero, and this is her story.

THE HERO IS THE MONSTER

Peek into the mind of Libi as she does everything to save edan her kidnapped lover, watch as she mows her way towards edan, what is going in her mind, what is she thinking, what will she do next?

FIGHT WITH ALL YOU HAVE

Trickery, mines, traps, firearms, blades, starvation, and even airstrikes. Use everything you can, however you can use it. There are no rules when you're trying to survive.

SCAVENGE TO SURVIVE

Every bullet and heart matters. Search an uncivilized world for scarce supplies, harvest the dead jesters, and assemble your own traps.

THEY NEVER STAY DOWN

The Jestress lurks around every corner and gets back up every time. She does not stay down, she thinks her survival is her victory, and now she carries a gun. What is her secret?

A WORLD FILLED WITH DREAD

Follow Edan's trail through this land and and uncover a story that gets harder to stomach with every step.

data.name: 雪晴日 （Waiting for sunshine）
data.detailed_description:
“雪，依然在下着，好似没有止境般地向着大地袭来……”

202x年县一中的一起学生跳楼自杀事件，改变了许多人的人生轨迹。高一三班的学生林雪晴被席卷进这场舆论的漩涡，同学们都无比确信，她就是“杀人凶手”，一时之间，学校的论坛上遍布对于林雪晴的怀疑、攻讦甚至是诅咒，无数恶毒的语言每天都在林雪晴的脑中萦绕。而只有少部分了解真相的同学知道她是无辜的，但他们暂时还没有理由站出来……

这起事件只是一个开始，您将扮演林雪晴，提升自己的学力、勇气、智趣，与协力角色共度校园生活，逐步走出校园霸凌的阴霾。她的命运由您来掌握，她的故事由您来书写！

游戏内容

《雪晴日》是一部以中式校园为背景、校园霸凌为主题的视觉性小说。您将扮演校园霸凌的承受者林雪晴，体验网络舆论带给个人的重压，而您的日程行动也将决定这场校园霸凌事件的最终走向。

4种结局  走出风雪 OR 被风雪湮没

20w+字文本

31张人物角色立绘

44张手绘背景

玩法介绍

《雪晴日》采用的角色日程驱动手法和ATLUS的《女神异闻录》系列相似，您扮演的林雪晴可以通过各项日程活动来提升自己的学力、勇气、智趣三维属性，也可以和选择相信您的人物角色提升关系，这两项系统是决定结局走向的关键。除此之外，为了真实还原中式高中生活与网络舆论暴力，《雪晴日》还引入了作业压力、每日校园论坛等原创系统，您需要进行相应的日程活动，来平衡角色的负面情绪，以免走入不想要的结局。

游玩须知

1.含有自杀、坠楼等相关不适描写

2.含有校园暴力等可能会引起ptsd的内容

3.本故事全属虚构，但所有故事素材全部取材于真实经历、社会新闻
