data.name: Lightspeed Frontier
data.detailed_description:
Leave everything behind and try your hand at captaining a ship on the frontier of the galaxy. Customize it piece by piece to tackle whatever adventures await you. Take on crime lords and space pirates in battle, undercut corporations that are monopolizing business, influence the galactic stock market, and become the most successful captain you can be.

In this sci-fi adventure sandbox game, you have the opportunity to explore and influence the universe around you and make your own path. Take on open ended missions that will have a lasting effect on your surroundings, and embark on an adventure to discover the mysteries of Lightspeed Frontier.


Faster than light travel has recently been made available for the common middle-class galaxy dweller, and you’ve just saved up enough money to purchase your first standard command pod. This pod can have it’s functionality and size extended with additional modular building blocks, such as engines, cannons, lasers, scanners, software, and more.

As you acquire more modules for your ship, your ship class will also increment unlocking more missions and special actions. While you start out as just a tiny fighter-class ship, you can eventually reach the pinnacle of modular ship development and be upgraded to the final Infinity class! Each class has its own pros and cons, as far as firepower, speed, maneuverability, etc, but slowly acquiring more modules through whatever means necessary will open up more opportunities for you.


While exploring the universe, you may encounter memorable NPCs, corporations, scavengers, programmers, asteroid belts, space stations, and more. Every encounter with an NPC will either make you enemies or allies with them, depending on if you choose to help them or stab them in the back. This could result on a bounty being put on your head, or more challenging (but rewarding) work from them in the future. There are also many different ways for you to make your mark in the universe. You can invest in mining equipment if you want to be a raw materials salesman, or BFGs if you’re more the bounty hunter type.


Battling other ships is a key part of the game, and also one of the challenges of traversing the frontier. You will need to utilize a multitude of different weapons, maneuvering techniques, and even physics to destroy your opponents (like ramming, or hurling asteroids for instance). And it goes without saying, the brochure from the command pod salesman did not mention anything about the constant and ceaseless life-threatening encounters you would face in the outer reaches of the universe.


Most the parts you can come across are made according to faction orders and designs. In the outer rim, old pre-warp tech has been modified by rogue gangs and refit to still work in this day and age, albeit with questionable durability. The industrial belt of the galaxy is controlled by the Industrial Conglomerate - with everything designed for sheer strength. And tensile strength too. In the very core of the galaxy resides the United Research Alliance always has the most high tech gear known to man.


Space is a massive opportunity for investment and profit which brings interstellar corporations to the frontier's outposts and space stations. These corporations can provide you with shipping contracts, protection work (or even more shady jobs once you earn their trust) or you can just simply invest into their stocks.

data.name: A Token War
data.detailed_description:
Prepare for battle! A Token War combines deckbuilding, turn-based strategy, and challenging tactical gameplay in a game that will challenge your strategic assumptions – encouraging creativity as you develop new and varied battleplans for every level.

As you progress through the game, you’ll build up your arsenal of unique Tokens to employ in battles across five distinct regions. Upgrade your stronghold to maximize your strength – and utilize powerful spells to turn the tide of battle. With a combination of both random and designed encounters, each game requires you to come up with unique tactics in order to utterly crush the enemy!

Features

  • A New Style of Deckbuilding: Build a collection of unique tokens and spells, and strategically select them so that each battle utilizes your strengths and creativity rather than fate.

  • Designed and Procedural Encounters: Each encounter combines designed and procedural elements to create a more varied and dynamic experience. Try out different Upgrade/Token/Spell combinations to find the most effective composition for each battle!

  • Powerful Upgrades: Earn new and powerful upgrades for your stronghold, which can dramatically alter your tactics – or bolster your current strategy.

  • Local Versus Mode: Bring the fight to your friends and family using a shared pool of tokens.

data.short_description: A Token War combines deckbuilding and turn-based strategy into a unique and challenging game. Acquire new tokens to use in battle, upgrade your stronghold, and cast spells to decimate your foes. With both designed and random battles, your tactics must change each time if you intend to win!
data.reviews:
“This is a neat lightish turn-based tactics game with a campaign and 2 different modes of play (difficulty levels). The unique thing about it is it has deckbuilder qualities as you gain gold in a battle that you use to hire units, buy spells, buy buildings and repair your stronghold. You choose which units to bring into battle based on a limit set by the battle itself. You can sell units and such back when you outgrow them. The game plays out as a combination of chess meets a CCG. The soundtrack is also very calming and relaxing and I enjoyed it.”
Positive – The Strategy Informer

“A Token War is a game that knows exactly what it is, and focuses on doing a few things really well rather than a lot of things in an okay way. And ultimately that was the right choice. It’s a fun and straight forward game that’s easy to pick up and play, but still has a good amount of depth.”
Save – Save or Quit

“A Token War is an interesting new entry into the deckbuilder genre, whether it belongs there or not. I think those who have my limited tactical capacity might have a limit on how much they can enjoy the game, but if you’re a modern Napoleon or just have the patience to handle repeated failures, there’s plenty to get out of the game.”
Positive – Russell Troxel

data.name: Chicken Coop
data.detailed_description:
Chicken Coop


The humans have disappeared, leaving the homestead in chaos. The cow desperately needs her pumpkin, and it's up to you and your trusty team of farm animals to save the day! Welcome to Chicken Coop, a charming and engaging game that's perfect for young audiences.

In this world, you'll take charge of your own magical farm, managing your flock of quirky chickens and using the tools available to build new structures, create tools and equipment, and plant crops that will keep your animals healthy and productive. As you explore the world around you, you'll encounter a range of other farm animals who can help you build a thriving homestead.

Paint and design your buildings to make them truly your own, and recruit the Golden Retriever to keep pesky foxes at bay. You'll also need the help of the Cat, who's always on the lookout for hungry birds trying to steal your crops.

With its engaging gameplay, cute characters, and endless possibilities for customization, Chicken Coop is a game that you won't want to put down. So gather your friends and start building your own magical farm today!

data.name: Droppy Ball
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Welcome to Droppy Ball, a game where you drop colorful balls into a box, aiming to combine the balls for massive scores! It's all about deliberate thinking and a bit of physics as you watch your creations cascade and combine.

How You Play

Your main goal in Droppy Ball is simple: drop balls into a box. But there's a trick! When two balls of the same color touch, they combine into a larger ball of the next color. Think of it like a chain reaction, starting with pink, then moving through a rainbow of colors. The bigger the ball you create, the more points you earn.

Explosions, Combos, and High Stakes

Every time balls combine, they let out a small explosion that pushes other balls around. This adds an exciting, unpredictable element to each drop. Sometimes it helps you clear a path, and sometimes it throws balls where you don't want them or ends your run. If you can manage to get multiple balls to combine from a single drop, you'll create a combo streak, making your score skyrocket! But be careful – the box has limited space. If any balls spill out, it's game over!

The Void Ball

Keep an eye out for the Void Ball! It's the last ball in the sequence. When two Void Balls combine, they vanish completely from the box. This clears space and keeps the game going, especially when things start to get crowded. Mastering the Void Ball is key to chasing those high scores.

Chase the High Score

Droppy Ball is all about pushing your limits and getting the highest score possible. Each game offers new opportunities to refine your dropping strategy, anticipate reactions, and pull off incredible combos. Can you outsmart the physics and become the ultimate Droppy Ball master?

data.name: Highway Police Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Introducing Highway Police Simulator: Dive into the action of American patrolling duty!

Put on your uniform and step into the shoes of an American police officer with Highway Police Simulator! This game brings the heart-pounding action of the American Highway Patrol right to your fingertips. Immerse yourself in the unique challenges and serious police duties that officers face on a daily basis and truly feel what it's like to patrol the highways while maintaining law and order.

A compelling police story awaits you, with the option to play as either a male or a female officer. With both a casual and a simulation gameplay modes, Highway Police Simulator combines the best of both worlds: the freedom to drive and walk in an immersive virtual environment, and a diverse variety of exciting cases to solve in story-driven gameplay. Explore a diverse open world and tackle any situation that comes your way with an array of vehicles including cars, helicopters, and more.

Welcome to Caminora, where new missions await you! Get ready to experience the thrill of the chase, the satisfaction of solving crimes, and the adrenaline rush of patrolling the highways. What kind of cop will you be? Will you uphold the law with integrity, or will you bend the rules to get the job done? Your decisions will have a real impact on the story and the environment. Highway Police Simulator is where YOUR story begins!

Key Features


  • Authentic American Setting: Freedom to patrol the highways and urban landscapes of the fictional US region of Caminora in a diverse open-world environment.
  • Story-driven Gameplay: Solve exciting criminal cases that require you to make critical decisions. Use training grounds to climb up the ranks and successfully complete assignments to advance in your career and ultimately become the best officer in town. Unlock new tools and vehicles to aid you in your quest for justice.
  • Unique Vehicles: Drive highly detailed special vehicles such as different police cars, helicopters and more.
  • Various Missions:
    • Investigate accident scenes, talk to the people involved, document the accident, collect evidence, and draw conclusions by interpreting all the information you have gathered so far.
    • Inspect vehicles at traffic stops and ensure safe roads for citizens.
    • Chase down criminals through traffic chaos in thrilling pursuits and test your skills as you navigate the streets in dynamic car chases.
    • Choose to approach missions in a strategically way and act calmly and cautiously or engage in shootouts where quick thinking and precision are the keys to success.
  • Morality System: Are you a good and righteous cop or do you like to bend the law from time to time? Either way, your choices will affect not only the outcome of the story, but also the environment in which you live. Do as you please and live with the consequences.

data.name: Man's Worst Friend
data.detailed_description:
Reject obedience to play as misbehaved dogs trying to destroy property, or become the unfortunate human trying to stop them.

Team up with your friends to play as a pack of dogs bent on driving the human insane. Sprint, crawl, and use the map to your advantage. Good behaviour is strongly discouraged.

Complete the objectives by breaking whatever you can, creating the biggest mess. Find and devour the kibble to fuel majestic, wall-spraying poops.


The destruction doesn’t end when you’re caught. Distract the human, break your friends out of the kennel, and get back to being a misbehaved menace.

Make terrible decisions together. Coordinate your destruction, save the pack when things go wrong, or commit the ultimate betrayal.

data.name: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition
data.detailed_description:
Important Updates To Grand Theft Auto IV and Episodes from Liberty City

We are making a number of changes to make sure players who own Grand Theft Auto IV and GTA: Episodes from Liberty City can continue to enjoy these games.

New Players

Starting 03/19/2020, Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition will replace both Grand Theft Auto IV and Grand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City wherever it is currently digitally available. Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition will as also be available via the Rockstar Games Launcher.

Current game save files will be compatible with Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition.

As a result of this update the following services will no longer be available in Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition:
  • Games for Windows Live
  • Multiplayer mode
  • Leaderboards

The following Radio Stations will be temporarily unavailable in Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition
  • RamJam FM, Self-Actualization FM, and Vice City FM (previously available in Grand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City)

Note: Because Japanese is a supported language for Grand Theft Auto IV, but is not supported for Grand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City, players will continue to be able to play Grand Theft Auto IV with Japanese sub-titles but will need to select another language in order to play Grand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City.

Current Players

Players who have previously installed and played Grand Theft Auto IV or Grand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City will be able to update their copy to Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition through the following means:

Steam Users

Depending on the game, players on Steam will need to install or update their current game:
  • Grand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City will be removed and replaced with GTAIV: Complete Edition in the launcher library. Update file size is expected to be approximately 22GB
  • Grand Theft Auto IV owners will download content from Grand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City and their game will update to GTAIV: Complete Edition. Update file size is expected to be approximately 6GB 

Physical Media

  • Games not previously activated using Games for Windows Live will be able to use the Key on the back of the game manual to activate and update to Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition

Games for Windows Live Digital Store Purchases

  • Games previously activated using Games for Windows Live will require players to create and/or link their Social Club accounts in replacement of Games for Windows Live to update to Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition

Note: New activations from players trying to install current copies of Grand Theft Auto IV may be disrupted until Grand Theft Auto IV: Complete Edition is available. All users will need to be connected to the internet and authenticate their copy of the game.


About the Game

Niko Bellic, Johnny Klebitz, and Luis Lopez all have one thing in common – they live in the worst city in America. Liberty City worships money and status, and is heaven for those who have them and a living nightmare for those who don’t.

Niko is looking to escape his past and make a new life for himself in the land of opportunity. Johnny, a veteran member of The Lost biker gang, is caught in the middle of a vicious turf war with rival gangs for control of the city. Luis, part-time hoodlum and full-time assistant to legendary nightclub impresario Tony Prince (a.k.a. “Gay Tony”), is struggling with the competing loyalties of family and friends in a world in which everyone has a price. Their lives cross paths with devastating consequences as they fight to survive in a city torn apart by violence and corruption.

The Complete Edition includes Grand Theft Auto IV and the Episodes – The Lost and Damned & The Ballad of Gay Tony.

data.name: Trolddom
data.detailed_description:
Version 1.0 finally live!

  • Old-school 2D fantasy open world MMORPG - all the basic stuff you'd expect, monsters, loot, player trading, auction houses, achievements, guilds, professions, and so on.

  • 5 classes - play as a fighter, a priest, a sorcerer, a paladin, or a witch, each with 3 unique talent trees and 150+ talents in total.

  • 350+ quests - you can reach maximum levels by doing quests, solo or in a party.

  • 8 instance dungeons - bring friends to tackle these challenges for unique rare loot.

  • Optional PVP - don't worry, you won't be ganked.

  • No pay-to-win (ever!) - the price of the game is what you see on the tin.

  • Mix of handcrafted and generated worlds and dungeons - every day Junjun the Portal Master will open up a gateway to another world that has never been visited before.

  • Gods and deities - discover new deities, show your allegiance to them and they'll reward you.

  • Optional offline mode and custom servers - play locally without internet connection or run your own servers.

data.name: The Elder Scrolls® Online
data.detailed_description:
The Elder Scrolls Online: Deluxe Edition

Get the Deluxe Edition to experience all ESO adventures in one place and begin your journey in the world of Tamriel. Includes the Base Game, 2025 Content Pass, and all eight previous Chapters.


The Elder Scrolls Online: Housing Starter Pack



Begin (or bolster!) your housing adventure in Tamriel with the Housing Starter Pack, featuring a brand-new Unfurnished House and 800 Crowns for Furnishings to decorate your new home with (or anything else you desire in ESO’s in-game shop, the Crown Store)!

This bundle includes:
• Seabloom Villa Unfurnished House
• 800 Crowns

Seabloom Villa Unfurnished House
Blossom lovers will delight in this picturesque villa perched on the western coastline of Auridon! With its elegant design, this cozy home awaits any who seek to nurture its blooms to life while enjoying how the light dances on the nearby rippling waters.

800 Crowns
The Crowns are for use in the Crown Store. The Crown Store can be accessed in-game to browse and purchase unique furnishings, houses, pets, mounts, costumes for your character, and other virtual goods and services.


The Elder Scrolls Online: The Hailcinder Mount Pack



Ride into your Tamrielic journey with the Hailcinder Mount Pack, featuring an exclusive Vale Elk Mount, 3000 Crowns for use in the Crown Store, as well as a Pledge of Mara Scroll to aid in your adventures.

This bundle includes:
• Exclusive Mount: Hailcinder Vale Elk
• 3000 Crowns
• Pledge of Mara Scroll

Mount: Hailcinder Vale Elk
Some claim a ghost possesses this proud steed, providing it with a haunting glow. Others point to its chosen diet: glowing flora and fungi. Regardless, riders feel as if they're gliding on air.

3000 Crowns
The Crowns are for use in The Crown Store. The Crown Store can be accessed in-game to browse and purchase unique pets, mounts, costumes for your character, and other virtual goods and services.

Pledge of Mara Scroll
Pledge commitment on sacred ground to bond a single character to another. Both will earn 10% more experience while adventuring together. Pledge is consumed on use.


About the Game

Includes The Elder Scrolls Online base game plus the Morrowind, Imperial City, Orsinium, Thieves Guild, and Dark Brotherhood adventures.

Every legend starts somewhere and in The Elder Scrolls Online, it starts with you. Write your story into a vibrant chapter of Tamriel’s distant past that takes place nearly 1,000 years before the iconic TES V: Skyrim, and discover a world steeped in adventure and possibility.

WELCOME TO SEASONS - Step into new stories and experimental content inspired by classic TES history, delivered every three months. Play and unlock epic rewards with Tamriel Tomes.

A DIVERSE FANTASY WORLD – Travel Tamriel and discover a world of adventure. Explore mushroom forests in Morrowind, battle Daedra in Oblivion, or duel other players in PvP combat.

RICH STORIES ON A SHARED CANVAS - Immerse yourself in storytelling crafted with the same spirit as your favorite Elder Scrolls games. Discover an ever-growing world with friends or solo.

PURPOSE IN EVERY PATH - Choose from an array of quests and challenges that fit your desires and ambitions. Make this Elder Scrolls world your own - you belong here.

data.name: 逆道（さかどう）　SAKA-DOH：THE REVERSAL ARTS
data.detailed_description:
An arcade combat-action game conceived in the 1980s

You play a martial artist, suspended upside down from a rope. Swing and strike!

Featuring development veterans from TAITO and ZUNTATA

  • Kenji Kaido: Cameltry, Night Striker, and more

  • Kentaro Matsumura: Darius Gaiden, G-Darius, and more

  • Raiden Nakayama (formerly ZUNTATA): Puzzle Bobble 2, Densha de GO!, and more

  • M-KAI: ESCHATOS, Judgement Silversword, and more

A brand-new '80s game, right here, right now

  • A trip back to that era

  • A 100-yen coin in hand, standing at the cabinet — those three minutes

  • The original concept and game design, kept as they were

80'S ALIVE! BACK IN!

Game Features

  • Swing on the rope and punch & kick — the wider the swing, the harder the hit

  • Unlock four distinct special moves as you master your Sen-Qi

  • Numerous boss battles

  • 15 stages spanning the world

  • Find your missing fiancée!

Controls

  • Controller supported (recommended)

  • Keyboard also supported

    Keyboard Controls

    • Move: WASD / Arrow Keys

    • Attack: N

    • Guard: B / M

    • Insert Coin: Backspace

    • Start: Enter

    • Pause / Menu: Esc

data.name: Warlore
data.detailed_description:
Win the board before you play the card.


Warlore is first and foremost a board strategy duel. Every match begins with an 11×11 grid, two commanders, and a fight for territory. You place stones, build influence, cut off space, and decide when a single position is worth more than a flashy move.

Cards are not the game. They are tactical tools: a feint, a trap, a tempo swing, a way to punish a weak formation. If your board position is poor, a card will not save you. If your board control is strong, the right card can turn pressure into victory.

The free Demo just received its biggest update


  • A stronger first five minutes — clearer onboarding, tutorials, prompts and commander unlocks
  • A smarter battlefield — improved pathfinding, deployment and anti-stall behavior
  • Sharper tactics — reworked cards and commander passives, clearer targeting, better localization and stability

Play the updated Demo now, then wishlist Warlore for the complete 16-commander experience arriving October 5, 2026.

🎯 How You Play


Each turn you place a stone to claim territory, like Go. But you also hold a hand of strategy cards — feints, ambushes, empty-fort bluffs, banquet traps — that bend the rules in your favor. The catch: cards cost action points, and points are scarce. Spend them wrong and you get walled off; hold them too long and one bold move collapses your position.

⚔ 16 Commanders = 16 Ways to Play


  • Sun Tzu — peeks at one of your cards every turn, reads you before you move
  • Caesar — free first move, seizes the initiative
  • Han Xin — fights with his back to the river, lays ambushes
  • Zhuge Liang — plays the empty fortress, waits you out
  • Hannibal — encircles and grinds you down
  • Oda Nobunaga, Alexander, Saladin, Napoleon… and 7 more

Picking your commander before the match is half the battle. Picking the right card mid-match is the other half.

🔥 Why You Won't Put It Down


Every move pulls you two ways. Lock down territory now, or hold your cards and trap them later? Push for the kill, or play safe and win on points? Matches stay tight to the last 30 seconds — there's almost always a comeback if you're sharp enough to find it.

The pressure builds slow. Then it snaps.

💪 Three Modes, One Ruleset


  • Duel — 15-minute 1v1 against 16 commanders, each rewriting the rules
  • Battlefield — a strategic layer with terrain, troop movement and city capture
  • Conquest — roguelite multi-battle runs with a deck that grows as you go

Plus 500 curated challenge stages across 1,500 stars, 30 strategy cards, and a Hard AI that doesn't cheat — it just plays meaner. Before launch we ran 100,000 AI-vs-AI matches to keep every card at a 40–60% win rate and give every commander something to fear. Easy to learn in 5 minutes. Enough depth for 200+ hours.

🎁 Why Wishlist Now


  • Wishlist players get -10% off automatically on day one
  • Full UI in 10 languages — English, Traditional & Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean and more
  • Steam Achievements, Leaderboards and Cloud saves; Steam Deck ready

AI Disclosure

Some visuals (commander portraits, capsule art) and music are AI-generated, all reviewed and edited by the developer before release. The game performs no AI generation at runtime — the opponent AI uses classical minimax search.

data.name: Mortal and Monster
data.detailed_description:
Mortal & Monster is a challenging rogue-like action RPG developed for 6DOF VR platform. We are aiming to combine tower-defense battle system and rogue-like dungeon map together to make an epic single player VR dungeon adventure.

Dynamic Character Build: Discover hundreds of unique weapons, skills, food, potions, wands and other items to make your own build.

Full 6DOF Battle System: Each weapon has its own unique battle style, including sword&shield, claymore, bow, throwing axe. You can use 6DOF controller to input actions like block, slash, stab, two-hand cleave and so on.

Random Map and Events: the dungeon map is generated randomly. Each room contains different events like combat encounters, trap, merchant, bonfire, alter, mini card game and so on. Every time you begin your journey in the dark dungeon, the layout differs which is displayed in map.

30+ unique monsters
10+ different rooms
100+ different random generated weapon and items
20+ skills
10+ mysterious events
30+ achievents to conquer

data.name: Astrocat: Milky Way Journey
data.detailed_description:
Astrocats: Milky Way Journey is a 2d puzzle in which you need to help the novice astrocat Skylar, from the planet Wool, from the distant Tek-1 Galaxy, she was traveling through space on a mission when she spotted a galaxy that looked like a milky way, curious, decided to investigate and saw that unfortunately there was no milk, but a lot of planets and peculiar objects to photograph as she quickly passed through the Milky Way.
As her small camera can't capture the entire galaxy, she took a picture of some planets in that galaxy and decided to put them together on her tablet to send to her planet's scientists, as she continued on her way to her mission.
Skylar is excellent at taking pictures, but terrible at montages, and she also didn't memorize the order of planets and objects very well, so whether you do the montages in the right order of the planets or not, Skylar thinks it's important to show scientists what you've seen. along the way, so she counts on you to finish editing the photos!

Resources:

  • 50 levels.
  • Solve the levels as you wish: what matters is using all the pieces!
  • No keyboards or joysticks! You just need the mouse!
  • Curiosities and information about all the pieces present in the game.
  • Hand-drawn parts.
  • Original and relaxing music.

Also Recommended For You

data.name: Under a Turning Sky
data.detailed_description:
A QUIET PUZZLE AMONG THE STARS

Under A Turning Sky is a meditative celestial puzzle game about finding harmony in alignment.

Rotate planets along their orbit rings, bring their positions and seasons into balance to create a path that carries a lone signal across the systems, and across the stars.

FIND HARMONY IN ALIGNMENT

Every movement changes the relationship between the planets. As planets move so too do they turn on their own axis. Observe the entire system, consider each orbit, and discover the sequence that brings everything into harmony.

The rules are simple to understand, but each new constellation introduces fresh ideas, mechanics, restrictions and puzzeling possibilities.

CARRY THE SIGNAL FORWARD

Guide a single signal from its origin planet, awakening each planet as a relay until the signal unites the system in a unified loop. Every completed connection becomes part of a larger celestial journey, revealing new constellations and new ways of seeing the sky.

A JOURNEY THROUGH THE ZODIAC

Travel through 12 distinctive zodiac worlds, each introducing its own atmosphere, visual identity, calm meditative soundtrack and evolving puzzle ideas. Across more than 150 handcrafted puzzles, the challenge develops gradually from peaceful introductions into intricate celestial systems.

MOVE AT YOUR OWN PACE

There are no timers, no enemies, and no pressure. Take your time, experiment freely, settle into the rhythm of the stars. A colourful, atmospheric universe and transporting soundtrack create a contemplative experience designed for quiet moments of discovery.

FEATURES

  • More than 150 handcrafted celestial puzzles

  • 12 colourful worlds inspired by the zodiac

  • Intuitive orbit and planet-alignment mechanics

  • Gradually evolving spatial and pattern-based challenges

  • No timers, combat or fail states

  • An atmospheric, relaxing original soundtrack

  • A peaceful single-player journey through the cosmos

data.name: パリィでボーガイ！デュアルランナー！
data.detailed_description:
The grand sports festival of spirits, held once every hundred years... is now open!!

A competitive racing game where you compete in two separate lanes, top and bottom!

The key to victory lies in "Parry"!

When an enemy appears, jump! While in the air, press the jump button again... Let's Parry!

Defeated enemies are sealed in the Parry stock!

By pressing the launch button, you can fire the "Obstruction Cannon" at your opponent's lane!

Send defeated obstructions back and disrupt your opponent's run!

Additionally! There is a new "Bread Eating Competition Mode" where you compete to see who can eat more bread before reaching the goal!

*More characters and courses are planned to be added in future updates.

data.name: Guillotine
data.detailed_description:
PLEASE WISHLIST AND FOLLOW - IT REALLY HELPS

The game is being created by a solo developer. Every Wishlist and Follow counts!


About the Game




You're in a tavern in the woods, but someone is a necromorph hungry for human meat. Guillotine the necromorph, or get eaten alive.

Guillotine is a multiplayer game of lying and deceit, with a pinch of survival.

It can be played with 4-18 players.

VOICE CHAT:

Proximity based voice chat. Sing at the piano, or scream for help when the necromorph is hunting you.

ROUNDS:

The game round has 3 phases:

Gather - Run around the forest, grabbing food and resources.
Discuss - The fog of death starts to rise up. Time to come back to the tavern, craft equipment and discuss.
Vote - Vote a player to get guillotined.

HUNGER:

Necromorphs have to kill people to satisfy their hunger.
Humans have to find food in the forest. Food growing plants are scattered in the forest, but most of them are located around the giant vines.

MATERIALS:

Materials can be collected around the map. They are used to craft items and upgrade equipment.

ZEPPELIN:

data.about_the_game:
You're in a tavern in the woods, but someone is a necromorph hungry for human meat. Guillotine the necromorph, or get eaten alive.

Guillotine is a multiplayer game of lying and deceit, with a pinch of survival.

It can be played with 4-18 players.

VOICE CHAT:

Proximity based voice chat. Sing at the piano, or scream for help when the necromorph is hunting you.

ROUNDS:

The game round has 3 phases:

Gather - Run around the forest, grabbing food and resources.
Discuss - The fog of death starts to rise up. Time to come back to the tavern, craft equipment and discuss.
Vote - Vote a player to get guillotined.

HUNGER:

Necromorphs have to kill people to satisfy their hunger.
Humans have to find food in the forest. Food growing plants are scattered in the forest, but most of them are located around the giant vines.

MATERIALS:

Materials can be collected around the map. They are used to craft items and upgrade equipment.

ZEPPELIN:

Humans can call a zeppelin by depositing the materials on its call table. Once all the required materials are there, the zeppelin will fly into the tavern's tower and rescue whoever gets in it. If any player manages to escape alive, it is a human victory.

data.name: Hereford 1642
data.detailed_description:
About This Project

You need to be aware that this is a historic recreation project and doesn't contain any game play that you would expect from a traditional game at this point. The game should be very enjoyable from a historic stand point and for exploring the past. Thank you


Join our disord

Help us with development and feedback by joining the discord


About the Game

A historically based recreation of my home city of Hereford in England UK from the year 1642. I have pieced together a picture of the city as it once was. Take a step into 17th century life and experience history in full 3D with realistic graphics.

Using period maps, illustrations and drawings, together with still existing period buildings in the City and elsewhere; A scale model of the city as it once was.

Over 200 unique enterable buildings together with the the city walls and gates, the castle and the bridge over the river Wye. Beyond the gates you can travel the countryside; A 4Km * 4Km map allows you to journey and explore a mile from the city in any direction. With towering cathedrals and churches seen from miles away. A highly interactable environment awaits with many hidden gems to find.

Your character lives and works in the 17th century with all that entails. Period clothes, money, tools, transport, food, language, writing, to name but a few aspects.

The past is another country: they do things differently there.

data.name: Burden of Truth
data.detailed_description:
Burden of Truth is the next entry in the Burden of Proof saga, marking the return of this grand courtroom adventure! Experience the missing chapter from the original story which has been restored & fleshed out into a full game. Gather evidence by investigating the crime scene, find contradictions in the courtroom, and confront the truth with everything you have!



One year after his mentor's poisoning, renowned prosecutor Conrad Cross accepts a new case tangled in a web of conspiracy. In order to determine the true culprit, Cross and his opponent, Kate Flocking, engage in a battle of wits and piece together the incident by analyzing the available evidence. However, this objective proves difficult to accomplish when it's revealed that a mysterious organization is interfering with the flow of information to the courtroom. Even so, the legal counsel is determined to persevere through these limitations and expel the lies by uncovering contradictions within the witness' statements. To deliver justice, someone must be found guilty.



But as the trial winds down, an unsettling situation unfolds when a mysterious figure informs Cross that his childhood friend, Sarah Fletcher, has been arrested on suspicion of murder. At the same time, the dangerous rebellion group 209 Dive mounts an assault to retrieve the Zero Data, a database of information that could plunge the world into nuclear war if it falls into the wrong hands. Knowing that Sarah could never be responsible for the heinous crime she's accused of, Cross must turn his entire mindset around to become the defense attorney that his friend deserves. As the only person capable of saving Fletcher and preventing the catastrophic consequences of the Zero Data's exposure, Cross must enter a deadly trial that could very well determine the fate of the world.



Burden of Truth continues RobProductions' iconic hybrid-genre experience with third person investigations and challenging logic puzzles that test your knowledge of each case. Explore the crime scene as you survey full 3D environments for traces of the culprit. Collect evidence and make surprising deductions via the new tagging system, which highlights more information about the status of each clue. Hold people accountable by tracking the source of each item added to the court record, or utilize on-hand items to get out of dangerous situations.



Then, make your case in the courtroom by cross-examining witnesses and presenting evidence that favors your argument. As legal counsel, you get to choose when to object and when to hold back, but be warned; the judge and his counselors grow weary with every faulty step, so be sure to back up your claims with concrete proof. As you make choices that affect the course of the trial, new discoveries can be made that contradict previous testimony. With logic as your weapon, search for the erroneous statement within the witness' assertions and take the fight to them!



The outcome of the case is in your hands. As such, the burden lies with you to deduce the truth and deliver justice for those that have been wrongly accused!



  • Uncover the missing link showcasing Cross' transition from a steadfast prosecutor to a legendary defense attorney
  • Experience new & familiar locations from Burden of Proof with completely overhauled graphics
  • Choose when to object in court & discover your own path to victory
  • Collect evidence at the crime scene & present it later to further your case
  • Utilize the new hint system to customize the puzzle difficulty
  • Expose shocking lies within witness testimonies via the new evidence tagging system
  • 4k screen support & compatible with any framerate
  • Native versions for macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Support for common input hardware, including the Xbox & DualSense controllers
  • Complete subtitle support and other common accessibility features
  • Full original soundtrack & album release

data.name: Commando Collection
data.detailed_description:
This collection is a living library that continues to grow. In addition to the core titles—Commando 2, Commando X, and Commando 3, we are dedicated to progressively restoring the extensive Macrojoy back catalog.

Every game joining the collection undergoes a comprehensive remaster, including:

  • HD Visual Enhancements: Giving classic graphics a crisp, modern look.

  • Difficulty Rebalancing: Adjusted gameplay for a better user experience.

  • Technical Modernization: Upgraded code to ensure smooth performance on modern systems.

Commando 2

The game has been fully optimized in this compilation, featuring new enemies, enriched level design, a new Workshop system, high-definition visuals, balanced difficulty, and adjusted AI for some bosses. Additionally, many interesting sound effects have been added, making the gameplay experience more immersive for players.

After entering the game, you can find a wealth of customizable options in the settings screen in the upper left corner, such as enemy generation multiplier, boss summoning troops and blood effect personalization. Through these settings, you will experience a different kind of gameplay from your childhood, and you will be able to face the tidal wave of enemies and feel the extreme pleasure of sweeping away thousands of troops!

Commando X Allied Assault

As an offshoot of Commando 2, players in this game will engage in positional confrontation with enemy forces, experiencing a completely different group combat mode from that of Generation 2. As with "Commando 2", this work has also been fully optimized to bring a better gaming experience.

Commando 3

As a sequel to Commando 2, this game adds a rich mount system, more enemy types and battle scenes, while the game's painting style has changed from a Q version to a more realistic style, bringing players a more realistic war experience.

Special Gift Section

This section contains a small music video for Commando 2, scanned designs, a curtain call animation for the entire cast, and an introduction to the series' future plans. This special content provides players with even more to enjoy and look forward to outside of the game.

The Macrojoy Completion Project kicked off in December 2025! Keep an eye on the right-hand list in the "Special Gift" section，we are constantly adding new games to expand this collection.

Whether you're a veteran or a newcomer to the series, Commando Collection will bring you unprecedentedly intense battles and a rich gaming experience. Get ready to step onto the battlefields of World War II and experience the passion of combat!

Some key visuals and promotional illustrations for this game were generated using AI tools based on original characters from the game, and are intended for promotional use only.

data.name: Solara: Starlight Horizon
data.detailed_description:
A Multiplayer Space Sandbox Experience


Set out as a nameless pilot with an unremarkable ship and a handful of credits. Earn influence and wealth by taking missions for various factions throughout the universe. Obtain the respect or ire of law enforcement, become a feared bounty hunter, a daring smuggler, or a ruthless outlaw. Every mission you take, every ship you destroy, every convoy you rob will affect your standing with numerous factions. Use your earned credits to outfit your ship, hire a crew, and purchase larger, faster, or more powerful ships.

Explore an Open-World

Traverse star systems using trade lanes, jump gates, and hidden worm holes solo or with a group of friends. Discover profitable trade routes, find bustling planets, and lifeless moons. Loot unique weapons and hardware by stumbling upon derelict ships in debris fields.

data.name: TapMazing
data.detailed_description:
Step into the eccentric laboratory of Doctor Rulo with TapMazing, an engaging game where you guide Po-G, a whimsical slime hero, through a vibrant and challenging world. Inspired by scientific experimentation and slimy ingenuity, this game blends fun with strategic depth. Explore a lab brimming with surprises, where each tap reveals a new twist!

Gameplay and Modes

TapMazing combines skill and strategy across diverse game modes:

  • Tracks: Master smooth paths with no obstacles to hone your tapping precision.

  • Gauntlets: Tackle twisting routes packed with obstacles, demanding skillful navigation.

  • Scavenger Hunts: Hunt for hidden cookie pieces, split into four parts, within compact mazes.

  • Mazes: Conquer expansive mazes filled with obstacles, seeking a single hidden cookie.

  • More to Come: Anticipate future updates with exciting new modes on the horizon!

Each mode challenges your reflexes and offers a unique experience, suitable for players of all skill levels.

Difficulties

Doctor Rulo offers four distinct difficulty levels to choose from:

  • Slime: Perfect for beginners to learn the basics, where obstacles sting and electric gates can end your run.

  • Volt: Walls crackle with electricity, causing damage on contact—ideal for intermediate players.

  • Lava: Walls turn to lethal lava, instantly ending Po-G’s journey with a single hit, suited for experienced players.

  • Acid: Walls dissolve Po-G into acid, forcing a restart from the mode’s beginning—perfect for hardcore enthusiasts.

Customization

Personalize Po-G to reflect your style with a variety of customization options!

  • A vibrant color palette featuring shades like Amber, Vermilion, and Jasmine.

  • Unique skins and accessories to enhance your slime hero’s look.

  • Customize Po-G’s core to match your preferences.

  • More customization slots are coming soon!

Achievements

Unlock achievements by demonstrating your prowess!

1166 is a psychological horror game following six people in Salem, Massachusetts and how their lives change when one of them is kidnapped….


Fight through pain, depression, and grotesque monsters to uncover the truth. The darkness has taken a hold, will you see the light or hide in the shadows? Or will you find another way? Will you slaughter everything in your path, or take a more passive approach? The choice is yours...

Made by a one man (and two cats) development team, this dark mystery has simple artwork, keyboard and mouse controls, compelling multiple endings and original music.


Key Features:

-Thrilling adventure with a deep story that captivates from beginning to end.

-Charming pixel-art graphics and a simple interface that gets out of your way.

-Complex characters, each with their own personality and agenda.

-Original soundtrack.

-Multiple endings, each with part of the whole story.

-Exciting combat that pushes you to move with caution.

-Available on PC, MAC, Linux.

-Occasional Pixel boob!


1166 contains strong adult themes and is recommended for player over 18.

data.name: Gaudí: Winds of Barcelona
data.detailed_description:
Barcelona, 1992


The world is abuzz with the approaching Olympic Games. Nations compete for prestige while Barcelona prepares to welcome the world.

Henry Howard arrives seemingly untouched by the excitement. A former Scotland Yard detective turned information consultant, he travels to Spain after accepting a sensitive assignment connected to the country's fragile political balance.

What begins as an unusual assignment draws Henry into a web of political intrigue, conflicting ideals and death. Beneath Barcelona's sunlit streets, light and shadow struggle to maintain an uncertain balance. To discover the truth, Henry must confront the city, its people and his own past.

Read the city. Follow the clues.


Gaudí is a classic point-and-click adventure in which every action depends on what you examine. Explore detailed locations, question their inhabitants, collect key objects and travel across Barcelona using the city map. Careful observation and the right decision at the right moment will move the investigation forward.

A X68000 adventure, reborn


Originally released by Wolf Team for the X68000, Gaudí returns in a native Windows edition that faithfully interprets the original scripts, pixel art and FM soundtrack without requiring hardware emulation.

  • A story-driven mystery set in Barcelona before the 1992 Olympic Games.
  • Context-sensitive point-and-click investigation and exploration.
  • Original pixel art and an authentic YM2151 FM soundtrack.
  • Playable in English, Spanish, Catalan and Japanese.
  • Mouse and keyboard controls, with partial controller support.
  • Four independent save slots for each language.
  • Optional CRT, LCD, Composite and dedithering display effects.

The free demo version is now available on Steam, which includes two chapters of the game for free!

data.name: Shape Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Angry shapes. Giant bosses. Screen-clearing builds.

Fight growing swarms across distinct arenas. Choose upgrades, combine weapons, and build the firepower to take on giant bosses. Collect Poly shards for permanent upgrades, then return with a new build and push further.

Build your own brand of chaos

Combine weapons and upgrades to fill the battlefield with swords, fire, lightning, and more. Experiment with different combinations and turn a growing swarm into a screen-clearing spectacle.

Take on giant bosses

Explore different arenas with their own enemies and giant bosses. Dodge attacks and keep your build dealing damage while the swarm closes in.

Hold the Beacon

Stay inside the beacon’s circle to charge it before time runs out. Hold your position against the swarm to earn treasure chests, Poly shards, and experience.

Hold your ground

The arena gradually shrinks over the course of a run. Survive long enough, and you’ll have less room to maneuver as the swarm closes in.

Come back stronger

Earn Poly shards during your runs and spend them on permanent upgrades to damage, health, movement speed, and more. Complete achievements to unlock new starting weapons and try a different approach on your next run.

Find your look

Unlock cosmetic hats with Poly shards, achievements, and a victorious run. Choose your look without changing your stats.

Chase your next best run

Compete on global leaderboards and work toward achievements as you experiment with new builds. There’s more to chase than survival.

Earn Poly shards during your runs and spend them on permanent upgrades to damage, health, movement speed, and more. Complete achievements to unlock new starting weapons and try a different approach on your next run.

Find your look

Unlock cosmetic hats with Poly shards, achievements, and a victorious run. Choose your look without changing your stats.

Chase your next best run

Compete on global leaderboards and work toward achievements as you experiment with new builds. There’s more to chase than survival.

data.name: HIRU : Mansa Assegai
data.detailed_description:
HIRU is an action-adventure game where you embody a young Masai prince on a relentless quest for justice across the vast African continent. When poachers murder your family and kidnap your sister in retaliation for protecting elephants, you must channel ancient warrior traditions and survival skills to track them down. Experience an epic journey of vengeance and redemption that spans diverse landscapes, from the Masai Mara savannas to the Congo forests and Nigerian Sahara deserts in the heart of the African wilderness.

Core Gameplay

What You'll Do:

  • Track Your Enemies - Use authentic tracking techniques to follow poacher trails across thousands of miles, reading footprints, animal movements, and environmental clues that reveal enemy movements.

  • Master Traditional Combat - Wield traditional Masai weapons like spears, simi's and clubs alongside modern tools, combining ancestral fighting techniques with tactical gameplay.

  • Navigate Diverse Terrains - Journey through realistic African environments including savannas, forests, towns, mountains, and deserts, each presenting unique challenges and opportunities.

  • Protect Wildlife - Encounter and save elephants and other endangered animals while learning about conservation efforts that mirror real-world initiatives.

Story & Setting

The Journey:

Set against the backdrop of modern Africa, HIRU tells a deeply personal story of loss, tradition, and determination. As a Masai prince, you understand the delicate balance between communities and wildlife conservation, but when poachers cross the line by targeting your family, the Masai ancient code of justice demands vengence. Your sister's life hangs in the balance as you traverse a continent, uncovering a larger conspiracy that threatens both your people and the animals you've sworn to protect.

Key Features

WARRIOR'S PATH 

Combine traditional Masai warrior skills with modern survival techniques as you adapt to different terrains and threats across Africa.

AUTHENTIC TRACKING SYSTEM
Experience one of gaming's most realistic tracking mechanics, using environmental storytelling and traditional hunting knowledge to pursue your quarry.

CULTURAL IMMERSION
Discover authentic Masai traditions, languages, and customs while exploring diverse African cultures and communities throughout your journey.

CONSERVATION NARRATIVE
Engage with real wildlife conservation themes as you protect elephants and other endangered species from poaching, reflecting actual conservation efforts across Africa.

EPIC SCALE ADVENTURE
Traverse a massive, beautifully rendered African continent with varied biomes, weather systems, and day-night cycles.

Why Wishlist HIRU

This gripping tale of family, tradition, and justice offers a unique perspective rarely seen in gaming. HIRU combines the emotional depth of personal revenge stories that have captivated players in titles across the action-adventure genre with authentic cultural representation and meaningful conservation themes. As you await its release, you'll be supporting a game that honors both traditional African culture and modern conservation efforts while delivering the intense action and compelling narrative that define the best adventure games.

Add HIRU to your wishlist today and prepare for an unforgettable journey across Africa where every step brings you closer to justice, and every choice determines the fate of both family and wildlife.

data.name: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
data.detailed_description:
Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

A Soul That Refused to Stay Dead

Become the Abyssal Dragon, a legendary general who once served under Emperor Yan, stripped of his name, cast into exile, and slain in battle. For centuries, only a sliver of his soul survived. Now, through a forbidden curse, he seizes the body of Yi, the godson of the flood-taming hero Yu, moments before death claims them both. Reborn in a form none could have predicted, the Abyssal Dragon walks the mortal world again, carrying centuries of unfinished business and a regret that even death could not bury.

Dual Weapon Combat System

Armed with a dual-weapon combat system, carve your way through gods, demons, and monsters drawn from ancient Eastern mythology. Every run is a fresh trial. Unlock new abilities, discover powerful combinations, and push deeper into a world that grows stranger and more dangerous the further you go. Death is never the end. Each cycle brings new understanding, new strength, and new pieces of a truth that has been buried for ages.

Re-live in the Mythical World of “Classic of Mountains and Seas”

Explore a world torn apart by catastrophic floods and divine conflict. Uncover the fate of Yu, the flood hero who has vanished without a trace. And confront the question at the heart of it all: what does a soul that has survived everything still have left to fight for?

Key Features:

Dual-Weapon Combat — Switch freely between two weapon types during combat, building synergies and adapting your style on the go.

Roguelike Depth — Every run brings new choices. Every death is a step toward something stronger.

Mythic World of "Classic of Mountains and Seas" — Navigate ancient lands steeped in lore, from storm-lashed mountains to celestial islands hidden beyond the sky.

data.name: Outbreak: Dead City
data.detailed_description:
Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity!

Join the H.A.D.E.S. special forces team as they drop into a cityscape overrun by zombies in hopes of recovering valuable research, evacuating a key scientist and perhaps even finding a vaccine to put an end to the apocalypse! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

Take the role of a soldier tasked with locating a hidden laboratory, use firearms and melee strikes to fend off undead hordes and work with your squad as you navigate the urban sprawl. Cycle between upgradeable weapon types like semi-automatic rifles, handguns and more, pick up ammo wherever you can find it and make contact with human survivors to gain information or supplies. Complete mission objectives and survive at all costs, then push your skills even further in New Game Plus.

The fate of humanity depends on your success!

Features:

  • Explore a zombie-infested cityscape in first-person perspective!

  • Customize and upgrade weaponry to improve your odds of survival.

  • Interact with fellow squad members and other human survivors!

  • Complete mission objectives to earn valuable resources.

  • Locate a hidden laboratory in hopes of finding a vaccine!

data.name: Chronicles: Medieval
data.detailed_description:
Chronicles: Medieval puts you at the center of a vast medieval sandbox, where the battles you fight, the army you build, and the decisions you make are what shape the course of your journey.

Combat is at the heart of it. Hundreds of soldiers clash around you, banners against banners, steel against steel. You command your troops in real time while fighting alongside them, rising from an unknown soldier to someone this era will remember.

Write your story, make your name!

A world built from history

Step into a medieval Europe shaped by the conflicts of the Hundred Years' War. A grounded world that rewards the curious.

Built on technology that makes every landscape feel rich and credible, accompanied by an authentic soundtrack.

Move through a turbulent era that never stands still. Factions shift in power, enemy forces patrol the landscape, and unexpected events unfold as you travel.

Intense battles await you

Hundreds of soldiers clash around you. Cavalry hammers into infantry lines. Banners clash, steel meets steel. This is medieval warfare, and you are in the middle of it.

The battles are demanding. Timing, formations, positioning, and the nerve to hold your ground when everything around you is falling apart.

In Chronicles: Medieval, you are both commander and warrior. In the heat of battle, you issue orders to your troops without ever leaving the fight. Position your Longbowmen at the right distance. Drive your cavalry into a crumbling line. Then draw your sword and enter the fight yourself.

Every unit fights with purpose. Longbowmen, men-at-arms, crossbowmen, cavalry, and more - each with a distinct role, each responding to your orders in real time.

Your choices, Your journey

Medieval Europe is full of opportunity, and what you do with it is entirely up to you. Where you ride, who you fight, how you build your character and your army are your decisions, so where does your path lead? 

Every choice leaves a mark: the banner you raise, the army you build, the battles you pick; all of it shapes your reputation and brings you one step closer to glory.

Chronicles: Medieval builds the stage, and you write the story…

A game that grows with you

Chronicles: Medieval launches into Early Access as the foundation of something larger. The world will deepen, the systems will grow, and the community shapes what comes next. New content, new features, and modding support are part of the road ahead.

This is just the beginning.

data.name: Yingtao Inn
data.detailed_description:
[About Languages & Voice‑Over]

The demo currently has no voiceover. The full version will include partial voiceover.

The game currently supports the following languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Korean, Japanese, Russian, French, Turkish, Vietnamese, Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong, Cantonese colloquial translation), and Brazilian Portuguese.

If you'd like to see your local language added, please feel free to contact us.

[About the Story]

A secluded inn deep in the mountains. A letter left behind. A destiny long sealed away.

You come following your grandmother's final wish, expecting nothing more than to see the place she tended all her life.

A gentle and thoughtful keeper. A jovial, spirited girl. A short-tempered, enigmatic woman with fiery red hair.

Warm meals, idle chatter, and the gentle rhythm of ordinary days. Life settles around you like a quiet dream.

Until one midnight passes — and you realize: this inn doesn't only take in travelers.

[About the Opening]

An immersive prologue that begins on a mountain trail. Make your way along a winding, untended path toward the inn your grandmother left behind. Slow your pace. Feel the gravel shift beneath your feet, catch your breath in the thin forest air, listen to the wind and the insects as you find your bearings. Shake the dust from your clothes. Take a sip of water. Let the stillness of the wild dissolve the clamor of the world you left behind.

There's no need to hurry. Beyond the ridge, the lights of the inn are already lit.

[Features]

Slow-Burn Narrative: A story that unfolds gently, peeling back the warmth of everyday life to reveal the deeper truths buried within the inn.

Light Interactive Elements: Simple, intuitive quick-time actions woven seamlessly into the narrative, keeping you engaged without pulling you out of the story.

A Living Ensemble: A cast of distinct, deeply human characters — each with their own secrets and regrets — who will accompany you through this strange mountain journey.

Chinese Folk Fantasy Reimagined: Blending the quiet eeriness of traditional Chinese tales with genuine human warmth. Unsettling yet never cold.

[About Localization]

As our studio is small‑scaled, some localized texts are AI‑assisted so that players from more regions can experience the game as soon as possible. Should you find any translation errors, please feel free to send us your feedback and suggestions for improvement.

data.name: Watch Party
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Stream

And You're Tonight's Star

Just when you're about to watch your favorite streamer, you realize something is off.  The house he is looking at, it's yours, and he just broke in.

Run, hide until the cops come, find a way to escape your house, without running away on foot, for his "accomplices" hides in the bushes. Check the stream to find out where the Streamer is at, read chat while in a closet, if that's what you're into.

Several mid game events to spice up the survival.

3 Endings to achieve.

Controls: 

Left Click: Open/Close Doors; Hide in closets and curtained bathtubs; Interact

Right Click: Watch the stream

Shift: Sprint

Ctrl (or C): Crouch

E: Pick Up/Pickpocket Items

F: Flashlight

X/Y: Lean

Additional information about what's in the game:

It is a one map game.

A killer to avoid.

A puzzle to solve.

Plenty of items to pick up.

Plenty of hiding spots.

There is an internal timer in game.

data.name: Astro Loopers
data.detailed_description:
Astro Loopers

What if you could rewind time — and team up with your past self?


Astro Loopers is a Sokoban-style puzzle game set in a cosmic universe, where every move echoes through time. Your past characters repeat their actions as time loops stack up — coordinate them to solve increasingly mind-bending stages.

Unique Characters

Each character comes with a special ability that interacts with blocks in different ways —
break them, push them, or pull them!
Master each character’s skill to solve complex puzzles and conquer every stage.

Variety of Gimmicks

Stages are filled with diverse and tricky mechanics:
slippery ice floors, explosive blocks, and more!
Learning how to use each gimmick to your advantage is the key to mastering the puzzles.

Over 120 Stages

Embark on an adventure to find the Time Shards scattered across the universe in over 120 stages.

From simple early stages to challenging levels that put your brain to the test, each stage challenges your ingenuity and creativity.

Streaming & Monetization Guidelines

You are free to stream, record, and monetize gameplay videos of Astro Loopers.
We encourage all creators to share and enjoy the game in any way they like!

data.name: Hearth Storm
data.detailed_description:
Hearth Storm is a turn-based strategy game where players attack and defend using cards. Strategically play to outwit enemies in this Solitaire-inspired game. With 20+ unique classes and dynamic card mechanics, every match offers fresh challenges and endless strategic possibilities.

TURN-BASED STRATEGY MEETS CARD COMBAT

At its core, Hearth Storm revolves around players attack and defend by drawing cards from their deck. Each turn presents a choice: should you play an aggressive card to deal heavy damage or a defensive card to prepare for incoming attacks?

Every move requires careful planning as you balance your strategy between offense and survival. The dynamic card mechanics ensure that each battle is a test of wit and adaptability.

With 20+ distinct classes, each boasting unique abilities and playstyles, the game invites creative strategies and experimentation. No two runs will feel the same, offering endless opportunities for discovery and replayability.

ROGUELIKE WITH DECKBUILDING

Engage in carefully crafted battles teeming with challenges and opportunities for creative play. Choose which enemies to confront as you adapt your strategy based on your hero’s unique abilities and the cards at your disposal.

Each match is a standalone challenge that pushes you to think tactically and use your resources wisely. While progress resets after each encounter, players can continuously refine their strategies and experiment with different classes to discover powerful synergies.

CRAFT CRAZY COMBOS

Hearth Storm’s unique blend of strategy, chance, and RPG mechanics delivers a dynamic and evolving gameplay experience. Whether you’re a fan of dungeon crawlers, deckbuilders, or dice games, the game offers endless ways to craft powerful combos, overcome challenges, and enjoy hours of replayable fun.

Unfold your cards, roll your dice, and conquer the dungeon in Hearth Storm!

data.name: Odd Remedy
data.detailed_description:
Odd Remedy is an online multiplayer action-adventure game in which you make your escape from a dangerous, abandoned island infested with monster spiders. Loot the island for tools and survival, use your smartphones to communicate and work together to complete objectives. Hoard and craft items in prison to prepare for your escape. Destroy the isolating dungeon to reveal the secret boat, attach it to your car and hit the off-road without the Blackfang Corp catching you. The island is at your disposal to reach your goals the way you want to, but it's new inhabitants will not allow you to feel safe at every turn.

SHARING IS CARING

Use your smartphones to call, text and share (relevant) photos and videos, among other things. Be aware that your phones also make noise, sometimes attracting unwanted attention.


TEAMWORK

While stealth is an option, against the hordes of spiders, your fellow prisoners are key to increase your chances of success. Work together, fight together.


HOME SWEET PRISON

Collect (cool) items from your journeys and customize your prison workplace. Manage your inventory, craft (useful) stuff for your next journey or treat yourself.


Features:

  • Online multiplayer with up to 8 players

  • Interactive phone system (phone calls, messages, taking/sending photos and videos)

  • Customizable player faces with any image file

  • Physics based interactions with objects and items

  • Interactive vehicle mechanics

  • Procedurally generated open-world island map (each run is different)

  • Collecting items and upgrading your base

  • Dynamic enemy behaviour

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Original soundtrack

  • Prisongram

  • Versus Hot Egg mode


Some Lore:

Blackfang Corp - a secret, government-backed military unit, running experiments on unique weapons and people in occupied, hidden areas. As tests on mutating spider monster species in the so called Hell Island were handled by underpaid and unmotivated workers, a dozen of spiders have unknowingly escaped the facility. The bugs were growing and multiplying in the forest for months, until they would eventually run out of resources, and begin flooding into the city. The emergency alarms were set on blast as many Blackfang workers escaped. Lacking further resources and desperate for a solution, they select a few prisoners to send on a remotely supervised mission. That's you, you are the odd remedy. What they don't know though, is that you have other plans.

data.name: Chat Millions - Stream Quiz Game
data.detailed_description:
Play the classic 4-choice quiz with a new twist, and see if your twitch chat has what it takes to win the millions.

Twitch integration


This game is build around playing with viewers. When playing in "Stream Mode" the game will poll answers from chat and choose the most popular. Finally they can prove whether they really do know more than you!

But don't rest yet, if chat can't decide they might leave it up to you...

Lifelines


Along with voting on answers, chat members can vote to use a lifeline. If that wins you have a variety of options:
  • 50:50 - Take away half the answers, leaving the right answer and one wrong answer.
  • Streamer's Choice - Most quiz games ask the audience, in Chat Millions the audience asks you!
  • Swap The Question - Got absolutely no idea what the answer could be? For one time you can try another question instead.

Categories


There are a variety of topics to choose from, you can play with all of them or just your favourites. Of course if you have more topics you get more variety, but that's a decision left for you.

Planned additions


  • More questions in existing topics
  • More topics
  • The ability to add your own questions

To keep up to date with all new additions make sure to check out our contact links.

Thank you for looking at this game and I hope you enjoy!

data.name: Brainrot Game
data.detailed_description:
This is a roguelike game about managing attention. Play 3 brainrot games at once with interconnected mechanics, and see how far you can progress.

UNLOCK BRAIN FUNCTIONS

Confront popular memes to unlock more of your brain functions that leads to more things to manage and difficult tasks to endure: such as talking to girls or taking a shower.

GET IN TOUCH WITH REALITY

What lies beyond your screen? How would I know if I spent most of the time making this cringe game. But you can find out as more and more of the reality bleeds into your brainrotten-bliss. And now you actually have to take responsibilities.

USE ABILITIES

Unlike you, your character actually invests in skills to help them progress in life. Strategize between a wide range of buffs, power-ups, and abilities to aid in your journey of re-awakening your brain.

TALKING CATS

The cats, they talk to you. Meet and chat with a colorful cast of cats each with their unique personalities, unlike you. Help them with tasks and progress through a narrative riddled with seemingly deep and philosophical conversations, until you realize the dev was high while writing the script.

GENRE-BENDING TWIST ENDING

Why is there actual progression in my dumb mobile arcade clone? Because beyond the brainrot lies a haunting truth: a reality you must confront - THE OUTSIDE. Can you lock in and defeat the final challenge after opening the door? Or will you choose to stay in this room and forever brainrot your life away?

What lies beyond your screen? How would I know if I spent most of the time making this cringe game. But you can find out as more and more of the reality bleeds into your brainrotten-bliss. And now you actually have to take responsibilities.

USE ABILITIES

Unlike you, your character actually invests in skills to help them progress in life. Strategize between a wide range of buffs, power-ups, and abilities to aid in your journey of re-awakening your brain.

TALKING CATS

The cats, they talk to you. Meet and chat with a colorful cast of cats each with their unique personalities, unlike you. Help them with tasks and progress through a narrative riddled with seemingly deep and philosophical conversations, until you realize the dev was high while writing the script.

GENRE-BENDING TWIST ENDING

Why is there actual progression in my dumb mobile arcade clone? Because beyond the brainrot lies a haunting truth: a reality you must confront - THE OUTSIDE. Can you lock in and defeat the final challenge after opening the door? Or will you choose to stay in this room and forever brainrot your life away?
data.short_description: Manage your attention while playing 3 brainrot games at the same time for as long as possible, while low-poly cats yap philosophy at you. Unlock brain functions to finally stand up, go outside, and maybe even touch some grass.

data.name: The Operational Art of War IV
data.detailed_description:
The legend is back!

The Operational Art of War IV is the new generation of operational wargames. With more flexibility than before and with a new array of exciting features, it will make you relive the most iconic battles from the dawn of the 20th Century to modern day, including the ones that never occurred!



More than 200 scenarios like the Battle of Marne, Dien Bien Phu, the Batte of Arnhem, the Falkland Invasion - and lots more! - will forge your strategy skills and ability to master all kind of troops and terrains!

The entire naval warfare system has been completely revised and implemented, bringing its realism to a new, higher, level!



The supply system has been greatly enhanced, allowing a more gradual simulation without adding extra tasks to the players.

In addition, the game will feature an Improved combat resolution, a much more consistent combat round management, along with major improvements to the TOAW Editor Event system, making complex scenarios easier to create!



A new Battlefield Time Stamp feature takes on TOAW's unique way of handling game turn resolution and makes it easier for players to plan ahead!

And for those among you intimidated by large scenarios, an Improved PO/AI assist automation exists to make handing off part of your friendly forces to the AI easier!

The Operational Art of War IV is the top-notch military simulation that every wargamer needs!

FEATURES

New naval warfare features

  • The modeling of ships has been improved. Instead of treating ships as a single piece of equipment, like a gun or a squad, they are now treated as complex systems that incur damage in combat. Ships have new armor, durability, accuracy, speed, and agility parameters.
  • Embarked units no longer employ their own strengths in defense. Naval combat now evaluates attackers’ Anti-Naval strengths as individual shots/planes – employing their shell weights to determine armor penetration and resulting damage.
  • Sea Interdiction can now be employed by aircraft, ships, and coastal guns. Ships subjected to sea interdiction fire counterbattery back (or, in the case of carriers, counterstrikes).

New Supply system

  • There is now an intermediate supply state that falls between “Supplied” and “Unsupplied”. It’s called “Overextended”. A new parameter called the Overextended Supply Threshold has been implemented. That is the location supply value below which locations are overextended. Units in such hexes will function somewhat between how supplied and unsupplied units function. The result will be that it will be much more difficult for units to press on at red-lined unit conditions from such locations.
  • Motorized unit movement over improved roads can be set by the designer to be less than one MP per improved road hex (for example, ½ MP per hex). If optioned, this affects supply in that supply lines traced over improved roads will extend proportionately further than over other terrain, like regular roads. Note how this would especially affect desert scenarios.
  • The limit of 50% unit supply recovery per turn has been lifted.

Other game features

  • Range Limits: Ranged units can have their nominal ranges player limited. This can be used to tailor bomber ranges to match fighter cover ranges or to make units with multiple range equipment operate within the range of the shortest-ranged equipment. The DBR will reflect the modified range.
  • Deployment Recovery: Ranged units retain their deployment states after combat and ground assaulters can recover theirs if a planned combat is canceled.
  • New Bridge Destruction Rules: There is an option to limit bridge hexes (for destruction purposes) to locations where the road feature graphically crosses the river feature.
  • Combat Report Review. Combat reports are saved in the pbl/sal files for review by both players during their player turns.
  • Adaptation of Matrix’s PBEM++ system.

data.name: Xen'Fonia: Path of Fortune
data.detailed_description:
Xen'Fonia: Path of Fortune is a strategic roguelite combining trading, deck-building, inventory management, and turn-based card combat.

Travel across the Nine Realms, monitor shifting markets, buy and sell goods, and carefully manage your limited inventory space. The cargo you carry affects not only your profits, but also your combat capability.

Encounter battles, merchants, and choice-driven events along node-based routes. Craft your build with new cards and treasures, then plan every turn around your enemy.

Beneath the Dragon Constellation appearing in the sky and amidst a progressively fragile peace, you begin not as a hero, but as a merchant wandering the continent's roads.

Every run offers new routes, new opportunities, and new strategies.

data.name: Renown
data.detailed_description:
In Renown, the open-world is your battlefield, and only the strongest will rule. Gather resources, build sprawling castles, and lead your clan into battle against rival players. Whether you're crafting siege engines to crush enemy walls, clashing swords in intense duels, or rallying your neighbors to destroy your enemies, prove your strength and become truly renowned.

Survive and Explore

Hunt, gather, craft and build to carve out your stronghold in a world filled with those who want to take everything you own. Whether you prefer to farm the wilderness, forge weaponry for the frontline or build defensive structures for your group, there's always a job to be done to ensure your survival.

Expand and Conquer

From simple camps to mighty castles, they are all targets for your destruction. Fight for control over key points of interest, gather vital resources, and launch devastating sieges against rival strongholds. In the struggle for power, there can only be one winner.

Skill-Based Combat

Victory is earned through skill, not chance. Wield a variety of medieval weapons and armor as you step onto the fray, where precise, skill-based combat decides your fate. One perfect strike, or a single fatal mistake can turn the tide of battle.

Unique Customisation

Customize your knight freely with a vast selection of armor appearances, tabards, emblems, and color schemes. Whether you prefer to roam the battlefield as a robed monk or stand alongside warriors draped in red and white beneath a blood moon banner, the choice is yours.

Free and Lawless

The world of Renown is a place of little oversight, your decisions are yours to make and the only repercussions are those exercised by your enemies. Build anywhere, kill anyone, raid everyone, take everything!

Key Features

  • Fast-paced PvP medieval survival with a strong emphasis on melee combat

  • From building humble farms to huge fortresses, the choice is with the player

  • Destroy all your neighbors with awe inspiring siege engines

  • Group systems for making Claims, taking titles, giving ranks and more

  • Customize everything from the helmet on your head to the banners on your base

  • Server Progression and Wipe systems, for an engaging and vastly replayable experience

  • Tools for Community Hosts to help tailor their servers. Future plans for extensive mod support
