data.name: 催眠スクールデイズ - Hypnotic School Days -
data.detailed_description:
"Hypnotic School Days" is a novel game in which a lame protagonist uses a hypnosis app he acquires to rapidly get close to the heroines.
A Bishojo Game released in 2018 under the "Noirsoft" brand has been reworked for the "PandaShojo" platform for players of all ages worldwide to enjoy.



◆Introduction
"Don't remember installing this app..."
An app that was suddenly installed on the smartphone.
It was an app that can hypnotize any girl listed in the app!


◆Synopsis
The protagonist, Kyoichi Hata is a lame male highschool student.
As usual, he was killing time with some free apps on his phone.
There, he noticed an installed app he was not familiar with.

"Hypnosis App"

Although he thought it was ridiculous at first,
he discovers it's a "legitimate" app that can hypnotize others by showing them the screen.

It was an extreme stimulation that came to his ordinary life.
That stimulation begins to change Kyoichi's boring school life....



◆Characters
・Yuna Kashiwagi
"Why are you so nervous?"

A pure looking girl with long black hair, she is in the same class as Kyoichi.
She is popular amongst both men and women, and someone who Kyoichi has a crush on her.
She is smart but not very good at sports.
When it comes to romance, she is the timid type who cannot make a move without an opportunity.


・Izumi Nakakaze
"Are you ignoring me, senpai? Pay attention to your cute junior a little!"

A junior gal with affection towards Kyoichi.
Despite her flashy looks, she is surprisingly smart and good at housework.
She is a gal with a strong will to enjoy life, without being swept by the influence of others.
Being full of curiosity, she is willing and eager to be hynoptized.


・Akari Shinozaki
"D... Don't call me cute... I'm your senpai"

A genius girl who is smart enough to skip a grade. She is one grade above Kyoichi, but a year younger.
She is quite a picky eater and has an extreme craving for sweet foods.
From her complex about having a petite and childish appearance,
she tends to wear mature clothes and listen to complex music.
Perhaps from her intelligence, she looks for solid proof in romantic feeling.


・Kyoichi Hata
A male student, always on his phone whenever he has time.
Although he has as much self-control as anyone, he was drawn in by the lure of the hypnosis app.

data.name: Prison Ball: Full Blown
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever played a brick breaking arcade action game against another player?

Have you ever had to make a split second decision on whether to use your paddle to reflect a ball or drop to your knees to blow attack your opponent?

Have you ever had to make a choice between choosing a huge "P size" at the cost of slowed mobility?

Welcome to "Prison Ball: Full Blown" where the objective is simply to score more points than your opponent when the timer expires!

Players on each side of the screen fight for control of three balls which score points when they break the bricks in the middle and the balls only score points for the player who last reflected the ball with their paddle. If your opponent is doing a good job at controlling the balls, you can drop to your knees and do a blow attack towards your opponent and if you are successful, they will be stunned in a block of ice giving you the opportunity to steal control of the balls!

Prison Ball: Full Blown is an indie game made from the heart that offers both lots of laughs and barrels of fun!

This game features Full Local Player Convenience! Both local players can play at a single keyboard (WASD and Arrow keys) OR One player can use the keyboard and the other can use a controller, OR Both players can use controllers! The choice is completely up to you and what works best for you!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CONTROLS: (Keyboard)

Player 1: W = UP // S = DOWN // D = launch blow attack when bar is full (bottom left) // WASD controls your blow attack once launched
If Playing as DLC character Vast Shadows, pressing the SPACE BAR when you get the "Balls Out!" indicator will split your ball into 3 additional balls in your opponents face!

Player 2: ^ = UP // V = DOWN // < = launch blow attack when bar is full (bottom right) // arrow keys controls your blow attack once launched
If Playing as DLC character Vast Shadows, pressing the RIGHT SHIFT when you get the "Balls Out!" indicator will split your ball into 3 additional balls in your opponents face!


CONTROLS: (Controller)

Left stick or direction pad to move player up and down to hit ball or dodge blow attacks // A Button launches your blow attack, left stick controls it after launched

If Playing as DLC character Vast Shadows: Pressing the X button when you get a "Balls Out!" indicator on screen will split your ball into 3 additional balls in the face of your opponent!


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Counter to playing DLC character Deborah Fire:

Deborah Fire can ignite balls with her flaming paddle and these fire balls can in turn ignite bricks. Bricks on fire will slowly burn up and if destroyed by fire will give Deborah points that can turn the game in her favor very quickly. To counter this, try to hit her burning bricks with your own ball which on impact will cause a massive explosion, giving YOU all the points destroyed in that explosion! You'll easily see all the points you get in these counter explosions because the points floating from the destroyed bricks will be double in size as they float upwards.


Counter to playing DLC character Vast Shadows:

Vast Shadows can turn a lost ball of his color into his advantage by timing his active ability button press well, which will split his ball into three additional balls in your face! They will all be his color and almost impossible for you to deflect them all! They will score points for him as any other ball his color, but if you can change these Vast shadow balls your color by deflecting them, they will score points for you instead. Also if a Vast ball that you've changed to your color hits an interior pink brick, you'll instantly destroy his shadow ball and this will cause a blinding search light to shine on him for several seconds. While this light may not seem like much, it can blind his ability to see and deflect balls near him and might just turn things back in your favor!

data.name: First Light
data.detailed_description:
PRESENTATION


This is a 2D old-school RPG in the vein of Black Home and A Plunge into Darkness.

After a devastating Plague purged most of humanity, the few who survived escaped to the underground, in an attempt to survive the disease. After a decade of living in the dark, away from the world. Bahar, and his wife Guidry, believe the Plague has ceased to be and are on the pursuit of a way out, a way back to the world they once knew.

The path is long and perilous, but they will walk it bravely so their children, Dan and Ava, can finally start living instead of just surviving.

FEATURES


A touching storyline that will resonate with all of us given the latest circumstances
An adventurous pace that will keep you on your toes
Explore the underground world, a place full of mystery and dangers
Auto-save feature to keep you from meaningless repetition

data.name: Marked
data.detailed_description:
What is Marked?

Dust, blood, and lies. Salvation’s Edge, 1899 — a dying town where you’re a killer, a thief, and a fraud — handed a dead man’s badge and told to solve a murder. Do they deserve redemption? Do you? Or will everyone forever be MARKED?

Inspired by classic Click-and-Point adventures, Marked combines a riveting narrative with a realistic visual style. Immerse yourself in the gritty, raw main street and the majestic wilds of the American West as you uncover the darkness that lurks within Salvation Edge.

Features

Experience the classic feel of point-and-click adventure games, where every clue matters. Navigate Salvation’s Edge with intuitive interactions—examine crime scenes, collect key evidence, and piece together the mystery one click at a time.

Your choices shape Ben Mercer’s journey. Decisions, from interrogations to moral dilemmas, impact the story’s outcome. Will you uphold justice or let your past dictate your actions? Multiple endings ensure no two direct playthroughs are the same.

Beyond dialogue and deduction, put your wits to the test with hands-on environmental puzzles. Pick locks, reassemble torn documents, manipulate old safes, and uncover hidden compartments to expose Salvation’s darkest secrets.

Forge alliances or make enemies in this frontier town. Gain trust through dialogue and actions, unlocking unique character-driven side stories. Your relationship with the town will determine who stands by you when the truth comes to light.

Piece together evidence through an in-depth detective system. Compare clues, analyze crime scenes, and reconstruct events to uncover hidden motives. Choose how to confront suspects—coerce, manipulate, or outsmart them to get to the truth.

data.name: Immortal Love: Stone Beauty Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Friendly Fox Studios, formerly 4 Friends Games, presents a Valentine’s Day treat with the 9th installment in the Immortal Love series!
You’re finally returning to your beloved! After a life spent at sea as a naval captain, it’s time to settle down with the woman of your dreams. But your excitement is overshadowed when you return to find her missing! No one’s seen her since she won a famous sculptor’s beauty contest, and your investigation quickly leads you to a string of disappearances and people turned to stone! Can you stop a dangerous man bent on perfection before it’s too late? Find out in this sensational Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

• Find who’s using magic to bring Golems to life in the bonus game!
• Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games to earn achievements!
• Complete your animal collection to unlock a bonus Hidden-Object Puzzle!
• Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, concept art, movies, and more!
• Never get lost with the strategy guide!


This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

data.name: The Lightnwatchers 1：海城（The Sea City）
data.detailed_description:
Summary

One day in the future, the city is flooded, and the humans inadvertently open the portal connecting to the other world, from the other end of the door out of countless creatures from the other world, and the giant elder guardian also woke up and launched an attack on the humans. Exhausted by the attack, the survivors built a city under the sea along the coastline, Haicheng. In order to deal with the threat of alien creatures, the humans rebuilt their army to defend the city against the powerful Ancient guardians, and created the Lightn organization to fight dangerous creatures and rebels in The city. Under the guidance of fate, the protagonist joins Lightn and begins to protect the city as "J" against the dark forces from another world.

Start

The player will take the role of the hero and embark on a dangerous journey. More secrets of the world can be discovered through dialogue and exploration.

Fight

The game is divided into melee combat, ranged shooting and medium range gun fighting, in the face of different types of enemies, players can switch between different attack modes, to achieve better results. In the face of massive damage, the player can use dodge to dodge. Collect ground items and guns during combat to increase your chances of survival against powerful enemies, and improve your stats and skills by gaining experience from killing enemies.

Story items

In the development of the story, there will be a special story props, players can use the exclusive story props to open the hidden map.

Game progress

The game will be updated in phases.

data.name: One in a Thousand: Clover Book
data.detailed_description:
Somewhere in this patch of clovers hides an elusive four-leaf clover.

One in a Thousand is a minimalistic and cozy hidden-object game about the quiet joy of searching for four-leaf clover, just like you did when you were younger and carefree. Take a moment to slow down, look closely, and train your eye to recognize the subtle patterns that will lead to your lucky find.

What awaits you

  • Find the four-leaf clover hidden in a patch full of clovers, in an almost realistic environment (~1 in 2,500 chance in-game vs ~1 in 5,000 in real life).

  • Discover 10 authentic leaflet patterns and shapes inspired by real wild clovers found in grass patches around Piedmont (Italy).

  • Keep a collection book that tracks every four-leaf clovers you find, and uncover new notes as you progress — botanical curiosities, inspirational quotes, and gameplay hints.

  • It's not just luck. Learn strategies to improve your chances of spotting four-leaf clovers that can carry over into finding real four-leaf clovers.

  • If you're extra lucky, you might find the elusive five-leaf clover.

  • Change clover patch at any time if you're feeling stuck (but don't give up, you might be closer than you think).

  • Stumble upon ladybugs hidden under the clovers; they may nudge you toward what you're really looking for (but you can also explore without them for a more true-to-life challenge).

data.name: Yakiniku!!!
data.detailed_description:
Smoke rises from the grill. Customers are lining up outside. And the whole shopping street is waiting to see what kind of restaurant you'll build.

Manage the Restaurant

Stock the fridge, set your menu, prepare the shop, and open the doors. Take orders, prep ingredients, serve dishes, clean tables, and keep everything moving through the dinner rush.

Serve the right cuts and keep an eye on every table. Cook the meat just right, respond to customer requests, and make sure nothing stays on the grill for too long.

Upgrade your equipment, expand your menu, improve the restaurant, and hire extra help. Start with a small neighborhood shop and build it into one of the best-known restaurants on the shopping street.

Run the Restaurant Together

Play Career Mode solo or with up to three friends.

There are no fixed roles. One moment you're working the grill, the next you're serving a table, restocking the fridge, or jumping in to help wherever the restaurant is falling behind.

Rival Mode

Co-op not working out? Kick the slackers out of your restaurant, split into two teams, and settle things properly.

Compete against your friends in 1v1, 2v1 or 2v2 matches. Both restaurants are fighting for the same customers, so every decision matters.

Offer better food, better service, and better prices—but keep an eye out for whatever sabotage your friends are planning across the street.

Go All In

About to go bankrupt? Don't worry.

Somewhere on the shopping street is a mysterious machine that might just turn things around. Grab some money from the restaurant, pull the lever, and put your comeback on the line.

Sneak away, keep it quiet, and come back a winner.

Earth: the Millennium of humans has approached its end. History has come to a halt. Demons, angelic Kells, and human Cybers are in a three way conflict with no end in sight. data.name: Brief Karate Foolish
data.detailed_description:
Online match records and privacy

To show match records and rankings in online play (Brief Karate Online), the results of online matches are stored on a server run by the publisher.

  • Stored: your Steam account ID (SteamID), your Steam display name, the date and time of each match, the opponent's SteamID, the result and rounds won, your rating, the number of matches you left or lost the connection in, and whether you play a copy borrowed through Steam Family Sharing (with the owner's SteamID)
  • To stop abuse, the IP address a request comes from is kept for up to 5 minutes
  • Sign-in uses Steam's authentication. We never receive passwords, email addresses or similar details
  • Your record (grade, rating, wins and losses) is shown to other players in the online lobby. The ratings of ranked players are also shown on the game's Steam leaderboard (community hub)
  • Matches in "Unrated" rooms are not recorded
  • Records are kept while the service runs; backups are kept for 14 days

data.name: Heartbreak High: A Break-Up Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Imagine you're the most popular kid in school. So popular, in fact, that you're dating every single person in your class. The only problem? You've decided to break up with all of them, one by one.

Heartbreak High is an arcade-style spin on visual novels and dating simulators that asks you to break up with all of your high school sweethearts instead of woo them. A single play-through can be completed in one 20-40 minute sitting, with each break-up featuring a unique branching story path and lovable (or unlovable?) characters for you to crush beneath your feet over and over again.

If you couldn't already guess, it won't be easy. data.name: HUNTACORE
data.detailed_description:
Civilization is collapsing.

Mutated creatures have overtaken cities and industrial districts, spreading faster than humanity can respond.

Deep inside these hostile zones lies a rare substance Core a resource believed to be essential for turning the tide.

In HUNTACORE, you are deployed into the heart of the outbreak.

Your missions take you through devastated urban environments where survival depends on combat skill, awareness, and decision-making under pressure.

Danger is constant.

Enemies come from all sides, resources are limited, and every push forward carries risk.

Success requires knowing when to fight, when to advance, and when to pull back before it’s too late.

Complete your objectives, escape the zone, and prepare for what comes next or lose everything by staying too long.

Key Features

  • Dark Action FPS Combat

Intense first-person gunplay focused on momentum, positioning, and survival in hostile environments.

  • High-Risk Mission Structure

Each operation challenges you to push deeper into dangerous territory while balancing progress against survival.

  • Extraction-Focused Gameplay

Critical resources must be secured and safely removed from the field — escape is as important as combat.

  • Hostile Urban Environments

Fight through ruined city districts, industrial complexes, and abandoned infrastructure overtaken by mutation.

  • Realistic Weaponry

A grounded arsenal of modern firearms, explosives, and close-combat tools designed for brutal, tactical encounters.

  • Constant Pressure

Limited safety, escalating threats, and difficult decisions define every mission.

Gameplay Experience

Enter unstable zones where control is fragile and danger escalates quickly.

Engage aggressive enemies, manage limited resources, and make fast decisions in environments designed to overwhelm.

Pushing forward increases both opportunity and risk staying too long can be fatal.

Every mission is a balance between ambition and survival.

The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to leave.

Player Fantasy

You are not a hero.

You are a professional sent into places others can’t survive.

Your role is to operate under pressure, adapt to chaos, and extract value from a world that is actively trying to kill you.

Skill, judgment, and restraint are your greatest weapons.

Enemies & Threats

  • Mutated Creatures

Unpredictable, aggressive entities shaped by a hostile environment.

  • Hostile Human Forces

Armed groups and corrupted survivors competing for territory and resources.

  • Major Threat Encounters

High-intensity confrontations that test combat awareness and survival instincts.

Progression & Risk

Progress comes at a cost.

Advancing through missions increases pressure, resource scarcity, and enemy aggression.

Failure to escape in time can result in significant losses, making every decision matter.

Calculated risks can accelerate progress reckless ones can end an operation instantly.

data.name: All the World's Cravings
data.detailed_description:
In All the World's Cravings, you play as Dana, a food delivery driver who is guided through the nine circles of Hell by the trusty delivery app, Virgil Meals. Overcome (or succumb) to your obsession with a woman named Beatrice, deliver meals, and face your own dark secrets as you deliver your way to the deepest layer of Hell.

Drive through Hell

Drive carefully on procedurally generated roads to maintain your customer rating. The choice is yours to investigate apparitions along the way: a hitchhiker? A strange man asking for change? An injured… statue? Did its eyes just blink? The reward may be worth the detour.

Deliver orders

Arrive at each circle of Hell to pick up and deliver orders and hopefully please the colorful re-imaginings of characters from Inferno. Solve various enigmas, and seek out items to manipulate your environment.

Descend into the Nightmare

With each passing circle, the secrets begin to unravel. Beatrice. Oh Beatrice...

data.name: White Hat
data.detailed_description:
White Hat is a bullet hell roguelite where you play as a white hat hacker, hacking into a system in order to find vulnerabilities and make it stronger and more resilient.

Move with the mouse to dodge bullets and position yourself to allow your auto-attacking weapons to hit enemies. Open item chests to gain new weapons, passive effects, active items and more.

Use points earned from successful runs to add more waves and modifiers to make the game much more difficult. However, the harder the game is, the more points you earn. As you play, the game unfolds unlocking new options, items, enemies, bosses, challenges, and new gameplay features to your runs.

Gameplay

  • Move with the mouse to dodge bullets
  • Collect weapons that auto-attack enemies
  • Build synergies between different passive effects
  • Use abilities and find active items to create your playstyle

Features

  • 6 Unique characters
  • 8 Weapons with different attack patterns and upgrades on each character
  • 60+ Items
  • 28+ mini-quests to unlock new gameplay features and items
  • 15 unique gameplay modifiers
  • Multiple post game completionist challenges to test your skills
  • Puzzling secrets to uncover

data.name: Rematonia
data.detailed_description:
Rematonia

Rematonia is a psychological horror about a kid who is trying to fall asleep. As sleep becomes fragmented and restless, you begin to question why everything feels wrong — and where your parents are.

Set in a cold Soviet apartment during the winter of the 1990s, Rematonia places you in a restless bed, trapped between fear and sleep. As the night drags on, reality begins to distort, and something watches from the darkness.

Gameplay

Your only goal is to fall asleep. When morning comes, your parents will return — and the nightmare should end. But every sound or movement builds fear. You can open your eyes to observe the room and calm yourself — but if Namnoi realizes you’re awake, it will react. Sometimes, the safest choice is to keep your eyes shut.

If you happen to go outside your room and Namnoi notices this, the best decision is to hide. While moving slowly, you must ensure that nobody is standing behind the door or around the corner...

Unique feature – camera flash

When the lights are out, you can use your phone camera flash to quickly illuminate the space for a few seconds. Don't get caught while doing it. But remember, that you have limited charges, if the battery dies, you will be surrounded by darkness...

Namnoi

This unsettling creature is watching while you try to sleep. Despite the fear it causes, Namnoi will not attack unless it knows you are awake.

Namnoi is not just a threat — it is part of the night itself.

Immerse in a sad story

By exploring locations and listening to the character’s monologues, you will be able to understand what is going on in the city, who Namnoi is, as well as your family’s sad story.

Rematonia Key Features

  • Authentic Soviet 1990s winter setting

  • Unique sleep and fear management mechanic

  • Unique illumination using camera flash mechanic

  • A stalking creature that reacts to player awareness

  • Direct interaction with the monster through perception and attention

  • Deep atmospheric and psychological horror

  • Retro-inspired visual aesthetic

data.name: Tiny Idle
data.detailed_description:
Tiny Idle is an auto-battler idle roguelike where your army fights on its own - Play fully in the background! Recruit units, collect loot, upgrade your forces, and push deeper through endless waves of increasingly dangerous enemies.

Recruit and Upgrade Your Army Start with basic melee pawns and archers, then unlock a growing roster of specialized units. Train Healers to keep your front line alive, Tanks to absorb hits, and eventually promote them into powerful Tier 2 classes - Paladins that heal while fighting, Druids with AoE healing auras, Berserkers that hit harder as they take damage, and Knights that shield nearby allies.

Discover Powerful Special Units As you progress, you'll encounter and unlock 13+ special unit types with unique abilities: Pyromaniac fire mages, Venomancers with poison DOT, Necromancers that raise skeletons, Warlords with devastating AoE slams, chain-lightning Stormcallers, and more - including a massive Troll Boss that swings with knockback before recovering.

Collect and Forge Items Open chests between waves to find items across 6 rarity tiers - from Common all the way up to Mythical. Items boost your army's HP, damage, speed, crit chance, healing, gold income, and more. Sacrifice Legendary items in the Forge for a chance at game-changing Mythics like Sheep's Call (turns pawns into exploding sheep) or Necro Grip (makes your healers summon skeletons). Combine Mythics in the Special Forge to create "The Caller" - an item of a rarity beyond Mythical: Not of this World.

Deep Progression Systems Spend gold on upgrades across multiple tabs: unlock new unit types, buff your minions' stats, improve your economy, or invest in Ascension bonuses that persist across runs. Level up your commander to choose powerful perks. Stack crit chains with the Luck stat for massive damage spikes.

Idle-Friendly Design Your army auto-spawns, auto-targets, and auto-attacks - watch the battle unfold or step in to manage upgrades, item decisions, and forge choices. Designed to run in the corner of your screen while you do other things, but with enough depth to actively engage when you want.

Key Features:

  • 20+ unit types across base, Tier 2, and special classes

  • 6 item rarities with dozens of items to discover, plus a secret 7th tier

  • Forge system: sacrifice items to craft stronger ones

  • Troll Boss fights with unique attack patterns

  • Unit and Item Codex to track your discoveries

  • Crit chain system with Luck-based rerolls

  • Persistent upgrades and Ascension progression

  • Steam Cloud save support

  • Pixel-art sprite animations for every unit

data.name: Relic Raiders
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Relic Raiders, the ultimate multiplayer showdown! Engage in adrenaline-pumping battles across two thrilling game modes. In "Rise and Brawl", fight tooth and nail in a dynamic battle royale where the battlefield is procedurally generated. Unleash chaos and harness the power of usable items to strategically reshape the landscape and gain an edge over your opponents. Adapt to the ever-changing environment and emerge as the last one standing!

But that's not all—prepare for the highly anticipated "Classic Raider" mode. Join forces with your teammates in an epic best-of-five rounds match, each taking place on a unique map layout. With two distinct environments at your disposal, you'll have access to a staggering variety of 10 unique maps. Each map is meticulously balanced, offering the losing team advantages to turn the tide of battle. Work together, communicate, and employ cunning strategies to secure the powerful relic in strategic zones.

In Classic Raider mode, the excitement doesn't end with map variety. As you progress through each round, you'll have the opportunity to upgrade your skills, becoming more powerful with each step. Choose your upgrades wisely, customize your playstyle, and evolve into an unstoppable force on the battlefield. Dominate your opponents, seize victory, and leave your mark as a legendary Raider!

Relic Raiders caters to your preferred control scheme. Engage in combat with precision using a mouse and keyboard or grab a controller for a seamless gaming experience. The choice is yours, ensuring that you have the optimal control setup to unleash your skills and dominate the competition.

Whether you're a seasoned Raider or a newcomer seeking excitement, Relic Raiders offers a multiplayer sensation like no other. With its action-packed gameplay, six unique characters, each equipped with their own special abilities, weapons, and skills, you can carve your path to victory. data.name: Fight Back The Night
data.detailed_description:
You are the Champion of Syr - an ancient champion awoken in times of great danger. Now, you have been awoken in the kingdoms most desperate hour - the kingdom overrun by an ancient enemy, the king and head of your order besieged in their own city. Do you have what it takes to fight back the night?

MONSTERS LURK IN THE DARK
Fight a variety of creatures infesting the kingdom - each with their own unique methods of attack, and ties to the darkness. Can you drive these beasts back to the realm they call home?

YOU MUST RESTORE THE LIGHT
Rid an area of the infesting darkness by lighting and protecting beacons - be wary, however, as once a beacon strarts to light it will draw in those who would see it snuffed out.

ENHANCE YOUR POWER
Use your experience to power up certain aspects of your power - either through devotion to the God of Fire, Syr - or by imbuing yourself with the powers of the beasts you slay. Will you embrace the darkness?

EXPLORE THE KINGDOM
Navigate levels through a charming overworld system - travelling between levels, finding new friends, allies - and foes - along the way.

DISCOVER THE TRUTH
Not all is as it seems with this invasion - can you discover what the church is hiding? Are these creatures of the night exactly as they appear, or are they something more?

data.name: Jack & Detectives - A Silent Social Detection Game -
data.detailed_description:
Join The Discord!

Discuss strategies and find people to play with in the community!


About the Game

Jack the Ripper is hiding among us. Can you find him?


In this turn-based detection game, two teams face off against each other: Jack the Ripper and the detectives.
Jack has to get away with murder without being found out by the detectives, who in turn need to find out who he is.
Unlike other detection games, you can't talk with the other players in Jack & Detectives, and you must figure out the truth based only on their actions.
Players cannot get eliminated, so everyone gets to enjoy the game to its end. Furthermore, since a game only last ten minutes, you don't need to commit a lot of time just to play.

Jack: Commit murders without being found out.


A serial killer lurking in the shadows. In order to win, he must make sure he isn't chosen during the voting phase.

Detectives: Find Jack, who is hidden among us.


Private detectives hired by the London police. In order to win, they must correctly vote Jack out during the voting phase.

Jack maniac: Muddy the waters so that Jack isn't found.


A maniac whose allegiance lies with Jack the Ripper. He wins if Jack wins, even if he gets voted out himself.

The detectives must plan their moves to corner the suspect among them!


At the start of each game, players are assigned a role at random.
Then, everyone places their token on a London tile of their choosing.

Jack must trick them and frame one of them!


Once they have done so, night will fall, and Jack the Ripper will commit his first murder. (In certain cases, there will be no murder during the first night)

Vote to choose whom to arrest!


The detectives located near the crime scene will become suspects. Who's on justice's side? Who's the murderer among us?
After the second murder, the voting phase starts. Everyone has to vote for the person that they think is secretly Jack the Ripper.
This is where the real battle of wits between the detectives and Jack starts.

■ Cross-platform online play


You can play online against console and mobile users.

■ Play against people from all over the world


Win matches against worldwide challengers to earn rank points. Once you have enough rank points, your rank will go up.

■ Play with your friends


Host a room to play against your friends! In room matches you can also customize the rules to your liking.

■ Personalize your avatar


Lots of option to personalize your avatar, token, and animations.

■ Match replay


Look back to the matches you've played in the past for useful insight.

■ Single-player mode


Play against the computer to improve your skills.

data.name: Escape Bloody Mary
data.detailed_description:
Escape Bloody Mary is a short and sweet horror VR escape room following the folklore behind the legend of Bloody Mary. Turn off the lights, light a few candles, say her name three times into a mirror and you might see her on the other side. Escape Bloody Mary takes you through the worst possible scenario of the childhood ritual. Prepare for an immersive horror experience which transforms your typical bathroom into an unsettling and stressful haunted environment with no way out. Can you find a way out before Bloody Mary claims your soul?

Gameplay offers a series of puzzles under pressure which are designed to force the user to balance strategy and survival.

data.name: Ocean Pop! : Calypso Collision
data.detailed_description:
Match and merge cute underwater creatures!

Travel to the ocean floor, listen to some upbeat tunes and then match and merge creatures from smallest to largest to earn points.  Match two of the largest sea creatures and you complete the sequence!

  • Use physics to nudge creatures into each other to create a larger creature

  • Play strategically to complete the sequence and trigger multiple merges

  • Earn squids to get out of tricky situations

  • Battle against the grumpy Octopus (Challenge mode only)

  • Super cute ocean creatures (a lot of artistic license was taken - don't come at me Marine Biologists!)

  • 2 game modes:

    • Challenge mode gives higher chain rewards and bigger bonuses but the play area is smaller and a grumpy Octopus will try to stop you from completing the sequence!

    • Select Cosy mode to enjoy a slower pace and matching the sea creatures in a larger play area.  There is no grumpy Octopus and the rewards and bonuses are smaller.

(Challenge Mode)

(Cosy Mode)

Tips for players

  • If the time limit on throwing objects is stressing you out, you can take it easy and disable this in Game Settings

  • Up the 'Bounciness' in Game Settings for a crazier time, or lower it for a chilled experience

  • Keep an eye on placement of small creatures, lots of small critters will make completing the sequences difficult

  • Use your squids carefully, they can help if you aim them right or set you back if you do not time them correctly

  • Use your Mantis Shrimp to smash the rocks thrown by the grumpy Octopus (Challenge mode only)

  • Chain together combinations quickly to achieve higher bonus points

  • Try not to get too excited by the chonky boys!

(Mantis Shrimp smashing rocks in Challenge Mode)

(Challenge Mode)

(Cosy Mode)

Cyfieithiad Cymraeg

Cyfunwch greaduriaid tanddwr ciwt gyda'i gilydd yn y gêm bos hon sy'n seiliedig ar ffiseg.  Allwch chi gwblhau'r dilyniant i gyrraedd y Siarc Morfil?  Allwch chi gyfuno dau Siarc Morfil?  Teithiwch i wely'r môr am gêm ymlaciol gyda thrac sain calypso bywiog a phrofwch eich sgiliau!

Parwch a chyfunwch greaduriaid tanddwr ciwt!

Teithiwch i wely'r môr, gwrandewch ar ganeuon llawen ac yna parwch a chyfunwch greaduriaid o'r lleiaf i'r mwyaf i ennill pwyntiau.  Parwch ddau o'r creaduriaid môr mwyaf ac rydych chi'n cwblhau'r dilyniant!

  • Defnyddiwch ffiseg i wthio creaduriaid i mewn i'w gilydd i greu creadur mwy

  • Chwaraewch yn strategol i gwblhau'r dilyniant a sbarduno cyfuniadau lluosog

  • Enillwch sgwidiau i ddianc o sefyllfaoedd anodd

  • Brwydrwch yn erbyn yr Octopws blin (y modd ‘Her’ yn unig)

  • Creaduriaid môr hynod giwt (cymerwyd llawer o ryddid artistig - peidiwch â dod ataf i, Fiolegwyr Morol!)

  • 2 fodd i’r gêm:

    • Mae’r modd ‘Her’ yn rhoi gwobrau cadwyn uwch a bonysau mwy o faint, ond mae'r ardal chwarae yn llai a bydd yr Octopws blin yn ceisio eich atal rhag cwblhau'r dilyniant!

    • Dewiswch y modd ‘Clyd’ i fwynhau cyflymder mwy hamddenol ac ardal chwarae fwy i gyfateb creaduriaid y môr.  Does dim Octopws blin ac mae'r gwobrau a'r bonysau'n llai.

Awgrymiadau i chwaraewyr

  • Os yw'r terfyn amser ar daflu gwrthrychau yn achosi straen i chi, gallwch chi ymlacio ac analluogi hyn yng Ngosodiadau’r Gêm.

  • Cynyddwch yr 'Adlamedd' yng Ngosodiadau’r Gêm am amser mwy gwallgof, neu ei ostwng am brofiad ymlaciol

  • Cadwch lygad ar leoliad creaduriaid bach, bydd llawer o greaduriaid bach yn gwneud cwblhau'r dilyniannau'n anodd

  • Defnyddiwch eich llewys môr yn ofalus, gallant helpu os ydych chi'n eu hanelu'n iawn neu eich rhwystro os na fyddwch chi'n eu hamseru’n gywir.

  • Defnyddiwch eich Berdysyn Mantis i falu'r cerrig sy’n cael eu taflu gan yr Octopws blin (y modd ‘Her’ yn unig)

  • Cadwynwch gyfuniadau at ei gilydd yn gyflym i ennill pwyntiau bonws uwch

  • Ceisiwch beidio â chael eich cyffroi gormod gan y bechgyn tew!

data.name: Runbow
data.detailed_description:
Runbow, and all its 9-player madness, is now on Steam!
With tons of competitive modes for up to 9 players--locally and online--and a massive Single Player Adventure, Runbow is the crazy, colour-based platformer you've been waiting for.

The world of Runbow changes with each swipe of the background, so you'll have to stay on your toes as platforms and obstacles disappear--If you can't see something, it doesn't exist. Fast, frantic, and fun for up to 9 players, Runbow is filled with tons of modes and content to keep you running back for more:

  • Save Poster District from the evil Satura in Adventure, and choose your own path through a massive map of over 140 single player levels.
  • Take on The Bowhemoth, a single, ultra-difficult challenge in the belly of a colossal beast. On your own or with friends, its sure to test the skills of even the toughest platforming veterans.
  • Go head to head with your friends, locally or online, in Run, Arena, or King of the Hill, for a colourful, crazy competition. Host a Private Game for you or your friends, or hop into an Open Party and take on the world!
  • Tons of costumes and Indie Guest Characters are waiting for you to unlock, including Shovel Knight, CommanderVideo, Shantae, Lilac, and many more.
  • Challenge yourself with 68 Steam Achievements! Be the first on your friends list to unlock them all!
  • Hundreds of pieces of unlockable Gallery content await you, from concept art to characters, and even a few hidden secrets...

With 9-player madness locally or online, 5 game modes, 19 guest characters, hundreds of levels, and tons more content all in one unforgettable colourful game, you better get ready to Runbow!


Default Controls

All Controls are fully remappable, but if you want to get running quickly, here's everything you need to know:


Player 1
Movement: WASD
Jump: F
Attack: G
Taunt: H

Player 2
Movement: Up, Down, Left, Right
Jump: Comma
Attack: Period
Taunt: /

Runbow is fully ready to support Xbox One and Playstation 4 controllers. Any similar-style controllers will default to Xbox bindings. But if you can get a controller connected, Runbow will let you remap it in the options menu!
data.about_the_game:
Runbow, and all its 9-player madness, is now on Steam!
With tons of competitive modes for up to 9 players--locally and online--and a massive Single Player Adventure, Runbow is the crazy, colour-based platformer you've been waiting for.

The world of Runbow changes with each swipe of the background, so you'll have to stay on your toes as platforms and obstacles disappear--If you can't see something, it doesn't exist. Fast, frantic, and fun for up to 9 players, Runbow is filled with tons of modes and content to keep you running back for more:

  • Save Poster District from the evil Satura in Adventure, and choose your own path through a massive map of over 140 single player levels.
  • Take on The Bowhemoth, a single, ultra-difficult challenge in the belly of a colossal beast. On your own or with friends, its sure to test the skills of even the toughest platforming veterans.
  • Go head to head with your friends, locally or online, in Run, Arena, or King of the Hill, for a colourful, crazy competition. Host a Private Game for you or your friends, or hop into an Open Party and take on the world!
  • Tons of costumes and Indie Guest Characters are waiting for you to unlock, including Shovel Knight, CommanderVideo, Shantae, Lilac, and many more.
  • Challenge yourself with 68 Steam Achievements! Be the first on your friends list to unlock them all!
  • Hundreds of pieces of unlockable Gallery content await you, from concept art to characters, and even a few hidden secrets...

With 9-player madness locally or online, 5 game modes, 19 guest characters, hundreds of levels, and tons more content all in one unforgettable colourful game, you better get ready to Runbow!


Default Controls

All Controls are fully remappable, but if you want to get running quickly, here's everything you need to know:


Player 1
Movement: WASD
Jump: F
Attack: G
Taunt: H

Player 2
Movement: Up, Down, Left, Right
Jump: Comma
Attack: Period
Taunt: /

Runbow is fully ready to support Xbox One and Playstation 4 controllers. Any similar-style controllers will default to Xbox bindings. But if you can get a controller connected, Runbow will let you remap it in the options menu!

data.name: Depraved Awakening
data.detailed_description:
You play as a washed up gumshoe just trying to get by when one of your clients is found dead. The police believe it was suicide, but as you dig deeper you realize that far more is at play. As you follow the case you will be introduced to many different individuals. Decide wisely how you interact with them. It could be the difference of a bullet to the head or a long passionate night with a beautiful lady.

Depraved Awakening is a story focused adult visual novel. The choices you make, whether they are big or small will have impact on how the adventure will unfold. With each choice leading to a myriad of different endings. Do, you play as the righteous detective just trying to find the truth, or do you let your inner demons take over.

As you dig into your investigation you will come across a wide array of characters, each with their own personalities and backgrounds for you to explore. Some may be willing allies, others tricking you with deceit. Best to tread carefully.

With hours of content on a single playthrough and multiple branching paths there is much to explore.

data.name: ONINAKI
data.detailed_description:
Reincarnation is the foundation of our way of life. We celebrate the lives we’ve been given, and offer up prayers for the next.

It is grief of death which shackles the living, and causes the dead to stray. Indeed, there is no greater affront to reincarnation.

So do we turn our grief to joy as we send off the dead.

But the souls of those who held back their tears in life still need salvation in death. A duty that falls to the Watchers.

Their task is to guide the wandering souls known as the Lost, and serve as keepers of the Living World and the Beyond.

The Watchers sever the bonds that tie the Lost to this world, and send them on to the next. They navigate the emotions of the living and the dead. They prize life above all else.

This is the story of one Watcher.

KEY FEATURES:
Action-RPG
Experience fast-paced, free-flowing gameplay with real time battles.
Battle enemies taking advantage of the Daemons Battle System making use of a variety of exciting weapons.

Character Customisation
Bind your hero, Kagachi with different Daemons to enhance his skills and abilities whilst in battle.

Daemon Battle System
Strategize in battle by choosing a Daemon that matches the enemy’s traits. Watch as Kagachi possess the Daemon power, entering a variety of states to increase attack levels.

Bold Graphics
Enjoy vivid graphics carefully drawn to convey the drastic contrast between the ‘Living World’ and the ‘Beyond’.

Events
ONINAKI's powerful story is brought to life further through emotional cut scenes, events and intimate conversations.

data.name: Spell Casting: Meowgically Enhanced Edition
data.detailed_description:
PLEASE NOTE

Spell Casting is free because it was made in 2016 using Construct 2 and I am no longer supporting the game.  If it run and you can play it, great, but there is no need to submit any bug reports anymore as I cannot fix it.

Spell Casting is a line drawing puzzle game in which you are a young wizard learning spells in the comfort of your home thanks to Wizardly Distance Education offered by the prestigious Magical Education Of Wizards School!

Practice casting spells by tracing out the patterns in the spell books using your mouse (or finger if using a touchscreen laptop / tablet). Earn a 3 star rating in each practice spell to unlock the exam for that book.

You'll need to remember the previously learned spell shapes to pass the exam and unlock new spell books!

Spell Casting is fun for all ages and family friendly. Play just for fun or try to achieve 5 stars in all the spells and exams.

Spell Casting supports accessibility by supporting touch screen tablet devices and also allows you to hold down the Space Bar when drawing instead of clicking the mouse.

data.name: Kona
data.detailed_description:
Northern Canada, 1970. A strange blizzard ravages Atamipek Lake. Step into the shoes of a detective to explore the eerie village, investigate surreal events, and battle the elements to survive. Kona is a chilly, narrative-driven interactive tale you won't soon forget.

"Parabole has created a stunning game of duality, effortlessly blending survivalism with detective work and well-researched history with dying folklore."
- Stephen Turner, destructoid

"It’s tremendous at creating its distinct atmosphere and then drawing you deeper in. It’s witty, spooky, and achieves an ideal sense of urgency. Weird, clamant and intriguing, this is well worth a look."
- John Walker, Rock, Paper, Shotgun

Setting

October 1970. W. Hamilton, a rich industrialist who owns a hunting manor in Northern Canada, reports several cases of vandalism perpetrated against his property. Unable to find out who dared to commit these acts, Hamilton calls Carl Faubert, a renowned private detective to handle the affair.

In Kona, Carl becomes trapped up in the deep north, engulfed in an unexpected snowstorm, and is unable to find his client —or any other living inhabitant for that matter. The player incarnated detective Faubert, who must shed light on the mysterious events befalling the area.

Key Features

  • Step into a surreal interactive tale of mystery and investigate the perplexing quietness in the entire town
  • Explore a vast, frigid Northern environment and battle the elements to survive
  • Enjoy the atmospheric soundtrack featuring music by Quebec folk band CuréLabel
  • Experience the tale through the omniscient, third-person storyteller
  • Go back in time with a vintage look and feel reminiscent of 1970s rural communities
  • Brave Survivor Mode’s darker nights, more frequent encounters, and greater challenges

New ways to play

Face the cold in Survivor mode and take on seven new Steam challenges in a separate achievement set. Adjust graphics settings and the frame-rate cap to suit your hardware.

Kona is also available in Virtual Reality.

The Kona VR DLC enables virtual reality on Windows PC with an OpenXR-compatible headset and controllers. The base game remains playable without a VR headset.

Tested headset: Meta Quest 3 connected to a VR-ready Windows PC, with tracked controllers. The Steam version is not a standalone Quest app.

data.name: Aquatico
data.detailed_description:
Aquatico is an underwater survival city-builder set on the ocean floor. The Earth’s surface has become a barren wasteland, forcing humanity to pour any remaining hope for a new beginning into the depths of the sea. Upon discovering a world below the tides, the opportunity to start over is within reach. Despite the new beginning, the dangers and challenges that lie ahead won’t make surviving under the sea a simple task…



Build a unique city underwater to escape a dying world. Survive the challenges of the sea and construct your base over multiple levels. Use the seabed to build core infrastructure and production facilities, while the domed layers above will house your people from the dangers of the depths.



Discover diverse biomes, gather resources, secure temperature readings and manage the multiple levels of your underwater base. Just be wary of natural sea life, as provoking creatures as you build and harvest may trigger dangerous events. Sharks and whales swarming your city may not be ideal…



Unlock new technologies and buildings through a vast research tree to determine how you construct your underwater city. From defense grids to sushi houses and oxygen extractors. The route you take will determine the city you create.



Use drones and submarines, construct production lines and oversee expeditions to investigate the dark depths of the sea. Expeditions will bring rewards and rare resources that are crucial to life. Success brings the opportunity to delve deeper into the unknown. Who knows what secrets hide across the ocean floor?

data.name: NOT ENOUGH SPACE
data.detailed_description:
A 2D space action roguelike where every shot pushes you in the opposite direction. There is no standard movement: to dodge, chase, escape, or correct your position, you have to fire.

Combat is built around recoil. Aim too carelessly, and you drift straight into danger. Time your shots well, and the same burst can kill an enemy, dodge an attack, and send you toward the next objective.

Fight through hostile space zones, destroy enemies, open chests, and collect upgrades that reshape your run. Stack damage, fire rate, survivability, effects, and strange synergies until the screen turns into controlled chaos.

Each level pushes you deeper into danger. Clear fights, gather power, survive bullet-heavy encounters, and reach the boss with whatever build the run has given you.

The stronger you become, the harder your movement is to control. More shots mean more damage, more movement, more chaos — and more ways to drift into danger.

data.name: Roll & Reign
data.detailed_description:
The Game

In Roll & Reign, every decision counts... and so does every roll. You start with a small pool of dice, each representing a villager. Throughout the game, you must expand your settlement, manage gold and food,  and pay increasing tributes to maintain your dominance.

Features

  • Tactical dice management: each villager is a die with its own class, value, and possible upgrades.

  • Synergies and combos: buildings that boost each other based on their position or what you have in play.

  • High replayability: random maps and multiple paths to optimize.

Each round you choose a building from several offered to you, build/place it, assign dices to the buildings and collect the results.

Buildings can interact with each other, be influenced by the environment, or change their function depending on whether they have a die assigned or not. Furthermore, depending on their functions, a high-roll die may not always be necessary or desirable.

Dices are divided from 4 to 8 sides and have different classes (farmer, merchant, soldier, etc.) that modify or improve their use in different buildings.

 

Add it to your wishlist to stay update!

data.name: K-PARTY FEVER
data.detailed_description:
K-PARTY FEVER Description

K-PARTY FEVER is an online party game for up to 8 players, inspired by fast-paced Korean group games built around timing, quick reactions, bluffing, and reading the room.

Play a series of short and intuitive games where you must read the other players, think fast, and react within a limited time.

One mistake can completely turn the game around, and every loss reduces your Mental HP. Keep your cool, protect your HP, and survive until the very end.

K-PARTY FEVER Features

- Korean Party Games!

Classic Korean group games such as 369, 007 Bang, and APT Game are reimagined as fast-paced online multiplayer games. Even if you have never played them before, the rules are designed to be simple and easy to understand.

- Up to 8-Player Online Multiplayer

Up to 8 players can gather together and compete through a series of party games. Invite your friends and play together in a private room.

- Easy to Learn, Hard to Relax

The rules are simple, but you will need to think and react quickly under time pressure. A single mistake can change the course of the game.

- Mental Survival System

Your Mental HP carries over throughout the entire match. Protect your mental state, manage your HP carefully, and survive until the end.

- Punishment Games!

Losing a game is not the end. Punishment games keep the pressure and tension going throughout the entire match.

- Expressive Character Reactions

Characters react with a variety of expressions and animations depending on mistakes, wins, and losses.

- Just as Fun to Watch

Who will make the next mistake? Who will face the punishment? And who will survive until the very end?

Watching the chaos unfold is all part of the fun in K-PARTY FEVER.

Choose to fight your way out with a pickaxe, or use your wits to manipulate the environment and create your own exit. Escape each level in your own way. Everything is destructible....

Two lovers ask for your assistance - it is of utmost importance you share your preference!

MARIA offers you one of two games to update:

GOLD WOMAN

An Egyptian royal demands your attention. Expect warmth, sweaty skin, and a desert wasteland.

COLD WOMAN

Under blue moonlight, a ghost appears. Expect the unexpected and death's softness.

PART II

A new world is created when one man crosses the line. Part II branches far from its roots, with familiar characters exploring a brand new story:

Two paint together in paradise.

Supper brings an intense inquiry of nightly whereabouts.

Your favorite bench is taken by a thin man on Cobbs Hill.

A note is offered to a skeleton in a wicked hallway encounter.

Married in death, two are brought to life again with their promise.

Sneaking out at night leads to a deep dive underwater.

data.name: Starry Navigator 星际领航员
data.detailed_description:
Create your own planet in the immense starry sky.

Starry Navigator is a role-playing recreational farming game. You can build your own planet with adorable animals. Planting flowers and breeding. Gaining starry energy to repair the interstellar train system. When the interstellar train starts, it will take you to explore the unknown universe and weave new stories with your animal friends on other planets. Pushing the story forward by diligent planting. Reopen the ancient galaxy routes, and try to make the desolate universe prosperous again!

Have you ever imagined a planet of your own?
Have you ever imagined meeting the fox that belongs to you in the long universe just like the little prince?

What will happen to the earth in 1000 years? The ability of humans to live in space without the support of the earth 1000 years later gave rise to a new occuption- interstellar navigator- to direct travelers between the stars. In the cosmic age, driving interstellar spacecraft or trains will no longer require human labor. However, every interstellar train requires a navigator to ensure the correct in the event that the driving machinery fails for safety reasons. In this era, humanity discovered a new energy known as "starry enery", which serves as the fuel for the interstellar train.

By understanding the speed of light, humans have discovered a new way to prodyct energy_ starry energy. This kind of energy can be found in biological processes. Huamns invented robots and other machinery, as well as mechanical devices that can collect and transform energy into other forms. The period of peace, however, is only temporary, as the majority of the universe's inhabited areas are now under attack, and you are one of them...

Fortunately, you finally woke up after a long darkness. What unexpected encounters will you have next?

data.name: Road 7
data.detailed_description:
Road 7 is an infinite arcade-style racing game where you navigate through various zones, dodging obstacles in classic mode or cruising freely in peaceful mode. With five difficulty levels, it accommodates all skill levels. Occasionally, you'll encounter anomalous zones with unpredictable events or hybrid zones blending elements from different environments.

Game modes:

  • Classic - The intended Road 7 experience. Drive endlessly until you can drive no longer.

  • Peaceful - Drive to your heart's content without any obstacles getting in your way. This mode is best for beginners or those who just want a relaxing experience.

  • Custom - Want to spice things up? Mess around with different settings to tailor the game to YOU.

Environments Include:

  • Grasslands

  • Farm

  • Desert

  • Tundra

  • Beach

  • Graveyard

  • Asteroid Field

  • Coral Reef

  • Plus more+

data.name: Flipping Death
data.detailed_description:
When Penny dies under mysterious circumstances, she wakes up and finds herself filling in for DEATH HIMSELF! This temp job comes with a new power - the ability to flip between the worlds of the living and the dead! In this puzzling platformer, she’ll need that - and her wits - if she ever hopes to unravel the mystery of her demise.

Leap between platforms, solve puzzles and help the dead rest in peace by possessing the living and making them dance around at your merest whim in this comedy adventure game by Zoink Games, with writing by the Eisner-award winning Ryan North.

- Flip between worlds: Move swiftly between the living and the dead.
- Possess the living: Control their limbs and read their minds to solve puzzles.
- Play as Death: You're just a temp, but the ultimate power of life and death is in your hands.
- Dive into a rich, colorful world: Explore vivid environments in a pop-up book style and make your way through a completely original storyline!

data.name: The Low Road
data.detailed_description:
Theme & Narrative:

1976.
Noomi Kovacs—an overeager graduate of the LeCarre Institute for Exceptional Spies (L.I.E.S)—has just landed her first job at Penderbrook Motors’ Division of Outside Intelligence. Confined to an office and underestimated by her gruff supervisor—a disgraced former government agent named Turn—Noomi will have to exploit her colleagues and surroundings to help further her dream of becoming a globetrotting secret agent. Once in the field, Noomi and Turn begin to realize that their company’s dogged pursuit of their rivals extend to something far more sinister than “healthy competition” and the two will be forced to reconsider the paths they’ve chosen. Lying, blackmail, and emotional manipulation will become Noomi and Turn’s greatest assets as they make their way through…The Low Road.

Description:

Set in the world of the 1970s automobile industry, The Low Road is a point-and-click graphic adventure game which follows a team of corporate spies dedicated to the protection (and appropriation) of game-changing industry secrets. Sporting a unique visual style inspired by gouache paintings and a pulsating rock and roll score, "The Low Road" will captivate players through intricate puzzles, branching moral dilemmas, and a quirky cast of memorable characters.



Digital Alberta Ember Awards 2017 "Best Gaming Experience" – Winner
Game Design Awards 2017 "Best Character Design" – Winner
Full Indie Vancouver "2017 Demo Night” – Winner
Indie Prize Showcase USA 2017 – Nominee
Game Developer Conference 2016 “Best In Play” – Winner
Playcrafting ’16 Bit Awards “Best Style” – Nominee

Key Features:

  • A unique digitally hand painted 2D illustration style with 1970s television influences.
  • Over 32000 words of dark comedic dialogue fully-voiced from a cast of characters
  • Play from the perspective of two corporate espionage agents
  • A mergence of traditional storytelling and engaging game play
  • An original score of swirling psychedelia and dusty Americana
  • Nostalgic point-and-click style gameplay influenced by LucasArts and Sierra classics
  • Branching conversation puzzles that will challenge your deductive and intuitive abilities
  • Over 15+ first person puzzle sequences

About XGen Studios:

XGen Studios is an independently owned and operated game developer of several award-winning titles on consoles, mobile platforms and the web. Established in 2001 and located in Edmonton Canada, we're a team of passionate creative people, united by a desire to create the type of games we wish existed. We're excited by emerging technologies and the new experiences these make possible.

Since 2001, XGen Studios has released 14 internally-developed titles for consoles, mobile and the web, including the #1-selling hit Defend Your Castle for Nintendo’s WiiWare™ Service and Day-1 PS4™ title Super Motherload.

During the production of The Low Road, XGen’s Founder and CEO, Skye Boyes, passed away. The Low Road is dedicated to Skye for the inspiration, leadership and friendship he brought to the XGen team.

The Low Road is XGen Studios’ first point-and-click adventure game and has financial funding support from the Canada Media Fund 2014-2015 Experimental Stream.

The Low Road is XGen Studios’ first point-and-click adventure game and has financial funding support from the Canada Media Fund 2014-2015 Experimental Stream.

data.name: Invincible VS
data.detailed_description:
Digital Deluxe Edition


About the Game

Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations. Unleash bone-breaking combos through fast combat and smart defensive tactics to leave a trail of blood and destruction. Land vicious Super moves and Ultimates to leave your opponents in a mess of blood. 

Invincible VS features a variety of game modes including a captivating cinematic story mode with an original narrative from a writer of the animated series. Jump into Arcade and battle with your team, hone your combos in Training mode, and test your skills against the world in competitive and casual multiplayer. Show, comic fans, and fighting game lovers will experience unparalleled heroic brutality, where every earth-shattering blow will leave you feeling... Invincible.

This is the debut title from the newly formed Quarter Up™—the first in-house studio at Skybound—led by former members of the core Killer Instinct (2013) dev team.

data.name: Heart of Mithras
data.detailed_description:
Lead the combat team of your district to the top of the ladder, in the epic battle game of the megacity Mithras. Play a detailed management game. Recruit new soldiers, hire trainers to help your team to develop, build up your new base and play epic tactical battles in a complex simulation, in the arena called Heart of Mithras.

Heart of Mithras is somehow a dystopian sci-fy sport manager paired with a tactical shooter simulation (like a CS-simulation)

Story:

After the great civil war of 2700 the megacity of Mithras was buried under rubble and ashes.
The combatant leaders decided to separate the city in thirty districts.
Since then conflicts in the city of Mithras are no longer solved in a gory battle in the streets of mithras.
Now a battle game decides about prosperity and future of those thirty districts.
The best soldiers of each district fight against each other in a arena in the middle of the Megacity, called the "Heart of Mithras".

Now it is your time to manage a squad, finding the best soldiers to fight for your district. Your actions will not only determinate between winning and losing, they will determinate the fate of your district.

data.name: Cloudwalker
data.detailed_description:
Clouds veil the moon,

and winds steal the blossoms;

fate parts us from those we love,

and binds us to strangers.

Overview

There's a type of billiards called carom. Unlike the more familiar pocket billiards, carom billiards has no pockets. As a result, the balls never drop—they race freely across the entire table.

Cloudwalker is a carom billiards RPG based on the carom discipline known as "four-ball".

Prologue

Hear ye, hear ye!

There once was a doctrine called mappō—the Latter Days of the Law, a kind of apocalyptic belief. It took hold in Japan some thousand years ago, in the Kamakura era.

It was said that once this Age arrived, no soul could be saved anymore. And so the people lived through an age of darkness and despair, ever searching for salvation.

Now then—the stage we present tonight is set in a far-eastern island nation, one that resembles that Japan of old, and yet is plainly not it. Its name: Yashima.

In this land, where the Maiden of Urd wields the magic of the spoken word, an unforeseen calamity was foretold—a falling star, fated to strike within the year.

The Maiden of Urd, guardian and pillar of the nation, was to set out on a journey to shatter this doom. Our tale begins the day before her departure.

And yet—the heroin of this tale is not the Maiden of Urd, keeper of the words of magic.

Here before you stands another: a nameless Shadow, who serves as her shield, and hones the sword in her stead. It is this Shadow who is the true hero of our story.

This is a tale of moon and cloud, of blossom and wind. To all of you gathered here, from corner to corner, edge to edge, we bow our knees seven-fold, and fold them seven-fold again, and humbly, humbly, we beg your company unto the very end.

What now begins is Cloudwalker.

A pilgrimage across every corner of Yashima, from shore to shore—let the journey begin!

Streaming Guidelines

There are no particular restrictions.

Please do not point your billiard cue at other people, or swing it around like a sword.

data.name: Untarctica
data.detailed_description:
At the frozen wastes of the world's end, a festering wound in the ice sings to you. The hive has taken root over all flesh and all steel of Tartarus Station; eldritch bureaucrats are vying for salvage rights; all suitors are ready for the ceremony. Something's trapped beyond the true glass, a will that defies death, who yearns for a vessel. It knows you better than you know yourself. It knows you will pick up your gun and fly to Antarctica. It knows you will fight as a true warrior. It has taken everything from you. You will be back.

WEAPONIZE THE RECOIL

Your shotgun doubles as a dash. Fire in one direction, get launched in the other. Jump again during the recoil window to get a second jump.

PURGE THE TARTARUS STATION

Explore the labyrinthine halls of a fallen research complex. Uncover classified experiments, decipher log entries, and survive brutal multi-phase boss encounters with grotesque biological mutants.

GRUNGY 1-BIT SURREALISM

Untarctica is a colorful mix of low-resolution 1-bit pixel art sprites and funky low-poly 3D backgrounds, paired with a gritty sci-fi soundscape.

KEY FEATURES

  • Gun parkour - Dash around backwards using your shotgun recoil

  • Born ready - Full moveset from the get go

  • No downtime - Instant respawn after dying

  • No rematches - 15+ unique boss battles

  • The 'vania suffix - A single, interconnected world

  • The juice - Smooth framerate and snappy controls

  • Quirky artstyle - grungy 1-bit sprites with 3D backgrounds

  • The full story - Lore Codex with 60+ unlockable entries

data.name: Detective Hayseed - The Cloning Madness
data.detailed_description:
The town of Monroe is world famous birthplace of a revolutionary technology, that enabled cloning of the human race. With the development of this technology and its wide application, the entire town is in its heyday. The production of clones in the company “DNA Revolution” takes on gigantic proportions and the dealers sell cloned celebrities and personalities all over the world. These clones act as doubles for politicians or famous artists. The world can also use the abilities and wisdom of cloned scientists, military commanders and others. The town is prospering and the standard of living is high. And at this very moment, the town is preparing for a highlight of the whole year – the cloned beauty contest. And it is the moment where crime corrupts the town’s plans. Join the crazy police detective Francis and go through countless escapades with him in this classic point & click adventure full of comedy.

  • 2D hand-drawn comic book stylized graphics, now available in widescreen 4K resolution
  • More than 50 game screens and locations and hundreds of items
  • A story full of comedy and twists
  • Stylish music and sounds
  • Game time 8-10 hours
  • Guide is available in case of getting stuck
  • Classic point & click adventure game
  • Fully dubbed in English

data.name: Radio Commander: Battle of Britain ’40
data.detailed_description:
Defend Britain in its darkest hour.

Take charge of RAF Fighter Command in Radio Commander: Battle of Britain ‘40, a real-time strategy game set during the darkest hours of World War II. As the European continent is overrun by the Axis war machine, the British Home Islands are under threat of invasion. Can the Royal Air Force and its advanced ‘Chain Home’ Radar Air Defense System defeat the supposedly invincible Luftwaffe?

Intercepting an Invisible Enemy

Dozens of squadrons of Spitfires and Hurricanes are at the commander's disposal, but these aircraft are useless if you can’t find the enemy. Utilize the most advanced air defense system in the world, ‘Chain Home’, a network of radar stations and air controllers all working towards the same goal, the defeat of Germany's Airforce.

Command the battle that cannot be seen

Radio Commander: Battle of Britain ‘40 models the delay in transmitting orders and information. From the radar stations detecting the enemy and reporting their position, to the player telephoning a friendly airfield and ordering the Spitfires to scramble, all of these actions take time. Minutes count, and your rapid response to a raid could be the difference between splashing a dozen enemy bandits, or the Jerry’s slipping the net and bombing your airplanes on the ground. The game features a single campaign with several presets, ranging from a full 100-day campaign to a shorter experience focused on the most intense period of the conflict, lasting approximately 30 days.

Live the full Battle of Britain in a complete historical campaign 

The full Battle of Britain is modeled with the campaign running from the July attacks on the English coast to the terror bombing of London. Whether you just want to re-fight the Eagle Day attacks or start from the beginning and play out the entire campaign, the choice is yours.

Immersive and diegetic experience.

Based on real-life photographs taken at the Uxbridge Battle of Britain bunker, the player controls the Dowding System from an authentically modeled 3-D command center. From the maps to the officers, the status lights to the upholstery, we aim to capture the desperate feeling of the Battle of Britain.

Strategic Control of RAF Command Network 

Leverage the RAF's revolutionary real-life command network: radar stations and the Dowding System provide a strategic edge,  for those who know how to use it. Detect incoming raids, assess threats, dispatch fighters, and become a true air commander.

Key Features:

  • The legendary Dowding System: optimize the flow of intelligence across radar stations, observers, and the Filter Room to intercept Luftwaffe raids

  • High replayability: a truly systemic approach makes every campaign unique, no two playthroughs are the same

  • A thinking enemy: adaptive AI changes tactics based on the condition, capabilities of its forces, and the dynamic weather system

  • Real-time planning: take control over fuel and repair logistics, and manage pilots' fatigue and morale: a tired squadron is as dangerous as an outnumbered one

  • Historical accuracy: feel the pressure of real-time command inside a RAF filter room, survive the Nazi attack and defend Britain for 100 days, from July to October 1940.

data.name: Halloween 1985
data.detailed_description:
Are you ready to relive the nostalgia of classic arcade games? Halloween 1985 transports you back to the essence of mid-80s platform games, where the action is fast, reflexes are key, and the adventures are unforgettable.

Halloween night 1985, the Halloween monsters decide to steal all the pumpkins from the shop of Pumpkman, our protagonist. Take control of Pumpkman and help him get all his pumpkins back through five dreamlike, original and hilarious scenarios. Face the monsters in their lairs, recover all the stolen pumpkins and get ready for the final challenge: teach the big Halloween boss a lesson.

Main Game Features:

  • A classic arcade adventure: This game will take you back to the magical arcades of the 80s!

  • 3 Game modes:

    • Beginner mode: Perfect for getting started in mastering the game (1 round).   

    • Expert mode: Complete adventure, high difficulty and no continues (2 rounds).   

    • Speedrun mode: For the most experienced players who want to be the fastest players  to beat the game (1 round).

5 iconic monster levels

Each level is designed to capture the spirit of Halloween with its                        characteristic monsters, in iconic settings:

  • Dracula awaits you in his dark castle. Remember that light is his enemy.     

                      

  • The Mummy lurks in the corridors of a mysterious pyramid, use its secret doors and dizzying ziplines to move around.

  • The Werewolf prowls around a dangerous abandoned mine full of speeding minecarts and dangerous electrical switches. Do you know anything about electric shocks?

  • The Witch has filled the enchanted forest with spells and traps. Use her magic cauldron wisely. She doesn't like her potions to be spilled.

  • The Evil Clown is the owner of a diabolical circus. Balloons, trapezes and the drop tube will be your allies to move around the screen.

         

+ Final boss: After recovering all the pumpkins stolen by the Halloween monsters, you must face the big boss, the most feared and cunning monster. Enter the challenging final level,  Inferno, where the devil awaits you with his own tricks and traps!

2 Extra objectives per level

 In addition to collecting all the pumpkins in each level, you can get a good handful of extra points by completing two additional objectives, which:

  • Banish the monster from each level: Hit the enemy 3 times and banish it in the most humiliating way possible, to get another juicy extra point bonus.

  • No-continue arcade challenges: Do you have enough skill to beat all the levels without being able to continue the game at any time? Only the best will make it to the end.

data.name: Flawless
data.detailed_description:
Flawless (完美无瑕) is a third-person adventure game that takes place deep within a young boy’s dreams. Explore the surreal landscape and solve puzzles to discover the origins of the boy’s fears in this psychological narrative experience. Can you escape the nightmare?

In addition to controlling the boy's movement through W A S D and using the left mouse button to communicate with the protagonist's parents to advance the plot development, players also need to use W A S D E to decrypt the variant gameplay of Tetris.

This game has one teaching level, three puzzle-solving levels, and one plot level, which correspond to encountering, getting along, resisting, and reconciling between the boy and his parents. I hope that players can learn why a lot of children in the process of growing up want to ask their parents the phrase, "Do I need to be perfect to be worthy of your love" while playing the game.

Flawless was made almost entirely by Thomas Wang, who hopes the narrative can help give players a glimpse into the mind of a child growing up under immense parental pressure. Special thanks go to Thomas’s parents for their support of the development and everyone else who contributed to the game.

Feedback is always appreciated!
Let's see if you could help the boy reach his parents' standards and escape the nightmare...

Caution for photosensitive epilepsy!
