data.name: Jumping Challenge
data.detailed_description:
This is a manipulation game where players control a character using the left and right movement keys, continuously jumping downwards. Each step on a board earns a certain number of points, avoiding touching the ceiling or a nail board to maintain health. Over time, the speed at which the boards rise gradually increases, testing the player's reaction speed and skills.

Types of boards:
1. Normal boards: basic boards, standing on which prevents the loss of health.
2. Conveyor belt boards: allow the character to move horizontally on the board, increasing the game's difficulty.
3. Nail boards: touching them results in the loss of health, unless a protective shield item is used.

Health and game over:
The character hits the ceiling or a nail board, losing health, and when health reaches zero, the game ends. In the air, when stepping into empty space, the character falls straight to the bottom, and the game ends.

Items:
1. Health items: restore one health point, providing additional survival opportunities.
2. Shield items: prevent the loss of health when touching a nail board.
3. Slow-down items: slow down the speed at which the boards rise for 10 seconds.
4. Bonus items: provide extra points, increasing the overall score.
5. Wing items: the character grows wings, and pressing the up key allows them to fly for 10 seconds.

Game features:
1. Continuous challenges, with the increase in levels, the speed at which the boards rise gradually increases.
2. Flexible use of items, increasing the player's survival ability and score.
3. This game combines reaction speed and strategy, providing players with an exciting and engaging gaming experience. In the process of continuous challenges, players can fully explore the effects of various items, challenge higher levels, and use game scores to unlock exquisite CG images in the gallery.

data.name: Blotch
data.detailed_description:
Blotch is a stealth adventure where you paint yourself to match the world around you.

The best hiding spot might be right under a guard's feet. Hold still, hold your nerve, and let it walk straight over you.

Steal the scenery. Copy colors and patterns from grass, cobbles or a gallery masterpiece. Move onto a new surface and it's time for a new disguise.

Watch your step after painting. Your wet coat leaves a trail for guards to follow.

Sneak past searchlights and cameras, dodge sprinklers, and find shelter before rain washes off your paint.

Some guards need more than a good paint job to fool. Hounds follow your tracks, profilers spot your shape, and listeners hear you coming.

Paint your way out of trouble. Stun a guard with a rock, splatter it with a paint bomb, or use your hose to make a hiding place where you need one.

Distract a patrol with a plush decoy, then slip into the Understreet through drains and vents.

Carry the loot. A crate on your back slows you down and gives you away, unless you painted it to match the floor first. Lift the wrong thing and the doors seal behind you.

Explore a world inside every painting. Thirty-two hand-made levels take you from sunlit gardens to glowing caves.

Get to know the sixteen people who call this island home. Help your neighbors save their homes by uncovering the clues the island's old owner left in his paintings.

Bring friends. Hide from them. Hunt or be hunted in Hide and Seek. Turn every catch into another pursuer in Infection, or race the rival team in Head to Head.

Be the furniture. Turn into a crate, barrel or suit of armor in Prop Hunt. Paint your disguise and try not to move while your friends walk past.

Paint your own camouflage. Match the colors and patterns around you to stay hidden.

Sneak past the guards. Watch their patrols and pick your moment.

Explore after dark. Find your way by lamplight and glowing mushrooms.

Mind the wildlife. Startled birds can give you away.

Get creative with a rock, a paint bomb, a hose and a plush decoy.

Take the Understreet. Crawl through drains and vents, but watch out for rust and floodwater.

Thirty-two hand-made levels, plenty of reasons to return. Hunt for secrets, chase three-star runs, and climb the Steam leaderboards.

Six ways to play online. Hide and Seek, Infection, Head to Head and Heist, plus Hide and Seek (Prop Hunt) and Infection (Prop Hunt).

Build the next great hiding spot. Design your own maps and tiles, then share your creations on Steam Workshop.

Play with keyboard and mouse or a controller. Remap your controls, read warnings by shape, or turn on sound to help match colors.

data.name: Star Hearts: Launch Point
data.detailed_description:
Pre-Purchase Offer

We are thrilled to announce the reLAUNCH of our Kisktarter campaign for our freshman project, Star Hearts: Launch Point! Whether you supported us last time, didn’t get the chance, or are just now learning about the project, PLEASE head over to now to learn more about what we’ve been up to and check out our awesome backer rewards! Of course, any assistance with spreading the word by sharing on social media, playing our demo on a live stream, or just telling your retro loving friends and content creators is invaluable and deeply appreciated. Use #ArcapCreative on all social media.


About the Game


Every Ending Has a Beginning
Meet Prin, a budding intergalactic rebel conscripted into performing the remarkably dangerous boots-on-the-ground work of eliminating the hostile infestations standing between the Manifest Company and their interplanetary investments. Train and battle your way through unknown perils across alien worlds to complete your missions, earn your keep, and awaken deep powers within…

Features

  • Activate Heart Links - Rescue and befriend colorful critters across new worlds to activate your Heart Link System and acquire up to four unique power suites: dash, float, grapple, and slide.
  • Master Movesets - Race against the clock to medal in over 25 increasingly challenging trials designed to hone your abilities to the extreme. Demonstrate those skills on the battlefield and Prin might just earn Employee of the Month!



  • Strategize Your Respawn Beacons - Use your limited number of self-placed respawn beacons to mark your own checkpoints. Ride the delicate balance of respawn pod economy and distance traveled.
  • Explore Never-Before-Seen Worlds - With the Manifest Company poised at the edge of a galaxy ripe for exploration and exploitation, the fate of 6 uncharted planetoids is in your hands.



  • Fight Off Alien Bosses - Guide Prin deeper into unknown territory as you vaporize apex alien predators and blast away the persistent varmints rampantly infesting every crevice of the star system!
  • Unravel the Manifest Company’s Motivations - Interact with Unkle Boss, Gene, and the rest of the crew back at the Company’s hub ship to brush up on your skillset mastery, scope out new missions, and get to the bottom of the Company’s rapid expansion.
  • Experience Modern Gameplay with an Arcade Feel - Easy to pick up but difficult to master, Star Hearts: Launch Point pairs vibrant, 8-bit nostalgia with intense action at up to 144 frames per second!



A Pixel-Perfect Love Letter to NES
Visually reminiscent of classic titles like Mega Man and Super Mario Bros., Star Hearts: Launch Point is an entirely handcrafted experience, featuring the vibrant color palette of the Nintendo Entertainment System, completely hand drawn animation and level design, and zero rotation, scaling, or bone rigging.

data.name: The Forgotten Villages of Gondomayit 2 - Kost Karangsari
data.detailed_description:
The Forgotten Village of Gondomayit lets you experience the mystical atmosphere of Indonesia.
Tells the story of a young man named Bagas, a vocational school student
who lost the bet and received a challenge from his friends. He had to test his courage in one of the boarding houses in Gondomayit Village, which had long been abandoned by the residents after the eruption of Mount Merapi. However, many strange things happened when they first arrived at the village. Starting from a scary and lonely atmosphere,
the appearance of strange creatures, full of puzzles and much more.
And this game is also very interactive because there are missions that must be completed, starting from looking for clues as to why the boarding house is so haunted.
Designed and developed from the ground up for fully immersive atmosphere and gameplay,
The Forgotten Village of Gondomayit is our approach to a truly unsettling and terrifying experience.

data.name: Spirit Guardians
data.detailed_description:
Spirit Guardians is a pixel-art, roguelike game that blends elements of role-playing, strategy, tower defense, real-time strategy, and shooting. Farming gears, upgrading skills, unlocking new talents…the game offers a continuous journey of empowerment, challenging relentless foes to protect the peace of the Spirit Realm!

Guardian


To safeguard the Spirit Realm, you must repel invading evil spirits and defend the spiritual energy crystals. Utilize traps, activate sigils, cast spells, and fight alongside allies to preserve the last hope.

Endless Powerup


Defeat swarms of enemies, absorb soul orbs, level up, and choose skills. Collect soul stones, unlock talents, and gain permanent enhancements. Spend coins to strengthen your unlocked skills. Only through constant growth can you stand against the onslaught of the evil spirit army.

Gear Up


Defeat elite enemies, open chests, choose the desired gears, and upgrade through synthesis. Dress in equipment according to your combat style to craft the strongest warrior uniquely yours!！

Legion of Evil Spirits


In the Spirit Realm, justice and evil are intertwined. Incarnate as an evil spirit, defeat guardians, corrupt spiritual energy crystals—various gameplay experiences await.

Formidable Foes


Within the legion of evil spirits, powerful individuals exist. You must give your all or face defeat. Death is not the end; you can utilize mysterious powers to resurrect, but miracles come at a cost…

Challenge enemies, collect gears, and upgrade skills in gradually unlocked campaigns, or conquer opponents in the arena to prove you might. Are you ready to delve into the Spirit Realm? Your battle begins now in Spirit Guardians!

data.name: Trench Run
data.detailed_description:
16 trench-runners. 1 winner. How many will survive ? How many will turn to stardust ?

Feel adrenaline surge while you fly through the trench at more than 1000 km/h, dodging treacherous obstacles and countless hot plasma shots which try to turn you shining racing spaceship into molten scrap. Fight with everything you’ve got to cross the finish line alive and, with a bit of luck, you might just climb to the top of leaderboard.

The trench is generated randomly at each game, offering different race lengths and a sequence of obstacles to the victory totally unpredictable.

data.name: Mustdashe
data.detailed_description:
YOU GET A MUSTACHE! YOU GET A MUSTACHE! YOU GET A MUSTACHE!


Mustdashe is the ONLY follicle-fueled first person puncher on Steam! You have sixty seconds to punch glorious mustaches on everyone (and everything) to rack up points and complete achievements for high scores and glory. As soon as you pick up the fabled Stash Knuckles the clock starts ticking, so get moving!

In sixty seconds, you need to run, jump and punch your way to a new high score. Discover hidden achievements and track your progress as you play though multiple levels full of secrets! Smack unsuspecting civilians, enemies, and babies across the map as you unleash the force of facial hair.

Mustdashe is the remastered edition of the original Mustdashe created in November 2014.

data.name: Onsen 1313
data.detailed_description:
Armed with only a candle and pistol, you must roam the dark and claustrophobic passages that once represented all things peaceful. Tales have been told of how demons wander these very halls, but these are all stories...Right?

EXPLORE: Journey through the maze like Onsen interior, before finding yourself in the lush Bamboo Garden. Along the way, try to find the key and door that will grant your escape.

EVADE: Avoid the gaze of the Demon and avoid it's judgment.

COMBAT: Using your pistol, ward off your pursuer, for a short time.

ESCAPE: After evading the Demon and finding the key, muster the courage to escape the Onsen for good.

data.name: Chasing Light
data.detailed_description:
2021 IGF Nuovo Award Finalist
2021 Korea Game Awards Indie Game Award, Good Game Award Finalist
2020 BIC Awards Excellence In Experimental
2020 GIGDC Bronze Prize
2020 Seoul Government G-RANK Challenge Seoul Prize
2020 SOTAESAN FILM FESTIVAL Official Selection
2020 IGN JAPAN INDIE GAME WEEK Official Selection
2020 BIGS Official Selection

Chasing Light is a game that sets out to deconstruct and revolutionize games, and a work that seeks to prove that games are great art.

What is a game? What should a game be made of? What should a game be? Chasing Light is the process of asking those questions: the story of a seven-day journey that explores the materiality of games and digs into the inner workings of people and society.

Chase the light. Until your wings melt.

Chasing Light is an 'Icarus Simulation' where you weave wings out of a game and soar toward the sun.

The game you make is called Chasing Light, too.

Within the budget you're given, pick the music, lay in the sound effects, and set the number and speed of enemies.

Fail to reach 100% on the box-office forecast, and there won't be a next time.

Every decision you make becomes a feather in your wings.

The developer will lend a hand too, so don't worry too much. Oh, I'm not speaking figuratively. I mean the real developer's hands.

Of course, those aren't the only hands on your wings.

The Investor shoves the market in your face, and the Critic trots out identity.

And the Senior? He warns you that calling a game a work of art is dangerous, and that you must never forget it's a product.

The closer you get to the sun, the more your wax melts away.

Your name is Director. Your job is director, too. After all, in this world, a name is a job title.

But the Judge of the court you end up in doesn't ask about anything as petty as your job.

All he does is bellow at you to tell him what you "do."

You make games. So what on earth is it that you do?

You will spend seven days answering that.

The Judge isn't the only one you'll meet in those seven days.

A child who talks like an old man, and a ferry that calls you son.

Recruits presenting business cards instead of arms.

And a Pope who looks like a piece of plumbing.

What happens once your wings have melted away, you ask?

Don't worry. According to the Judge, falling from the sky is a perfectly legitimate kind of "doing."

Fall.

For there will be light.

data.name: Xon
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the world of Xon, a god game where you can create and control your own world!

With powerful miracles at your fingertips, you'll guide your people as they build structures and develop their society. But be warned: other gods are also vying for control, and you'll need to defend your land while also forging alliances with others.

As you play, you'll gain points for your accomplishments, and the winner will be decided at the end of a set time period. Will you be the one to guide your people to victory, or will your rivals outsmart you?

Key Features:
  • Create and control your own world
  • Use powerful miracles to shape the land and influence your people
  • Play solo or with/against other players in real-time
  • Build structures, develop society, and defend your land
  • Gain points for your accomplishments and compete for your self or others
  • Global Online score board and post game tracking

Are you ready to become a god and lead your people to victory?

Gameplay - Multiplayer
In this game, every player has their own world where they can command soldiers and gather resources. By using gates, they can also send soldiers and resources to other players.

The game was inspired by multiplayer Tetris, where players have their own game but can affect others by throwing special blocks into their game.

In this game, if you're not one of the top ten players, you can't be targeted by others. However, there's no limit to the number of players who can join the game.

Development process
I created this game together with my four-year-old son. He contributed some of the graphics using Paint and came up with all the prompts for the Midjourney images.

We spent a lot of time brainstorming ideas on our living room floor, using crayons and toys, and his input was invaluable.

He has also been my most honest tester, providing feedback on what features were becoming too complex or frustrating.

It has been an amazing process, and I am proud to say that I could not have made this game without him.

Trapped in a valley that repeats forever.

Ten correct calls and you escape.

One wrong call and the valley starts over.

Features

  • 30+ Anomalies to discover and identify

  • 2D Stylized Art inspired by Arabic traditions and environments

  • A Looping Valley where familiar places may not always be what they seem

  • Story-Rich Experience with mysteries hidden throughout the journey

  • A Complete Experience in One Sitting focused, dense, no filler

    Look closely. Trust your instincts. Find your way out.

data.name: EMITIME
data.detailed_description:
EMITIME is a RHYTHM-based DECKBUILDER - where MUSIC is your STRATEGY!

Combing multiple genres together, EMITIME creates a stylish and unique gameplay that makes you bop to the beat!

Match your Attack and Movement to the RHYTHM on the Grid, and activate your SKILL CARDS to defeat the enemies!

Build your deck and customize your characters with frequencies (power ups!) during each run with various possibilities!

Characters from the Past... and Future...

Play as one of the characters from the Past, or the Future - each of them is equipped with the power of "EMITIME", the power to synchronize with Time and Rhythm!

...

Unique Gameplay Mechanics!

By attacking and moving on the BEAT, you can charge up your cards, and activate them to deal great damage to the enemies!

Each card has different abilities and attack patterns... Sync Yourself to the Music, and use them to your advantage to defeat the enemies!

Pick new cards as you encounter enemies during the battles, and equip yourself with Powerful Skills to Defeat them all!

You can also charge up your Ultimate Attack by synchronizing your action to the beat! Unleash it to deal great damage to the Enemy!

Roguelike Elements with Different Possibilities!

EMITIME is a Roguelike Deckbuilder that allows you to Replay the game more than one... if not many times! Expand your deck as you meet new enemies on the Procedurally Generated map, and create a unique deck every run!

You can also equip powerful frequencies by levelling up, or by purchasing new upgrades from the shop! - Mix and match different frequencies and power ups to build your character each run!

data.name: Bird of Light
data.detailed_description:
WHAT IS THE BIRD OF LIGHT?

Finding the answer to this question will take skill, strategy, intelligence and insight. You will need to become One with the Path.

Bird of Light is an action-strategy platformer with a twist. Place bridge tiles to create paths through levels in the sky, then run through avoiding obstacles in your path. Leap over vast chasms, collect loot, and discover new lands on your journey.

THE STORY OF TARA


Tara, an eight-year-old girl, is something of a loner whose family moves to a farm from the city to improve the quality of their lives. Once in the country, Tara soon makes friends with all the animals on the farm. Everything goes well until one day, her animal friends start mysteriously disappearing one at a time. Tara struggles to understand what's going on, but luckily, Tara and the animals have a friend and guide in the Bird of Light, who talks to them and helps to make sense of it all.

The gameplay is an abstract representation of Tara's search for The Truth.

GAME FEATURES


  • 2D level design puzzle transforms into 3rd person action.
  • Multiple level solutions and multiple pathways within each solution.
  • 21 Hand-crafted levels with three unique missions and two leaderboards in each level.
  • 33 unique Achievements
  • Over 10 hours of gameplay.
  • Unique mode of storytelling; interactive story scenes unlocked as you progress.
  • Subjective Difficulty Design engages players of all skill levels.
  • New abilities and mechanics unlocked as the game progresses: The Leap, Teleportation, Moving pickups.
  • Pause screen serves as a path finding map.
  • Intuitive and efficient controls.

data.name: Project: SnowBound©
data.detailed_description:
Welcome, you are in for one of the craziest rides of your life with Imysoo Games newest release: Project SnowBound©!

We are currently in Alpha v0.0.3G, and this will be the Early Access version available for everyone to participate.

*This game is made by a (solo) 1-man developer team*

Project: SnowBound is a H-MMO, or hybrid massively multiplayer game set in a future after humans have colonized their local universe and are expanding not only for new science & technologies. But also for extreme sports! You are a up and coming potential prospect, aiming to become one of the top of the "High Heaven" circuit players. With nothing but a busted up snowboard, and the prowess of a baby lamb, can you climb your way to the top?

Using a top-down unique systems, players will be spawned into an overworld, and from there, they can participate in free-for-all races (FFA RACE) or gain some serious altitude with the big air (BIG AIR) game-modes!

Or if you're feeling more homely, you can always go and relax in your inn room, customize your furniture and soak the great mountain air in.

Preseason Alpha

You can race, level-up, earn currency and bragging rights against your friends and the rest of the server. Purchase & Collect beautiful, exotic, and colorful board wrappers! You may also pay rent (in-game currency) to keep an inn room, which is completely customizable! You may purchase furniture in order to decorate yourself, or just have somewhere to hang up your trophies!

Explore High-Heaven's Inn

Get yourself an amazing board wrapper at Board Hall:A

Wrap yourself up out there, it can get chilly! Shop XippWear!

data.name: Japan Train Models - JR Kyushu Edition
data.detailed_description:
Japan Train Models, the game where you can enjoy trains in its entirety, is now available with trains of JR Kyushu!

There are three modes to play: Pazzle mode, Layout mode, and Encyclopedia mode!
You can enjoy the fascination of trains as much as you want.

Puzzle Mode
This is a game mode in which players create pazzle by attaching train parts at puzzle intervals.
All vehicles appearing in the game are officially licensed!
You can assemble these finely detailed vehicles as many times as you like.

And the vehicles are not the only pazzle you can build.
At the end of each stage, you can create a diorama of the scenery where the cars run.

Layout Mode
The layout base featured in this work is the new layout from old edition of "Japan Train Models", the new layout base included in this work is the new layout from the old version!
Let's create a new cityscape different from the old version.

You can place buildings and other structures on the layout to create your one and only original layout!
You can also take cool pictures by running the cars you built in the Pazzle mode!
By selecting morning, evening, or night time, you can enjoy the changes in scenery depending on the time of day.
There are also a variety of shooting modes, such as scenery from a train window or from the viewpoint of a cameraman placed on the layout!
In addition, you can move the placed cameraman. Take the best shot from your favorite place and angle!

Encyclopedia Mode
You can check detailed data and 3D models of the vehicles!
Enjoy your favorite cars by enlarging and rotating them.
You can switch the internal camera and move to the carriages to feel as if you are on the train.
You can also see the detailed descriptions of the cars supervised by JR Kyushu.

Equipped with a train car.
Japan Train Models - JR Kyushu Edition features the following 3 cars.
813-1100 Series
811-0 Series
Kiha 66 /67

Here is your own railway space to create!

data.name: Layerworld
data.detailed_description: In this 2d platformer, your death is merely part of the puzzle. data.name: Demon Castle Guard
data.detailed_description:
Getting into the Demon Castle is harder than it looks

Every woman in the land wants to move into the Demon Castle, but the Demon Lord's army is not exactly open to walk-ins. Rejected saints, knights and angels march on the gate with whole armies, loudly "here to slay the Demon Lord." They are actually here for the job interview.

How it plays

You are the Demon Lord, and your guards are a squad of cool, squishy slimes. Merge two slimes of the same kind and star level to get a random new slime one star higher, set up your formation, chain elemental reactions, and hold the Castle Gate. Hold it, and the applicant passes the interview: she joins your army as an Officer and can fight beside you. Camilla, your icy, sharp-tongued adjutant and HR chief, runs the tutorials and insults you as a free bonus.

Stubborn applicants

  • Lisera: the "top" summoner of the Holy Church (the title was a lottery), hopelessly lost, and her summons are rented
  • Alicia: a Holy Knight Commander who can spin any embarrassment into something "tactical"
  • Sylphie: a shy novice nun, followed by a Double that says everything she cannot
  • Seraphina: a self-proclaimed noble seraph, actually heaven's last pick, who just discovered instant noodles
  • Saint Marian: the holiest Grand Saint around, whose voice changes completely when the act drops

Features

  • 5 chapters and 42 stages, each chapter with its own enemies and bosses
  • 11 slime types, each with a Mastery board and an Ultimate to build around
  • Ember, Frost, Volt and more trigger elemental reactions for satisfying chain bursts
  • Talents and Castle Upgrades to grow your castle your way
  • The Abyss (10 floors, a random Curse on each), Endless mode and Holy Trials for more challenge beyond the story
  • A Recollection room to rewatch scenes, plus 68 achievements
  • Available in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Simplified Chinese

Content notice

This is an adult comedy. It contains nudity, sexual themes and suggestive dialogue. Please play only if you are 18 or older.

data.name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
data.detailed_description:
Your brother has left for university and the attic where he kept all his things - and spent most of his time - is now yours. Very quickly you realize something's off. Matt was hiding something.  Who's Destiny and why is this the first time you've ever heard that name?

The Attic is an adventure in which you'll have to solve riddles, puzzles, and repair objects from the ‘80s and  ‘90s to unveil the secret your brother and his mysterious friend, Destiny, were hiding.

Hideouts, secret spots, locked chests, mysterious videogame cartridges… A cozy adventure with hints of mystery inspired by escape rooms and the classic point-and-click adventure games. 

FEATURES:

  • Solve a wide variety of riddles, puzzles and minigames. 

  • Repair and restore retro objects from the 80s and 90s.

  • Unveil the truth about your brother and why you had never met his friend Destiny.

data.name: Kanon
data.detailed_description:
■About the Game

Kanon is the debut work from the visual novel studio, Key, known for titles such as CLANNAD, Little Busters, Summer Pockets and more. It received great acclaim and was even adapted into an anime series.

Enjoy this tale of small miracles that occur in a northern town, now with the latest visual novel engine!

· The story evolves depending on the choices you make, providing a variety of different endings to the visual novel's story for you to discover.

· Featuring retouched HD visuals and CG coloring!

This version not only offers the best HD quality to date, but the game's CG coloring has also been adjusted to better complement LED display colors. Enjoy the experience with beautiful graphics!

· Although the Windows version of Kanon has never had voice support before, the Steam version adds full voice support with an amazing cast of actors! (The protagonist is only voiced during certain parts of the game.)

· The text can be set to Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese (audio only available in Japanese). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

· Touch gestures can also be used if you're playing on a tablet PC or a Steam Deck.

· Voice Actor: Yui Horie, Mariko Kouda, Mayumi Iizuka, Akemi Sato, Yukari Tamura, Tomoko Kawakami, Ayako Kawasumi, Yuko Minaguchi, Maaya Sakamoto, Tomokazu Seki, Hiroshi Kamiya, Tomokazu Sugita

data.detailed_description:
Christmas is coming! That means it’s time to dive into the holiday spirit with the new game Find All Things: Christmas. This time, you’ll explore a variety of themed locations filled with Christmas magic and an even wider selection of mini-games. For every level you complete, you’ll earn coins that you can use to unlock collectible items for your room. In this game, everyone will find something they enjoy!

Embark on an exciting journey with a variety of mini-games and puzzles that will never let you get bored.

✔ Relax and unwind with soothing gameplay
✔ Build puzzles and solve various brain teasers

data.name: Sky in your eyes
data.detailed_description:
Our upcoming VNs:





Visual novel about the life in the post-soviet. Cute artstyle, 10 animated live2d CGs, 5 BGs and 5 chibi CGs in 4k, English voice-over for each main heroine, animated live2d sprites (lip-sync, hair movement, physics of the chest, head + body rotations, expressions and etc.), original OSTs and a dramatic story! Length is 3-4 hours (for all endings).

Events and characters depicted in this visual novel are fictional.


Story
Slava is a young FSS (Federal Security Service) officer from Siberia. In the past he made a lot of questionable decisions during the work, but he believed that he benefited the Motherland. This faith helped him to not lose the confidence in the chosen path. But one day he met Lena - poor orphan girl from Brightarus. who was sold by her teacher for food. According to the rules, he had only two choices - send her to the migration center, where she will be deported back to her homeland, or kill her on the spot. He couldn't choose either of it, so he decides to hide her in his home.
It turned out to be harder than he thought.
Will he handle the constant fear about his live? Can he lie to his wife about Lena's origin? Will this chance meeting help him look differently at the actions he did in the past?

Anya


Wife given to Slava by the government. Passionate and hard-working girl. She has a very strict parents - her Dad is the Moscowia State University professor, her Mom works in the Institute of Hydrodynamics. Because of them she gets an excellent education, but they are always busy with work, so she lacks love.

Asya


Slava's childhood friend. They both were raised in the orphanage. Due to their complex nature, they could not make friends with anyone, and somehow it turned out that they began to talk with each other. Asya is very shy and soft girl, so active and rough Slava fits her perfectly. Also she really wants to enter the MSU, but Slava doesn't allow her to do that - he's worried about her and doesn't want to let her go far away from home.

Lena


Little orphan girl from Brightarus. Despite the hard and hungry life, she remained a positive and kind girl. Deep down, Lena is worried about Slava, because she understands that he's risking his life for her. She is very grateful to him for saving her, but she's too embarrassed by the care and help received from him. That's why Lena always tries to hide her shyness with causticity.

data.name: Teddy Horses
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to a Warm, Cozy, and Charming Ranch Adventure!

Teddy Horses invites you to a peaceful sunlit valley filled with colorful wildflowers, gentle breezes, and delightful friendships. Step into the paws of an adorable teddy bear, take charge of your very own ranch, bond with charming horses, and leave the stress of the day behind.

Key Features

  • Heartwarming Horse Care: Adopt a wide variety of horses—from chestnut browns and snowy whites to magical pastel pinks! Feed them delicious treats, refill water troughs, brush their coats, and build lasting bonds filled with affection and joy.

  • Free-Roam Riding & Exploration: Mount your favorite steed and freely explore a lush valley packed with scenic paths, wooden bridges, and a lively village.

  • Thrilling Races & Competitions: Train your horses' speed and stamina! Line up at the starting gates, master tight turns, and race against the clock to bring championship trophies home to your stables.

  • Build & Expand Your Dream Ranch: Upgrade your stalls, expand paddock fences, place new facilities, and customize your ranch with charming seasonal decorations.

  • Village Life & Daily Horse Market: Visit friendly village shops run by Barnaby and neighbors. Browse daily horse markets, join lively auctions, and trade for gear, feed, and supplies.

  • Teddy Bear Fashion & Customization: Dress up your cute teddy bear protagonist with adorable shirts, hats, outfits, and backpacks.

  • Wholesome & Relaxing Atmosphere: No time limits, no harsh penalties—just a gentle, cozy sandbox where you can play entirely at your own pace alongside uplifting acoustic melodies.

Saddle up, feel the wind in your fur, and create your dream sanctuary in Teddy Horses!

Design buildings. By playing.

There's a building in your head. Voxitect is the fastest way out of it. It's an architectural design tool with the feel of a sandbox game and the components of real architecture — you click walls into place, snap floors, drop ceilings, and a building takes shape in minutes. No 14-page install. No license keys.

Heavy CAD wants you to commit before you've decided anything. Voxitect is built for the moment before all that — the napkin-sketch phase, when you're just trying to feel out a space and see if it wants to be there.

Build together.

Share the space you are standing in with a link. Whoever opens it joins you inside the same building — you see each other move, and every wall, slab and material change appears for everyone as it happens. Shared spaces stay in your library, so you can come back to them any time and pick up where the group left off. Works between Steam and the browser.

The interface disappears

Click, drag, place. Corners snap so walls actually meet, slabs hold themselves up, and everything lands on the voxel grid. It plays like a game and designs like a tool.

One scroll, three walls

Aim at any wall and scroll the wheel. Solid wall becomes a wood door becomes full glass, swapping in place. No tool change, no menu.

Materials, terrain, and light

  • Materials — cycle a texture library onto any surface: wood, plaster, glass, concrete and more, applied live.

  • Terrain — build into real landscape; cantilever a massing over a hillside.

  • Lighting — drop point lights, then flip to Rendered mode for a progressive lightbake that keeps refining while you work.

Read it like a real drawing

A clean black-line floor plan reads itself straight off your geometry. Drop a cutting plane anywhere and the building peels open at any depth.

Step inside the building you just drew

First-person mode unlocks the camera. WASD and Space — the controls you already know.

Your spaces, everywhere

Voxitect runs in the browser at and as this desktop app — sign in and your spaces sync across every device. Export your model into Rhino, Blender or Revit when you're ready.

Buy once. Build forever.

One purchase, no subscription on Steam.

data.name: Rosie Planet
data.detailed_description:
Jam Packed full with Videogame

Rosie Planet is a videogame tribute to videogames. While the meat-and-potatoes gameplay is 3d platforming, it blends in elements of just about every videogame genre. Rosie Planet is a movie-theater-popcorn-bucket filled full with curveballs. Consider it the Nier of 3d platformers.

Explore a planet filled with 3D platforming joy!

A planet is a big place. In this huge cohesive world you'll get to drive all kinds of vehicles to get you from city to city... And then you can explore the cities too!

What's in a city?

In each city there are 5 linear action platform stages, and 5 hidden stars to collect. Collecting everything unlocks a minigame. As well, there are plenty of charming townspeople to talk to and things to see.

 

Fixed Camera Platforming Delivers Driving Forward Momentum 

Action Stages in Rosie Planet feature a fixed camera. Inspired by Mario 3d World, this camera will always telegraph the action so that you can focus on the fast paced platforming. You'll never wonder where to go. You'll never have to break your flowstate with a camera adjustment. 

Tons of atmosphere and variety

The world of Rosie Planet is a world - visually dense, atmospheric, and varied. Every area is filled with new sights to discover.

data.name: Cards from the West
data.detailed_description:
This game adds a twist to the Rogue-like Deck builder genre by separating the combat in two phases.

In the first phase you will load your revolver with the cards you want to use.

Then, the shooting begins, where you will "shoot" your cards one by one, while the enemy "shoots" back in-between.

Each game takes place in a new unique map where cards battles won't be the only way to progress and upgrade your deck.

You will find duels, where the faster shooter wins!

Saloons were you will find good deals on cards to add to your deck and have a drink to help you recover some health (don't drink too much or you will get dizzy).

And more...

Your goal is to beat the boss at the end of the level to go further into more complicated and fun encounters as your deck of cards evolves.

data.detailed_description:
EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™ Deluxe Edition

EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™ Deluxe Edition includes:

- EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™
- 1500 PGA TOUR POINTS
- PGA TOUR XP Bundle


About the Game

Tee off at Augusta National where you can compete for a Green Jacket. Play unique challenges and complete quests inspired by the Masters. Access exciting new content, golf gear drops to customize your golfer, and online tournaments to test your skills on the course.

The exclusive home of the Majors, EA SPORTS PGA TOUR features Pure Strike for superior golf gameplay, powered by ShotLink®, and unrivaled access to the world’s most exclusive golf courses.

  • Home of the Majors — EA SPORTS PGA TOUR is the exclusive home of the Majors, including the Masters Tournament, the PGA Championship, the U.S. Open Championship, and The Open Championship.

Pure Strike combines golfer-specific tendencies with unique Course Dynamics and revolutionized Ball Behavior for the premier golf gameplay experience.

  • Your career, your way — As your golf game improves, so does your path to becoming a Major champion. Create and customize a golfer, develop your skill set with new Shot Types, gain deeper knowledge as you play, and learn to attack every course like a pro.

  • The world’s most exclusive courses — The tee is yours at 30 courses, including some of the world’s most exclusive, designed in stunning quality with Frostbite™ so you can enjoy more of golf’s finer details than ever before.

data.name: Funimal: Fusion Animal
data.detailed_description:
“Funimal” is a turn-based sliding puzzle you move the field.

And < you can always clear in 5 moves or fewer! >

“Think deeply, solve instantly!”

Funimal is a turn-based slide puzzle designed with a simple goal in mind: to be "just right" for everyone, regardless of age or gaming experience.

The true charm of the game lies in its intuitive controls paired with the "perfectly balanced challenge" of finding the optimal solution within limited moves. Experiment with your fields and help lead Funimal to the goal!

  • How to is simple! Just move it ↑ or ←!

Simply select the ground you want to move and slide it vertically or horizontally?it's that easy!

There's no time limit, so you can take your time without feeling rushed.

  • What is a Funimal?

They're a creature still shrouded in mystery.

One known characteristic is that “when two Funimals of the same type stick together, they fuse and transform

into a new Funimal!”

One goal, two Funimal...

In such cases, you have to FUSE them before leading them to the goal.

Use the field smoothly to lead the Funimal!

  • The story proceeds as your CATCH

Pokke and Pikke are here to support you.

The more you CATCH Funimal, the more new information and new places you'll discover.

Whenever there's a new discovery, it seems they'll let you know.

Please enjoy CATCHING together with them.

  • No worries if puzzles aren't your thing!

Most stages can be cleared in just 3 moves,

making it easy to think things through repeatedly and plan ahead.

It's enjoyable regardless of gaming experience or age!

Even so, stuck and can't figure it out...?

If that happens, try Redoing it a few times, and Pikke will give you a “Hint”!

...That said, the further you progress, the harder it gets.

Puzzle pros will definitely enjoy it too!

  • Encyclo of Living things

You can check detailed info on the Funimals you've CATCHED in the encyclopedia.

Successfully CATCHING them seems to unlock more details to explore.

Why don’t you browse the encyclopedia relaxing between CATCHES?

It's fun!

data.name: CYBERFIELD
data.detailed_description:
The game takes place in a sci-fi world where warrior's combat skills are highly valued. You are the next contender for the prestigious title of the Cyberfield Champion. But are you worthy of the commemorative Statue in your honor?

In Cyberfield, your goal is to create a unique combination of skills and upgrades to defeat the Champions of each Section. You will be presented with a list of skills from which you can choose only 5 that are most suitable.

Additionally, you can use Enhancers – powerful technological devices that grant you special powers. Fire, ice, lightning, energy, defense, and more – an arsenal to suit any taste.

You will have to overcome multiple rounds, facing a variety of opponents – from powerful giants to small drones. But the ultimate test of your strength will be battles against Special Warriors and reigning Champions.

In Cyberfield, defeat is not the end, but an opportunity to learn from mistakes and improve your approach. Embrace the unforgiving nature of the roguelike genre and constantly refine your tactics. Use accumulated coins to upgrade your fighter to the maximum.

Learn, adapt, and conquer!

Get ready to show your character and willpower on the path to Cyberfield Championship. The Steel Arenas are full of traps and dangers, but only the bravest warrior awaits the true reward – the feeling of personal perfection.

Step into the arena!

data.name: Boom Crew: Co-op Minesweeper
data.detailed_description:
Boom Crew is co-op minesweeper where you are the cursor. Every player is a little sapper standing on the grid. The numbers never lie: they count the mines around you exactly like the game you remember, except now you are standing on them.

  • Step on a cell to reveal it. Step on a mine and you fly. Your friends laugh, then one of them has to walk over and revive you.
  • Plant flags in your own colour. A wrong flag is still a wrong flag, and the chord will find it under your feet.
  • A blast knocks down everyone in its 3x3, so keep your distance from the hero who "definitely knows this one".
  • Classic mode: clear the board together. Turn on classic rules and one mine ends it for everyone.
  • Endless mode: the board grows ahead of you and the dark closes in from behind. Keep moving.
  • Local co-op for 1-4 players, keyboard and mouse or gamepads.

data.name: Ancient Arbiter
data.detailed_description:
Draft. Position. Watch it play out.

Ancient Arbiter is an auto-battler built around a tower defense frame. There's no tower placement and no real-time input during combat — you spend your prep time drafting heroes into a fixed formation, and once a wave starts, everything resolves on its own. Your job happens entirely before the fight: who you recruit, where you put them, and how you gear them. Losing means your comp had a hole in it, not that you missed a click.

Set in the sun-scoured ruins of a lost civilization — the Aurveil — you're rebuilding an ancient Arbiter tower, recruiting wasteland survivors and salvaged tech to hold the line against whatever the desert throws at you next.

An Auto-Battler at Its Core

Preparation has no timer — take as long as you want arranging heroes, shopping, and adjusting targeting before you commit. Then combat runs fully automatically, and you're free to just watch, or push the time-scale up to 3x and blow through waves you've already solved. The tension lives entirely in the setup phase: nine tower slots (three rows × three columns) plus three frontline slots are your whole board, and row position alone changes a hero's damage and cooldowns. Every targeting mode you assign — First, Strongest, Weakest, Lowest Resistance, Flying, Ground, Nearest — is another lever you pull before the fight starts, not during it.

A Growing Roster, Real Roles

Recruit heroes through a pick-one-of-three draft as you climb waves. Each hero has a distinct attack pattern, an ultimate that fires on its own cooldown, and passives you unlock over time through their personal specialization tree. Frontline tanks block and soak damage so your ranged and support heroes can work from behind them; supports heal and shield the squad; snipers and burst casters pick off priority targets. No hero is the obviously correct pick every time — the right lineup depends on what a given wave is throwing at you.

Six Elements, One Universal Armor Rule

Damage comes in six flavors — Physical, Celestial, Plasma, Cryo, Gravity, and Void — each with its own identity (crit-focused, damage-over-time, crowd control, healing) and all governed by the same armor/resistance formula, so nothing is ever a special case. Later waves roll a resistant element that punishes a mono-element team, and enemies can stack a wide range of status effects — stuns, freezes, armor breaks, burns, silences, and more. Your comp has to answer for what's coming, not just hit hard.

Deep, Long-Term Power Progression

Items: Gear across many armor sets and five rarities from Common to Legendary, each with set bonuses and rollable stat lines.

Artifacts & Runes: Account-wide artifacts and socketable runes, earned from boss fights, wave milestones, and side Expeditions.

The Forge: Craft, upgrade, and reroll your gear instead of just hoping for drops.

Skill Tree: A sprawling radial tree across six elemental branches that buffs your whole roster at once.

Promotions: Every hero has their own specialization path, freely reconfigurable between waves.

Vehicle Modules: Permanent, account-wide upgrades installed into the tower itself, that persist across resets.

Endless Waves, Real Stakes

Before every wave you choose between three cards, each independently rolling a difficulty tier — Normal, Hard, or Elite — trading more enemies and higher stats for better loot odds. Boss fights land at regular milestones as their own separate encounters with dedicated rewards. There's no fixed ending: waves scale forever, so the goal is climbing as high as your roster and gear can carry you.

A Scavenger's Loot Loop

Every wave guarantees a payout of gold and gems — never a popup, just your wage. On top of that, each wave independently rolls for salvage materials, a run-scoped trinket, and a permanent cache (an item crate or a crafting blueprint). Rarity is capped by how deep you've gone, so early runs stay grounded while a long run can eventually earn its way to Epic and Legendary gear.

Beyond the Run — The Bunker

Between runs, the Bunker is your hub: a Mastery Forge with perks spanning nearly every system in the game, a Trophy Hall, an Archive, and a Control Room. Send heroes out on Expeditions and Excavations to bring back runes and loot passively. When you're ready for a clean slate, Retire resets your run while keeping everything you've earned account-wide — gems, skill points, artifacts, runes, and promotions.

Built to Keep Going

Steam Cloud keeps your saves in sync across machines, and leaderboards and clans let you compare your best wave against friends and the wider community.

Genre: Auto-Battler / Tower Defense / Roguelite Progression

Playtime: Runs range from a focused 20-minute session to open-ended, multi-hour climbs — there's no scripted campaign length, just how far you can push.

Kiko the bear has one goal: to bake the biggest apple pie ever for the annual Apple Festival! To do that, Kiko needs lots of apples 🍎

  • Cartoony graphics

  • Relaxing music and playful sounds

data.name: Voidspace
data.detailed_description:
This highly experimental 2D top-down SCIFI MMORPG is attempting to model the human experience in a society. This game isn't just about you and your journey, it's a about how all players progress technology, society, and infrastructure in a virtual environment, together. Every man-made object you come across is crafted by a real player.

The crafting/invention system is central to the game. Players can prototype a new version of a weapon or piece of equipment in the hopes of getting a better version that they can use or sell to other players. Once a new item is prototyped, the player can repeat the skill to make that item as much as they want as long as they have the required materials. The skill can then be taught to other players, charging a fee or otherwise.

Free to play (soon!)

While the game is in Early Access, we have to charge a fee allow players to gain access to the test. This is to limit the number of players we have in the test while we are scaling the servers and polishing the client. We plan on making the game entirely free-to-play monetizing on a premium membership and on cosmetics (no pay to win). If you wish to donate to help support our development efforts, we also offer a series of Kickstarter-like perks with details on our website.

Effectively infinite, completely seamless game world

TWITCH-BASED GAMEPLAY

Voidspace aims to finally bring a limitless multiplayer experience. No "zones" or seams of any kind, just one enormous game world; everyone is playing together in the same server. Discover other player outposts and possibly join another group in order to maintain your own security. Find ancient abandoned player-made civilizations that you can research and study, acquire, or disassemble and recycle.

For those who would rather have a more solo/singleplayer experience, the game world is effectively infinite so you will be able to choose to spawn "in the middle of nowhere" in order to limit the possibility of seeing anyone.

The centerpiece: Invention and Crafting

As players go about regular activities in the game, their character will come up with an "idea" for a new skill or invention. This will happen at random along with a number of other influential factors such as:

  • The character's intelligence
  • A need that the character has been tagged with internally
  • The availability of the materials required for the skill or invention, or the character's knowledge and experience with these materials
  • Other skills or inventions that the character has available to him

However for the most part, the best ideas come from more focused research which the character can engage in using a lab or research facility. Generalized experimentation with materials is the first step, and once the character has a certain level of understanding of various materials, he will start to get ideas for actual working inventions that use those materials. Once a character has an idea, he can use the lab to try to create a prototype.

The prototype stage is the stage in which the character is trying to turn an idea into a reproducible invention or skill. It may take many tries to get something working, and the difficulty of coming up with a working invention will depend on the following factors:

  • the character's intelligence
  • the knowledge level of the category the invention falls within
  • the level of knowledge the character has of the materials being used
  • the general complexity of the skill

Once the character has successfully produced a skill or invention, he will be able to create or perform it at will. For objects or skills that are executed by the character himself (not by some completely automated, mechanical process) the result of the skill or invention will vary somewhat, and the character will get better at producing better and more consistent results through practice. For example, if a character is hacking a certain type of equipment, he will get faster and more accurate, and have fewer failures as he continues to perform that particular skill.

The player can then choose to create another prototype in order to get a better end product, by going through the very same process and hoping for a better result. For the most part, the resulting attributes of a skill or invention are random, but they will also be influenced by the 4 factors listed previously.

Ideas, skills, and inventions can all be shared freely or sold between characters.

In addition to skills and inventions, characters will be able to research concepts in order to open up to them more skills and inventions to be discovered. For example, The Void is a place where physics are different from the natural universe. Characters can use a lab in a research facility to concentrate their research on The Void itself in order to unlock certain concepts that allow for inventions that make use the discoveries made.

Generally everything is made by players

Since there are no NPCs, there is also no supporting infrastructure in Voidspace. Players will need to create their own infrastructure in order to facilitate their own growth and progression in the game. Players will be able to build and manufacture their own buildings, outposts, bases, cities, ships, ship upgrades and equipment, and even ammunition.

Certain large scale projects will also require multiple characters contributing to it's construction. There is no centralized auction house which means the might a player possesses is really relative to his local area. One area might be lacking in ammunition production, so a player can take advantage of that and create the factories required to meet that local need. The alternative would be to have players trade ammunition brought in from the nearest manufacturing plant, which would raise the price of that commodity in the area.

Gamers are used to things like "manufacturing plant" being an item/building you can build. However in Voidspace these concepts don't exist explicitly. Instead a player can build a structure, put the required equipment inside the structure, give it some way of generating or acquiring power, and then use the structure's inventory space to build things. The game gives tools to the player, but what the player does with those tools is up to them.

We, the developers, aren't explicitly making "carriers" or "businesses" for the player, instead we're giving the player a generic set of tools (like the ability to create objects, the ability to share ideas...etc) and it is up to them to create a business out of it.
Due to this, there are so many businesses that can be created, so here are some examples to spur your imagination:

  • Allow players to rent your infrastructure to build their inventions.
  • Sell your services as a defence contractor.
  • Act as a maintenance crew for a base/outpost while players are away.
  • Give other players rides from one place to another if they're without a ship or if you can offer a safer passage.
  • Ferry smaller ships inside of larger carriers for a fee.
  • Store offline players, their ships, and/or their equipment in protected facilities for peace of mind while they're offline.
  • Offer your services as a guard or patrol.
  • Offer your service as an intelligence agent and spy for weaknesses in other players bases.
  • Start a package delivery service that delivers sealed containers with goods.
  • Start a telecom company that delivers messages over a network of long distance communication nodes.
  • Start a bank that secures in-game currencies.
  • Provide loans and credit with interest.
  • Offer insurance for aspects within the game.

Voidspace will allow for all of these types of businesses, and many many more.

data.name: Decktoon
data.detailed_description:
Decktoon is a strategic card game inspired by the most iconic symbols of Brazilian comics! Developed by Funktoon — the largest platform for reading Brazilian comics — the game throws you into electrifying duels where each card represents legendary characters, memorable scenes, narrative twists, and moments of pure emotion.

⚔️ Objective: Build your deck, unleash your creativity, and dominate the board with smart plays and surprises only comics can deliver. Every match is unique, testing your tactical skills and ability to read your opponent.

🕹️ Gameplay Overview

  • Choose a themed deck made up of characters, scenes, and twists.

  • Use creativity points to summon cards, strategize, and respond to your opponent’s moves.

  • Character cards form the core of combat.

  • Scene cards shift the pace of the match with special effects.

  • Twist cards can flip the game upside down at the right moment.

  • Victory goes to the player who balances attack, defense, and storytelling.

🌟 Key Features

  • 🃏 100% Brazilian-themed card game

  • ✨ Cards include characters, scenes, and twists for emotional and surprising gameplay

  • ⚔️ Strategic creativity system where every decision matters

  • 🔄 Fast-paced matches, great for both beginners and veterans

  • 🌍 Celebrates Brazilian comics with art and symbols honoring major works and artists

Get ready to duel, surprise, and prove you're the true master of comics in Decktoon! 🚀

data.name: Held By The Sky
data.detailed_description:
You are a girl who wakes up inside a tower high up in the sky. There is no window, no door and no escape from this infinite tower. You climb and climb, and begin to notice that the tower might be alive, constantly generating obstacles to stop you from moving, But you are determined.

Held By the Sky is a 2D-platformer where players can roam within a grid-based terrain while simultaneously dealing with falling blocks. This game features experimental mechanics that combine genres to create a new experience. There may be a learning curve as the game requires dual-hand controls to manage two gameplay aspects at the same time.

Features:

  • Puzzle-platforming within grid-based, shifting terrain

  • Control falling blocks while platforming

  • Different skills to help with managing the terrain

  • Different block types in the terrain for more dynamic interactions.

  • Thoughtful level and difficulty design to ensure player can get used to the game's controls in no time

data.detailed_description:
Vet Van Organizer is a strategy puzzle game where order, focus, and sweet chaos come together! 🧩

You’ve inherited your grandmother’s old vet van, and now it’s your job to keep things running.
Every day, new animals arrive, and your task is to place them correctly!
But be careful, some species simply do not get along! 🐕🚫🐈
If you put rival animals side by side, chaos begins.

Each of the 27 animal types has its own size and personality, and some are even VIPs! 💎
VIP animals have special needs, which makes finding the right spot a little harder but even more rewarding.

Across 100 levels, you’ll face limited space, oddly shaped crates, and adorable yet stubborn animals.
Improve your strategy step by step and turn your vet van into a true organization masterpiece.

With relaxing music 🎶, a minimal design 🧘‍♀️, and cute animal sounds 🐾,
Vet Van Organizer invites you to experience the most satisfying kind of order. 💖

• 💎 VIP animals that require extra care and attention
• 🚫 Keep rival species apart with smart placement
• 🚐 100 levels of increasing organizational challenge
• 🧩 A true “sort and fit” puzzle experience
• 🎶 Calm music and a cozy atmosphere
• 🌸 Play entirely at your own pace with no time pressure

data.name: Italia 1915–1918 : Great War Logistics
data.detailed_description:
Command an Italian camp on the front lines of the Great War. Every turn counts, every building has a purpose, every soldier a story.

Italia 1915–1918 : Great War Logistics is a turn-based management game set in the encampments of the Italian Army during World War I. Step into the boots of the commander: organize the camp's structures, manage men and resources, and keep your unit alive from dawn to the freezing night, turn after turn, as the front looms ever closer.

Every order begins at the Command Office. From the Mess Hall to the Barracks, from the Field Hospital to the Supply Depot, every building you upgrade makes your camp more efficient and your soldiers more ready. And when evening falls, camp life goes on: the tavern comes alive, sentries stand their watch, couriers dash from building to building.

Between the mud of the trenches and the warmth of a mess tin, war isn't won only at the front. It's won in the camp too. Are you ready to command?

data.name: UfoPilot : Astro-Creeps Elite
data.detailed_description:
UfoPilot : Astro-Creeps Elite puts you at the controls of a nimble Vector-class starfighter in an epic mission to rid the galaxy of the pesky Astro-Creeps.

This game is a revival of the classic Asteroids-style gameplay, with a twist. You control a small ship that must destroy entire fields of asteroids, but inside these space rocks live the evil Astro-Creeps. While the asteroids will drift blindly thru space, the Astro-Creeps, once released, will chase you down.

Controls

We have worked hard to create intuitive and responsive controls for this game. You aim with the mouse and fire with the left mouse button. You can thrust with your main engines using the right mouse button, and you will accelerate in the direction you are aiming. For finer control, you can also use the WASD keys to maneuver your ship in axial directions. Combine WASD and the right mouse button for even higher rates of thrust and supreme control. It is also possible to use an XBOX 360 Controller to play the game.

Your Arsenal and Powerups

You always have access to unlimited ammunition (orange) that you can use to destroy asteroids and Astro-Creeps. There are also 7 powerups that can be dropped randomly by asteroids and Astro-Creeps:
  • Bombs - When detonated Bombs fire a ring of projectiles around your ship.
  • Bounce Bullets - Unlike normal bullets (orange) Bounce bullets (blue) will continue bouncing off the edges of the screen until they hit something.
  • Lasers - Lasers travel at infinite speed, unlike bullets, and immediately destroy everything in their path.
  • Shields - Shields grant you invulnerability for 10 seconds, allowing you to plow thru hordes of asteroids and Astro-Creeps.
  • Anti-Gravity - Anti-Gravity pushes things away from you for 10 seconds, allowing you to keep a safe distance between your ship and the enemy.
  • Decoys - When a Decoy is on the playing field, all Astro-Creeps will chase it instead of your ship.
  • Deflectors - A Deflector creates a bubble in space, within which you can remain and fire out from. Nothing else can penetrate the Deflector.

All of the Powerups can be combined to great effect, with some specific twists:

  • Bombs can fire Bounce and Laser ammunition in a devastating ring. This can be toggled in Gameplay Options.
  • When you have both Shield and Anti-Gravity, your ship will transform into a Black Hole. With a Black Hole active, your ship is both completely invulnerable and will suck all enemies into itself, destroying them.
  • While the default is for the game to automatically select Lasers and Bounce bullets when you have them, it is possible to enable manual weapon selection in Gameplay Options.

Gameplay Options

There are many Gameplay Options to choose from, resulting in 1024 permutations. How to play is up to you, and you can name and store your custom settings locally for easy access:

  • Auto-Brake - Enabled by default, this will slow your ship to a halt when not accelerating.
  • Explosion Impulses - Disabled by default, this will cause explosions to knock things around to a greater extent.
  • Auto-select Weapon - Enabled by default, this will cause the game automatically select your must powerful ammunition for you (Laser, Bounce, Normal).
  • Bombs use Lasers - Enabled by default, this causes Bombs to use Laser ammunition.
  • Bombs use Bounces - Enabled by default, this causes Bombs to use Bounce ammunition.
  • Weapon Recoil - Enabled by default, this causes weapons discharge to push your ship in the opposite direction.
  • Explosive Asteroids - Enabled by default, this causes medium sized Explosive Asteroids to sometimes spawn. Destroying these will cause an explosion equivalent to a Bomb detonation with normal bullets.
  • Explosive Bounce Asteroids - Enabled by default, this causes medium sized Explosive Bounce Asteroids to sometimes spawn. Destroying these will cause an explosion equivalent to a Bomb detonation with Bounce bullets.
  • Random Powerups - Enabled by default, this will cause Powerups to spawn in random order. When disabled, Powerups will spawn sequentially by type.
  • Shootable Powerups - Disabled by default, this will allow the player to pickup Powerups by shooting them with bullets or Lasers.

Soundtrack

The game features 7 custom composed tracks of electro/drone music by Johannes 'johno' Norneby.

Steam Leaderboards

Specific to the Steam release, the game now stores high scores in the Steam Leaderboards. It is thereby possible to prove that you are indeed the best UfoPilot : Astro-Creeps Elite player in the known universe.

data.name: The Caribou Trail
data.detailed_description:
THE CARIBOU TRAIL - Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

Gallipoli, 1915.

Far from home, Fisher leaves his quiet harbor town in Newfoundland to join the British war effort with his friends. They expect a short-lived adventure full of tales to bring back home.

What awaits them is not glory, but dirt, loss… and a touch of madness. The quiet gestures that hold a regiment together, the impossible choices, the weight of survival and... well, dubious stews no one back home would dare to call edible.

The Caribou Trail is a visceral, first-person narrative experience about a band of friends sent on some of the most unlikely missions of the Great War.

Inspired by real testimonies, The Caribou Trail blends history with fiction to portray a rarely explored front of WWI: Gallipoli, from the landing to the final evacuation.

Cut through barbed wire in no man’s land on a desperate reconnaissance mission, silence a sniper holding the line, and make noise during a chaotic evacuation. Each step is experienced through your own eyes.

Yet this is not about winning the war, it’s about enduring it. Explore the back lines, feel the weight of anticipation, stumble through the trenches, reclaim the dog tags of fallen comrades, and share stories with those who still have the strength to speak. Sit by the fire, share ghostly tales (that may or may not be true), and find warmth around the campfire.

When the time comes, you may choose to pull the trigger… or not. Every gesture brings you closer to the men who laugh beside you… and fall before you.

There is no score. No kill count. Only resilience, fleeting friendship, and the fragile hope of making it home.

War may take everything, but it also builds bonds.

You and your companions are not hardened soldiers, but ordinary men: fishermen, dreamers, storytellers; cooking fish’n’brews in battered pots, laughing at bad jokes, and clinging to one another when silence grows too heavy.

In the chaos, these small rituals become lifelines - reminders of who you are, and of who's fighting alongside you. What begins as survival becomes brotherhood, etched into memory long after the guns fall silent.

Gordon - Insufferable and lovable. Always the center of attention. He'll crack a joke or roast you at the worst moment possible, but he'll be there for you no matter what.

Lonnie - A whimsical, dreamy kid who doesn't belong, but still strives to do his best. What he lacks in military prowess, he compensates with his warmth and spirit. He'll even share a good spooky story or two to change the mood…

Fisher - You are the middle brother, constantly defusing (or participating in) Gordo and Lon's bickering. In the face of the war's horrors, you define Fisher's willingness to see things as they are, or instead delve into superstitious escapism.

These are the faces you will remember long after Gallipoli.

When night falls, the line between reality and imagination blurs.

Are the shadows in the trenches just tricks of the firelight, or spirits drawn to the living? In The Caribou Trail, folklore and psychological horror intertwine, echoing how soldiers made sense of a world that no longer did.

What you find may not change history, but it might change you.

  • Visceral First-Person Experience

    Feel the closeness of the trenches, the weight of silence, cut through barbed wire, crawl across no man’s land.

  • Narrative Exploration

    Explore the camp between battles: the waiting, the daily lives of ordinary soldiers, and the quiet moments that speak louder than combat.

  • Friendship & Humor

    Share ghost stories, laugh with comrades, and improvise suspicious stew together because survival is found in warmth and laughter, not in gunfire.

  • Folklore & Psychological Horror

    Face the blurred line between reality and myth as campfire tales echo into the darkness.

  • Inspired by Real Events

    Rooted in historical testimonies and the legacy of those who lived through Gallipoli.

  • Original Score & Immersive Sound Design

    A haunting and gut-wrenching soundtrack paired with realistic ambient sounds to reflect the emotional weight of each moment.

  • Stylized Visuals

    A semi-stylized art direction inspired by archival photography, evoking memory, loss, and timelessness.

Sit by the fire, share ghostly tales (that may or may not be true), and find warmth around the campfire.

When the time comes, you may choose to pull the trigger… or not. Every gesture brings you closer to the men who laugh beside you… and fall before you.

There is no score. No kill count. Only resilience, fleeting friendship, and the fragile hope of making it home.

War may take everything, but it also builds bonds.

You and your companions are not hardened soldiers, but ordinary men: fishermen, dreamers, storytellers; cooking fish’n’brews in battered pots, laughing at bad jokes, and clinging to one another when silence grows too heavy.

In the chaos, these small rituals become lifelines - reminders of who you are, and of who's fighting alongside you. What begins as survival becomes brotherhood, etched into memory long after the guns fall silent.

Gordon - Insufferable and lovable. Always the center of attention. He'll crack a joke or roast you at the worst moment possible, but he'll be there for you no matter what.

Lonnie - A whimsical, dreamy kid who doesn't belong, but still strives to do his best. What he lacks in military prowess, he compensates with his warmth and spirit. He'll even share a good spooky story or two to change the mood…

Fisher - You are the middle brother, constantly defusing (or participating in) Gordo and Lon's bickering. In the face of the war's horrors, you define Fisher's willingness to see things as they are, or instead delve into superstitious escapism.

These are the faces you will remember long after Gallipoli.

When night falls, the line between reality and imagination blurs.

Are the shadows in the trenches just tricks of the firelight, or spirits drawn to the living? In The Caribou Trail, folklore and psychological horror intertwine, echoing how soldiers made sense of a world that no longer did.

What you find may not change history, but it might change you.

  • Visceral First-Person Experience

    Feel the closeness of the trenches, the weight of silence, cut through barbed wire, crawl across no man’s land.

  • Narrative Exploration

    Explore the camp between battles: the waiting, the daily lives of ordinary soldiers, and the quiet moments that speak louder than combat.

  • Friendship & Humor

    Share ghost stories, laugh with comrades, and improvise suspicious stew together because survival is found in warmth and laughter, not in gunfire.

  • Folklore & Psychological Horror

    Face the blurred line between reality and myth as campfire tales echo into the darkness.

  • Inspired by Real Events

    Rooted in historical testimonies and the legacy of those who lived through Gallipoli.

  • Original Score & Immersive Sound Design

    A haunting and gut-wrenching soundtrack paired with realistic ambient sounds to reflect the emotional weight of each moment.

  • Stylized Visuals

    A semi-stylized art direction inspired by archival photography, evoking memory, loss, and timelessness.
data.short_description: The WWI story where your goal isn’t to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

data.name: 幻想三国志4
data.detailed_description:
重要通知


About the Game

《幻想三国志4》是由宇峻奥汀研发、寰宇之星和游戏天堂联合代理的单机角色扮演游戏 。
故事背景设定在第一代的约十年之后，除了开展系列作中最新进展的剧情，也继承了前几代三国战役及独特的世界观，历史人物、军师猛将也在此代出现。

公元208年赤壁之战后，蚩尤现世、群魔乱舞。而后蚩尤伏诛，神州各地自此宛如惊弓之鸟，各尊神佛、各拥仙灵，大规模的猎魔行动从此展开。魔族馀孽被逼四处逃窜，或隐匿行藏，或群起反抗，原本便已纷乱垂危的汉室天下，因此步入更黑暗的时期。

公元215年，正值刘备入蜀、自领益州牧，孙权回秣陵、得荆州三郡，曹操平定汉中、称魏王，就在三方势力明争暗斗、互有增长的同时，一个名不见经传的少年却在紊乱的世局中掀起滔天巨浪。

阵型系统

《幻想三国志4》阵型系统，阵型范围及策略性大幅提升。本作敌方人数为5x3，最大同时可以有15位敌人进行战斗；我方角色则为3x3，战斗人数也增为6位，展开同时共有21人参与战斗的大混战！

化神系统

化神系统大幅提高神兽支持的地位，变为主要战斗角色。只要在阵型编制接口设定好支持神兽，进入战斗后不需经过召唤就自动出现于战场上，并且会依据玩家所指定的阵型位置就位。

Hello, this is a simple retro car drifting game.

Game Features

  • Steam leaderboard support.

  • Collect as many small wrenches as possible to increase your score.
  • Avoid obstacles on the road.

data.name: Salome's Kiss
data.detailed_description:
Letitia Reed is an unremarkable woman in many aspects. Meek and mild, she prefers to keep her head down, and fears drawing undue attention to herself. As a governess to the wealthy Mortimer family, Letitia devotes her humdrum days in London to the schooling of her pupil, Clara, to better mould her into the image of an ideal lady.

Lurking beneath Letitia’s placid mannerisms, however, lay desires so intense they begin to unnerve her. As Clara matures, Letitia finds her feelings towards her maturing too – until, in the end, she can no longer bear it.

Driven to distraction by Clara’s sensuous brown eyes and her sweet, seraphic laughter, Letitia soon begins to question her sanity. Fearful that, eventually, something within her might snap, and she will do something she regrets, Letitia is bidden to leave her former place of employment, and to seek out work elsewhere.

Fortunately, Letitia soon discovers, in the pages of The Morning Post, a job offer which will grant her a means to escape her predicament. The Langley family are searching for a governess for their daughter, the unruly Genevieve – and, best of all, the family resides in the isolated Yorkshire moors, which seems as far away from London as it is possible to get.

Upon reading this advertisement, Letitia soon decides to hand in her notice. She will travel to Yorkshire, become Genevieve’s governess, and then – God willing – she will be able to forget about Clara.

Such was Letitia’s plan – but this plan, alas, soon goes horribly awry. Genevieve is not quite so young as Letitia first believed, and is, instead, a grown woman: already eighteen years of age. Genevieve is wilful and impetuous, but impossibly charming, and Letitia soon falls for her.

As time passes, the two women get far closer than a governess and her pupil ought, and then…

  • About 120k words of text (approx 4-8 hours of reading)

  • A kinetic story with no choices/branches

  • Detailed character and background artwork

  • A custom OST

  • A dramatic gothic romance story

  • Suffering

data.name: Botlands
data.detailed_description:
You don't play the sports. Your bot does.

Botlands is about making your own bot, and testing in different minigames other players built.

<h2>Build a brain, then live with it</h2>

Socialize in the hub, compete in matches, and gain Unicoins to expand your inventory. Improve your bot, challenge it against other player in real-time or asynchronous multiplayer.

Wins and losses move Elo. Beating a heavier brain pays more than beating a tiny one. Weight class comes from how many nodes you stuffed into the graph, so a clever lightweight can still pick on something huge.

A whole island of games

  • Tennis

  • Soccer (Football)

  • Racing

  • Volleyball

  • Parking

  • Demo Derby

  • Survival

Watch the match. Tweak the graph. Try it at something else. Publish again.

data.name: Learn Japanese
data.detailed_description:
Usually learning a new language requires significant determination and dedication, but this game requires neither! Learn Japanese is a language learning simulation game where players actually learn the Japanese language. Learn Japanese aims to provide an innovative method to learn the Japanese language. The learning process is intuitive so that players can learn the Japanese language very naturally with minimal effort. By the end of the game, you will have learned the basics of the language.

Learn Japanese is the fastest way to learn the Japanese language because players will learn the Japanese characters, words and grammar at the same time. Players will solve puzzles together with instructors. In the process of puzzle solving, players will naturally learn the Japanese language.

The game is very beginner friendly and will familiarize players with the basics of the Japanese language. If you are interested in learning the Japanese language, this game will be an excellent starting point. Even if you are not interested, knowing the basics of a language must be useful and will deepen your insight into the world.

Learning a language should not be something stressful. With Learn Japanese, learning a language is like playing a game!

Features
Lesson mode and practice mode
English text and voice instruction
Japanese pronunciation
Players will learn the Japanese characters (Hiragana), words and grammar
